data.title: Associate Manager - BQ QMS and Compliance
data.description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Every day, our unwavering commitment to quality ensures the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented culture is rooted in science and risk-based compliance. Whether you are engaged in development, maintenance, compliance, or research analysis, your contributions have a direct impact on patient care. By being part of our team, you help uphold a quality culture that adapts and evolves to meet the needs of patients, ensuring that every product we deliver meets the highest standards of safety and efficacy. 

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will: 

- Create, review, and approve test method transfer and validation protocols, reports, and equipment qualification records. 
 - Maintain compliance with Current Good Manufacturing Practices in Quality Control and Stability laboratories. 
 - Support in investigations and critical assessments. 
 - Change control process owner, tracking CAPA and BQ Metrics. 
 - Manage Laboratory Information Management System builds, and review laboratory data. 
 - Serve on cross-functional teams, conduct safety inspections, participate in audit walkthrough and responses, recommend corrective actions, and train junior colleagues. 

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

- M. Sc. Microbiology with 8+ years of industrial experience with any years of relevant experience
 - Strong technical skills in Change management, Risk management and Investigations. 
 - Experience in microbiological testing and technical review. 
 - Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, packaging, and quality assurance operations
 - Detail-oriented with robust knowledge of quality systems
 - Effective written and verbal communication, as well as interpersonal skills

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

- Relevant pharmaceutical experience
 - Strong understanding of computer system utilization. 
 - Experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
 - Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation
 - Knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines
 - Strong problem-solving abilities
 - Effective time management and organizational skills
 - Ability to mentor and train junior colleagues

Work Location Assignment: On Premise

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software development. 
 - 5 years of experience with building and developing infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies. 
 - 2 years of experience in a people mentorship supervision role. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- 8 years of experience testing, and launching software products. 
 - 5 years of experience with software design and architecture. 
 - Experience with cloud computing platforms (e. g. , Google Cloud Platform, etc. ). 
 - Experience writing high-quality Java/C++/Python code. 

About The Job

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. 

Responsibilities

- Deliver production-ready code for Compliance and Platform Infrastructure in Google Workspace. 
 - Design scalable and performant storage solutions. Drive the technical design for features, making data-driven decisions to optimize system efficiency and reliability. 
 - Identify and resolve performance issues and intricate system issues. Develop innovative, practical solutions to technical challenges that arise at the intersection of infrastructure and machine learning. 
 - Partner with product and engineering stakeholders across the storage domain to deliver high complexity features and products. 
 - Research into the existing usage, understanding API and service boundaries, identifying customer needs, and finding existing pain points. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Test Engineering Lead
data.description:
Job Description

Change the world. Love your job. 

The Test Engineering Lead manages the planning, development, and implementation of procedures for the testing and evaluation of standard and special devices. In this role, you are expected to lead TE activities for the program including managing interactions and alignments with the cross functional teams. Test Lead specifies tests to be performed, compiles data, and makes recommendations for changes required in testing equipment procedures, manufacturing processes, new testing requirements and/or design of testing equipment. You will also recommend the purchase of test equipment and select, develop and evaluate personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. 

Responsibilities Include

- Develop and drive innovation in test to drive test cost to entitlement
 - Optimize production test programs, including test time reduction activities, and yield Improvement
 - Develop and drive TI technology for Design for Test (DFT), design verification, failure analysis and qualification of products
 - Translate defect driven test suites to production test solutions that also validate spec performance
 - Create and implement highly optimized tester agnostic& design centric test methods
 - Analyze test data to thoroughly understand and resolve problems
 - Present analysis and conclusions to internal customer teams in a comprehensive and effective manner
 - Lead TE activities for the entire program including managing interactions and alignments with the cross functional teams
 - Lead, coach, and train a team of product/test engineers to a higher level of performance and ability

Qualifications

Minimum requirements: 

- Bachelors in Electrical Engineering
 - 8-15 years of relevant experience
 - Proven history of technical accomplishment, leadership, planning, coordinating, executing on multiple projects simultaneously for all silicon verification, characterization, qualification, capacity and test cost reduction activities
 - Great breadth of test platform and test technologies
 - Advanced level of understanding and use of Advantest and Teradyne/Eagle ATE
 - Probe Burn-In stress application & testing methods experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Architectural model level understanding and familiarity with digital designs in TI (Verilog and VHDL designs
 - Track record of innovation in the test methods resulting in elimination of Burn-In
 - Willingness to learn new things even when it might not directly be related to the job role/responsibility
 - Experience working with demanding customers with the highest standards in quality and reliability
 - Demonstrated leadership skills with confidant and charismatic personality
 - Demonstrated strong analytical, critical thinking and problem solving skills
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
 - Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
 - Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
 - Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

About Us

Why TI?

- Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics. 
 - We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI 
 - Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well-being is important to us. Please find our country-specific benefits here

About Texas Instruments

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI. com . 

Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment. 

If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.

TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

Keep GSK's standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section. 

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK's Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment. 

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner's backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Reliability: achieve 99. 9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred. 
 - Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards. 
 - Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team's time. 
 - AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails. 
 - Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline. 
 - Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting. 
 - Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours. 
 - Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect's reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 - Area of Specialisation
 - Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
 - Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts. undefined
 - Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
 - Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
 - Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert). 
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

Skills

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Senior Director
data.description:
Sr. Director - AI & Software Engineering

India |Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time| Hands-on technical leadership

Location - Bengaluru/Gurgaon/Noida/Pune/Mumbai/Chennai/Hyderabad

Straive is seeking a hands-on technology leader to serve as the senior technical authority for our AI, analytics, and software engineering solutions. 

About the Role: 

You will set technical direction, resolve complex engineering challenges, and move solutions from prototype to secure, scalable production. The role combines architecture and execution leadership including a mandate to improve enterprise AI economics through fit-for-purpose frontier, open-source, and smaller models. 

This is not a conventional delivery-governance role. You will remain close to the technology, lead critical design and code reviews, mentor teams, and take accountability for high-stakes technical outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Production-Grade Engineering

- Own engineering standards across architecture, development, testing, deployment, security, observability, and documentation. 
 - Ensure prototypes have a credible production path; introduce architecture and code reviews, automated testing, quality gates, and release-readiness checks. 
 - Close gaps in scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and security from design through deployment. 2. AI Architecture and Economics

- Define scalable, reliable, and cost-effective AI/GenAI architectures based on accuracy, cost, latency, privacy, and deployment needs. 
 - Lead selection, evaluation, fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment of frontier, open-source, small, and domain-specific models. 
 - Reduce operating cost through model routing, caching, quantization, batching, retrieval and prompt optimization; design robust RAG and agentic systems with evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and human oversight. 3. Technical Architecture and Platforms

- Serve as the final escalation point for complex architecture, performance, security, and deployment issues. 
 - Guide modular applications, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, AI services, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Promote reusable components and strong cloud-native, CI/CD, observability, data governance, and secure-development practices. 4. Team Capability

- Mentor architects, engineering leads, data scientists, and developers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical workshops. 
 - Build independent problem-solving capability, identify skill gaps, and support targeted hiring and development. 
 - Create a culture of engineering ownership, technical rigor, experimentation, and continuous improvement. 5. Client Solutioning and Innovation

- Partner with commercial, consulting, and delivery teams on client workshops, proposals, due diligence, and solution design. 
 - Assess feasibility, architecture, effort, risk, and operating cost; translate business problems into pragmatic technical roadmaps. 
 - Develop reference architectures and accelerators that strengthen Straive's differentiation and delivery speed. Required Experience and Qualifications

- 12-18 years across software engineering, architecture, data platforms, AI/ML, or related roles, including experience in a startup, product company, or similarly fast-moving environment. 
 - Proven ownership of enterprise-grade software, data, or AI products from architecture through production adoption. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering background, preferably in Python and modern backend/frontend technologies. 
 - Practical GenAI experience spanning RAG, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, safety controls, and production monitoring. 
 - Strong command of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, cloud-native architecture, enterprise integration, and at least one major cloud platform. 
 - Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, secure development, and modern data platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ability to improve solution cost, latency, scalability, reliability, and engineering quality. 
 - Experience mentoring senior technical professionals and communicating complex decisions to business and client leaders. Preferred Experience

- Multi-tenant platforms, reusable AI accelerators, MLOps/LLMOps, model governance, or regulated and security-sensitive environments. 
 - Technical pre-sales, client workshops, proposals, solution estimation, and technical due diligence. 
 - A track record of taking multiple AI or software products from concept to sustained production use. Leadership Profile

- Hands-on and accountable: Stays close to code and architecture and drives critical issues to resolution. 
 - Commercially pragmatic: Balances technical ambition with client value, speed, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Constructive challenger: Identifies weaknesses early, challenges assumptions, and raises engineering standards. 
 - Capability builder: Develops strong, independent teams rather than becoming the sole source of expertise. Why Join Straive?

You will shape how enterprise-grade AI solutions are architected, built, and scaled with the mandate to influence technical strategy, strengthen engineering practices, develop high-performing teams, and deliver differentiated solutions for global clients.

data.description:
Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Bentley Systems is seeking a Manager, Software Development to join the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud Portal team. The Portal serves as a foundational platform connecting Bentley's infrastructure solutions and enabling seamless experiences across projects, assets, users, organizations, and shared services. 

In this role, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-based platform capabilities. You will build high-performing teams while driving engineering excellence, technical execution, and delivery of strategic initiatives. Working closely with Product Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, UX, and Quality Engineering, you will help shape technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions, and advance Bentley's Infrastructure Cloud vision. 

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing software engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation. 
 - Provide ongoing feedback, performance management, mentoring, and career development support for team members. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and retain top engineering talent while supporting workforce planning and succession planning. 
 - Drive the delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-based platform capabilities. 
 - Partner with Technical Leads and Architects to drive technical strategy, architectural direction, and key engineering decisions. 
 - Establish and maintain high standards for software quality, performance, reliability, security, testing, and operational excellence. 
 - Promote modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, automation, observability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Align engineering execution with product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives. 
 - Use data, telemetry, and engineering insights to improve team effectiveness, product quality, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, UX, Quality Engineering, and peer engineering leaders to achieve shared goals and remove delivery barriers. 
 - Champion Bentley's vision, values, and strategic priorities while helping teams understand how their work contributes to broader business outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline. 
 - 5+ years of people management experience leading and developing software engineering teams. 
 - 8+ years of software development experience building enterprise-scale applications, platforms, or cloud services. 
 - Demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and developing software engineers and emerging leaders. 
 - Strong technical background with the ability to participate in architecture discussions, evaluate technical trade-offs, and influence technical direction. 
 - Experience designing, building, and operating cloud-based software products, platforms, or services at scale. 
 - Experience evaluating, building, or delivering AI-enabled features, developer productivity solutions, or intelligent platform capabilities. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native development, security, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience driving engineering excellence across code quality, testing, CI/CD, reliability, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Proven ability to build engaged, high-performing teams and establish credibility with senior engineers, technical leads, and architects. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed teams and cross-functional partners. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to balance people leadership, technical leadership, engineering execution, and business priorities. 

This is a Hybrid role. 

What We Offer

- Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success. 
 - An attractive salary and benefits package. 
 - Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice. 
 - Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform. 
 - A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
 - Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world's infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact. 

Who We Are

Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Job Description

Key Responsibilities

- Global Engineering Leadership & India Expansion
 - Lead and scale a high-performing global engineering organization, including building and expanding the India team supporting Acquisition and Open Banking platforms. 
 - Establish a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive talent strategy across hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Foster an inclusive, accountable environment that promotes collaboration, technical excellence, and leadership growth.

 - Own the design and evolution of API-first, event-driven platforms enabling digital acquisition and real-time underwriting. 
 - Architect decoupled systems separating customer journeys, decisioning, and core banking platforms to improve scalability and agility. 
 - Establish reusable platform capabilities (decisioning, identity, fraud, KYC, and data integration) consumable across products, channels, and partners. 
 - Drive engineering excellence in distributed systems, scalability, and secure Open Banking integrations. 
 - Execution, Delivery & Operational Performance
 - Lead delivery of the product and platform roadmap with clear accountability for business outcomes, quality, and operational stability. 
 - Ensure predictable, on-time, and within-budget execution while meeting security, compliance, and reliability standards. 
 - Promote strong engineering practices, including high-quality code, sound design decisions, and production stability. 
 - Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and strategic goals. 
 - Technical Leadership & Architectural Governance
 - Provide strategic architectural direction, aligning solutions to business needs, enterprise standards, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Ensure designs are scalable, resilient, maintainable, and testable, with clear handling of dependencies and failure scenarios. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and design forums, driving consistency and simplification across platforms. 
 - Continuously simplify systems to improve speed, reliability, and supportability. 
 - Cross-Functional Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement
 - Partner with product, business, risk, and architecture leaders to define and deliver acquisition and underwriting capabilities. 
 - Influence roadmap decisions by balancing engineering strategy, customer experience, risk, and delivery constraints. 
 - Drive alignment across teams to enable efficient, end-to-end value delivery across the ecosystem. 
 - Communicate architecture, strategy, and delivery risks clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders. 
 - Resiliency, Risk & Operational Excellence
 - Define and enforce resiliency standards (tiering, SLOs, failover strategies) for mission-critical acquisition and underwriting flows. 
 - Ensure high availability and low-latency performance for real-time decisioning systems. 
 - Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements across the platform. 

Technical Scope

The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong hands-on technical leadership and credibility in designing and delivering modern, distributed, and scalable platforms. This role leads engineering teams building API-first acquisition and Open Banking solutions, with a focus on real-time decisioning, resiliency, performance, and regulatory compliance. 

Core Technical Expectations

- Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems, with a strong emphasis on modularity, extensibility, and testability. 
 - Lead development of microservices, APIs, SDKs, and front-end components (MFE) using Java, Spring Boot, and modern UI frameworks aligned to API-driven architectures. 
 - Architect low-latency, high-throughput platforms to support real-time acquisition flows and credit decisioning workloads. 
 - Enable seamless integration across channels and partners through well-defined RESTful APIs and event-driven communication patterns. 
 - Apply event-driven architecture principles using Kafka and related streaming technologies to support asynchronous processing and real-time data flows. 
 - Leverage cloud-native and container-based platforms, including Kubernetes, Istio, Rancher, and API gateways (Apigee), to enable scalability, observability, and secure service communication 
 - Establish modern DevOps and CI/CD practices using tools such as Jenkins/CloudBees and GitLab, ensuring automated testing, deployment, and release management. 
 - Enforce best practices in source control, code quality, and agile delivery, driving consistency, speed, and reliability across engineering teams. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues, ensuring rapid recovery, root cause analysis, and continuous system improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience designing and delivering modern, distributed software systems. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams, including globally distributed/offshore teams. 
 - Proven expertise building and scaling platform-based solutions with measurable business impact. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams in delivering complex, multi-stakeholder products in fast-paced, enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering practices, architecture patterns, and enterprise development tools. 
 - Ability to translate business strategy into technology and engineering outcomes, driving alignment across product, risk, and engineering. 
 - Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, scrum teams, business stakeholders, and external partners. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong domain expertise in customer acquisition, credit underwriting, and Open Banking ecosystems. 
 - Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries, with an understanding of risk, compliance, and security requirements. 
 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, API platforms, and event-driven integration patterns. 
 - Experience leading modernization initiatives, including integrating new platforms with legacy systems in enterprise environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance feature delivery, technical debt, and operational reliability at scale. 
 - Experience with cloud-native platforms and engineering ecosystems (Azure, containers, CI/CD, API management). 
 - Relevant certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, or Cloud technologies are a plus. 

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks and operates at a platform and ecosystem level, considering impacts across domains, customer journeys, and partner integrations. 
 - Demonstrates deep understanding of end-to-end acquisition and underwriting flows, including users, systems, and business outcomes. 
 - Proactively addresses ambiguity, risks, and dependencies, guiding teams toward sound, data-driven decisions. 
 - Builds a culture of strong engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountability. 
 - Combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and disciplined execution to deliver consistent results. 
 - Effectively represents and scales global engineering teams, especially across India and U. S. -based stakeholders. 

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants. 

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. 

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.title: Solution Architect
data.description:
WirelessCar's Journey

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands-like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover-innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

As a Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience, you will help shape and evolve the architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle - from business needs and early design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution. You will work closely with our development teams and other architects to turn business needs into secure, scalable and sustainable technical solutions. 

Our environment is primarily built around AWS, but also Azure, using modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to technology while helping teams make good architectural decisions. You won't be working in isolation. Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort, and an important part of your role will be creating alignment and helping teams make sound technical decisions. 

Your Impact: 

- Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services. 
 - Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 - Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs. 
 - Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions and their implications clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software. 
 - Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects. 

What We're Looking For

- You are a technically experienced and pragmatic person who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details. 
 - You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping a team reach a good solution. 
 - You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation. 

We believe you bring: 

- Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure. 
 - A strong background in software engineering and modern agile development practices. 
 - Experience designing distributed systems and working with areas such as APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures. 
 - An understanding of non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance and cost. 
 - Programming experience in Java, Python or similar languages, allowing you to engage meaningfully with development teams and implementation decisions. 
 - Experience communicating technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to different audiences. 
 - Experience working collaboratively across teams and disciplines in complex development environments. It would be a plus if you have
 - Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms or similar cloud-native technologies. 
 - Experience with system or data migration initiatives. 
 - Interest in or experience with AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning platforms or applying AI to improve engineering and product capabilities. 
 - Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures. 
 - Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements. 
 - Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed development teams. 
 - Knowledge of the automotive industry, connected vehicles or large-scale IoT solutions. 
 - Relevant AWS, Azure or other cloud certifications. 

To join our journey

WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world. 

Way of working

At WirelessCar we believe in a Hybrid Remote work setup. The work location is Bangalore. 

- Applicants must have a valid work permit for: xxxx .

Job Description

Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.

At Electrolux, we are at the forefront of Digital Transformation, designing smart, centralized solutions that power seamless communication across systems, connect with third-party platforms and serve as the backbone for Master Data across the organization. 

Our mission? To deliver high-performance, scalable software that drives real business value, across Europe, North America and APAC. 

If you're motivated by complex challenges, love clean architecture and want your work to be seen and used globally - we would love to meet you. 

What you'll do:

Who Are You

- 8+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, preferably with experience from data-intensive or high-volume transactional systems.

 - Strong programming experience in one or more modern backend languages such as Typescript or Java. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, API-first development, domain-driven design, SOLID principles and clean architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience with NoSQL/document databases, preferably MongoDB, including data modeling, query optimization, indexing and performance tuning.

You are a pragmatic and experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems with clean, maintainable solutions. You care about performance, reliability and long-term quality, but you also understand the importance of delivering business value iteratively. 

You are comfortable working in a distributed environment, collaborating with architects, engineers, product owners and stakeholders to shape solutions that can scale globally. You take ownership, challenge assumptions constructively and help raise the engineering standard of the team.

Desirable Experience

- MongoDB cluster administration or advanced MongoDB performance optimization.

 - SAP-based systems, enterprise integrations, or data migration. 
 - Master data, product data, pricing, customer data, or commerce-related domains. 
 - Caching strategies, CQRS, read models, or other patterns for high-performance data access. 
 - Azure certifications or hands-on experience with Azure platform management. 

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. 

Why work for Electrolux?

- Build at scale: Lead the development of mission-critical digital commerce experiences used by thousands of customers daily. 
 - Own the architecture: Influence core technical decisions and help evolve our platform for high scalability, resiliency, and flexibility. 
 - Modern tech stack: Work with cutting-edge tools in cloud, commerce, and full-stack engineering. 
 - Empowered leadership: Drive strategy and execution while mentoring a world-class engineering team.

data.title: Leader, Hardware Engineering
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms-like Silicon One-are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development-from design to qualification to production-is within our team, we're able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. The Enterprise Routing organization designs and develops Cisco's Edge and Access routing products. We architect the next generation of routing technology using both internally developed and commercially available silicon. The team designs, implements, and delivers industry leading routing products. You will be part of the dynamic and passionate team working on innovative projects. 

Your Impact

As the Leader of the Enterprise Routing India hardware engineering team, you will: 

- Lead a dedicated team of Hardware Design engineers on a mission to deliver next generation routing products. 
 - Drive hardware product development from concept to production. 
 - Lead your team through the entire design process from requirements definition, hardware specification, design, development, test and introduction into volume production.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering + 12+ years of related experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience in hardware design and development. 
 - Experience in managing teams and leading technical projects. 
 - Experience leading teams through specification, design, and development of complex electronic systems including component selection, schematic design, printed circuit board design, system bring-up, debug and qualification. 
 - Experience leading programs from concept through all stages of development and into production. 
 - Experience working with cross functional teams of mechanical, signal integrity, ECAD, manufacturing engineers, etc. to deliver high quality products. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience designing networking equipment like routers and switches is a plus. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. data.title: Lead Full Stack Data Engineer
data.description:
The Lead Full Stack Data Engineer owns Data products across the full lifecycle: from data ingestion and transformation through to semantic modelling, reporting, documentation, and user adoption. Working closely with commercial, operations, finance, and clinical stakeholders, the role translates complex and often ambiguous business requirements into clear, reliable, and scalable Analytics solutions built on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. 

This position requires strong technical capability across data engineering and Analytics, a structured analytical mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

About Role

- Design, build, and support end-to-end data products from ingestion through to reporting and analytics.

 - Define and enforce ETL/ELT standards, performance optimization practices, and engineering best practices.

 - Drive CI/CD adoption using GitHub, including branching strategies, automated testing, and deployment pipelines.

- Apply data quality checks, validation frameworks, monitoring, and issue resolution processes.

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Data Engineers.

 - Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.

 - Experience working with enterprise source systems (e. g. ERP, CRM, finance systems). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. 
 - Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.

Education/ Qualifications

- Bachelor/Masters in a relevant field (e. g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.

This transformation together with Lenovo's world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www. lenovo. com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. 

About The Role

As a Staff AI Quality Engineer for the Qira AI Platform, you will lead the technical test strategy and architectural validation for Lenovo's cross-device agentic AI ecosystem. You will serve as the technical authority on evaluating non-deterministic systems, designing automated quality platforms that operate across personal computing form factors (PCs, tablets, and smartphones). You will drive non-functional quality standards-ensuring that privacy, security, accessibility, internationalization, and device thermals/battery efficiency are safeguarded-while acting as a crucial release partner alongside Product Management and PMO leads. 

What Will You Do

- Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness. 
 - Agentic AI Quality Frameworks: Design automated evaluation methodologies to validate multi-step agent reasoning, tool-calling graphs, autonomous error recovery, and transactional rollback mechanisms; establish statistical release gates for non-deterministic model behaviors. 
 - Hardware Runtime Resource Profiling: Formulate automated performance and endurance soak suites to benchmark on-device SLM execution against cloud fallback paths, monitoring thermal throttling, memory leaks, and battery draw across hardware device tiers. 
 - Non-Functional Quality Standards: Lead automated verification across non-functional pillars: red-teaming indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities, securing inter-process data barriers, standardizing automated accessibility (screen-reader verbosity, dynamic token streaming), and validating semantic fidelity across international locales. 
 - CI/CD Quality Pipelines Gating: Drive the technical implementation of shift-left gating in continuous integration pipelines, establishing automated failure analytics, regression detection, and flakiness isolation frameworks. 
 - Cross-Functional Peer Leadership: Serve as a core technical gatekeeper alongside Product Management and PMO; establish release acceptance criteria, lead data-informed risk assessments during schedule compressions, and influence platform design for enhanced testability. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of progressive software quality engineering, test architecture, and automation experience covering multi-device hardware ecosystems (Windows and Android). 
 - 3+ years of experience leading quality strategy and automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic AI workflows, or conversational platforms. 
 - Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons. 
 - Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation. 
 - Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on expertise implementing and tuning non-deterministic evaluation platforms (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, TruLens) in production pipelines. 
 - Direct experience testing local NPU runtimes and quantized models (INT4/INT8 vs. FP16) on client silicon (Qualcomm, Intel, AMD). 
 - Background designing automated testing for multimodal inputs (synchronized voice injection, screen-capture parsing, synthetic system events). 
 - Demonstrated ability to resolve complex release-gating disputes with Product Management and PMO using objective risk metrics and clear mitigation trade-offs.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II
data.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

Introduction to the team

You will be joining Travels Foundation, Expedia Group's core platform powering pre and post-booking journeys at global scale. At its heart, the Ordering Services team owns the end-to-end lifecycle of every trip-from checkout to post-booking-across all major travel products. 

We're looking for an experienced backend engineer and strong technologist to build and evolve highly scalable, low-latency systems that power millions of bookings every day. 

Operating at the core of Expedia's transaction platform, our systems process millions of orders and updates daily, ensuring reliability, consistency, and auditability across brands and channels through domain-driven APIs. 

Join us to shape and scale the ordering platform that underpins Expedia Group's global travel marketplace. 

As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate key components of Expedia Group's Ordering Services platform, powering critical booking, reservation, and order management experiences across the travel ecosystem. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality, scalable, and reliable services that support order creation, modification, fulfilment, and lifecycle management while ensuring a seamless experience for travelers and partner teams. 

You will be a hands-on engineer, contributing code, driving technical design discussions, improving system reliability, and collaborating closely with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Your work will directly impact the scalability, performance, and resilience of the Ordering Services domain, enabling millions of travel transactions to be processed accurately and efficiently while accelerating innovation across Expedia Group's customer experiences. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance services and applications, contributing to end-to-end feature delivery across multiple domains. 
 - Implement clean, testable code, including system design (low-level design), API design, and data modeling, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable. 
 - Collaborate with peers, product, and operations teams to translate business and customer requirements into technical solutions, using data and metrics to guide decisions. 
 - Own the full software development lifecycle for your services, including code reviews, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational support in production environments.

 - Demonstrated ability to design and implement service- or API-based solutions, including basic data modeling and system design within a single service or small set of services. 
 - Experience collaborating in an agile environment, owning features from design through deployment, and supporting them in production within a team or product area. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing and evolving service architectures, including thoughtful low-level design, API contracts, and data models that support reliability, performance, and extensibility. 
 - Proven experience operating systems at scale, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and cost. 
 - Track record of using data and experimentation to drive engineering decisions, optimize user experiences, and improve system behavior. 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating AI/ML‐enabled capabilities into existing services. 
 - Experience contributing to technical direction within a team through code and design feedback, and applying modern engineering practices (e. g. , automation, security-by-design, performance tuning) to elevate overall code quality. 

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https: //expedia. service-now. com/askeg?id=job_accommodation. 

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels. com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. data.title: Engineering Manager 2
data.description:

Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 77662

Description

The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB's IC Verification Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on chip-level verification. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed & complex front-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US. 

As the Verification manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving chip top level verification. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad. 

In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company. 

We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast-paced dynamic team environment. 

Responsibilities

The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US leading IC design. 

Responsibilities Will Include, But Not Be Limited To

- Recruiting & Staffing: 
 - 
 - Jointly drive staffing & recruiting with HR to ensure a world-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs. 
 - Technical Leadership: 
 - Act as the IC Verification & Technical Leader for a team focused on the verification of RFICs that are integrated into our complex front-end modules
 - Experience managing large technical teams
 - A track record of growing successful design teams
 - Ability to set & articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those 
 - Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug-tracking and reporting
 - Communication: 
 - Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1: 1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US. 
 - Travel to US will be required from time to time
Required Experience And Skills

- The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status & schedule progress to senior management. 
 - Technical requirements: 
 - Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools
 - Deep and broad expertise in functional AMS verification of RFICs including RF/Analog/Digital content
 - Develop and maintain verification plans, strategies and methodology
 - Perform functional, behavioral and regression verification
 - Collaborate with RF designers and chip leads for successful tapeout and release of products to guarantee first-pass success
 - Automate verification flows and reporting infrastructure
 - Strong debug and root-cause analysis skills
 - Circuit Analysis: 
 - Understanding of analog blocks including low bit count data converters (ADC & DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge-pumps, Temp sensor, LDO, ESD, e-fuse and other supporting cells. 
 - Knowledge of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning & RF LNA design. 
 - Digital Design including SPI & MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines. 
 - Semiconductor device and process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe. 
Minimum Requirements

- BSEE; MS preferred
 - 10+ years of IC Design/Verification experience
 - 6+ years of Technical Leadership and Management experience

Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced DevOps erve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, assessing DevOps maturity, identifying capability gaps, recommending improvement opportunities, and guiding teams through the implementation and adoption of approved standards, practices, and enterprise capabilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own and advance a designated DevOps capability domain, defining its implementation patterns, adoption strategy, technical direction, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Serve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, providing technical leadership, standards guidance, architecture direction, and capability adoption support. 
 - Lead DevOps excellence evaluations by establishing maturity baselines, assessing current-state capabilities, defining and tracking key performance indicators, performing gap analyses, measuring progress against target-state objectives, and recommending improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead DevOps capability adoption across product teams by assessing current-state maturity, identifying capability gaps, establishing implementation backlogs, defining roadmaps, and driving adoption of enterprise DevOps standards. 
 - Perform application, platform, and team readiness assessments to identify technical, operational, process, skills, and capability gaps. Conduct gap assessments against enterprise cloud requirements, engineering standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and DevOps standards, and define remediation plans to address identified deficiencies. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of DevOps transformation and implementation initiatives, including roadmap development, backlog establishment, work prioritization, effort estimation, resource planning, budget forecasting, and day-to-day delivery coordination. 
 - Assign, lead, and support DevOps Engineers embedded within product teams to accelerate capability adoption, standards implementation, platform modernization, and delivery improvements. 
 - Ensure all engagements include structured coaching, mentoring, knowledge transfer, documentation, and capability enablement activities that increase team self-sufficiency and reduce long-term dependency on embedded DevOps support. 
 - Establish clear engagement objectives, success criteria, transition plans, and exit criteria that enable operational ownership to be successfully transferred to product teams once capabilities have been adopted. 
 - Provide low-level solution architecture and low-level cloud architecture guidance, ensuring applications, platforms, delivery pipelines, and operational practices remain aligned with enterprise standards, architecture principles, and strategic technology direction. 
 - Design, review, and contribute Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application deployment specifications, automation scripts, and reusable implementations that improve scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead and promote observability and monitoring practices that improve visibility into application and platform health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Integrate security controls and tooling into development pipelines and partner with engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Apply and promote DevOps good practices, industry standards, enterprise architecture principles, and approved engineering patterns across product teams and platforms. 
 - Define and promote standard implementation patterns, ensuring teams leverage approved enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever practical and appropriate. 
 - Track delivery milestones, capability adoption progress, implementation outcomes, and team objectives, proactively identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required. 
 - Perform code reviews, architecture reviews, standards compliance reviews, and change-control assessments to identify quality, security, reliability, and compliance gaps. 
 - Promote awareness and adoption of enterprise platforms, shared services, engineering capabilities, and reusable solutions available across the organization. 
 - Create opportunities for experimentation, proof-of-concepts, pilot implementations, and innovation initiatives that improve engineering effectiveness, accelerate adoption, and support the evolution of DevOps capabilities. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, automation practices, cloud capabilities, observability approaches, and AI-driven engineering techniques, recommending solutions that improve the repeatability, reliability, security, and efficiency of software delivery. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, maintain a continuous learning mindset, and support the ongoing evolution of the assigned DevOps capability domain. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, platform engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one designated DevOps capability domain, such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, observability and monitoring, deployment automation, platform engineering, or DevSecOps. 
 - Strong technical background in DevOps practices, including cybersecurity and secure software delivery. 
 - Experience with low-level solution architecture, Infrastructure as Code, low-level cloud architecture, and observability and monitoring. 
 - Expert knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - Demonstrated understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Agile development and Scrum methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps good practices and relevant industry standards. 
 - Excellent project-management, problem-solving, and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills, including written and verbal communication. 
 - Strong English-language skills and comfort communicating in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and teach technical concepts to engineers and product teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects and capability outcomes to completion. 
 - Capability-ownership mindset with accountability for technical quality, adoption, standards, and continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with team and people leadership. 
 - Experience assessing candidates for technical positions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to quickly develop a working understanding of new technologies. 
 - Fast learner with a strong willingness to acquire and apply new skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to accept feedback and take action. 

Preferred Qualification

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, or a comparable cloud certification, is a plus

Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Data Integration team enables organizations to connect, move, and shape data across their entire data estate. As data is generated across applications, devices, and systems, our integration capabilities make it easy to ingest, transform, and prepare data for downstream use. Fabric's unified integration experience simplifies how customers bring data together, ensuring it is trusted, usable, and ready to power analytics, real-time insights, and AI scenarios. 

The Customer Data Integration (CDI) organization within Power Query is building a new Live site engineering team that serves as the first line of defense for one of Microsoft's most critical data integration services. You will own incident triage and response across Power BI, Fabric, Power Query Online, Gateway, and hundreds of data connectors, and you will build the agentic automation that makes that operation increasingly self-driving. 

This is not a passive monitoring role. You will be on call, triaging real incidents, and ensuring uptime for business-critical services. You will simultaneously build the intelligent agents, automation pipelines, and tooling that reduce manual effort with every iteration. Your goal is to make yourself more effective over time by engineering your way out of repetitive work. 

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities

- Incident triage and first-line response: Provide on-call coverage for incoming incidents across CDI services. Perform initial investigation, severity assessment, and routing to owning engineering teams. 
 - Agentic triage system development: Build and extend AI-driven agents that ingest ICM alerts, correlate with recent deployments and feature flag rollouts, check known-issue databases, and produce initial assessments with suggested severity and owning team. 
 - TSG and known-issue matching: Develop automation that matches incoming incidents to relevant Troubleshooting Guides (TSGs) and known issues across Fabric and Power Platform - reducing investigation time and enabling faster resolution. 

Auto-routing and classification: Configure and extend ICM routing rules and build intelligent classification systems based on service tree, alert signatures, and historical patterns. 

- Incident lifecycle automation: Build agents for incident summarization, customer communications drafting, postmortem generation, and reporting, replacing manual authoring with AI-assisted workflows requiring human judgment only for high-severity incidents. 
 - Metrics and continuous improvement: Measure and improve first-time mitigation (FTM) rates, incident deflection rates, and time-to-triage. Use data to identify patterns, propose new TSGs, and drive systemic improvements. 
 - CSS quality bar: Defend the standard for incoming escalations by enforcing organizational and process standards
