data.title: Software Development Engineer II – Data Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Are you ready to build the future of the supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery. 

If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time. 

About the Team

You'll join the Full Stack group within Cloud Services, which is being built now. Today, production and analytical workloads share a single database, and each product defines its own metrics. This team exists to fix that by designing and building the warehouse, transformation layers, and semantic model from the ground up. You'll work closely with Full Stack, ML, Product, Security, and Customer Success. 

About the Role

Most data engineers early in their careers maintain one slice of a large, mature platform, or build pipelines against a model someone else designed years ago. This role is the opposite. 

As an SDE II, Data Engineer, you'll be one of the first engineers building Gather AI's data foundation from scratch. The work includes: 

- Moving analytics off our production PostgreSQL database
 - Writing the layered dbt models every product will share
 - Defining metrics once so they stay consistent everywhere
 - Linking structured records back to the drone images and video they came from

You'll start by shipping well-scoped pipelines and models on our Drone product alongside senior engineers. From there, you'll grow toward owning a data domain end to end: its design, its quality, and its on-call. 

This is a fully remote role on our India-based team. We work across multiple time zones, so clear written communication, initiative, and the ability to make progress independently matter. 

What You'll Do

- Build extraction pipelines. Move data from production PostgreSQL into the analytical warehouse (raw, refined, serving) using incremental loads that protect the production database. 
 - Build and extend the shared data model. Write and maintain dbt models, such as dimensions, reusable metric building blocks, and serving tables, following the architecture set by our Principal Data Engineer. 
 - Implement metrics. Add metrics to the semantic layer so a measure like "scan accuracy by site" is defined once and matches across every dashboard. 
 - Keep data trustworthy. Add tests, freshness checks, and alerts to the pipelines you build, and help run safe backfills when data needs correcting. 
 - Build in tenant isolation. Apply our access-control and tenant-separation patterns to every model and pipeline you ship. 
 - Maintain lineage. Keep metrics traceable to their source records and drone images, so any number can be checked against the original capture. 
 - Work at the ingestion boundary. Partner with the integration team to validate incoming WMS data against agreed contracts. 
 - Document your work. Keep models documented and registered in the data catalog. 
 - Ship safely. Deliver through CI/CD, use AI-assisted development, and join on-call for the pipelines you own. 
 - Grow with the platform. Start on the Drone product, then help onboard MHE Vision, 3D case counting products onto the same data foundation over the year. 

What You'll Need

- Experience: 2-5 years building and running production data pipelines, and a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 
 - SQL: Strong SQL, including joins, window functions, and CTEs, plus a working understanding of dimensional modelling (facts, dimensions, grain). PostgreSQL experience preferred. 
 - Transformation: Hands-on experience building tested models in dbt, Snowflake Dynamic Tables, Databricks Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, or equivalent. 
 - Python: Production pipeline code with tests and code review, beyond notebooks or one-off scripts. 
 - Orchestration: Experience running pipelines in Airflow, Dagster, Databricks Lakeflow Jobs, Snowflake Tasks, or equivalent, including handling failures, re-runs, and backfills. 
 - Data movement: Has loaded data from an operational database into a warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks. 
 - Cloud: Production experience on Azure or another major cloud, including object storage, Git, CI/CD, and Docker/Kubernetes. 
 - Data quality mindset: Writes tests alongside code and cares whether data is correct, not just whether the job ran. 
 - Ownership and growth: Hands-on and curious. Digs into problems beyond their own code, brings ideas to the team, and takes review feedback well. 
 - Communication: Clear written and spoken English. Writes good PRs and documentation and raises blockers early in a distributed team. 

Nice to Have

- Change data capture (Debezium, Fivetran) or streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs)
 - PySpark or Snowpark
 - Terraform or other infrastructure as code
 - Semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs (Purview, DataHub)
 - Multi-tenant data platforms or row-level security
 - Working with image, video, or sensor data alongside structured records
 - Logistics, warehousing, or robotics domain experience

How You'll Help Us Build

- Designing, writing, and executing comprehensive manual test cases for Spotnana's web and mobile applications, APIs, and backend services
 - Performing functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing across product releases
 - Collaborating with developers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and translate them into thorough test scenarios
 - Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and supporting evidence
 - Defining and monitoring quality assurance metrics to drive continuous quality and process improvements
 - Leveraging AI tools to assist in test case generation, test data creation, exploratory test ideation, and defect summarization 
 - Supporting and contributing to automation efforts by reviewing automated test results, flagging gaps, and working alongside SDETs to improve coverage
 - Communicating clearly with internal stakeholders regarding test progress, risks, blockers, and release readiness
 - Estimating testing efforts, identifying risks, and contributing to mitigation plans to meet project schedules
 - Working closely with the engineering and QA team to continuously improve testing processes, checklists, and quality benchmarks

Experience You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent with 5+ years of manual QA / functional testing experience
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test lifecycle, and QA best practices
 - Hands-on experience testing REST APIs using tools like Postman or similar
 - Ability to write clear, structured, and reusable test cases and test plans
 - Familiarity with at least one automation framework (e. g. , Selenium, Cypress, PlayWrite) 
 - Basic SQL knowledge to validate data and assist with backend verification
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with tools like Jira for defect tracking and test management
 - Comfort using AI tools such as Claude for productivity tasks - including drafting test cases, summarizing bugs, generating test data, and exploring edge cases - as part of the team's established AI-assisted QA workflow
 - Good understanding of web application architecture and how frontend, backend, and APIs interact
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a sharp eye for detail
 - Clear verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams
 - A curious, quality-first mindset with the initiative to ask "what could go wrong?" before it does
 - Good to have: Prior experience in the travel and hospitality domain, particularly with airline and/or hotel booking engines - familiarity with GDS and NDC systems, booking flows, PNR structures is a plus

What To Expect Next

The process typically begins with an introductory call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll discuss your background, career aspirations, and what makes Spotnana a great fit for you. Then a live virtual and onsite interview with a panel of engineers and hiring managers. 

We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment and to encourage these values in everyone on our team. We provide an environment of mutual respect where opportunities are available without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that diversity and inclusion for people from all walks of life is key to our success as a company.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

The Team

Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products - and our mission. We are constantly looking for new ways to solve real-world problems, and we aren't afraid to try new things. Our engineering team is core to our innovation and success, and you will be a part of a team that is changing the future of cybersecurity. We're a team of builders, breakers, and problem solvers. We're a friendly, collaborative, and incredibly talented team that is looking to expand. If you're looking to be a part of a team that is changing the future of cybersecurity, you've found it. 

Job Summary

Join the Palo Alto Networks SASE group as a seasoned QA/Automation engineer to validate core networking and security features for our SD-WAN team. You will be part of a world-class, multi-functional engineering team working on groundbreaking technologies. In this role, you will solve interesting and complex problems in the SD-WAN space, contributing directly to our mission of protecting our digital way of life. 

Key Responsibilities

- Work in a small, fast-paced team to solve important customer problems and deliver impactful results. 
 - Contribute to all phases of end-to-end product and solution validation. 
 - Collaborate with development and quality assurance groups to achieve the best quality. 
 - Suggest and implement improvements to the QA process. 
 - Work with DevOps and Technical Support teams to troubleshoot customer issues. 
 - Lead, mentor, and coach team members to foster growth and excellence. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 5-10 years of relevant experience, with a BS or MS degree in a related field. 
 - Strong experience with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, and OCI. 
 - Strong experience with automation and programming using Python.

data.title: Security Automation Engineer
data.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise. 

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP. com. 

Why we're hiring: 

The Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining security automation solutions that enhance detection, response, workflow efficiency, and operational consistency across Operational Security. Working under the Automation Lead, this role builds high-quality SOAR playbooks, integrations, scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and orchestration pipelines to reduce manual workloads and support the Autonomic Security Operations (ASO) model. 

What you'll be doing: 

Core Responsibilities

Automation Engineering & Development

- Develop SOAR playbooks, workflows, and automations for alert triage, enrichment, containment, and remediation. 
 - Build scalable, reusable automation components, scripts, and integrations. 
 - Implement high-quality scripting using Python, PowerShell, and REST APIs. 
 - Ensure appropriate version control, QA, testing, and documentation of automation artefacts. 
 - Maintain reliability of automations by monitoring performance, exceptions, and system behaviour. 

Platform Integration & Tooling Engineering

- Integrate SOAR with SIEM, EDR, TIP, cloud-native security tools, and case management systems. 
 - Engineer automation pipelines to support Microsoft and Google security ecosystems. 
 - Develop API integrations, webhooks, and event-driven automation triggers. 
 - Support data transformation, enrichment, and telemetry orchestration requirements. 

AI / ML Automation Enablement

- Contribute to embedding AI/ML-driven enrichment and correlation logic into automated workflows. 
 - Support operationalisation of ML models for anomaly detection and decision support. 
 - Collaborate with data and detection teams to refine and enhance AI-enabled automation. 

Workflow Engineering & Process Automation

- Translate SOPs, response runbooks, and detection workflows into automated processes. 
 - Identify automation opportunities to eliminate manual tasks across SecOps functions. 
 - Ensure automated processes remain consistent, auditable, and compliant with Operational Security standards. 

Operational Collaboration & Support

- Work with Detection Engineering, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and Threat Intelligence teams to automate use cases. 
 - Participate in post-incident reviews and embed improvements into automation workflows. 
 - Assist with tool evaluations, optimisation initiatives, and integration efforts led by the Automation Lead. 

Continuous Improvement

- Contribute to a backlog of automation enhancements and new capabilities. 
 - Optimise accuracy, resilience, and efficiency across automation workflows. 
 - Ensure alignment with GCAT SOC10x principles, including 10X Technology, Process, Speed, and Visibility. 

What you'll need: 

Technical Expertise

- Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or Chronicle SOAR. 
 - Proficiency in Python and/or PowerShell for automation development. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and event-driven automation. 
 - Experience integrating SIEM, EDR, TIP, and cloud-native security tools. 

Process & Operational Knowledge

- Understanding of workflows across SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering. 
 - Ability to convert operational requirements and SOPs into engineered automation. 
 - Familiarity with playbooks, runbooks, and security process governance. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Strong communication and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work in an engineering-led, automation-first culture. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional technical teams in security operations. 

Certifications (Preferred)

- SOAR platform certifications. 
 - GIAC (GMON, GCTI, GCIH, GCDA). 
 - Python or scripting certifications. 
 - Azure or GCP cloud certifications. 

Key Attributes

- Engineering-first mindset with strong attention to detail. 
 - Problem-solving orientation with a focus on automation and efficiency. 
 - Structured, methodical, and reliable approach to delivery. 
 - Commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

Who you are: 

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working. 

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected. 

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day. 

What we'll give you: 

Passionate, inspired people - we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity - we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry. 

Challenging and stimulating work - unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

Please read our Privacy Notice (https: //www. wpp. com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Description

Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers. 

We are a team of builders - from new graduates to seasoned architects - who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on. 

Who Are We

The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact. 

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices.

Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline

A day in the life

You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders.

The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device.

Job Description

The Post-Silicon Validation team within the Performance Computing Power Division is building a world-class organization of highly skilled engineers across multiple global sites. We are committed to delivering the highest level of validation quality by continuously improving test coverage, measurement accuracy, repeatability, automation, and execution efficiency while reducing overall validation time. 

As a Validation Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary global development team and play a key role in ensuring that every new product fully meets its electrical, functional, and performance specifications before release to production. You will work closely with Design, Applications, Product Engineering, Quality, and System teams to identify, debug, and resolve silicon and system-level issues while supporting aggressive product development and New Product Introduction (NPI) schedules. 

For our office in Bangalore, we are looking for a passionate engineer who thrive on innovation, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and is committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. 

Principal Responsibilities : 

- Validate analog, digital, mixed-signal, and power management ICs against electrical, functional, and performance specifications. 

- Prepare advanced laboratory test setups for complex silicon evaluation. 

- Contribute to the design of custom evaluation boards and supporting hardware for silicon characterization. 

- Develop measurement scripts using Python. 

- Perform data acquisition, statistical analysis, result correlation, preparation of detailed technical reports and silicon evaluation summaries. 

- Evaluate silicon performance at device, board, and system level, identifying, documenting, and tracking silicon and application issues. 

- Collaborate closely with Design, Applications, Firmware, Product Engineering, and Quality teams to investigate and resolve silicon and system-level bugs. 

- Contribute innovative ideas that enhance validation quality, automation, productivity, and time-to-market. 

Qualifications

- Good level of expertise in lab automation, ability to propose improvements to existing measurements techniques. 

- Proficiency with Python programming with particular use for lab automation hardware environments

- Basic knowledge of power management applications in consumer electronic

- Board level analog and digital circuit design expertise for PCB schematic creation

- Strong analytical and debugging skills with a systematic approach to problem solving. 

- Self-motivated, proactive, and able to manage priorities while delivering high-quality results under demanding project schedules. 

- Goals-oriented and able to deliver on-time results under tight schedules

- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within international cross-functional teams. 

Important

- Concise and precise communication, internal and with customers

- Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity within multisite and multicultural environments

- Flexible to undertake occasional international travel

- Excellent command of verbal and written English

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. data.title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

Lead the service transformation teams

Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans. 

Turn architecture into shipped services

Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered. 

Establish the base service tier

Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application - and the AI agents and partners building on top of them - can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably. 

Protect compatibility and business continuity

Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved. 

Modernize the application foundations

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over. 

Raise the bar for engineering quality

Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops - layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience - that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly. 

Drive AI-native ways of working

Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates - not manual inspection - prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Hire and grow strong engineers

Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through. 

Partner across the program

Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed. 

What This Is Not

This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes - while your engineers own the code. 

This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications. 

This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events. 

What You Bring

Proven engineering leadership

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health. 

Service transformation depth

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments - and delivering those migrations to production. 

Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency

Enough hands-on depth - in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems - to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room. 

Migration safety instincts

You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs. 

Quality and operational discipline

You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built - and you hold that bar for your teams. 

People development

You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care. 

Cross-functional execution

You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute. 

An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering

You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning - and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective. 

Bonus Points

Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades. 

Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies. 

Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well. 

Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers. 

Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks). 

Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering. 

What Success Looks Like

The base service tier becomes real

Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired - reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered. 

Convergence advances without destabilizing the business

Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use. 

The platform compounds

New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver. 

The team gets stronger

Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change. 

Why This Matters

Everything ABC is building - the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform - stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted. 

This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
 - Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
 - Best Life Perk - we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
 - Premium Calm App - enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
 - Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don't just build technology-we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. 

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn't just the right thing to do-it's a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness. com. 

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. 

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness. com

data.title: Director - Tech Operations
data.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Joining Amex Tech means helping build and operate technology that supports critical business capabilities at enterprise scale. We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead a portfolio within the Operations Data and Analytics organization spanning ServiceNow and IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategy platform engineering, and observability and operational analytics for the Customer Journey availability program. 

A significant area of focus will be the continued development and modernization of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) capabilities that support these processes. This leader will help ensure these capabilities operate as integrated enterprise technology products, with strong engineering practices, reliable data, appropriate governance, and roadmaps aligned to the needs of the broader technology organization. 

This leader will be responsible for bringing together platforms, engineering practices, operational processes, and data to improve availability, resiliency, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across mission-critical technology services. 

The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels-setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions. 

Responsibilities

How You Will Make an Impact

Engineering & Platform Leadership

- Lead engineering and platform capabilities supporting ServiceNow/ITSM, Strategy, and Customer Journeys. 
 - Establish and execute multi-year platform and engineering strategies aligned with organizational priorities. 
 - Drive modernization of platform architecture, engineering practices, automation, integrations, and data capabilities. 
 - Establish standards for software quality, testing, deployment, security, scalability, resilience, and maintainability. 
 - Ensure critical platforms meet expectations for availability, performance, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Develop strong technical talent and create organizational depth while establishing clear accountability and ownership. 

ServiceNow, ITSM & Operational Excellence

- Provide strategic and engineering leadership for ServiceNow and associated enterprise ITSM capabilities, with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB development as it relates to those areas. 
 - Establish and evolve a technology roadmap for these capabilities that aligns ServiceNow development with enterprise operational, reliability, risk, product owners, and business priorities. 
 - Maintain a strong understanding of industry standards, established practices, and emerging trends across ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management and use that knowledge to inform platform strategy and engineering priorities. 
 - Ensure CMDB capabilities supporting Incident, Problem, and Change processes provide accurate, useful, and sustainable configuration and relationship data. 
 - Drive integration across Incident, Problem, Change, and CMDB capabilities so that configuration data strengthens impact analysis, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, operational decision-making, and automation. 
 - Partner with ITSM process owners and technology stakeholders to translate process strategy into scalable ServiceNow capabilities. 
 - Participate in and influence the ServiceNow roadmap through established governance, prioritization, and planning forums, representing the needs and priorities of SRE, Application Support, Operations Engineering, and other technology stakeholders. 
 - Build alignment across process owners, platform teams, engineering organizations, and senior leaders on ServiceNow priorities, investments, sequencing, and technical direction. 
 - Challenge unnecessary process or platform complexity while ensuring appropriate controls, governance, and auditability. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, eliminate process gaps, improve data quality, and reduce operational toil. 
 - Ensure ServiceNow capabilities evolve as engineered products rather than simply administrative workflows. 
 - Establish metrics demonstrating the effectiveness of ITSM capabilities and their impact on availability, reliability, engineering productivity, and operational outcomes. 

Observability, SRE & Availability

- Define and evolve observability capabilities using technologies such as Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and related enterprise tooling. 
 - Improve telemetry, monitoring, alerting, event correlation, and root-cause-analysis capabilities. 
 - Drive adoption of engineering practices that move teams from reactive monitoring toward proactive observability and reliability management. 
 - Partner with SRE and application teams to establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs, availability measures, and service-health standards. 
 - Use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns and prioritize engineering investments. 
 - Connect observability, CMDB, Incident, and Problem data to improve identification and resolution of reliability issues. 
 - Expand the footprint of our Customer Journeys and align them to critical business services. 

Strategy & Data Platforms

- Lead application development and production support for Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), including delivery execution and the long-term platform roadmap. 
 - Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of BI and analytics capabilities supporting critical business and operational decisions. 
 - Drive modernization of data architecture, tooling, and engineering practices. 
 - Partner with business and technology stakeholders to develop advanced analytics and data-driven operational insights. 
 - Create integrations with other operational solutions including agentic solutions. 

Customer Journey Availability

- Provide leadership across modern data ecosystems and workflow/orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow. 
 - Lead and expand capabilities for measuring end-to-end availability across critical customer journeys. 
 - Establish visibility and accountability across application, infrastructure, platform, and business teams. 
 - Support 99. 99% availability objectives for designated critical journeys through standardized measurement, governance, and engineering practices. 
 - Establish controls and processes supporting reliability, risk management, auditability, and consistent delivery of business outcomes.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As an IT Test Automation Engineer, you will strengthen enterprise testing and quality engineering capabilities across global SAP and business application landscapes. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, operation, governance, and continuous improvement of automated testing solutions, with a key focus on Tricentis Tosca and related Tricentis products to enable scalable, reliable, and maintainable test automation across SAP and integrated non-SAP environments. As SSO for the Test Automation Service, you will ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations while overseeing governance, risks, documentation, stakeholder collaboration, continuous improvement, and financial planning aligned with the service roadmap. You will also drive ongoing validation and quality assurance to ensure that deployed automation remains effective, efficient, compliant, and aligned with business requirements throughout its lifecycle, including monitoring automation quality, reviewing test assets, validating execution results, and driving continuous improvement of testing processes. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Review and validate automation scripts, test cases, test data, and execution strategies. 
 - Ensure compliance with established automation standards, naming conventions, and development guidelines, and define and continuously improve quality standards for automated testing. 
 - Conduct quality reviews of automation assets and automation frameworks, assess automation coverage, and identify opportunities to expand automation adoption. 
 - Establish controls to ensure consistency and reusability of test assets across projects and verify traceability between requirements, business processes, test cases, and execution results. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies and test automation practices. 
 - Ensure secure, compliant, reliable, and lifecycle-oriented operation of the Test Automation Service (SSO). 
 - Coordinate service governance and manage operational, technical, and compliance risks while maintaining service documentation and controls. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders, platform teams, vendors, and support organizations, and define and drive the service roadmap and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Support financial planning, forecasting, and budget monitoring. 
 - Monitor the health, quality, and effectiveness of deployed automated tests, analyse execution trends, automation success rates, and defect leakage, and coordinate root-cause analysis of failed executions. 
 - Ensure automation assets remain current following SAP releases, transports, upgrades, and business process changes, while managing the automation maintenance backlog and technical debt. 
 - Support the introduction of self-healing and AI-assisted automation capabilities where appropriate, and monitor and report automation KPIs and quality metrics. 
 - Support and optimise the enterprise testing toolchain, including Tricentis Tosca, Tricentis qTest, SAP Cloud ALM, and SAP Solution Manager, and collaborate with teams using these solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and AI-enabled testing capabilities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and testing transformation programs. 
 - Increase automation coverage across critical business processes, improve reliability and maintainability of automated test suites, reduce regression testing effort and execution time, and improve traceability and quality of test assets. 
 - Strengthen governance and quality controls in automated testing, provide transparency through meaningful testing KPIs and reporting, and enable faster, safer, and higher-quality SAP releases. 
 - Ensure reliable, compliant service delivery, continuous improvement, and effective budget management. 

What You Bring

- 8-10 years of overall experience in software testing, quality engineering, and test automation. 
 - Approximately 5 years of experience in software testing and test automation, with strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Proven experience in SAP testing environments and enterprise-scale test automation solutions; experience supporting large transformation, ERP, or SAP S/4HANA programs is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and SAP ECC is advantageous.

 - Knowledge of Quality Metrics & KPI Management, Risk-based Testing, Root Cause Analysis, and Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 - Tricentis Tosca Certification and ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification are preferred. 
 - Experience with AI-enabled testing approaches and SAP Cloud ALM integrations is preferred. 
 - Experience establishing Testing Centers of Excellence or Test Governance frameworks is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise-scale testing operating models is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a quality-driven mindset and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to challenge existing processes and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across global and cross-functional teams. 
 - Passion for automation, innovation, and operational excellence. 

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100, 000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 

Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

data.description:
About Impact Analytics

Impact Analytics is an agentic-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made. 

What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000. 

For candidates looking to work on next-generation AI products with global scale and real-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here's a link to our website: www. impactanalytics. co. 

The impact you will make

As the DevOps Architect, you will lead the architecture, automation, and continuous optimization of our enterpriseGoogle Cloud infrastructure. You will define our global DevOps strategy, enforce Zero Trust security standards, design resilient CI/CD frameworks, and ensure high-performance execution for our agentic AI engines and multi-tenant SaaS platforms across Fortune 500 deployments. 

What Lands You In This Role (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES)

- GCP Infrastructure Architecture: Design, deploy, and maintain highly resilient, scalable Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible). 
 - CI/CD & Automated Delivery: Architect scalable CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, ArgoCD) for zero-downtime deployment of microservices, distributed data streams, and AI/ML model execution pipelines. 
 - Kubernetes & Container Orchestration: Lead enterprise multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Anthos / Service Mesh architecture, and container security for high-throughput enterprise workloads. 
 - Security, Compliance & FinOps: Drive Zero Trust architecture, HashiCorp Vault secrets management, vulnerability monitoring (Trivy/Snyk), SOC 2/ISO compliance, and FinOps cloud cost optimization across GCP environments. 
 - Observability & Reliability Engineering: Establish full-stack telemetry (Google Cloud Operations Suite / Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) to enforce high-availability SLAs, proactive alerting, and low MTTR. 
 - Technical Leadership & Governance: Mentor engineers across DevOps and SRE domains, foster a culture of continuous automation, and align infrastructure strategy with product roadmaps. 

What This Role Entails (QUALIFICATIONS & TECHNICAL STACK)

- 12-15 years of progressive experience in DevOps, Cloud Architecture, and Systems Engineering supporting high-scale enterprise SaaS or AI/ML product environments. 
 - Cloud Platforms: Deep, expert-level hands-on proficiency strictly centered on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Expertise across core GCP services including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, BigQuery, IAM, Artifact Registry, and Vertex AI infrastructure support. 
 - IaC & Containers: Mastery of Terraform, Pulumi, Docker, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Helm, and Service Mesh. 
 - Automation & MLOps: Advanced hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Python, Go, or Bash, alongside supporting distributed compute engines and pipelines (Spark, Cloud Composer / Airflow). 
 - Mandatory Certifications: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect and/or Google Cloud Certified Professional DevOps Engineer. 

What We Offer

- An opportunity to be part of some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India. 
 - Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions. 
 - A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude. 
 - A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure. 
 - Remuneration with best-in-class industry standards with generous health insurance cover. 

Some of our accolades include

- Ranked as one of America's Fastest-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020-2024. 
 - Ranked as one of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018-2024. 
 - Voted #1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report. 
 - Ranked #72 in America's Most Innovative Companies list in 2023-by Fortune-alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc. 
 - Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting-edge generative AI tools. 
 - Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Unified Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Job Overview

Plan A Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer with strong expertise in end-to-end testing to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our applications. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in software testing, test case design, defect management, and quality assurance best practices. This role involves testing Bingo gaming applications, with a primary focus on delivering high-quality software through comprehensive testing processes. 

Please note: you must have at least 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, preferably

testing gaming or iGaming applications to be considered for this role. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios. 
 - Perform end-to-end, functional, regression, integration, smoke, and exploratory testing. 
 - Validate complete application workflows, ensuring seamless integration between frontend, backend, and APIs. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Conduct API testing to validate data integrity, functionality, and system integrations. 
 - Execute cross-browser and cross-platform testing to ensure consistent application behavior. 
 - Validate business logic, data accuracy, system behavior, and user interactions. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve quality issues. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes. 
 - Support release testing and production validation to ensure application stability. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with manual testing and end-to-end test execution. 
 - Proven experience designing and executing functional, regression, integration, and exploratory tests. 
 - Solid understanding of QA methodologies, testing techniques, and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or similar. 
 - Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, or similar. 
 - Ability to write clear test cases, document defects, and analyze testing results. 
 - Understanding of frontend/backend architecture and client-server communication. 
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
 - Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Initiative and drive to do great things

Nice to Have

- Experience testing gaming, iGaming, or Bingo applications. 
 - Familiarity with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Experience with SQL for data validation. 
 - Knowledge of performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Experience testing real-time applications or WebSocket-based systems. 

About The Company/Benefits

Plan A Technologies is a global engineering firm created to solve the toughest tech challenges facing today's businesses. Founded by software entrepreneurs Aron Ezra and Slav Kulik, Plan A helps organizations analyze their tech ecosystem to identify exactly what needs to be improved across their products and infrastructure-and then builds the solutions to fix it. 

Rather than offering theoretical ideas or software that never launches, Plan A combines elite engineering talent with custom-built, proprietary AI agents to deliver fast, secure, production-ready solutions. Its capabilities span proprietary AI agent deployment, custom software development, application modernization, data platforms, cloud migrations, systems integration, and practical technical advice. 

With more than 500 successful product deployments completed worldwide, Plan A helps organizations of every size-from ambitious startups to global enterprises-modernize their systems, automate complex operations, and stay ahead of the technology curve. 

Read more about us here: www. PlanAtechnologies. com . 

Location: Hybrid (Chennai, India)

Great colleagues and an upbeat work environment: You'll join an excellent team of supportive engineers and project managers who work hard but don't ever compete with each other. 

Benefits: Vacation, Brand New Laptop, and More: You'll get a generous vacation schedule, and other goodies. 

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

data.title: Software QA Engineer
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence. 

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing. 

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages. 
 - Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases. 
 - Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery. 
 - Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable. 
 - Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage. 
 - Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies. 

Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger. 
 - Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation. 
 - Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner. 
 - Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts. 
 - Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies. 
 - Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

#DISWSIM

data.title: Team Leader - Data Analytics
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly capable Team Leader - Data Analytics (P4) to lead and manage the Data Analytics function within the UK&I Transport & Infrastructure PMO GCC. 

The role is responsible for delivering high-quality, scalable, and data-driven analytics solutions across data engineering, visualisation, reporting, automation, and advanced analytics, enabling effective decision-making across project controls, programme performance, portfolio governance, and strategic leadership reporting. 

This is a dual leadership role requiring both strong technical expertise and effective people leadership. The successful candidate will lead a team of data analytics professionals, drive reporting standardisation, champion digital innovation, and work closely with Head -T&I PMO, PMO Leads and UK stakeholders to continuously streamline, optimise, and enhance reporting and insights across projects. 

Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & People Management
 - Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing team of Data Analytics professionals within the GCC. 
 - Provide day-to-day leadership across analytics delivery, team priorities, and performance outcomes. 
 - Drive resource planning, workload allocation, and delivery prioritisation across multiple concurrent projects and PMO initiatives. 
 - Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain talent aligned to business growth and capability requirements. 
 - Conduct performance reviews, set development goals, and implement structured upskilling plans for team members. 
 - Foster a strong "one-team" culture across GCC and UK / onshore stakeholders, promoting collaboration, accountability, and shared success. 
 - Build sustainable team capability in reporting, automation, analytics, and digital PMO solutions. 
 - Reporting Standardisation & Scalable Delivery
 - Define and implement a standardised reporting solutions across projects and portfolios which are scalable, efficient, and aligned to PMO governance standards. 
 - Work in consultation with PMO Leads in GCC and UK stakeholders to align project reporting requirements to the appropriate maturity level. 
 - Standardise key dashboards, templates, KPIs, and reporting approaches to support consistency across the portfolio. 
 - Drive adoption of common data models and structured reporting approaches across teams. 
 - Analytics Delivery & Governance
 - Oversee end-to-end analytics delivery, including: Data ingestion, Data transformation and modelling, Validation and QA/QC, Dashboard development and reporting, Insight generation and stakeholder presentation 
 - Ensure all outputs meet expected standards for quality, consistency, governance, auditability, and repeatability. 
 - Establish and maintain QA/QC frameworks, delivery checklists, KPI libraries, and reporting standards. 
 - Create structured operating models for analytics delivery, including templates, SOPs, naming conventions, and version control. 
 - Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement across analytics delivery processes. 
 - Dashboarding, Visualisation & Reporting
 - Lead the design and development of Power BI dashboards and interactive reporting solutions to support: 
 - Project controls performance 
 - Programme and portfolio reporting 
 - Cost and commercial insights 
 - Risk and issue visibility 
 - Resource utilisation and team performance 
 - Leadership and business review reporting 
 - Ensure dashboards are intuitive, executive-friendly, and tailored to stakeholder needs. 
 - Support standardisation of reporting outputs across tools such as Power BI, Excel, and other approved visualisation platforms. 
 - Improve visibility and decision-making through automated, real-time, or near real-time reporting where appropriate. 
 - Automation & Power Platform Enablement
 - Drive adoption of Power Platform solutions to streamline PMO and project reporting processes, including: 
 - Power BI for analytics and visualisation 
 - Power Automate for workflow and process automation 
 - Power Apps for digital forms, data capture, and process enablement 
 - Identify repetitive manual processes and convert them into efficient automated solutions. 
 - Design integrated workflows connecting project data, approvals, alerts, and reporting outputs. 
 - Promote a digital-first approach to reporting, governance, and information management. 
 - Propose and implement practical automation solutions that improve efficiency, control, and user experience. 
 - Technical Analytics, Data Engineering & Advanced Insights
 - Build and maintain integrated data models across multiple systems and data sources, such as SharePoint, ERP / finance systems, Project controls tools. 
 - Promote use of advanced Excel, Power Query, DAX, SQL, Python, and modern data engineering practices where appropriate. 
 - Explore opportunities to apply advanced analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and automation to improve efficiency and insight generation. 
 - Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable, business-relevant insights for PMO, project, and leadership stakeholders. 
 - PMO, Project Controls & Business Integration
 - Work closely with PMO Leads, Project Controls teams, Commercial teams, and Delivery stakeholders to align analytics outputs with business and project needs. 
 - Ensure reporting supports visibility across Cost, Schedule, Risk, Commercial performance, Resource and delivery metrics 
 - Integrate analytics outputs with project controls and PMO processes to strengthen governance and decision-making. 
 - Support alignment of reporting with project and portfolio performance frameworks. 
 - Enable joined-up reporting across PMO, controls, commercial, and operational functions. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration
 - Act as the primary analytics SPOC for collaboration between GCC and UK stakeholders on reporting and analytics requirements. 
 - Partner with PMO leadership, Project Directors, Project Managers, and functional leads to understand evolving reporting needs. 
 - Present insights through governance forums, showcases, leadership reviews, and stakeholder meetings. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, Finance, Risk, Commercial, and Project Controls to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Build trusted relationships and position the GCC analytics team as a value-adding strategic partner. 
 - Strategy, Innovation & Continuous Improvement
 - Drive the analytics capability roadmap for the PMO GCC, aligned to business needs and digital strategy. 
 - Continuously review current ways of working and identify opportunities to streamline, optimise, and improve reporting and analytics delivery. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest developments in analytics, Power Platform, automation, AI, and emerging technology, and translate relevant advancements into practical solutions for projects and PMO teams. 
 - Introduce new tools, methods, and innovations to improve reporting maturity and operational efficiency. 
 - Support knowledge management and reusable solution development across the analytics function. 
 - Define and track service performance metrics, team KPIs, and adoption measures. 
 - Capability Building & Training
 - Build a sustainable and continuously improving analytics capability within GCC. 
 - Develop structured training and development plans such as Power Platform, PMO reporting standards and KPI design etc. 
 - Promote data literacy and dashboard adoption across PMO and project teams. 

Ensure the analytics team remains technically current and aligned to evolving business and technology requirements. 

Essential

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Information Systems, or related discipline. 
 - 8-12 years of experience in Data Analytics / BI / PMO Reporting / Project Controls Analytics / Management Information roles. 
 - Proven team management experience leading and managing Data Analytics professionals, including workload allocation, mentoring, performance management, structured upskilling, and delivery governance. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Power Platform, SQL and other reporting and automation solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, automation, or advanced analytics use cases. 
 - Strong experience designing and delivering reporting solutions in PMO / project controls / infrastructure / engineering environments. 
 - Experience working in a GCC / offshore / shared services / UK-India delivery model. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and influencing skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions. 

Desirable

Tools & Technology

- Power BI - dashboards, DAX, modelling, visualisation
