data.description:
Job Description

The role operates at the intersection of technology strategy, product discovery, domain‐driven design, and engineering execution, driving rapid experimentation, applied innovation, and technical excellence while respecting real‐world operational, security, and regulatory constraints. Success is measured by validated learning, speed‐to‐insight, and successful transition of ideas into core product organizations. The role is expected to be hands-on with 40% time dedicated to Software Development and the rest on the remaining responsibilities. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Innovation & Idea Incubation Leadership

- Own the end‐to‐end lifecycle of idea incubation from problem discovery and hypothesis framing to prototyping, validation, and graduation or termination. 
 - Establish repeatable incubation frameworks using design thinking, Lean Startup, and experiment‐driven development. 
 - Champion a culture of experimentation, learning velocity, and evidence‐based decision‐making in high‐ambiguity environments. 
 - Ensure early‐stage experimentation incorporates domain realities from Buildings, Security, and Industrial contexts, avoiding innovation that cannot transition to real deployments. 

Technical & Architectural Leadership

- Provide technical direction across incubated initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and production‐ready. 
 - Guide teams in selecting and applying emerging technologies including cloud‐native platforms, SaaS, AI/ML, GenAI, IoT, and edge computing. 
 - Ensure architectural decisions explicitly address non‐functional requirements such as availability, scalability, security, compliance, and operational resilience. 
 - Partner with Architecture and SRE leaders to ensure smooth transition of incubated solutions into enterprise‐scale delivery models and long‐lived product platforms. 

AI SDLC + SW Engineering Skills

End-to-End AI Lifecycle : Data → model → deployment → monitoring

MLOps / LLMOps + CI/CD : Pipelines, versioning, automated deploy & testing

Data & Model Engineering: Data pipelines + LLMs/RAG + model optimization

Software Engineering Fundamentals

- API design, microservices 
 - Clean code, testing 
 - System design

Cloud-native Architecture: Kubernetes, Docker, scalable AI services

Domain‐Driven Engineering Leadership

- Ensure engineering teams deeply understand and design for domain‐specific constraints and requirements, including: 
 - Buildings (commercial buildings, campuses, multi‐site operations, 24×7 uptime expectations) 
 - Security (cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory compliance, secure‐by‐design principles) 
 - Industrial / OT (manufacturing, process industries, legacy systems, safety‐critical environments) 
 - Drive domain‐driven design practices so incubated solutions reflect real operational workflows, asset models, and system boundaries. 
 - Validate that domain requirements are explicitly captured and tested during incubation, not deferred to later product teams. 
Buildings Domain Knowledge

- Has led engineering innovation for software platforms that integrate with Building Management Systems (BMS) such as HVAC, lighting, energy, fire, and life‐safety systems. 
 - Ensure incubated solutions support multi‐site and multi‐tenant building deployments and can scale reliably beyond pilot environments. 
 - Drive interoperability across heterogeneous OT devices, protocols, and vendor ecosystems common in building environments. 
 - Ensure experimentation and pilots account for continuous operations and minimal disruption expectations in live buildings. 

Security & Privacy Knowledge

- Own security‐by‐design and privacy‐by‐design accountability across all incubated software initiatives. 
 - Ensure security requirements align with industrial and OT security standards (e. g. , ANSI/ISA‐62443) and enterprise security policies. 
 - Require and oversee: 
 - Threat modeling and secure architecture reviews 
 - Strong authentication, authorization, and role‐based access control 
 - Secure handling of credentials, secrets, and certificates 
 - Audit logging and traceability for security‐relevant actions 
 - Ensure compliance with data protection and privacy regulations (e. g. , GDPR) and completion of required Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) prior to graduation of incubated solutions.

Industrial & OT Engineering Knowledge

data.title: FS RC-FSRM - CSTC-MORTGAGE QUALITY CONTROL-QUALITY ASSURANCE-MANAGER
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)

Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview

As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post-underwriting and post-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks. 

Core Responsibilities

- Perform pre-funding and post-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
 - Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
 - Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
 - Validate collateral-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
 - Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e. g. , Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
 - Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
 - Reconcile underwriting decisions by re-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
 - Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
 - Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
 - Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
 - Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading

Domain Skills Required

- Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc. ) and underwriting frameworks
 - Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre-funding and post-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
 - Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
 - Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
 - Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
 - Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management-ready findings

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- MBA/CA or equivalent with 7-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
 - Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage. 
 - Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations. 

Good-to-have: 

- Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage-specific certifications
 - Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
 - Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to business and executive stakeholders. 
 - Experience working in regulated environments with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, CSV, data governance, privacy, and security requirements. Preferred Life Sciences Experience

data.title: Design Manager-Piping
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Design Engineering Manager Piping support the Discipline Manager on achieving Jacob's project and engineering process and procedure. This dynamic position provides leadership, champions inclusion and diversity, drives global delivery, supports a culture of innovation applies a disciplined deployment and ensures Management responsibilities including performance appraisals, pay reviews, training and development. Manages professional employees and/or supervisors or manages multi-discipline teams of support employees accounting for a large/significant span of control. Has accountability for the performance and results of a team within own area of specialty. Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges and problem solving guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance from senior manager. Provides technical guidance to employees, colleagues and/or customers. Drives design consistency across projects by standardizing templates, specifications, and workflows. Promotes continuous improvement in design efficiency, digital tools, and engineering practices. 

The Piping Design Manager will lead and manage piping design activities for life sciences projects-including pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities, biotechnology plants, sterile/aseptic production suites, R&D laboratories, utility systems, and cleanroom environments. This role ensures that all piping design deliverables meet project requirements, regulatory standards, GMP compliance, and client expectations while driving innovation, efficiency, and quality. Ensure design deliverables meet quality and safety standards, regulatory expectations, and project specifications. Act as the primary point of contact for piping design matters with clients, PMCs, and EPC/EPCM partners. Participate in design workshops, HAZOPs, risk assessments, and constructability studies and provide technical support during construction, commissioning, and start‐up. 

Here's what you'll need

- 17-20 Years of Experience and Degree in full time BE/Btech - Chemical/Mechanical
 - Strong experience on design of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility / Speciality Chemical in terms of Piping design. 
 - Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility inter discipline requirements. 
 - Location- Navi Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Chennai (Candidate will be considered for Pharma & Lifescience only)

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer - VP
data.description:
Join us as a Full Stack Engineer - VP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as a Full Stack Engineer - VP, you should have experience with: 

- Extensive hands-on experience in Java (JDK 17+), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and building highly scalable, secure backend systems for financial and enterprise applications. 
 - Strong expertise in RESTful API design and development, microservices architecture, and service-to-service integrations in high-volume transactional environments. 
 - Strong experience in workflow orchestration and workflow management platforms, including designing and implementing long-running business processes, stateful workflows, and automation frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms, including Apache Kafka and asynchronous processing patterns. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise integration frameworks such as Apache Camel (or equivalent), implementing routing, mediation, transformation, orchestration, and API integration patterns across distributed systems. 
 - Solid understanding of end-to-end full-stack development, including frontend-backend integration and asynchronous communication patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern UI technologies including React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, and frontend testing frameworks such as Jest or Jasmine. 
 - Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on data integrity and performance. 
 - Strong knowledge of security standards and practices including OAuth2, JWT, authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure coding guidelines. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build tools (Maven, Gradle), and secure deployments. 
 - Proficiency with version control systems (Git) and enterprise development workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, system resiliency, fault tolerance, observability, and production support in mission-critical environments. 
 - Experience leading technical design discussions, conducting code reviews, and mentoring engineers in large delivery teams. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and integrating solutions on Hyperledger Besu or other enterprise blockchain platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of blockchain network architecture, node operations, transaction lifecycle, consensus mechanisms, and enterprise DLT deployments. 
 - Practical experience developing, integrating, testing, and supporting Smart Contracts and blockchain-enabled business workflows. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications with blockchain networks through APIs, events, message-driven architectures, and middleware platforms. 
 - Strong experience working in regulated environments with strict compliance, audit, and governance requirements. 
 - Deep understanding of system resiliency, fault tolerance, high availability, and performance optimization. 
 - Solid knowledge of design patterns, object-oriented principles, and enterprise architecture best practices. 
 - Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, integration testing, and contract testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and large-scale delivery models. 
 - Ability to collaborate closely with product owners, architects, QA, security, and DevOps teams. 
 - Strong communication skills for explaining complex technical solutions to business and senior stakeholders. 
 - Banking domain knowledge such as Payments & Transfer, Treasury, Settlement, Reconciliation, Regulatory and Compliance Controls. 
 - Experience building Digital Asset, Blockchain, Tokenization, Custody, Settlement, or Enterprise DLT platforms. 
 - Good understanding of workflow-driven architectures, orchestration patterns, event-driven systems, and distributed transaction processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architectures, and interoperability across complex banking ecosystems. 
 - Experience integrating on-chain and off-chain applications across enterprise platforms and blockchain networks. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Hyperledger Besu
 - Ethereum and EVM-Based Blockchain Platforms
 - Smart Contract Development and Integration
 - Tokenization Concepts and Platforms
 - Digital Asset Custody Concepts
 - Distributed Ledger Technologies (DLT)
 - Blockchain Architecture and Design
 - Consensus Mechanisms
 - Wallet and Key Management Concepts
 - Blockchain Security and Auditing Concepts
 - Enterprise Blockchain Integration Patterns
 - Web3 Fundamentals and Ecosystem Awareness

Artificial Intelligence & Developer Productivity

- AI-Assisted Software Development
 - Unit Test Generation
 - Code Review Automation
 - MCP (Model Context Protocol) Awareness
 - AI-enabled SDLC and Engineering Productivity Practices

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives. 

Accountabilities

- Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives. 
 - Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget. 
 - Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity. 
 - Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development. 
 - Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. data.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - Decision Intelligence

About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today. 

The opportunity

Amgen's AI & Data Science team is building decision-intelligence products that help teams make faster, more defensible decisions under uncertainty. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Decision Intelligence to join the Forecasting & Decision Intelligence team, within the AI & Data organization. This role will develop cutting edge scenario-planning capabilities, while creating reusable foundations for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI-assisted decision products across the enterprise. 

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer who can own meaningful product experiences end-to-end. You will build the interfaces people use to configure, launch, monitor, compare, and understand complex scenarios, as well as the APIs, data integrations, and execution services that make those experiences trustworthy. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, deploy, and operate end-to-end decision-support products across frontend, backend, data, and workflow layers. 
 - Create intuitive planner experiences for configuring scenarios, managing assumptions, launching and monitoring, comparing outcomes, and understanding uncertainty and trade-offs. 
 - Build responsive, accessible React/TypeScript user interfaces and reusable frontend components for scenario setup, results visualization, and decision workflows. 
 - Design and implement production APIs, backend services, data integrations, and execution workflows for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI-assisted decision products.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of professional software-engineering experience, including ownership of complex production applications or major end-to-end capabilities.

 - Experience designing usable, data-rich web applications in partnership with product, design, and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience with relational SQL and data-intensive applications, including integration with warehouse, lakehouse, or operational data systems. 
 - Experience with asynchronous processing, queues, workflow engines, or resilient patterns for long-running workloads. 
 - Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated commitment to code quality, accessibility, observability, documentation, and operational ownership. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with FastAPI, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, modular frontend architectures, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience building interactive visualizations and comparison workflows for analytical, operational, financial, or planning users. 
 - Experience embedding statistical models, optimization engines, simulation, or machine-learning capabilities into production applications. 
 - Experience with API and data-contract versioning, enterprise identity and access management, and secure integrations. 
 - Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, healthcare, finance, or another complex operational domain. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted product experiences and appropriate grounding, evaluation, and human-review controls.

 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

Collaboration & Growth

We embed with product, engineering, and architecture teams, apply modern automation and AI-enabled testing, and take quality work from experiment into operational delivery at enterprise scale. 

You Are

A hands-on SDET and quality leader with 12+ years in test automation and software quality engineering. You write and review automation, set and execute the quality strategy for your program, and coach a team while remaining technically engaged. You are comfortable in global, collaborative delivery environments and you care about embedding quality across the full software development lifecycle - not only at the end of a sprint. 

The Work

You will lead quality for complex application delivery: partnering with product, development, and architecture teams; defining and executing a modern test strategy; and applying AI-enabled approaches where they deliver measurable value. You will take accountability for your team's delivery outcomes, technical direction, and continuous improvement, acting as both a technical lead and a client-facing quality partner. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Define and lead end-to-end quality for your program, including early validation, risk-based testing, and continuous testing. 
 - Own quality strategy, test planning, estimation, execution governance, defect management, and release-readiness assessment across your workstreams. 
 - Establish the appropriate balance of unit, API, UI, integration, regression, and exploratory testing based on product risk and architecture. 

SDET & Custom Application Quality

- Lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and validation components - not test cases alone. 
 - Design, implement, and scale maintainable automation frameworks for web applications and services, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Build UI, API, and where required mobile automation using Playwright and comparable tools such as Appium and REST Assured. 
 - Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, coding standards, and shift-left quality practices. 

AI-Enabled Testing & Innovation

- Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and agentic test automation solutions to accelerate test design, implementation, maintenance, and analysis responsibly. 
 - Apply GenAI tooling (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve test design, code generation, debugging, and root cause analysis. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI-enabled testing tools through controlled proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, accuracy, and maintainability. 

DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gates that provide fast, reliable feedback. 
 - Embed automated testing into delivery pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, covering version control and artifact management. 

Cross-Platform Quality Delivery

- Lead testing across web, API, and mobile (iOS/Android) layers as the engagement requires. 
 - Apply contract testing, test-data management, service virtualization or mocking, and observability practices. 

Client Engagement & Advisory

- Partner with client and business stakeholders to shape quality strategy and support transformation initiatives. 
 - Facilitate workshops and deliver pragmatic quality solutions in ambiguous or evolving delivery environments. 

Team Leadership & Delivery Accountability

- Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing quality engineering team, local or distributed, while remaining technically engaged. 
 - Own your team's delivery outcomes and guide day-to-day technical decisions. 
 - Coach team members, set technical direction, review automation code, and promote continuous learning and engineering discipline. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Collaborate across product, development, architecture, DevOps, security, and business teams to resolve dependencies and embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

- Improve test coverage, automation maturity, and delivery efficiency over time. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, reusable standards, automation patterns, and shared assets that build team capability. 

Reporting & Insights

- Produce clear test outcome reports covering execution status, coverage, defect trends, residual risk, release recommendations, and improvement actions. 
 - Track meaningful quality metrics and deliver dashboards that identify systemic issues, improve predictability, and reduce escaped defects. 

Security, Accessibility & Compliance

- Embed secure, accessible, and compliant quality practices into delivery, including in regulated environments such as financial services, public sector, and healthcare. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of experience in test automation, SDET, or software quality engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex automation programs. 
 - Proven experience leading quality engineering teams, managing priorities, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery outcomes. 
 - Hands-on coding proficiency in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java, with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, clean-code principles, reusable framework design, version control, and code reviews. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright or a comparable modern UI automation framework. 
 - Strong API testing and automation knowledge, including REST services, authentication, data validation, error handling, and service-level test design. 
 - Strong grounding in functional testing techniques, including requirements analysis, test design, boundary and negative testing, risk-based testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with unit-testing frameworks and close collaboration with development teams to improve unit and component test coverage. 
 - Proven experience integrating testing into DevSecOps pipelines, including CI/CD, automated quality gates, reporting, source control, and artifact management. 
 - Strong experience in test strategy, test-data management, mocking, and observability. 
 - Ability to create effective test strategies and communicate concise, evidence-based test outcome reports to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder-management, written communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in SAFe Agile or other scaled Agile environments. 
 - Strong understanding of GenAI in the SDLC, including prompting techniques and AI-augmented testing approaches. 
 - Experience with contract testing and advanced observability frameworks. 
 - Background in cross-platform application testing across web and mobile. 
 - Experience in compliance-heavy or regulated industries such as financial services, public sector, or healthcare. 
 - Experience contributing to quality engineering transformation or digital testing programs. 
 - Experience leading quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, or distributed teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation suites or transitioning to Playwright and AI-enabled testing approaches. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality areas such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and observability. 
 - Relevant testing, cloud, Agile, DevOps, or engineering certifications are an advantage. 

Leadership Competencies

- Lead with accountability, sound judgment, and a strong customer-focused quality mindset. 
 - Communicate quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leaders and business stakeholders. 
 - Build alignment across teams without relying solely on authority, and facilitate timely resolution of quality issues. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports coaching, knowledge sharing, and sustainable delivery. 
 - Continuously improve processes while balancing speed, reliability, maintainability, and business value.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tooling & Automation
data.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3. 5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world's largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. 

Vultr Cares

- Medical Insurance stipend paid annually 
 - 9 Company-Paid Holidays 
 - Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
 - Professional Development Reimbursement 
 - Internet reimbursement 
 - Fitness membership reimbursement
 - Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Dev Engineer to serve as the technical owner connecting our engineering alerting to Vultr's new Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai, India, and to build the consolidated single-pane dashboard GIOC will operate from. The ideal candidate looks at five disconnected monitoring consoles and a dozen siloed alert feeds, winces, and then methodically builds the one dashboard that replaces all of them. This is a highly visible, focused role, requiring deep familiarity with Vultr's current architecture, monitoring stack, and operational workflows. This is your opportunity to build the operational backbone GIOC runs on from day one. 

Role Overview

The Senior Software Engineer - Tooling & Automation will own the development of automation, integrations, and unified monitoring capabilities for Vultr's GIOC in Chennai. The role will connect multiple monitoring, SIEM, infrastructure, and provider platforms into a single operational view, while automating alert routing, ticketing, paging, escalation, and SLA tracking. The engineer will work closely with Systems, Network, Security, and GIOC teams to improve observability, reduce manual intervention, and enable reliable 24×7 global infrastructure operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze every engineering alert stream across Systems, Network, and Security-including Icinga, Grafana, and SIEM platforms-to determine the optimal integration strategy via webhooks, APIs, or native connectors. 
 - Develop a robust notification layer that funnels high-priority events into GIOC's operational toolkit, ensuring critical context remains intact for rapid L1 response. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts to align automated routing logic with established escalation and resolution protocols. 
 - Engineer seamless on-call notification workflows that drive strict adherence to acknowledgment SLAs without requiring manual intervention. 
 - Architect a comprehensive single-pane dashboard that aggregates monitoring across global providers like Equinix and Airtel, eliminating inefficient tool-switching. 
 - Define the initial scope for visualization projects alongside leadership to meet aggressive technical and operational milestones. 
 - Maintain continuous infrastructure visibility by managing side-by-side operations of legacy and modern tools during the GIOC transition phase. 
 - Integrate health and performance metrics-such as escalation precision and aging-into reporting modules for executive-level status updates. 
 - Produce detailed documentation for all routing systems and dashboards to ensure long-term maintainability by global operations teams. 

Qualifications

- 5-8 years of experience in Platform Engineering or similar domains, with significant expertise in NMS platforms, Grafana, and major SIEM environments. 
 - Profound understanding of Vultr's existing monitoring ecosystem, infrastructure stack, and standard operational procedures across multiple technical pillars. 
 - Proven track record of building complex integrations using Python and RESTful APIs over the last three years. 
 - Extensive experience crafting or customizing sophisticated dashboards via Kibana, Power BI, or similar visualization toolsets. 
 - Deep knowledge of ITSM workflows-specifically Jira and Mattermost-and the technical mapping of event severity to incident metadata. 
 - Preference for candidates with experience in 24x7 global NOC/SOC environments and multi-provider datacenter logistics. 

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted. 

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U. S. privacy rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures. 

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

data.title: Lead SDET
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Own quality outcomes, not activities - the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint, " it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it. "
 - Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there - the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention
 - Own bug leakage rate - target under 2-3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through
 - Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite - preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does
 - Shape automation coverage at the right layer - E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it - not just chasing a coverage percentage
 - Stay 50-60% hands-on - writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code
 - Build AI-native quality infrastructure - systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions
 - Deliver engineering-wide quality impact - at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar
 - Partner and present - sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation - this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (: 40-50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring)
 - Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal - you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works
 - AI-native, not AI-assisted - you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves - validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems
 - A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator - with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow
 - Fluent in the modern stack - Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them
 - Comfortable influencing without authority - defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote, the content data division of Nielsen, powers innovative entertainment experiences for leading media companies worldwide. Our advanced entertainment metadata and connected IDs enable seamless content navigation and discovery, helping consumers connect to the content they love and explore new favorites. With a global presence, Gracenote delivers both global and localized video, audio, automotive, and sports content solutions across the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Some of the biggest names who trust Gracenote are Jio, Amazon, NBC, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Samsung, Sony, and more. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Director of Engineering to lead our high-impact engineering organization at Gracenote. In this role, you will be responsible for defining technical strategy, building scalable architectures, driving platform modernization, and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (including Engineering Managers and technical leads). 

You will lead the evolution of next-generation metadata processing pipelines-integrating modern data platforms, automated web crawling, content curation, real-time metadata serving, and AI/Machine Learning solutions. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, and Global Business leadership to ensure our technology directly powers market-leading media solutions. 

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technical Vision

- Define Engineering Strategy: Drive long-term technical vision and architectural direction for Gracenote's core metadata, ingestion, and serving platforms. 
 - Platform Modernization: Lead initiatives to platformize metadata processing pipelines, transitioning legacy flows into modern, intelligent, high-performance distributed architectures. 
 - AI & Data Science Integration: Partner with Data Science and AI teams to integrate machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and GenAI capabilities into core operational processes, content ingestion, and data enrichment pipelines. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Excellence

- Scale High-Performing Teams: Lead, mentor, and build an engineering organization of Engineering Managers, Architects, and Software Engineers. 
 - Culture & Retention: Foster an inclusive culture based on Nielsen values-promoting innovation, continuous learning, technical rigor, and high associate retention. 
 - Talent Management: Oversee succession planning, performance management, career growth frameworks, and talent pipelines (including university relations and new joiner programs). 

Business & Stakeholder Alignment

- Product & Strategy Collaboration: Partner directly with Product Management, Data Science, and cross-functional executives to align engineering deliverables with key business metrics and strategic revenue drivers. 
 - Global Execution: Coordinate across local and global stakeholders to ensure seamless integration, high productivity, and successful delivery of high-visibility projects. 

Operational & Technical Execution

- System Scale & Reliability: Ensure overall system health by defining Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)-focusing on high availability, fault tolerance, low latency, recoverability, and scalability across global delivery APIs. 
 - Process Improvement & Automation: Drive agile methodologies and apply an automation-first mindset to software delivery, CI/CD, testing automation, and operational monitoring. 
 - Engineering Governance: Establish robust quality assurance standards, operational cadences, and continuous process optimization across the Product Development Lifecycle. 

Qualifications

Basic / Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

Experience

- 13+ years of total software development and engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing scalable, high-performance systems. 
 - 5+ years of direct management experience, including managing managers, technical leads, and multi-disciplinary global engineering teams. 

System Architecture & Tech Stack

- Deep expertise in object-oriented and functional programming languages (e. g. , Golang, Java, Python, Scala). 
 - Proven experience designing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and microservices. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern data architectures: real-time streaming architectures (e. g. , Kafka), batch data processing (e. g. , Spark, Flink), and RESTful/GraphQL API serving. 
 - Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Cassandra), caching layers (Redis, Memcached), and search engines (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch). 
 - Solid expertise in cloud-native deployment environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud ecosystems. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: FULL STACK DEVELOPER
data.description:
TEAM LEAD - BACKEND / FULL STACK ENGINEER (FINTECH)

Impacto Digifin Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 

Bangalore (Brookefield) | Work from Office | Full-Time

Job Location

Bangalore (Brookefield) - Work from Office

Experience

3-5 Years

Employment Type

Full-Time

Department

Engineering / Product Development

Document Date

21 October 2026

Role Overview

We are hiring a hands-on Team Lead to design, build, and run the backend of our digital banking and payments products. You will lead a small team building Java and Spring Boot microservices, Apache Kafka event pipelines, and PostgreSQL data models that move real money for banks and their customers. 

The role is backend-first, with full stack ownership: you will also guide ReactJS and Next. js frontends that sit on top of these services. You will own the full lifecycle, from requirement analysis and system design to production deployment, monitoring, and 24x7 support. 

We want someone who treats correctness, auditability, and uptime as product features. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend and Microservices Development
 - Design and build scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and third-party integrations with clear, versioned API contracts. 
 - Implement authentication, authorization, input validation, and secure coding practices across all services. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, backed by unit, integration, and API tests. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture with Apache Kafka
 - Build and maintain event-driven systems using Kafka producers, consumers, and Kafka Streams. 
 - Design event schemas, topics, partitioning, and retention to match business flows. 
 - Ensure exactly-once or idempotent processing so no event is lost or applied twice. 
 - Handle retries, dead-letter topics, consumer lag, and replay for failed or delayed events. 
 - Apply patterns such as Outbox, Saga, event sourcing, and CQRS where they fit. 
 - PostgreSQL Data Design and Management
 - Design normalized, transactional data models in PostgreSQL for accounts, ledgers, payments, and customers. 
 - Use ACID transactions, appropriate isolation levels, and row-level locking to keep balances correct under concurrent load. 
 - Tune queries, indexes, partitioning, and connection pooling for high-volume tables. 
 - Manage schema changes safely with versioned migrations (Flyway or Liquibase) and zero-downtime deployment. 
 - Plan data archival, backup, point-in-time recovery, and read replicas for reporting. 
 - Full Stack Ownership
 - Guide and contribute to responsive web applications built with ReactJS, Next. js, and TypeScript. 
 - Integrate frontend applications with backend services and keep API contracts in sync. 
 - Optimize end-to-end performance, responsiveness, and reliability. 
 - Team Leadership
 - Lead, mentor, and support developers in daily technical work. 
 - Break business requirements into technical specifications, tasks, and delivery plans. 
 - Assign work, track progress, and deliver milestones on time. 
 - Run code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design reviews. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Coordinate with Product, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, Business, and Management teams. 
 - Support technical interviews, onboarding, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Deployment and Production Support
 - Use Git-based workflows, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines for builds and releases. 
 - Own production health: troubleshoot incidents, fix performance bottlenecks, and lead root-cause analysis. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and deployment procedures. 
 - AI-Assisted Development
 - Use AI coding tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor for code, tests, debugging, and documentation. 
 - Review and validate all AI-generated output before it reaches production. 

Designing and Maintaining Banking Products

Designing Banking Products

- Ledger-first design: build double-entry ledgers in PostgreSQL where every debit has a matching credit and balances can always be rebuilt from entries. 
 - Transaction integrity: use idempotency keys, unique transaction references, and state machines so a request retried by a customer, bank, or network never posts twice. 
 - Payment flows: design end-to-end flows for UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, and card or wallet payments, including timeouts, pending states, reversals, and refunds. 
 - Distributed consistency: keep data consistent across microservices with Outbox, Saga, and compensating transactions instead of distributed locks. 
 - Core banking integration: integrate with core banking systems such as Oracle FLEXCUBE or Finacle, NPCI and switch interfaces, and partner bank APIs. 
 - Product configuration: model savings and current accounts, loans, deposits, and wallets so limits, charges, interest, and rules are configuration rather than code changes. 
 - Customer lifecycle: support onboarding, KYC and e-KYC, account servicing, and closure with clear status tracking. 
 - Security by design: encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit, mask PII in logs, manage keys through HSM or a vault, and apply least-privilege access. 
 - Regulatory compliance: build to RBI guidelines, including data localization, audit trails, and NPCI operating rules, and align with PCI DSS where card data is involved. 
 - Controls: implement maker-checker approvals, transaction limits, velocity checks, and hooks for fraud and AML monitoring. 

Maintaining Banking Products in Production

- Reconciliation: run daily automated reconciliation between internal ledgers, partner banks, NPCI, and settlement files, and resolve mismatches within agreed timelines. 
 - Settlement and batch jobs: own end-of-day and beginning-of-day processes, interest accrual, charges, and settlement runs, and make them safe to re-run. 
 - High availability: design for 24x7 uptime with no single point of failure, graceful degradation, and defined RPO and RTO for disaster recovery. 
 - Observability: track business and technical metrics such as transaction success rate, latency, and consumer lag in Prometheus and Grafana, with alerts before customers notice. 
 - Incident management: lead incident response, customer-impact assessment, root-cause analysis, and post-incident fixes for failed or stuck transactions. 
 - Safe change management: release through feature flags, canary or blue-green deployments, and backward-compatible APIs and schemas, with tested rollback plans. 
 - Audit and reporting: keep immutable audit logs and support regulatory reports, internal audits, and data requests from banks and regulators. 
 - Continuous improvement: track defects, performance, and technical debt, and plan regular upgrades of frameworks, libraries, and security patches. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

Candidates must have hands-on experience in the following areas: 

- Backend: strong Java (Core Java, Java 17+), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security. 
 - Messaging: Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, event design, partitioning, and offset management. 
 - Database: strong SQL and PostgreSQL, including data modeling, transactions, isolation levels, indexing, and query tuning. 
 - Architecture: microservices, distributed systems, event-driven design, OOP, and design patterns. 
 - APIs: designing and documenting RESTful APIs with JSON and OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Frontend: working knowledge of ReactJS, Next. js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript. 
 - DevOps: Docker, Git (GitHub or GitLab), and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Testing: unit and integration testing with JUnit and Mockito, plus debugging and code review. 
 - Leadership: experience guiding developers, reviewing code, planning tasks, and owning delivery. 
 - Problem solving: strong debugging skills for production issues in distributed systems. 

Mandatory Screening Requirement: Candidates must have strong backend experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL, plus working frontend knowledge in ReactJS or Next. js. Frontend-only profiles will not meet the core requirement. 

Good to Have

- Payments domain: experience with UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, NPCI integrations, or card and wallet systems is highly preferred. 
 - Message-driven patterns: event sourcing, CQRS, Saga, and Outbox. 
 - Performance: experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems, such as payments or UPI switches. 
 - Spring ecosystem: Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, Spring WebFlux, and Spring Integration. 
 - Security: OAuth 2. 0, JWT, OpenID Connect, encryption, key management, and OWASP practices. 
 - Data and caching: Redis, PostgreSQL replication and partitioning, and Oracle Database or Oracle FLEXCUBE exposure. 
 - Cloud and orchestration: Kubernetes, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, and AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Monitoring and quality: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry, and SonarQube. 
 - Compliance: working knowledge of RBI guidelines, PCI DSS, and audit requirements. 
 - Ways of working: experience in Agile/Scrum teams. 

Preferred Domain Experience

- Banking, Financial Services and FinTech. 
 - Digital payments, lending, or core banking platforms. 
 - Enterprise integrations and digital transformation projects. 

Skills: - Javascript, React. js, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, TypeScript, SQL, Microservices, Redux/Flux, GitHub, Docker, DevOps, PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs, HTML/CSS, Spring Security and NextJs (Next. js)

For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www. morganstanley. com.

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. 

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week. 

About The Team

The Investment Systems team at Parametric: 

We are building financial software that solves for some of the world's most complex financial opportunities. This includes building solutions to provide customized direct index exposure while making tax sensitive asset selection to improve overall after-tax portfolio returns. 

We design and build scalable multi-asset portfolio management solutions, secure platforms for creating financial applications and low-code workflows, and a core data platform that delivers trusted financial data.

We are looking for individuals that have a strong curiosity and passion for learning new things, while continuously challenging oneself to build things better and more scalable.

About the Role

As a Lead Developer, you will own and evolve the core platform services that power our AI-driven products. You will design and build production-grade APIs, LLM-based extraction and enrichment pipelines, and agentic workflows - ensuring they are reliable, performant, and scalable. 

You will work closely with AI engineers, front-end developers, and product stakeholders to translate investment use cases into robust back-end solutions. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who combines deep Python expertise with hands-on experience building LLM-driven applications and who thrives in a fast-paced, product-oriented environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain back-end services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, serving both internal and external consumers. 
 - Build and optimise LLM-based pipelines for information extraction, summarisation, and classification across diverse source types. 
 - Develop and maintain agentic AI workflows using LangGraph, including tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning chains, and feedback loops. 
 - Extend and operate the MCP server layer (FastMCP), enabling seamless integration of AI capabilities into third-party tools and workflows.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Payfinia

Payfinia is a SaaS payment hub powering community banks and credit unions across the United States. Our flagship product, IPX (Instant Payment Exchange), enables real-time payment processing across major payment rails including FedNow and RTP. We build secure, scalable, cloud-native financial infrastructure that empowers smaller financial institutions to compete at the highest level. 

We are a fast-growing engineering organization with deep roots in AWS, microservices, and payment compliance. We are looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager to join our leadership team at our India development center. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineering Manager based in India who is as comfortable reviewing a system design as they are running a sprint planning session. You will lead one of our core engineering teams, take full ownership of feature delivery, and work closely with Product, QA, and DevOps - as well as our US-based leadership, client teams, and financial institution partners. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will operate through 2-3 tech leads and senior engineers while personally engaging in architecture reviews, critical-path technical decisions, and AI-SDLC adoption - not just managing timelines. You will be expected to drive autonomous decision-making during India business hours and maintain proactive communication across a 10-15 hour time zone gap. 

Key Responsibilities

People & Team Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 10-15 engineers across Java, Node. js, and React. js stacks, operating through 2-3 tech leads
 - Conduct regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations
 - Drive hiring - own technical interviews and build a high-quality engineering pipeline
 - Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, engineering pride, and AI-augmented productivity
 - Manage and coordinate with QA team, and external contractors

Technical Leadership

- Actively participate in architecture, design, and code reviews across the stack
 - Make or guide key technical decisions on microservices design, API contracts, data modeling, and integration patterns
 - Ensure adherence to engineering best practices: code quality, security-by-design, observability, and documentation
 - Own technical quality gates for multi-tenant SaaS releases

AI-SDLC Leadership

- AI-Assisted Development - Drive adoption of AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalents) across the team; establish usage guidelines, measure productivity impact, and share best practices
 - AI Across the SDLC - Integrate AI into the full development lifecycle: AI-driven test case generation, automated code review augmentation, design document drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and documentation generation
 - Measurement & Governance - Define and track AI productivity metrics (AI-assisted code coverage, review cycle time reduction, defect escape rates); ensure AI tooling usage complies with PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and data residency requirements; establish prompt engineering standards and reusable context libraries for the team

Delivery & Execution

- Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for your team's domain - from planning and sprint execution to production deployment and post-go-live support
 - Collaborate with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate effort, and translate roadmap into executable plans
 - Drive risk identification and mitigation - proactively surface blockers and manage dependencies across teams
 - Support multi-tenant SaaS releases including customer onboarding, integration certification, and go-live events
 - Own deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate improvements for your team's domain

Security & Compliance

- Participate in threat modeling and secure SDLC practices for payment processing workflows
 - Ensure team adherence to PCI-DSS, SOC 2 compliance requirements as operational realities, not checkboxes
 - Support security incident response - coordinate remediation, produce root-cause analyses, and drive hardening initiatives
 - Maintain audit-ready engineering practices: code review documentation, change management records, access control hygiene

Stakeholder & Client Engagement

- Represent engineering in scoping, discovery, and integration discussions with US-based financial institution partners and third-party vendors (expect periodic evening IST calls)
 - Maintain clear, proactive communication with internal and external stakeholders across time zones - default to over-communication given the distributed model
 - Provide regular engineering status, risk, and delivery updates to US-based leadership without requiring prompting

Required Qualifications

Experience

- 12+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years in an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead Manager role
 - Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (10+) in a SaaS or product-based environment
 - Strong background in full-stack development - hands-on expertise across at least two of: Node. js, React. js, Java/Spring Boot
 - Experience managing distributed/remote teams across time zones, including vendor and contractor coordination
 - Demonstrated experience adopting AI development tools and driving engineering productivity improvements

Technical Skills

- Node. js - REST API design, async/event-driven patterns, Express/Fastify, NPM ecosystem
 - React. js - Component architecture, state management (Redux/Zustand/Context), modern hooks, performance optimization
 - Java / Spring Boot - Microservices, Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, Maven/Gradle, multi-threading
 - Cloud & Infrastructure - AWS (EKS, RDS, API Gateway, Lambda, SQS/SNS, KMS, or equivalents), Docker, Kubernetes
 - Databases - PostgreSQL/MySQL (relational modeling, query optimization), Redis (caching, pub/sub)
 - API Security - OAuth 2. 0, JWT, mTLS, API Gateway patterns, WAF concepts
 - CI/CD & DevOps - GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar pipelines; familiarity with GitOps principles
 - AI Development Tools - Working proficiency with at least one AI coding assistant (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor); understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations in software engineering workflows

Domain Knowledge (Strongly Preferred)

- Experience in fintech, banking, or payment systems - understanding of payment rails (ACH, FedNow, RTP, Wire) and payment message lifecycles
 - Familiarity with PCI-DSS, SOC 2, or other financial compliance/security frameworks
 - Exposure to IBM MQ, Salesforce, core banking systems (Symitar, Corelation, DNA, XP2), or multi-tenant FI onboarding patterns

Soft Skills

- Strong communication skills - able to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders and communicate clearly in writing. 
 - High ownership mindset with a bias for action and autonomous decision-making
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast-paced, distributed environment
 - Collaborative leader who can balance empathy with accountability
 - Proactive communicator who defaults to transparency - doesn't wait to be asked for updates

data.title: QMS Lead
data.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Manager - QMS is a strategic leader responsible for driving the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization's Quality Management System. This role ensures compliance with global quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations while fostering a culture of quality excellence across the enterprise. The position involves leading cross-functional teams, managing audits, and influencing organizational strategy to achieve world-class quality performance. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership in Quality Management Systems

 - Oversee implementation and maintenance of QMS in compliance with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 26262, ISO 13485, ISO 14001, and other relevant standards. 
 - Champion continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and best practices to enhance process efficiency and product quality. 
 - Establish governance for documentation control, standardization, and quality assurance across all functions. 
 - Compliance, Certifications & Regulatory Affairs
 - Ensure adherence to international standards and regulatory requirements including RoHS, SEMI, AS9100, and customer-specific mandates. 
 - Lead certification audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections; act as the primary liaison with external auditors and certification bodies. 
 - Drive timely closure of audit findings through robust Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) systems. 
 - Monitor global regulatory trends and proactively update organizational policies to maintain compliance. 
 - Customer Quality & Relationship Management
 - Serve as the senior quality representative in customer interactions, audits, and technical reviews.

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Quality Management; Master's degree preferred. 

Certifications (Preferred)

- Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lead Auditor (ISO/IATF), Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent. 

Experience

- 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within manufacturing or engineering environments.

Technical Expertise

- Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 26262, ISO 13485, ISO 14001 standards.

data.description:
Description

READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?

How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world-class infrastructure. Sellers, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, in 135 countries worldwide, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces. 

Our team is working to solve what is arguably the most difficult eCommerce problem that exists today: building sophisticated, scalable technology to effectively simplify the complexity of connecting millions of FBA sellers with hundreds of millions of consumers who buy their products. Even small improvements result in millions of dollars in savings for our sellers and customers. Given the importance of small and medium sized businesses, these savings are what helps drive the global economy. 

Specifically, the Send to Amazon - STA Platforms (STAP) team is part of the broader Inbound Workflows and Platforms organization. The STAP team owns the user interface platform that enables sellers to inbound products to Amazon. As the owners of this platform, the STAP engineering team is responsible for the codebase, development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and providing on-call support. The team is also accountable for the inbounding workflow built on this platform, which supports a wide range of marketplaces categorized as "Worldwide" (WW). This encompasses the end-to-end engineering and quality assurance for the seller-facing UI on Seller Central. Additionally, the STAP team owns various services that they have inherited over time from other teams. The QA team within STAP specifically owns manual feature and regression testing across multiple initiatives, both within the inbound workflows organization and beyond. 

We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing our team great flexibility in product and technology direction. Come, join us and build the future!

Key job responsibilities

- Design and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plan, automation, and methodologies to ensure the quality and reliability of software products. 
 - Collaborate and influence cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and project managers to understand software quality requirements and design effective test strategies. 
 - Define release planning and provide input on the readiness of software for production deployment. 
 - Work with component teams to identify the pain points in their area and provide technical guidance. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for various software components, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing. 
 - Identify and document defects, issues, and potential areas of improvement in the software development process. 
 - Perform root cause analysis of complex issues and work with the development team to resolve issues and enhance the overall product quality. 
 - Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in QA and testing, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve testing processes.
