Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)

Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview

As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post-underwriting and post-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks. 

Core Responsibilities

- Perform pre-funding and post-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
 - Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
 - Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
 - Validate collateral-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
 - Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e. g. , Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
 - Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
 - Reconcile underwriting decisions by re-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
 - Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
 - Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
 - Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
 - Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading

Domain Skills Required

- Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc. ) and underwriting frameworks
 - Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre-funding and post-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
 - Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
 - Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
 - Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
 - Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management-ready findings

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- MBA/CA or equivalent with 7-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
 - Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage. 
 - Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations. 

Good-to-have: 

- Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage-specific certifications
 - Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
 - Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Engineering Systems, Digital Thread, and Continuous Improvement

Business, Plant, and Cross-Functional Leadership

Talent and Organizational Development

Qualifications

- Bachelors/Masters in Electrical engineering or equivalent
 - 15+ years of engineering experience in low-voltage power distribution, switchgear, busway, or related electromechanical products, with substantial experience in Engineer-to-Order, Customer Order Engineering, Customer Order Design, application engineering, detailed design, or requisition engineering. Minimum 5 years of people-leadership experience leading multi-disciplinary electrical and mechanical engineering teams; experience leading leaders or multiple product-line teams is preferred. 

Skills

- Extensive knowledge of ETO order engineering, including specification and drawing review, configuration, feasibility assessment, customer-approval drawings, detailed design, bills of material, manufacturing release, change management, as-built documentation, and plant support. 
 - Demonstrated product knowledge in both Low Voltage Assembly and Busway engineering, or deep expertise in one product line with proven ability to build capability in the other. 
 - LVA knowledge: Magnum PXR and Magnum DS switchgear; front- and rear-access arrangements; arc-resistant and arc-quenching configurations; UL 1558 and UL 891 applications; breakers, bus, risers, runbacks, stabs, bracing, neutral and grounding systems; protection, metering, communication, interlocks, control power, automatic-transfer and power-control schemes; one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, and mechanical layouts. 
 - Busway knowledge: Pow-R-Way III, Pow-R-Way II, and supported busway offerings; feeder and plug-in busway; straight lengths and fittings; elbows, offsets, tees, crosses, flanges, joints, expansion and phase-transposition sections; transformer taps and throat connections; reducers, adapters, end feeds, end closers, hangers, power takeoffs, plug-in devices, layout drawings, final-field-fit requirements, and equipment coordination. 
 - Working knowledge of copper and aluminum conductor application, bus ampacity, voltage and short-circuit ratings, phasing, orientation, grounding, neutral arrangements, insulation, voltage drop, environmental ratings, clearances, supports, seismic requirements, installation constraints, and field coordination. 
 - Strong understanding of applicable ANSI, IEEE, UL, NEMA, NEC, NFPA, CSA, and IEC requirements, including low-voltage switchgear, busway, arc-resistant, testing, and installation requirements applicable to the supported portfolios. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, structure and compartment assembly, breaker and device fitment, bus fabrication and jointing, wiring, inspection, testing, packaging and shipping splits, quality systems, engineering changes, and product lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with BidManager or comparable configuration tools; AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical; Inventor or comparable 3D CAD; ENOVIA/3DX or comparable PLM; Design Automation; BIM; MAPICS/AS400; and manufacturing-release or order-management systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead design automation, BIM and digital-thread initiatives, reusable product definition, configuration validation, drawing and BOM automation, busway engineering automation, workflow optimization, and engineering-quality improvement. 
 - Demonstrated application of Lean, DMAIC, Design for Six Sigma, Agile, and continuous-improvement methods; Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred. 
 - Ability to evaluate competitor offerings, customer and market trends, product standards, installation practices, and technology developments relevant to low-voltage assemblies and busway.

Purple Business | Mobile Application Testing & Quality Assurance

Company: Purple Business

About Purple BusinessPurple Business is an AI-powered business growth platform designed to help small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer insights, and automation. 

We're looking for a detail-oriented and technically curious Mobile App QA Intern to ensure our Flutter-based iOS and Android applications deliver reliable, intuitive, visually polished, and high-quality user experiences. 

You'll work closely with our Flutter developers, product designers, AI engineers, and founders to identify issues, improve app quality, and support product releases. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Mobile App Testing & Quality Assurance
 - Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing of our Flutter-based iOS and Android applications. 
 - Identify bugs, crashes, performance issues, UI inconsistencies, and unexpected application behavior. 
 - Create detailed test cases, testing scenarios, checklists, and bug reports. 
 - Validate user journeys, onboarding flows, navigation, forms, and other core product features. 
 - Test application behavior across different devices, operating system versions, and screen sizes. 
 - Verify bug fixes and conduct regression testing before releases. 2. UI/UX & Visual Quality Testing
 - Compare implemented Flutter interfaces against approved Figma designs. 
 - Identify inconsistencies in typography, colors, spacing, layouts, responsiveness, and visual hierarchy. 
 - Test animations, transitions, interactive components, and user feedback states. 
 - Identify usability issues and recommend improvements to enhance the overall user experience. 
 - Collaborate with the visual design team to maintain high standards of UI quality. 3. iOS & Android Environment Testing
 - Test applications across Android and iOS environments. 
 - Understand platform-specific behavior, permissions, notifications, navigation, and device compatibility. 
 - Test app builds distributed through TestFlight, Android internal testing, and other development environments. 
 - Validate application behavior under different network conditions, interruptions, and background/foreground states. 
 - Identify platform-specific crashes, inconsistencies, and performance issues. 4. API, Network & Backend Testing
 - Use tools such as Postman, Charles Proxy, Proxyman, or similar tools to inspect API requests and responses. 
 - Verify API integrations, authentication flows, error handling, and data consistency. 
 - Test application behavior during API failures, slow network connections, timeouts, and unexpected responses. 
 - Collaborate with backend developers to identify and reproduce integration issues. 5. Analytics, Performance & Crash Monitoring
 - Validate analytics events, user interactions, screen tracking, and conversion funnels. 
 - Work with tools such as Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and other monitoring platforms. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks, slow loading screens, memory issues, and application crashes. 
 - Test loading states, caching, and overall application responsiveness. 
 - Help ensure accurate event tracking across iOS and Android. 6. AI Feature Testing
 - Test AI-powered workflows, generated content, and intelligent features within the Purple Business application. 
 - Verify that AI responses, recommendations, and generated outputs are displayed correctly within the UI. 
 - Identify AI workflow failures, unexpected outputs, loading issues, and error-handling problems. 
 - Develop testing scenarios for different user inputs, business use cases, and edge cases. 
 - Collaborate with AI engineers to report issues and improve the reliability of AI-powered experiences. 7. Test Documentation & Team Collaboration
 - Maintain organized bug reports, testing checklists, and quality assurance documentation. 
 - Track issues and progress using Trello or other project management tools. 
 - Provide clear bug reproduction steps, screenshots, screen recordings, and device details. 
 - Collaborate with Flutter developers to verify fixes and prevent regressions. 
 - Participate in product reviews, testing discussions, and release planning. 
 - Share regular updates on testing progress, identified issues, and application quality. Requirements
 - Good understanding of mobile application testing principles and QA methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with Flutter-based applications and the iOS and Android ecosystems. 
 - Ability to write structured test cases, identify edge cases, and document bugs clearly. 
 - Understanding of functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. 
 - Familiarity with Postman and network debugging/proxy tools. 
 - Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP requests, and response codes. 
 - Strong attention to UI/UX details and ability to compare implementations against Figma designs. 
 - Familiarity with analytics, event tracking, and crash reporting. 
 - Good analytical thinking, debugging skills, and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, designers, and product managers. Preferred Skills
 - Basic knowledge of Flutter and Dart. 
 - Experience with Flutter widget testing, integration testing, or automated testing frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Appium or other mobile automation tools. 
 - Experience with Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, or similar monitoring tools. 
 - Understanding of Git, CI/CD, and mobile release processes. 
 - Familiarity with Android Studio, Xcode, TestFlight, and Google Play Console. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered applications or API-integrated mobile products. What You'll Gain
 - Hands-on experience testing a real AI-powered mobile application. 
 - Direct collaboration with the Purple Business founding, engineering, and design teams. 
 - Exposure to Flutter development workflows, mobile testing tools, and release processes. 
 - Practical experience in functional testing, API debugging, analytics validation, and AI feature testing. 
 - Opportunities to contribute to product quality and user experience improvements. 
 - Mentorship and experience working in an early-stage product technology startup. How to ApplyShare your resume, LinkedIn profile, and any mobile application testing projects or QA experience. 

Candidates with experience testing Flutter applications, identifying UI inconsistencies, debugging API issues, or writing automated test cases are encouraged to apply. 

We're looking for someone who doesn't just find bugs, but understands how applications should behave, anticipates potential failures, and actively contributes to building a polished, reliable, and high-quality mobile product.

data.title: AVP- Fullstack AI Engineer- HR Tech
data.description:
Job Description

About the Role

As Jefferies transitions from traditional SaaS workflows to an Agentic AI Operating Model, the skillsets required to manage the platform shift fundamentally. The platform relies on continuous monitoring, external signal processing (Watcher Agents), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) governance. 

We are seeking a hybrid engineering profile-a Lead AI Engineer-who bridges the gap between enterprise systems integration, LLM prompt governance, and complex business logic. This role goes beyond traditional "keep the lights on" IT support; this individual will act as the operational pilot of the AI platform, tuning agent behavior, ensuring data security, and evolving the system's capabilities to meet dynamic business demands. 

You will be the primary technical owner of the platform: operating and hardening it in production, extending its AI agent workflows and enterprise integrations, and driving the Phase 2 roadmap (candidate portal, scheduling, assessments, and further automation). 

Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
 - Backend: Python 3. 12+, FastAPI, Pydantic, async I/O, Server-Sent Events (SSE)
 - AI / Agents: LangGraph and LangChain agent pipelines with AWS-hosted LLMs (e. g. , Amazon Bedrock), human-in-the-loop approval gates, agent control room, prompt and eval management
 - Database: MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB (document modeling, async access via Motor)
 - Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, structured logging, metrics, tracing, audit trails
 - Enterprise integrations: Oracle ORC (HRIS - requisitions, candidates, scorecards), PeopleSoft incl. CSS (staffing & comp), background-check vendor APIs (e. g. , First Advantage - bidirectional), DocuSign e-signature, Microsoft Exchange / Outlook via Graph API, ServiceNow ITSM
 - Sourcing channel integrations: LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (One-Click Export ingest), Indeed Retrieve Candidates API (GraphQL + OAuth), Naukri ATS webhook ingest

Key Responsibilities

- Own production operations of the platform: monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and SLA adherence ("keep the lights on"). 
 - Evolve the platform on the delivered foundation: design, build, and ship new features across the React frontend and FastAPI backend. 
 - Maintain and extend agentic AI workflows - agent nodes, prompts, guardrails, tool bindings, and human-in-the-loop approval gates - including evaluation and bias-governance of AI scoring. 
 - Operate and extend the connector framework integrating Oracle ORC, PeopleSoft, BGC vendors, DocuSign, Exchange/O365, and ServiceNow. 
 - Maintain sourcing-channel ingestion pipelines - LinkedIn RSC candidate export, Indeed Retrieve Candidates API streaming, and Naukri webhook receivers - feeding the Sourcing Agent's scoring and shortlisting. 
 - Manage data models and pipelines in MongoDB/DocumentDB, ensuring data quality, sync integrity across systems of record, and auditability. 
 - Own the AWS infrastructure via IaC and CI/CD; manage environments, releases, security posture (SSO/RBAC), and cost. 
 - Maintain observability: dashboards, agent audit trails, structured logs, alerts, and operational runbooks. 
 - Partner with HR Ops, Recruiting, Legal/Compliance, and IT stakeholders to prioritize the backlog and translate business needs into platform capabilities. 
 - Agent Operations: Monitor, tune, and deploy updates to specialized AI process agents (e. g. , automated sourcing, offer generation, candidate triage) utilizing Jefferies' internal LLM gateways. 
 - Ontology & Knowledge Base Maintenance: Continuously update the system's Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge graph (e. g. , uploading new compliance policies, visa regulations, or compensation matrices) to ensure agents reason against the latest ground-truth data. 
 - Data Sovereignty & PII Handling: Proven ability to architect data-masking pipelines to ensure highly sensitive data (Compensation, SSNs, Diversity metrics) is encrypted, scrubbed, and strictly isolated from broader LLM reasoning engines. 
 - Algorithmic Bias & Regulatory Auditing: Familiarity with validating AI outputs against strict employment and compliance laws (e. g. , EEOC guidelines, NY Fair Chance Act constraints) to ensure automated workflows remain legally defensible and auditable. 
 - Lead knowledge transfer from the delivery partner and serve as the internal technical authority for the platform. 

Required Skills & Experience Skill AreaWhat We Expect

Full-stack engineering Strong professional software engineering experience, with ownership of production systems

Python backend (FastAPI) Async Python services, REST APIs, Pydantic data modeling, SSE/streaming patterns

React / TypeScript Modern React (hooks, router), TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS; component-driven UI

MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB Document data modeling, aggregation pipelines, async drivers (Motor), performance tuning

AWS cloud & DevOps ECS/EKS or similar container runtimes, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, Docker

GenAI / agentic systems LLM application development - LangChain/LangGraph or similar, prompt design, human-in-the-loop workflows, evals

Enterprise integrations Building/maintaining API integrations with enterprise systems (HRIS, ITSM, e-signature, email/Graph API); webhook ingest, OAuth, and partner-API patterns (e. g. , LinkedIn RSC, Indeed, Naukri)

Observability & operations Structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, incident response, runbooks

About Us

Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments. 

At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients. 

Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

data.title: Principal GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer
data.description:
The Principal GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI systems that combine LLM-powered GenAI and ADK-based agentic workflows on Google Cloud Platform. This role also requires leading and developing data pipelines for necessary data layer for AI/ML. This role sets architecture standards, leads multi-team delivery, and governs safety, reliability, and cost at enterprise scale-accelerating product teams to achieve monetization of AI based products through reusable patterns, platforms, and guardrails. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Architecture

- Define reference architectures for GenAI apps, RAG systems, and agent ecosystems (single/multi-agent) on GCP using ADK. 
 - Leverage capabilities of Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform in the Agentic AI Product development. 
 - Establish domain and platform standards: model selection, RAG/generation patterns, memory architectures, security baselines, observability, and LLMOps. 
 - Lead portfolio-wide technical decisions (build/buy, vendor selection, SLAs, quotas) with a focus on reliability, safety, and cost control. 
 - Define the data pipeline development for lakehouse, delta lake or feature engineering. 

Solution Design & Delivery

- Architect and lead implementation of production-grade GenAI solutions (Vertex AI models, Grounding, Pipelines, Evaluation) and agentic services (planning, tools, memory, HIL). 
 - Design multi-tenant and hub-and-spoke patterns with Okta/IAP/Apigee for secure API exposure and tenant isolation. 
 - Drive end-to-end delivery across teams: data ingestion (Dataflow/Composer), indexing (BigQuery vectors/Vertex Vector Search), services (Cloud Run/Workflows), events (Pub/Sub). 
 - Data Pipeline both near real time and batch. 

Platformization & Reuse

- Build and maintain prompt libraries, tool catalogs, agent templates, and evaluation harnesses for organization-wide reuse. 
 - Standardize LLMOps: CI/CD for prompts/models/agents, model registry, traceability, rollback, canaries, cost/performance scorecards. 
 - Enable a marketplace of agents/services with productized APIs, documentation, chargeback, and KPIs. 

Responsible AI, Security & Compliance

- Implement multi-layer guardrails: policy prompts, filters, memory governance, tool whitelisting, audit logs; ensure regulator-ready posture. 
 - Codify privacy, PII handling, data residency, and per-tenant isolation using VPC-SC, Secret Manager, IAM, and Apigee policies. 

Leadership & Enablement

- Mentor senior engineers and team leads; run architecture reviews, design clinics, and red-team exercises. 
 - Drive continuous evaluation programs and publish org scorecards for quality, safety, and cost. 
 - Partner with Product, Security, and SRE to align roadmaps, SLOs, and operational playbooks. 

Required Technical Competencies

- Dataflow and Apache Beam for data pipeline development. 
 - Strong on using SQL for data analysis. 
 - LLM & GenAI: Model selection (Gemini & Model Garden), prompt engineering, RAG/grounding, multimodal pipelines, fine-tuning/adapter methods. 
 - Agentic AI (ADK): Agent loops, planners, tool/function design, memory (episodic/semantic/long-term), HIL, policy enforcement. 
 - Data & Retrieval: BigQuery (including vector functions), Vertex Vector Search, Document AI, Dataplex for lineage and governance. 
 - Orchestration & Services: Cloud Run, Workflows, Pub/Sub, Dataflow/Composer; HA/DR, backpressure, circuit breakers. 
 - LLMOps/MLOps: Vertex AI Pipelines, registry, CI/CD, trace correlation, cost/performance monitoring. 
 - Security & Compliance: IAM, Secret Manager, VPC-SC, private service connect, DLP, Okta/IAP, Apigee API policies. 
 - Observability & Cost: Central telemetry, user feedback loops, drift/outlier detection, quota/capacity planning. 

Qualifications

- 12-15+ years in software/data/ML engineering; 1+ years hands-on with LLMs/GenAI and agentic systems. 
 - Proven delivery of enterprise-scale GenAI/agent platforms on GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Workflows). 
 - Demonstrated impact in platformization, governance, and multi-team technical leadership. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript (or equivalent) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/GCP Deployment Manager). 
 - Experience in security-by-design, privacy, and compliance audits. 
 - Proven delivery in building data pipeline using distributed computing frameworks such as Dataflow, Spark.

We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong expertise in modern C++, object-oriented design, algorithms, and software architecture to build and evolve scalable application frameworks and reusable software components. 

In this role, you will work on the core framework layer, designing robust and reusable components that enable application teams to build high-quality products efficiently. You will solve complex technical problems involving large datasets, performance, memory usage, scalability, reliability, and cross-platform software development. 

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who enjoys deep technical problem solving, understands how to design reusable frameworks and APIs, and is passionate about writing clean, maintainable, high-performance code. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop core frameworks: Design, develop, and evolve scalable application frameworks, reusable libraries, and common software components using modern C++. 
 - Build robust APIs and architecture: Design well-defined, stable APIs and interfaces, maintain backward compatibility, and apply strong object-oriented design principles, design patterns, and software architecture practices. 
 - Solve complex performance and scalability challenges: Design efficient algorithms and data structures and optimize performance, memory usage, scalability, and reliability when working with large datasets and demanding applications. 
 - Collaborate on framework capabilities: Work closely with Product and Application teams to understand requirements and translate them into robust, reusable framework capabilities that address broader product needs. 
 - Own quality across the development lifecycle: Contribute to requirements, design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery of core framework functionality while maintaining high coding and engineering standards. 
 - Build automated testing and reliability: Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to validate framework stability, compatibility, and long-term reliability. 
 - Drive technical excellence: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, contribute to Agile practices, promote engineering best practices, and continuously improve the quality and maintainability of the framework. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 3+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience developing core libraries, frameworks, platforms, or reusable software components. 
 - Strong expertise in modern C++ and Object-Oriented Programming, including practical application of design principles, design patterns, interfaces, abstraction, composition, and reusable software design. 
 - Strong understanding of algorithms and data structures, with the ability to analyze and solve complex problems involving performance, memory, scalability, and large datasets. 
 - Proven experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and product delivery. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to understand complex codebases, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and develop robust solutions. 
 - Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for automation and/or exposing or integrating C++ functionality, along with solid experience using Git and modern version-control practices. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience designing and maintaining public or internal APIs, including API versioning and backward compatibility.

data.title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

21-Oct-2026

Closing Date

05-Nov-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. What you'll do:

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

 - Experience with data engineering, data pipelines and data warehousing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deploying containerized microservices in Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with AI developer tooling like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor and using it to be a more productive engineer. 
 - Track record of shipping commercial APIs and data-driven applications in high-growth environments. 
 - Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling high-traffic services. 

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

data.title: Technical Quality Assurance Analyst
data.description:
The Technical QA Analyst ensures that all code changes and product releases are thoroughly tested and correctly implemented before deployment. The primary goal of the role is to protect product quality by identifying bugs, usability issues, and unintended side effects early, reducing incidents in live environments. 

The role also plays a key part in problem definition: working closely with end users and stakeholders to understand reported issues, reproduce them accurately, and assess their scope, severity, and root conditions. 

This role is expected to grow its automation capability - moving from manual and exploratory testing towards developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks that support faster, repeatable release validation. 

Key Responsibilities

Testing & Quality Assurance

- Test code changes, fixes, and new features prior to release, ensuring they meet functional and technical requirements. 
 - Validate that deployments have been implemented correctly across environments (e. g. test, staging, production). 
 - Identify bugs, regressions, and edge cases before and after releases. 
 - Document test results clearly, including steps to reproduce issues and expected vs actual behaviour. 
 - Support release sign-off by providing confidence-based quality assessments. 
 - Develop, maintain and execute automated test scripts and test plans to validate software functionality and regression coverage. 
 - Contribute to the build-out of automated testing frameworks, working towards integration within the CI/CD pipeline over time. 

Issue Reproduction & Analysis

- Work with end users, product teams, and support teams to understand reported issues. 
 - Recreate problems in test environments to determine: 
 - How widespread the issue is
 - Under what conditions it occurs
 - Whether it is intermittent or consistent
 - What makes the issue better or worse
 - Distinguish between user error, configuration issues, data-related problems, and genuine defects. 
 - Provide structured findings to developers to support fast and accurate fixes. 
Collaboration & Communication

- Work closely with software engineers, product managers, and IT colleagues throughout the development and release lifecycle. 
 - Act as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical users by translating user experience into clear technical detail. 
 - Provide feedback to improve testing processes, release checklists, and documentation. 

Process Improvement

- Help improve test coverage and testing approaches over time (with a growing emphasis on automation, alongside manual and exploratory testing where appropriate). 
 - Contribute to quality standards for releases and change management. 
 - Identify recurring problem patterns and suggest preventative improvements. 

Essential

Skills & Experience

- Experience working in a technical or IT environment (QA, testing, support, engineering, or similar). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to methodically reproduce and isolate technical issues. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to testing. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining issues and impact. 
 - Comfortable working with developers and technical systems. 
 - Foundational understanding of, or demonstrable interest in, test automation - including scripting, automation frameworks or tools (e. g. Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing. 

Desirable

- Experience testing software applications, platforms, or internal systems. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycles and release processes. 
 - Familiarity with bug tracking or ticketing tools. 
 - Basic understanding of code, APIs, databases, or system configuration - including the ability to write or interpret basic test scripts. 
 - Experience with regression testing, UAT, or exploratory testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools or CI/CD pipelines (e. g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions). 

Personal Attributes

- Curious and investigative mindset. 
 - Patient and persistent when tracking down complex or intermittent issues. 
 - Comfortable asking questions and challenging assumptions. 
 - User-focused: concerned with how real people experience the product. 
 - Calm and structured, particularly during incidents or release windows. 
 - Eager to grow technical skills, particularly in test automation and quality engineering. 

What Success Looks Like In This Role

- Fewer bugs and incidents reaching live environments. 
 - Faster resolution of reported issues due to clear reproduction and diagnosis. 
 - Increased confidence in releases from both technical teams and stakeholders. 
 - Improved understanding of product behaviour and risk areas over time. 
 - Growing test automation coverage, reducing reliance on manual regression testing over time. 

Why join YouGov?

Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people's opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities. 

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do. 

Life at YouGov

We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do. 

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

Role: Vice President - Product Engineering

About AppViewX: 

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments. 

Our Values

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together. 

- We Do What We Say: We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity. 
 - We Are Trusted Experts: We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need. 
 - We Raise the Bar: We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results. 
 - We Win Together: We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates. If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern engineering practices, Agentic AI, and platform engineering - and will play a pivotal role in shaping AppViewX's next-generation product strategy. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Engineering Leadership & Culture

- Lead and manage the product engineering team, providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and motivation to foster a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture. 
 - Set and champion engineering best practices - including coding standards, code reviews, CI/CD, TDD, and operational excellence - across all teams. 
 - Exert broad technical influence across multiple teams, driving productivity and effectiveness through deep domain expertise and hands-on leadership. 
 - Cultivate a culture of innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning - rapidly integrating emerging technologies and methodologies into day-to-day engineering work. Product & Platform Engineering

- Own and drive the Product Engineering charter to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce cognitive load across product teams. 
 - Work with Platform Engineering leaders to contribute platform development including internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability frameworks, and self-service capabilities
 - Scope and author technical plans for complex, large-scale features spanning multiple teams and release cycles; accurately track and report project and feature status at the executive level and release management. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams - including Product Management, Design, and Quality Assurance - to ensure seamless product development and timely, high-quality delivery. 
 - Be forward-looking on customer needs and technology trends to architect solutions that serve a wide variety of enterprise use cases at scale. Agentic AI & AI-Driven Engineering

- Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization - identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities. 
 - Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices - including AI code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools - to meaningfully accelerate the engineering lifecycle. 
 - Architect and oversee the integration of AI/ML capabilities - including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent frameworks - into AppViewX products, particularly within the AIS (AI Security) product line. 
 - Stay at the forefront of Agentic AI developments (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, etc. ) and evaluate their applicability to AppViewX's product and platform roadmap. 
 - Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value. Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction. 
 - Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations. 
 - Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models - enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment. 
 - Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level. 

What We Require

Experience & Leadership

- 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles. 
 - Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results. 
 - Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments. Technical Depth

- Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and LLM integration - including LangChain, AutoGen, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration patterns. 
 - Solid understanding of Platform Engineering principles - including internal developer platforms, GitOps, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and developer experience (DevEx) optimization. 
 - Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices. 
 - Strong command of software engineering best practices - coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI/CD, build processes, testing strategies, and production operations. 
 - Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals. 
 - Proponent of TDD and CI - capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices. Leadership & Communication

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills - with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments. 
 - Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery. 

Why AppViewX?

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way. 

AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24, 000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives. 
 - Drive multi-platform delivery: Provide leadership across Azure Cloud services, web application ecosystems, Salesforce capabilities and integrations, and payment processing platforms. 
 - Translate strategy into outcomes: Partner with product, business, architecture, security, risk, operations, and infrastructure leaders to convert priorities into roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable results. 
 - Strengthen engineering excellence: Champion scalable architecture, secure coding, automation, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, reliability, and disciplined software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans. 
 - Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions. 
 - Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement. 
 - Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation. 
 - Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk. 
 - Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel.

 - Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices.

 - Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

About Us

Meesho is India's e-commerce marketplace, on a mission to democratise internet commerce. 

Our multi-sided technology platform connects four key stakeholders - consumers, sellers, logistics partners, and content creators - to power inclusive growth at scale. 

We enable individuals and small businesses to sell online with ease, offering access to a wide customer base, integrated logistics, payment solutions, and platform support. 

For customers, Meesho offers a broad and affordable selection, tailored for diverse needs across Bharat. We also empower creators to build commerce-driven content that drives discovery and engagement. 

Our logistics operations are powered by Valmo, Meesho's asset-light logistics platform that works entirely through partner-led infrastructure to ensure cost-efficient and scalable deliveries. 

Follow Meesho

LinkedIn Instagram YouTube Facebook Twitter Website

Benefits & perks

Health & Insurance

Medical Insurance: Base cover of ₹6 lakhs for employees and their families, including coverage for LGBTIQ+ and live-in partners, with day-1 coverage for pre-existing conditions. 

Accident & Life Insurance: Personal accident insurance up to 3x CTC and term life insurance up to 2x CTC. 

Wellbeing Support: Free doctor consultations, telehealth services, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

Leave & Time Off

Parental & Childcare Support: Gender-neutral parental leave, including 30 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers, 30 days for secondary caregivers, adoption assistance (up to ₹1 lakh), and pet adoption leave. 

Wellness & Special Leaves: Company-wide "Reset & Recharge" leaves (approx. 11 days), infinite wellness leaves (up to 365 days), and bereavement/paid time off (around 20 days/year). 

Financial Benefits & Equity

Stock Options (ESOPs): Direct ownership via MeeSOPs with employee-friendly vesting schedules and periodic buyback opportunities. 

Retirement & Planning: Provident Fund (PF), Gratuity, National Pension System (NPS) contribution options, and flexible benefit plan (FBP) tax benefits. 

Perks & Aids: Salary advance program (up to 3 months CTC), car lease policy, gym/wellness benefits, and relocation support. 

Work Culture & Learning

Work Arrangement: Remote-first and flexible work policies, with certain roles operating on hybrid or office models. 

Development & Training: Access to learning platforms, courses, and continuous development initiatives via MYAcademy and specialized programs. 

Why explore a career with us

The Key Reasons to Join Meesho

- Accelerated Career Growth & "Extreme Ownership"

Meesho operates on a culture of high autonomy. Teams utilize a "problem-first" approach rather than a feature-first approach. Employees are encouraged to take extreme ownership of projects early in their careers, giving them opportunities to ship ideas quickly and see their direct impact on millions of users. 

- Immense Impact (Building for the Next Billion)

Unlike platforms targeting Tier 1 demographics, Meesho is dedicated to democratizing internet commerce for Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. To foster deep user empathy, the company implements unique rituals like "Listen or Die" (LOD)-mandating that team members gather direct user insights before beginning any project-and sponsors user-safari trips into smaller towns to study consumer habits firsthand. 

- Top-Tier Compensation & Financial Perks

Meesho rates highly for its Compensation & Total Rewards (4. 1/5 stars on Glassdoor). The company offers: 

Competitive base cash salaries. 

Direct equity ownership with employee-friendly vesting schedules and frequent ESOP buybacks. 

Substantial lifestyle perks, such as gym benefits, car lease policies, and salary advance programs. 

- People-First Benefits & Well-Being

Through its MeeCare Program, Meesho focuses on holistic wellness. Notable initiatives include comprehensive health insurance, mental health support, flexible leave policies, and a distinct 9-day post-festive "rest and recharge" shutdown to prevent burnout after major sales campaigns. 

Interview process

Overview of Interview Rounds

- Application & Resume Screening: 
 - Candidates apply via official job portals, campus drives, or recruiter networks. 
 - AI-backed review tools on platforms like Lever may analyze resume metrics, experience, and baseline competencies. 
 - Online Assessment (OA): 
 - Typically lasts 90 to 105 minutes and features 3 to 5 coding and debugging questions (ranging from arrays and greedy approaches to graph/tree and dynamic programming problems) alongside computer science MCQs on OS, DBMS, and Networks. 
 - Technical Interviews (1-2 Rounds): 
 - Round 1 (DSA / Problem-Solving): Focuses on core data structures, algorithms, and logical problem-solving (such as greedy algorithms, array manipulations, or DFS/trees). 
 - Round 2 (Machine Coding / Low-Level Design): A practical coding or LLD session (e. g. , implementing a carpooling system or ticket booking system in 60-75 minutes) to test code structure, scalability, and clean design under constraints. 
 - Hiring Manager / System Design Round: 
 - In-depth discussion on past projects, internships, concurrency, multi-threading, and CS fundamentals like CAP theorem. 
 - Evaluates system architecture and trade-offs. 
 - HR / Cultural Fit Round: 
 - Focuses on alignment with Meesho's core values, such as "extreme ownership, " a "user-first" mindset, and structured communication.

Explore opportunities to be part of our dynamic team at the Energy Plant Unit and contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine the onshore and offshore industry. #OneEPU

Position Overview

- The Lead Engineer - General Civil is responsible for leading and delivering all general civil engineering works for Power plant/ Petrochemical/Oil & Gas Industry, covering site development, earthworks, roads, paving, drainage systems, fencing, manhole and other associated facilities. 
 - Lead Engineer - General Civil develops corporate technical standards/ Procedures, workflow, engineering platform (e. g. General Civil design data integration) and keep them updated, integral, practical, and fit to purpose with incorporating Project Lessons Learnt. 
 - Lead Engineer - General Civil assists Head of Discipline for managing a corporate organization and mentors Engineers in the Discipline. 
 - Lead Engineer - General Civil conducts Technical Validation and Quality Assurance (input/output data accuracy, technical appropriateness, consistency, practicality, codes, optimum solution, and regulatory compliance) in executing Feasibility/ Conceptual Study/ Pre-FEED/ FEED, EPCI Engineering for Powerplant/ Petrochemical/Oil & Gas Industry projects. 
 - Lead Engineer - General Civil will have a strong background in Power plant/Petrochemical/Oil & Gas Industry, be an expert in General Civil Engineering, and provide strategic focus in General Civil Engineering functions. 
 - The strategic focus will also include providing support to Hanwha Ocean engineering teams based in Korea and elsewhere as necessary including Conceptual, pre-FEED and FEED for projects in the future. 
 - This role may require frequent travel to the US, Europe, and Asia. 

Key Responsibilities

General

- Develop Corporate Technical Standards, Procedures, Engineering Workflow and Engineering Platform for General Civil works. 
 - Assist Department Head of Discipline to manage corporate organization. 
 - Update and Maintain EPCI and O & M Phase Lesson Learnt database. 

Proposal/Pre-award Phase

- Conduct Conceptual/ Feasibility study to propose the optimum & competitive technical solution. 
 - Ensure that general civil works are optimized, efficient, safe, environmentally compliant, and engineering documents prepared in accordance with relevant design codes, standards, and client's project specifications. 
 - Provide engineering expertise and support to form the optimum & competitive proposals, engineering review and support for bid proposal including estimate of manhours & cost. 

Feasibility Study/Pre-FEED/FEED/EPCI Phase

- Become a focal point for General Civil works in Project Team and Communicate with Clients. 
 - Raise Technical Queries towards the Client's project documents, Design basis to ensure all scope of works and design basis are clarified. 
 - Manage interface with all relevant disciplines to get necessary information for General Civil engineering or to provide data to other disciplines for their engineering. 
 - Manage Project General Civil team - Resource and Schedule control. 
 - Mentor junior or less experienced engineers, promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team. 
 - Attend project meetings internally and with clients, 3rd party, sub-contractor and generate MOM. 
 - Report Area of Concerns, Progress and Plan to Project management team. 
 - Ensure Compliance with Client/ Regulatory requirements, develop Project Design Philosophies, Standards, Procedures. 
 - Conduct feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, FEED Verification (Inception of EPCI Phase) and EPCI phase Engineering. 
 - Prepare design calculations including design of roads and pavement design, drainage and stormwater design, studies, and review other deliverables performed by team members. 
 - Review and approve general civil drawings, calculations, specifications, and material take-offs (MTO/BOQ). 
 - Manage Design Team for 3D modelling of General Civil units and 2D AutoCAD drawings. 
 - Participation in various Workshops, Plot plan development, Layout optimization, 3D Model Review, Constructability Study, etc. 
 - Close out comment/punches/recommendation related to general civil works from 3D Model, Constructability Review, etc. 
 - Review Vendor Documents. 
 - Review contract structure for 3rd party consultants and manage work scope, review/ comment/ approval of 3rd Party's output.

data.title: Engineering Manager — Advanced Manufacturing Systems (Mechanical)
data.description:
Company Overview - Leumas

Leumas is a venture-funded deep-tech company based in Bengaluru, building modular robotic factories and software-defined manufacturing systems for healthcare products. 

Our R&D ambition is to build the future of drug manufacturing across emerging therapeutic modalities. We are developing new manufacturing modules and technologies for peptide synthesis, oncology applications and other advanced drug-production processes, while exploring Physical AI to make manufacturing systems more capable, adaptive and autonomous. 

This work brings together mechanical engineering, chemistry, process development, electronics, firmware, AI and quality systems. Our engineers translate scientific and process requirements into machines, test them through experiments and develop them toward scalable manufacturing platforms. 

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who wants to tackle unfamiliar engineering problems, build a strong multidisciplinary team and help define how future medicines will be manufactured. 

Industry Context

Our equipment must combine process performance, flexible configurations, hygienic design and practical manufacturing economics. Development succeeds when new mechanisms work repeatedly across realistic operating conditions. 

The Role

You will lead mechanical and manufacturing-system R&D for Leumas' next generation of technology modules, spanning peptides, oncology applications, Physical AI and emerging drug-manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with scientific, process, electrical, firmware and AI teams, you will translate new process requirements into equipment architectures, experimental systems and deployable manufacturing modules. You will guide development from early feasibility through prototypes, performance verification and transfer toward production. 

This role requires strong mechanical engineering depth, systems thinking and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You will build and mentor the engineering team while remaining personally involved in critical designs, experiments and technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

1. Technology roadmap - Translate manufacturing needs into development requirements, technical priorities and measurable acceptance criteria. Plan projects, resources and design milestones with leadership. 

2. Architecture & design - Lead mechanisms, motion systems, product-contact assemblies and modular interfaces. Review materials, tolerances, cleanability, maintainability and cost before releasing designs. 

3. Prototype learning - Plan experiments and instrumented trials; quantify dosing accuracy, throughput, repeatability or other relevant performance. Resolve failure modes through evidence and controlled design iterations. 

4. Cross-functional integration - Agree mechanical, electrical and software interfaces early. Coordinate process constraints, sensors, actuation, guarding and service access through complete-machine trials. 

5. Industrialisation - Own drawing and BOM quality, design-for-manufacture reviews and engineering change discipline. Transfer designs to build teams with assembly, test and operating documentation. 

6. Team & knowledge - Coach engineers, run technical reviews and maintain reusable design knowledge. Support invention documentation and protect confidential engineering information. 

7. New Manufacturing Technologies & Module Architecture - Work with scientists and process experts to understand the manufacturing requirements of new therapeutic modalities. Translate these into equipment concepts, module architectures and development plans. Evaluate technical feasibility, identify critical unknowns and build experiments that establish whether an approach can work. 

8. Physical AI & Adaptive Manufacturing - Collaborate with AI, robotics and controls teams to develop machines that can sense, interpret and respond to physical process conditions. Own the mechanical systems, actuation, sensing provisions and interfaces needed to test these capabilities. Establish measurable performance targets and appropriate safeguards with the responsible teams. 

You're a Fit If

·            BE/BTech, ME/Mtech, PHD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; typically 8-12 years in machine design and product development, including technical team leadership. A strong academic foundation from a leading engineering institution such as IITs, IISc, BITS or leading NITs is preferred. 

·            Track record delivering machines from requirements through prototypes, testing and manufacturing release. 

·            Strong fundamentals in mechanisms, machine elements, tolerances, materials and engineering analysis, with practical CAD proficiency. 

·            Ability to balance experimentation with schedules and lead cross-functional decisions using test evidence. 

·            You have developed novel machines or complex hardware where the solution was not fully defined at the outset. 

·            You can translate scientific or process requirements into engineering problems and work effectively with experts outside your discipline. 

·            You understand how mechanical design, sensing, actuation and software interact in a complete system. 

·            You can distinguish early technical feasibility from equipment ready for reliable manufacturing. 

Preferred: Candidates with a leading engineering-institution background and/or substantial R&D experience in a leading technology company / deep tech startups. Demonstrated engineering depth, delivery and startup adaptability will determine selection. 

How You Will Operate

You are a working technical leader who reviews details, invites critique and makes decisions explicit. You distinguish an interesting prototype from a design ready for deployment. 

What Success Looks Like

·            Priority development programs have clear requirements, test plans and accountable milestones. 

·            At least one agreed development milestone reaches documented performance verification and build handover. 

Why Join

·            Help build manufacturing technologies for emerging medicines and therapeutic modalities. 

·            Shape new modules spanning peptide processes, oncology applications and Physical AI. 

·            Work across engineering, science and AI to turn new manufacturing concepts into functioning machines. 

·            Build a capable R&D team and influence Leumas' technology roadmap. 

·            Take substantial ownership in a demanding startup where your work can define future manufacturing platforms.

data.title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer, AI & Search
data.description:

Yieldmo is an advertising platform that helps brands invent creative experiences through tech and AI, using custom ad formats, proprietary attention signals, predictive format selection, and privacy-safe premium inventory curation. We believe all ads should be human-centered, tailored, and provoke emotion and action. Yieldmo helps brands deliver the best ad for every impression opportunity, merging creative and media for proven results. 

The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (5-10 years of experience) to help build Yieldmo's AI-powered search engine, which will change how users discover and engage with content across major publishers. This is a full-stack role with a strong ML component. You'll build backend services and ML-powered features, and ship the user-facing interfaces that bring them to life. We care most about builders: engineers who write production code, iterate quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and own their work end to end. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that power AI-driven search, including retrieval, ranking, and indexing components. 
 - Build and deploy ML features into production: embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and model evaluation. 
 - Develop responsive, performant front-end experiences that surface search results and AI features to users and internal teams. 
 - Build and maintain data and content ingestion pipelines that feed the search system. 
 - Own features end to end, from prototype through production, monitoring, and iteration. 
 - Partner with Product, ML, and Engineering teams to turn requirements into shipped features.

 - Share knowledge and support teammates; senior engineers will mentor others and contribute to technical design decisions. 

Requirements

- Must be based in India. 
 - 5-10 years of professional software engineering experience, building and operating production systems. 
 - Strong backend skills in Python, with solid SQL and experience designing APIs and microservices. 
 - Hands-on front-end experience with a modern framework (React preferred) plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

 - Experience with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and CI/CD. 
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, system design, and testing. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-moving, remote team. 
 - An ownership mindset: you ship, measure, and improve. 

Nice to Haves

Hiring Process

 - An offer for successful candidates.

 - Equity: Share in Yieldmo's success through our employee stock option program.
