data.title: Platform Head
data.description:
Role Purpose

The Platform Head is accountable for leading end-to-end vehicle platform delivery. The role owns platform-level target setting, system-level cascade, cross-functional execution, trade-off decisions, deviation governance and launch readiness, ensuring achievement of TCP targets across all projects within the platform. 

Role Snapshot

Platform Target Setting

System Target Cascade

Engineering Integration

Purchase & Supplier Closure

Manufacturing Readiness

Deviation Governance

Cross-functional Trade-offs

TCP Delivery Ownership

Launch Handover

Exp - 18-25yrs

- Platform Strategy and Target Setting
 - Set TCP targets across all projects within the platform on time. 
 - Interface with Product Planning and Marketing to define platform targets including FI requirements. 
 - Ensure engineering, supplier, manufacturing, investment and cost feasibility are incorporated at target-setting stage. 
 - Incorporate planning and resource availability inputs from Program Portfolio Management. 
 - Ensure overall vehicle-level TCP targets are translated into effective system-level targets through Platform Engineering Heads. 
 - Delivery of Set Targets
 - Own achievement of TCP targets for all platform projects with support from platform team members and delivery organizations. 
 - Drive disciplined execution across engineering, purchase, manufacturing, quality and program teams. 
 - Review program health, highlight risks early and enable timely resolution of delivery bottlenecks. 
 - Engineering Leadership
 - Ensure effective translation of system-level targets into SORs, specifications, drawings and engineering deliverables through PEHs. 
 - Ensure inter-system trade-offs taken by PEHs are aligned with overall platform requirements. 
 - Resolve system and function interface conflicts to protect platform-level performance, cost and timing commitments. 
 - Purchase and Supplier Integration
 - Ensure timely closure and minimum reopening of technical deliverables through PEHs. 
 - Guide techno-commercial deliverable decisions through Platform Purchase Heads. 
 - Ensure vendor panel and Vendor on Board decisions by Strategic Sourcing Unit are aligned with platform requirements. 
 - Manufacturing and Industrialization
 - Ensure timely closure and minimum reopening of manufacturing decisions including make-vs-buy, manufacturing strategy and localization. 
 - Drive in-house part development decisions and manufacturing-related PPAP closure through Plant Manufacturing Heads. 
 - Partner with manufacturing, quality and plant teams to ensure readiness for vehicle handover. 
 - Governance and Trade-off Decisions
 - Lead inter-function and inter-project trade-off decisions to minimize or eliminate deviations in overall platform TCP targets. 
 - Oversee inter-project fund transfers and utilization where required. 
 - Debottleneck and veto system or function interface conflicts where platform outcomes are impacted. 
 - Reallocate material cost and investment within predefined limits. 
 - Deviation Management
 - Decide acceptance or rejection of TCP deviations based on feasibility, impact and overall platform priorities. 
 - Drive escalation and closure of approvals for necessary vehicle-level TCP deviations during delivery phase. 
 - Ensure deviation decisions are documented and aligned with business, engineering and launch priorities. 
 - Launch Readiness
 - Own timely vehicle handover to Manufacturing and Marketing & Sales teams. 
 - Ensure completion of all required quality clearances, validation milestones and launch gate requirements. 
 - Support smooth transition from development to launch and initial post-launch stabilization. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- Senior automotive leader with strong experience in vehicle platform development, product engineering or program delivery. 
 - Strong exposure to engineering integration, manufacturing readiness, supplier collaboration and target-cost management.

Job Description

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. 

Legacy infrastructure doesn't retire itself. Someone has to build the pipelines, rehearse the cutover, and carry the release into production and that's this seat. As a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer, you serve our application and infrastructure modernization work: you own build and release cycles for customer projects, land migrations from legacy hardware to AWS, and make deployments boring in the best sense of the word. 

Agents change what this job looks like day to day. Aedeon and automation handle the repetitive discovery, mapping, and validation work that used to eat engineer hours. That leaves you the parts that actually need a senior engineer: infrastructure architecture, risk tradeoffs, release judgment, and the operational standards the whole team ships against. You'll work client-facing, embedded with customer teams, and the delivery commitment is one you carry personally. 

What we are looking for?

- 6+ Years of total Hands-On Experience in DevOps
 - 4+ years with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) including modules, remote state, state management, imports and multi account providers. 
 - Experience in designing highly available and secure AWS architecture within strong understanding of RTO/RPO and DR Strategies.

 - 4+ years of Linux or Windows administration. 
 - 4+ years working with Git, with a solid grasp of branching and merging strategies.

 - 2+ years with cloud automation tools such as Ansible or Chef. 
 - 2+ years with container orchestration, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS ECS, and Docker. 
 - A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a drive to improve reliability and scalability. 

What you will do?

- Automate infrastructure creation with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation - infrastructure as code, not tickets and toil. 
 - Own application configuration management and drive Infrastructure as Code through deployment tooling. 
 - Own the build and release cycle for customer projects, end to end. 
 - Share responsibility for deploying releases and for operations and maintenance work. 
 - Improve the operations infrastructure we ship with - Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools like Graphite and Grafana. 
 - Support the engineering team operationally and help migrate legacy infrastructure to the cloud - retiring the old systems, not just standing up new ones. 
 - Establish and enforce operational best practices, and hold releases to them. 
 - Help hire culturally aligned engineers and mentor them as they grow. 
 - Work with the founders on team strategy and long-term technical planning.

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.

The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitise the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision.

 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling. 
 - Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience. 
 - Stack Breadth: Broad technical exposure across front-end, back-end and integration layers. 
 - System Design: Strong system design judgement with the capability to evaluate, challenge and refine agent-generated architectural outputs. 
 - Technical Support: Experience supporting production cloud environments, including logging, alerting, incident response and observability
 - Proficient in Kotlin, with a strong understanding of Jetpack Compose, View-based layouts (XML), , Kotlin Flows, Coroutines and asynchronous programming (async/await, structured concurrency). 
 - Solid grasp of MVVM architecture, Clean Architecture patterns (Use Cases / Repositories), and Navigation Component.

Preferred:

data.description:
Job Description

Greetings From Rakuten Symphony!

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry's pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https: //symphony. rakuten. com

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan's newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global. 

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business - from sales to engineering, support functions to product development. 

Let's build the future of mobile telecommunications together! About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30, 000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https: //global. rakuten. com/corp/. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Lead/Senior QA Engineer to design, architect and lead end-to-end integration testing and validation strategies across our OSS (Operations Support Systems) platforms. In this role, you will drive quality governance for complex multi-vendor ecosystems spanning Configuration Management (CM / Config Manager), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM), Performance Management (PM), Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Cloud Observability workflows. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in telecom service assurance, network synchronization parameters and a strong background in validating highly distributed data layers- specifically leveraging Graph databases for complex network topologies alongside Redis for high through put, real-time caching and data streaming pipelines. 

Key Responsibilities : 

• Integration & E2E Validation: Architect and execute comprehensive integration testing strategies across highly interconnected OSS environments, ensuring flawless structural data orchestration between northbound/southbound APIs, multi-vendor EMS/NMS and physical/virtual network elements. 

• Configuration Management (CM) Validation: Design and drive automated validation frameworks for CM engines to audit network configurations, track baseline drift, validate parameters (e. g. , cell parameters, routing tables) and verify automated network provisioning rollbacks. 

• Database & Network Topology Testing: Validate large-scale Graph databases (e. g. , Janus Graph)utilized for real-time network topology mapping, complex entity relationship queries and cross domain dependency modeling. 

• Performance & Cache Validation: Performance-test and validate distributed Redis DB implementations, ensuring active data structures, eviction policies, session states and high frequency pub/sub message queuing behave reliably under simulated peak telecom traffic loads. 

• Test Automation Frameworks: Design, build and scale custom test automation frameworks from scratch using Java and/or Python leveraging industry-standard tools such as Selenium, Playwright, PyTest, TestNG and REST Assured. 

• Observability & Streaming Validation: Validate cloud-native observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) along with high-throughput distributed messaging and event data logs streams orchestrated via Apache Kafka clusters. 

• AIOps & Closed-Loop Automation: Lead end-to-end quality validation initiatives for AI/ML-driven root cause analysis (RCA), predictive network analytics, anomaly detection algorithms and closedloop self-healing operational workflows. 

• CI/CD/CT Quality Gates: Embed robust automated quality validation gates, automated continuous regression suites and infrastructure tests seamlessly into DevOps deployment pipelines via Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD/CT engines. 

Required Technical Skills & Competencies: 

OSS & Telecom Domain Expertise

• Comprehensive understanding of the FCAPS structural framework and modern Telecom Service Assurance principles. 

• Hands-on validation experience covering Configuration Management (CM), Inventory Management (IM), Fault Management (FM) and Performance Management (PM) domains. 

• Expertise in parsing network topology nodes, checking delta configurations and validating multivendor EMS/NMS integration points. 

Database & Architectural Skills

• Strong querying and structural knowledge of Graph Databases along with graph query languages. 

• Deep understanding of Redis DB core architecture, including data structures, replication, eviction policies, clustering and Pub/Sub functionality. 

• Proven experience verifying log, search and transactional accuracy across distributed data backends including Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Cassandra. 

Automation Engineering

• Advanced proficiency using Python or Java to design test libraries, custom keywords and object oriented testing suites. 

• Robust hands-on framework experience with programmatic API Testing Tools (REST Assured, Postman) and message brokers (Kafka). 

• Solid architectural knowledge of containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes orchestration and Helm charts. 

Experience & Qualifications

• 5-10 years of direct, hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on Telecom OSS and Service Assurance systems. 

• Proven background validating highly distributed distributed systems with demanding high availability, real-time telemetry and complex data persistence requirements. 

• Excellent analytical, root-cause isolation and communication skills to collaborate efficiently across multi-vendor technical domains. 

• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical engineering field. 

Rakuten Shugi Principles: 

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. 

We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success. 

• Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen. 

• Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best. 

• Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory. 

• Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile. 

• Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

data.description:
Castrol is one of the world's leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company's commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol. 

Job Description

About the Team: 

The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems. 

You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance. 

You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations. 

Key Tasks: 

Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels. 

- Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces. 
 - Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR. 
 - Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices. 
 - Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures. 
 - Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover. 
 - Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value. 
 - Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets. 
 - Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting. 
 - Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant. 

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards. 

The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract. 

The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site. 

Experience Required: 

Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification. 

- Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks. 
 - Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers. 
 - Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage. 
 - Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings. 
 - Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination. 
 - Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable. 

Privacy

The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy. response@castrol. com. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e. g. , accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc. ). 

If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.

Job Title: Senior Software Quality Engineer (8-12 Years)

About Veoneer: 

Veoneer is a world leader, and over the years, Veoneer has delivered more than 1. 1 billion electronic control units and crash sensors to car manufacturers globally.

Reporting & Communication

Standards Knowledge

Technical & Functional Skills

- Expertise in audit planning and execution (process and product audits).

Behavioral Competencies

 - Ability to influence teams and drive compliance without conflict.

data.title: Lead EMS Engineer - Systems Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs. 

Lead system engineer is responsible for Design engineering and coordination/key technical interface to customer and vendors in execution of EMS/Sub-station automation/Marine/O&G/Power Projects in time, quality and budget. System engineer will also closely work with service organization to ensure that new developments are aligned with business strategy and are compliant with latest regulation and standards.

- Basic and Detailed engineering for EMS/SAS/MIROGRID based projects and solutions.

data.title: SDET, Portworx
data.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. 

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE. . . 

We're in an unbelievably exciting area of tech, fundamentally reshaping the cloud-native, modern virtualization, and AI infrastructure landscape. Here, you'll lead with innovative thinking, grow alongside us, and work with some of the smartest minds in the industry. 

We're looking for engineers passionate about system testing, distributed systems, Kubernetes, storage, modern virtualization, AI workloads, and automation. You'll work on complex, real-world scenarios involving HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, scalability, and failure testing across large-scale Kubernetes environments. 

As enterprises modernize their infrastructure, containers, virtual machines, and AI/ML workloads are increasingly converging on Kubernetes. From traditional enterprise applications and VMs to GPU-accelerated AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads, Kubernetes is rapidly becoming the common platform for running the next generation of applications. 

This role gives you the opportunity to test and influence how Portworx delivers enterprise-grade storage, data protection, availability, and resiliency across these workloads-including containerized applications, KubeVirt/OpenShift Virtualization VMs, and demanding AI/ML workloads running on Kubernetes. 

What You Will Do

- Own system-level quality for Portworx Enterprise across Kubernetes, storage, and modern virtualization environments. 
 - Develop comprehensive test plans, test strategies, and automation for multiple concurrent product and feature releases. 
 - Build and maintain scalable automation test suites, with a strong focus on Golang-based automation and code quality. 
 - Drive validation of HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, upgrades, scale, and failure scenarios in large-scale Kubernetes environments. 
 - Identify functional and automation coverage gaps, assess risks early, and drive improvements to overall product quality. 
 - Collaborate with development, QE, and architecture teams across geographies to troubleshoot complex system-level issues and ensure timely releases. 
 - Ensure CI/CD pipelines and automation infrastructure effectively execute the required functional, regression and system test strategies. 
 - WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE: 
 - Strong SDET mindset - engineering for quality and ability to design complex distributed system test failure scenarios
 - Ability to lead by example and take end-to-end ownership of product quality. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Golang, with Python experience also valuable. 
 - Strong debugging skills across Kubernetes, Linux, storage, virtualization . 
 - Ability to work on multiple concurrent product/feature releases. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers, conduct automation/code reviews. 
Minimum Qualifications

- BS/MS with 8+ years of software testing/SDET experience, preferably involving distributed systems, infrastructure, storage, or virtualization. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Kubernetes application lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with VMWare/HyperV , KubeVirt or Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization is highly desirable. 
 - Strong background in enterprise storage (file/block/Object) and Kubernetes persistent storage/CSI. 
 - Strong Golang and/or Python programming skills, with Golang preferred. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes platforms such as OpenShift, EKS, AKS, or GKE is a plus. 
 - Working experience with public clouds such as AWS. , Azure and Google Cloud is preferable. 
 - Experience with tools such as Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, X-ray is preferable. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. 
 - Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in TechnologyTM, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay AreaTM, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
 - Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. 

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

data.title: SDE II - DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Auriga is looking for a DevOps / SRE Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and operational health of our production infrastructure. He will manage infrastructure end-to-end through code, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, respond to production incidents as part of an on-call rotation, and partner with engineering teams to embed reliability into every stage of our software delivery lifecycle. This is a hands-on ownership role - not a support or ticket-queue position. 

Key Responsibilities

On-Call & Incident Management

- Participate/ lead production incident triage, mitigation, and resolution. 
 - Define and track SLIs / SLOs and manage error budgets for critical services. 
 - Author blameless postmortems with root cause analysis and corrective action plans for all significant incidents. 
 - Build and maintain runbooks and incident response playbooks. 

Infrastructure as Code & Infra Management

- Own the full infrastructure lifecycle using Terraform exclusively - no manual console provisioning in production. 
 - Design modular Terraform modules for cloud resources: compute, networking, storage, IAM, DNS, databases. 
 - Manage environment parity (dev / staging / prod), drift detection, and immutable infrastructure principles. 
 - Use Ansible or equivalent for configuration management, patch management, and compliance at scale. 
 - Plan and execute capacity planning, scaling, and cost optimization initiatives. 

Kubernetes & Containers

- Provision, configure, upgrade, and maintain production Kubernetes clusters (EKS / GKE / AKS). 
 - Manage Helm charts, ArgoCD / FluxCD GitOps workflows, RBAC, network policies, and secrets management. 
 - Troubleshoot pod failures, resource constraints, scheduling issues, and node-level problems. 

CI/CD & Release Engineering

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins) with quality gates and automated rollback. 
 - Implement progressive delivery: blue-green, canary deployments, and feature flags. 
 - Conduct production readiness reviews before new service go-lives. 

Observability & Monitoring

- Implement and manage full-stack observability: metrics (Prometheus + Grafana), logs (Loki), traces (OpenTelemetry / Jaeger). 
 - Build SLO-driven alerting and dashboards covering the four golden signals; route via PagerDuty / OpsGenie. 

Linux, Networking & Security

- Administer production Linux systems (Ubuntu / RHEL / CentOS): performance tuning, hardening, troubleshooting. 
 - Manage VPCs, subnets, security groups, VPNs, load balancers, Nginx / HAProxy, CDNs, and SSL/TLS certificates. 
 - Manage secrets with Vault / AWS Secrets Manager; integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps). 

Database & Application Operations

- Manage operational health, backups, replication, and failover for MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Memcached. 
 - Support deployments for both monolithic and microservices architectures; validate DR procedures regularly. 

Requirements

- 3-5 years of hands-on production DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering experience. 
 - Proven on-call experience: incident ownership, RCA, and postmortem authorship in a real production environment. 
 - Strong Terraform proficiency: writing and maintaining modules, managing state, and working in team IaC workflow. 
 - Solid Linux administration skills at the OS level (not just application-layer). 
 - Kubernetes production experience: cluster admin, workload management, debugging, RBAC, network policies. 
 - CI/CD pipeline ownership experience (built pipelines from scratch, not just run them). 
 - Hands-on Prometheus + Grafana: alert rule design and dashboard creation. 
 - Python and/or Bash scripting for production automation. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS (primary), GCP, or Azure - able to architect and troubleshoot independently. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, VPCs, load balancers, firewalls. 

Preferred Qualifications

- CKA / CKAD, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification. 
 - GitOps experience with ArgoCD or FluxCD in production. 
 - Service mesh experience: Istio or Linkerd. 
 - Message queue / streaming experience: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS / SNS. 
 - Chaos engineering or DR game day experience. 
 - HashiCorp Vault or cloud-native secrets management experience. 
 - Exposure to FinOps, cost visibility tooling, and cloud cost optimisation. 

Preferred Technical Skill Set

- Cloud: AWS (primary) | GCP / Azure
 - IaC & Config: Terraform, Ansible
 - Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD / FluxCD
 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, PagerDuty / OpsGenie
 - Scripting: Python, Bash, Go
 - Databases: MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Memcached
 - Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS (preferred)
 - Networking: Nginx, HAProxy, CloudFront, Cloudflare, Vault, WAF
 - Workflow: Argo Workflows

data.title: Agentic AI Architect — Backend Platforms and Voice Agents
data.description:
Role Overview

We are hiring a hands-on architect to design the backend foundations and the shared agent platform

that every team builds products on. You will own architecture across products and client deployments

- service boundaries, data flows, agent execution, real-time voice infrastructure and operational

reliability - and consolidate the systems different teams use today into one platform that is faster and

safer to build on. You will set the engineering practices the whole company follows, and partner with

senior AI engineers on solution delivery and with inference engineers on model-serving interfaces. 

Key Responsibilities

Backend and distributed systems

- Design service boundaries, APIs, data models, databases, caching and event-driven integrations

that scale to [thousands] of concurrent agent sessions. 

- Make consistency, partitioning and replication trade-offs explicit, and design for partial failure

with timeouts, backpressure, circuit breakers and graceful degradation. 

- Scale real-time voice infrastructure: session routing, media servers, and horizontal scaling of

WebSocket, SIP and WebRTC connections. 

- Set reliability targets (SLOs), latency and cost budgets, and plan capacity across cloud and on-

premises deployments. 

- Manage all infrastructure as code with GitOps workflows, so every environment is reproducible, 

reviewed and auditable. 

- Track model, speech and infrastructure cost per team, product and client, and set up chargeback

so owners see and control their spend. 

Agent platform

- Build a shared agent platform: agent runtime, tool registry, enterprise connectors, memory and

retrieval services, and a model gateway with routing, fallbacks, rate limits and caching. 

- Architect durable agent execution with persisted state, checkpoints, retries, idempotency, 

timeouts, compensation for failed actions and human approval points. 

- Enforce tenant isolation, authentication, authorisation, tool permissions and audit trails at the

platform level, so every product inherits them. 

- Make the platform self-serve: SDKs, templates and documentation that let a team launch a new

voice or chat agent in days, not weeks. 

- Run an internal developer portal (such as Backstage) as the single place to find services, 

connectors, templates, owners and docs. 

- Provide shared evaluation, tracing and monitoring services that every agent uses by default. 
 - Build a data platform for call and agent analytics: transcripts, outcomes, tool usage and latency, 

feeding product insights, evals and client reporting. 

Consolidation And Company-wide Practices

- Audit existing agent and voice stacks, and consolidate duplicate pipelines, connectors and

prompt setups onto the platform with migration plans that keep live clients running. 

- Define reference architectures and golden paths for common use cases, such as voice agents, 

chat agents and document workflows. 

- Set engineering standards: architecture decision records, design reviews, API guidelines, testing

and eval requirements, release controls and incident management. 

- Maintain a tech radar of approved, trial and retired tools, and lead build-versus-buy decisions

for agent frameworks, model providers, speech vendors and infrastructure. 

Security, governance and resilience

- Design systems to meet security and compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and India's

DPDP Act, and support audits with evidence from the platform. 

- Set AI governance policy: red-teaming of agents before launch, model risk reviews, prompt-

injection defences and rules for which data each model may see. 

- Define disaster recovery targets (RPO and RTO), run regular recovery drills and use chaos testing

to prove agents and voice sessions survive failures. 

Technical leadership

- Translate business workflows into technical designs, build reference implementations and

review critical code. 

- Guide engineering teams through architectural decisions, and mentor senior engineers to make

sound design choices on their own. 

- Manage a team of [N] engineers: set goals, run one-on-ones and performance reviews, and

support their career growth. 

- Act as solution architect in pre-sales: scope client requirements, design proposed solutions, 

estimate effort and present the architecture to client technical teams. 

- Align product, infrastructure, inference and delivery teams around one implementable

architecture, and represent it to enterprise clients. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

- Strong backend and distributed-systems experience, including ownership of production

architecture and its evolution under growing scale. 

- Hands-on Python expertise and deep knowledge of APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, queues, 

caching, concurrency and consistency trade-offs. 

- Practical experience delivering LLM agents with tool integrations, stateful orchestration, 

retrieval and failure handling. 

- Understanding of real-time, low-latency systems such as voice or streaming, including

backpressure and connection scaling. 

- Experience building internal platforms or shared services adopted by multiple teams. 
 - A track record of leading system consolidations or architectural migrations without disrupting

production. 

- Ability to design for partial failures, long-running tasks and secure multi-tenant execution, 

supported by automated tests, tracing and deployment practices. 

- Ability to write clear design documents, explain trade-offs and align product, infrastructure and

delivery teams. 

- Experience managing engineers, and working directly with clients in pre-sales or solution design. 
 - A relevant technical degree or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Experience

- Workflow engines and agent orchestration frameworks such as Temporal or LangGraph, model

gateways, and vector search. 

- Additional backend languages such as Go or Java. 
 - Kubernetes, service meshes and infrastructure as code. 
 - Production voice systems at scale: SIP, media servers, LiveKit or similar. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS platforms and enterprise deployments with restricted infrastructure. 
 - Model-serving interfaces such as vLLM or Triton, and working with inference teams on

throughput and cost. 

- Multimodal agents that combine voice, text and vision. 

Success in the role

Success means one reliable platform that every team builds on, with clear architectural decisions and

measurable control of task completion, latency and cost. In your first year, that looks like: 

- Platform adoption: most new agents are built on the shared platform and found through the

developer portal, and the time to launch a new agent drops from weeks to days. 

- Consolidation: duplicate pipelines and connectors are retired, with no disruption to live clients. 
 - Scale and reliability: SLOs hold as traffic grows, agent runs recover cleanly from partial failures, 

and recovery drills meet their targets. 

- Cost control: every team and client can see its model and infrastructure spend, and per-task

cost stays within budget. 

- Security and governance: compliance audits pass, and every agent is red-teamed and reviewed

before launch. 

- Company-wide practices: design reviews, decision records, eval gates and release controls are

used across teams. 

- Team and clients: your team grows in skill and ownership, and clients sign off on architectures

you designed in pre-sales.

data.title: Sr. Tech Lead, Prod Dev (RAN, AI-Assisted RCA, Design & Development)
data.description:
Parallel Wireless is transforming its Feature-Validation & Stability organization into a single Prod-Dev team - in the AI era there is no longer a separate "development" vs "validation" team. We are building a group of strong System Engineers who own a problem end to end: understand the complete product behavior, find the actual root cause, and contribute directly to the fix - accelerated by Claude / AI-assisted engineering. 

This is a pro-development, system-level problem-solving role. You will take a field or test issue and drive it the whole way: 

Issue → Reproduction → Cross-layer analysis → RCA → Code investigation → Fix → Validation

You will not stop at "which component failed. " You will name the root cause, prove it, and fix it. 

What You Will Do

- Deep, cross-layer RCA on field and lab issues that span multiple modules, correlating evidence across the full stack: 

→ UE logs

- PHY logs
 - DU / MAC / SCH logs
 - CU / L3 logs
 - Core logs
 - Platform logs
 - RRH logs
 - System logs
 - field issues across EMS / system monitoring. 
 - Reproduce field/customer issues in the lab on production-like (Friendly-Operator) setups. 
 - Investigate code and deliver bug fixes - own the fix through to validation, not just the analysis note. 
 - Field-issue investigation with direct customer / field involvement; feed learnings back into design, regression and stability. 
 - Feature development driven by design/framework gaps and customer-driven requirements. 
 - Use AI tools (Claude / AI-assisted engineering) to accelerate code understanding, log analysis, debugging, correlation and RCA - especially on multi-module problems. 
 - Identify scenarios, improve monitoring/validation coverage, and raise the quality bar before issues reach the field. 

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

- Strong software engineering in C / C++ (and Python for tooling/automation) with the ability to read and fix production RAN stack code. 
 - Solid wireless/telecom system understanding across 2G / 4G LTE / 5G NSA / SA - RRC, S1AP/NGAP, X2/Xn, PDCP/RLC/MAC scheduling, PHY/FAPI, GTP-U, and the core/platform interfaces. 
 - Proven debugging & RCA skills: coredumps/gdb, log/PCAP analysis, memory/crash triage, KPI/counter reasoning. 
 - A system mindset - comfortable reasoning across UE ↔ RAN ↔ Core ↔ Platform ↔ EMS rather than a single layer. 
 - Willingness and aptitude to work with AI tools as a daily engineering accelerator. 
 - Ownership attitude: drives Issue → Fix → Validation to closure. 
 - Good to have
 - O-RAN / disaggregated CU-DU, fronthaul (split 7. 2), PTP/timing, IPsec/transport exposure. 
 - Experience with EMS / OSS, Kibana/KPI monitoring, PM counters. 
 - Prior field / customer-facing deployment or NPI experience. 
 - Scrum / Agile delivery experience

Addional details

What Success Looks Like

You turn an opaque field escape into a named, proven root cause and a merged fix. 

Your RCA is accurate - the cause you name is the one the fix confirms (evidence-cited, instrumented, graded). 

You reduce field escapes and the RCA load on the core development team. 

You grow into a complete-product System Engineer who can design, reproduce, debug and fix across any layer. 

Why join

You will work at the center of PW's Prod-Dev transformation - a "Friendly customer in the lab" operating model - using cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering to solve real, multi-layer telecom problems end to end, with direct customer impact and genuine system ownership. 

Academic Qualification

Relevant Degree in Bachelor of Engineering in computer science, Electronics , Information Technology or relevant field from reputed college/ University

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Hiring: Food Technologist - In-House Manufacturing, Quality & Food Safety

Location: Andheri East, Mumbai (Manufacturing Facility)

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Manufacturing / Operations

Reports To: Founders / Head of Operations

Role PurposeThe Food Technologist will be the technical owner of in-house food manufacturing, responsible for ensuring all products are safe, compliant, consistent, shelf-stable, and scalable. 

This role has end-to-end responsibility from raw material intake to finished goods dispatch, with authority over production processes, quality control, food safety systems, and factory discipline. 

This is a hands-on factory-floor role, not a desk-based QA position. 

Scope of AuthorityThe Food Technologist is authorized to: 

- Stop production in case of quality or food safety risk
 - Approve or reject raw materials, in-process batches, and finished goods
 - Define and enforce SOPs, GMP, and HACCP requirements
 - Set and modify production process parameters
 - Lead corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

Key Responsibilities

1. In-House Production Management
 - Own daily production operations across all SKUs
 - Define and control batch sizes and process parameters
 - Monitor environmental conditions (temperature, humidity)
 - Ensure production targets, yields, and timelines are met
 - Troubleshoot issues related to texture, binding, moisture, breakage, and packaging
 - Minimise downtime, rework, and wastage

2. Product Development & Scale-Up
 - Translate R&D formulations into production-ready recipes
 - Conduct pilot trials and commercial validation batches
 - Optimise formulations for: 
 - Shelf life
 - Process stability
 - Ingredient functionality
 - Cost efficiency
 - Support new product launches from trial to full-scale production

3. Quality Control & Quality Assurance
 - Design and implement factory-wide QC systems
 - Define quality specifications and acceptance criteria
 - Oversee: 
 - Incoming raw material checks
 - In-process quality controls
 - Finished goods inspections
 - Review and approve batch manufacturing records
 - Manage non-conformances, deviations, and CAPAs

4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Compliance
 - Implement and maintain GMP and HACCP systems
 - Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations
 - Maintain food safety documentation and records
 - Lead internal and external audits
 - Act as the primary food safety contact for regulatory authorities

5. Shelf Life, Stability & Packaging Control
 - Design and execute shelf-life and stability studies
 - Monitor oxidation, moisture migration, texture changes, and sensory drift
 - Validate packaging materials and sealing integrity
 - Define storage and distribution conditions
 - Implement natural shelf-life enhancement strategies

6. Raw Material & Supplier Quality
 - Approve raw material specifications and suppliers
 - Monitor ingredient variability and seasonal changes

data.description:
About Navi

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale. 

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, 

Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold - building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience. 

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India's fastest-growing UPI platforms.

The Debt Management team is responsible for ensuring timely and efficient recovery of outstanding dues from customers. Their role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing collection strategies across various channels to minimize delinquencies and improve cash flow. The team focuses on balancing customer experience with recovery effectiveness by using data-driven insights, segmentation, and targeted action plans.

- Managing a team of ground Field Executives for effective & efficient recovery of overdue amounts from default customers through planned visits to customer addresses
 - Ensure proper planning for effective recovery through strong execution; guide and motivate the field team to reach monthly targets
 - Overview of day-to-day agent activities including regular performance monitoring, in-person visits for high-value accounts, and regular & timely follow-ups with customers

data.description:
Designation : Team Lead - AI & Data Science

Required Experience: 5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership. 

Job Description:   

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement. 

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production. 

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  

1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria. 

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs. 

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach. 

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications. 

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement. 

2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership-

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring. 

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern. 

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices. 

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently. 

3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows-

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate. 

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation. 

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior. 

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed. 

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops. 

4. Applied machine learning and data science-

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization. 

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly. 

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps-

Job Description: AWS MDM Technical Lead

Experience: 8+ years

Role: Technical Lead - AWS Cloud & Master Data Management

Domain: Customer Master Data Management (MDM) and Enterprise Data Integration

About the Project

We are developing an AWS-based Master Data Management (MDM) hub to consolidate, cleanse, standardize, and manage customer data from multiple CRM systems. 

The solution will establish trusted golden customer records, support AI-assisted customer matching, orchestrate data processing and exception workflows, and integrate with Oracle Fusion. It will also include a web-based user interface that enables business users to review and manually resolve MDM exceptions. 

We are looking for an experienced AWS Technical Lead to drive architecture implementation, engineering execution, and end-to-end technical delivery. 

Role Overview

The AWS MDM Technical Lead will lead a cross-functional Agile engineering team comprising data engineers, full-stack developers, and DevOps engineers. 

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in AWS cloud-native application development, Python, SQL, distributed systems, and enterprise data integration, along with proven technical leadership and delivery experience. 

The successful candidate will own technical design decisions, engineering standards, solution quality, and production readiness while collaborating with solution architects, business stakeholders, and enterprise platform teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of the AWS-based MDM solution. 
 - Translate solution architecture and business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical implementations. 
 - Make architectural and technology decisions, establish engineering standards, and drive code quality.

 - Ensure appropriate security, performance, availability, monitoring, and operational reliability. 
 - Drive infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and deployment practices in collaboration with DevOps engineers. MDM and Data Integration

- Lead the implementation of customer data ingestion, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and consolidation pipelines. 
 - Implement customer matching, deduplication, golden record creation, and survivorship logic. 
 - Design reliable integrations with source CRM systems and Oracle Fusion. 
 - Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and reconciliation across integrated systems. Full-Stack Development and Exception Management

- Oversee backend services, REST APIs, and web-based user interfaces for MDM operations. 
 - Support the development of exception management workflows for manual review and resolution of uncertain customer matches. 
 - Ensure effective integration between the UI, backend services, data processing components, and workflow orchestration. Engineering Delivery and Production Readiness

- Lead Agile planning, estimation, sprint execution, and delivery tracking. 
 - Coordinate integration testing, performance testing, deployment, and release readiness. 
 - Identify and resolve technical blockers, integration issues, and production defects. 
 - Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and production engineering requirements. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, and enterprise platform teams to deliver business outcomes. Required Skills and Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, including hands-on technical leadership of cloud-native application development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and developing AWS-based enterprise applications. 
 - Proficiency in AWS services, including: 
 - AWS Lambda
 - ECS Fargate and ECR
 - Step Functions and EventBridge
 - API Gateway
 - Aurora PostgreSQL
 - Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. 
 - Experience developing REST APIs, backend services, and distributed applications. 
 - Experience with data integration, data transformation, data quality, and relational database design. 
 - Familiarity with modern full-stack application development and web-based user interfaces. 
 - Proven experience leading cross-functional Agile engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production support. 
 - Experience implementing security-by-design principles, including access control, encryption, and secure handling of enterprise data. 
 - Excellent technical problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into enterprise applications, particularly using Amazon Bedrock. 
 - Experience with entity resolution, fuzzy matching, customer deduplication, and AI-assisted data matching. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle customer data models, or Oracle Trading Community Architecture (TCA). 
 - Experience implementing enterprise MDM, customer master, or Customer 360 solutions. 
 - Exposure to AWS infrastructure as code and automated deployment frameworks. Key Success Criteria

The Technical Lead will be successful in delivering a secure, scalable, and production-ready MDM hub that: 

- Consolidates customer data from multiple CRM systems. 
 - Produces trusted golden customer records using effective matching and data quality rules. 
 - Enables business users to resolve data exceptions through an intuitive review workflow. 
 - Integrates reliably with Oracle Fusion. 
 - Meets enterprise standards for security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Is delivered through effective technical leadership and cross-functional Agile execution.

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About Cvent: 

www. cvent. com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000+ employees and ~34, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Role Overview

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. You will build this team from zero, then lead it as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bengaluru, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom you will plan, design, and ship. 

This is an AI-first role in two senses. The team ships AI into the product, and the team builds software with AI: agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment. We are looking for a manager whose value comes from engineering judgment and a high quality bar rather than from the volume of code they personally write. You will decide what gets built and how, set the standard for what is good enough to ship, and hold the team to it. 

Reporting line: Director of Engineering, Splash India. Team size: 4-5 engineers by the end of the first year, hired by you. 

In This Role, You Will: 

Build the team (your main job in year one)

- Hire the founding team from 0 to 4-5: define the roles and levels, run the hiring loop end to end, close candidates, and onboard them to be productive quickly. 
 - Establish the team's engineering standards, operating rhythm, and ways of working from day one, including how AI tools are used, reviewed, and measured. 
 - Create a culture where engineers own outcomes, learn fast, and hold a high bar for quality. 

Lead delivery of AI features for Splash

- Own execution of the AI feature roadmap for Splash in partnership with Product, Design, and the Splash teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain. 
 - Make architecture and technology decisions for the team's services and front ends; ensure what ships meets non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance) and responsible-AI expectations. 
 - Run the team across time zones: coordinate dependencies, manage production issues and incidents, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, honest status. 

Set the engineering bar in an AI-native workflow

- Define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human. 
 - Be the quality gate. Review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, and maintainability, and teach the team to do the same. 
 - Keep the team's tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organization. 

Grow people

- Coach engineers, set goals, give direct and timely feedback, and run performance reviews and career development. 

Here's What You Need: 

These are requirements, not nice-to-haves. We expect candidates to meet all of them. 

- People management and hiring. 12+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in backend systems and 3+ years managing software engineers, with a track record of hiring, onboarding, and growing strong engineers, and the appetite to do that here from the ground up. 
 - Depth in our stack. Java with Spring Boot for backend services; React or Next. js with TypeScript on the front end; GraphQL APIs; relational and NoSQL databases; event-driven microservices on AWS. 
 - Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development. You use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts. 
 - Strong engineering judgment. You can evaluate a design or a change for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability without having written it yourself, and you have a track record of owning non-functional requirements for production systems. 
 - Experience shipping AI product features. You have taken LLM-powered functionality to production (for example retrieval, agents, or structured generation) and understand evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes. 
 - Cross-geography collaboration. Proven ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, design, and SRE teams in other regions and time zones, including in a matrixed or distributed organization. 
 - Clear communication. You write specs, decisions, and status updates that people in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience forming a team from scratch (0 to N): defining roles and levels, standing up the hiring loop, and establishing norms rather than inheriting an existing team. 
 - Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows. 
 - Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production.
