data.title: I&E Design Engineering Lead
data.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world's current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies. 

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world's growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all. 

About the position

Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a I&E Design Engineering Lead (LNG) to join the Facilities Design Engineering team. Reporting to the Facilities Design Engineering Manager, this role will be based in Chevron's office in Bengaluru. 

Supervises a team that designs, selects, tests, installs, monitors, modifies, and maintains safe and reliable process automation systems and electrical infrastructure ?for new and existing facilities. The team utilizes process automation systems (PAS) including process control systems (PCS), safety instrumented systems (SIS)/instrumented protective systems (IPS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems and associated applications. Optimize process automation system integrity, reliability, safety, and efficiency. In addition, the team supports site MOC work packages and project design assurance for the Instrumentation & Control (I&C) as well as Electrical engineering disciplines. 

Manages group and employee work to align with corporate/department objectives. Direct reports are typically technical individual contributors from I&C and Electrical disciplines. 

Key responsibilities

- Supervise, coach, mentor, and develop I&E Design Engineers providing leadership and guidance on standard tools and processes such as Engineering Work Orders, Management of Change, Chevrons Turnaround process and Root Cause Analysis techniques. 
 - Sets clear expectations and support creation and management of individuals' performance and development plans
 - Partner with customers and stakeholders to prioritize the team's workload. Ensure the team is appropriately resourced to meet the customer's needs and business plan commitments
 - Responsible for the timeliness and quality of team deliverables including Engineering Work Orders as well as technical and constructability reviews
 - Collaborate with other Designs Engineering Team Leads to manage Designs Engineering department organizational capabilities and competencies
 - Promote a continual improvement mindset while removing barriers and seeking simple, fit-for-purpose solutions
 - Provide leadership in sharing information and resources across the business units
 - Utilize Chevron and Industry Engineering Standards for Safety in Designs
 - Leverage expertise and knowledge of electrical power systems and codes, instrumentation and control design, safety instrumented systems, process control systems, field instrument selection and sizing, equipment procurement, field construction and repair practices, process safety information, management of change work process and process control and monitoring to coach and develop team. 
 - Support department recruiting and hiring efforts. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Minimum of 10-15 years relevant experience performing I&E Engineering in an Oil & Gas operating environment
 - Demonstrated supervisory experience will be highly regarded
 - Bachelor's degree in instrumentation or electrical engineering (B. E. /B. Tech. ) from a deemed/recognized (AICTE) university

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of refinery and LNG process technologies will be highly regarded
 - Knowledge of Australian electrical legislation and codes

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way. 

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace. 

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work. 

Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration. 

Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron's values and business priorities. 

Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. 

Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise. 

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8: 00 AM to 5: 00 PM or 1: 30 PM to 10: 30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network - using protocols like 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI - and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time. 

The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function - not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product. 

You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features - authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding - primarily in Go. 
 - Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e. g. , RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves. 
 - Build and extend internal test utility libraries - simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers - and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis on test failures - distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it. 
 - Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented - shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end. 
 - Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers. 
 - Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework. 
 - Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews - identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field. 
 - 3-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering - not just manual testing. 
 - Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols - 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing - designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code. 
 - Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) - writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability. 
 - Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication - test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up. 

Good To Have

- Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS). 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) - knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior. 
 - Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios. 
 - Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) - validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted. 

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

data.title: QA Engineer - Core Business Systems
data.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on QA Automation to establish, implement, and drive a comprehensive quality assurance strategy across the CBS platform estate - ServiceNow (ITSM), Salesforce and NetSuite (CRM/ERP), Boomi (integrations), OpenAir, and Anaplan - alongside the enterprise-level integrations connecting them. This role requires a strong focus on test automation, integration testing, and data validation, alongside leadership to define best practices and ensure system reliability across the estate. The ideal candidate will also bring an understanding of cloud-native testing principles and security testing requirements at a high level. 

You will work as a hands-on contributor within CBS, leading by example, building automation frameworks, and driving testing across all six platforms and the workflows that connect them. 

What You Will Do: 

Test Automation Framework Development

Design, Develop, And Maintain Robust Test Automation Frameworks For: 

- UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright - covering ServiceNow, Salesforce, and NetSuite front ends
 - API Testing: Postman, REST Assured - covering Boomi integration endpoints and platform APIs
 - Data Validation: Python scripting with SQL integration - covering cross-platform data flows between Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, OpenAir, and Anaplan
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins or Azure DevOps to ensure seamless testing during deployments across the CBS estate. 
 - Maintain clean, reusable, and well-documented test scripts for consistent results across all platforms. 

Metrics: 

- Achieve 70-80% test automation coverage for critical CBS workflows within 12 months. 
 - Ensure automation stability with <5% failure rates across regression runs. 

Functional, Integration, and Regression Testing

- Conduct functional testing to validate workflows, integrations, and system updates across CBS platforms. 
 - Perform end-to-end integration testing across ServiceNow (ITSM), Salesforce and NetSuite (CRM/ERP), Boomi (integration layer), OpenAir, and Anaplan. 
 - Automate data validation testing to ensure consistency and accuracy across systems, using SQL and Python scripts - with particular attention to Boomi-mediated data flows as integration scripting is rewritten for ongoing platform compliance. 

Metrics: 

- Maintain <10% defect leakage post-production, improving to <5% as automation matures. 

Performance and Load Testing

- Use tools like JMeter or Locust to conduct performance testing to measure response times and system scalability across CBS platforms. 
 - Establish performance benchmarks for critical workflows and collaborate with the Data and Integrations lead and platform owners to address bottlenecks. 

Metrics: 

- Ensure systems meet defined performance SLAs under expected and peak load conditions. 

Cloud-Native Testing and Monitoring (High Level)

- Understand cloud-native testing principles for monitoring system availability, scalability, and resource utilisation across the CBS estate (e. g. , AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor). 
 - Provide insights into system performance statistics to align with CBS's Service Operating Model. 

CI/CD and Continuous Improvement

- Enhance CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated test execution, reporting, and validation processes across CBS platforms. 
 - Identify and introduce 1-2 new tools or methodologies annually to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. 
 - Collaborate with CBS platform owners, the service delivery manager, and the data and integrations lead to align QA processes with project timelines and delivery goals. 

Metrics: 

- Ensure 98% deployment success rates for automated CI/CD test integrations. 

Security Testing Understanding (High Level)

- Maintain a high-level understanding of where security testing is typically required across the CBS estate (e. g. , API authentication, data encryption, access controls). 
 - Collaborate with security teams to ensure QA processes align with basic security requirements and compliance standards (e. g. , OWASP Top 10). 
 - Guide platform owners and stakeholders on QA best practices. 
 - Define and document testing strategies, frameworks, and processes to ensure consistency across the CBS platform estate. 

Required Skills and Qualifications: 

- 7 years of experience in QA automation with a strong focus on test automation frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with tools and technologies: 
 - UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright
 - API Testing: Postman, REST Assured
 - Performance Testing: JMeter or Locust
 - Strong scripting skills in Python and SQL for data validation and automation. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native testing principles for system monitoring and statistics. 
 - High-level understanding of security testing requirements and standards (e. g. , OWASP Top 10). 
 - Proven ability to define, implement, and optimise QA strategies from the ground up. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong collaboration abilities across a multi-platform, multi-stakeholder environment. 
 - Prior exposure to at least two of: ServiceNow, Salesforce, NetSuite, Boomi, OpenAir, Anaplan. 

Nice-to-Have Skills: 

- Certifications: ISTQB (Foundation Level or higher) or equivalent QA certifications. 
 - Experience with cloud environments: AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Familiarity with test reporting tools like Allure or advanced CI/CD dashboards. 
 - Prior experience testing Boomi integration flows specifically.

 - Employee Assistance Programme - Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7.

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day.

Flutter Functions' AI & Automation team is looking for an expert AI Engineering Lead to build and lead a unit of 2-3 AI developers. You will be responsible for the technical vision and execution of Flutter's enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms , using internal data to enhance productivity and decision-making across our global sports betting and gaming operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining AI engineering, architecture, people leadership and cross-functional teamwork . You will shape engineering standards, make key architectural decisions, mentor your team, and help deliver production-grade AI systems serving over 20 million customers across 20+ regulated markets.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED

Core Requirements

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That's why we're committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone - unless they're a cybercriminal, of course. 

We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we'd encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

Experience in Manufacturing or Supply Chain domains is a strong advantage. 

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office, KA-India

 - Document software designs, processes, and implementation details.

 - Strong understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks. 
 - Experience with Spring, Hibernate, and other Java frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration abilities. 

Preferred Skills

 - Hands-on experience with Warranty Systems. 
 - Front end Technology: Angular
 - Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 
 - Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Exposure to Agile development methodologies. 
 - Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies. 
 - Work Timings: 01: 00 Noon -10: 00PM IST
 - This position requires the employee to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office. 

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process. 
 - Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas. 
 - Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes. 
 - Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns. 
 - Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives. 

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. 
 - Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. 
 - Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. 
 - Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. 
 - Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. 

Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Conducts walkthroughs and monitors effectiveness and quality of the development activities. 
 - Elaborates on multiple-development toolkits for traditional and web-based software. 
 - Has participated in development of multiple or large software products. 
 - Contrasts advantages and drawbacks of different development languages and tools. 
 - Estimates and monitors development costs based on functional and technical requirements. 
 - Provides consulting on both selection and utilization of developers' workbench tools. 

Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Describes similarities and differences of life cycle for new product development vs. new release. 
 - Identifies common issues, problems, and considerations for each phase of the life cycle. 
 - Works with a formal life cycle methodology. 
 - Explains phases, activities, dependencies, deliverables, and key decision points. 
 - Interprets product development plans and functional documentation. 

Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Has experience with designing data exchange interfaces to and from software product. 
 - Describes tools and techniques for extraction, transformation and loading of electronic data. 
 - Cites examples of common linkage requirements for software products and vendors. 
 - Works with integrating software into the customer or partner framework and infrastructure. 
 - Participates in the development of technology interfaces and bridges. 

Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design. 

Level Extensive Experience: 

- Demonstrates experience with the architecture and design of major or multiple products. 
 - Describes major software architecture alternatives and considerations. 
 - Explains design considerations for commercial database systems, operating systems and web. 
 - Displays experience in estimating the cost of a specific design of a proposed product. 
 - Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs. 
 - Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture. 

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Maintains and utilizes data related to install base configurations and environments. 
 - Solicits customer feedback; reports and monitors bugs and implementation issues. 
 - Participates in defining and conducting technical acceptance tests. 
 - Participates in creating technical requirements for software development and deployment. 
 - Explains basic environment and product configuration options. 

Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Participates in test readiness reviews, functional, volume, and load testing. 
 - Describes key features and aspects of a specific testing discipline or methodology. 
 - Tests software components for compliance with functional requirements and design specifications. 
 - Explains procedures for documenting test activities and results (e. g. errors, non-conformance, etc. )
 - Conducts functional and performance testing on aspects of assigned products. 

What You Will Get:

Holistic Development

- Personal and professional development through Caterpillar 's employee resource groups across the globe
 - Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

- Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
 - Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

- Employee investment plan
 - Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U. Software Development Engineer III (SDE-III)

Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Development Engineer III will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling full-stack AI-powered systems that drive critical business workflows. 

Role Overview

The Software Development Engineer III is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning end-to-end full-stack solutions - from cloud-native backend services and APIs to modern front-end interfaces - built for scale, reliability, and performance. This role requires deep technical expertise across the stack, hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, and the ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI/ML technologies into production-grade engineering workflows. The Software Development Engineer III delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

- Partner cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and the establishment of engineering best practices that raise the bar across the team. 
 - Contribute to a strong engineering culture by proactively sharing knowledge, championing code quality and observability standards, and supporting a collaborative, high-performance team environment. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Build and maintain highly reliable, performant systems that directly power the digital experiences fans interact with across Fanatics Commerce's global platform. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed with scalability and uptime in mind, minimizing disruption and delivering consistent, seamless fan-facing functionality. 
 - Translate business and product requirements into technical designs that keep the fan experience at the center of every architectural decision. 
 - Drive improvements to system observability and monitoring so that issues impacting fans are identified and resolved rapidly. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Evaluate and integrate the latest AI/ML tools and frameworks - including LLM-based agents, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI copilots - into product and engineering workflows to drive automation and efficiency. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and company-wide AI initiatives, and proactively bring relevant innovations into the team's roadmap. 
 - Architect and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM to build secure, scalable infrastructure. 
 - Identify and prototype new approaches to reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and unlock new capabilities for the business. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Own the full software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration - with an uncompromising focus on code quality, security, and reliability. 
 - Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability risks, and drive initiatives to resolve them before they impact the business. 
 - Operate with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, making sound technical decisions without waiting for direction. 
 - Consistently deliver complex, full-stack systems end-to-end with a track record of high-quality outcomes on time and at scale. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

- 4-5 years of professional software development experience with a strong track record of owning complex, full-stack systems end-to-end. 
 - Strong proficiency in backend development using languages such as Java, Python, Node. js, or Go, paired with hands-on experience in modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services spanning compute, storage, networking, serverless, and container orchestration (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM). 
 - Practical experience working with or integrating AI/LLM technologies, including OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), or building AI-powered features and agents in production environments. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, SQL and NoSQL databases, caching strategies, and API design patterns (REST/GraphQL). 
 - Strong command of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform/CloudFormation). 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and mentor other engineers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. 

WORK LOCATION

On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Hyderabad, Telangana. 

Remote: As a fully remote role, the primary place of performance will be your residence or other approved remote location. 

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Hyderabad, Telangana, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days per week.

data.title: Principal ASIC Verification Engineer - DDR/LPDDR
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You understand that verification is not about writing tests, it is about building an environment where the right bugs cannot hide, and you have the scars from finding those bugs at 2am to prove it. 

Leading a team does not mean delegating tasks, it means knowing when to step in, when to let someone struggle productively, and when to rewrite the testbench architecture because the current one will not scale. You have worked with RTL designers who swear their code is clean and architects who change the spec on Thursday, and you have learned to build verification strategies that survive both. 

Memory protocols like DDR or LPDDR do not intimidate you. Serial interfaces, complex checkers, SystemVerilog assertions that actually mean something, these are tools you reach for without thinking. You care about functional coverage because it tells you what you have not tested yet, not because it is a metric someone asked for. At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that powers real products, with a team that takes verification as seriously as you do. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of verification engineers through full IP verification cycles, from test plan definition through coverage closure and signoff
 - Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations
 - Define test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions, then review and guide implementation across the team
 - Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
 - Extract, analyze, and drive functional coverage and code coverage metrics to closure, identifying gaps and adjusting strategy in real time
 - Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and catch issues early
 - Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to keep verification cycles efficient and reliable

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver verification signoff on IP cores that ship in millions of devices, ensuring they work correctly the first time in silicon
 - Raise the bar for verification quality across the DesignWare team by mentoring engineers and evolving testbench architecture and methodology
 - Catch critical bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months of schedule and customer trust
 - Influence IP architecture decisions by surfacing verification insights early, when design changes are still cheap
 - Help shape how the team adopts AI-assisted verification flows, improving efficiency without sacrificing rigor
 - Contribute to Synopsys' leadership in IP by ensuring that what we deliver is not just feature-complete but robustly verified
 - Build verification environments and strategies that other teams will reuse and learn from, multiplying your impact across the organization

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 8+ years of hands-on verification experience
 - Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
 - Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow
 - Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs
 - Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage, and using those metrics to drive verification closure
 - Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
 - Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

Who You Are

- You can explain a coverage hole to an architect in two sentences and walk out with a plan to close it
 - You debug by hypothesis, not by adding print statements until something makes sense
 - When a testbench is too slow or too brittle, you refactor it instead of working around it
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes the code pass
 - You work across time zones and teams without losing context or creating confusion downstream
 - You know when to push back on a design decision and when to adjust the verification plan to match reality

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join Synopsys' DesignWare IP Verification R&D team in Bangalore, working with a global group of experienced verification engineers who are responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of IP cores that power semiconductors across the industry. This team collaborates closely with RTL designers, architects, and infrastructure engineers to deliver robust, production-ready IP. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer – Cloud Native
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Cloud Native builds and runs automation scripts and tools (IaC / Terraform) to streamline provisioning, configuration, and management of Cloud PaaS and Serverless Services, and sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About ComplyStream

ComplyStream is a RegTech company building compliance operations software for fintechs and payment service providers. Our platform brings KYB, KYC, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and AML case management into one place, with AI assisting compliance analysts in their daily work. We are a small, focused team of engineers, product and design, and we move quickly because our customers rely on us to keep up with changing regulation. 

About the role

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to become our first dedicated quality specialist. You will own how we test our web platform, combining careful manual and exploratory testing with an automated suite that the whole team can trust. Our product handles sensitive customer data and complex workflows that move through many states, so thoughtful testing has a direct impact on our customers and on the regulated businesses they serve. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in India. 

What you will do

Define and own the QA strategy for our web application and APIs, deciding where manual testing adds the most value and where automation should take over. 

Carry out thorough manual and exploratory testing of new features, with a focus on edge cases, error handling and multi-step workflows. 

Build and maintain automated end-to-end and API test suites, and run them as part of our CI pipeline. 

Test that customer data stays properly separated between tenants and that user roles and permissions behave as intended. 

Work with engineers to find practical ways to test AI-powered features whose output can vary from one run to the next. 

Write clear, reproducible bug reports and follow issues through to resolution. 

Take part in planning and review so that quality is considered before code is written, not only after. 

What we are looking for

At least 5 years of professional QA experience on web applications, with strong skills in both manual and automated testing. 

Hands-on experience building automated tests with a modern framework such as Playwright or Cypress. Playwright with TypeScript is a strong advantage, as it is what we use. 

Solid experience testing REST APIs using Postman or similar tools. 

Experience running automated tests in a CI/CD pipeline, such as GitHub Actions. 

A good understanding of how modern web applications work, including browser developer tools and basic SQL for checking data. 

The ability to work independently, set your own priorities and make sensible decisions when requirements are incomplete. 

Clear written and spoken communication in English. 

You must be based in India. 

Nice to have

Experience in fintech, compliance, banking or other regulated B2B SaaS. 

Experience as the first or only QA at a startup. 

Experience testing multi-tenant systems, role-based access or AI and LLM features. 

Familiarity with synthetic monitoring, performance testing or basic security testing. 

What we offer

A fully remote role with a small team where your work is visible and valued from day one. 

Real ownership of quality and the freedom to shape how we test. 

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. We'd also like to hear briefly about a bug you found that you're proud of and how you found it. Candidates who can join quickly are preferred, so please mention your notice period in your application.

data.title: Sr Quality Engineer
data.description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. 

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. 

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

- Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins. 
 - Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices. 
 - Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers. 
 - Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production. 
 - Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems - including reconciliation checks - to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions. 
 - Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions. 
 - Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit. 
 - Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability. 
 - Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team - identifying dependencies and escalating risks early. 
 - Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes. 
 - Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery. 
 - Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

- 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages. 
 - Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows - including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools - with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated. 
 - Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman. 
 - Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers and product managers, prioritize independently, and communicate quality risks with supporting evidence; prior experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and/or FinTech/Payments domains, or with ERP systems and their integrations, is strongly preferred. 

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. 

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Our more than 22, 000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally - as well as its flagship site, www. fanatics. com.

As an Engineering Director, you will act as a pivotal technical leader, driving the architecture and execution of full-stack platforms that serve millions of daily active users.

 - Resource Management: Manage budgets, infrastructure costs, and engineering bandwidth effectively, honoring our core value of operational frugality without compromising on quality.

- Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in a senior engineering leadership role (Director, Associate Director or Senior Engineering Manager).

Platform, Cloud & Infrastructure

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced RPA Specialist - Blue Prism with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Blue Prism architecture, process automation, exception handling, application integration, debugging, and production support, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable automation solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- RPA Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using Blue Prism, following established development standards and best practices. 
 - Process Assessment: Analyze business processes, identify automation opportunities, and evaluate feasibility, complexity, and expected business benefits. 
 - Solution Design: Prepare Process Definition Documents (PDDs), Solution Design Documents (SDDs), process maps, and technical specifications. 
 - Blue Prism Development: Build and maintain reusable Business Objects, Process Objects, Work Queues, Credentials, Schedules, and Control Room configurations. 
 - Exception Handling: Implement robust exception-handling frameworks, logging, recovery mechanisms, and retry strategies to ensure reliable bot execution. 
 - Application Integration: Integrate Blue Prism with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, web applications, Excel, email, and file systems. 
 - Testing and Deployment: Perform unit testing, support system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), and manage production deployments. 
 - Production Support: Monitor bot performance, troubleshoot failures, conduct root-cause analysis, and resolve production incidents within agreed SLAs. 
 - Automation Optimization: Enhance existing automations to improve execution performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business analysts, process owners, IT and infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Governance and Documentation: Follow security standards, access controls, coding conventions, version control, release management, and RPA governance guidelines. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to expand automation coverage, standardize business processes, and improve operational efficiency. 

Required Technical Skills

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on RPA development experience, with strong practical expertise in Blue Prism. 
 - Strong knowledge of Blue Prism architecture, Process Studio, Object Studio, Application Modeller, Control Room, and Work Queues. 
 - Experience developing reusable Business Objects, Process Objects, exception-handling frameworks, and resilient automation workflows. 
 - Proficiency in UI automation, surface automation, and integration with Windows-based, web-based, and enterprise applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with Excel automation, VBA, SQL, databases, email automation, and file handling. 
 - Understanding of APIs, web services, JSON/XML, and application integration techniques. 
 - Experience with bot scheduling, credential management, environment configuration, release management, and production monitoring. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, testing practices, and technical documentation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Blue Prism certification, preferably Blue Prism Developer or equivalent. 
 - Experience in enterprise-scale RPA implementations and Center of Excellence (CoE) environments. 
 - Exposure to automation governance, reusable component development, and RPA operating models. 
 - Experience with version control, CI/CD practices, and deployment automation. 
 - Exposure to OCR, document processing, and AI-based intelligent automation technologies. 
 - Experience automating business processes in Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Operations, HR, or other enterprise functions.

data.title: Technical Manager
data.description:
Position Overview

The Technical Manager will lead technical and engineering activities for Kaprel India, ensuring accurate and timely project technical submittals, compliance with project specifications, effective coordination with contractors and consultants, and practical technical support through procurement, production and installation. The role will oversee the technical team, support product development and standardization, and act as a central technical resource for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. 

Responsibilities

1. Technical Submittals and Project Approvals

·                Prepare, review and coordinate complete technical submittal packages for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, in line with project-specific requirements and approval procedures. 

·                Compile material submittals, compliance statements, technical data sheets, product specifications, test reports, certificates, method statements and supporting engineering documents as required. 

·                Manage material and finish sample submissions, approval tracking, consultant comments, resubmissions and closure of technical queries. 

·                Coordinate with main contractors, consultants, clients, project teams and Kaprel management to obtain approvals and finalize project-specific materials, system details and designs. 

·                Maintain an up-to-date submittal register, document revision history and approvals record; proactively flag submission risks affecting procurement or site schedules. 

2. Technical Leadership and Engineering Management

·                Lead and coordinate the technical and design team, assign work priorities, review deliverables and monitor workload, quality and submission deadlines. 

·                Oversee the development and checking of shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation details, material take-offs and bills of materials to support accurate procurement and manufacturing. 

·                Conduct technical evaluations and design assessments for compliance with applicable standards, approved specifications, contractual scope and customer requirements. 

·                Establish consistent engineering checklists, drawing review procedures, revision controls and handover requirements between departments. 

·                Identify gaps or discrepancies in tender documents, drawings and specifications; raise technical clarifications and coordinate timely resolution before fabrication. 

3. Procurement, Production and Site Coordination

·                Prepare and maintain procurement schedules and long-lead material requirements in coordination with project programmes and approved technical submittals. 

·                Liaise with Procurement, Stores and Production teams to ensure the correct materials and specifications are available when required, and highlight risks early. 

·                Provide technical support to manufacturing and installation teams, resolving design interfaces, fabrication constraints and site-specific technical problems. 

·                Investigate installation and product performance issues, establish root causes and implement practical corrective measures to prevent recurrence. 

·                Coordinate technical responses and support to customers and project teams on system specifications, installation details and product performance. 

4. Product Engineering, Quality and Improvement

·                Drive value engineering initiatives to improve manufacturability, installation efficiency, product reliability and cost effectiveness without compromising approved performance. 

·                Support new product and system development, component selection, prototyping, testing, certification and performance improvement initiatives. 

·                Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders on suitable alternatives for aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, seals, gaskets and related components. 

·                Maintain controlled records of technical specifications, approved system details, certificates, testing reports and product documentation for use across Kaprel locations. 

·                Analyze recurring technical errors, nonconformities and rework costs; recommend design standardization and preventive improvements. 

5. Reporting and Accountability

·                Provide regular updates to the General Manager on technical submission status, departmental workload, approval delays, unresolved technical risks and improvement initiatives. 

·                Coordinate closely with regional Kaprel teams so requirements and approved technical documentation are consistent, while respecting differences in local project specifications and standards. 

·                Escalate deviations involving unapproved system changes, project cost impact, contractual scope or technical performance before implementation. 

Qualifications and Experience

·                Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline. 

·                Minimum 6 years of relevant construction or subcontracting experience, preferably in the glazing, architectural aluminium, partition or door systems industry. 

·                Prior experience managing technical work and coordinating with main contractors, consultants and clients. 

·                Good knowledge of project specifications, technical documentation, material approvals and subcontract scope management. 

·                Ability to interpret engineering drawings and coordinate fabrication, procurement and installation requirements; proficiency with AutoCAD and relevant technical tools is advantageous. 

·                Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and team management skills; comfortable coordinating technical deliverables across multiple locations. 

For those interested, pls send your CV to recruitment@kaprel. com with subject line: Application_Technical Manager_India

data.title: Engineering Manager (AI)
data.description:
About Innovapptive

Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an AI-powered Connected Worker Platform for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity. 

Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly-Clark, Scott Miracle-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations. 

Our customers have achieved $50M+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10× improvement in frontline productivity, and 15-20% reductions in maintenance costs. 

Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in Frost & Sullivan's "Frost Radar 2025 - Augmented Connected Worker Platforms", with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by Vista Equity Partners and Tiger Global Management. 

With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300+ employees across the U. S. , India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR. 

The Role

Innovapptive's Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product-facing AI agents purpose-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer-specific asset data and SOPs. 

This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle: from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust. 

What You Own

- AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation. 
 - End-to-end agent lifecycle: requirements through architecture, build, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. 
 - RAG and knowledge infrastructure: document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding. 
 - LLM governance: model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human-in-the-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive's AWS VPC - no data to external LLM endpoints. 
 - Agent quality: evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines. 
 - Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard. 
 - Hiring, performance management, and coaching. 

You Must Have

- 7+ years in software engineering with 3+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered products in enterprise production. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi-step agentic workflows. 
 - Strong grasp of RAG architecture: document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re-ranking, and similarity thresholds. 
 - Experience with managed inference infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent. 
 - Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context - not just prototypes or internal tools. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability: prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent). 
 - Data-driven: model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team. 
 - Strong engineering standards: prompt discipline, eval-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production-grade reliability. 

Nice to Have

- Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data. 
 - Industrial domain knowledge: EAM, ERP integrations (SAP, Maximo), maintenance workflows, or field operations. 
 - Multi-agent orchestration patterns: tool calling, agent-to-agent delegation, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Vision models or multimodal AI: image-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation. 
 - MLOps and LLMOps: model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines. 
 - Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads: token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies. 
 - MongoDB and change stream-based event architectures. 

Tech Stack & Tools

- AI / ML- AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, LiteLLM, LangGraph, Milvus (vector DB), AWS Neptune (knowledge graph), Langfuse
 - Backend- Node. js / TypeScript, Python, MongoDB
 - Infrastructure- AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD
 - Observability- Langfuse, Sentry, CloudWatch
 - Tools- GitLab, Jira, SonarQube

Compensation & Growth

Reports to VP PE&A. Path to Sr. EM or platform leadership as integration becomes a core horizontal capability. 

What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance. 
 - A platform to shape the semantic intelligence layer of a category-defining industrial SaaS company. 
 - Access to cutting-edge AI, data, and observability toolchains for continuous learning and innovation. 

Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms. 

Innovapptive is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place. 

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

- AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. 
 - Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. 

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

- Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm. 
 - Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months. 

Technical Strategy & Authority

- Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration. 
 - Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies. 

Customer & Business Impact

- Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. 
 - Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed. 

You're Our Builder Lead If. . .

10th Floor, Sri Harsha ICON, Narsingh, Nanakramguda Service Road, Financial District, Telangana - 500032
