Build systems that solve hard problems. 

8th Element is an AI-first engineering company focused on turning technology into measurable business outcomes. We build systems for complex enterprise challenges, including healthcare workflows, clinical intelligence, payment integrity and knowledge-intensive operations. 

We're looking for a strong backend engineer who combines technical depth, intellectual curiosity, ownership and the ability to lead through engineering. Someone who can reason through complex problems, make sound architectural decisions, take systems into production and help other engineers grow. 

You don't need to be an AI expert. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more. 

What You'll Work On

Backend systems and architecture: Design and build reliable backend services, APIs, data models, enterprise integrations and distributed workflows. 

Technical exploration: Research unfamiliar technologies, evaluate approaches, develop proofs of concept and validate assumptions before committing to a solution. 

Complex problem-solving: Investigate difficult technical issues, identify root causes and reason through trade-offs involving performance, reliability, scalability and cost. 

End-to-end ownership: Take systems from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability and production support. 

Technical leadership: Guide design decisions, mentor engineers, conduct meaningful code reviews and raise the team's engineering standards. 

AI-powered systems: Depending on the project, work on LLM applications, retrieval systems, AI agents and intelligent workflows. 

What We're Looking For

Strong engineering fundamentals-

Strong programming skills in Python or another backend language, with the ability to become productive in Python. 

Experience building production backend services and APIs, with a solid understanding of system design, databases, SQL and data modelling. 

Familiarity with asynchronous programming, concurrency, distributed systems and failure handling. 

Experience with testing, CI/CD, Docker, cloud deployments and production debugging. 

Technical depth and problem-solving-

You understand the reasoning and trade-offs behind your technical decisions, not just how to implement them. 

You can break down ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions and investigate root causes systematically. 

You can navigate unfamiliar codebases and technologies, learn quickly and make progress without needing detailed instructions. 

You care about code quality, simplicity, reliability and long-term maintainability. 

Ownership and technical leadership-

You've taken ownership of a service, subsystem, major feature or significant engineering initiative. 

You've mentored other engineers, guided implementation decisions or helped improve a team's technical capabilities. 

You can make decisions with incomplete information, identify risks early and take responsibility for outcomes. 

You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively and can lead through technical credibility rather than relying on formal authority. 

Good To Have, Not Required

Experience with LLMs, GenAI, AI agents, RAG, vector databases, model evaluation or AI observability is valuable. 

We don't expect expertise across a particular AI technology stack. We'd rather hire a strong systems engineer who can learn AI than someone who knows AI frameworks but lacks engineering depth. 

How We Work

We're a small team where engineers help shape the problem, not just implement a predefined specification. You'll work directly with engineers, product leaders, domain experts and clients, contributing to technical research, architecture, implementation and production operations. 

We use AI extensively in our engineering workflows. We expect you to use these tools effectively while retaining the judgment to evaluate their output, understand the code and own what you ship. 

You'll have the opportunity to influence our engineering practices, build reusable capabilities and help shape the technical direction of a growing AI-first company. 

We're looking for engineers who think deeply, take ownership and make the people around them better.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
FlexTrade Systems is a global leader in high-performance multi-asset execution management and order management systems for equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, futures, and options. A pioneer in the field, FlexTrade is internationally recognized for introducing FlexTRADER®, the world's first broker-neutral, execution management trading system, which allows clients to completely control and customize their execution workflows through a comprehensive ability to search/access liquidity while maintaining the confidentiality of their trading strategies. 

At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to an ever-changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to every interaction, and we continue to improve, grow together, and collaborate as one team. All of these, while having Fun, truly make FlexTrade a wonderful place to work. 

About you: 

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically curious engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges in a fast‐paced trading environment. As part of the FX Development & Client Services team, you will architect high‐performance FX trading components, build low‐latency integrations with leading global market participants, and work directly with traders and technologists to shape next‐generation FX workflows. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys breaking down complexity into well‐defined technical solutions and wants to continuously grow as financial products and markets evolve. 

Responsibilities

As a member of the FlexFX Development & Client Services team, you will: 

- Design, implement, and maintain advanced FX trading components with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Build and optimize low‐latency integration solutions that connect FlexTrade systems with brokers and clients across global FX markets. 
 - Collaborate closely with traders, quants, and senior engineers to translate sophisticated trading workflows into robust, scalable systems. 
 - Individually test each component you build-designing comprehensive automated tests that cover edge cases, failure scenarios, performance‐critical boundaries, and real‐world resiliency requirements. 
 - Produce clear technical designs, architecture documents, and workflow specifications. 
 - Continuously learn and adapt to new products, markets, and trading technologies as financial systems evolve. Job requirements

- Minimum of 7+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Proficiency in modern C++ or similar high‐performance languages. 
 - Experience working on large‐scale, low‐latency, and/or distributed systems, with teams spread all across global regions. 
 - Strong problem‐solving and debugging skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into clear, actionable tasks. 
 - Familiarity with testing methodologies and frameworks such as GTest. 
 - Excellent communication skills for working across technical and business teams. 
 - A positive attitude and fast‐learning mindset, with openness to learning new products, markets, and financial systems as they evolve. 
 - Strong discipline in designing thorough component‐level tests and validating all edge conditions

Nice to have

- Knowledge of trading systems and FIX protocol. 
 - Experience with Order Management Systems (OMS) or Execution Management Systems (EMS). 
 - Exposure to real‐time, high‐throughput, or low‐latency financial applications.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Job Description - GDS Independence | Process Lead

Role title GDS Independence Process Lead

Position Summary

The Process Lead is accountable for the governance, quality, and overall health of an assigned GDS Independence process portfolio. Acting as the process steward and independent quality oversight leader within the operating model, the role provides a consolidated view of process performance, recurring issues, control effectiveness, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities across the portfolio. 

The role establishes process priorities, directs and supports Process SMRs, and drives assurance, remediation, and capability initiatives to strengthen consistency, compliance, and operational effectiveness. Working closely with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Leaders, and other stakeholders, the Process Lead ensures global standards are effectively embedded, risks are proactively managed, and process improvements are implemented in a controlled and sustainable manner. 

Through strong governance, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement, the Process Lead enables consistent execution, strengthens process maturity, and supports the delivery of high-quality Independence services across GDS. 

Key Responsibilities

Process Governance & Portfolio Leadership: 

- Lead the governance agenda for assigned GDS processes. 
 - Maintain an integrated view of process health, quality, risks, capability, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Establish portfolio priorities and determine focus areas for assurance, remediation, and process improvement. 
 - Drive consistent application of Global standards and approved process requirements. 
 - Partner with Global and Regional Process Owners to support effective process governance and decision-making. 

Quality, Assurance & Risk Oversight: 

- Approve and oversee risk-based quality and assurance coverage across the portfolio. 
 - Review significant findings, recurring issues, control weaknesses, and emerging risks. 
 - Determine when additional review, remediation, or escalation is required. 
 - Oversee thematic reviews, trend analysis, and quality assessments to identify systemic risks. 
 - Ensure assurance outcomes lead to meaningful and sustainable improvements. 

Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement: 

- Analyse recurring issues, root causes, assurance findings, and process risks across the portfolio. 
 - Establish remediation priorities and monitor progress to closure. 
 - Hold designated owners accountable for delivering corrective actions. 
 - Confirm remediation activities address underlying causes and reduce future risk. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve process effectiveness. 

Process Change & Knowledge Management: 

- Oversee implementation of approved process improvements and changes across GDS. 
 - Maintain process documentation, SOPs, playbooks, controls, job aids, and knowledge repositories. 
 - Translate approved Global changes into practical guidance and readiness actions. 
 - Ensure process standards remain current, accessible, and consistently applied. 
 - Support successful adoption through effective communication and learning strategies. 

Stakeholder & Process Stewardship: 

- Partner with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Independence Leaders and other stakeholders to strengthen process performance and governance. 
 - Provide clear recommendations on process risks, quality concerns, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Influence decisions through data-driven insights and objective process oversight. 
 - Represent the process portfolio in governance forums and strategic discussions. 
 - Foster strong collaboration between process, service, and delivery teams. 

People Leadership & Capability Development: 

- Lead, coach, and develop assigned Process SMRs. 
 - Establish clear expectations, ownership, and accountability for portfolio outcomes. 
 - Drive calibration and consistency of technical judgment across teams and locations. 
 - Strengthen succession planning, knowledge continuity, and leadership readiness. 
 - Build a sustainable pipeline of process stewardship capability to support future organizational needs. 

Success measures

- Quality: Quality at source, rework, Second-line review themes, business escalations, independent QA themes and sustained remediation
 - Experience: RIL pulse, Voice of Customer, communication quality. 
 - People: Capability, engagement, retention, coaching, succession and primary/secondary coverage
 - Risk & Assurance: Reduced systemic risks and recurring quality issues through effective assurance and independent oversight. 
 - Improvement & Transformation: Measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, standardization, and user experience. 
 - Capability & Succession: A strong pipeline of capable Process SMRs supported by effective coaching, knowledge continuity, and succession planning. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Strengthen stakeholder confidence through effective governance, strategic insights and Global alignment. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong Independence or risk and compliance knowledge, with the ability to link process decisions to regional and business outcomes. 
 - Experience in quality management, assurance, root cause analysis, risk assessment, control effectiveness reviews, and remediation oversight. Able to identify recurring and systemic issues, assess risks, and drive practical, sustainable improvements. 
 - Proven leadership of multi-location teams, with clear accountability for capacity, performance, risk and people outcomes. 
 - Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships. 
 - Sound judgment, using service, quality, demand, people and stakeholder insights to set priorities and improve performance. 
 - Inclusive and culturally aware leadership, with a strong focus on coaching, talent development and succession. 
 - Proven ability to lead change, drive technology adoption and deliver sustained service improvements. 

To qualify for the role

- A university degree (master's or post-graduate degree) or equivalent professional experience in business, accounting, finance, risk, compliance, operations or a related area. 
 - 12-14 years of relevant experience in professional services, global delivery, Independence, risk or another controlled service environment. 
 - Demonstrated people leadership, stakeholder management, Quality and controls and change implementation. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English and confidence operating across time zones and cultures. 
 - Evidence of portfolio leadership, senior stakeholder credibility and cross-process judgment appropriate to Rank 62 or aspiring Rank 62. 

What You Can Look For

- A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment. 
 - A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY's brand name. 
 - A team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills. 
 - A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness. 
 - Opportunities to work with regional teams and stakeholders on strengthening the compliance framework. 
 - A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiency to processes. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland and UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve. 

Who You Are

As a Staff Engineer L6, you lead development across Inovalon products and platforms with a focus on solving resiliency, scale, and security challenges at a higher level of technical sophistication. You serve as a functional lead and subject matter expert, helping guide engineering execution across teams while raising discipline, productivity, and technical quality. In this role, you partner with business stakeholders, architecture leads, and engineers to deliver scalable data solutions, strengthen platform reliability, and drive a collaborative, data-driven engineering culture. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable healthcare data pipelines and data access patterns that support Inovalon products and platforms.

 - Design and implement distributed data processing pipelines using tools and languages common in the big data ecosystem. 
 - Document technical designs, estimate scope, and help define implementation approaches for complex engineering initiatives. 
 - Drive a culture of collaborative reviews across designs, code, and test plans to improve quality, consistency, and engineering discipline. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders and architecture engineering leads to ensure high quality solutions are delivered and engineering standard methodologies are followed. 
 - Advance DevOps practices by utilizing and improving continuous integration and deployment frameworks, including automated pipelines with multi stage validation. 
 - Solve complex data and platform issues through root cause analysis, and work across teams to resolve operational and performance problems. 
 - Provide strong technical leadership by raising the technical bar, fostering a data and results driven culture, and building trust and collaboration across teams. 
 - Influence and coach junior engineers within and outside your team, communicate effectively across disciplines, and support on call responsibilities for critical issue resolution. 

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of industrial experience with cloud and serverless technologies. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience required. 
 - Hands on experience with AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, test orchestration, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling. 
 - Experience implementing fully automated pipelines with multi stage validation. 
 - Familiarity with SQL Server, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL, especially test data creation, schema validation, and data quality automation. 
 - Proven ability to drive test automation maturity, reduce manual testing, eliminate flakiness, and improve reliability through automation, monitoring, proactive stability improvements, and automated alerting. 
 - Proficiency in test automation for microservices, containerized environments, and orchestrated systems including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by evaluating emerging tools and frameworks, expanding expertise across cloud, data, and automation domains, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes. 
 - Demonstrate leadership by setting technical direction, aligning teams on goals and timelines, coaching engineers, and influencing high quality execution across functions and teams. 
 - Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to changing technologies, priorities, and operational demands while maintaining focus on delivery, resiliency, and quality. 
 - Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying innovative ways to solve scale, security, reliability, and automation challenges across products and platforms. 
 - Demonstrate analytical skills by performing root cause analysis, assessing data and system issues, and using evidence to improve performance, quality, and operational stability. 
 - Nice to have: Experience with service meshes and asynchronous or event streaming systems such as Kafka, SQS, and SNS; advanced performance testing and benchmarking experience with k6, JMeter, or Gatling; security automation experience including vulnerability scanning, static analysis, and secrets validation; experience leading organization wide automation transformations, platform migrations, or quality initiatives. 

Our Shared Commitments

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer. 

Work Environment

- This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law. 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e. g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth. 

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. insightsoftware is looking for a technically sharp, people-first Engineering Lead to lead our Financial Reporting team - a squad at the center of our most complex and high-stakes enterprise workloads. We want a hands-on technical leader who codes when it counts, drives architecture decisions with conviction, and knows how to get the best out of engineers in an AI-accelerated development environment. 

You'll lead a team building and maintaining mission-critical reports and dashboards that serve Fortune 500 financial enterprises. You think in systems, not just features. You hold the bar high on code quality, design integrity, and delivery discipline - and you coach your team to do the same. 

If you've led high-performing backend engineering teams, are fluent in modern AI developer tooling, and thrive at the intersection of technical depth and people leadership - this role is built for you.

data.description:
Job description: 

  

About the Team

We are expanding our AI Engineering organization at ZF and are hiring Senior Solution Architects. 

Our team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and solutions across Agentic AI, Generative AI for the software development lifecycle, systems engineering, automated testing, MLOps, computer vision, and engineering data intelligence. 

Our work includes developing AI agents for requirements engineering, code development, test generation, and traceability. We also address complex automotive engineering challenges, including virtual sensors, lateral and longitudinal control, perception engineering, object detection and tracking, digital twins, condition monitoring, and intelligent validation. 

  

What you can look forward to as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)

- End-to-end ownership: You'll own the technical architecture of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, from framing the business problem through to secure, observable and cost-efficient production systems. 
 - Real-world impact: You'll turn LLM capabilities into reliable, auditable solutions that hold up against complex enterprise data, strict security and compliance requirements, tight latency and cost budgets, and unpredictable model behavior. This role goes well beyond proof of concept. 
 - Architecture leadership: You'll set the reference architecture, platform patterns and guardrails that multiple engineering teams build on. 
 - Strategic decisions: You'll lead decisions on what to build versus buy, which models to use, and whether to customize models through fine-tuning, weighing quality, cost, scalability and vendor independence. 
 - Cutting-edge technology: You'll design multi-agent systems on leading frameworks and cloud platforms, such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Visibility and influence: You'll be the trusted technical authority for business leaders, security teams and enterprise architecture boards.   

Your Profile as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, AI or a related field. 
 - 10+ years in software, data or ML engineering, including at least 3 years as a solution or lead architect. 
 - Production GenAI delivery: You have delivered at least 2-3 LLM / Generative AI solutions into production, not only proofs of concept, and owned the architecture and non-functional requirements end to end. 
 - Agentic AI: You have built hands-on agentic systems hands-on, with tool use, state management and human-in-the-loop controls. You've used code-first frameworks such as LangGraph / LangChain or managed platforms such as AWS Bedrock Agents or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service. 
 - LLM and model expertise: You have a strong grasp of LLM fundamentals (transformers, embeddings, context windows). You have hands-on experience customising models through fine-tuning (e. g. , LoRA / QLoRA) and evaluating them, and you can choose sensibly between prompting, RAG and training. 
 - Engineering and cloud: You are an expert in Python and API engineering (FastAPI, async, event-driven design). You have strong architecture experience on at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure or GCP), including networking, identity and security. 
 - RAG, quality and security: You have practical experience with vector databases, hybrid search and retrieval evaluation. You've implemented LLM evaluation, tracing and observability in production, and you're well-grounded in AI security (prompt-injection defence, data protection).

data.title: DISTINGUISHED, SOFTWARE ENGINEER - WFS
data.description:
About The Team

Walmart's Marketplace is the backbone of a thriving ecosystem connecting millions of third-party sellers to hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. You will be build applications that provide accurate and contextual intelligence and recommendations to sellers on Walmart Marketplace and Omni platforms. 

Role Overview

Distinguished Engineer is one of the most coveted technical IC titles at Walmart - and this role lives up to it. As a Distinguished Engineer on the Marketplace team within Growth Tech, you will be developing services that helps millions of sellers to leverage Walmart Fulfilment Services. You will write code, design systems, review architectures, and solve the problems that are complex. Your world-class expertise in distributed systems, API design, and platform engineering will be paired with a Al-forward mindset. 

This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of scale, commerce, and platform engineering. You will own the technical vision and execution for a portfolio of mission-critical, cross-cutting services that enables Seller through Seller Center UI and APIs. You will be the technical standard-setter across all of it. 

What You'll Own Technically

The Walmart Fulfilment Services team is essential to the Marketplace ecosystem, responsible for designing and scaling the global platform that supports the complete seller fulfilment within Walmart marketplace journey. The team develops robust global workflows, and complex multi-platform integrations connecting cloud microservices, seller portals, and AI-driven analytics. You will own Architecture, design, development and delivery of Seller journey, addressing distributed systems challenges, optimize APIs, and establish architectural standards to enable international marketplace growth. 

What You'll Do

Architecture & System Design

Lead end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives involving from API contracts, UI interfaces and data models to distributed system topologies and cross-cutting concerns. 

Drive platform standardization by defining and documenting reference architectures, design patterns, and implementation guardrails that teams adopt

Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and cloud-native patterns with a clear-eyed understanding of trade-offs at Walmart's operational scale

Author and review RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that become the technical canon for the platform

Hands-On Engineering

Write production-grade code and not prototypes or proof-of-concepts, test and deploy them to production

Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability

Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality

Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team. 

Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving

Solve the hardest and complex problems and enable the team while doing so

Lead technical investigations for P0/P1 incidents affecting platform services; own the root cause analysis and define permanent fixes

Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes

Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements

Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement

Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

Al & Innovation

This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale. 

Day-to-Day Al Fluency

Proficient with GitHub Copilot, Wibey, and LLM-based tooling as active, daily parts of your development workflow

Use Al to compress every phase of the engineering loop: schema design validation, code generation and review, test coverage acceleration, documentation, drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and API design feedback

Identify where Al can replace toil, then build the automation yourself

Al-Native Platform Thinking

Architect and build Al-native capabilities like intelligent API health monitoring, Al-assisted seller onboarding flows, smart alerting and anomaly detection

Evaluate and integrate Al/ML capabilities into services where they create measurable seller value

Stay current on the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring high-signal, opinionated recommendations to the team

Al Advocacy & Enablement

Model Al-augmented engineering practices for the team through live demos, pairing sessions, and written guides

Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams

Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

What You'll Bring

Distinguished Engineers at Walmart lead through technical gravity. Your impact multiplies across teams. 

Raise the floor - your code reviews, design feedback, and written standards lift the quality of every engineer in the team

When a team is stuck on a systems design challenge or a production crisis, you are the person who helps unblock

Your architectural decisions today shape the technical capabilities and codebase for the future

Grow technical depth across the org through tech talks, design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on pairing, you are a force multiplier for technical growth across Growth Tech

Bridge platform and product translate complex technical constraints into clear trade-offs that inform product decisions; translate product ambitions into technically sound, phased engineering strategies

Pioneer Al adoption - model what Al-augmented engineering looks like at the Distinguished level and create the patterns, playbooks, and tooling that the broader team follows

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 4 years' experience in software engineering or related area, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

data.title: Director, Software Engineering
data.description:
About Team

This area owns the technology portfolio that connects demand intelligence, inventory positioning, and product flow across Walmart International. Through SMART Forecasting, GeoDemand, Placements, IO2, and O3, the organization enables the capabilities that determine what customers are likely to need, where inventory should be positioned, and how product should flow efficiently through the supply chain. 

The team's purpose is to build an intelligent, scalable, and connected replenishment ecosystem that turns demand signals into better inventory and flow decisions. By bringing together software engineering, data, machine learning, forecasting, and optimization, the team seeks to improve product availability and inventory productivity while reducing variability and creating greater efficiency across suppliers, distribution centers, stores, clubs, and fulfillment networks. 

What You'll Do

Lead the engineering strategy and execution for the IO2, O3, GeoDemand, Placements, and SMART Forecasting portfolio, connecting demand intelligence, inventory positioning, and product flow. 

Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and modernization strategy for highly scalable, business-critical platforms. 

Build a more integrated replenishment ecosystem, ensuring forecasting, geographic demand, placement, and flow capabilities work together to deliver end-to-end outcomes. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Supply Chain Operations, Architecture, and market teams to translate business priorities into scalable technology solutions. 

Lead the engineering of data-, machine learning-, forecasting-, and optimization-driven capabilities that improve how inventory decisions are made. 

Drive engineering excellence and operational health, including reliability, scalability, observability, security, automation, performance, and production readiness. 

Establish strong technical standards and architecture guardrails while enabling teams to move quickly and make effective engineering decisions. 

Manage complex cross-platform and cross-organizational dependencies, proactively removing barriers and aligning teams around shared outcomes. 

Lead technology modernization and simplification, reducing technical debt and creating platforms that can be more easily adopted and scaled across international markets. 

Own execution against the portfolio roadmap, improving delivery predictability, quality, and accountability across teams. 

Lead through engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating clear accountability while empowering teams to own solutions and outcomes. 

Recruit, develop, coach, and retain strong engineering talent, while building a healthy leadership pipeline and opportunities for technical career growth. 

Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, experimentation, and responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies. 

Communicate technology strategy, investment needs, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior business and technology leaders. 

Maintain a strong connection between technology investments and measurable outcomes such as product availability, inventory productivity, flow stability, and supply-chain efficiency. 

What You'll Bring

Large-scale software & distributed systems - Strong technical background designing and operating highly scalable, resilient, cloud-based platforms and distributed systems. 

Data-intensive platforms - Deep understanding of large-scale data processing, streaming/batch architectures, data quality, and the engineering patterns required to turn large datasets into operational decisions. 

AI/ML-enabled systems - Experience engineering production platforms that operationalize machine learning, forecasting, and optimization models, including the partnership model between Software Engineering and Data Science. 

Modern architecture & platform engineering - Ability to establish architecture strategy, APIs/contracts, platform standards, observability, reliability, scalability, security, and engineering guardrails across interconnected systems. 

Technical strategy & modernization - Proven ability to modernize complex technology ecosystems while continuing to operate business-critical capabilities and progressively reducing legacy dependencies. 

End-to-end systems thinking - Ability to understand and architect across multiple interconnected products rather than optimizing individual systems in isolation. 

Engineering excellence & operational health - Strong command of SRE/DevOps practices, availability, performance, automated testing, CI/CD, telemetry, incident management, capacity planning, and production readiness. 

Retail supply-chain domain expertise - Knowledge of replenishment, demand forecasting, inventory planning, allocation/placement, distribution-center operations, transportation, and store fulfillment. 

Forecasting & optimization experience - Familiarity with time-series forecasting, demand sensing, optimization algorithms, simulation, and operations research. 

Enterprise platform integration - Experience managing large dependency landscapes across data, infrastructure, security, product, and other platform teams. 

AI-enabled engineering - Experience applying generative AI/LLMs to engineering productivity, decision support, or supply-chain use cases. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Flexible Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. data.title: STAFF, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
About The Team

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets. 

What You'll Do

Remain hands-on and contribute production-quality code for critical platform capabilities, complex integrations, and technically challenging initiatives. 

Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for International Pricing platforms. 

Write high-quality design documents, including HLDs, LLDs, Architecture Decision Records, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams, and operational readiness plans. 

Review architecture and technical designs produced by engineering teams and ensure alignment with platform standards, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Design and build scalable, high-throughput, and low-latency Java- or Kotlin-based microservices deployed on cloud infrastructure. 

Build extensible pricing capabilities using domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, Kafka, API-first principles, and well-defined service boundaries. 

Design solutions for pricing recommendations, rule evaluation, approvals, simulations, publishing, execution, auditability, and downstream-system integration. 

Own data-modeling and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data stores, with a strong focus on data accuracy, lineage, consistency, and traceability. 

Design resilient distributed workflows using appropriate patterns such as orchestration, outbox, retries, circuit breaking, idempotency, and dead-letter processing. 

Define REST and gRPC APIs with clear contracts, backward-compatibility guarantees, versioning strategies, and consumer-driven contract testing. 

Design for multi-market and multi-tenant use cases while balancing global platform consistency with market-specific business requirements. 

Identify and proactively address systemic risks, including scaling bottlenecks, single points of failure, data-integrity gaps, operational dependencies, and technical-debt accumulation. 

Drive architecture and integration alignment with shared platforms and downstream systems responsible for price calculation, price publishing, execution, catalog, analytics, and store operations. 

Represent International Pricing in cross-organizational architecture and engineering forums. 

Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security validation, canary deployment, rollback, and production verification. 

Drive observability-first engineering through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, actionable alerts, and business-flow monitoring. 

Ensure that services comply with enterprise security, privacy, infrastructure, and software-development standards. 

Lead production-readiness reviews, incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reliability-improvement initiatives. 

Mentor junior, mid-level, and senior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, pairing, and structured feedback. 

Establish engineering standards for design quality, code quality, automated testing, performance, security, release readiness, and operational excellence. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Business, Program, Quality Engineering, and other platform teams to translate complex pricing requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Promote a platform-first mindset by creating reusable and configurable capabilities that enable multiple markets and engineering teams without duplicating solutions. 

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value. 

Make sound technical decisions and solve complex problems efficiently in a high-impact, fast-moving environment. 

What You'll Bring

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21 Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed-system fundamentals, design patterns, and software-engineering principles. 

Strong experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms and asynchronous processing patterns. 

Experience designing and operating systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 

Advanced experience with cloud infrastructure such as Azure, GCP, or AWS. 

Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, service-to-service communication, autoscaling, resource management, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

Experience designing systems that process large data volumes while maintaining strong consistency, traceability, performance, and availability. 

Demonstrated ability to author clear technical designs and influence architecture across multiple teams. 

Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, messaging, and data layers. 

Experience driving engineering excellence through automated testing, performance optimization, reliability improvements, operational readiness, and incident prevention. 

Experience integrating machine-learning inference APIs or model endpoints into production services. 

Familiarity with GenAI-assisted engineering tools and their responsible use across software-development workflows. 

Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus-building skills. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical capabilities of the broader team. 

Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform architecture and sustainability.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability and performance of our customer-facing platform.  - Address routine service requests while identifying ways to automate and simplify. 
 - Create infrastructure as code using Terraform, ARM Templates, Cloud Formation. 
 - Maintain data backups and disaster recovery plans. 
 - Design and deploy CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Octopus, Ansible, Jenkins, Azure DevOps. 
 - Adhere to security best practices through all stages of the software development lifecycle

Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Engineer

"Microsoft Azure/AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Golden Signals monitoring(Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation) and modern SRE practices(SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and Error Budgets. )" Please match your work experience with these mentioned skillset for a quick right-fit check. 

Location: Viman Nagar, Pune - Work From Office

Experience Overall(must have): 8 Years

CTC: Up to ₹25 LPA

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only within 15d or (if serving max 30days)

Working Hours: 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM, Monday to Friday

On-Call: 24/7 Production Support - On-Call Rotation Required

Employment Type: Full-Time

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) / DevOps Engineer to manage and improve the reliability, scalability, performance, security, and observability of mission-critical production environments. 

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps automation, Monitoring & Observability, Incident Management, and SRE practices. The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling production incidents while also driving long-term initiatives around reliability, automation, scalability, and reduction of operational toil. 

Must-Have Skills & Experience1. SRE & Production Operations

- Relevant 7+ years of relevant experience in SRE / DevOps / Cloud Infrastructure / Production Engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience with 24/7 production support and on-call operations. 
 - Strong experience in incident management, troubleshooting, RCA, and post-mortems. 
 - Good understanding of SLI, SLO, SLA, Error Budgets, MTTR, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience with toil reduction, capacity planning, high availability, disaster recovery, and failover strategies. 
 - Ability to improve system availability, performance, scalability, and operational reliability. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure
 - Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, storage, compute, and cloud-native services. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and good exposure to multi-cloud environments. 
 - Experience with: 
 - Azure: VMs, Networking, Storage, IAM, Azure Monitor, AKS 
 - AWS: EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS 
 - GCP: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, GKE, Cloud Monitoring 
 - Kubernetes & Containerization
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. 
 - Experience with AKS / EKS / GKE or equivalent Kubernetes environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm deployments. 
 - Understanding of Kubernetes troubleshooting, scaling, networking, and workload management. 
 - Infrastructure as Code & DevOps
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
 - Experience with Git-based workflows using GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos. 
 - Strong DevOps automation and CI/CD understanding. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python and/or Bash. 
 - Monitoring & Observability
 - Strong hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as: 
 - Prometheus 
 - Grafana 
 - Datadog 
 - Azure Monitor 
 - AWS CloudWatch 
 - GCP Cloud Monitoring 
 - Strong understanding of metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting. 
 - Experience implementing monitoring based on Golden Signals: 
 - Latency 
 - Traffic 
 - Errors 
 - Saturation 
 - Ability to develop symptom-based, user-impact-focused alerting. 
 - Linux & Networking
 - Strong knowledge of Linux system administration. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - DNS 
 - TCP/IP 
 - Load Balancing 
 - SSL/TLS 
 - Networking fundamentals 
 - Experience supporting highly available production environments. 
 - Incident & Reliability Engineering
 - Ability to rapidly diagnose and resolve high-severity production incidents. 
 - Experience driving MTTR reduction. 
 - Strong debugging and analytical problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to identify recurring issues and implement permanent corrective/preventive solutions. 
Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience working across Azure + AWS + GCP in a multi-cloud environment. 
 - Knowledge of Go (Golang). 
 - Experience with OpenSearch / ELK Stack. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production. 
 - Exposure to Azure AI Services and Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Experience supporting RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workloads. 
 - Experience designing infrastructure for AI/ML platforms. 
 - Experience building enterprise-wide OpenTelemetry observability frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture. 
 - Exposure to advanced cloud-native architectures and reliability patterns. 
 - Experience with security, compliance, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and network segmentation. 

Key ResponsibilitiesProduction & Incident Management

- Participate in the 24/7 on-call rotation. 
 - Diagnose, mitigate, and resolve production incidents. 
 - Lead RCA and post-incident reviews. 
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Continuously improve MTTR and production stability. 

Reliability Engineering

- Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and Error Budgets. 
 - Identify and eliminate operational toil. 
 - Conduct reliability and capacity reviews. 
 - Improve redundancy, failover, disaster recovery, and system resilience. 

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP. 
 - Manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications. 
 - Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. 
 - Support CI/CD and Git-based development workflows. 

Observability & Performance

- Build and improve monitoring, logging, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Implement OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing. 
 - Establish Golden Signals-based monitoring and alerting. 
 - Identify and resolve infrastructure and application performance bottlenecks. 

Security

- Implement cloud security best practices around IAM, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation and compliance initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with Development, Security, and Infrastructure teams. 

Ideal Candidate

We Are Looking For Someone With

- Strong SRE mindset and production ownership. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting and incident-management skills. 
 - Hands-on expertise in Cloud + Kubernetes + Terraform + Observability. 
 - Strong understanding of OpenTelemetry and Golden Signals. 
 - Experience working in highly available, production-critical environments. 
 - Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions during critical incidents. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Passion for automation, scalability, reliability, and continuous improvement. 

Important Hiring Criteria

Must Be

- 7+ years relevant experience 
 - Immediate joiner 
 - Willing to work from office in Viman Nagar, Pune 
 - Comfortable with 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM shift 
 - Comfortable with 24/7 on-call rotation 
 - Strong hands-on SRE/DevOps experience 
 - Strong Cloud + Kubernetes + Observability experience 
 - Strong production incident management experience

Good To Have

- Multi-cloud: Azure + AWS + GCP 
 - OpenTelemetry 
 - AI/ML or RAG production workloads 
 - Azure AI / AI Foundry 
 - Go 
 - OpenSearch / ELK 
 - Distributed systems

data.title: Manager, Manufacturing Process Operations
data.description:
Job Purpose

JOB DESCRIPTION

Lead Peptide Upstream Manufacturing, particularly Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS), along with manufacturing QMS activities to ensure safe, compliant and timely execution in line with cGMP, quality, EHS and business/project requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Peptide Upstream Manufacturing: Lead SPPS operations covering resin charging/swelling, Fmoc deprotection, amino acid coupling, washing, cleavage and filtration. Ensure execution as per approved BMR/BPR, SOPs, process parameters, quality requirements and production schedules; monitor yields, solvent/material consumption and equipment utilization. 
 - QMS Management: Own manufacturing-related deviations, CAPA, change controls, incident investigations, RCA and risk assessments. Review/approve SOPs, BMR/BPR, protocols, forms, checklists and logbooks, ensuring GDP, Data Integrity and timely QMS closure. Maintain readiness for customer, regulatory and internal audits. 
 - Project & Equipment Readiness: Provide manufacturing inputs for URS, equipment/facility design and process requirements. Coordinate equipment procurement, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning and qualification, including DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ as applicable, and ensure equipment readiness for engineering and GMP batches. 
 - Technology Transfer & Scale-Up: Coordinate with R&D/Process Development for technology transfer, manufacturing feasibility and scale-up. Support engineering, demonstration, validation and commercial batches; identify scale-up risks, implement mitigation and transfer process knowledge to shop-floor teams. 
 - Team Management: Lead, allocate and monitor the Upstream Manufacturing & QMS team. Ensure training and qualification in SPPS, GMP, QMS, troubleshooting and documentation, while driving Safety, Quality, Compliance, Productivity and Accountability. 
 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with R&D, QA, QC, Engineering, Projects, Warehouse, Supply Chain, EHS, Validation and Procurement to ensure timely availability of raw materials, equipment, documents, utilities and manpower. 
 - EHS & Compliance: Ensure safe handling of solvents, reagents, amino acids, resins and process materials. Participate in process risk assessments, HAZOP and safety reviews, and ensure timely closure of safety observations and corrective actions. 

Qualifications

Qualification B. Pharm / M. Pharm / B. Sc. / M. Sc. / B. Tech / M. Tech in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field

Experience Preferably 12-15 years in Peptide/Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, with relevant experience in manufacturing operations and QMS.

Job PurposeOversee daily factory food safety, regulatory compliance, and quality operations. Drive full implementation of FSSC 22000 (v6), manage incoming Raw Material (RM/PM) testing, ensure statutory compliance, and lead specialized QC testing matrices for beverage and frozen product lines. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Regulatory & Legal Compliance: Ensure factory-wide adherence to national/international food laws, additive limits, and labeling rules. Manage factory licenses, product registrations, packaging artwork approvals, and serve as the liaison during government inspections. 

- FSSC 22000 v6 & Systems Management: Implement and maintain FSSC 22000 v6, HACCP, PRPs, and OPRPs. Lead internal/external audits, non-conformance management, RCA, and CAPA execution. 

- Beverage QC Matrix Operations: Oversee line testing for syrup, batching, thermal processing (Pasteurization/UHT), and filling. Monitor physicochemical parameters (Brix, pH, acidity, $CO_2$ volumes, viscosity), microbiological stability (yeast, mold, TAB), and Water Treatment Plant (WTP) quality parameters. 

- Frozen Products QC Matrix Operations: Enforce cold chain monitoring across receiving, IQF/blast freezing, storage ($-18^\circ\text{C}$), and dispatch. Oversee testing for drip loss %, thaw stability, glazed %, and high-risk pathogens (Listeria, Salmonella, psychrotrophs). 

- Factory Operations & Floor Quality: Enforce strict hygiene, sanitation, GMP/GHP, and environmental monitoring programs (EMP). Conduct daily process audits, train production staff, and drive 5S/yield improvement projects. 

- RM & PM Quality Control: Oversee receiving, sampling, and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) verifications for incoming ingredients/materials. Manage supplier rejections, vendor CAPAs, allergen control, and traceability systems. 
 - 
Key Qualifications & Skills: 

- Education & Experience: Bachelor's/Master's in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemistry, or Microbiology. 5-8 years of food plant QA/QC experience (2+ years in a supervisory role), preferably spanning both beverage and frozen food lines. 

- Certifications: HACCP Certified. Certified Internal Auditor for FSSC 22000 v6 / ISO 22000 is strongly preferred. 

- Core Competencies: 

- Proven track record as an Internal Auditor, with hands-on experience planning, conducting, and reporting on internal FSSC 22000/HACCP audits. 

- Strong expertise in food regulatory laws, packaging compliance, and statutory standards. 

- Hands-on knowledge of beverage parameters ($CO_2$, Brix, pH, WTP) and frozen matrix testing (IQF, drip loss, cold chain, psychrotrophs). 

- Direct experience in FSSC v6 mandates (Food Defense, Food Fraud, Equipment/Waste Management) and factory CIP/COP systems.

data.title: Senior Bring up and Characterization Engineer
data.description:
Bring-Up and Characterization Engineer

Multiple roles across different levels

Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Bengaluru which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing. 

We are looking for a Characterisation and Bring-Up engineer to work with Architecture, Silicon Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Operations (device manufacture) and Product teams to help create and execute the bring-up and characterisation of our cutting-edge silicon devices and system platforms. Graphcore design and develop leading edge silicon processors and high-power high-speed blade systems at the forefront of AI technology. As such you will need to develop a detailed understanding of our silicon and platform products. Your role will be to create and execute bring-up and characterisation plans of our silicon devices in systems to show that they will operate correctly over all conditions in the final product. You will concentrate on automated and manual testing of systems in the lab and datacentre. The results will be integrated with data from other teams to provide the complete characterisation solution for the product. For example, a large amount of device testing can be performed by the production test team using high-speed production test equipment. 

Responsibilities and Duties

- Understand the architecture and design of silicon devices and systems, and clearly document the requirements for characterisation
 - Creation of product specific characterisation plans
 - Liasing with engineering teams to understand what are tests are available for characterisation purposes and driving change where appropriate
 - Create and maintain an automated system for running characterisation testing, capturing the results to a central database and performing data analysis
 - Execution of manual characterisation tests where automation is not appropriate
 - Report regularly on progress and issues during the characterisation
 - Produce characterisation reports containing platform test results and feeding them up into the overall product characterisation report

Essential Skills

- A proven track record of delivering technical output, perhaps as an individual contributor, manager, or project manager
 - Solid experience and understanding of silicon digital device design characterization
 - Knowledge of silicon process technology and how that impacts device performance at transistor and system level
 - Knowledge of high-performance processor and system-on-chip systems
 - Experience of high-speed digital interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet or DDR
 - Knowledge of measurement automation and data analysis
 - The ability to code or script automation and data analysis using appropriate coding languages such as Python, JMP for example
 - An ability to work independently without daily oversight

Desirable Skills

- Knowledge of PCBA and system level technologies
 - Background knowledge of ATE systems and capabilities. Whilst you will not be directly involved with such testing, some of the characterisation work will be performed on such systems

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers a competitive benefits package. We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Software Development Engineer 2 - Fulfilment

About Urban Company

Urban Company is Asia's largest tech-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services - beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more - delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high-quality, and reliable experience every single time. 

About the Fulfilment Team

The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace - we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters: 

- Planning & Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals. 

- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement. 

- Allocation & Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability. 

These are classic marketplace optimization problems - forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real-time recovery - solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests. 

Job Description: SDE-2

We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE-2) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high-impact engineering challenges - the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. - Design and build scalable, high-performance, fault-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.

- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.

Job Title: Senior Salesforce Solution Architect

Location: Jaipur

Duration: Fulltime

EXPERIENCE: 8+ years

ROLE LEVEL: Senior Consultant / Technical Architect / Solution Architect

About the opportunity

Celebal Technologies is seeking experienced Salesforce professionals to contribute to enterprise transformation, application modernization, and next-generation architecture initiatives. The role requires a deep understanding of CRM business processes, application landscapes, data models, workflows, and integrations, and the ability to translate those capabilities into flexible, scalable future-state solutions. 

This is not a conventional Salesforce implementation or administration role. 

Key responsibilities - Salesforce assessment and architecture

• Assess Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, custom objects, metadata, data models, security, workflows, automations, and business processes. 

• Review existing Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, APIs, and enterprise integrations. 

• Document the current-state landscape, application dependencies, business rules, data flows, and reusable capabilities. 

• Identify modernization opportunities, constraints, and technical risks. 

Key responsibilities - modernization and solution design

• Translate Salesforce-based business capabilities into future-state application and integration architectures. 

• Design modular applications, reusable services, API strategies, integration patterns, and data architecture components. 

• Contribute to technical discovery, solution design, proof-of-concepts, implementation planning, and design reviews. 

• Collaborate with enterprise architects, developers, data engineers, cloud teams, and business stakeholders. 

Key responsibilities - enterprise integration, data and AI

• Design secure Salesforce integrations with enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and cloud services. 

• Apply API-led, synchronous/asynchronous, event-driven, and service-oriented integration patterns. 

• Assess data ownership, relationships, quality, migration considerations, and access to CRM business capabilities. 

• Support connected enterprise solutions involving modern data platforms, intelligent automation, and AI-driven applications. 

Mandatory qualifications and technical skills

• 8+ years of relevant technology experience with substantial hands-on Salesforce implementation and solution architecture exposure. 

• Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud, CRM business processes, objects, relationships, metadata, and permissions. 

• Ability to explain and review Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, SOQL, and platform customization. 

• Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns. 

• Understanding of OAuth 2. 0, authentication, authorization, API security, and asynchronous/event-driven communication. 

• Demonstrated ability to assess complex existing applications, map business capabilities, and develop technical architecture documentation. 

• Hands-on solution design capability and willingness to participate in implementation, not only advisory work. 

Preferred / good-to-have skills

• Exposure to Azure, cloud-native applications, microservices, and modern application development. 

• Familiarity with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or other enterprise data platforms. 

• Experience with Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, or Copilot Studio integrations. 

• Understanding of data migration, transformation, enterprise AI, intelligent automation, RAG, or agentic systems. 

• Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect credentials. 

• Prior Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. Strong architecture fundamentals and learning agility are essential. 

Ideal candidate

• Understands end-to-end Salesforce implementations and the business capabilities they support. 

• Can reason about how those capabilities could be redesigned across different platforms and integration boundaries. 

• Combines architectural ownership with a practical, builder-oriented approach. 

• Is motivated to broaden their expertise into cloud, data, enterprise integration, and AI.
