data.title: AI-Native Developer (Sandbox)
data.description:
Experience: 2+ years

Core Technologies: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, SQL

Development Approach: AI-assisted software development

Role Summary

We are looking for an AI-native developer who uses AI coding tools as a primary part of the software development workflow. You should be able to turn a loosely defined idea into working, tested software quickly-and take full responsibility for the quality of the code, including code generated by AI. 

You will work directly with the owner in short feedback cycles, build and validate changes in a safe sandbox environment, and collaborate with a dedicated tester before any release. All live releases will remain under the owner's control. 

Who You Are

- AI-first by habit: You regularly build with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools, and know how to use them effectively on real codebases. 
 - A sharp reviewer: You treat AI-generated code like a junior developer's pull request. You inspect it, challenge assumptions, verify behaviour and catch plausible but incorrect output before it ships. 
 - An owner, not a ticket-taker: You turn loosely described needs into clear requirements, ask the important questions and deliver end to end without constant follow-up. 
 - Fast and careful: You deliver small changes quickly but never mark work complete until you have tested and verified it. 
 - Product-minded: You notice confusing screens, inaccurate labels and awkward workflows, and improve the user experience proactively. 
 - Honest about status: You communicate whether work is done, partly done, untested or broken, and raise risks early. 

Key Responsibilities

- Translate product ideas and business requirements into working web application features. 
 - Use AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, debugging, refactoring, test creation and documentation. 
 - Review AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, performance and consistency with the existing codebase. 
 - Build and maintain web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and React; use Next. js where appropriate. 
 - Work with SQL databases, understand schemas, write queries, prepare migrations and independently validate data. 
 - Use Git confidently, including branches, merges, conflict resolution and clean commits. 
 - Write automated tests for important logic and manually test complete user journeys across desktop, tablet and mobile. 
 - Verify user-facing details, including forms, buttons, labels, calculations and workflows. 
 - Provide concise change notes, test evidence and simple instructions for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Build and validate changes in an approved sandbox environment. Do not deploy to live systems; releases remain under the owner's control. 

Required Skills And Experience

- At least 2 years of experience building and maintaining real-world web applications. 
 - Strong TypeScript/JavaScript and React skills; Next. js experience is an advantage. 
 - Solid SQL knowledge, including schema understanding, queries, migrations and data validation. 
 - Confident use of Git, including branches, merges, conflict resolution and clean commits. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding agents as a core development tool, with the ability to assess and verify their output. 
 - Strong testing habits, including automated tests for logic and hands-on checks across desktop, tablet and phone screen sizes. 
 - Clear written English, including concise change notes and instructions for non-technical users. 
 - Strong ownership, product judgement, attention to detail and transparent communication. 

Good to Have

- Experience creating prompts, rules or workflows that make AI agents more reliable for a team. 
 - Experience with billing, payments, bookings or other systems where incorrect calculations can have financial consequences. 
 - Familiarity with cloud hosting and managed databases such as Vercel, Supabase or similar services. 
 - Proficiency in Hindi or Gujarati. 

How You Will Work

- Work directly with the owner through short feedback cycles: idea → working version → feedback → completion. 
 - Develop and test changes in an approved sandbox environment. 
 - Collaborate with a dedicated Software Tester who validates changes before release. 
 - Communicate progress, limitations, test results and risks clearly, without overstating completion. 

How Success Will Be Measured

- Changes are accepted on the first review wherever requirements and scope are clear. 
 - No work is left half-finished or delivered with known, unreported breakages. 
 - Useful software is delivered consistently each week without compromising correctness, security or maintainability. 
 - AI-generated code is reviewed and verified, with appropriate tests and clear change notes accompanying each change. 

Selection Process

- 20-minute introductory call: Discuss what you have built and how you use AI coding tools in your day-to-day work. 
 - Short paid practical task: Fix real issues in a test copy using your preferred AI tools, add relevant tests and write a change note. 
 - Review discussion: Walk through your solution, demonstrate where the AI made mistakes and explain how you identified and corrected them. 

We value developers who build quickly, think critically, test thoroughly and take ownership of the final result. 

Skills: code, agents, typescript

data.title: Builder Developer II
data.description:
Job Description

The Builder-2 (Dev) Profile

You are a full-stack agent engineer. You can take a complex business requirement and build the multi-step AI workflow that solves it, end to end, without someone breaking it down for you first. 

- Core DNA
 - AI-Native Workflow. You use AI to accelerate development, testing and documentation as a default, not an experiment. You have opinions about which tools earn their place. 
 - Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic. 
 - Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else's problem. 
 - Evidence Over Confidence. You don't ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases - and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn't one. 
 - What You Own

Your agent. Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down. 

The evidence it works. Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does - characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs. 

Your blast radius. You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry. 

- Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)
 - The Agentic Architect (Systems) - you don't just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes. 
 - The UX/Interaction Builder (Product) - the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done. 
 - The Data & Context Engineer (Data) - master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry. 
 - The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA) - you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic. 
 - The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps) - you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI. 
 - The Domain Logic Translator (Business) - you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints. 

What You'll Actually Do

- Build execution agents. Move beyond RAG into action - agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix. 
 - Automate the untestable. Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided. 
 - Prove parity. Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches - on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones. 
 - Prompt engineering and evals. Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions. 
 - Rapid prototyping. Turn a "what if" into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months. 
 - Fix your own agents in production. Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again. 

What Good Looks Like

(Illustrative - real targets agreed with the hiring manager. )

- 30 days: Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small. 
 - 90 days: Owning a legacy module end to end - parity evidence, tests, deployment - with minimal supervision. 
 - 6 months: Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You're the person people ask about one thing in particular. 

The Stack

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. 

Who You Are

- You've shipped one. You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work - not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did. 
 - The early adopter. You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn. 
 - Agent-first thinker. You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions. 
 - The manual-task hater. You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you've already started drafting the automation. 
 - Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn't complexity, it's a puzzle about to get solved. You aren't intimidated by spaghetti code - you're the one who brings the sauce. 
 - Rigor over hype. You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data. 

Why Join Us

- The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you've mastered the hardest problem in software. 
 - Agentic autonomy. We don't do tickets. We do missions. You'll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win. 
 - No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee - a "Does It Work?" policy. 
 - The Builder Tribe. You won't be the only AI person in the room. You'll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Software Engineer based in India. 

Lead the development of innovative software products and AI-powered solutions that transform business operations and deliver exceptional digital experiences. In this role, you will define technical direction, guide architecture decisions, and lead projects from early discovery through production delivery. You will help establish an AI-native engineering culture, leveraging advanced coding tools, intelligent agents, and scalable cloud technologies. Working closely with senior engineering and product leaders, you will translate complex business challenges into practical, high-impact solutions. You will also mentor engineers, strengthen development standards, and ensure that technical decisions balance quality, cost, risk, and speed. This opportunity is suited to a hands-on technical leader who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is passionate about turning ambitious AI strategies into reliable products. 

Accountabilities

As Lead Software Engineer, you will own technical execution for a team or product while helping shape the broader engineering strategy. You will combine architectural leadership, hands-on development, cross-functional collaboration, and team mentorship to deliver measurable business outcomes. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Lead AI Initiatives End to End: Define and maintain the architecture roadmap for your team or product, transforming ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans and production-ready software. 
 - Shape AI Architecture: Partner with senior engineering leaders to develop and implement approaches involving AWS Bedrock, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic architectures, evaluation pipelines, and production safeguards. 
 - Establish AI-Native Development Practices: Design and implement agentic coding workflows using tools such as Claude Code, including reusable skills, engineering standards, and review processes that ensure AI-generated code meets production requirements.

The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong technical judgment, a track record of delivering products end to end, and the leadership skills to guide teams through complex engineering challenges. We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go - staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation. As an iOS engineer at WhatsApp you will use your ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set technical direction across multiple teams, own the architecture for a major area of the product, and shape what WhatsApp Services becomes in India.

 - Prepare and manage test data to support a wide range of business and system scenarios. 
 - Record, triage and manage defects with clear supporting evidence, including reproduction steps, expected results and actual results. 
 - Support continuous integration and release readiness activities by ensuring automated and manual test coverage is aligned with delivery priorities.

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Core Competencies

- Understanding of the core technology stack and application architecture supporting the UAMC platform. 
 - Strong test automation capability within a fast-paced, cross-functional Agile delivery environment. 
 - Experience designing, maintaining and executing automated test scripts and frameworks. 
 - Ability to perform functional, regression and exploratory testing where manual validation is required. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving and investigative skills. 
 - Degree in an IT-related discipline or equivalent practical experience. 

Technical Skills And Tools

- Testing of web applications, APIs and back-end services.

Preferred Experience

data.title: Senior QA Test Engineer GCC
data.description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI. 

AI doesn't work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can't access or use their operational data. We solve that gap. 

We're a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world's largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production. 

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing. 

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you'll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments. 

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You'll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints - where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable. 

Have real impact, fast

You'll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You'll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale. 

Join a high-performance team

We're building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You'll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers. 

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that's in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other. 

We're a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you'll do well here. 

About The Role

We are hiring Senior QA Automation Engineers to test our data cataloging and real-time data platform products. You will build reliable automation with Playwright, turn business and technical requirements into test cases, and work with developers and product owners to improve product quality. 

We have openings in two areas: application and API automation for our data cataloging product, and end-to-end data validation for our real-time data platform. Your experience will help us identify the best fit. Both openings are hands-on automation roles. 

What You Will Do

- Develop and maintain automated UI tests with Playwright, using TypeScript or JavaScript, and build supporting test scripts and tools in Python where appropriate. 
 - Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear test cases and automated coverage. 
 - Investigate test failures, work with developers to identify root causes, and improve test coverage and automation efficiency. 
 - Use Linux, Git and AI tools as part of your testing and automation work. 

Depending on your product assignment, you will also: 

- Automate API tests, build and troubleshoot Docker test environments, and set up and maintain CI pipelines for application testing. 
 - Test data flows from source systems to downstream destinations, checking completeness, correctness and consistency, and build scripts to generate test data and validate results at scale. 

What You Will Bring

- QA experience with a strong focus on hands-on test automation. 
 - Practical experience building and maintaining automated tests with Playwright. 
 - Automation coding skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills for the application automation opening. 
 - Confidence working in the Linux command line, using Git, and turning requirements into effective test cases. 
 - Experience using AI tools to support testing and test automation. 

Additional Requirements By Opening

- Application and API automation: API testing experience; hands-on Docker skills, including building images, running containers and debugging; and experience with CI/CD practices and setting up pipelines in Jenkins, Git-based tooling or similar. 
 - Real-time data testing: 3-6 years of QA experience, including hands-on validation of data from source to destination; working knowledge of SQL and JSON; and the ability to automate data checks using Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. Docker and Kubernetes can be learned on the job. 

Nice to have

- Experience with data processing or cataloging products, industrial or IoT data, or MQTT, Kafka and other pub/sub messaging systems. 
 - Kubernetes, performance or load testing, and CI pipeline setup experience for the real-time data opening.

data.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer(Test Automation Engineer (Salesforce Using Cypress)
data.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One - our cloud-first, AI-powered platform - CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve. 

We're at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences. 

Our Enterprise Platform team aspires to be a leader by applying technology to power business strategies. We connect concepts with solutions to create value and efficiencies for our employees and customers. Our success is driven by our skilled and diverse team who are passionate about excellence, innovation, and agility. 

As the Senior Salesforce Test Automation Engineer, you will lead the expansion of automated quality engineering across our Salesforce ecosystem, with primary ownership for establishing Cypress. io as a scalable, maintainable, and trusted enterprise test automation capability. You will combine hands-on automation engineering with technical leadership, partnering with developers, administrators, product owners, business analysts, release engineering, and quality engineers to improve release confidence, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a Cypress. io automation framework for Salesforce applications, Experience Cloud, integrated web applications, and critical end-to-end business processes. 
 - Define automation architecture, coding standards, repository structure, reusable commands, fixtures, test-data patterns, environment configuration, tagging, and reporting conventions that support maintainability and scale. 
 - Develop and maintain reliable automated suites for smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, API, and selected component-testing scenarios, balancing UI coverage with faster API-based setup and validation where appropriate. 
 - Create a pragmatic automation roadmap that prioritizes high-risk, high-volume, and business-critical Salesforce journeys and converts the existing regression inventory into a sustainable Cypress test portfolio. 
 - Design resilient approaches for Salesforce-specific automation challenges, including dynamic Lightning DOM behavior, asynchronous processing, authentication, role-based access, complex data dependencies, integrations, and multi-environment execution. 
 - Integrate Cypress execution into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows, including pull-request validation, scheduled regression runs, pre-release quality gates, test result publishing, screenshots, videos, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish test observability and quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rate, execution time, flaky-test rate, defect escape trends, failure causes, and manual effort avoided; use insights to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Build secure, repeatable test-data and credential-management practices across Salesforce sandboxes and connected systems, partnering with platform, security, and DevOps teams to protect sensitive information. 
 - Perform hands-on exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and release-readiness testing when automation is not yet available or when human judgment provides better coverage. 
 - Partner with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and administrators to make requirements testable and to strengthen acceptance criteria, negative scenarios, risk analysis, and definition-of-done standards. 
 - Troubleshoot failed tests and application defects, distinguish product issues from automation issues, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution. 
 - Review automation code, mentor quality engineers and developers, provide technical guidance, and promote engineering practices that treat automated tests as production-quality software. 
 - Evaluate Cypress. io capabilities, plugins, Cypress Cloud features, and AI-assisted test authoring; recommend adoption based on security, maintainability, cost, measurable value, and enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to QA governance, release management, Agile ceremonies, test planning, risk reviews, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, including 3+ years testing Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience building and maintaining Cypress. io automation using JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong understanding of selectors, custom commands, fixtures, network interception, retries, asynchronous behavior, and test isolation. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing an automation framework or materially scaling an existing framework across teams, applications, or release trains. 
 - Strong Salesforce testing experience across Lightning Experience and one or more of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ/commerce, custom Apex and Lightning Web Components, integrations, or platform automation. 
 - Experience with API testing, including REST and GraphQL patterns, authentication, request/response validation, data setup, and combining API and UI tests. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket and pipeline technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with test management, defect lifecycle, and work-management tools such as Jira, Xray, Confluence, or equivalent. 
 - Experience developing quality strategies, risk-based test plans, automation backlogs, traceability, release-readiness assessments, and meaningful quality reporting in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Experience diagnosing flaky tests, improving suite performance, handling parallel execution, and maintaining reliable automation across multiple environments and data states. 

Skills: 

- Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate failures across the UI, Salesforce platform, APIs, integrations, test data, and automation framework. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, version control, code review, debugging, documentation, and maintainable test-code practices. 
 - Ability to translate business processes and technical architecture into clear, risk-based automated test coverage. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through influence, mentorship, collaboration, and ownership of cross-team outcomes. 
 - Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance immediate release needs with long-term automation health. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or relevant Salesforce Consultant certification. 
 - Cypress certification, recognized test automation certification, or equivalent evidence of deep Cypress expertise. 
 - Experience with Cypress Cloud capabilities such as recorded runs, test replay, analytics, flaky-test insights, parallelization, and enterprise reporting. 
 - Experience with Okta or SSO-enabled test authentication and secure automated credential management. 
 - Familiarity with accessibility testing, performance testing, AI-assisted test generation, and complementary tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Selenium, Playwright, or Jest. 
 - Experience modernizing or migrating an automation portfolio from a commercial or legacy testing platform to Cypress. io. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- Cypress. io is established as a governed, secure, and reusable automation capability for Salesforce delivery. 
 - Critical business journeys have reliable automated coverage and provide fast, actionable feedback before releases. 
 - CI/CD pipelines consistently execute the right tests at the right stage, with clear evidence for failures and release decisions. 
 - Flaky tests, duplicated effort, and manual regression time decline as framework quality, test data, and team adoption improve. 
 - Developers and quality engineers contribute to a shared automation codebase using consistent standards and effective code reviews. 
 - Quality metrics clearly communicate risk, progress, and business value to engineering and leadership stakeholders. 

Why Join Us?

- Shape the test automation strategy for a business-critical Salesforce platform and influence quality engineering practices across teams. 
 - Lead a high-visibility Cypress. io implementation with opportunities to modernize delivery, improve engineering velocity, and reduce release risk. 
 - Work with a collaborative, forward-thinking team investing in Salesforce, AI-enabled engineering, and enterprise platform transformation. 
 - Access ongoing professional development, technical learning, and Salesforce certification opportunities. 
 - Competitive compensation and benefits. 

Location: 

- Remote - India

As the Senior Salesforce Test Automation Engineer, you will lead the expansion of automated quality engineering across our Salesforce ecosystem, with primary ownership for establishing Cypress. io as a scalable, maintainable, and trusted enterprise test automation capability. You will combine hands-on automation engineering with technical leadership, partnering with developers, administrators, product owners, business analysts, release engineering, and quality engineers to improve release confidence, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a Cypress. io automation framework for Salesforce applications, Experience Cloud, integrated web applications, and critical end-to-end business processes. 
 - Define automation architecture, coding standards, repository structure, reusable commands, fixtures, test-data patterns, environment configuration, tagging, and reporting conventions that support maintainability and scale. 
 - Develop and maintain reliable automated suites for smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, API, and selected component-testing scenarios, balancing UI coverage with faster API-based setup and validation where appropriate. 
 - Create a pragmatic automation roadmap that prioritizes high-risk, high-volume, and business-critical Salesforce journeys and converts the existing regression inventory into a sustainable Cypress test portfolio. 
 - Design resilient approaches for Salesforce-specific automation challenges, including dynamic Lightning DOM behavior, asynchronous processing, authentication, role-based access, complex data dependencies, integrations, and multi-environment execution. 
 - Integrate Cypress execution into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows, including pull-request validation, scheduled regression runs, pre-release quality gates, test result publishing, screenshots, videos, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish test observability and quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rate, execution time, flaky-test rate, defect escape trends, failure causes, and manual effort avoided; use insights to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Build secure, repeatable test-data and credential-management practices across Salesforce sandboxes and connected systems, partnering with platform, security, and DevOps teams to protect sensitive information. 
 - Perform hands-on exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and release-readiness testing when automation is not yet available or when human judgment provides better coverage. 
 - Partner with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and administrators to make requirements testable and to strengthen acceptance criteria, negative scenarios, risk analysis, and definition-of-done standards. 
 - Troubleshoot failed tests and application defects, distinguish product issues from automation issues, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution. 
 - Review automation code, mentor quality engineers and developers, provide technical guidance, and promote engineering practices that treat automated tests as production-quality software. 
 - Evaluate Cypress. io capabilities, plugins, Cypress Cloud features, and AI-assisted test authoring; recommend adoption based on security, maintainability, cost, measurable value, and enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to QA governance, release management, Agile ceremonies, test planning, risk reviews, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, including 3+ years testing Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience building and maintaining Cypress. io automation using JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong understanding of selectors, custom commands, fixtures, network interception, retries, asynchronous behavior, and test isolation. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing an automation framework or materially scaling an existing framework across teams, applications, or release trains. 
 - Strong Salesforce testing experience across Lightning Experience and one or more of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ/commerce, custom Apex and Lightning Web Components, integrations, or platform automation. 
 - Experience with API testing, including REST and GraphQL patterns, authentication, request/response validation, data setup, and combining API and UI tests. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket and pipeline technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with test management, defect lifecycle, and work-management tools such as Jira, Xray, Confluence, or equivalent. 
 - Experience developing quality strategies, risk-based test plans, automation backlogs, traceability, release-readiness assessments, and meaningful quality reporting in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Experience diagnosing flaky tests, improving suite performance, handling parallel execution, and maintaining reliable automation across multiple environments and data states. 

Skills: 

- Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate failures across the UI, Salesforce platform, APIs, integrations, test data, and automation framework. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, version control, code review, debugging, documentation, and maintainable test-code practices. 
 - Ability to translate business processes and technical architecture into clear, risk-based automated test coverage. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through influence, mentorship, collaboration, and ownership of cross-team outcomes. 
 - Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance immediate release needs with long-term automation health. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or relevant Salesforce Consultant certification. 
 - Cypress certification, recognized test automation certification, or equivalent evidence of deep Cypress expertise. 
 - Experience with Cypress Cloud capabilities such as recorded runs, test replay, analytics, flaky-test insights, parallelization, and enterprise reporting. 
 - Experience with Okta or SSO-enabled test authentication and secure automated credential management. 
 - Familiarity with accessibility testing, performance testing, AI-assisted test generation, and complementary tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Selenium, Playwright, or Jest. 
 - Experience modernizing or migrating an automation portfolio from a commercial or legacy testing platform to Cypress. io. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- Cypress. io is established as a governed, secure, and reusable automation capability for Salesforce delivery. 
 - Critical business journeys have reliable automated coverage and provide fast, actionable feedback before releases. 
 - CI/CD pipelines consistently execute the right tests at the right stage, with clear evidence for failures and release decisions. 
 - Flaky tests, duplicated effort, and manual regression time decline as framework quality, test data, and team adoption improve. 
 - Developers and quality engineers contribute to a shared automation codebase using consistent standards and effective code reviews. 
 - Quality metrics clearly communicate risk, progress, and business value to engineering and leadership stakeholders. 

Why Join Us?

- Shape the test automation strategy for a business-critical Salesforce platform and influence quality engineering practices across teams. 
 - Lead a high-visibility Cypress. io implementation with opportunities to modernize delivery, improve engineering velocity, and reduce release risk. 
 - Work with a collaborative, forward-thinking team investing in Salesforce, AI-enabled engineering, and enterprise platform transformation.

About Turing:

Role Overview: 

- We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative. 
 - In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5-10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks. 

What you'll do: 

- Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks. 
 - Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests. 
 - Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems. 
 - Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning. 
 - Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability. 
 - Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results. 
 - Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues. 
 - Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior. 
 - Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations. 
 - Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval. 
 - Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices. 

What we're looking for: 

- Ph. D. , postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design. 
 - Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs. 
 - Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results. 
 - Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions. 
 - Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams. 
 - Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards. 

Nice to have: 

- Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm. 
 - Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest. 
 - Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems. 
 - Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions. 
 - Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions. 
 - Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems. 
 - Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs. 

Offer Details: 

- Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. 
 - Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 - Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

data.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end

About This Role

- The Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end will help build Prudential Japan's next generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation initiative. 
 - This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams. 
 - As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan. What you could work on We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Customer servicing, portals used by our employees as well as customers to view policy information and execute certain business workflows. Sales Enablement, portal used by our sales team to manage leads and maintain regulatory records. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build customer-facing journeys, and the internal tools staff use when a customer cannot complete one alone. 
 - Model identity, consent and authority as first-class concepts, including the cases where one person acts on anotherʼs behalf. 
 - Work directly with the staff who handle these requests today, watching real cases rather than reading summarised tickets. 
 - Design for users of every age and confidence level, treating accessibility as a design constraint rather than an audit term. 
 - Instrument journeys so drop-off, error and abandonment are visible, then act on what they show. 
 - Share the APIs your journeys need together with their backend owners, rather than accepting whatever exists. 
 - Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives. 
 - Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to replace and what to leave alone. 
 - Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design, development, testing, business engagement and team leadership. 
 - Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for someone to blame. 

Qualifications

General

- You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain. 
 - Five or more years in product engineering with genuine front-end depth, TypeScript and a modern framework. 
 - Demonstrated accessibility practice, with examples of what you changed and why. 
 - Experience in designing workflow and state and not only screens. 
 - User research or direct observation as a normal part of how you work. 
 - Advantageous: contact center or telephone integration, identity, consent or KYC workflows, and designing for older or less confident users. 
 - Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience. 

Technical

- We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them. 
 - AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills is an advantage. 
 - Frontend: TypeScript with React, and a framework such as Next. js. Strong CSS and layout skills
 - Testing: component and end-to-end testing as a habit. Playwright, Vitest or Jest and accessibility checks in the pipeline. 
 - Design systems: consuming one, contributing to one, and knowing when to break it. 
 - Backend for frontend: API gateway with lambda or a small service, enough to own the layer your journeys depend on. 
 - AWS ecosystem
 - Nice to have: analytics and session instrumentation (such as Amplitude), design tooling fluency (such as Figma), and telephony and contact centre integration such as Genesys telephony or Amazon Connect. 

Language

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage. 

Culture and Leadership Expectations

- Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business domains Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
 - Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
 - Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity

data.title: Scientific QA
data.description:
Position: Scientific QA

Location: Pune

Position Summary

ACS International India is looking for a Scientific QA Associate who combines strong scientific aptitude with an interest in technology, data quality, and automation. This role sits at the intersection of Chemistry, Scientific Content, Data Quality, and Software Testing, supporting the accuracy, integrity, and quality of scientific information and technology platforms used by researchers worldwide. 

The successful candidate will leverage their chemistry expertise to review scientific literature, validate chemical information, identify data inconsistencies, perform quality assurance activities, and progressively develop capabilities in QA automation and scientific technology solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Content & Data Quality

- 
 - Review published scientific literature and validate scientific information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency. 
 - Analyze chemical structures, reactions, nomenclature, and associated metadata. 
 - Identify and resolve ambiguities in scientific content using established scientific policies and standards. 
 - Validate data extracted from scientific publications and databases. 
 - Conduct quality checks on curated scientific content and datasets. 
 - Investigate discrepancies and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance scientific data quality. 
Scientific QA & Testing

- 
 - Execute manual testing of scientific applications, workflows, and data pipelines. 
 - Validate business rules, chemical data transformations, search results, and system outputs. 
 - Develop test scenarios, test cases, and validation procedures. 
 - Perform regression, functional, and data validation testing. 
 - Document defects clearly and collaborate with development teams to resolve issues. 
 - Support user acceptance testing and production validation activities. 
Automation & Technology

- 
 - Learn and apply QA automation concepts, frameworks, and best practices. 
 - Assist in developing and maintaining automated test scripts. 
 - Work with tools such as Python, Playwright, Selenium, or similar technologies. 
 - Participate in process automation initiatives that improve quality and productivity. 
 - Leverage technology and data analysis tools to identify trends and quality risks. 
Collaboration & Learning

- 
 - Work closely with Information Scientists, Scientific QA specialists, Software Engineers, and Product teams. 
 - Share insights, findings, and best practices with team members. 
 - Demonstrate continuous learning of chemistry, scientific information workflows, and QA technologies. 
 - Contribute to knowledge management and process documentation. 
Required

Educational Qualifications

- 
 - M. Sc. in Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, or related Chemistry discipline
Preferred

- 
 - M. Pharma (Pharmaceutical Chemistry / Pharmaceutics)
 - M. Phil. or Ph. D. in Chemistry or related scientific discipline
Experience

- 
 - 0-2 years of experience in scientific content, chemistry, cheminformatics, data curation, scientific publishing, quality assurance, or related areas. 
 - Fresh graduates with strong academic credentials and a demonstrated interest in scientific data, quality, and technology are encouraged to apply. 
Required Knowledge & Skills

Scientific Competencies

- 
 - Strong understanding of Organic Chemistry fundamentals. 
 - Ability to interpret chemical structures, reactions, and scientific publications. 
 - Excellent scientific reading comprehension and analytical skills. 
 - Attention to detail in identifying inconsistencies and quality issues. 
 - Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking capability. 
Quality & Analytical Competencies

- 
 - Ability to evaluate information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. 
 - Strong investigative mindset and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Ability to apply scientific policies, standards, and validation rules. 
Technology Competencies

- 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel. 
 - Comfort working with databases, scientific tools, and digital platforms. 
 - Understanding of data validation and quality processes. 
Professional Competencies

- 
 - Learning agility and curiosity. 
 - Effective communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively. 
 - Strong organizational and time-management skills. 
 - Adaptability to new technologies and evolving business requirements. 
Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with exposure to any of the following will have an advantage: 

- 
 - Python programming
 - Java programming
 - SQL or database querying
 - Scientific data curation
 - Cheminformatics tools (RDKit, KNIME, etc. )
 - Quality Assurance methodologies
 - Test case design and defect management
 - Automation testing tools such as: 
 - Playwright
 - Selenium
 - Cypress
 - Data analytics and visualization tools

data.title: Calypso Functional Quality Analyst (QA)
data.description:
An opportunity is available for a Senior Quality Analyst to join our client, a leading Australian financial institution, as a key contributor to the Test analysis, design, and Test Execution of their OTC derivative clearing platform. You will be part of functional quality assurance team of the Calypso platform, with focus on end-to-end testing of IRD, Fixed Income asset classed including trade lifecycle validation, settlements, EOD Batch across functional, regression and release testing, in close partnership with BA, development, platform and operations teams. 

Responsibilities: 

- Design, execute and maintain functional, regression and UAT test cases for Calypso. 
 - Validate end-to-end trade lifecycle for Interest Rate, Fixed Income products covering Trade capture, lifecycle events, novations, terminations and clearing flows. 
 - Automated trade booking, Re-booking to validate trade workflows, including trade migration and data integrity checks. 
 - Validate static data, market data inputs, pricing and valuation impacts. 
 - Test EOD and scheduled-task processing; verify outputs, reports and extracts. 
 - Reconcile trades, positions and reports between Calypso and upstream/downstream systems. 
 - Raise clear, evidence-based defects and drive triage through to closure. 
 - Build and run automated regression packs using CATT where applicable. 
 - Support test planning, change-request coverage, test summary reports and release sign-off. 
 - Work with platform engineering on testing calypso cloud migration. 

Mandatory Skills Description: 

- 5 to 10 years overall QA/testing experience in capital markets with 2 to 3 years' experience on Calypso
 - Strong hands-on functional /configuration knowledge of the Calypso platform. 
 - Hands-on testing experience in Swaps (IRS/OIS/CCS), Bond, Repo products. 
 - Proven ability to understand, validate and test end-to-end trade lifecycle within Calypso. 
 - Good knowledge on various calypso objects like Workflows, Filters, Report Templates and Task Station
 - Test market data setup including curves, quotes, feeds and validate their impact on pricing, P&L, and reports. 
 - Experienced in testing schedule tasks, batch execution from scheduling tools like Control-M
 - Hands on with trade, position and cash / security reconciliation between Calypso and downstream/related systems. 
 - Solid test design, execution and defect management in release-driven cycles. 
 - Ability to analyse test failures and reconciliation breaks to root cause. 

Nice-to-Have Skills Description: 

- Exposure to CATT (Calypso Automated Testing Tool). 
 - Experience with AWS Cloud, Database migration and Calypso version upgrades
 - OTC clearing / CCP domain knowledge. 
 - Linux/Unix skills for logs, files, processes, and job troubleshooting. 
 - Jenkins experience for CI/CD, regression, and batch job execution/monitoring. 
 - Market data knowledge covering curves, FX, bonds, credit spreads, and feeds. 
 - Domain knowledge of Fixed Income, Derivatives, Backoffice, pricing, P&L, CSA/collateral, and trade reconciliation. 
 - Experience with regression comparison tools, CSV/file-diff utilities, or Calypso QA automation. 
 - Exposure to related platforms/interfaces such as MarkitWire, Bloomberg

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Corporate Technology (Finance) team, you will report to the Lead, Platform Engineer (Oracle Financials, Chart of Accounts) and will be the application lead managing Power Apps, Python automation tools, and financial models, with responsibility for production support, issue resolution, and enhancement delivery in support of our customers! In addition to applied experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do. 

What You Can Expect

- Build applications ensuring that the code follows latest coding practices and industry standards, using modern design patterns and architectural principles; actively code against the roadmap
 - Develop high-quality, well-documented and efficient code adhering to all applicable Prudential standards
 - Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
 - Write unit, integration tests and functional automation, researching problems discovered by quality assurance or product support, developing solutions to address the problems
 - Bring an applied understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others, and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
 - Work on complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors
 - Use programming languages including but not limited to AWS, Python, Database, Java, or JavaScript and React, Springboot, and Node. js frameworks

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or experience in related fields
 - 5-7 years of experience in managing Power Apps, Python automation tools, and financial models
 - Demonstrated knowledge of agentic AI concepts and frameworks, with the ability to design, guide, and implement AI-driven solutions that leverage autonomous agents to enhance business and technology outcomes. 
 - Financial knowledge / experience
 - Ability to leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts and perspectives to the benefit of the organization
 - Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
 - Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
 - Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
 - Applied experience with several of the following: 
 - Programming Languages: Python, Java or Java Script; working in distributed systems, object-oriented programming, design patterns and design methodology; JAVA services using Spring CLI, Maven, Microservice, multi-threading, Concurrency and parallel processing
 - Frameworks: React, Springboot, Node. js, such as Full / MEAN / MERN stack
 - Data Store: NoSQL or Relational Data structures; MongoDB BPM tools
 - Data Streaming: SQS, Kinesis
 - Application Programming Interfaces (API): Consumption & Development; implementing service-oriented architecture (SOA) patterns; Web service technologies such as APIs, REST, JSON, SOAP, XML, JDBC, MySQL
 - Unit, interface and end user testing concepts and tooling (functional & non-functional)
 - Automated testing
 - Accessibility awareness
 - Software security skills including secure coding, web application security and DevSecOps; Solid grasp of security concepts (authentication, authorization, encryption, digital signature, JWT), SSL, web service proxies, firewall, SAML 2. 0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2. 0)
 - DevOps Tools & Practices: Branching techniques and usage of GitHub, Bitbucket or Subversion; DevOps, Jenkins
 - Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Monitoring and logging techniques
 - AWS Core Services: AWS Services such as CloudWatch, Code-Deploy

What will set you apart?

- AWS Development
 - Architecture Patterns
 - Design Thinking
 - Financial/Insurance industry knowledge is a plus
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, serves as a trusted partner within the First Line Information Technology Operational Risk (ITOR) group and is accountable for issue validation testing, risk and controls advisory, governance, and reporting across Global Technology and Operations (GTO). The role leads multiple concurrent validation and control reviews to assess whether remediation addresses root causes, controls are designed and operating effectively, and risk outcomes are sustainable. The individual partners with business and technology leaders identify emerging risks, shape risk strategies and remediation priorities, and strengthen risk and control inventories. The role assists with risk and control governance forums, develops meaningful metrics and executive reporting, communicates risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalates matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. The role also coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities, supports the Privacy team as needed, and provides leadership, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure work is completed in accordance with department and industry standards. 

What You Can Expect

The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, leads the planning and execution of issue validation and control testing to confirm remediation addresses root causes and delivers sustainable outcomes. The role, as a risk advisor, partners with business and technology leaders to identify and assess emerging risks, shape risk strategies, clarify risk acceptance decisions, and align remediation priorities with enterprise standards and business objectives. The role strengthens the control environment by advising on control design, evaluating design and operating effectiveness, maintaining accurate risk and control inventories, identifying thematic gaps and trends, and driving clear ownership, monitoring, and timely remediation. The role also supports effective governance by facilitating risk and control forums, establishing meaningful metrics and reporting, communicating risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalating matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. It coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities across Global Technology and Operations, and supports the Privacy team with privacy-related risk assessments, incident response, data mapping, and privacy-by-design activities. 

- Lead issue validation and testing engagements to confirm that root causes are addressed and remediation is sustainable. 
 - Plan and schedule validation reviews for open issues, prioritizing work based on risk, target closure dates, and validation readiness. 
 - Coordinate validation activities with issue owners, control design functions, First Line management, and Audit to confirm scope, evidence requirements, dependencies, and review timelines. 
 - Assess remediation evidence and control implementation to determine whether corrective actions address root causes and operate as intended. 
 - Track validation progress, resolve evidence gaps, and escalate delays or risks that could affect timely issue closure. 
 - Partner with business and technology leaders to assess technology, cyber, data, resilience, and third-party risks; shape risk strategies; and align risk acceptance and remediation decisions with enterprise standards and business objectives. 
 - Lead risk assessments, maintain accurate process, risk, control, and issue inventories, and analyze trends and control gaps to strengthen control design, monitoring, remediation, governance, and reporting. 
 - Coordinate responses to risk events and emerging issues with business, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and control partners; provide executive reporting and escalation; facilitate root-cause and after-action reviews; and track corrective actions through sustainable resolution. 
 - Remain current on industry developments in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, information security, third-party risk management, and resilience. 
 - Lead and execute engagements that meet the department's methodologies and quality standards. 
 - Invest in professional development, educate others on key risks and controls, and support staff development, recruiting, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Leverage data analytics and develop review programs to support risk assessments, review design, and testing of key GTO risks. 
 - Guide the team on continuous monitoring, year-over-year review coverage, aggregation of key issues for senior leadership, and stakeholder governance meetings. 
 - Support the Privacy team, as needed, with incident response and escalation, awareness activities, Privacy Impact Assessments, data mapping, and privacy-by-design engagement with Technology Product Owners. 
 - Lead and support regulatory gap assessments and responses, SOC/SOX activities, and client assessments in partnership with Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders. 

What You Will Bring

- 8+ years of relevant experience gained through a combination of information security/technology, risk and/or audit related roles, including leading complex engagements and managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Specifically, experience in cloud operations, cyber security operations, vulnerability management or other IT operation-based specialist roles. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in the intricacies associated with a global company and its information technology/cyber security risk profile, including expanding regulatory requirements
 - Strong knowledge of emerging topics and current analytical methods and techniques used to monitor and manage relevant risks. 
 - Track record of supervising, coaching, and developing talent; experience with work planning, staffing, and reviewing team deliverables for quality and consistency. Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience communicating complex topics to senior management and driving alignment on issues, ownership, and remediation. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to leverage data, metrics, and analytics to inform scoping, testing strategy, and thematic insights. 
 - Executive level communication skills, both oral and written, and the ability to partner effectively with multiple business groups, corporate areas, and second and third lines teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree related to technology, risk management, finance, or other quantitative fields of study

What will set you apart?

- Experience in leveraging and/or performing data analysis in support of internal auditing. 
 - Advanced degrees in information technology or cyber security are preferred: An MBA, CIA, CISA, CISSP and/or designations/certifications (e. g. , AI, AWS Cloud Practitioner) that demonstrate proficiency in information technology, information security, and/or cyber security related risks and controls is a plus. 
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Siemens PLC Developer
data.description:
Company Description LoyaltyTown by ADIION is an AI-powered Connected Manufacturing Platform that gives every physical product a secure digital identity, extending visibility beyond the factory gate. With a single QR or NFC scan, the platform enables product authentication, anti-counterfeit protection, supply chain traceability, digital warranty, and customer registration. It also powers channel loyalty programs, incentives, and advanced customer analytics to help brands understand who bought their products, where they were sold, and what customers may purchase next. Offered as a white-label B2B SaaS solution and built specifically for Bharat-based manufacturers, LoyaltyTown supports brands in gaining deeper market insights and stronger customer relationships. 
Role Description The Siemens PLC Developer will design, program, test, and commission Siemens PLC-based automation solutions for manufacturing clients using the LoyaltyTown platform. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing PLC logic, configuring communication interfaces, integrating PLC systems with IoT devices and backend services, and troubleshooting control systems on the shop floor. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, optimize production processes, ensure system reliability, and create technical documentation and support materials. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, requiring close interaction with engineering, operations, and client stakeholders. 
Qualifications

- Strong knowledge of Siemens PLC platforms (e. g. , SIMATIC S7, TIA Portal) and experience in PLC programming, testing, and commissioning. 
 - Skills in industrial automation and control systems, including sensors, actuators, HMI/SCADA integration, and fieldbus/industrial communication protocols. 
 - Ability to integrate PLCs with IoT devices, cloud platforms, and databases, including basic understanding of networking, APIs, and data exchange. 
 - Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical and control schematics, P&IDs, and technical specifications. 
 - Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills in live production environments, with a focus on safety and uptime. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with manufacturing, operations, and software teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related engineering field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience in manufacturing or process industries and familiarity with traceability, quality, or MES systems is an advantage. 
 - Willingness to work on-site in Chennai and occasionally visit customer facilities as needed.
