data.description:
This role has been designed as ''Onsite' with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

In the HPE Hybrid Cloud, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what's next for you. 

This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in Linux, hypervisor technologies, automation/scripting, and cloud platforms who wants to grow into private-cloud and clustered-infrastructure specialization. We are looking for a candidate with 7-8 years of experience to work on HPE VM Essentials (VME) clusters and the HPE CloudOps Suite. 

Experience Level ( Specialist and trainable candidates)

7-8 years of hands-on experience in Linux systems, virtualization/hypervisors, automation, and/or cloud platform operations. 

What You'll Do

Role Summary

We are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer with 3-4 years of experience to help design, build, automate, and continuously improve our HPE VM Essentials (VME) private cloud platform and HPE CloudOps Suite environment. This is an engineering-focused role - you'll spend your time building automation, hardening infrastructure, improving platform reliability, and engineering solutions to recurring problems. 

What You Need To Bring

Key Responsibilities

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Build and maintain automation for VM lifecycle management, provisioning workflows, patching, and configuration using Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent IaC tooling. 
 - Develop scripts and tools (Python/Bash) to automate health checks, capacity reporting, drift detection, and routine operational tasks. 
 - Own and improve CI/CD-style pipelines for infrastructure changes (version-controlled playbooks/templates, peer-reviewed changes, staged rollouts). 
 - Build self-healing automation and proactive alerting to reduce manual intervention

Linux Systems Administration

- Administer and troubleshoot RHEL/Ubuntu (or similar) Linux servers - services, storage, networking, and log analysis. 
 - Analyze system and kernel logs to support incident diagnosis (storage errors, service failures, resource exhaustion). 

Cloud Platform & CloudOps Suite Engineering

- Support integration tasks between orchestration tooling and underlying infrastructure. 

Documentation & Knowledge Engineering

- Write and maintain infrastructure-as-code documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks as living engineering artifacts . 
 - Contribute to design reviews and engineering retrospectives, driving permanent fixes into automation and standards. 

________________________________________

Required Technical Skills And Good To Have

- Hypervisors: Hands-on experience with KVM/QEMU, VMware, or similar virtualization platforms - VM lifecycle management, snapshots, basic performance troubleshooting. 
 - Linux: Skills on RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu - services, storage (LVM, filesystems), networking basics, log analysis. 
 - Automation: Working knowledge of scripting (Bash and/or Python) and at least one automation/config management tool (Ansible preferred). 
 - Cloud Platforms: Practical exposure to at least one public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) or private cloud orchestration platform (Morpheus, OpenStack, or similar). 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. 

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

data.title: Senior Consultant - Quality Assurance
data.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Lead to establish and lead practical QA practices for our Digital Environment development team. This hands-on role will define quality strategy, improve delivery processes, guide testing activities, and promote shared ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle. 

The team delivers data management, software development, and web-based weather information services for internal and external clients using cloud technologies and Agile delivery practices. 

Responsibilities

Quality Strategy, Governance & Process Leadership

- Define and implement a practical QA strategy, operating model, standards, roadmap, and supporting templates. 
 - Assess current practices, identify quality risks and process gaps, and prioritize measurable improvements. 
 - Establish quality gates, release-readiness practices, defect workflows, and test evidence expectations. 

Test Planning, Automation & Execution

- Lead risk-based test planning for features, integrations, data workflows, and production releases. 
 - Perform and oversee manual and automated testing across web, API, data-processing, and mobile solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain the team's test automation approach, including standards and CI/CD integration. 
 - Track defects and quality risks, support timely resolution, and turn findings into process improvements. 

Team Leadership & Capability Development

- Provide technical direction, mentoring, and coordination for QA professionals and others performing testing. 
 - Help shape QA roles, responsibilities, recruitment, onboarding, and future team structure. 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Participate in Agile planning, refinement, stand-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning. 
 - Provide evidence-based recommendations on product quality, release readiness, and material risks. 
 - Promote shared ownership of quality rather than treating QA as a final testing step. 

Qualifications

- 7+ years of software QA experience, including senior, lead, or equivalent responsibilities. 
 - Experience defining and improving QA processes, standards, governance, measures, and team practices. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring QA professionals; formal supervisory experience is an asset. 
 - Strong knowledge of testing methods, risk-based testing, defect management, root-cause analysis, and quality engineering. 
 - Hands-on test automation experience using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, data-processing workflows, and CI/CD quality controls. 
 - Strong analytical, facilitation, and communication, and skills. 

Preferred Skills & Experience

- Experience with cloud services, especially Amazon Web Services, and 24/7 operational systems. 
 - Experience with performance, reliability, accessibility, security, mobile, or usability testing. 
 - Experience testing data-intensive, geospatial, environmental, weather, or other operationally critical systems. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration. 
 - Maintain product quality and cultural integrity. 
 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: 

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Cyber Managed Service -Threat Detection & Response - Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (Sentinel SOAR) - Senior

KEY Capabilities: 

- Excellent teamwork skills, passion and drive to succeed and combat Cyber threats
 - Working with the customer to identify security automation strategies and provide creative integrations and playbooks. 
 - Work collaboratively with other team members to find creative and practical solutions to customers' challenges and needs. 
 - Responsible for execution and maintenance of Sentinel SOAR related analytical processes and tasks
 - Management and administration of Sentinel SOAR platform
 - Developing custom scripts and playbooks to automate repetitive tasks and response actions. 
 - Experienced developer with at least 2 + yrs of experience using Python programming language, REST API and JSON. Must have basic SQL knowledge. 
 - Knowledge on Incident Response and Threat Intelligence tools. 
 - Creation of reusable and efficient Python-based Playbooks. 
 - Use Splunk SOAR platform to enable automation and orchestration on various tools and technologies by making use of existing or custom integration
 - Partner with security operations teams, threat intelligence groups and incident responders. 
 - Should have worked in a security operations center and gained understanding of SIEM solutions like Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel and other log management platforms. Having experience in Splunk content development will be an added advantage
 - Willing to learn new technologies and take up new challenges. Assist in developing high-quality technical content such as automation scripts/tools, reference architectures, and white papers. 
 - Good grasp in conceptualizing and/or implementing automation for business process workflows
 - Knowledge in Network monitoring technology platforms such as Fidelis XPS or others
 - Knowledge in endpoint protection tools, techniques and platforms such as Carbon Black, Tanium, Microsoft Defender ATP, Symantec, McAfee or others
 - Should be able to assist, support and mitigate production issues. 
 - Should have the capability to work with partners and client stack holders to full fill their asks
 - Ability to Coordinate with Vendor to incident closure on according to the severity
 - Review, assess, benchmark and develop issue remediation action plans for all aspects of an engagement. 

Qualification & experience: 

- Minimum of 3+ years' experience in cyber security with a depth of network architecture knowledge that will translate over to deploying and integrating Sentinel SOAR solution in global enterprise environments. 
 - Experience working in ServiceNow SOAR is also an added advantage
 - Strong oral, written and listening skills are an essential component to effective consulting. 
 - Strong background in network administration. Ability to work at all layers of the OSI models, including being able to explain communication at any level is necessary. 
 - Should have strong hands-on experience with scripting technologies like Python, REST, JSON, SOAP, ODBC, XML etc. 
 - Must have honours degree in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field
 - Minimum 2 years of working in SOAR (Sentinel)
 - Experience in Process Development, Process Improvement, Process Architecture, and Training
 - Quick to apprehend and adapt new applications. 
 - Knowledgeable in Cybersecurity and Incident Response Management
 - Certification in any one of the SIEM Solution such as Splunk or SC-200 will be an added advantage
 - Certifications in a core security related discipline will be an added advantage. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
Job Title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - MySQL, PostgreSQL & Oracle

Location: Remote

Work Mode: Fully Remote

Experience: 5+ years

Start Date: Immediate

Job Summary: 

Owision is seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to own the reliability, performance, scalability, and automation of our MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle database fleet across on-premises and multi-cloud platforms (AWS, OCI, Azure). Operating at the intersection of DBA, SRE, and Platform Engineering, you will treat databases as code, eliminate operational toil, and build self-healing, highly available, and observable data platforms that power mission-critical services. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define, monitor, and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs for database availability, latency, durability, and error budgets across all production tiers. 
 - Architect, maintain, and continuously validate High Availability (HA) configurations, clustering, replication topologies, and automated failover mechanisms. 
 - Lead database incident management, participate in on-call rotations, and conduct blameless Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) to implement permanent preventive engineering solutions. 
 - Design, automate, and regularly test Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity plans to guarantee strict RPO and RTO targets. 
 - Treat databases as code by automating provisioning, scaling, patching, backups, and zero-downtime schema migrations using Python, Bash, Terraform, and Ansible. 
 - Build and maintain internal Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) self-service tools and CI/CD automation pipelines for engineering teams. 
 - Conduct deep query optimization, indexing strategies, capacity planning, and engine-level tuning (InnoDB, PostgreSQL autovacuum, Oracle AWR/ASH). 
 - Build end-to-end monitoring, alerting, and telemetry dashboards using PMM, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, and Zabbix. 
 - Enforce database security by design, including encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, auditing, compliance, and data governance policies. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 4-6+ years of hands-on experience as a DBRE, SRE, or Systems DBA managing large-scale, production database environments. 
 - Strong SRE mindset with practical experience managing SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, incident response workflows, and post-mortem practices. 
 - Deep production expertise in MySQL and PostgreSQL internals, alongside solid working knowledge of Oracle Core (RMAN, Data Guard, OEM, RAC basics). 
 - Proven hands-on experience with cloud-native database services across AWS (RDS/Aurora), OCI, or Azure Database. 
 - Strong scripting proficiency in Python and Bash, combined with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Extensive experience with enterprise backup and recovery tools (Percona XtraBackup, pgBackRest, RMAN) and replication mechanisms (async, semi-sync, logical). 
 - Advanced Linux/Unix systems administration skills, OS-level performance tuning, and deep SQL execution plan diagnosis. 
 - Proven track record of self-directed technical ownership and disciplined incident handling in a fully remote environment. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience deploying and orchestrating stateful database workloads using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS R12. x) database administration, patching, cloning, and upgrades. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server (Always On Availability Groups) or NoSQL data platforms (MongoDB, Redis).

data.title: QAE II,  Business Operations Business Operations
data.description:
Description

Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2, 000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon. 

We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches. 

Key job responsibilities

As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will: 

Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off. 

Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase. 

Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response. 

Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on. 

Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does. 

You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role. 

A day in the life

You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate. 

About The Team

Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
 - Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - Experience scripting or coding
 - Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
 - Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment
 - Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
 - Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
data.description:
Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Engineer - Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity. 

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree. 

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1-4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation. 

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation. 

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications. 

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times. 

• Run demos, application trials and customer training. 

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running. 

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation. 

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team. 

Must Have

• Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation. 

• 1-4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering. 

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge. 

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills. 

• Willingness to travel to customer sites. 

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus. 

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus. 

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming. 

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment. 

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity. 

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership. 

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles. 

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics. 

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications. 

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. , headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. 

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna. co. in and recruitment1@luna. co. in with the subject "FAE - Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi). 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

What You Will Do

- Lead the development of next-generation routing and switching hardware platforms, taking complete ownership from concept and design through validation, production release, and product sustaining. 
 - Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) programs as a technical lead, coordinating cross-functional and geographically distributed teams to deliver high-performance, quality-driven, and cost-effective products. 
 - Define hardware design specifications, implement designs, and drive PCB development, including schematic reviews, layout validation, Gerber generation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) release. 
 - Lead high-speed board bring-up, system-level debugging, fault analysis, Design Verification Testing (DVT), and new component qualification using advanced laboratory test and measurement equipment. 
 - Drive hardware design and validation involving CPU and memory architectures, including DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, SPI, XGMII, XFI, and XAUI interfaces. 
 - Collaborate with PCB layout, signal integrity, power, mechanical, thermal, CPLD/FPGA, firmware/BIOS, software, testing, manufacturing, and sustaining teams to resolve complex system-level challenges. 
 - Design and verify CPLD/FPGA logic and support hardware integration, functionality, and platform validation. 
 - Review and approve schematics, BoMs, PCB placement and routing, laboratory results, compliance test reports, and product technical documentation. 
 - Own technical documentation, including product specifications, hardware design specifications, design review records, DVT plans, compliance test plans, diagnostic test plans, and hardware test reports (HTRs). 
 - Ensure compliance with EMI/EMC, safety, environmental, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA) requirements, as applicable. 
 - Work closely with external vendors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, resolve issues, and support product quality and cost objectives. 
 - Provide ongoing product sustaining support, identify design improvements, and stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and hardware engineering best practices. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Telecommunication, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized university; an M. E. /M. Tech. is preferred. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex, high-end hardware products from concept to volume production, with a strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle. 
 - Strong expertise in high-speed board design, hardware bring-up, debugging, system integration, and advanced laboratory testing and measurement techniques. 
 - In-depth knowledge of CPU and memory architectures, with hands-on experience in DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, SPI, XGMII, XFI, and XAUI interfaces. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of system-level design considerations, including software, PCB design, signal integrity, power conversion, thermal management, mechanical design, DFM, DFA, and cost optimization. 
 - Experience leading NPI programs and influencing design decisions to achieve performance, quality, reliability, and cost targets. 
 - Working knowledge of CPLD/FPGA design and verification, along with hardware integration and validation. 
 - Knowledge of EMI/EMC, safety, and environmental regulatory compliance requirements for telecommunications systems. 
 - Strong technical documentation, design review, problem-solving, and fault-analysis skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, external suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
 - Strong leadership, interpersonal communication, negotiation, and supplier-management skills. 
 - A proactive, self-motivated, and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to organize work, take ownership, and lead by example. 
 - Adaptability to changing business priorities, ambiguous challenges, and assignments beyond immediate areas of expertise, while following established processes, checklists, reporting structures, and company practices. 
 - Awareness of current industry trends, emerging technologies, innovations, and hardware engineering best practices.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

Cloud Platform & CloudOps Suite Engineering

data.title: QA Engg - Backend Automation
data.description:
Corporate Overview

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online  marketplaces that match searchers and "research and compare" consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation's largest media networks. 

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven  matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.   They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results. 

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience. 

We believe in: 

- The direct measurability of digital media. 
 - Performance marketing. (We pioneered it. )
 - The advantages of technology. We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world's biggest channel. 

  

Quality Engineer - Backend Automation  

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
Experience: 4-7 Years |  

About the Role

We are seeking hands-on Quality Engineers to support the modernization of Quest, a high-volume event and workflow-processing platform. This role focuses on backend quality engineering, including API, event-driven, database, integration, performance, and migration testing to ensure reliability and correctness throughout the Quest v2 migration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test strategies for backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and database interactions. 
 - Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate Kafka-based event processing, retries, ordering, duplicate handling, replay, and idempotency scenarios. 
 - Perform migration validation between Quest v1 and Quest v2, including reconciliation and data consistency checks. 
 - Develop SQL-based data validation, integration, regression, performance, and resilience tests. 
 - Investigate defects using logs, metrics, traces, databases, and event streams. 
 - Support production deployments, release validation, and incident investigations. Required Skills

- 4-7 years of Quality Engineering, SDET, or software testing experience. 
 - Strong Java programming and test automation skills. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Strong SQL and database validation experience (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, etc. ). 
 - Experience testing backend services, integrations, and distributed systems. 
 - Good understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, Git, and Linux/Unix environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Preferred Skills

- Experience with Kafka, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures. 
 - Knowledge of Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing. 
 - Experience with JMeter, Gatling, k6, or similar performance testing tools. 
 - Exposure to resilience, concurrency, recovery, and high-volume transaction systems. What We're Looking For

- Engineers who treat automation as production-quality software. 
 - Strong focus on backend, data, event-processing, and system reliability testing. 
 - Ability to independently own test coverage, defect investigation, and quality validation. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with developers, architects, and QA teams. Levels: Candidates may be hired as Quality Engineer (4-6 years) or Senior Quality Engineer (5-7 years) based on experience and capability in automation design, test strategy, performance testing, and technical leadership. 

  

QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law. 

Please see QuinStreet's Employee Privacy Notice here.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. We are seeking an experienced and technically influential Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Cloud Tooling and Pipelines team. This pivotal team is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our core Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (leveraging Spinnaker and custom tooling), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) execution engines (primarily Terraform), and a suite of supporting microservices. These systems are critical for enabling and managing our extensive resource footprint across AWS ECS and EKS. 

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a key contributor, driving the implementation of scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. Your deep expertise in software engineering principles and cloud-native development will be essential in building and enhancing our critical tooling for infrastructure provisioning, vulnerability management, and IaC deployments. You will also play a vital role in mentoring other engineers and influencing the team's technical roadmap. If you have a strong passion for building robust software systems that empower operational efficiency at scale, we encourage you to apply.

 - Design and Develop Core Platform Components: Lead the design and development of scalable and reliable microservices and tools that form the backbone of Okta's Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (including components for Spinnaker, Terraform, and custom tooling). 

- Build Infrastructure as Code Automation: Develop sophisticated software solutions and APIs that empower engineering teams to provision and manage infrastructure, execute production changes, and deploy code with high reliability and efficiency.

- Provide Technical Guidance and Mentorship: Serve as a technical mentor and role model for other engineers on the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence in software engineering. 

Required Qualifications
 - 7+ years of professional experience in Software Development, with a strong focus on backend systems and distributed applications. 

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java, Go, Python, or similar backend languages, specifically building scalable and reliable applications. 

- Demonstrated experience in developing and maintaining automation tools, platforms, or microservices for cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or similar).

- Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) platform development, including familiarity with tools like Spinnaker or similar.

- Proficient in using Docker and experienced with building applications that interact with underlying Linux and networking fundamentals. 

- Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, etc. ) in the context of application development and operational management.

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled API Test Automation Engineer with hands-on expertise in Karate

Framework, REST API Testing, Automation, and CSIRT/Security Testing. The ideal

candidate will be responsible for validating API functionality, performance, authentication

mechanisms, and security compliance while ensuring high-quality releases through

automation and continuous testing practices. 

The role requires close collaboration with Development, DevOps, Security, and

Architecture teams to identify quality and security risks early in the SDLC and support

secure application delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

API Testing & Automation

- Design, develop, and execute API test cases based on business and technical

requirements. 

- Build, enhance, and maintain API automation frameworks using Karate Framework. 
 - Validate REST APIs, request/response payloads, status codes, headers, data

integrity, and API workflows. 

- Perform API sequencing and end-to-end integration testing. 
 - Develop reusable automated test scripts and test data management strategies. 

Security & CSIRT Testing

- Conduct CSIRT-related API security validation activities. 
 - Validate authentication, authorization, access control, and token management

mechanisms. 

- Perform vulnerability verification and security regression testing. 
 - Assess API security risks and validate remediation fixes. 
 - Verify adherence to OWASP API security best practices. 

Quality Assurance & Release Testing

- Execute SIT, E2E, Regression, UAT support, and Release Validation testing. 
 - Identify, log, track, and manage defects through closure. 
 - Analyze test execution results and prepare quality reports. 
 - Support release readiness assessments and production deployment validation. 

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate API automation suites into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support continuous testing initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve automated quality gates. 
 - Ensure test execution and reporting are aligned with Agile delivery practices. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

- Work closely with Developers, Architects, Security Teams, and Product Owners. 
 - Participate in requirement reviews and test strategy discussions. 
 - Provide risk assessments and actionable testing insights. 
 - Drive quality improvements across the software delivery lifecycle. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace.

- REST API Testing

 - JSON

 - API Validation

Automation Tools

- Karate Framework (Mandatory)
 - Postman
 - CURL

Security Testing

 - Authorization Testing

API Security

- OAuth

- SIT Testing

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
We're looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability and performance of SDS2, our structural steel detailing software. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on steel detailing or fabrication experience who wants to apply that knowledge to improve software quality and user outcomes. 

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITY: 

- Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests for SDS2. 
 - Develop and expand GUI-based automated test suites using Eggplant. 
 - Validate new features, bug fixes, and releases against real-world detailing and fabrication workflows. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, developers, and UX to define acceptance criteria and improve test coverage. 
 - Reproduce, document, and prioritize defects with clear, actionable detail. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, tooling, and release quality. 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR: 

- Experience in structural steel detailing or fabrication (SDS2 experience strongly preferred). 
 - Solid understanding of detailing workflows, shop drawings, and fabrication processes. 
 - Experience with software QA practices, including test case design and defect tracking. 
 - Familiarity with GUI test automation tools (Eggplant preferred, others acceptable). 
 - Strong attention to detail and ability to think through edge cases and real-world usage. 
 - Comfortable working in an agile, cross-functional team environment. 
 - Willingness to overlap with EST/CST hours
 - Problem-solving mindset and analytical thinking with a focus on continuous improvement. 

SKILLS PREFERRED: 

- Experience with CAD/BIM software (e. g. , Tekla, Advance Steel, Revit). 
 - Basic scripting or programming experience (Python or similar). 
 - Experience testing complex engineering or manufacturing software. 

WHY JOIN US

- Work on industry-leading structural steel software used worldwide. 
 - Directly influence product quality and user experience for fabricators and detailers. 
 - Collaborate with a team deeply rooted in AEC and construction technology.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes. 

About Us

Redwood Software is the leader in full stack automation fabric solutions for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in the transformative power of automation. Our unparalleled solutions empower you to orchestrate, manage and monitor your workflows across any application, service or server - in the cloud or on premises - with confidence and control. 

CORE VALUES

- One Team. One Redwood
 - Make Your Own Weather
 - Obsess over Customer Success
 - Work the Problem
 - Be Curious
 - Own the Outcome
 - Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

We are looking for an Senior Engineering Manager, Products & Platforms to join our Product engineering team to lead a high-performing software engineering team while driving technical strategy across Redwood's Workload Automation Platform. You will be instrumental in mentoring engineers, managing team deliverables, and guiding the design, development, and enhancement of scalable, secure software that powers enterprise data exchange for more than 1, 000 customers worldwide. 

- As an Engineering Manager, you will: 
 - People Leadership & Mentorship: Manage, coach, and grow a team of talented software engineers, supporting career development, conducting performance reviews, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative team culture. 
 - Technical Strategy & Architecture: Provide hands-on technical guidance, participate in design reviews, and define technical roadmaps for Java/Spring Boot microservices while ensuring high standards for architecture, security, and observability. 
 - Delivery & Platform Ownership: Oversee team execution, Sprint planning, and delivery timelines to ensure resilient, scalable core platform features and infrastructure. 
 - AI Integration: Research and apply AI/ML concepts and their usage to innovate and enhance the MFT (Managed File Transfer) and WLA (Workload Automation) product capabilities (e. g. , intelligent routing, predictive maintenance, enhanced security). 

Your Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 4 years of direct people management experience leading engineering teams. 
 - Strong Java, Spring Boot, and REST API skills with a solid understanding of OOP, design patterns, and architecture principles. 
 - Cloud Platform Expertise (AWS Preferred): Extensive experience architecting, deploying, and managing complex solutions on a major cloud platform, with a deep understanding of cloud concepts including networking, security, and cost optimization. 
 - Expertise in building distributed SaaS systems, micro services, APIs, Kubernetes, cloud platforms. 
 - AI Awareness: Proven familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their usage, with practical experience or a strong conceptual understanding of how to apply these techniques to solve engineering problems. 
 - DevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) such as Terraform, and automated platform management. 
 - EKS/Kubernetes: Mastery of container orchestration, specifically with EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service), including managing inter-component communication and cluster operations. 
 - Protocol Understanding: In-depth understanding of enterprise file transfer protocols (e. g. , SFTP, FTPS, AS2) and secure communication protocols. 
 - Proven track record of building and managing high-performing engineering teams, hiring top talent, and driving team productivity. 
 - Knowledge of agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 - Experience with large-scale enterprise application integration, preferably with SAP. 

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Job Title: Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst (Java Full Stack)

Job Level / Band: C13 (Vice President )

Primary Location: [Pune/ Hybrid]

Function / Group: Technology / Applications Development

Role Overview

The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst (Java Full Stack) is a senior-level technical leadership role responsible for establishing, designing, and delivering high-quality, scalable application systems and software solutions in coordination with cross-functional technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to drive end-to-end applications systems analysis, architectural alignment, full-stack software engineering, and implementation activities across distributed enterprise environments. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Solution Delivery

- System Integration & Product Delivery: Partner with engineering managers, product owners, and multi-disciplinary teams to establish architectural roadmaps, integrate enterprise services, and deliver core system enhancements and new digital capabilities. 
 - Architecture & Engineering Standards: Ensure software and application designs strictly adhere to enterprise architecture blueprints, security baselines, and industry best practices. 
 - Complex Problem Resolution: Resolve high-impact, critical engineering and architectural challenges through in-depth evaluation of complex business flows, technical bottlenecks, system dependencies, and industry standards. 
 - Coding & Quality Governance: Define, champion, and enforce engineering standards for clean code, design patterns, automated unit/integration testing, debugging, code reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Cross-Functional Domain Alignment: Maintain a comprehensive understanding of how application architecture, infrastructure, data management, and business capabilities integrate to achieve business objectives. 

Innovation, AI-Augmented Engineering & Coaching

- Innovative Problem-Solving: Apply interpretive thinking and structured analysis to identify complex technical problems, proposing modern, scalable, and resilient technical solutions. 
 - AI-First Software Delivery: Actively leverage generative AI and modern developer-productivity tools to accelerate software delivery cycles, streamline automated test creation, refactor legacy code, and elevate code quality. 
 - Mentorship & Team Guidance: Serve as a technical advisor and mentor to mid-level software engineers and analysts, leading technical discussions and delegating engineering tasks effectively. 

Risk, Compliance & Governance

- Risk & Controls Assessment: Appropriately assess risk when business and technical decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding client assets. 
 - Regulatory & Policy Compliance: Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and enterprise standards; apply sound ethical judgment; and escalate, manage, and report control issues with full transparency. 

Qualifications & Technical Competencies

- Core Backend Software Engineering (Java)
 - Java Mastery: Advanced, hands-on expertise with Java (Java 17 / 21) and the modern enterprise Java ecosystem. 
 - Frameworks: Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, and Hibernate / JPA. 
 - Microservices Architecture: Proven track record of architecting, implementing, and deploying high-throughput, low-latency, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed processing systems. 
 - Messaging & Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience with asynchronous messaging and event streaming technologies (Apache Kafka, Solace, or JMS). 
 - API Standards: Expertise designing and developing enterprise-grade RESTful APIs and gRPC services with strong authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS). 
 - Modern Frontend Engineering (React / Angular)
 - Frontend Frameworks: Deep practical experience building modern, responsive web applications using React and/or Angular with TypeScript and modern ECMAScript (ES6+). 
 - State Management & Reactive Programming: Proficiency in state management patterns (Redux / NgRx) and reactive streams using RxJS. 
 - Modern UI & Micro-Frontends: Hands-on experience with Micro-Frontend architectures, standalone components, dynamic routing, and complex enterprise data grids (e. g. , AG Grid Enterprise, Elemental UI / Design System components). 
 - Web Fundamentals & Real-Time Data: Strong mastery of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, DOM manipulation, responsive layouts, and bidirectional communication protocols (WebSockets / Server-Sent Events). 
 - Database & Data Engineering
 - Relational Databases (RDBMS): Deep experience with relational data modeling, schema design, advanced SQL tuning, and query optimization on enterprise databases (Oracle, ). 
 - NoSQL Data Stores: Practical experience designing, indexing, and maintaining document/key-value NoSQL databases (MongoDB/Couchbase). 
 - High Availability & Scalability: Solid understanding of database clustering, indexing strategies, replica sets, connection pooling, and caching strategies . 
 - CI/CD, Containerization & Cloud Operations
 - Containers & Orchestration: Proven experience containerizing applications using Docker and deploying onto container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift). 
 - Enterprise CI/CD Pipelines: Hands-on proficiency configuring automated build, test, and release pipelines using modern enterprise platforms (Harness, Jenkins, Tekton, or GitHub Actions) in Linux environments. 
 - Job Scheduling & Batch Systems: Familiarity with enterprise workload automation and job schedulers (Autosys or equivalent). 
 - Quality & Security Tooling: Experience integrating automated code quality, dependency management, and vulnerability scanning tools (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx). 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering
 - AI-First Tooling: Demonstrated proficiency integrating Generative AI developer tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or internal LLM coding assistants) into daily development workflows to enhance productivity, code generation, and test coverage. 

Education & Experience

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent; Master's degree preferred. 
 - Experience: 6-10+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering and application architecture, with demonstrated experience leading technical delivery within enterprise environments.

data.title: Principal R&D Engineer (3DIC)
data.description:
You Are

You have 15+ years of experience and are already drawn to hard technical problems: algorithms, data structures, and software that has to be correct, fast, and maintainable. You may not yet have shipped a full EDA product, but you write solid C/C++, you debug with discipline, and you want to learn how production design tools actually get built. 

You are curious about how chips are designed and packaged - and you want to grow into that domain by working on real software, not only on theory. At Synopsys, you will contribute to package substrate design automation within 3DIC Compiler, helping enable advanced multi-die systems for AI, high-performance computing, and heterogeneous integration. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Implement and extend package substrate design automation capabilities within the 3DIC Compiler platform. 
 - Write production C/C++ code for features such as HDI substrate auto-routing, design rule checking, power delivery network analysis, and design for manufacturability. 
 - Build, test, and debug software that runs on large, real-world packaging designs, including multi-die chiplets and heterogeneous integration. 
 - Work with senior engineers, product teams, and customers to understand design bottlenecks and turn them into well-scoped software changes. 
 - Participate in design and code reviews; learn how architecture decisions are made across the 3DIC product. 
 - Grow your skills in algorithms, performance, and software quality under the mentorship of experienced R&D engineers. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Contribute features that help customers design next-generation advanced packaging for AI, high-performance computing, and other complex systems. 
 - Help reduce design cycle time for teams working on HDI substrates, chiplets, and multi-die architectures. 
 - Own well-defined pieces of auto-routing, power delivery, checking, and manufacturability software - and see them used by leading semiconductor companies. 
 - Build a foundation in a strategic Synopsys product line at the center of the industry shift toward chiplet-based systems. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of relevant software or R&D experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ skills and a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity. 
 - Ability to write, debug, and test production-quality code; coursework, internships, or projects that show this clearly. 
 - Interest in physical design, EDA, semiconductors, or advanced packaging - prior domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. 
 - Coursework or project experience in at least one related area is helpful: graph algorithms, computational geometry, CAD/EDA tools, VLSI/physical design, or large-scale C++ software. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to learn from design reviews and feedback. 

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the advanced packaging design automation team for 3DIC Compiler. The team focuses on package substrate design and the industry shift toward chiplet architectures and heterogeneous integration. You will be mentored by senior and distinguished engineers, contribute to a strategic Synopsys growth area, and see a clear path to greater ownership as you grow.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems
data.description:
About Onehouse

Onehouse is a mission-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock-in. We deliver the industry's most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML). 

We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self-optimizing data lake platform!

The Community You Will Join

When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category - the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems. 

The Impact You Will Drive: 

- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest. Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads. 
 - Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing. 

A Typical Day: 

- Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers. 
 - Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance. 
 - Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines. 
 - Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster. 
 - Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C++ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform). 
 - Experience with inner workings of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases. 
 - You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions. 
 - An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed. 
 - An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems. 
 - An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data. 
 - Experience running production services, at scale. 
 - Robust and clear communication skills. 
 - Nice to haves (but not required): 
 - Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases. 
 - Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization). 
 - Existing publications of optimizing large-scale data systems in top-tier distributed system conferences. 
 - PhD degree with 2+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high-impact optimization projects. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

- Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
 - Health & Well-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well-being by reimbursing up to 20, 000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
 - Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
 - Location; we are a remote-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America + India), though some roles will be subject to in-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
 - Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
 - Food & Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in-office snacks/drinks
 - Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
 - Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents - fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition

House Values

One Team

Optimize for the company, your team, self - in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of. 

Tough & Persevering

We are building our company in a very large, fast-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!

Keep Making It Better Always

Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward. 

Think Big, Act Fast

We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns. 

Be Customer Obsessed

Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It's how we've contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services - and our open-access model - we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. 

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25, 000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG's ticker symbol is LSEG. 

OUR PEOPLE: 

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. 

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder - which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. 

ROLE PROFILE: 

The Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering is accountable for the reliability, resilience, and operational effectiveness of critical enterprise applications and platforms throughout the service lifecycle. 

The role will drive the evolution of the L2/SRE function from reactive production support towards proactive reliability engineering, using automation, observability, operational learning, and strong engineering partnerships to reduce toil, incidents, and operational risk. 

Working across engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and support, the role will promote shared ownership of production reliability and ensure services are continuously improved to meet agreed levels of availability, performance, resilience, and customer experience. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead the L2/SRE function and its continuous improvement, with accountability for improving service reliability, resilience, operational efficiency, and engineering maturity. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing L2/SRE team, fostering accountability, technical capability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define and mature Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets to support clear, data-led reliability and engineering decisions. 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation, improved tooling, self-service capabilities, and simplification of repetitive support activities. 
 - Establish strong observability and alerting standards across logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and telemetry to improve detection, diagnosis, and recovery. 
 - Define operational readiness standards, ensuring services are supportable, resilient, appropriately monitored, well documented, and have clear recovery and escalation procedures before entering production. 
 - Lead effective Incident Management within L2/SRE, including response, escalation, post-incident review, and identification of recurring issues. Partner with L3 on Problem Management and RCA, ensuring corrective actions and reliability improvements are tracked through to completion. 
 - Champion strong ITSM practices and operational hygiene across Incident, Problem, Change, service ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Oversee proportionate, risk-based Change Management and approval processes, ensuring changes are appropriately assessed, dependencies and conflicts are understood, implementation and rollback plans are robust, and higher-risk activity receives the right level of scrutiny while avoiding unnecessary overhead for well-understood, low-risk change. 
 - Partner with L3 engineering and other technology teams to ensure production learnings, recurring incidents, support trends, and reliability concerns are reflected in engineering priorities and addressed at source. 
 - Drive resilience improvements through disaster recovery and failover testing, capacity planning, dependency analysis, and clear ownership of reliability-related technical debt. 
 - Define, monitor, and report on service health and reliability measures, including availability, performance, SLO attainment, incident trends, recovery times, operational risk, and improvement outcomes. 
 - Apply strong technical judgement, risk assessment, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills when making decisions in high-pressure operational situations. 

What you'll get in return: 

At LSEG, we invest in excellence. You'll be part of a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your impact is visible. We offer: 

- Competitive compensation with performance-based rewards. 
 - A flexible hybrid work model that supports work-life balance. 
 - Access to cutting-edge tools and infrastructure to do your best work. 
 - Opportunities for continuous learning, including certifications, conferences, and internal mobility. 
 - A collaborative culture that values technical mastery, ownership, and innovation. 
 - The chance to work on a globally critical system that powers secure financial transactions across markets. 

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Career Stage: 

Manager

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions. 

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25, 000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. 

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. 

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering. 

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives. 

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it's used for, and how it's obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject. 

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.
