Job Description

WSP is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Lead to establish and lead practical QA practices for our Digital Environment development team. This hands-on role will define quality strategy, improve delivery processes, guide testing activities, and promote shared ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle. 

The team delivers data management, software development, and web-based weather information services for internal and external clients using cloud technologies and Agile delivery practices. 

Responsibilities

Quality Strategy, Governance & Process Leadership

- Define and implement a practical QA strategy, operating model, standards, roadmap, and supporting templates. 
 - Assess current practices, identify quality risks and process gaps, and prioritize measurable improvements. 
 - Establish quality gates, release-readiness practices, defect workflows, and test evidence expectations. 

Test Planning, Automation & Execution

- Lead risk-based test planning for features, integrations, data workflows, and production releases. 
 - Perform and oversee manual and automated testing across web, API, data-processing, and mobile solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain the team's test automation approach, including standards and CI/CD integration. 
 - Track defects and quality risks, support timely resolution, and turn findings into process improvements. 

Team Leadership & Capability Development

- Provide technical direction, mentoring, and coordination for QA professionals and others performing testing. 
 - Help shape QA roles, responsibilities, recruitment, onboarding, and future team structure. 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Participate in Agile planning, refinement, stand-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning. 
 - Provide evidence-based recommendations on product quality, release readiness, and material risks. 
 - Promote shared ownership of quality rather than treating QA as a final testing step. 

Qualifications

- 7+ years of software QA experience, including senior, lead, or equivalent responsibilities. 
 - Experience defining and improving QA processes, standards, governance, measures, and team practices. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring QA professionals; formal supervisory experience is an asset. 
 - Strong knowledge of testing methods, risk-based testing, defect management, root-cause analysis, and quality engineering. 
 - Hands-on test automation experience using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, data-processing workflows, and CI/CD quality controls.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.

Working with Us

data.title: Software Engineer 3
data.description:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. To accelerate this transition, MongoDB is building a dedicated Platform and Infrastructure team to develop the Application Modernisation Platform and Infrastructure . As we help customers modernize their application and data ecosystems, we face the challenge of deploying complex tooling into highly restrictive client environments and architecting automated verification frameworks to ensure data equivalence. 

This new team will architect the platform foundation and infrastructure that enables a "build once, run anywhere" model, ensuring our AI-powered modernisation suite operates seamlessly regardless of a client's security or network constraints. We are looking for engineers to join this high-visibility initiative, where you will solve unique distributed systems puzzles and help shape the future of how global enterprises leverage data and AI. 

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer who thrives on solving infrastructure constraints and building developer-centric modernisation platforms with a strong background in building software testkits/frameworks. The ideal candidate will be designing and building automated frameworks that validate functional equivalence, performance benchmarks, and data integrity. From leveraging LLMs for unit test generation to building contract testing frameworks, your work will be the safety net for the world's largest enterprise migrations. 

This role will be based in our India office in Gurgaon and offers a hybrid working model. 

The ideal candidate for this role will have

- 3-4 years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
 - Expertise integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into the developer workflow to automate unit test generation and edge-case discovery
 - Experience building developer tools, infrastructure, or complex testing frameworks
 - Solid experience in software architecture and development
 - Deep expertise in application/database modernization with proven ability to design and implement frameworks that ensure database state equivalence across different implementations
 - Must understand change data capture, event-driven database interception (MongoDB listeners, RDBMS triggers), and state comparison algorithms with pattern-based exclusions. Strong Spring Boot (or equivalent Java framework), MongoDB (or equivalent), and JDBC/JPA skills required
 - Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e. g. MongoDB)
 - Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity
 - Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations

- Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the modernization and framework team and its surrounding services
 - Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap
 - Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and patterns
 - Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in our distributed systems
 - Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests
 - Perform tasks related to process such as CI/CD, quality, testing, etc

Success Measures

Within the first three months, you will have: 

- Familiarize yourself with the MongoDB Modernization Infrastructure & Frameworks stack
 - Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
 - Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design reviews

Within six months, you will have: 

- Familiarised yourself with the rest of our the application modernization tool stack
 - Delivered at least one large scale feature that spans the entire tech stack
 - Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have: 

- Become a key contributor to our stack, capable of taking on complex features independently
 - Helped recruit and interview new members of the team
 - Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross-functional projects

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. Quality Strategy, Governance & Process Leadership

Test Planning, Automation & Execution

Job Summary

More about the role

The Lead Software Quality Engineer, an Individual Contributor, is a Functional Quality Expert responsible for driving company-wide adoption of the IoT Software Quality Framework across the connected lighting ecosystem, including edge devices (luminaires, drivers, controllers), platforms, gateways, cloud, mobile applications, and security layers. 

This is not an operational Quality Assurance role. The position focuses on enabling and influencing global BU Stakeholders (e. g. R&D teams, Architecture teams, Test Teams, Product Management teams and Field teams) to embed reconfigurable, scalable, secure, and reliable software quality practices into engineering execution. 

The ideal candidate must have prior hands-on experience within IoT software engineering (embedded + cloud-connected systems) and must understand system-level integration challenges such as device-cloud communication, OTA updates, interoperability, performance, and cybersecurity risks. 

Key Areas of Responsibility IoT Software Quality Framework Deploymen

- Drive the implementation of the defined Software Quality Framework across
 - Firmware (MCUs, RTOS-based systems). , Gateway / edge computing platforms. , Cloud services & APIs. Mobile applications (iOS/Android). 'Device-cloud connectivity layers. 
 - Ensure system-level traceability across hardware-firmware-cloud-app interactions. 
 - Institutionalize risk-based engineering practices for distributed Connected Lighting Architectures. 
Engineering-Embedded Quality Enablement

- Partner with device, cloud, and mobile R&D teams to embed "Built-in Quality. "
 - Translate governance standards into practical guidance aligned to Agile / SAFe / DevOps. 

Proactive Measures

- As defined in Company IoT SW Quality Framework. 
 - Enable cross-layer dashboards for leadership visibility. 
 - Drive early risk detection through data analytics and release readiness reviews. 

Reactive Quality & Closed-Loop Learning

- Support institutionalizing of Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Actions and Closed Loop Preventions (Field failures. , Interoperability breakdowns, safety and Security incidents)

Cross-BU & System-Level Alignment

- Collaborate with: Firmware R&D. , Platform engineering, System architects, Field quality & customer support. 
 - Support alignment between central quality governance and BU engineering autonomy. 
 - Build strong stakeholder buy-in through technical credibility and pragmatic execution guidance. 

Critical Experiences

- 12+ years in Software Engineering within IoT, embedded systems, cloud platforms, or connected products. 
 - Prior hands-on development experience (Software Engineer / Tech Lead / Architect). 
 - Experience working in Agile / SAFe / DevOps and global engineering environments. 
 - Experience with development tooling (JIRA, Confluence) and Software Quality Tooling (SonarQube, MEND, TIOBE, Dynamic Code Analysis). 

Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority

Functional Expertise

- Experience with reliability engineering and large-scale IoT deployments. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD quality gates. 
 - Strong understanding SW Quality KPIs and Leading and Lagging Product Quality Indicators. 
 - Experience with proactive metrics and defect prevention strategies. 
 - Experience with industry quality standards and structured problem-solving methods (RCA, 5Why, 8D, CAPA etc). 
 - System FMEA experience is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of software reliability, and system-level integration challenges is a plus. 

Everything we'll do for you

You can grow a lasting career here. We'll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We'll help you learn and progress in a way that's right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We'll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27, 000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python + AI) - Remote
data.description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. 

We're Most Proud Of: 

- Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. 
 - Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world's greatest companies. 
 - Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. 
 - Our 4. 1-star rating on GlassDoor. 
 - Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. 

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client's problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production. 

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday. 

On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right. 

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don't hold up. 

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment: 

- Reframes the request. Treats "we need an agent for X" as a hypothesis, not a spec. 
 - Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints - before choosing technology. 
 - Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent - and defends why. 
 - Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won't deliver value. 

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE's first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch. 

- Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it's worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes. 
 - Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they're worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually. 
 - Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines - the things that kill projects in month two. 
 - Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success. 
 - Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with "why, " "how do you know, " and "what happens today when. . . " - without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better. 
 - Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology. 

What You'll Do

- Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. 
 - Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. 
 - Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture - data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted - plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Build. Ship working systems - agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. 
 - Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases. 
 - Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch - eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client's team run it without you. 
 - Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of professional software development experience with core proficiency in Python (or TypeScript/Node. js). 
 - Has shipped at least one agentic AI solution, LLM workflow, or RAG architecture to a production environment. 
 - Advanced English is required. 
 - Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI developer tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex) in daily workflows. 
 - Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls to translate unstructured business requirements into technical architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience building agentic systems using orchestration frameworks or APIs such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or direct LLM APIs. 
 - Proven experience taking full end-to-end technical ownership of features from discovery to deployment. 
 - Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. 
 - Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. 
 - Forensic attention to detail. 
 - A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. 
 - Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. 
 - Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. 
 - Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. 
 - Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. 

Strong Plus

- Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems. 
 - Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases. 
 - Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing). 
 - Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense. 
 - Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background. 
 - Client enablement and training - building the client team's capability, not just the system. 
 - Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts. 

Work Authorization Requirements

Leadership & Professional Skills

Tools & Technologies

Integration & APIs Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, authentication and API documentation tools

Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

data.title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

data.title: Senior Developer - Azure Full Stack / Custom Business Applications - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)
data.description:
Job Description

Title: Senior Developer - Azure Full Stack / Custom Business Applications - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)

Id: 21372

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer (SDE II) || Altera Institute - Digiaccel Learning

At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to redefine management education for the digital and AI-first world. We are building technology that powers transformative learning experiences for thousands of learners across India. From learner journeys and assessments to AI-enabled learning experiences and internal platforms, our engineering team plays a critical role in shaping the future of education. 

As a Senior Software Engineer II (SDE II), you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling high-performance web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work across the full technology stack, collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams, and take ownership of key product initiatives from ideation to deployment. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing clean and scalable code, and building products that create meaningful impact. 

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Development & Product Engineering

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express. js, React. js, Node. js, Nest. js). 
 - Build reusable, modular, and high-quality components that enhance application performance and maintainability. 
 - Translate business requirements and product specifications into elegant technical solutions. 
 - Own features end-to-end-from technical design and development to deployment and post-release monitoring. Engineering Excellence & Architecture

- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to engineering best practices and coding standards. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions that improve scalability and reliability. 
 - Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and help maintain a high engineering quality bar across the team. 
 - Continuously improve application performance, security, and overall system reliability. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Execution

- Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and fellow Engineers to define, prioritize, and deliver product features. 
 - Collaborate with QA teams to ensure high-quality releases through effective testing and validation. 
 - Support technical discussions, sprint planning, and estimation activities within the engineering team. 
 - Mentor junior developers and contribute to fostering a collaborative engineering culture. Performance Optimization & Problem Solving

- Identify bottlenecks and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, debug complex technical problems, and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Monitor application health and proactively improve system stability and user experience. Quality, Testing & Continuous Improvement

- Develop and maintain unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure application reliability. 
 - Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for applications, APIs, and engineering processes. 
 - Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices, driving continuous improvements within the engineering team. 

What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years of experience in full-stack software development using the MERN stack. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong proficiency in MongoDB, Express. js, React. js, NestJS and Node. js. 
 - Experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development
 - Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows. 
 - Exposure to Docker, cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD pipelines, or containerized deployments is desirable. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable solutions. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - High ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 

Why Join Us?

- Build Products That Matter - Create technology that impacts the learning journeys and careers of thousands of professionals. 
 - Engineering with Ownership - Work on challenging product problems where your ideas and technical decisions have meaningful influence. 
 - High-Growth Environment - Be part of a fast-scaling organization that values innovation, speed, and engineering excellence. 
 - Continuous Learning - Work alongside experienced product and engineering leaders while continuously expanding your technical expertise. 
 - Collaborative Culture - Join a team that believes in transparency, ownership, intellectual honesty, and continuous improvement. 

About the Company

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education. 

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift inthe skills ecosystemat the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA studentsfrom legacy institutes who are unplacedand professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don't have the skills to progress. 

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception. 

Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India's top digital commerce companies as it's investors. 

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a youngcompany and each role has the abilityto make a largeimpact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, actionoriented and collaborative environment. 

We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

The group you'll be a part of

WETS Deposition group at Lam India Global Hardware Technology (LIGHT) is hiring a Electrical Lead Engineer for its product development engineering and product ownership team.

As an Electrical Lead Engineer, owns and lead controls, instrumentation and electrical subsystem design for WETS modules. Act as a technical owner for medium - complex electrical subsystems across product lifecycle with reliability and cost goals. Drives safety, diagnostics, reliability, and performance of systems

Job Responsibilities

- Own and influence PDR process deliverables, technical deliverables, obtain design review approvals and achieve project milestones
 - Validates design using prototype or simulation and design verification testing (including test stand development). Safety policy & procedure adherence is mandatory

 - Work closely with firmware and software teams to define signal interfaces, IO behaviour, and control assumptions

Who We're Looking For

- Education: B. E. / B. Tech / M. E. / M. Tech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering

Core Competencies

- Proficient in system level understanding of Electro-Mechanical Sub-systems (Semi-conductor/Automotive/Aerospace), Power Distribution/Control systems and/or Industrial Automation. 
 - Strong competency in communication protocols - RS485, EtherCAT and Ethernet TCP/IP. 
 - Strong experience in mixed circuit design(analog+digital) with strong experience in circuit analysis & simulation, with good hands-on experience in lab testing & validation
 - Good experience in motion control systems - handling drives like Yaskawa/Beckhoff
 - Define and design instrumentation architecture - Temperature, pressure, flow, proximity, position and safety sensors and expert level skill in sensor interfacing and actuators

Desirable Competencies

- Experience in Semiconductor Wafer Fab Equipment (WFE) domain.

 - Good to have worked on control & simulation tools preferably MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent. 
 - Good to have PCBA design skills with CID certification
 - Basic understanding of pneumatic and hydraulic control systems is added advantage

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. 

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. 'Virtual Flex' you'll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

You act as the bridge between business stakeholders, clinical operations teams, and technical teams to ensure the platform is configured to meet business and regulatory requirements. data.title: AI Product Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others. 

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving. 

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance

- Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar. 
 - Detect drift early: identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead. 
 - Track portfolio health through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders. 

Technical Assurance

- Assess solution architecture and engineering practice for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability. 
 - Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence. 
 - Review operational risk: hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live. 

Best-Practice Translation & Enablement

- Identify what works in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions. 
 - Spread learning across teams by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery. 
 - Help teams solve operational problems as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio. 

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

- Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads to align roadmap, technical feasibility and delivery priorities, and to surface cross-solution dependencies and shared-platform needs. 
 - Guide and mentor the solution delivery leads and architects across the portfolio; set expectations on delivery discipline and engineering quality, and give feedback on their performance. 
 - Escalate clearly: raise risks and decisions with options and recommendations to program governance and senior leadership. 

Qualifications

Must have

- BE/B. Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MBA / PG is a plus. 
 - 12+ years in IT services, product engineering or platform delivery, with a progression through developer, architect and delivery roles; has led or overseen more than one solution or team at a time. 
 - Strong technical grounding, enough to challenge architecture, code quality and engineering practice credibly: APIs and microservices, data pipelines, CI/CD, containers, observability and security. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler's cloud and AI services and how they integrate with enterprise systems. 
 - Working knowledge of GenAI / Agentic AI solutions in production: LLM integration, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, LLMOps. 
 - Experience running review and governance mechanisms (design reviews, stage gates, release-readiness checks) across several concurrent programs. 
 - Proven ability to codify and transfer best practices across teams, such as playbooks, standards and reference architectures. 

Good to have

- Experience in a product-company or product-engineering environment, working with product managers on roadmaps and releases. 
 - Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, model-evaluation tooling and agent interoperability standards (e. g. MCP). 
 - Hyperscaler AI certification(s) and/or PMP / Scrum / SAFe certification. 
 - Exposure to responsible-AI, data privacy and compliance requirements for enterprise AI. 

Expected Impact

- Solutions across the IAIS portfolio are built as per roadmap, with early detection of drift and fewer late surprises. 
 - Consistent engineering quality and release readiness across solutions, rather than strong in some and weak in others. 
 - Best practices and lessons learned travel quickly between solutions, reducing rework and raising team capability. 
 - Delivery teams resolve operational and technical problems faster because proven fixes and experts are readily available. 
 - Stakeholders have a single, credible, KPI-driven view of portfolio delivery health. 

Skills

Solution Portfolio Review, Roadmap Conformance Tracking, Technical Assurance, GenAI / Agentic AI Architecture Understanding, Hyperscaler / Cloud Integration, Best-Practice Codification, Delivery Governance, Technical Problem Solving, Coaching & Mentoring, Product-Engineering Partnership, Risk/Issue Management, KPI & Metrics Reporting, Stakeholder Management

Role Overview

You will oversee end-to-end engineering of PCBA-based testing and automation systems - including ICT (In-Circuit Test), FVT (Functional Validation Test) fixtures, robotic integration, and automated equipment design - within high-volume manufacturing. Your expertise will span hardware design, automation systems, process engineering, and equipment deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Fixture & PCBA Design

- Design ICT/FVT test fixtures, including PCBA-based interface boards, load boards, and DUT connectors. 
 - Develop high-precision fixture layouts for electrical testing, pogo-pin sockets, and contact validation. 
 - Ensure SI/PI integrity for high-speed signals (e. g. digital I/O, RF, power rails), using controlled impedance designs and board stack-up practices.

Validation & Debug

- Drive hardware bring-up, fault diagnosis, and test debug during NPI/test-floor integration.

Collaboration & Leadership

- Partner with cross-functional teams: process engineering, product/test engineering, SMT/assembly, and quality. 
 - Lead design reviews, project timelines, and handoffs for ICT/FVT and automation milestones. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, oversee vendor qualification for probe/fixture suppliers and robotic integrators. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering. 
 - 5-10+ years in PCBA test fixture design, automation tooling, robotic system deployment, or equipment engineering in electronics manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience with ICT, FVT, flying-probe, functional testers, or test handler systems. 
 - Strong background in PLC programming (Siemens, Allen‐Bradley, Omron), HMI design, and robot motion/control integration. 
 - Practical skills in SI/PI simulation and PCB layout tools (Cadence Allegro/SiWave, Mentor Xpedition, PADS). 
 - Solid understanding of DFM/DFA, SMT/ICT/FVT process environments, statistical process control, and quality systems (Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA). 
 - Hands-on debugging, validation, and automation deployment experience in manufacturing test floors. 
 - 6+ years of hands‐on experience with LabVIEW development and NI hardware platforms (e. g. cRIO, PXI, DAQms)

Preferred & Soft Skills

- Expertise in designing fixtures and robotic test integrators for high-speed PCBA testing. 
 - Experience with IIoT data analytics, predictive maintenance, and digital twin simulation workflows. 
 - Effective communicator with strong documentation and cross-functional leadership. 
 - Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing and automated test environments.

data.title: Senior Salesforce Tester
data.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company's patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www. azurity. com. 

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization. 

About The Role

Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self-driven, hands-on team member who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 

The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives. 

The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Strategy

- Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications. 
 - Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies. 
 - Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities. 

Functional & Regression Testing

- Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities. 
 - Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance-related business processes. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations. 
 - Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes. 
 - Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments. 

Integration & Data Testing

- Test integrations with third-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions. 
 - Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman. 
 - Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes. 
 - Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems. 
 - Support testing of end-to-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications. 

Compliance & Security Testing

- Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions. 
 - Perform role-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification. 
 - Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements. 
 - Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems. 

Performance & Automation Testing

- Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites. 
 - Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads. 
 - Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance. 
 - Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities. 

Defect Tracking & Collaboration

- Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X-Ray, or similar test management tools. 
 - Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities. 

Continuous Improvement & Best Practices

- Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices. 
 - Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes. 
 - Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 7+ years of experience in Salesforce testing, preferably within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries. 
 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud. 
 - Strong knowledge of manual and automated testing frameworks for Salesforce applications. 
 - Experience testing Salesforce integrations with pharmaceutical platforms such as IQVIA, Veeva, SAP, Sales Enablement tools, Snowflake, and MDM solutions. 
 - Proficiency in Salesforce Administration, Flows, Apex test classes, and Lightning Web Component (LWC) testing. 
 - Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP), Postman, and Data Cloud validation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release management practices. 
 - Understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements. 
 - Experience using JIRA, X-Ray, or similar test management and defect-tracking tools. 
 - Basic Python knowledge to support test automation and data validation activities. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a global offshore-onshore delivery model. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release pipelines. 
 - Experience validating Snowflake, MDM, SAP, Veeva, IQVIA, MedPro, or other pharmaceutical data integrations. 
 - Basic Python skills for test utilities, data validation, or automation support. 
 - Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery, risk-based testing, and software quality practices in a regulated environment. 
 - Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial operations and HCP/HCO engagement processes. 
 - Experience with Data Cloud, AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities, and advanced automation frameworks. 

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

Drive production issue resolution, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive improvements.

Deployment frequency

Lead time for changes

Change failure rate

Mean time to recovery

Partner with SRE, Operations, Infrastructure, Security, and Support teams to improve service reliability and resilience. 

Proactively identify automation opportunities, recurring issues, and support pain points. 

Required Experience & Skills

Proven experience managing software engineering teams in enterprise-scale environments. 

Strong people leadership skills with ability to coach, mentor, motivate, and develop engineers. 

Strong DQ and EQ with demonstrated ability to lead with empathy, fairness, accountability, and transparency. 

Experience owning and operating production services in a high-volume, mission-critical platform. 

Strong understanding of full stack engineering, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, databases, and integrations. 

Experience with cloud platforms, private/public cloud environments, containers, CI/CD, observability, and DevOps practices. 

Understanding of multi-tenant platforms, customer-specific configurations, production support, and operational readiness. 

Practical knowledge of DORA metrics and engineering productivity improvements. 

Strong agile delivery, planning, risk management, and stakeholder management skills. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong documentation discipline. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, payments, rewards, loyalty, or large-scale customer-facing platforms. 

Experience supporting globally distributed, multi-tenant platforms. 

Experience with legacy modernization and cloud-native transformation. 

Experience improving production stability, operational readiness, and engineering maturity. 

Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, audit, and regulatory expectations. 

Exposure to automation, developer productivity, or AI-assisted engineering practices is a plus. 

Success Measures

The successful candidate will be measured by their ability to: 

Build and retain a strong, motivated, and accountable engineering team. 

Lead with decency, empathy, clarity, and ownership. 

Ensure team-owned services are reliable, secure, scalable, and operationally ready. 

Deliver commitments predictably with high engineering quality. 

Improve production stability, observability, incident response, and DORA metrics. 

Maintain clear documentation and alignment across stakeholders. 

Support modernization of the Mastercard Rewards Platform while ensuring platform stability for global customers. 

Summary

This role is ideal for an engineering manager who can combine people leadership, service ownership, delivery execution, operational excellence, and strong communication. The Manager, Software Engineering will lead teams responsible for building, modernizing, and operating key capabilities within the Mastercard Rewards Platform while ensuring quality, reliability, and accountability at global scale. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2, 500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. 

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. 

Principal Engineer - Backend

About Payoneer

Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Principal Engineer - Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems. 

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence. 

As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems. 

The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol). 

What You'll Do

- Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms. 
 - Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure. 
 - Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains. 
 - Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams. 
 - Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity. 
 - Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt. 
 - Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value. 
 - Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems. 
 - Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority. 
 - Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness. 
 - Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities. 

What We're Looking For

- Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability. 
 - Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains. 
 - Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders. 
 - Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes. 
 - Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment. 

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build. 

You Will: 

- Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms. 
 - Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems. 
 - Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices. 
 - Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies. 
 - Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate. 
 - Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms. 
 - Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership. 

Why This Role

The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership. 

You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI-first world. 

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer's partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it. 

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today. 

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

data.description:
Backend Software Engineer - Integrations

Location: Bengaluru, India

Employment: Full-time

Work Model: Hybrid preferred; Remote and onsite options also considered

Experience: Ideally 2+ years; exceptional candidates with less experience may be considered

Compensation: 22-24 LPA INR, based on interview performance and skill set

About the Role

Our client is a healthcare technology company helping senior living communities manage resident and staff profiles, care activity, and operational data. 

The challenge is that this information often lives across different systems - EHRs, engagement platforms, billing systems, and other applications. 

As a Backend Software Engineer - Integrations, you'll build and maintain the backend systems that connect these platforms. The role is highly hands-on and approximately 99% focused on coding, debugging, documentation, and testing. 

You'll work with Java and Spring Boot to build reliable integrations, troubleshoot complex data flows, and ensure systems work correctly in production. Partner communication will primarily be handled by the US-based team, allowing you to focus on the technical implementation and delivery. 

This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role reporting directly to the Engineering Manager, within a team of approximately 10-12 developers. 

What You'll Do

- Build, maintain, and improve backend integrations between CarePredict and external systems. 
 - Develop backend services using Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, and AWS. 
 - Design and consume REST APIs, working with authentication, pagination, idempotency, retries, webhooks, and error handling. 
 - Analyze API documentation and understand how external systems map to internal data models. 
 - Identify data mapping, transformation, and integration gaps. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code. 
 - Debug complex integration and backend issues and identify root causes. 
 - Test integrations end to end and validate functionality before production release.

 - Monitor and troubleshoot integrations after deployment. 
 - Create and maintain clear technical and integration documentation. 
 - Contribute to technical design decisions and continuously improve integration workflows. 
 - Take ownership of assigned systems and problems from development through production support.

Must Have

 - Strong hands-on experience with Java. 
 - Production experience with Spring Boot. 
 - Hands-on experience building or consuming REST APIs. 
 - Understanding of API concepts such as authentication, pagination, retries, idempotency, webhooks, and error handling. 
 - Strong understanding of relational databases and SQL. 
 - Experience debugging backend applications and troubleshooting production issues. 
 - Ability to write clean, maintainable code and clear technical documentation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical tasks.

Technology Stack

 - Spring Boot
 - MySQL

 - Datadog

Role Structure & Team

 - This role is primarily focused on hands-on engineering rather than partner or stakeholder management. 

Working Hours & Location

 - Standard working commitment is 8-9 hours per day.

Compensation & Benefits

 - 15 National Holidays

Ideal Candidate

You'll thrive in this role if you: 

- Enjoy solving backend and integration problems through code. 
 - Are comfortable debugging issues and investigating root causes. 
 - Can work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables. 
 - Have strong Java and Spring Boot fundamentals. 
 - Care about writing reliable, maintainable production code.
