data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you "Create your own sunshine"- by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community. 

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you'll find yourself becoming 'Better every day' through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you 'Take charge' and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we 'Thrive together' and support each other's journeys. "

Background Of The Initiative

Sun Pharma CSR implements a wide range of infrastructure and community development initiatives including healthcare facilities, educational infrastructure, water and sanitation assets, community buildings and rural development projects. The organisation seeks an engineering professional to provide technical oversight, quality assurance and project governance across all CSR construction projects nationwide

Position Overview

The Engineer - CSR Projects will be responsible for planning, monitoring, quality assurance, procurement coordination, technical verification, payment facilitation and reporting for all CSR construction and infrastructure projects. The role will ensure that projects are executed within approved budgets, timelines and quality standards while creating sustainable community assets. 

Responsibilities

Project Planning & Technical Assessment: 

Review project proposals and assess technical feasibility. 

Prepare, review and validate BOQs, cost estimates, drawings and specifications. Standardise BOQ templates, Engineering SOPs, QA/QC protocol

Support budgeting, project planning and implementation scheduling. 

Recommend cost-effective and sustainable engineering solutions. 

Construction Monitoring & Site Supervision

Conduct regular site visits across India. 

Track project progress against timelines and milestones. 

Monitor contractor performance and implementation quality. 

Identify risks and recommend corrective actions. 

Technical Oversight & Quality Assurance

Verify quality of materials and workmanship. 

Ensure compliance with engineering standards, safety norms and approved designs. 

Conduct technical audits and quality inspections. 

Maintain quality control documentation. 

Climate resilient. Green building practice wherever possible and is cost effective

Measurement, Verification & Certification

Verify executed quantities against approved BOQs. 

Review contractor bills and work completion claims. 

Certify stage-wise progress and milestone completion. 

Conduct final verification before asset handover. 

Documentation, MIS & Reporting

Prepare site reports, progress reports and technical reviews. 

Develop project completion reports and closure documentation. 

Maintain drawings, approvals, photographs and technical records. 

Support management reviews and audits. 

Technical risk register and mitigation planning

Procurement & Payment Coordination

Prepare Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for approved requirements. 

Coordinate with Procurement teams for timely issuance of Purchase Orders (POs). 

Track procurement status and prevent implementation delays. 

Facilitate vendor and contractor payment release as per PO terms, contracts and milestones. 

Verify invoices, supporting documents and work certifications before payment processing. 

Maintain complete procurement and payment records for audit compliance. 

Ensure Quality engineering (quality vs cost)

Stakeholder Management & Asset Handover

Coordinate with NGOs, implementing agencies, consultants, contractors and government stakeholders. 

Provide technical guidance throughout the project lifecycle. 

Technical appraisal of NGOs and vendor as required. 

Support asset handover, maintenance planning and sustainability measures. 

Provide technical inputs for impact assessments and evaluations. 

Conduct post-handover performance audit

Travel Estimate

Extensive travel across India

Job Scope

Job Requirements

Educational Qualification

Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (Mandatory)

Specific Certification

NA

Experience

10- 15 years of relevant experience in construction, infrastructure development, engineering supervision or project management. 

AutoCAD, MS Project, Primavera, GIS familiarity

Experience in healthcare, education, WASH, rural infrastructure or CSR projects preferred. 

Experience managing projects across multiple locations

Skill (Functional & Behavioural)

Technical & Behavioural Competencies: 

BOQ preparation and verification

Cost estimation and budgeting

Quality assurance and quality control

Vendor and contractor management, technical assessment

Project planning and scheduling

Excellent communication and stakeholder management

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

High integrity and accountability

Key Deliverables & KPIs

Projects completed within approved budgets and timelines. 

Quality compliance across all project sites. 

100% timely preparation of PRs for approved project requirements. 

Timely coordination of PO issuance within agreed timelines. 

Timely facilitation of contractor/vendor payments after verification of documentation and milestones. 

Zero project delays attributable to procurement coordination. 

Zero audit observations related to procurement, invoices, payments or technical documentation. 

Accurate and timely submission of progress reports, MIS reports and completion reports. 

Complete and audit-ready records of PRs, POs, contracts, invoices and certifications. 

Your Success Matters to Us

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let's create a brighter future together!

data.title: Principal Engineer (Java, AWS)
data.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101290

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of our AssetGraph Platform at scale. This is an exciting opportunity to work on Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and services that directly impact millions of Autodesk product users worldwide. 

In this role, you will drive technical strategy, influence platform direction, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable, resilient, and high-performing systems that support critical business outcomes. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, architects, and Product Management to shape platform capabilities, drive technical excellence, and deliver innovative solutions. 

This position is based in Pune, India. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of platform services using Java, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Redis, and Apache Kafka
 - Design and implement distributed, event-driven microservices architectures with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, latency, and observability
 - Take end-to-end ownership of platform capabilities, including architecture, engineering practices, software quality, deployment, operational excellence, and production support
 - Lead large-scale, complex, and ambiguous technical initiatives from requirements clarification through execution and successful delivery
 - Drive technical discussions and alignment across engineering teams, architects, Product Management, and Platform Engineering groups
 - Serve as a technical leader during production incidents, driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), issue resolution, and systemic improvements
 - Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing
 - Influence engineering direction across organizations and enable teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions
 - Establish and promote engineering best practices that improve platform reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align technical decisions with broader product and business objectives

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in back-end development and distributed systems
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Redis, and Docker
 - Proven experience designing and developing scalable, highly available distributed platforms and microservices
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams
 - Strong technical leadership, analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and mentoring skills
 - Ability to make sound architectural decisions while balancing scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing and operating large-scale, event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka or similar messaging technologies
 - Experience building and maintaining cloud-native applications and distributed systems on Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 - Familiarity with observability, monitoring, incident management, and production reliability practices
 - Experience leading architectural reviews and defining engineering standards across multiple teams
 - Experience optimizing distributed systems for performance, scalability, latency, and operational efficiency
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across engineering organizations

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced and technically accomplished engineering professional who combines deep expertise in distributed systems, strategic thinking, and strong technical leadership to build scalable, resilient, and reliable platforms that deliver meaningful business outcomes

- Demonstrates deep technical expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and modern software engineering practices
 - Applies sound architectural judgment and analytical thinking to solve complex technical challenges
 - Designs scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems while balancing performance, reliability, security, and operational efficiency
 - Takes ownership of complex technical initiatives and drives them from architecture and design through implementation and production support
 - Influences technical strategy and architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams and organizations
 - Approaches ambiguous engineering challenges with creativity, structured problem-solving, and a focus on practical solutions
 - Builds strong partnerships with Architects, Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders
 - Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Mentors engineers, shares technical knowledge, and contributes to a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning
 - Identifies opportunities to improve engineering practices, platform capabilities, and operational processes
 - Demonstrates accountability, ownership, and the ability to work independently while guiding teams through complex technical decisions
 - Connects technical initiatives with broader product objectives and business outcomes to deliver long-term platform value

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software - from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. 

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk - it's at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. 

When you're an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk's competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate's experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. 

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https: //www. autodesk. com/company/global-belonging

data.title: Outsystems Platforms - DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Location - Gurgaon (On-site)

Responsibilities

- Own the strategic direction of the OutSystems platform, including evolution, feature-request intake and prioritization across business subdomains, and long-term roadmap alignment with enterprise architecture
 - Design and maintain standardized application templates, reusable foundation controls, and the organization's OutSystems design language to improve consistency and accelerate delivery
 - Own and continuously enhance the end-to-end CI/CD framework (PR-based deployment model, quality gates, versioning, artifact storage, environment-independent deployments, and automated code analysis)
 - Establish and operationalize testing and quality practices across the platform (BDD frameworks, visual regression testing, static analysis, schema review tooling), including enablement and adoption across teams
 - Help work with Infrastructure team to help manage OutSystems infrastructure across all environments, including platform and database upgrades, provisioning, build-agent management, certificate lifecycle, air-gap solutioning, and environment-specific configuration automation
 - Help work with Security team to drive the platform security posture, including authentication modernization (OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID), PKI certificate management, security assessments, and approvals/compliance coordination with enterprise security
 - Build and maintain integration frameworks (REST APIs with Azure AD auth, Elastic/Kibana observability, Kafka/event-driven patterns, SailPoint identity provisioning, and API-level RBAC)
 - Introduce developer productivity tooling, including AI-driven enablement (LLM integrations, agentic bot frameworks, ML-powered code review, and MCP client rollout)
 - Define and enforce guardrails and standards; maintain documentation; and support teams through enablement and hands-on guidance

Your Profile

Success is measured by how well the OutSystems platform scales across the organization: teams can build and deploy reliably, new teams can onboard quickly, and the platform's infrastructure, security, and CI/CD practices remain stable under increasing demand. Key indicators include adoption of shared standards/templates, the stability and evolution of the deployment pipeline, and well-documented, audit-ready practices suitable for a regulated environment. 

- Deep expertise in OutSystems (O11 and ODC): architecture, Lifetime, Service Studio, Integration Studio, and platform administration
 - Strong CI/CD and DevOps skills: Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), Git branching strategies, JFrog Artifactory, build-agent management, and PowerShell scripting
 - Hands-on security and identity experience: Azure AD / Entra ID, OpenID Connect, SAML, PKI certificate management, and SailPoint integration
 - Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns: REST APIs, Kafka, Elastic/Kibana/Logstash, OpenAPI, and WebSockets
 - Experience building and operationalizing quality practices: BDD, visual regression testing, SonarQube, and automated code review tooling
 - Working knowledge of AI/ML integration: LLM integration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), bot framework development, and practical use of AI in developer tooling
 - Infrastructure management skills: SQL Server, Windows Server (OutSystems hosting), environment provisioning, and air-gap architecture
 - Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including security/architecture/vendor teams
 - High ownership and autonomy-you can prioritize, plan, build, test, deploy, document, and support independently across a broad scope
 - Experience with OutSystems ODC Early Access Programs, solution-level deployments, or parallel deployment architectures
 - Familiarity with financial services and regulated industry requirements
 - Knowledge of low-code platform licensing cost optimization
 - Enterprise-level vendor management experience

We get curious people invested in the world

Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success. 

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations. 

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense. 

At Saxo we don't just offer a job - we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

data.title: IT Application Specialist
data.description:
The Opportunity

Hitachi Energy is driving digital transformation across its global manufacturing network through advanced industrial automation, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and data-driven solutions. As factories continue to evolve toward smarter and more connected operations, there is an increasing need for skilled engineers who can design, implement, test, and support these solutions across diverse manufacturing environments. In this role, you will work with state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies, integrating MES, industrial automation systems, quality and production applications, data analytics, and digital tools that enable operational excellence. As solutions become more sophisticated and customized to meet factory-specific needs, extensive collaboration, testing, validation, and continuous improvement are required to ensure successful deployment and long-term business value. This is an exciting opportunity to work with global teams, support digital transformation initiatives, engage directly with factory stakeholders and customers, and contribute to the future of smart manufacturing at Hitachi Energy. 

How Will You Make An Impact

- Design, configure, implement, verify, and commission systems to meet customer and project requirements. 
 - Lead control activities, ensuring compliance with project schedules, budgets, quality standards, and technical specifications. 
 - Develop, test, and optimize system functionalities for industrial and energy applications. 
 - Coordinate hardware integration activities, including interfacing with other systems and plataforms. 
 - Plan and execute In ternal Acceptance Tests (IAT), Software Acceptance Tests (SAT), and commissioning activities while maintaining detailed test records and technical documentation. 
 - Act as a technical focal point between project management teams, local and global offices, and customers during project execution. 
 - Participate in meetings, workshops, and technical reviews to ensure alignment and successful project delivery. 
 - Support on-site commissioning activities and provide troubleshooting assistance during system startup and operational phases. 
 - Ensure compliance with internal procedures, industry standards, and safety regulations throughout all project phases. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, knowledge sharing, and best practices within the engineering organization. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, Power Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in industrial control systems, automation, system integration, testing, or commissioning. 
 - Experience with control logic development, MES systems, systems integration, Internal Acceptance Testing (IAT), Software Acceptance Testing (SAT), and commissioning activities. 
 - Strong knowledge of power systems, industrial automation, communication protocols, and control system architectures. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and work effectively in multidisciplinary and international project environments. 
 - Experience managing technical deliverables while ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and project requirements. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with proficiency in spoken and written English. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for testing, commissioning, and technical support activities.

What We Offer

Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That's what we're passionate about at Magna Powertrain, and we do it by creating world-class powertrain systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex powertrain systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain. 

Job Responsibilities

Job title: 

Specialist Durability

Job Introduction

Durability Systems Engineer is responsible for ensuring that a system can withstand its intended operating conditions throughout its design life. This role combines simulation (virtual validation) and testing (physical validation) to Durability. 

Major Responsibilities

- Perform Fatigue analysis with FEMFAT, ncode, Hyper life for powertrain components
 - Deep simulation understanding of Dynamic Analysis for Vibration test. (Sine and Random signals)
 - Deep simulation understanding of Thermo-mechanical analysis with Abaqus (CREEP and Plastic strain)
 - Perform Mounting fatigue strength analysis. 
 - Able to perform Mechanical shock and Cylinder test explicitly. 
 - Development of test specifications, test procedure and test reports. 
 - Data analysis for test data and failure analysis. 

Knowledge And Education

Bachelor's/master's in mechanical/mechatronics engineering from Reputed institution. 

Work Experience

8-10 years of professional experience working in the field of Durability simulations (preferably in automotive transmission systems). 

Skills And Competencies

- Advanced Knowledge of HyperMesh, Ansa, Optistuct, Abaqus, FEMFAT and Ncode
 - Good knowledge of Radioss or LSDyna
 - Scripting Skills for MATLAB and Python
 - Deep understanding of material behaviour
 - Good Knowledge of Microsoft Office tools
 - Problem solving approach
 - Correlation test reports with Simulation
 - Modelling of Printed Circuit boards for simulations is added advantage

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

Maintains safe work practices, complies with Magna H&S requirements, and participates in training and hazard reporting.

We believe it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45, 000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!). 

We're looking for Senior QA Engineers with strong experience in manual or automated testing, skilled in ensuring the quality of high-performance, scalable systems, and committed to quality best practices. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning quality end-to-end and collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to ship reliable, well-crafted software.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. 

Job Title

Advisor, Solutions Architecture

About Your Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Architect to join our dynamic team at Fiserv. As a Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and innovative payment processing solutions for our clients. Your expertise will contribute to the success of our organization by providing technical guidance, overseeing the development of robust payment systems, and ensuring seamless integration with client applications. 

What You'll Do

- Solution Design: Collaborate with clients, business stakeholders, and development teams to define and design end-to-end payment processing solutions that meet business requirements, industry standards, and security regulations. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership and expertise throughout the entire project lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, development, testing, implementation, and support. Drive architectural decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and secure. 
 - System Integration: Evaluate existing systems and develop integration strategies to ensure seamless communication and data exchange between payment processing systems and client applications, such as e-commerce platforms, mobile apps, and point-of-sale (POS) systems. 
 - API Development: Design and document APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) to facilitate secure and efficient communication between various payment systems and client applications. Collaborate with development teams to ensure proper implementation and adherence to industry standards. 
 - Security and Compliance: Ensure that payment processing solutions adhere to industry security standards (such as PCI DSS) and comply with relevant regulations. Identify potential security risks, recommend, and implement appropriate controls and safeguards. 
 - Technical Consultation: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing technical guidance, best practices, and recommendations related to payment processing technologies, trends, and emerging industry standards. 
 - Documentation and Training: Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, design specifications, user guides, and training materials. Conduct training sessions for internal teams and clients as necessary. 
 - Collaboration and Teamwork: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, quality assurance engineers, and operations teams, to ensure successful delivery of payment processing solutions. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members. 

Experience You'll Need To Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 - Deep understanding of payment processing technologies, including payment gateways, card networks, tokenization, encryption, fraud prevention, and risk management.

 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess complex business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

🚀 About Joveo

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work.

🌟 About the role

Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on. 

You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop. 

For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost. 

🧠 What you'll do

- Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service. 
 - Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand. 
 - Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible. 
 - Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs. 
 - Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions. 
 - Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability.

- You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field.

 - You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results. 
 - Experience launching a service, turning pilots into repeat programs or operating expert contributor networks is especially relevant. We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold.

You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience. 

This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.

Job Description

data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work. 

Principal AI Engineer

TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You build the intelligent features that make software feel like magic, and you make them work in production. You are equally at home shipping a clean API, standing up a RAG pipeline, evaluating an agent, or tuning guardrails so an LLM behaves safely at scale. You are excited by the current moment in AI and pragmatic about where it actually adds value. 

As Principal AI Engineer, you design and build the AI capabilities that differentiate an OpCo's modernized applications: GenAI features, agentic workflows, and ML-powered functionality, integrated safely and reliably. You work side by side with the Technical Lead / Architect, contribute as a strong full-stack engineer, and help the whole pod raise its game in AI-native development. 

If you want to turn the frontier of applied AI into shipped, dependable product features, this role is for you. 

About the PodA TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do
 - Ship production AI/ML features: Design, build, and deploy GenAI integrations, agentic workflows, RAG and GraphRAG systems, and ML-powered functionality into the OpCo's modernized applications. 
 - Orchestrate and integrate LLMs: Implement LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, and evaluation to deliver reliable, safe, production-grade AI. 
 - Engineer cloud-native services: Build scalable, secure, resilient services that host and serve AI capabilities, as a strong hands-on contributor. 
 - Build agents and tooling: Develop AI agents and tooling, including building and connecting MCP servers and tools, and champion agentic development practices across the pod's SDLC. 
 - Own data and retrieval: Design the data, retrieval, and vector or knowledge-graph infrastructure that powers GenAI features, with quality, performance, and security built in. 
 - Own technical design and quality: Lead design and implementation for AI features, write clean, well-tested code, and uphold engineering standards, security, and observability. 
 - Collaborate and mentor: Partner with the Architect and senior engineers, and coach the team on AI/ML engineering best practices. 
 - Apply pragmatic judgment: Know where AI adds real value versus risk, and navigate a fast-moving landscape with a clear head. What You Bring
 - Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, with significant hands-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production. 
 - Production experience on AWS or Azure (required): You have designed and built cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure, including containers, serverless, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus. 
 - Applied AI/ML: Demonstrated experience implementing GenAI capabilities (RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrail design) and/or ML features in production systems. 
 - Agentic and GenAI frameworks: Hands-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools. 
 - Software engineering depth: Strong full-stack ability with solid SQL/No-SQL and API design skills. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - AI-native tooling: Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow. 
 - Engineering principles: Solid grounding in DDD, design patterns, clean code, test-driven development, and application security. 
 - DevSecOps: Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud-native observability. 
 - Collaboration: Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have
 - Deep LLM and vector database expertise: hybrid vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced prompt and guardrail design for enterprise AI safety. 
 - Experience fine-tuning or evaluating models, building eval harnesses, or implementing LLM observability. 
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - Prior experience modernizing or re-platforming enterprise or B2B applications. What Success Looks Like
 - First 90 days: You have shipped your first production AI feature, established reliable patterns for orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, and the pod has a clear, safe approach to building with LLMs. 
 - First 6 months: AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship. Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
 - Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. Should You Apply?We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes. 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.   

Protect yourself by following these steps: 

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware. com email address. 
 - Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond - instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware. com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.

You'll be part of the DevOps and Assurance team within Bain's Next Generation Software Solutions (NGSS) department - a multidisciplinary engineering organization responsible for building, operating, and scaling Bain's next-generation digital products and platforms. 

The DevOps and Assurance team plays a critical role in enabling secure, efficient, and reliable delivery of technology solutions across Bain's global ecosystem. The group focuses on both technical operations and platform assurance, ensuring that every deployment meets the firm's high standards for quality, security, and compliance. 

What You'll Do

We are looking for an accomplished DevOps engineer to drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cloud infrastructure and software delivery processes. In this role, you will lead efforts to build and scale CI/CD pipelines, provision and operate Azure infrastructure, and ensure security and reliability across the deployment lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate will work in close partnership with software development, QA, and security teams to foster a culture of automation, performance excellence, and operational resilience. This position requires both strong technical expertise and the ability to guide best practices and mentor engineers across teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Automation - 30%

- Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Terraform Cloud. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security across environments. 
 - Architect and manage Azure networking: VNet/subnet design, private endpoints, DNS resolution, NSG rules, and Front Door Premium configuration. 
 - Provision and maintain Azure platform services: App Services, Azure SQL, Azure OpenAI, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Key Vault, Entra ID, and Storage Accounts (ADLS Gen2). 

Cloud & Platform Management (Azure) - 25%

- Manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pools, scaling, spot instances, and workload connectivity to dependent services (databases, storage, AI services). 
 - Manage identity and access: Entra ID app registrations, managed identities, RBAC, and integration with external IdPs (Okta). 
 - Administer database platforms from an infrastructure perspective: Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Cosmos DB - including connectivity, Entra auth, firewall rules, and private endpoints. 
 - Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability across dev, demo, and production environments. 

CI/CD & Software Delivery - 20%

- Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for container builds, infrastructure deployments, and application releases. 
 - Manage container image lifecycle: build, scan, push to ACR, and deploy to AKS or App Services. 
 - Implement environment promotion workflows with appropriate gating, secrets management (Key Vault), and rollback strategies. 
 - Design and operate GitHub-hosted private runners where required, including network integration with Azure VNets. 

Monitoring, Security & Assurance - 15%

- Implement and operate observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability. 
 - Respond to security findings: triage, containment, IAM scoping, container image CVE remediation, and endpoint hardening. 
 - Handle L2/L3 incident escalations, including root-cause analysis, user journey tracing, and log analysis. 
 - Enforce solution compliance across products: network isolation, least-privilege access, secrets hygiene, and deployment guardrails. 

Leadership & Collaboration - 10%

- Partner with architects, product engineers, and security teams to align on infrastructure standards and platform roadmaps. 
 - Promote DevOps culture, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across the NGSS engineering organization. 
 - Contribute to technical discovery, POCs, and innovation work streams to validate new tools, technologies, and architectural patterns. 
 - Support team recruiting activities: resume screening, technical interviews, and candidate evaluation. 

About You

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or cloud platform engineering roles. 
 - Proven track record of designing and operating cloud infrastructure in production environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional engineering teams in fast-paced product organizations. 

Professional Skills & Mindset

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for diverse stakeholders. 
 - Proactive, analytical, and systematic - strong problem-solving skills with the ability to trace issues across multiple layers (DNS, networking, identity, application). 
 - Results-driven with a bias for automation and continuous improvement. 
 - Familiarity with Agile methodologies and a commitment to team enablement. 

Technical Expertise

- Hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud (or equivalent) - workspace management, state, modules, and remote backends. 
 - Strong proficiency in Azure services, including AKS, Networking (VNets, subnets, private endpoints, NSGs, DNS zones), App Services, Key Vault, Container Registry, and Storage Accounts. 
 - Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and container image lifecycle management. 
 - Expertise in roles, permissions, and IAM - particularly Microsoft Entra ID and Okta. 
 - Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related DevOps toolchains. 
 - Proficient in Linux administration and automation scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) for reusable workflows. 
 - Experience with monitoring platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights. 
 - Familiarity with Azure private networking: private endpoints (blob, DFS, SQL, PostgreSQL), Private DNS Zones, and VNet integration for App Services and AKS. 
 - Competent in database deployment and management from an infrastructure perspective - Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, and Cosmos DB. 
 - Foundation in security remediation: container CVE patching, IAM scoping, NSG/firewall tightening, and WAF/Front Door rule management. 

Preferred Qualifications

data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

The Opportunity

The Monetization Team powers Postman pricing & packaging, and scales its business. 

We Build And Operate Mission-critical Billing Systems That Handle

- Payments & renewals
 - Subscription lifecycle
 - Sales, tax & compliance
 - Revenue systems
 - Post Purchase product onboarding

As Postman grows, we are evolving towards a config-driven, highly scalable platform that supports both self-serve and sales-led motions globally. 

We're looking for a Front End Senior Engineer who can lead the development of the user-facing platform, driving technical excellence in UI architecture and product innovation in the monetization experience. 

What You'll Do

- Build & Optimize Monetization Experiences Design, develop, and own the user interfaces for key monetization flows, including checkout, subscription management, and pricing pages. 
 - Drive UI Architecture and Performance Establish and enforce best practices for front-end architecture, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability across all user-facing features.

 - Raise the Engineering Bar Conduct thorough code reviews, define front-end best practices, mentor engineers, and influence decisions on UI technology stack and tooling. 

About You

- 6+ years of experience designing and building complex, high-traffic web applications.

 - Strong collaboration skills, comfortable working with and challenging PMs, EMs, and stakeholders. 
 - (Bonus) Experience with A/B testing frameworks and deep understanding of user experience principles in high-stakes transaction flows (e. g. , checkout, billing portals)
What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. data.title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems. 
 - Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide. 
 - Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them. 
 - Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience. 
 - Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

Under minimal direction, the Senior Manager, DCCA leads a DS, DP or FDP team based in India that creates and revises controlled GMP documentation for Amgen sites globally. The role owns the service-delivery model that enables reliable, compliant, and accurate documentation support - delivering to agreed service-level agreements while driving right-first-time quality, predictable turnaround, and continuous improvement. Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours. 

Role Responsibilities

Global Service Delivery and SLA Management

- Lead the daily operation of the global GMP documentation service for DS, DP, or FDP, ensuring requests are received, clarified, prioritized, assigned, completed, and handed off in accordance with defined service-level agreements. 
 - Establish transparent intake, triage, prioritization, and escalation practices that balance site criticality, compliance risk, business impact, and available capacity. 
 - Develop and maintain capacity plans, workload forecasts, staffing models, and recovery plans that enable the team to meet commitments across supported sites and time zones. 
 - Own performance management routines and dashboards for on-time delivery, right-first-time quality, cycle time, queue aging, rework, customer feedback, and resource utilization. 
 - Identify service risks early, communicate impacts and options clearly, and escalate constraints with proposed mitigation and recovery actions. 

GMP Documentation Quality and Compliance

- Ensure document creation and revision activities comply with applicable global and local GMP requirements, good documentation practices, data-integrity expectations, controlled-document procedures, and approved change-control processes. 
 - Set and maintain standards for document structure, technical writing, accuracy, traceability, version control, formatting, and review readiness to prevent defects before delivery. 
 - Oversee authoring and revision of controlled GMP documents, such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing and laboratory records, technical reports, and associated attachments, based on approved site inputs and change requirements. 
 - Oversee the content creation of training materials used in the manufacturing areas including instructional design. 
 - Implement appropriate peer review, quality checks, training, and escalation mechanisms to improve right-first-time acceptance and reduce avoidable rework. 
 - Support inspection and audit readiness; ensure service records, training, and performance evidence are complete, traceable, and review-ready. 
 - Oversee investigational support within the specific manufacturing domain. 

Global Partnership and Governance

- Serve as the senior-manager-level liaison between the India documentation team and global site stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, QC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other technical functions. 
 - Create effective governance forums with supported sites to review demand, priorities, service performance, quality trends, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Clarify and maintain accountability between the service team and site owners: the service team provides disciplined document development and revision support; site functions retain ownership of technical content, approvals, local requirements, and implementation decisions. 
 - Resolve complex cross-functional issues that could affect document quality, approval readiness, delivery timing, or compliance, using a risk-based approach. 

People Leadership and Organizational Capability

- Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of GMP documentation professionals, technical writers, and/or documentation specialists. 
 - Establish role clarity, training curricula, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans that build sustainable technical and leadership capability in India. 
 - Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning while maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and accountable work environment. 
 - Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to maintain an adaptable organization that can respond to changing global demand and business priorities. 

Operational Excellence and Strategic Improvement

- Standardize and continuously improve documentation workflows, templates, authoring practices, quality controls, and digital ways of working across the service. 
 - Lead cross-site projects and improvement initiatives that increase speed, accuracy, scalability, and customer experience without compromising compliance. 
 - Manage departmental headcount, training, technology, and operating budgets; optimize resources against the long-range demand plan. 
 - Represent the documentation service on global teams, task forces, and quality-system initiatives as needed. 

Service Performance and Quality Measures

The leader establishes goals and management routines that keep customer commitments, documentation quality, and compliance visible and balanced. 

Measure

Leadership expectation

On-time delivery

Meet committed site service-level agreements through active planning, workload balancing, and early escalation of risks. 

Right-first-time quality

Increase documents accepted without material rework by applying defined authoring standards, peer review, and quality checks before handoff. 

Cycle time and queue health

Monitor turnaround time, aging, backlog, and prioritization to maintain a predictable global service. 

Compliance performance

Maintain adherence to controlled-document, change-control, data-integrity, training, and audit-readiness requirements. 

Customer partnership and capacity

Use site feedback, demand forecasts, and workload data to improve service reliability and plan resource needs. 

Service-level targets and acceptance criteria are defined in collaboration with the supported sites and governing quality processes. 

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 12 to 17 years of experience

2 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, technical communications, business, or a related field. 
 - 7+ years of directly related experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical-device, or other regulated GMP environment, including 4+ years leading people, technical writers, documentation specialists, projects, or programs. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing and revising controlled GMP documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing or laboratory records, and related technical documentation. 
 - Experience operating a shared service or customer-facing function across multiple sites, cultures, and time zones, with accountability for service-level agreements and delivery metrics. 
 - Experience with electronic document-management and quality-management systems, document lifecycles, change control, and inspection or audit support. 
 - Lean, continuous-improvement, project-management, or operational-excellence experience is preferred. 

Core Competencies

- Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and capability building for a diverse technical team. 
 - Expert technical writing, editing, and review skills; sound judgment to distinguish content clarity, document quality, and compliance risk. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, good documentation practices, data integrity principles, controlled-document requirements, and change-management processes. 
 - Service-management discipline: intake, prioritization, workload planning, capacity modeling, performance dashboards, and timely risk escalation. 
 - Ability to influence global stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and operate effectively across time zones. 
 - Analytical problem solving, continuous-improvement mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage change without compromising quality while demonstrating a commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and Amgen values.

data.title: Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

data.description:
Meet The Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. We design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Cisco Silicon One (#CiscoSiliconOne) is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches all the way through web scale data centers and across service provider, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. 

Your Impact

- Responsible for implementing the Hardware Design-for-Test (DFT) features that support ATE, in-system test, debug and diagnostics needs of the designs. 
 - Responsible for development of innovative DFT IP in collaboration with the multi-functional teams, and play a key role in full chip design integration with the testability features coordinated in the RTL. 
 - Work closely with the design/design-verification and PD teams to enable the integration and validation of the Test logic in all phases of the implementation and post silicon validation flows. 
 - Your team will participate in the creation of Innovative Hardware DFT & physical design aspects for new silicon device models, bare die & stacked die, driving re-usable test and debug strategies. 
 - The job requires the candidate to have the ability to craft solutions and debug with minimal mentorship. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or a Master's Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required with at least 7-11 years of experience. 
 - Knowledge of the latest innovative trends in DFT, test and silicon engineering. 
 - Experience with Jtag protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan. 
 - Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime
 - Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design
 - Experience with Jtag protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan. 
 - Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime
 - Experience working with Gate level simulation, debugging with VCS and other simulators. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Post-silicon validation and debug experience; Ability to work with ATE patterns, P1687
 - Strong verbal skills and ability to thrive in a multifaceted environment
 - Scripting skills: Tcl, Python/Perl. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way.
