data.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end - from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface - and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on. 

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1-2 years) building AI-agentified applications - not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own features end to end - database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next. js) user interface - operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker. 
 - Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next. js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services. 
 - Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces. . 
 - Build and productionize AI-agentified features - agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling - grounded in 1-2 years of hands-on experience with these systems. 
 - Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers. 
 - Apply reliability engineering practices - observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews - to keep production systems healthy. 
 - Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning. 
 - Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend. 
 - Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked. 
 - Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos. 

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation). 
 - 1-2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production. . 
 - Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery. 

Technical Skills - Applied AI

- 1-2 years of hands-on experience building AI-agentified applications, including agent frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, or equivalent), tool/function-calling for LLMs. 
 - Practical understanding of AI-specific considerations: latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code or similar). 

Technical Skills - Full Stack

- Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next. js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing/SSR). 
 - Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs. 
 - Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization. 

Technical Skills - Distributed Systems & Reliability

- Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling. 
 - Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks. 
 - Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity. 

Soft Skills

- Proactive communication - shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early. 
 - Asks the right questions - clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation. 
 - Ownership mindset - treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets. 
 - Transparency - speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions. 
 - Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects - production deployment experience preferred. 
 - Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI). 
 - Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices. 
 - Testing experience across unit and integration levels. 
 - Experience with modern web app tooling - component libraries (e. g. , Tailwind, MUI) and state management (e. g. , Redux, Zustand). 
 - Exposure to cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers and infrastructure as code. 

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it's powered by the anime content we all love. 

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

We are considering applicants for the location of Hyderabad, India. 

Crunchyroll is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our India Engineering Center and help build the next generation of our member-focused eCommerce platform. 

The eCommerce platform is designed to create an exclusive experience for Crunchyroll members, including access to unique products and limited drops. An integral part of the member experience, the platform must be designed to deliver high-quality features, operate reliably at scale, and delight our fans. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across the Shop team, helping define the architecture, engineering strategy, and execution approach for critical eCommerce capabilities. You will remain hands-on while operating with a broad perspective: solving complex technical problems, shaping durable platform investments, raising engineering standards, and enabling other engineers to deliver with confidence. 

You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Product, Program Management, and other Engineering verticals to align on requirements, priorities, technical trade-offs, and dependencies. You will help turn ambiguous problems into clear technical direction and scalable solutions, while ensuring that features are delivered with strong operational ownership. 

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can connect customer and business outcomes to pragmatic technical decisions, influence across team and organizational boundaries, and establish patterns that improve the quality, reliability, and velocity of the Shop platform.

data.title: Principal/Senior/Software Engineer (AI-Powered Advertising Agents - AgenticOS)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for engineers with expertise in Generative AI and AI agent development. You will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced AI agents that leverage the latest technologies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and large language models (LLMs). You will work on developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance Generative AI capabilities and enable our platform to handle complex information retrieval, contextual generation, and adaptive interactions. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven features. Drive end-to-end ownership-from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release-while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast-paced Agile environment. 
 - Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures. 
 - Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long-term product strategy and technical roadmaps. 
 - Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine-tuning models, deploying pre-trained models, and evaluating their performance. 
 - Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content. 
 - Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms. 
 - Create sophisticated prompts and fine-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses. 
 - Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e. g. , Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems. 
 - Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI-driven capabilities into customer-facing products and internal tools. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company's offerings. 
 - Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

We'd Love For You To Have

- 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles - transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning. 
 - Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, multi-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short-term and long-term). 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs). 
 - In-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus. 
 - Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails - tools like Langfuse or equivalent - to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems. 
 - Proficiency in prompt engineering - crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context-sensitive, domain-specific LLM outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers. 
 - Experience with data preprocessing, vectorization, and handling large-scale datasets. 
 - Ability to present complex technical ideas and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience in building AI agents using graph-based architectures, including knowledge graph embeddings and graph neural networks (GNNs). 
 - Experience with training small base models using custom data, including data collection, pre-processing, and fine-tuning models to specific domains or tasks. 
 - Familiarity with deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, or ad auction mechanics. 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-integration standards
 - Publication or contributions to research in AI, LLMs, or related fields. 

Qualification

Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!. 

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

data.title: DevOps & AIOps Engineer REQ_122
data.description:
Embark on an exciting journey into the realm of AI Product Engineering with 3Pillar!

Collaboration & SysOps Partnership

Platform & Multi-Cloud Development

Required Experience

- Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success.

What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?

Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.

data.title: DevOps Engineer (WordPress & Hosting)
data.description:
Brainstorm Force is a product-based software company that builds WordPress products and SaaS applications, while also hosting WordPress production sites for customers. We are looking for a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer with 2-3 years of experience to help maintain the performance, security, availability, and scalability of our infrastructure. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing customer hosting environments on cPanel, WordPress/PHP servers running on Nginx and LiteSpeed, and Laravel and Next. js SaaS applications deployed on bare-metal servers and VPS environments. You will also leverage AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day work to troubleshoot issues, build automation, and document solutions more efficiently, while ensuring that every production change is reliable, secure, and well-tested. 

Why You'll Love Working With Us: 

- Remote work
 - Competitive pay
 - Flexible working hours
 - Paid time off
 - Parental leave
 - Allowances for setting up workspace
 - Excellent work-life balance
 - Career growth opportunities

What you'll be doing: 

WordPress/PHP servers: 

- Run and tune Nginx + PHP-FPM and LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed stacks with MySQL/MariaDB and Redis. 
 - Fix slow sites, 5xx errors, memory exhaustion and database bottlenecks. 

SaaS infrastructure: 

- Deploy and maintain Laravel (queues, Horizon/Supervisor, schedulers) and Next. js (Node/PM2) apps on bare metal and VPS. 
 - Run zero-downtime deployments with clear rollback plans. 

Customer hosting (cPanel/WHM): 

- Maintain the servers that host our customers' production WordPress sites. 
 - Handle account setup and migrations, PHP version management, resource limits, malware cleanup and email deliverability. 
 - Diagnose and fix server-level issues on customer sites. 

Edge and networking: 

- Own DNS, Cloudflare (WAF, caching rules, SSL modes), CDN setup and load balancing across our services. 
 - Improve performance through CDN and caching (Cloudflare, server-side caching, Redis object cache). 

Cloud services and reliability: 

- Manage AWS S3 storage, SES email sending and IAM access, following least-privilege practices. 
 - Run monitoring, alerting, backups with tested restores, patching, SSH hardening, firewalls and SSL/TLS certificates. 
 - Respond to incidents and write clear root-cause reports. 
 - Document infrastructure and fixes so the team can work from shared runbooks, and work with development teams to scale applications and improve performance. 

AI-assisted operations: 

- Use Claude to troubleshoot, write scripts and Ansible playbooks, review configs and keep runbooks current. 
 - Automate routine tasks with shell scripting, Ansible and other tools. 
 - Check AI output before running it, and never share customer data or credentials with it. 
You must have these skills: 

- 2-3 years working on Linux production servers over SSH. 
 - Hosted and maintained WordPress/PHP sites at server level: reading logs, fixing 500/502 errors, slow sites, PHP and memory issues. 
 - Working knowledge of DNS, Cloudflare/CDN, SSL, and the basics of how load balancing works. 
 - MySQL/MariaDB basics: backups, restores, finding slow queries. 
 - Redis working knowledge: installing and securing it (no public exposure, password/ACL), WordPress object caching, Laravel cache/queue/session use, and basic memory and eviction settings. 
 - Working knowledge of core AWS services: 
 - S3: buckets, access policies, storing backups and assets, lifecycle rules
 - SES: domain verification, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, handling bounces and complaints, leaving the sandbox
 - IAM: users vs. roles, least-privilege policies, access keys and why to avoid long-lived ones
 - Uses Claude or similar AI tools in daily technical work, and checks the output before running it. 
Good-to-Have skills: 

- cPanel/WHM server administration or shared-hosting infrastructure experience
 - LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed, PHP-FPM tuning
 - Deploying Laravel or Node. js/Next. js apps; PM2/Supervisor
 - Load balancer setup (Nginx, HAProxy, cloud LB)
 - AWS CloudFront and other AWS services (EC2, Route 53, CloudWatch)
 - Bash scripting, Ansible, Docker, CI/CD

Ready for an exciting journey? Apply now and be part of our awesome team! We're excited to hear from you!

For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. CSE SRE - DBA Focus

Job Description

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer - setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead on call response and triage - help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
 - Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership. 
 - Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
 - Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms - metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing - to ensure full visibility into production systems. 
 - Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams. 
 - Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers. 
 - Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion. 
 - Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout. 
 - Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists. 
 - Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection. Required: 

- 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
 - 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
 - 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required. 
 - Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale. 
 - Experience managing other database systems - PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc . 
 - CS Degree or equivalent experience. Preferred: 

- Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
 - Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues. 
 - Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments. 
 - Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure. 
 - Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
 - Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
 - Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language. 
 - Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes. 
 - Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes. 
 - Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent). 
 - Experience with incident management platforms and on-call tooling (e. g. , PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer (SDE 3) to lead web engineering across all three FundsIndia businesses, from application architecture and frameworks to performance, quality and our shared design system. 

About the Company

FundsIndia is a 17-year-old Indian investing platform serving close to 30 lakh investors, backed by WestBridge Capital. We run three businesses on one technology foundation: 

- Direct (D2C): the consumer web and app experience at fundsindia. com
 - Partner: a B2B platform that independent advisors use to run their practice and serve their clients
 - Private Wealth: a relationship-led experience for affluent and HNI clients

Each audience expects something different, from a first-time investor to a professional advisor working a dashboard all day. 

Key Responsibilities

Build the product

- Own major web features end to end, from technical design to release and monitoring. 
 - Build complex, data-dense interfaces that work with very large data sets, such as dashboards and tables with lakhs of rows, filtering, sorting, exports and interactive charts, and keep them fast and usable. 
 - Turn product and design intent into clean, reusable, well-tested code, and push back early when a requirement needs rethinking. 
 - Write secure front-end code for sensitive user data, covering auth flows, session handling, CSP and OWASP front-end risks. 

Shape the platform

- Lead the architecture of our React and Next. js applications: rendering strategy (SSR, SSG, ISR, client), routing, data fetching and state management. 
 - Design for several products on one foundation, using a monorepo, shared packages and, where it earns its place, micro-frontends or module federation. 
 - Own web performance: Core Web Vitals, bundle budgets, code splitting, caching and real-user monitoring. 
 - Evolve our design system with design: tokens, theming, accessible components and Storybook docs that every team can adopt. 
 - Improve developer experience: build tooling, CI/CD, testing strategy and release safety for the web. 

Engineering leadership

- Write technical designs (RFCs) for significant features and platform changes, and see them through. 
 - Raise the bar on code review, testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and CI/CD for the web. 
 - Mentor SDE 1 and SDE 2 engineers, and help hire the next members of the team. 
 - Work closely with product, design, backend and mobile teams; you are the go-to person for anything web. 

Qualifications

- 5-8 years building for the web, with at least one large React application you helped architect, not just contribute to. 
 - A track record of leading features end to end, from RFC to production and monitoring. 
 - Clear written communication; you can explain a technical trade-off to a designer or a product manager. 
 - Experience mentoring other engineers through code reviews and pairing. 

Required Skills

- Core web: Expert JavaScript and TypeScript; deep HTML and CSS, including layout, the cascade and responsive design; how browsers render and paint. 
 - React: Hooks, context, composition patterns, concurrent features and Server Components; you can explain why a component re-renders and fix it. 
 - Next. js: Production experience with App Router, SSR/SSG/ISR, middleware, caching and image/font optimisation. 
 - State and data: Redux Toolkit, Zustand or similar for client state; TanStack Query or SWR for server state; REST and GraphQL integration. 
 - Design systems: Built or maintained a component library used by several teams; design tokens (Style Dictionary or similar); theming; Storybook; publishing versioned packages. 
 - Styling: CSS Modules, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS, and a clear view on the trade-offs of each for a shared library. 
 - Accessibility: WCAG 2. 1 AA in practice: semantic markup, keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA, screen-reader testing. 
 - Performance: Measured and improved Core Web Vitals on a real product using Lighthouse, WebPageTest or RUM data; rendered very large data sets smoothly using virtualisation, pagination, web workers and memoisation. 
 - Testing: Jest or Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, and visual regression (Chromatic or similar). 
 - Tooling: Webpack, Vite or Turbopack; monorepos with Turborepo or Nx; CI/CD pipelines; feature flags. 

Good To Have

- Full-stack experience: building APIs or BFF layers in Node. js (or similar), and working with databases, caching and queues. 
 - Micro-frontend or module federation experience across several products or teams. 
 - Building white-label or multi-tenant UIs, where one codebase serves several brands or audiences. 
 - Data visualisation with D3, Recharts, Highcharts or similar for dense, interactive charts. 
 - Shared code between web and React Native. 
 - Front-end observability with Sentry, Datadog RUM or similar. 
 - Using AI coding tools well in your daily workflow, and a view on where they help and where they don't. 
 - Experience in fintech or another regulated industry, where security and audit trails matter.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III
data.description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is India's leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15, 000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1. 5B+ customer conversations, we're building the operating system for commerce growth. 

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce. 

The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team. 

What You'll Own

- Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations. 
 - System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly. 
 - Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution. 
 - System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes. 
 - Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits. 
 - Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models. 
 - Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues. 
 - Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities. 
 - Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices. 
 - AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails. 

Who You Are

- Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems. 
 - Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes. 
 - Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery. 
 - Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity. 
 - Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation. 
 - Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems. 
 - Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions. 
 - Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz. 
 - Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs. 
 - Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly. 
 - Are proficient in Node. js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team's technology stack. 
 - Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems. 
 - Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices. 

Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

data.title: Software Engineer - Advanced
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Simcenter HyperMesh CFD is a powerful pre- and post-processing solution for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), designed to help engineers efficiently prepare models, generate high-quality meshes, and analyze complex simulation results. 

We are looking for a Software Developer - CFD Post Processing to join our development team and contribute to the continued evolution of the Simcenter HyperMesh CFD (HMCFD) interface. 

In this role, you will design, develop, and enhance GUI-based software capabilities used by engineers working with advanced CFD workflows. You will work closely with software developers, CFD experts, and users to understand technical requirements and translate them into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance software solutions. 

The role provides an opportunity to work across C/C++, Python, Tcl, GUI technologies, CFD, and engineering software, while contributing to a product used in complex engineering workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop core product capabilities: Design, implement, test, and enhance software features for the HMCFD graphical user interface using C/C++ and appropriate software engineering practices. 
 - Build intuitive engineering interfaces: Develop and maintain GUI functionality that enables engineers to efficiently prepare CFD models, interact with simulation data, and perform pre- and post-processing activities. 
 - Solve complex technical problems: Analyze user and product requirements, investigate technical challenges, and develop robust, maintainable solutions for complex engineering workflows. 
 - Develop automation and customization: Use Python and Tcl scripting to automate workflows, customize solutions, and improve productivity for specific CFD applications and user requirements. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with software developers, CFD specialists, product teams, and users to understand requirements and deliver effective product capabilities. 
 - Ensure software quality: Perform development-level testing and QA activities, troubleshoot defects, and contribute to maintaining the reliability and usability of the product. 
 - Support product adoption: Contribute to technical documentation, user tutorials, and other technical content that helps customers and internal users effectively utilize HMCFD capabilities. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software. 
 - Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows. 
 - Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions. 
 - Working knowledge of both Linux and Windows operating systems and experience developing or supporting software in a multiplatform environment. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software developers, engineering experts, and end users. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Qt and/or OpenGL. 
 - Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows. 
 - Experience with Simcenter HyperWorks or other CAE/engineering software. 
 - Experience with CAD modeling or visualization software. 
 - Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) and structural analysis. 
 - Experience developing software for engineering, scientific, simulation, or visualization applications. 
 - Familiarity with scripting-driven engineering workflows and application customization. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
Software Engineer/Senior Software Engineer – Baseboard Management Controller
data.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. 

We are looking for highly capable software engineers with practical experience of programming the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC). The successful candidate will be working with vibrant software and hardware teams across multiple geographies on ground breaking products and will be presented with opportunities to vastly grow their technical understanding. 

If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

We are seeking those who will perform both software development and actively participate in the OpenBMC community. 

- Your day-to-day role will involve develop, enhance, and maintain the OpenBMC firmware stack for Arm-based server platforms, ensuring robust and reliable system management capabilities. 
 - BMC firmware bring-up and platform enablement activities for new Arm-based server boards, including hardware integration, driver configuration, debugging, and validation. 
 - Develop and port BMC functionalities across multiple Arm-based server platforms, promoting software reuse, scalability, and consistency across platforms. 
 - Working closely with colleagues who develop SoC firmware to ensure that the BMC operates correctly within the complete system. 
 - Contribute to the upstream OpenBMC community to ensure that common server manageability features and Arm-specific platform requirements are well supported, maintained, and aligned with industry standards. 

Required Skills and Experience

We need the following experience and skills from our candidates: 

- 4+ years of strong proficiency in C/C++ programming and Linux shell scripting for embedded firmware development, debugging, and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with U-Boot, Linux kernel development, and device driver integration for hardware interfaces such as GPIO, I2C, I3C, SPI, PCIe, and Ethernet. 
 - Good understanding of OpenBMC architecture, system management services, D-Bus communication, and systemd service management, with experience in developing, integrating, and debugging OpenBMC components. 
 - Good Linux debugging skills. 
 - Familiarity with Git. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills; excellent written and spoken English. 

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience

We Would Look Favourably At The Following

- Knowledge of DMTF specifications and protocols, including PLDM, MCTP, and SPDM, with an understanding of their application in server management and platform security. 
 - Familiarity with OCP specifications and standards related to server manageability, including DC-SCM and other relevant platform management requirements. 
 - Experience contributing to upstream open-source projects, particularly OpenBMC, including patch submission, code reviews, and collaboration with the open-source community. 
 - Hands-on experience with BMC SoCs from vendors such as ASPEED or Nuvoton, including platform bring-up, peripheral integration, and firmware development. 
 - Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, understand board-level interfaces, and collaborate with hardware teams to debug platform integration issues. 

Our 10x mindset guides how we engineer, collaborate, and grow. Understand what it means and how to reflect 10x in your work: https: //careers. arm. com/en/10x-mindset

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description

The Sr. Director / Vice President, Optical Engineering will be a senior engineering leader responsible for strategy, execution and NPI scale for Nokia's Product and Solutions Engineering organization within the optical networking portfolio. With a strong focus on high-volume pluggable optical and line system products, this leader will enable the business to scale complex technologies from development into reliable, cost-effective, high-quality volume production. 

The role will serve as the senior operational interface between engineering, supply chain, manufacturing partners, and business leadership, ensuring manufacturing readiness, production scalability, yield performance, quality, delivery, and cost competitiveness across a global footprint. The successful candidate will bring deep credibility in optical networking or adjacent high-tech manufacturing environments, combined with the executive presence and influencing capability required to lead through a complex global matrix. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- 
 - Set the global manufacturing and operations strategy for optical networking products, with emphasis on high-volume pluggable solutions and complex optical systems. 
 - 
 - Own strategic engagement with global contract manufacturing partners, including key partners across Southeast Asia, to ensure scalable capacity, quality discipline, cost competitiveness, and supply continuity. 
 - 
 - Lead and coordinate all pre-GA ramp activities across R&D functions, including hardware, PV&T, firmware, and OSG, ensuring seamless manufacturing readiness for successful product launches. 
 - 
 - Drive design for Manufacturing ( DfM ) strategies across hardware, firmware, test, calibration, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to optimize scalability, quality, cost, and speed to volume. 
 - 
 - Define and influence manufacturing CAPEX investments to maximize operational efficiency, support scalable production capacity, and minimize long-term impact on COGS. 
 - 
 - Establish manufacturing processes, operating mechanisms, test infrastructure, and governance frameworks capable of supporting production volumes in the millions of units annually. 
 - 
 - Own the CP-to-C5 manufacturing lifecycle, leading post-GA manufacturing performance, yield improvement initiatives, FMA activities, workforce training, test-time optimization, QRBs, binning strategies, and continuous process improvement. 
 - 
 - Oversee a global manufacturing ecosystem spanning development, testing, qualification, and production sites across North America, Europe, and Asia. 
 - 
 - Build executive-level relationships with external suppliers, contract manufacturers, and ecosystem partners while maintaining rigorous standards of operational performance and accountability. 
 - 
 - Provide strong leadership and governance across a complex matrix organization, ensuring accountability, driving timely decision-making, and influencing senior stakeholders to achieve critical business outcomes. 
Key Skills And Experience

- Senior manufacturing and operations leader with extensive experience (15+ years) in optical networking, photonics, telecommunications hardware, semiconductor-adjacent technologies, or comparable high-tech manufacturing environments. 
 - Strong industry credibility and technical depth in optical components, pluggable technologies, and complex electro-optical systems
 - Proven record of scaling complex products from new product introduction, engineering validation, and pre-GA ramp through high-volume global production. 
 - Deep expertise across manufacturing engineering, product industrialization, supplier strategy, quality systems, operational excellence, and production governance. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional global programs involving hardware, PV&T, firmware, OSG, supply chain, quality, and contract manufacturing partners. 
 - Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills with the ability to operate effectively in a global matrix environment. 
 - Ability to align senior leaders, create clear governance mechanisms, and hold stakeholders accountable for delivering manufacturing, quality, cost, and launch outcomes. 
 - High levels of resilience, credibility, executive presence, and leadership maturity. 
 - Experience working across geographically distributed teams and manufacturing ecosystems in North America, Europe, and Asia. 

Success Factors

- Deliver scalable manufacturing operations capable of supporting significant growth in optical pluggables volumes, from pre-GA ramp through post-GA sustained production. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with internal engineering organizations and external manufacturing partners. 
 - Drive operational efficiency, yield performance, test-time optimization, quality, cost, and delivery performance across the entire manufacturing value chain. 
 - Serve as a respected cross-functional leader who can align diverse stakeholders, enforce governance discipline, and execute complex global manufacturing programs with speed and accountability.

data.description:
Overview

Intuit's strategy is to be an AI-driven expert platform, delivering world-class, revolutionary experiences for our customers at unprecedented speed and scale. The AI Foundation (AIF) Platform team builds and operates the evaluation infrastructure, ML pipelines, and observability tooling that Intuit's agentic product teams (QBO, TurboTax, and others) rely on to ship AI agents safely and quickly. Come join AIF as a Staff Software Engineer to help build the platform that lets the rest of Intuit bring trustworthy, high-quality AI agents to market fast. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build backend services and pipelines in Python that power agent evaluation, observability, and quality measurement at Intuit scale
 - Own and evolve core components of the eval platform - golden datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, trajectory and correctness scoring, and regression detection across agent releases
 - Build and operate agent observability infrastructure using Langfuse (or equivalent OTel-based tracing), ensuring product teams have real-time visibility into agent behavior, latency, and failure modes
 - Design, author, and maintain ML pipelines using Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP), including DAG authoring, artifact tracking, caching/memoization, and deployment on internal Kubernetes (IKS) infrastructure
 - Drive end-to-end ownership of initiatives - from design through production launch - partnering closely with product agent teams to understand their evaluation and observability needs
 - Champion a builder culture: experiment with customers to find the best solutions, take on ambiguous problems, and iterate quickly
 - Use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate your own engineering workflow, and help shape how the broader platform team adopts AI-native development practices
 - Design and develop highly scalable, high-performance distributed applications and services; expect roughly 80-95% hands-on development/coding. 
 - Mentor and coach other engineers on software engineering best practices, platform architecture, and AI/agent evaluation concepts
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and other engineering teams to define what "quality" means for an agent and how the platform measures and guarantees it

Qualifications

- Bachelors of engineering in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
 - 10+ years of experience building and operating distributed backend systems in production
 - Strong proficiency in Python; solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals (APIs, data modeling, testing, CI/CD)
 - Hands-on experience with LLM/agent systems: prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, LLM-as-judge evaluation, or agent frameworks (e. g. , LangGraph)

data.title: Senior Principal Engineer
data.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work. 

Senior Principal Engineer

Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands-on. 

As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo's modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security. 

If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you. 

About the PodA TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do
 - Own the architecture: Define and own the end-to-end software architecture for the pod's applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native across AWS and Azure. 
 - Own the frontend architecture: Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against. 
 - Lead the technical direction: Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity. 
 - Stay hands-on: Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents. 
 - Lead AI-native development: Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security. 
 - Set the quality bar: Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security. 
 - Build secure and reliable systems: Embed secure-by-design principles and cloud-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production. 
 - Mentor and raise the team: Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with the OpCo: Work with the OpCo's technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge. What You Bring
 - Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems. 
 - Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required): You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. 
 - Architectural depth: Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale. 
 - Hands-on technical depth: Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI-generated work. 
 - AI-native engineering: Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI-native team. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - Frontend architecture: Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React. js and Next. js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale. 
 - DevSecOps: Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices. 
 - Communication and leadership: You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast-moving teams. Nice to Have
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - A track record leading application modernization or re-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications. 
 - GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases. 
 - Experience leading embedded or client-facing engineering teams. 
 - Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure. What Success Looks Like
 - First 90 days: You understand the OpCo's landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI-native workflow. 
 - First 6 months: The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team's technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership. Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
 - Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. Should You Apply?We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes. 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.   

Protect yourself by following these steps: 

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware. com email address. 
 - Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond - instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware. com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

Could that be you?

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. data.description:
Job Description

Location: Hyderabad

Experience

BS and 5-8 years

MS and 3-6 years

PhD and 0-3 years

Primary Areas: Developer Productivity, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, Reliability Engineering, Test Automation

Primary Stack: Azure, Terraform, Docker, Azure DevOps, Python, Go, Playwright, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Developer Productivity and Reliability Engineer to build the internal engineering platform, automation, and quality systems that enable teams to deliver software quickly, safely, and reliably. 

The role will own reusable infrastructure patterns, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment provisioning, deployment workflows, observability, and developer self-service capabilities across our Python/Django, Go, and Angular/TypeScript applications running on Azure. 

The engineer will help establish a modern platform-engineering model based on automation, Infrastructure as Code, measurable reliability, reusable golden paths, and fast developer feedback. This role will work closely with engineering, QA, architecture, security, and product teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Developer Productivity and Internal Platforms

- Build and operate reusable developer workflows that simplify build, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and release activities. 
 - Create self-service workflows for project setup, environment provisioning, database initialization, test execution, deployment, and diagnostics. 
 - Develop reusable repository templates, pipeline templates, Terraform modules, container templates, and engineering tooling. 
 - Establish "golden paths" for common application types and deployment scenarios. 
 - Improve local development environments using consistent tooling, containers, service emulators, and documented workflows. 
 - Reduce developer cognitive load by standardizing common infrastructure, deployment, testing, and observability patterns. 
 - Provide clear feedback through pipeline reports, deployment status, test evidence, quality dashboards, and actionable failure diagnostics. 

Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Automation

- Design and maintain Azure infrastructure through Terraform and version-controlled Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Build reusable, composable, and versioned Terraform modules for application, networking, identity, storage, databases, monitoring, and security services. 
 - Automate infrastructure validation, policy checks, drift detection, security scanning, and controlled promotion across environments. 
 - Implement environment provisioning and teardown workflows, including short-lived or ephemeral environments where appropriate. 
 - Automate application deployments using Docker and Azure services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring. 
 - Establish safe deployment patterns, including blue-green or canary releases, health checks, automated rollback, and progressive delivery. 
 - Manage configuration and secrets securely using appropriate Azure services such as Key Vault and managed identities. 
 - Improve infrastructure consistency across development, test, staging, and production environments. 

Reliability Engineering

- Define and implement service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and reliability dashboards for critical applications and delivery systems. 
 - Establish production-readiness standards covering availability, performance, scalability, resilience, observability, backup, recovery, and operational ownership. 
 - Instrument applications, pipelines, infrastructure, and deployment workflows with logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and diagnostic context. 
 - Analyze incidents, recurring failures, deployment problems, flaky tests, and operational toil; drive permanent corrective actions. 
 - Support incident response, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvement plans. 
 - Improve mean time to detect, mean time to recover, deployment success rate, and change failure rate. 
 - Introduce resilience and failure testing for important services and infrastructure. 
 - Automate health checks, smoke tests, rollback decisions, and post-deployment verification. 

CI/CD and Release Engineering

- Design and optimize Azure DevOps pipelines for fast, reliable, repeatable builds and releases. 
 - Implement pipeline stages for validation, compilation, unit testing, API testing, security scanning, container image creation, infrastructure validation, deployment, and post-deployment verification. 
 - Use dependency and build caching, parallel execution, selective test execution, and incremental pipelines to reduce feedback time. 
 - Establish quality gates based on test results, coverage, security findings, code quality, infrastructure validation, and release risk. 
 - Support Git-based development workflows, pull-request validation, branch policies, artifact versioning, and release traceability. 
 - Automate release evidence, test reports, deployment records, and compliance-related documentation. 

Test Automation and Quality Engineering

- Define a layered testing strategy across unit, integration, API, contract, component, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Build and maintain Playwright-based UI and regression suites with traceability, screenshots, videos, logs, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Improve test reliability through deterministic test data, service virtualization, isolation, parallelization, and environment management. 
 - Automate test data creation and cleanup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and dependent services. 
 - Reduce flaky tests and ensure failures are classified as product defects, test defects, infrastructure issues, or environmental issues. 
 - Partner with engineering and QA teams to make applications easier to test and operate. 
 - Explore AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, and coverage analysis with appropriate human review. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Graduate with 5-8 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, CI/CD, test automation, or developer-productivity engineering. 
 - Strong experience building internal developer platforms, delivery automation, or reusable engineering tooling. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces or equivalent environment strategies, policy validation, and infrastructure testing. 
 - Strong Azure experience with services such as Container Apps, Functions, storage, networking, identity, Key Vault, monitoring, and managed databases. 
 - Strong experience designing Azure DevOps pipelines and Git-based delivery workflows. 
 - Practical experience with Docker, container image lifecycle management, registries, health checks, and deployment automation. 
 - Strong understanding of SRE concepts, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, incident response, resilience, and operational readiness.

data.title: Software QA Engineer - Performance Testing
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

We are looking for a Software QA Engineer - Performance Testing to design, automate, and execute performance testing strategies for cloud-based enterprise applications, APIs, platforms, and distributed services. 

In this role, you will evaluate system performance, identify bottlenecks, analyze scalability and reliability, and establish performance baselines to support release readiness. Working closely with Software Development, Architecture, DevOps, and QA teams, you will help embed performance engineering into the software development lifecycle and explore AI-assisted performance analysis and anomaly detection. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design performance test strategies: Plan and execute load, stress, scalability, endurance, spike, capacity, and benchmark tests using realistic workload models. 
 - Develop performance automation: Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts, frameworks, and workload-generation solutions using tools such as JMeter, k6, Locust, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Analyze and troubleshoot performance: Investigate latency, throughput, resource utilization, and system behavior to identify bottlenecks and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Establish performance baselines: Compare results across builds and releases, identify regressions, and provide data-driven recommendations for performance and release readiness. 
 - Test cloud-native and distributed systems: Evaluate APIs, microservices, databases, and enterprise applications across containerized and cloud-based environments. 
 - Leverage monitoring and observability: Use metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards to correlate performance results with system behavior and communicate actionable findings. 
 - Integrate performance engineering into delivery: Embed automated performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate across engineering teams to improve performance standards, test efficiency, and continuous quality. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 4+ years of relevant experience in performance testing or performance engineering, including workload design, execution, analysis, and reporting. 
 - Hands-on experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter, k6, Locust, RPT, or equivalent. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or Groovy, with the ability to develop and maintain test automation. 
 - Experience testing web applications, APIs, and distributed services, with knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP, databases/SQL, and relevant communication protocols. 
 - Strong understanding of performance metrics, workload modelling, statistical analysis, performance baselining, regression detection, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Experience with cloud-native or enterprise application architectures, CI/CD integration, and monitoring/observability tools, along with strong analytical and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience performance-testing microservices, Kubernetes-based applications, containers, and large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI. 
 - Experience with observability and application performance monitoring tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, Telegraf, Loki, Tempo, Kibana, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics. 
 - Experience with distributed load generation, performance dashboards, and automated performance regression testing. 
 - Knowledge of Git/GitLab, Jira, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Exposure to desktop application performance testing, WebSockets, GraphQL, CLI-based testing, or other relevant protocols. 
 - Experience with AI/ML-assisted performance analytics, anomaly detection, or automated root-cause analysis. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. The Team: 

You will join the Sailfin Accounts Receivable (AR) Team, a product engineering team within the Finance & Accounting domain. We build and maintain an enterprise-grade AR product used by global customers. 

The team works with modern engineering practices, AI/ML capabilities, automation, and deep integrations across platforms such as Salesforce, Celonis, and other enterprise systems.

The Role: ()

We are looking for an AI Quality Engineer who can build next-generation intelligent automation and quality frameworks. This role goes beyond traditional QA-it combines strong automation engineering, enterprise integration understanding, and AI-assisted quality improvement. You will architect automation frameworks, drive end-to-end quality strategy, and build smart testing capabilities powered by LLMs and AI agents. 

Most importantly, you will test the bridge between the world's #1 CRM (Salesforce) and the world's #1 Process Mining platform (Celonis)-a complex, data-heavy integration that powers enterprise decision-making.

AI / LLM Skills

- Experience using LLM-powered QA tools (Copilot, Codeium, test generators).

- Experience working with Salesforce, Apex, or Salesforce data models. 
 - Understanding of Celonis or other process mining / data transformation platforms. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools like k6, JMeter, or Locust.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is not a typical QA role. 

You will be validating a mission-critical integration between two global platforms (Salesforce ↔ Celonis) that must remain stable, accurate, and high-performing for Fortune 500 customers. 

You will also be part of the journey of transforming QA using AI, LLMs, and autonomous agents, making quality engineering faster, smarter, and more predictive. 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. 
 - Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. 
 - Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy-24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. 
 - Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
