 - Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. 
 - Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. 
 - Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values-Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future-drive every decision. 

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand - turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Job Purpose

The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar's state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy. 

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep. 

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers. 

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager. 

Job Duties

- The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions. 
 - Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets. 
 - The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact. 
 - Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions. 
 - Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals. 
 - Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development. 
 - Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams. 
 - Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity. 
 - Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues. 
 - Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division. 
 - Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time. 
 - Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications. 
 - The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions. 
 - The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc. 
 - S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices. 
 - Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time. 

Basic Qualifications

- Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university. 
 - Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master's degree in computer science or related field. 
 - Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team. 
 - Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure. 

Top Candidates Will Also Have

- Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities. 
 - Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment. 
 - Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs. 
 - Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues. 
 - Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints. Passion for technology and innovation. 
 - Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements. 

Proven Experience In Many Of The Following

- Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale. 
 - Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc. 
 - Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable. 
 - Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis. 
 - Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL. 
 - Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc. 
 - Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum). 
 - Researching data to support design decisions. 
 - Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms. 
 - Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8. 0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc
 - Must Have - Deep hands-on expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot. 
 - Nice to Have - Certifications in AWS/Azure, MongoDB/Redis. 
 - Nice to Have - Hands-on experience on React, Typescript, JavaScript frameworks. 
 - Nice to Have - BPMN/Workflow/Rules Engine technology like Camunda, Temporal, Drools. 

This position requires working onsite five days a week. 

Relocation is available for this position.

October 21, 2026 - October 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

data.title: Senior Manager- Backend
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

Senior Managers of Engineering at OneTrust make long-term strategic and technical contributions. They set strategic goals for the team, hire and develop engineers, and prioritize projects that create meaningful customer and business impact. They remain technically engaged-helping develop new products, identify requirements, and execute with excellence. 

As a Senior Manager on the AI Governance Engineering team, you will lead the development of OneTrust's next-generation AI Governance platform. You will help turn complex governance, compliance, security, and responsible AI requirements into scalable products that enable organizations to confidently build, evaluate, deploy, and operate AI models and agents. This is an opportunity to shape a high-impact product area at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, and trust. 

Your Mission

Drive strategic planning and execution while developing key technologies that strengthen OneTrust's long-term, proprietary strategic position in AI Governance. Create new concepts from initial design through market release, establish a strong engineering culture, and lead teams that deliver reliable, secure, and extensible AIG capabilities at enterprise scale. 

You Are

- Experienced overseeing end-to-end development activities while monitoring the reliability, security, and performance of internal systems and recommending improvements when required. 
 - Able to translate AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI needs into clear product requirements, technical strategy, and execution plans. 
 - Able to ensure compliance with security regulations while managing software development projects by setting requirements, goals, and timelines. 
 - Designing strategies for future development projects based on the company's overall objectives and resource availability. 
 - Implementing innovative technologies and architectural patterns for AI model and agent governance. 
 - Coordinating effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Security, Compliance, and customer-facing teams. 
 - Providing technical oversight and hands-on leadership to your team, while staying close enough to the technology to guide critical decisions. 
 - Ensuring projects are delivered according to schedule without compromising quality, reliability, or customer trust. 
 - Good at finding opportunities to improve development processes, engineering productivity, and operational excellence. 
 - Experienced building onboarding and mentoring programs to teach and train other engineers in order to incubate individual and team growth. 
 - Comfortable leading through ambiguity and balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform investments. 

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - 12+ years of engineering experience with a strong track record of successful development and delivery of complex, enterprise-class software that results in material market impact. 
 - Recent experience in development, operations, troubleshooting, and managing teams. 
 - Understanding of how to operate in a DevOps model. 
 - Experience with the AI agent ecosystem and deployment platforms such as Agent Core, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Vertex AI. 
 - Proven critical thinking and advanced analytical skills and qualities. 
 - Strong consulting skills and tactful conflict management skills. 
 - Systematic problem-solving approach coupled with a strong sense of ownership and drive. 
 - System design and architecture experience. 
 - Experience designing and architecting large, complex distributed systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of data structures and programming. 
 - Ability to think of various algorithms, given a problem. 
 - Solid understanding of the agile software development lifecycle. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Monetization Platform
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365, all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors, including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling. com addresses. 

About Monetization Platform

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries. 

The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle: 

Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue

These systems support a $1B+ sales base, manage entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries. 

As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time. 

Our vision is simple: 

Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code. 

This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team. 

The opportunity

- Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories. 
 - Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems. 
 - We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform. 
 - You will own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust. 
 - This role combines: 
 - 
 - Hands-on backend and platform engineering
 - Org-level architectural leadership
 - Technical leadership and mentorship
 - Cross-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data
 - You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence. 
 - This is not an architecture-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

- Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries. 
 - Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one-off solutions. 
 - Lead multi-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long-term operational ownership. 
 - Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems. 
 - Make high-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed. 
 - Stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level decisions. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams. 
 - Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake. 
 - Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence. 

What Success Looks Like

- Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure. 
 - Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability. 
 - Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one-off implementations. 
 - Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems. 
 - Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership. 
 - Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross-system problems. 
 - Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives. 

What We're Looking For

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering. 
 - Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff+ scope. 
 - Deep hands-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience. 
 - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements. 
 - Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross-functional, multi-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership. 
 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
 - Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments. 
 - Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus. 

Bonus points

- Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems. 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow-heavy domains, or high-growth product companies. 
 - Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise-grade controls. 
 - A builder-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.

data.description:
About Astrobase Space Technologies

Astrobase is a pioneering spacetech startup founded by prominent Senior ISRO scientists and IIT Bombay alumni with over 20 years of experience in designing, manufacturing, testing and flying advanced Cryogenic Launch Vehicles. Driven by a vision to make India a Space tech powerhouse, we are developing innovative launch vehicles that will transform space exploration. At Astrobase, you'll be part of a team creating history in the Indian space industry. Our goal is to become the first private space company from India to land on the moon economically. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform in-process and final inspections of engine components and assemblies. 
 - Verify compliance with technical drawings, specifications, and standards. 
 - Ensure dimensional checks and quality verification during assembly stages. 
 - Witness functional and mechanical tests. 
 - Supervise engine component assembly and integration activities. 
 - Ensure proper alignment, fitment, and installation of engine subsystems. 
 - Monitor torqueing, fastening, and mechanical integration processes. 
 - Ensure adherence to approved assembly procedures and drawings. 
 - Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists, and quality records. 
 - Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) for deviations and coordinate corrective actions. 
 - Maintain traceability of parts, materials, and inspection records. 

DESIRED QUALIFICATION

- Diploma in Mechanical / Aerospace / Automobile Engineering (minimum requirement for inspection roles). 
 - B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical / Aerospace Engineering (preferred for supervisory or engineer-level positions). 
 - ITI certification in trades such as Fitter / Machinist with additional training in quality inspection (suitable for technician-level inspectors). 
 - Specialized certification in Quality Assurance / NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) / Metrology adds strong value. 

WHY WORK WITH US?

At Astrobase, We Believe In The Power Of Human Ingenuity And Collaboration To Push The Boundaries Of Space Exploration. As a Team Member, You'll Be

- Creating History: Join us in developing cutting-edge launch vehicles, playing a pivotal role in transforming space access and shaping the future of space exploration. 
 - Collaborating with Experts: Work alongside ISRO scientists and industry veterans with decades of experience in designing India's iconic space missions like Chandrayaan 3
 - Growth Opportunities: As Astrobase scales, you'll have the chance to take on leadership roles and be part of an expanding organization driving change in the Indian space sector. 
 - Pioneering Space Technology: Your contributions will not only impact Astrobase but also influence the global space ecosystem. Be part of something larger than yourself

data.description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!

Who Are We?

For 115 years, L'Oréal, the world's leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world. 

For more than a century, L'Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L'Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty. 

Today, L'Oréal includes more than 2, 000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future. 

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L'Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure. 

A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!

We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH. 

Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC . . . 

You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment. 

Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale. 

In this role, You will. . 

Be Responsible For The Following

As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact. 

You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy. 

In This Position Your Main Mission Will Be

- Engineering mission and leadership: 
 - Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group's business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization. 
 - As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs. 
 - Platform Engineering: 
 - Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines. 
 - Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality. 
 - Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
 - Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation. 

- Architecture and industrialization: 
 - Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments. 
 - Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
 - End-to-end delivery: 
 - Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale. 
 - Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris. 

- Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices. 
 - Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services. 
 - Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy. 
 - Cross-functional partnership: 
 - Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets. 
 - Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris. 
What are we looking for?

- Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.

data.title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
data.description:
About QCI

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030. 

Role Summary

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential. 

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation's Drone Ecosystem. 

Role & Responsibility-

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below: 

- Scheme Design & Development: Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS. 
 - Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products: Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components. 
 - Report Writing & Deck Preparation: Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders. 
 - Scheme Operations: Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i. e. , regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination. 
 - Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme: Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation. 

Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-

Educational Qualification: 

- A Bachelor's degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor's degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role. 
 - An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage. 

Experience-

- Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program. 
 - Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification. 
 - Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required. 
 - Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred. 
 - Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory. 
 - Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired. 
 - Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required. 

Technical Capabilities-

Strong Research Skills: Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e. g. , government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information. 

Structured Thinking & Writing: Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs. 

Data Analysis: Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage. 

Visualization & Presentation Skills: Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations. 

Behavioural Capabilities-

High Degree of Curiosity: Genuine interest in how India's public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks "why. "

Integrity & Accountability: Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions. 

Meticulous Attention to Detail: Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook. 

Proactive & "Get-it-Done" Attitude: Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

Role Summary

The Assistant Manager - Testing & Validation is responsible for leading testing, analytics, quality control, method development and validation, and validation activities for New Product Development (NPD) projects in line with the Aliaxis Innovation Model (AIM), from concept to successful market launch. The role manages laboratory testing, product qualification, benchmarking, plant issue investigations, failure analysis, counterfeit product identification, and Intellectual Property (IP)-related testing while ensuring compliance with ISO/IEC 17025 and NABL requirements. The incumbent oversees day-to-day laboratory operations, resource planning, calibration and validation programs, measurement uncertainty (MU), Green Pathway initiatives, laboratory capability enhancement, and the development, validation, and standardization of new test methods. As an authorized signatory in the absence of the Laboratory Manager, the role is responsible for reviewing and approving test reports and maintaining the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of laboratory data and records. Additionally, the position drives 5S, laboratory housekeeping, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives to maintain an efficient, compliant, and audit-ready laboratory environment. The role provides technical leadership and subject matter expertise to R&D-Innovation, Quality, Manufacturing, and Global Aliaxis teams, with hands-on expertise in advanced polymer characterization techniques including FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, SEM-EDX, XRF, Capillary Rheometry, and Weathering Testing, along with strong knowledge of UTM, Charpy and Izod Impact Testing, HDT/VST, MFI, viscosity testing, and other polymer testing and characterization methods. Strong project management, communication, data analysis, Excel, PowerPoint, and presentation skills are essential for delivering high-quality technical outcomes and supporting innovation, product quality, and business growth. 

Roles And Responsibility

- Lead testing, quality control, analytics, and validation activities for New Product Development (NPD) projects in accordance with the Stage & Gate Process, ensuring timely execution from concept through product launch. 
 - Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of polymer materials, processing technologies, and product performance requirements, with expertise in uPVC & CPVC pipes and fittings, solvent cement, water storage tanks, and other polymer-based products. 
 - Independently perform, supervise, and interpret a wide range of polymer testing and characterization activities, including UTM, Charpy & Izod Impact, HDT/VST, MFI, Capillary Rheometer, Weathering (Q-SUN/Xenon), Fusion Study, Viscosity, XRF, DSC, TGA, DMA, SEM-EDX, and other advanced material characterization techniques. 
 - Support plant issue investigations, failure analysis, counterfeit product identification, intellectual property (IP)-related testing, material qualification, benchmarking studies, and root cause analysis to support business and quality objectives. 
 - Provide subject matter expertise for QA/QC analysis, NPD projects, product validation, process improvement initiatives, and technical problem-solving activities. 
 - Collaborate closely with R&D, Innovation, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement, and external partners to achieve project objectives and deliver high-quality technical outcomes. 
 - Manage annual maintenance, calibration, intermediate checks, performance verification, and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment as per approved schedules. 
 - Review, validate, and maintain test reports, technical records, raw data registers, equipment logbooks, trend charts, and laboratory documentation to ensure data integrity and traceability. 
 - Lead and support implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Quality Management System, including: 
 - Ensuring SOPs are current, available, and consistently followed. 
 - Compliance with latest ASTM, ISO, BIS, and other applicable standards. 
 - New test method development and validation. 
 - Measurement Uncertainty (MU) estimation and maintenance. 
 - Proficiency Testing (PT) and Inter-Laboratory Comparison (ILC) participation. 
 - SRM/IRM testing and control chart monitoring. 
 - Raw data, master register, and report verification. 
 - LMS maintenance and documentation control. 
 - Verification of calibration certificates and quality records. 
 - Repeat/replicate testing and investigation of abnormal results. 
 - Closure of non-conformances arising from internal and external audits. 
 - Lead NABL accreditation activities and support Green Pathway initiatives to strengthen laboratory compliance, sustainability, and operational excellence. 
 - Ensure adequate inventory and availability of laboratory consumables, spare parts, reference materials, and testing resources. 
 - Drive 5S implementation, laboratory housekeeping, safety compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives to maintain an organized, efficient, safe, and audit-ready laboratory environment. 
 - Plan, coordinate, and execute laboratory activities in the absence of the Laboratory Manager and act as authorized signatory for reports and laboratory records as delegated. 
 - Lead assigned laboratory sections to ensure safe, efficient, and quality-compliant operations while achieving testing, project, and business objectives. 

Skills And Competencies

- 6 - 8 Yrs of relevant experience
 - Bachelor's /Master's degree in disciplines related to Polymer Engineering/Science, Plastic Technology, Chemical Engineer
 - Strong knowledge of polymer materials, polymer processing, product performance, and material characterization techniques. 
 - Good understanding of uPVC, CPVC, solvent cement, water storage tanks, and other polymer-based products. 
 - Sound knowledge of ASTM, ISO, BIS, and other relevant testing standards. 
 - Strong understanding of ISO/IEC 17025: 2017, NABL accreditation requirements, laboratory quality systems, and Measurement Uncertainty (MU) principles. 
 - Knowledge of failure analysis, benchmarking, counterfeit product identification, intellectual property (IP)-related testing, root cause analysis, and product validation. 
 - Understanding of statistical analysis, data interpretation, trend analysis, and technical reporting methodologies. 
 - Hands-on expertise in advanced polymer characterization techniques including FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, SEM-EDX, XRF, Weathering Tests (Q-SUN-Xenon & UV), Capillary Rheometer. 
 - Knowledge of interpreting results from Universal Testing Machines (UTM), Charpy & Izod Impact Testers, HDT/VST Testers, Melt Flow Index (MFI) Testers, Viscosity Testing Equipment, Fusion Studies and other polymer testing instruments. 
 - Experience in test method development, method validation, troubleshooting, and laboratory investigations. 
 - Proficiency in calibration, intermediate checks, performance verification, and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment. 
 - Experience in proficiency testing (PT), inter-laboratory comparison (ILC) programs, SRM/IRM testing, and laboratory quality assurance activities. 
 - Strong leadership, planning, project management, and execution capabilities. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results within agreed timelines. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Canva, Laboratory Management Systems (LMS), and other data analysis and presentation tools. 
 - Capability to lead assigned laboratory sections, mentor team members, and drive continuous improvement, 5S, safety, and operational excellence initiatives.

data.title: Senior Engineer
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Test Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm is looking for an experienced software QA to work within an existing team to add firmware support for machine learning Edge and Datacenter use cases. The development target is Qualcomm's next generation high-performance inference accelerator. 

Candidate should have a background in embedded software development and AI inferencing such as: 

- Chipset Power Blocks
 - Low-Speed Peripheral Interfaces (I2C/SPI/UART)
 - PCIe and Efficient Data Movement using DMA
 - Hardware/Software Bring-up and System Validation
 - Development Integration and Functional Testing (DIFT)
 - Test Automation Frameworks and CI Infrastructure
 - Software Quality and Regression Testing
 - ML Inference Software Stack (vLLM, Runtime, Compiler)
 - Open Source AI Models and Framework Integration

Critical Skills And Aptitude

- Understanding of the ML software ecosystem and QA approaches/frameworks
 - Strong fundamentals of Deep learning, transformer architecture, industry-grade LLM serving KPIs
 - Responsible for development of test strategies and ML test harnesses for AI Inference Accelerators
 - Ability to interact with firmware and app software stacks stakeholders and define workflows. 
 - Strong experience in Python and Shell scripting for test automation and infrastructure development. 
 - Experience with C/C++ software development, debugging, and testing on embedded platforms. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and Development Integration Testing (DIFT) solutions. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Git/Gerrit, and build automation. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC architecture, memory hierarchy, interrupts, power management, and multi-threaded programming. 
 - Experience validating hardware/software interfaces including PCIe, DMA, memory, and peripheral subsystems. 
 - Experience with software quality metrics, regression testing, and release qualification. 
 - Familiarity with AI inference runtimes such as vLLM and accelerator software stacks. 
 - Familiarity with compiler technologies, model onboarding, optimization, and deployment workflows. 
 - Experience working with open-source AI/ML models and frameworks such as Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or similar. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work across global cross-functional teams. 

The Ideal Candidate Will Have/Demonstrate the Following

- Familiarity with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe and LPDDR. 
 - Familiarity with ECC, PCIe AER, RAS, and reliability validation. 
 - Experience with end-to-end system integration, feature validation, and Go/No-Go quality assessments. 
 - Experience with scalable automation frameworks, CI/CD systems, and continuous testing methodologies. 
 - Experience onboarding, validating, and optimizing open-source AI models on accelerator platforms. 
 - Experience working across firmware, runtime, compiler, and inference software stacks. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership in software quality, validation, automation, and release readiness. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving best practices across multiple teams. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Test Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Test Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. 

- 1+ year of work or academic experience with Software Test or System Test, developing and automating test plans and/or tools (e. g. , Source Code Control Systems, Continuous Integration Tools, and Bug Tracking Tools). 

Applicants: Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm. com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries). 

Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law. 

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. 

If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers.

data.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer (Security)
data.description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000 employees and 34, 000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. 

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent. com. 

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About the role: As a Principal SRE, you will set the technical direction for how Cvent scales, secures and operates its platforms, and you will mentor others while helping Cvent both envision and achieve its DevSecOps goals. 

Strong AI and automation skills are required, and candidates with hands-on WAF and security exposure are especially valued. 

This role is open in Bangalore and Gurgaon. 

We are looking for someone with the drive, ownership and ability to take on challenging problems, both technical and process related, in a dynamic, collaborative and highly distributed, multi-disciplinary team. You will use your background as a generalist to work closely with product development teams, Information Security, Cloud Infrastructure and other SRE teams to keep our platforms secure, and you must be able to see the big picture and solve hard multi-disciplinary problems with others. 

Technical depth in cloud operations, the software development lifecycle and security vulnerability

management will help you, but excellent mentorship, communication and the ability to drive alignment are must-haves. We use SRE principles such as blameless postmortems and a focus on automation to keep improving our knowledge and maintain a good quality of life. 

In this Role, You Will: 

- Enlighten, enable and empower a fast-growing set of multi-disciplinary teams across multiple applications and locations. 
 - Tackle complex development, automation and business process problems, and champion Cvent standards and best practices. 
 - Ensure the scalability, performance and resilience of security-related systems and processes. 
 - Work with product development teams, Information Security, Cloud Automation and other SRE teams to build a holistic understanding of security concerns and resolve them effectively and efficiently. 
 - Identify recurring problems and anti-patterns in development, operational and security processes. 
 - Develop build, test and deployment automation that seamlessly targets multiple on-premises and AWS regions. 
 - Give back by working on and contributing to open-source projects. 

Preferred candidate profile

Experience: 10 to 15 years in SRE, DevSecOps or DevOps, with significant time in a lead, staff or principal role. 

Core SRE skills (must have)

• AI and automation: a proven track record applying AI, automation and ML to improve reliability, 

operational efficiency and developer productivity, for example AI-assisted alert triage, event

grouping and incident response. 

• Deep fluency in AWS across multi-account, multi-region and high-traffic environments, with a strong foundation in distributed systems and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, CDK or Terraform). 

• Demonstrable leadership in scaling SRE practices: CI/CD, observability, incident management, RCAs and blameless postmortems. 

• Incident management experience: able to act as Incident Commander, write clear incident

summaries, drive RCA, and coordinate resolution across teams under pressure. 

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent), PR-based deployment workflows, and troubleshooting pipeline failures in distributed environments. 

• Change management discipline: communicating changes proactively, documenting rollout strategies, and managing phased production deployments with rollback plans. 

• Fluent in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Ruby or Bash, with solid Linux and networking fundamentals. 

• Experience with APM, monitoring and logging tools (Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus, 

Grafana). 

• Excellent communication skills and a track record of driving alignment across multi-disciplinary

teams, plus a passion for mentoring and making things better for your peers. 

• Experience with SDLC methodologies (preferably Agile). 

WAF and security exposure (strongly preferred; candidates with hands-on experience are prioritized)

• AWS WAF: rule authoring, rate-based rules, Bot Control integration, rule group management, and

multi-product WAF sharing strategies (e. g. , managing rule limits across applications sharing the same WebACL). 

• DDoS protection with AWS Shield Advanced, including moving endpoints from count to block mode and building observability (Lambda + CloudWatch alarms). 

• CDN experience, ideally Amazon CloudFront, as part of a layered security posture with WAF and

Shield. 

• Bot mitigation strategies, including AWS Bot Control, token-based traffic classification, JA4+ASN

fingerprinting, and evaluation of third-party vendors (e. g. , Datadome). 

Good to Have Skills

• Disaster recovery planning and execution: multi-region failover, DR runbooks, and RTO/RPO

management. 

• Experience managing API Gateways and ALBs as part of a layered security posture. 

• Experience with APM, monitoring and logging tools (Datadog, New Relic, Splunk). 

• Good understanding of containerization concepts: Docker, ECS, EKS, Kubernetes. 

• Experience managing 3-tier application stacks. 

• Understanding of basic networking concepts. 

• Familiarity with risk assessment and management concepts and practices.

Job Description

MantaRay NM is a cutting-edge network management platform enabling telecom providers to operate, optimize, and assure complex networks through automation, analytics, observability, and intelligent fault management. 

We are looking for Software Engineers passionate about building scalable, cloud-native solutions. You will design, develop, and enhance next-generation observability applications, leveraging modern technologies and automation frameworks while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance software. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Independently design, develop, debug and maintain scalable cloud-native applications
 - Own microservices and APIs and raise the bar on quality, scalability, security and reliability
 - Deliver and deploy with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift and CI/CD
 - Use Agentic AI as part of the standard workflow; build solutions that speed up development, testing and automation
 - Coach juniors on design, quality and AI-assisted engineering

Key Skills And Experience

You have: 

- A Graduate/master's degree in engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering cloud-native, distributed software systems using Java (Spring Boot)/Python. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes/OpenShift. 
 - Experience building and integrating REST APIs and microservices. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI and/or Jenkins)
 - Exposure to Agentic AI/AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, or equivalent). 

Nice to have: 

- Experience with SOAP APIs, Oracle/PostgreSQL, or other relational databases. 
 - Proficiency in Linux shell scripting, automation, and strong development experience in Java and Python. 
 - Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). 

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we're advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Learn more about life at Nokia . 

Our recruitment process

We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. data.title: Controls Project Engineer I
data.description:
Job Title

Controls Project Engineer I

Job Description

Controls Project Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, and delivering advanced automation solutions for material handling environments, this could be the ideal opportunity for you. 

Your Role

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, integration, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems. You will work with Siemens PLC technologies, SCADA, HMI, drives, and safety systems to deliver reliable and high-quality control solutions. 

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary and international project teams, support customer-facing activities, provide technical guidance to junior engineers, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of Vanderlande's controls solutions. 

What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities

Controls Software Development & Engineering

- Design, develop, and test LLC software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems using Siemens TIA Portal. 
 - Develop functional PLC software based on customer requirements, project specifications, and standard controls architecture. 
 - Program and configure Siemens PLC systems using Ladder Logic, FBD, STL, and SCL. 
 - Configure and integrate PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, and safety systems. 
 - Apply reusable software modules, library structures, and standardized controls solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain technical documentation including functional specifications, interface documents, and engineering deliverables. 

Testing, Integration & Commissioning

- Perform engineering, simulation, emulation, FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities. 
 - Troubleshoot software, communication, PLC, HMI, and controls-related issues during testing and commissioning. 
 - Perform system integration activities with SCADA, Equipment Management, Mechanical, Electrical, and Safety disciplines. 
 - Use Siemens diagnostic tools such as Proneta and online diagnostics for troubleshooting and system validation. 
 - Support backup, version management, and software configuration activities. 
 - Prepare test plans, commissioning documentation, and reports to support successful project delivery. 
 - Support successful project handover and completion of Service Take Over (STO) deliverables. 

Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

- Identify project risks, technical issues, and dependencies and recommend appropriate mitigation actions. 
 - Support customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions when required. 
 - Mentor junior Controls Engineers and provide technical guidance during engineering, testing, and commissioning activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with engineering standards, development processes, and quality guidelines. 
 - Contribute to software standardization and continuous improvement of products, tools, and engineering processes. 
 - Report technical progress, deviations, risks, and issues to the Project Lead Engineer and Group Leader. 
 - Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams across global locations. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation and PLC-based control systems. 
 - Proven experience in engineering, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automated material handling or industrial automation systems. 
 - Experience working on international projects and site commissioning activities is preferred. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal for PLC development, troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning. 
 - Good understanding of SCADA systems and system integration. 
 - Experience with HMI development, screen configuration, alarms, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Strong knowledge of
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram (FBD)
 - Statement List (STL)
 - Structured Control Language (SCL)
 - Hands-on experience with
 - PROFINET
 - PROFIBUS
 - AS-i
 - Familiarity with Siemens engineering and diagnostic tools including Proneta, online diagnostics, backup, and version management. 
 - Working knowledge of Siemens PLC concepts including data blocks, indirect addressing, reusable software modules, and library structures. 
 - Basic to intermediate experience with Safety PLC programming, testing, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View is an added advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Good communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally for commissioning and customer support, approximately 50-70%. 
About Vanderlande

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey-from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors. 

At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other. 

Website www. vanderlande. com

What We Offer

Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice

- Competitive Salary Package
 - 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
 - 22 paid leave days
 - 8 sick/casual leave days
 - Applicable government holidays
 - Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance
 - Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs
 - Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
 - Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
 - Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering teams and international customers
 - Exposure to advanced automation and material handling technologies
How We Work

We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. 

In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say. 

Ready to apply?

data.title: Senior SDET
data.description:
About Keka

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12, 500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders. We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Engineering team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in. 

The Role

As a Senior SDET at Keka, you'll build quality into every stage of the product lifecycle, going beyond traditional testing to think like an engineer and understand how systems work. You'll work closely with Engineering and Product teams to identify risks early, build scalable automation, and strengthen our testing practices. Together, you'll help us ship reliable, high-quality software with confidence. 

What You'll Do

- Analyze requirements, technical designs, and architecture to identify potential risks and provide early quality feedback. 
 - Design and implement robust, scalable, and maintainable UI and API automation frameworks. 
 - Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Work closely with developers and product teams to embed testing and quality practices early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Perform API, backend, and database validation to ensure systems are reliable and behave as expected. 
 - Identify, investigate, document, track, and validate defects through resolution. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable faster, reliable feedback for engineering teams. 
 - Define and track meaningful quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage, automation efficiency, and overall product quality. 
 - Identify quality gaps, flaky tests, bottlenecks, and process improvements, and implement solutions. 
 - Contribute to performance and security testing initiatives where applicable. 
 - Mentor junior team members, share knowledge, and promote strong automation and quality engineering practices. 
 - Stay curious about emerging testing tools, technologies, and industry practices and bring relevant ideas to the team. 

What You'll Bring

- 4+ years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong focus on automation. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more of Python, Java, or JavaScript. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Cypress Playwright, RestAssured, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or Mocha. 
 - Practical experience with API testing using tools such as Postman or REST clients. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL, databases, and backend testing. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD environments using tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing principles, including white-box and black-box testing. 
 - Exposure to performance and/or security testing is an added advantage. 
 - What We're Looking For
 - We're looking for someone who thinks like an engineer, not just a tester. 
 - Someone who enjoys understanding systems and finding what could go wrong before it reaches the customer. 
 - You should have strong problem-solving and analytical skills, take ownership of quality from requirement to release, and be comfortable challenging assumptions and asking the right questions. 
 - You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders, so strong communication and collaboration are important. 
 - Most importantly, you should believe that quality is a shared engineering responsibility and enjoy finding smarter ways to build and test software. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Responsibilities

Position Purpose : 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our NeXus Core backend team. You will own and improve automated testing for distributed services supporting accounts, balances, trades and positions. Working closely with engineers, product and DevOps, you will build reliable component, integration, end-to-end and performance coverage, identify quality risks early, and help the team deliver correct, resilient services. This is a coding-focused role with technical ownership, code review and mentoring responsibilities. 

Primary Responsibilities Include

- Own the backend test strategy, prioritising by business risk and choosing appropriate component, integration and end-to-end coverage. 
 - Extend shared TypeScript automation frameworks and reusable helpers; build maintainable suites, deterministic test data and isolated component environments. 
 - Validate gRPC contracts and behaviour, including authentication, authorisation, errors, deadlines, streaming and backward compatibility. 
 - Test Kafka-driven ingestion and processing, including eventual consistency, duplicate or out-of-order events, retries, recovery and reconciliation with database state. 
 - Develop and maintain k6 performance suites; investigate latency, throughput, error rates and resource behaviour using Datadog. 
 - Integrate functional and performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines; diagnose failures, improve feedback and reduce flaky tests.

 - Work with engineers and product on acceptance criteria and testability; drive defect investigation through resolution.

Qualifications
