 - Practical experience testing gRPC / Protocol Buffers, including client setup, metadata, status codes and service contracts; a solid understanding of REST API testing. 
 - Experience designing component and integration tests using controlled fixtures, mocks or service simulation, alongside end-to-end coverage. 
 - Experience testing Kafka or comparable event-driven systems, with an understanding of asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency. 
 - Strong SQL skills for validating persisted data and investigating discrepancies; experience with PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database. 
 - Hands-on performance testing experience using k6 or a comparable tool, including workload design, interpreting results and investigating regressions. 
 - Experience running tests in Docker-based environments and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines; confident use of Git and pull-request workflows. 
 - Ability to diagnose failures across tests, service logs, APIs, messaging and databases, distinguishing product defects from environment or test issues. 
 - Clear communication of quality risks and release confidence, effective collaboration across teams, and experience reviewing test code or mentoring other QA engineers. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with our specific tooling: Azure DevOps, Docker Compose, WireMock, TestRail, Allure and Datadog. 
 - Familiarity with Java / Spring Boot code, Kubernetes deployments, health/readiness checks and service recovery scenarios. 
 - Experience validating schema evolution, API compatibility and authentication/authorisation across distributed services. 
 - Domain knowledge in financial services, trading systems or regulated environments, particularly account, balance, trade or position data.

4 days from office

Job Summary

A Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET IV) in the BenTech Integrations API team will drive high-quality software delivery for API-first and event-driven integration capabilities that connect The Standard's insurance ecosystem with external benefits technology platforms, HCM systems, and partner solutions. This role will focus on designing, developing, and maintaining advanced automation frameworks for REST APIs, microservices, event-driven flows, data validation, and integration testing across the BenTech platform. 

In this role, you will work closely with API engineers, data engineers, product owners, architects, DevOps/SRE teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that integration capabilities are reliable, secure, scalable, and production ready. You will build automated test coverage into CI/CD/CT pipelines, validate API contracts, test data flow across upstream and downstream systems, support non-functional testing, and improve observability through logs, metrics, dashboards, and automated quality gates. 

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on automation engineering experience, deep API testing expertise, strong test design discipline, and the ability to operate with ownership in a globally distributed delivery model. This role requires investigative thinking, technical depth, and a strong understanding of how automated testing, code-level quality practices, observability, and risk-based validation support reliability, operational readiness, and business confidence in a regulated insurance environment. 

- Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, India is a requirement of the role. 

Mode of Working: This role follows a hybrid work model, with a primary base in Bengaluru. While on-site presence is essential for key engagements, flexibility is offered for remote work based on business needs and team alignment. 

Skills And Background You'll Need

Education: A B. E. / B. Tech. degree is required. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. 

Experience: Typically requires 8+ years of related experience in software testing , test automation , API testing, and quality engineering for enterprise applications. 

Automation Engineering and Code-Level Quality

API, Integration, and Distributed Systems Testing

- Deep experience with API testing practices, including OpenAPI/Swagger validation, request/response schema validation, contract testing, authentication and authorization validation, error handling, negative testing, and backward compatibility testing. 
 - Proficiency in backend, API, and microservices testing, including service virtualization, mocking/stubbing dependent services, test data setup, and automated validation of distributed workflows. 
 - Experience validating integration flows across systems such as HCM platforms, benefits administration platforms, internal insurance systems, data platforms, or partner APIs is preferred. 
 - Experience testing API-first and event-driven integration solutions across benefits technology, HCM, data, or insurance-related platforms is strongly preferred. 

CI/CD, Test Data, Performance, and Operational Readiness

- Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD/CT pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps, including test gating strategies, pipeline automation, build health monitoring, and automated quality reporting. 
 - Experience with synthetic data creation, test data management, data masking, and data quality rule automation to support high-fidelity testing in regulated environments.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate test strategy, risks, defects, and quality insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Domain Background

- Preferred: Experience testing software in regulated, mission-critical, or high-consequence domains such as insurance, healthcare, medical devices, financial services, or similar environments where quality, traceability, risk management, and release discipline are essential. 

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate

- Ownership and Accountability - Takes initiative, drives automation and quality outcomes independently, manages ambiguity, and owns validation from requirement understanding through production readiness. 
 - Customer and Business Focus - Understands how BenTech integrations support employer, broker, partner, and customer experiences; identifies quality risks that could impact business outcomes or operational reliability. 
 - Engineering Excellence - Builds scalable, maintainable, and reusable test automation; promotes strong engineering discipline, quality gates, observability, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Collaboration and Influence - Partners effectively with API engineers, data engineers, product owners, architects, DevOps/SRE teams, and business stakeholders to strengthen quality practices across the team.

Job Opportunity: Automation Engineer

Location : PAN India Site

Company : SFC Environmental Technologies Limited

SFC is an environmental technology company providing advanced solutions in wastewater treatment, wastewater recycle & reuse, and solid waste treatment. Since 2005, we have been enabling municipalities and industries to build and operate plants that are simple, flexible, and cost effective throughout their lifecycle. 

We are the market leader in India in sequencing batch reactor (SBR) technology through our flagship C-Tech process, holding 80%+ share and delivering reliable treatment at scale. With technologies spanning C-Tech, Fiber Disc Filters, Submerged Ultrafiltration, MBR, MABR, and CCRO, we are helping drive the transition to reuse and circular water management. 

Our footprint covers India, Austria, Germany, and Czechia, supported by in-house R&D, manufacturing, and automation capabilities. Together with our subsidiary Hindustan Waste Treatment, we are also advancing integrated solid waste management solutions that generate renewable energy and reduce landfill impact. 

At SFC, we believe in People → Planet → Profit. Our culture is built on freedom, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning - empowering our teams to innovate and grow across roles, functions, and geographies. 

Role Definition: 

The Automation Engineer (PLC Programmer) will develop and implement PLC-SCADA-HMI programs, support onsite commissioning, troubleshoot automation issues, and ensure reliable plant operation across project sites in India. The role requires strong programming skills, coordination with cross-functional teams, and adherence to safety, quality, and project standards. 

Experience

- 2-5 years of relevant experience in industrial automation, PLC-SCADA programming, and plant commissioning. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Diploma / B. E. in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) - The AI Factory Platform Company - we're building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide. 

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale. 

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision. 

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact. 

Job Overview

We are seeking a Manager, Quality Engineering to lead quality engineering for ClusterWareAI, a critical component of the Penguin Solutions AI Factory Platform. 

ClusterWareAI enables automated provisioning, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large-scale AI infrastructure. In this role, you will define and drive the quality strategy for a complex distributed platform spanning GPU infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, Kubernetes, workload orchestration, and AI-enabled operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead and develop a Quality Engineering team while partnering closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration teams to build quality into every stage of the product lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate brings a strong product-engineering mindset, deep experience with test automation and distributed systems, and a passion for delivering reliable cloud and infrastructure software at scale. 

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI across functional, integration, system, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resilience testing. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing QE team while establishing strong technical, automation, and execution practices. 
 - Drive a shift-left, automation-first quality culture, partnering with Engineering, Product, Platform, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Design scalable test automation frameworks across APIs, UI, CLI, control-plane services, infrastructure integrations, and end-to-end workflows, integrated with CI/CD quality gates. 
 - Define test strategies for GPU infrastructure, bare metal, Kubernetes, networking, storage, workload orchestration, and distributed systems at scale. 
 - Validate infrastructure lifecycle workflows including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, rollback, deprovisioning, monitoring, health management, and automated remediation. 
 - Drive performance, scalability, HA, fault-injection, longevity, and failure/recovery testing across large-scale distributed environments. 
 - Define validation for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, security, access controls, resource governance, and workload separation. 
 - Establish quality and release-readiness metrics covering automation, escaped defects, test reliability, performance, scalability, and product risk. 
 - Partner with Support and Engineering on customer issues, root-cause analysis, and converting field failures into automated regression coverage. 
 - Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted quality engineering approaches to improve test generation, failure analysis, defect triage, and engineering productivity. 

AI / Agentic Quality Engineering

- Own the AI Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI's AI Platform capabilities. 
 - Build automated AI evaluation frameworks and benchmark suites covering accuracy, groundedness, consistency, reliability, latency, cost, and task success. 
 - Establish LLM and agent evaluation methodologies using golden datasets, scenario-based testing, synthetic data, LLM-as-a-Judge, rubric-based evaluation, and human evaluation. 
 - Test RAG, tool calling, multi-step agents, planning/execution, agent collaboration, memory, and infrastructure-aware reasoning. 
 - Develop AI regression pipelines to detect degradation caused by changes to models, prompts, agents, tools, knowledge sources, and orchestration logic. 
 - Drive AI safety and adversarial testing, including hallucination, prompt injection, unauthorized tool use, policy violations, data leakage, and unsafe infrastructure actions. 
 - Validate agent guardrails, policy enforcement, approvals, authorization boundaries, tenant isolation, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Establish production AI quality metrics including task success rate, hallucination rate, tool-call accuracy, agent failure rate, escalation rate, latency, and cost efficiency. 
 - Develop scenario-based autonomous infrastructure testing to validate that agents correctly observe, reason, plan, obtain approval, execute authorized actions, verify outcomes, and recover safely from failures. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years in Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, Test Automation, or related engineering roles, with 3+ years leading QE teams. 
 - Proven experience owning quality for a commercial software, cloud, infrastructure, or distributed systems platform. 
 - Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Python, with experience building scalable automation frameworks. 
 - Strong experience testing APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure software, and complex enterprise applications. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, performance, scalability, reliability, HA, security, and failure/recovery testing. 
 - Strong Linux, debugging, observability, log analysis, and distributed-systems troubleshooting skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, coaching, and team development. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/LLM quality engineering, AI evaluation, or testing AI-powered applications. 
 - Experience testing LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation methodologies including golden datasets, benchmark testing, LLM-as-a-Judge, RAG evaluation, adversarial testing, and red teaming. 
 - Experience with frameworks such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith/LangChain evaluation, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, or equivalent. 
 - Understanding of AI failure modes including hallucination, prompt injection, non-determinism, tool-use errors, context failures, model regression, and unsafe agent behavior. 
 - Experience integrating AI evaluation and regression testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU cloud/neocloud platforms, or large-scale cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and multi-tenant cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with GPU infrastructure, including GPU lifecycle, drivers, firmware, health monitoring, and heterogeneous accelerator environments. 
 - Experience with high-performance networking technologies such as InfiniBand, RDMA/RoCE, high-speed Ethernet, and distributed storage. 
 - Experience with bare-metal provisioning, infrastructure lifecycle management, and fleet-scale automation. 
 - Experience with workload orchestration and scheduling technologies such as Kubernetes and Slurm. 
 - Experience with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Ansible. 
 - Experience with cloud platform security, tenant isolation, identity/access controls, and resource governance.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II - Frontend
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About Commerce & Payments Team: 

The Commerce & Payments team is a newly formed organization to add HighLevel's evolving capabilities and make it both a Commerce Platform and a surface where our customers can perform their sales motions for their products. Building Catalogs, subscriptions, fulfillment , payment processing engines, inventory mgmt, pricing, documents/contracts and more to enable our SMBs to increase their revenue will be the core focus of the org. Hardly any tech debt, mostly green field work working closely with product folks to build, ship and refine our Commerce offerings makes this an exciting place to learn, engage and thrive. 

About the Role: 

We're building a global commerce platform to power $1T+ in annual transactions for millions of SMEs. As an SDE II on the frontend, you'll build the surfaces that customers and their buyers touch: storefronts, checkout, catalog, subscription management, invoices and contracts. 

These surfaces carry money. They get embedded inside other people's experiences. They run on slow phones and flaky networks in 150+ countries. A layout shift shows up in someone's conversion rate, and a 300ms regression shows up in someone's revenue. 

This role is for engineers who obsess over frontend craft and have the depth to back it up. If you already know why your bundle is that size, where your hydration cost goes, and what your service worker does on a cache miss, we want to talk to you. 

Responsibilities: 

- Build and ship the commerce surfaces: storefronts, checkout, catalog, subscription management, invoices and documents
 - Embed our experiences inside other experiences - module federation, iframes and white-label hosts that stay isolated, load fast and degrade gracefully
 - Own performance budgets end to end: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, render cost, hydration, main-thread work. Measure them in CI and defend them
 - Build installable, offline-tolerant PWAs with service workers, considered caching strategies and background sync
 - Deliver WCAG 2. 2 AA accessibility and full localisation across languages, currencies, tax and address formats, and RTL layouts
 - Instrument the client with real-user monitoring and OpenTelemetry so regressions surface before customers report them
 - Collaborate with PM/Design and mentor junior engineers

Requirements: 

- 2+ years building and operating production frontend applications
 - Deep Vue. js knowledge: the reactivity model, component composition, rendering behaviour, and the runtime cost of each choice
 - A visible performance habit. You live in Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools and the performance profiler, and you can walk us through a regression you found, measured and fixed
 - Service workers and caching strategy: precaching, runtime caching, versioning, invalidation, and offline behaviour that stays correct
 - Client state management and local caching at scale (TanStack Query or equivalent): cache keys, staleness, invalidation, optimistic updates
 - Accessibility as a build-time discipline: semantics, focus management, keyboard paths, screen reader behaviour, WCAG 2. 2 AA
 - Internationalisation and localisation: message extraction, plurals, locale-aware currency and date formatting, RTL
 - Modern frontend tooling and module federation (Rspack, Vite), plus bundle analysis and code splitting
 - An eye for craft. You notice the four-pixel misalignment, the janky scroll, and the layout shift that only appears on a throttled connection, and you fix all three
 - Comfortable consuming typed backend contracts (ConnectRPC/protobuf) and reasoning about API contracts and error states
 - Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills

Tech Stack: 

Frontend: Vue. js, Rspack, Module Federation, TanStack Query

Client platform: Service workers/PWA, OpenTelemetry, Vite, ESLint

Backend contracts: Go, ConnectRPC, Buf

Cloud: GCP (GKE), Pub/Sub

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values-Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous-we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all. 

Role Summary & Purpose

Championing product integrity and consumer trust, you will architect and deploy the site Quality Master Plan and Quality Manual across Colgate-Palmolive's high-speed Sri City manufacturing plant. You will drive a rigorous 'Right First Time' operational culture by auditing manufacturing systems, resolving Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) through CAPA, and leading technical bundle validations. Partnering directly with shop-floor operations and global audit teams, you eliminate process variation and customer complaints. Based on-site in Sri City, you ensure every toothbrush manufactured meets world-class quality and safety standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, document, and maintain the site Quality Master Plan, Quality Manual, and Global Quality standards compliance. 
 - Conduct internal audit programs and participate in Divisional and Corporate Quality Audits to evaluate site quality effectiveness. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and CAPA closures for all Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) in coordination with plant leadership. 
 - Manage the online Customer Response System (CRS), analyzing consumer complaints to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor shop-floor quality KPIs and process capability to ensure all finished products fulfill KRSs (Key Release Specification) prior to market release. 
 - Deliver structured technical training and coaching to Quality Technicians, Operators, and plant line teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science or Technical stream (B. Sc / M. Sc / B. Tech) from a recognized university. 
 - Experience: 3 to 5 years of core experience in the FMCG industry with Quality & Production management responsibility. 
 - Quality Methodologies: Proven expertise in developing Quality Manuals, executing CAPA, NCR resolution, and process capability monitoring. 
 - Systems: Working knowledge of SAP (QM module), online CRS complaint management, and quality audit frameworks. 

Preferred Qualification & Experience

- Industry: Experience in high-volume consumer goods (CPG/FMCG), oral care, or precision plastics manufacturing. 
 - Audit Expertise: Familiarity with international subsidiary benchmarking, cGMP, and EOHS site standards.

data.title: Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

data.title: Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

data.title: Software Engineer 2
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications, combining responsive, accessible React interfaces with backend services and RESTful APIs. 
 - Build scalable backend services using Java/Spring Boot and Node. js/TypeScript, integrating SQL and NoSQL databases with high availability and fault tolerance. 
 - Optimize query performance and data modeling across relational (SQL) and document/key-value (NoSQL) stores. 
 - Use AI coding agents to plan and implement frontend and backend features, navigate repositories, refactor code, generate and run tests, and debug issues; review and validate changes for correctness, quality, and security. 
 - Implement secure coding practices leveraging SAST and DAST tools; partner with security to remediate findings. 
 - Build reusable UI components and backend integrations using shared libraries for authentication, configuration, logging, caching, and data access; collaborate on CI/CD, containerization, and runtime operations. 
 - Contribute to cloud-ready architecture; deploy and monitor frontend applications and backend services on cloud platforms such as Azure. 
 - Ensure code quality and collaboration using GitHub (PRs, code reviews, branching strategies). 
 - Troubleshoot frontend, API, and database issues in production, perform root cause analysis, and improve performance and reliability across the application. 
 - Own features from requirements and UI/API design through implementation, automated testing, and release; collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams in an Agile environment. 

Key Qualifications

- Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or a related field, or relevant experience considered. 
 - At least 5 years of software development experience, including hands-on delivery across frontend and backend. 
 - Strong proficiency in React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, plus backend development experience with Java/Spring Boot or Node. js; willingness to work across both backend stacks. 
 - Hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design, indexing, performance tuning, and transactions. 
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and frontend-to-backend integration, including API contracts, validation, authentication, authorization, and error handling. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI agentic coding workflows: providing requirements and repository context, guiding multi-step implementation, using development tools and test feedback, and reviewing agent-generated changes. Ability to validate results while protecting sensitive data and respecting security, privacy, and licensing constraints. 
 - Knowledge of SAST and DAST for secure coding practices. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Experience with source control systems, preferably GitHub. 
 - Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work efficiently in a team-oriented environment. 
 - Capability to manage complex requirements and adhere to deliverable timelines. 
 - Experience or knowledge in DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure as code) is a valuable asset. 

Preferred Experience

- Proficiency with SQL (e. g. , SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e. g. , DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra), including data modeling and migration strategies; familiarity with Redis caching. 
 - Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for container orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing) and performance profiling. 
 - Knowledge of API gateways, service mesh, or message queues (e. g. , Kafka, RabbitMQ); experience with micro-frontends, shared component libraries, and design systems. 
 - Experience creating reusable instructions and workflows for AI coding agents, including test generation, static analysis, documentation, and safe refactoring; familiarity with MCP tools and schema validation. 
 - Understanding of security best practices (OAuth2/OpenID Connect, secrets management, TLS). 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with infrastructure concepts: networking, load balancing, autoscaling, and cost optimization. 
 - Exposure to IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) and pipeline automation (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). 
 - Background in frontend and backend test automation (unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing) and blue/green or canary deployments. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance practices, including prompt hygiene, data redaction, and validation against organizational coding standards. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Cost & Engineering Efficiency

Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Hybrid)

Summary Of Role

Sumo Logic's microservices architecture, hosted on AWS, ingests petabytes of data daily across many geographic regions in support of our planet-scale observability and security products, serving hundreds of millions of queries a day against thousands of petabytes of data. At that scale, every inefficiency - in code, architecture, or infrastructure - compounds into real cost. 

This role sits within the Product SRE organization, working alongside your global SRE team on your product area's reliability roadmap - with a mandate that leads with code as much as operations. You'll find where Sumo's systems are spending more compute, storage, or engineering time than necessary, and fix it in the code and architecture, not just the infra config, while also carrying the fuller SRE mandate - reliability, security posture, and improving the day-to-day experience of the engineers within your product area. You'll be part of a team that blends SRE and backend software engineering skillsets, partnering closely with product engineering teams across your product area. 

This is an engineering role - the work is about shipping code, architecture, and system-level changes that improve unit economics, not managing cost dashboards, tagging, or reserved-instance/savings-plan purchasing. 

What You'll Do

- Continuously discover cost and efficiency opportunities through production profiling, telemetry, cost data, capacity trends, and system-level analysis - across algorithmic inefficiencies, resource-heavy code paths, and architectural decisions - and turn ambiguous problems into prioritized engineering initiatives. 
 - Apply performance and capacity engineering techniques to understand CPU, memory, storage, network, and I/O behavior under real production workloads, and optimize the resulting resource footprint. 
 - Write production-grade code to implement the optimizations you identify - JVM/GC tuning, algorithmic and resource-efficiency improvements, re-architecting inefficient services - in systems that process petabytes of data daily. 
 - Define and track engineering efficiency metrics such as cost per GB ingested, cost per query, cost per event, resource utilization, or cost per customer workload, and translate the work into measurable impact for engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement - influencing teams where you don't have direct ownership - and help establish engineering patterns and practices that make cost and efficiency a continuous part of the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with engineering teams in your product area to prioritize changes, and with developer infrastructure and Global SRE to align with the broader reliability roadmap. 
 - Participate in the SRE responsibilities for different product areas - SLOs, on-call, incident response, and blameless RCA - using those experiences to identify systemic reliability, performance, and efficiency improvements. 

What You'll Have

- B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience with a demonstrated track record of ownership. 
 - Strong CS fundamentals - comfortable with algorithmic complexity, data-structure performance characteristics, and system design at scale. 
 - Ability to author production-ready code in at least one OO/systems language (Java, Scala, Go, C++, or similar) - depth of engineering ability matters more than which language. 
 - Experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of independently identifying ambiguous performance, scalability, or cost problems and driving engineering changes that produced measurable improvements in production. 
 - Strong ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior, capacity, performance, and cost, and use production data to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes. 
 - Working fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS compute, storage, networking) - enough to reason about cost and architectural tradeoffs. 
 - Comfort moving across the stack, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on, to find root causes of inefficiency. 

Nice to have

- JVM tuning and GC optimization experience at scale. 
 - Exposure to cost-attribution/FinOps practices or tooling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or modern CI/CD tooling. 
 - Prior SRE experience - on-call, SLOs, incident response. 
 - Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kafka Streams) or observability/security platforms. 

Why this role

- Visibility - Cost/efficiency work maps directly to metrics the business already tracks. 
 - Scope you define - you identify where the opportunities are rather than executing a fixed backlog. 
 - Real scale - systems ingesting petabytes of data daily and serving hundreds of millions of queries. 

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www. sumologic. com.

data.description:
Lead Data Services Engineer

Experienced Data Engineering leader driving enterprise-scale GCP data platforms, distributed systems, and developer enablement through modern cloud-native architectures. 

Opportunity to be one of our first team members in Woolworths Group India in Bangalore. 

Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position

. 

Purpose

As a Lead Data Services Engineer at Woolworths Group, you will provide technical leadership for our enterprise-scale data ecosystem, shaping the future of modern data platforms, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering practices. You will drive the design and delivery of scalable, low-latency, event-driven data solutions while enabling engineering teams through reusable frameworks, self-service tooling, and platform standardisation. This role combines deep software engineering expertise with data platform strategy, operational excellence, AI-enabled solutions, and engineering leadership. You will work closely with Product Managers, Architects, Analytics teams, and engineering leaders across ANZ and India to modernize data services and deliver business-critical outcomes across Woolworths' global technology landscape. 

Scope: 

This role carries technical stewardship of Woolworths' core Data Services platform and Information Management (IM) ecosystem. You will lead architecture decisions, define engineering standards, oversee platform reliability, and drive adoption of cloud-native technologies across multiple squads. You will be responsible for ensuring scalable, secure, and cost-efficient solutions while championing software engineering excellence, product-centric thinking, platform governance, and operational readiness. 

What you'll do

- Drive Product Vision & Data Platform Strategy: Define and champion the strategic product vision for Data Services, treating data infrastructure, APIs, ingestion frameworks, and platform capabilities as internal products. Build and maintain engineering roadmaps that align platform evolution, feature delivery, and technical debt reduction with business priorities. 
 - Lead Architecture & Distributed Systems Design: Design and implement resilient batch, streaming, and event-driven architectures leveraging GCP services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Bigtable, and Memorystore. Drive best practices in distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Enable Developer Productivity & Platform Standardisation: Build reusable ingestion frameworks, self-service tooling, internal SDKs, and standardised data contracts that empower squads to deliver solutions faster while maintaining governance and consistency across the platform. 
 - Champion Software Engineering & Cloud Native Practices: Lead CI/CD implementation, Infrastructure-as-Code adoption using Terraform, containerization strategies, automated testing frameworks, and deployment automation across development and production environments. 
 - Drive Reliability, Governance & Operational Excellence: Establish SRE principles including SLOs, latency SLAs, observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, data lineage, security controls, and FinOps practices. Ensure enterprise-grade reliability, governance, and operational readiness across all platform services. 
 - Lead, Mentor & Collaborate Across Teams: Mentor engineers, conduct architecture and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and lead cross-functional squads. Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Analytics teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Advance AI & Next-Generation Data Solutions: Leverage AI technologies, GenAI infrastructure, and intelligent automation to solve complex data challenges, accelerate engineering productivity, and enable innovative data-serving capabilities. 
 - Ensure End-to-End Quality & Service Transition: Oversee automated testing strategies, release governance, change management processes, operational documentation, and service transition activities to ensure platform solutions are production-ready and fully supported. 

What you'll bring

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience: 6+ years of software and data engineering experience, including 4+ years of hands-on GCP architecture experience and 3+ years in a Senior Engineer, Technical Lead, or Platform Leadership role. 
 - GCP & Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep knowledge of BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, Bigtable, Memorystore, IAM, and modern distributed system architectures. 
 - Software Engineering Excellence: Strong hands-on experience with Python and Go (or Java/Scala), advanced SQL optimisation, microservices architecture, event-driven systems, API development, and cloud-native engineering. 
 - DevOps & Infrastructure Automation: Strong experience in Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/GKE, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, automated testing, and infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Product & Platform Mindset: Demonstrated success in building shared platforms, establishing self-service capabilities, managing engineering roadmaps, and delivering scalable enterprise solutions. 
 - Leadership & Mentorship: Proven ability to lead engineering squads, mentor team members, influence technical direction, and collaborate effectively across distributed global teams. 
 - Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification is mandatory. 

What you'll experience

- Be a part of Australia's largest retailer. 
 - Work on large-scale global data and cloud transformation initiatives. 
 - Opportunity to influence next-generation data platform architecture. 
 - Collaborate with highly skilled engineering teams across ANZ and India. 
 - A flexible and inclusive working environment. 
 - Continuous learning, mentoring, and career growth opportunities. 

Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team's diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer II
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer II based in India. 

In this role, you will design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade Linux platforms that enable engineering teams to deliver reliable software efficiently. You will lead platform engineering initiatives spanning infrastructure automation, vulnerability management, compliance, and cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Leveraging advanced Linux administration, Ansible, Terraform, and CI/CD practices, you will improve platform consistency, operational resilience, and security at scale. You will also drive automation initiatives that streamline patching, standardize system configurations, and strengthen production readiness across complex environments. Working closely with security, infrastructure, and application teams, you will troubleshoot critical issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced platform engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, modernizing operational practices, and building secure, scalable systems in an enterprise environment. 

Accountabilities

- Design, build, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise UNIX/Linux platforms throughout their lifecycle, from server provisioning and configuration to production readiness, maintenance, and retirement. 
 - Lead Linux vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance validation, and audit readiness across large-scale enterprise environments. 
 - Plan and execute operating system patching, kernel updates, platform upgrades, and fleet maintenance, using controlled rollouts, canary deployments, and reliable rollback procedures. 
 - Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code tools to improve operational efficiency and consistency. 
 - Manage Linux workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including server provisioning, bootstrap processes, platform images, private repositories, and lifecycle management. 
 - Build and maintain standardized, secure Linux images using Packer or AWS Image Builder, integrating security controls and automated configuration management into golden-image workflows. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, primarily with GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms, to automate patching, security hardening, compliance checks, and governed operational procedures. 
 - Implement and maintain CIS benchmark compliance using Ansible Lockdown, investigate failed controls, remediate configuration gaps, and manage documented policy waivers with appropriate business justification and variable mapping. 
 - Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, including Qualys vulnerability QIDs associated with CVEs and packages, as well as CIS compliance CIDs. 
 - Integrate security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, and StackHawk into CI/CD workflows where applicable. 
 - Improve platform reliability through monitoring, diagnostics, automated remediation, self-healing capabilities, and observability enhancements. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex operating system, networking, storage, authentication, and performance issues, leading root-cause analysis and implementing preventive measures. 
 - Manage secure access mechanisms, including SSH, sudo, Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), certificates, and privileged access controls. 
 - Support incident, problem, and change management processes, production operations, and on-call response to maintain service availability and operational stability. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, log analysis, scripting, root-cause investigations, documentation, and automation development. 
 - Maintain platform standards, technical documentation, operational runbooks, and reusable automation patterns while collaborating with security, infrastructure, and application teams to continuously improve platform services. 

Requirements

- At least 7 years of hands-on experience in platform engineering, including substantial experience administering and operating enterprise Linux environments. 
 - Expert-level Linux administration skills across RHEL 8/9, Ubuntu 22. 04/24. 04, and Amazon Linux 2/2023, including kernel and security patching, package management, service administration, user and permission management, SSH configuration, logging, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Practical experience with controlled patch deployments, canary rollouts, rollback procedures, and Linux lifecycle management, including tools such as dnf history. 
 - Strong knowledge of CIS security benchmarks and experience applying them through Ansible Lockdown, remediating failed controls, and managing documented policy exceptions with business justification and corresponding Ansible variable mappings. 
 - Advanced Ansible skills for configuration management, automated patching, security hardening, and platform provisioning. 
 - Experience integrating security hardening into golden images and onboarding third-party Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), including bootstrap configuration, automation keys, domain joining, and agent installation. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience managing Linux workloads across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, including EC2, user data, bootstrap automation, and private package repositories. 
 - Strong Terraform and Ansible expertise, along with practical experience building standardized Linux images using Packer or AWS Image Builder. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable tools, including workflows for patching, compliance validation, and controlled operational execution. 
 - Proven ability to remediate Qualys vulnerability QIDs involving CVEs and packages, address CIS compliance CIDs, and work with security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, and StackHawk. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering automated platform solutions, including large-scale vulnerability remediation, compliance diagnostics, policy-waiver registers, and repository or mirror troubleshooting. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose complex operating system, networking, storage, authentication, and performance issues and lead effective root-cause analysis. 
 - Solid understanding of secure access management, including SSH, sudo, PAM, certificates, and privileged access controls. 
 - Familiarity with incident management, problem management, change management, production support, and on-call operational practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve troubleshooting, scripting, log analysis, documentation, root-cause analysis, and automation workflows. 
 - Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate across infrastructure, security, and application engineering teams. 
 - AWS certifications or additional working knowledge of Azure and Google Cloud are advantageous. 
 - Experience with immutable infrastructure, autoscaling, observability, monitoring, GitOps, and progressive delivery is desirable. 
 - Familiarity with mixed Windows/Linux environments and IT operations, including DNS, load balancers, reverse proxies, Microsoft Active Directory, and Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), is a plus. 

Benefits

- Remote working: Opportunity to work remotely from India, subject to the applicable working arrangements. 
 - Full-time employment: A full-time opportunity to contribute to enterprise platform engineering initiatives. 
 - Competitive compensation: Salary aligned with experience, technical expertise, and the overall employment package. 
 - Professional development: Opportunities to deepen expertise in Linux infrastructure, cloud engineering, security automation, and platform reliability. 
 - Modern technology stack: Hands-on exposure to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, security tooling, and AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Technical ownership: Lead impactful platform improvements and influence infrastructure standards, automation strategies, and security practices. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration: Work with infrastructure, security, and application engineering teams on complex enterprise challenges. 
 - Continuous learning: Develop skills in cloud platforms, compliance automation, immutable infrastructure, observability, and progressive delivery.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced DFT Architect to lead Design-for-Test strategy, architecture definition, and implementation for complex ASIC/SOC designs across advanced technology nodes. The ideal candidate will drive end-to-end DFT architecture including scan, MBIST, compression, boundary scan, and at-speed test methodologies while collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve high test coverage, quality, and silicon bring-up success. 

What You'll Do

- Define and own SOC-level DFT architecture and test strategy for complex semiconductor designs. 
 - Lead implementation of scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, boundary scan, and test compression methodologies. 
 - Drive DFT planning and integration aligned with power, timing, area, and test coverage goals. 
 - Collaborate with RTL, Physical Design, Verification, and Product Engineering teams for seamless DFT integration and signoff. 
 - Analyze and resolve DFT-related timing, routing, and testability challenges. 
 - Support silicon bring-up, debug, diagnosis, yield analysis, and production test optimization. 
 - Develop and enhance DFT automation flows, methodologies, and reusable infrastructure. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across projects. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, or related field. 
 - 14+ years of experience in ASIC/SOC DFT implementation and architecture. 
 - Strong expertise in scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG, compression, and low-power DFT methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard DFT tools such as Siemens Tessent, Synopsys DFT Compiler/TestMAX, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of RTL design, timing, physical design constraints, and silicon debug. 
 - Experience with advanced technology nodes and large SOC integration. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell. 
 - Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with automotive safety standards such as ISO 26262. 
 - Exposure to chiplet-based architectures and 3D IC testing methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of diagnosis-driven yield improvement and silicon analytics. 

Success in This Role Looks Like

- Delivery of robust DFT architectures with high test coverage and efficient manufacturing test cost. 
 - Successful silicon bring-up with minimal DFT-related issues. 
 - Improved DFT methodology scalability, automation, and execution efficiency. 
 - Strong technical leadership and contribution to organization-wide DFT best practices. 

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

data.title: Pre/Post  Silicon Validation Framework/Tools / Infra development engineer
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm's System Validation & Emulation (SVE) organization is seeking exceptional engineers with deep expertise in Embedded Software Architecture, Framework Development, Validation Infrastructure, and System Software Debug. The ideal candidate will possess strong software architecture skills and the ability to root-cause complex issues across multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous SoC environments spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, validation frameworks, and system infrastructure. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Responsibilities

- Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable embedded software frameworks, validation infrastructure, and platform software for pre-silicon and post-silicon SoC validation. 
 - Develop reusable framework components, platform abstraction layers, middleware, and system software services supporting multicore and heterogeneous compute environments. 
 - Drive software architecture and framework design to enable portability, scalability, maintainability, and reuse across multiple SoC programs and IP validation domains. 
 - Develop and maintain bring-up, validation, and debug infrastructure for bare-metal, lightweight RTOS, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments. 
 - Debug and root-cause complex system-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, framework software, memory subsystems, coherency fabrics, and system infrastructure IPs. 
 - Develop framework capabilities supporting multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous CPU architectures, including system-level synchronization, coherency, and performance optimization. 
 - Design, implement, and optimize automated validation, regression, and release workflows to improve productivity, quality, and scalability. 
 - Integrate static analysis, code-quality tools, build systems, and release processes into Continuous Integration (CI) environments. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and validation teams to enable efficient silicon bring-up, feature validation, and debug. 
 - Drive continuous improvements in software quality, framework architecture, automation, and validation methodologies. 

Minimum Qualification

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 6+ to 10 years of industry experience in Embedded Software, System Software, SoC Validation, Silicon Enablement, Platform Software, Framework Development, or related domains. 
 - Proven experience in embedded software architecture, framework development, low-level software design, and complex system-level debug. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills in hardware-software integrated environments. 

Mandatory Skills

- Strong expertise in Embedded Software Architecture, Framework Design, and Infrastructure Development using C, C++, and Assembly. 
 - Proven experience designing and developing scalable software frameworks, platform abstraction layers, middleware, validation infrastructure, and reusable system software components. 
 - Extensive experience in low-level software development, including boot code, exception handling, interrupt management, startup sequences, and C-Assembly interworking. 
 - Deep understanding of CPU architectures and microarchitectural concepts, including ARMv8/ARMv9, x86, and PowerPC architectures. 
 - Strong expertise in multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous SoC environments, including SMP, AMP, heterogeneous compute subsystems, and cross-core software interactions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to debug complex system-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, framework software, and validation infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of cache coherency, I/O coherency, memory ordering, synchronization primitives, inter-processor communication, and concurrency-related issues. 
 - Deep knowledge of SoC architecture, including compute subsystems, memory hierarchies, interconnect fabrics, power management, and system infrastructure IPs. 
 - Strong understanding of Operating Systems, RTOS, and Linux kernel internals, including multithreading, scheduling policies, locking mechanisms, interrupt handling, virtual memory, MMU architecture, and kernel synchronization primitives. 
 - Deep understanding of memory management, weakly ordered memory models, cache architectures, pipelining, memory barriers, TLBs, coherency protocols, and performance optimization techniques. 
 - Strong expertise in software build infrastructure, compiler toolchains, linker internals, Makefiles, linker/scatter scripts, and build system architecture. 
 - Proficiency with GCC, Clang/LLVM, ARM toolchains, code optimization techniques, and root-causing complex compiler and linker issues. 
 - Strong debugging expertise using JTAG, trace, emulation, FPGA, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for automation, framework development, debug, and productivity tooling. 

Desired Skills

- Experience architecting and developing large-scale embedded software frameworks or validation infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams and SoC programs. 
 - Experience with silicon bring-up, board bring-up, post-silicon validation, and hardware-software integration. 
 - Hands-on experience with pre-silicon emulation, FPGA prototyping, and post-silicon debug environments. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM-based SoC architectures, memory hierarchies, cache coherency protocols, interconnect fabrics, and system infrastructure IPs. 
 - Experience developing framework abstractions supporting heterogeneous processing elements such as application processors, real-time processors, DSPs, AI/ML accelerators, and security subsystems. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD systems, automated regression infrastructure, release management, and software quality methodologies. 
 - Experience with JTAG, Lauterbach Trace32, hardware trace, and performance analysis tools. 
 - Experience with source code management systems such as Git and Perforce. 
 - Familiarity with build automation, containerized development environments, and scalable software deployment workflows. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical direction for framework and infrastructure development initiatives. 

Applicants: Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm. com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).

data.description:
About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 

About The Team

Our mission is to deliver a resilient, internet-scale microservice platform supporting high-velocity development, real-time analytics, and intelligent automation. 

The team architects and powers critical backend services at the core of our opportunity management and forecasting ecosystem. We collaborate closely with cross-functional leaders to drive innovation, enable data-driven decisions, and leverage cutting-edge AI/ML to ensure global customer impact. 

The Role

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer who thrives on tackling complex technical and architectural challenges at scale. 

You will bring deep expertise in scalable, distributed systems design, lead high-performing teams through ambiguity, and accelerate product innovation in data-driven and AI-rich environments. 

You will steer system evolution, guarantee performance under high loads, and mentor peers while shaping delivery and technical direction.

 - Diagnosing and eliminating performance bottlenecks and proactively addressing reliability risks. 
 - Mentoring, reviewing code/architectures, and fostering a culture of rapid learning. 
 - Decomposing legacy systems into SOA/microservices, resolving tech debt, and evolving the architecture for scale. 
 - Taking end-to-end ownership of major initiatives from planning through impact.

- 7+ years of strong backend development experience. 
 - Demonstrated excellence designing and operating large-scale distributed systems with cloud service-oriented architecture. 
 - Proven leadership in fast-paced environments, setting standards, and inspiring technical teams to exceed delivery goals. 
 - Mastery in backend programming (Go required, Python/Java/Ruby a plus) and hands-on with distributed data platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NoSQL). 
 - Experience building APIs, analytics/data infrastructure, and deploying ML algorithms in production. 
 - Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills. 
 - Commitment to security, compliance, and robust, scalable design. 
 - Growth mindset - always learning, always elevating the technical bar for the team. 

Why You'll Love It Here

 - 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
 - Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
 - OPD benefit covered up to INR 10, 000

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. data.title: SAP SuccessFactors & Payroll Test Analyst
data.description:
Company Description TestDel provides specialized software quality and testing services to organizations that choose to outsource all or part of their QA activities. The company focuses on helping clients gain testing efficiencies and reduce the overhead of managing in-house QA teams. TestDel's core expertise lies in identifying and preventing application issues to support smooth, reliable user experiences. The team collaborates closely with clients to understand their needs and recommend testing services that best fit each environment and business objective. 

Role Description The SAP SuccessFactors & Payroll Test Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for validating SAP SuccessFactors modules and payroll processes to ensure accuracy, stability, and a seamless user experience. Day-to-day tasks include planning and executing test scenarios, creating and maintaining test cases, and performing manual testing of configurations, integrations, and payroll runs. The role involves analyzing test results, documenting defects, and collaborating with functional consultants, HR, payroll, and technical teams to resolve issues. The analyst will participate in test management activities such as test data preparation, regression testing, and reporting on test progress and quality metrics. This role also contributes to continuous improvement of testing practices and supports UAT by guiding stakeholders through test cycles. 

Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience with Testing and Manual Testing, particularly in SAP SuccessFactors and payroll processes. 
 - Proficiency in Test Execution, including designing, running, and documenting test cases and scenarios. 
 - Experience with Test Management, such as organizing test cycles, managing defects, and reporting test outcomes. 
 - Demonstrated Analytical Skills for troubleshooting issues, validating data, and interpreting complex HR and payroll rules. 
 - Practical knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors (e. g. , Employee Central, Time, Payroll) and related integrations is highly beneficial. 
 - Familiarity with QA tools and methodologies, including regression testing, UAT support, and defect tracking systems. 
 - Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage priorities, and communicate clearly with cross-functional teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Previous experience in HRIS or payroll testing, and relevant certifications in SAP SuccessFactors or testing (e. g. , ISTQB) are a plus. Essential Requirements

- Available to join within 4 week
 - Minimum 3 years of hands-on SAP testing experience. 
 - Strong experience in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central testing. 
 - Practical experience in SAP Payroll or Employee Central Payroll testing. 
 - Experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors releases, upgrades, or enhancements. 
 - Good understanding of HR business processes and employee lifecycle events. 
 - Experience with payroll integration and data validation. 
 - Strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression, SIT, and UAT testing. 
 - Experience designing test cases independently from business requirements. 
 - Familiarity with JIRA, qTest, Azure DevOps, TestRail, or similar testing tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment. How To Apply

If you have hands-on SAP SuccessFactors and Payroll testing experience and are looking for an opportunity to work on challenging enterprise projects, we would like to hear from you. 

Please submit your updated CV, highlighting your relevant SAP testing experience, current notice period, and earliest joining date. 

IMPORTANT: This is an urgent requirement. Only candidates who can join within 4 weeks should apply. If your notice period exceeds 4 weeks and cannot be reduced, please do not apply.
