Summary Of Role

Sumo Logic's microservices architecture, hosted on AWS, ingests petabytes of data daily across many geographic regions in support of our planet-scale observability and security products, serving hundreds of millions of queries a day against thousands of petabytes of data. At that scale, every inefficiency - in code, architecture, or infrastructure - compounds into real cost. 

This role sits within the Product SRE organization, working alongside your global SRE team on your product area's reliability roadmap - with a mandate that leads with code as much as operations. You'll find where Sumo's systems are spending more compute, storage, or engineering time than necessary, and fix it in the code and architecture, not just the infra config, while also carrying the fuller SRE mandate - reliability, security posture, and improving the day-to-day experience of the engineers within your product area. You'll be part of a team that blends SRE and backend software engineering skillsets, partnering closely with product engineering teams across your product area. 

This is an engineering role - the work is about shipping code, architecture, and system-level changes that improve unit economics, not managing cost dashboards, tagging, or reserved-instance/savings-plan purchasing. 

What You'll Do

- Continuously discover cost and efficiency opportunities through production profiling, telemetry, cost data, capacity trends, and system-level analysis - across algorithmic inefficiencies, resource-heavy code paths, and architectural decisions - and turn ambiguous problems into prioritized engineering initiatives. 
 - Apply performance and capacity engineering techniques to understand CPU, memory, storage, network, and I/O behavior under real production workloads, and optimize the resulting resource footprint. 
 - Write production-grade code to implement the optimizations you identify - JVM/GC tuning, algorithmic and resource-efficiency improvements, re-architecting inefficient services - in systems that process petabytes of data daily. 
 - Define and track engineering efficiency metrics such as cost per GB ingested, cost per query, cost per event, resource utilization, or cost per customer workload, and translate the work into measurable impact for engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement - influencing teams where you don't have direct ownership - and help establish engineering patterns and practices that make cost and efficiency a continuous part of the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with engineering teams in your product area to prioritize changes, and with developer infrastructure and Global SRE to align with the broader reliability roadmap. 
 - Participate in the SRE responsibilities for different product areas - SLOs, on-call, incident response, and blameless RCA - using those experiences to identify systemic reliability, performance, and efficiency improvements. 

What You'll Have

- B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience with a demonstrated track record of ownership. 
 - Strong CS fundamentals - comfortable with algorithmic complexity, data-structure performance characteristics, and system design at scale. 
 - Ability to author production-ready code in at least one OO/systems language (Java, Scala, Go, C++, or similar) - depth of engineering ability matters more than which language. 
 - Experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of independently identifying ambiguous performance, scalability, or cost problems and driving engineering changes that produced measurable improvements in production. 
 - Strong ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior, capacity, performance, and cost, and use production data to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes. 
 - Working fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS compute, storage, networking) - enough to reason about cost and architectural tradeoffs. 
 - Comfort moving across the stack, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on, to find root causes of inefficiency. 

Nice to have

- JVM tuning and GC optimization experience at scale. 
 - Exposure to cost-attribution/FinOps practices or tooling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or modern CI/CD tooling. 
 - Prior SRE experience - on-call, SLOs, incident response. 
 - Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kafka Streams) or observability/security platforms. 

Why this role

- Visibility - Cost/efficiency work maps directly to metrics the business already tracks. 
 - Scope you define - you identify where the opportunities are rather than executing a fixed backlog. 
 - Real scale - systems ingesting petabytes of data daily and serving hundreds of millions of queries. 

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www. sumologic. com. 

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
The opportunity

The EMR Architect is a core architect of Experity's vision to become the indispensable operating system for on-demand healthcare. 

By diagnosing the legacy WPF monolith and mapping a domain-by-domain path to the modern web stack, this role transforms a rigid, single-threaded system into modular, workflow-aligned services that clinicians can move through faster and clinics can build on. This position ensures Experity's core clinical record isn't just stable-it becomes the foundation the rest of the platform can modernize around. 

We're modernizing a legacy Windows/WPF-based EMR into a new web stack. This is a hands-on architecture role-you'll spend real time in the existing codebase, not just reviewing it from above, debugging multi-threaded WPF code paths and tracing real-time data flows to build an accurate picture of what's actually broken. 

You'll own the architecture story for this migration end to end: diagnosing what's wrong with the current system, communicating that visually to engineers and leadership, and mapping a domain-driven path from monolith to modular web app aligned to real clinical workflows. 

This role demands someone who can go deep on legacy Windows internals one day and present a migration roadmap to executives the next-thriving on ambiguity, incomplete documentation, and a codebase that predates most of the team. 

Business impact

- Reduces patient-record risk and clinician downtime by replacing a fragile, single-threaded WPF core with a stable, modular architecture that can scale with clinic volume. 
 - Speeds care delivery by decomposing the EMR into workflow-aligned domains (vitals, exam, charting), cutting the friction clinicians hit moving between tasks in a shared screen and shared thread. 
 - Improves engineering velocity and lowers migration risk by producing a domain-by-domain roadmap that lets teams modernize incrementally instead of a high-risk, all-at-once rewrite. 

What you will own

Architecture diagnosis

- A visual architecture diagnosis (diagrams, not docs) mapping the current WPF/. NET system's failure points, including thread contention and real-time data flow issues. 

Domain boundary mapping

- A domain boundary map splitting the EMR into workflow-aligned pieces (e. g. , vitals intake, full exam, charting) instead of one monolithic screen and thread. 

Migration roadmap

- A domain-by-domain migration roadmap sequencing the move from legacy WPF to the modern web stack, with near-term stabilization fixes called out separately from the long-term rebuild. 

Architecture communication

- A set of before/after architecture diagrams usable at both engineer and executive review, showing tradeoffs at each migration stage. 

What you'll do

- Diagnose and visually communicate problems in the current WPF/. NET architecture (diagrams, not just docs). 
 - Debug and reason about Windows/WPF applications, including multi-threaded and real-time data (WebSockets, live push) code paths. 
 - Balance near-term performance and sustainability fixes with a long-term web-stack migration plan. 
 - Analyze the codebase to identify domain boundaries, and propose splitting the EMR into pieces aligned to workflow personas (e. g. , nurse taking vitals vs. PA doing a full exam). 
 - Produce a go-forward roadmap for migrating the legacy EMR domain-by-domain to the new stack. 

What we're looking for

Experience

- Bachelor's degree in one of the STEM fields or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with Windows/WPF application development and debugging. 
 - Hands-on C# multi-threaded debugging experience (race conditions, UI freezes, thread contention). 
 - Strong visual communication skills-can explain complex architecture and tradeoffs through diagrams at any audience level (engineer to exec). 
 - Experience with domain modeling and breaking down monolithic systems into bounded domains. 
 - Solid . NET fundamentals, including async/await and efficient sync-to-async call patterns. 
 - Experience with WebSockets or real-time data push architectures. 

Nice to have

- Prior experience on an EMR, healthcare, or other high-reliability enterprise application. 
 - Experience leading or contributing to a legacy-to-web-stack migration. 
 - Solid, hands-on experience with TypeScript, Next. js, and modern web architecture. 
 - Experience designing for concurrent request handling from UI through to DB in large-scale systems. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Role Description

The Identity Governance Administration Automation Engineer is responsible for administering, automating, and continuously improving the enterprise's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environment, with a focus on Saviynt. This role ensures that access certification, provisioning, and entitlement management processes are secure, auditable, and efficient across the enterprise and its Operating Companies (OpCos). 

This role acts as both a platform administrator and an automation engineer, building and maintaining workflows that connect Saviynt to enterprise identity sources, target applications, and downstream systems. The engineer partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Audit teams to ensure identity lifecycle events - joiner, mover, leaver, and access certification - are governed, automated, and evidenced consistently across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 

The role is hands‐on and execution‐focused while embracing the Ralliant Business System (RBS) by embedding operational discipline, staff training, and continuous improvement into tools, workflows, and standard work so endpoint management is scalable, measurable, and repeatable. The role operates in service to the enterprise and operating companies, ensuring standardized identity governance practices while adapting to regional and business-specific needs. 

Key Responsibilities

- Administer and support the Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform, including application onboarding, connector configuration, and control library management. 
 - Design, build, and maintain automated identity lifecycle workflows (joiner, mover, leaver) across Active Directory, cloud directories, and business applications. 
 - Configure and enforce access certification campaigns, segregation of duties (SoD) controls, and role-based access (RBAC) policies to manage least-privilege access at scale. 
 - Develop and maintain Saviynt connectors and integrations using REST APIs, SCIM, and native connector frameworks to onboard new applications and OpCo environments. 
 - Develop PowerShell, Python, and REST API scripts and workflows to automate provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement reconciliation tasks.

 - Saviynt certification preferred; cloud platform or security certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CISM, Security+) a plus. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, control owners, and auditors.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

You will set technical standards, lead platform governance, and design solutions that meet complex business requirements while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.

 - Translate complex requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions, establishing reusable architectural patterns across applications, data, integrations, security, and automation. 
 - Provide architectural guidance across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, IRM, SecOps, HRSD, DevOps, and custom applications. 

Platform Modernization & Innovation

- Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, features, products, and capabilities, recommending adoption based on business value, architectural fit, and risk. 
 - Provide architectural leadership for platform upgrades and modernization, increasing adoption of strategic and native capabilities while reducing legacy customization. 
 - Stay current with ServiceNow innovation and industry trends, contributing to the platform technology roadmap and its ongoing evolution. 

Architecture Governance & Engineering Standards

- Define and enforce architecture principles, technical standards, design patterns, and engineering guardrails through architecture and design reviews. 
 - Champion configuration-first and out-of-the-box approaches, reducing unnecessary customization, technical debt, complexity, and architectural risk. 
 - Promote consistent engineering practices and provide architectural guidance to internal teams and implementation partners. 

Solution & Integration Architecture

- Design ServiceNow solutions for complex business requirements while maintaining platform integrity, scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Define architecture for enterprise integrations, APIs, MID Servers, data flows, and automation, establishing reusable patterns that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. 

Security, Risk & Compliance

- Partner with Information Security, Risk, Privacy, and Compliance teams to embed security, privacy, resiliency, auditability, and regulatory requirements into platform architecture. 
 - Assess security and architectural implications of new applications, integrations, plugins, and capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and security standards. 

Reliability, Scalability & Performance

- Ensure platform architecture supports enterprise requirements for availability, reliability, scalability, performance, and recoverability. 
 - Provide architectural direction for complex platform, integration, and performance challenges. 
 - Partner with engineering and operations teams to continuously improve platform health, resilience, and maintainability. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor, working closely with the Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect and Platform Engineering Leads to maintain a cohesive enterprise-wide architectural direction. 
 - Collaborate across Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Infrastructure, Product Management, Engineering, and business teams. 
 - Guide technical teams and clearly communicate architecture decisions, options, risks, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of IT experience, including significant ServiceNow architecture, engineering, or solution design experience. 
 - 5+ years as a ServiceNow Architect in a large enterprise environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, configuration, application development, integrations, data, and security. 
 - Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Experience establishing architecture standards, design patterns, governance, and engineering guardrails. 
 - Strong understanding of ITSM/ITIL, security, privacy, risk, and enterprise technology practices. 
 - Ability to translate complex business needs into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions. 
 - Strong communication and influencing skills across technology and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience across ServiceNow products such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, IRM, SecOps, HRSD, and DevOps. 
 - Experience with enterprise-scale ServiceNow modernization or transformation. 
 - ServiceNow CSA certification; CIS, CAD, or CTA certifications preferred. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer

Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced engineers looking to step up their scope and impact. As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

data.description:
Who are we?

RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC. 

Role Overview

RZR is seeking a high-caliber Kubernetes & Platforms Engineer to join our Bangalore engineering hub. This role is the backbone of our container orchestration strategy, critical for the design, scaling, and management of the infrastructure powering our programmatic Demand-Side Platform (DSP). 

You will transition our high-performance Real-Time Bidding (RTB) environment into a world-class, cloud-native ecosystem. Leveraging Kubernetes (K8s), Docker/Containerd, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi), you will ensure our bidding services operate with sub-millisecond latency and massive horizontal scalability. You will collaborate with global SRE and Backend teams to bridge the gap between bare-metal performance and cloud-native agility. 

Key Responsibilities

- Cluster Orchestration: Design, deploy, and maintain production-grade Kubernetes clusters across on-prem (bare metal) and hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Container Networking: Optimize K8s CNI plugins (e. g. , Cilium, Calico) to handle high-throughput RTB traffic with minimal overhead. 
 - GitOps & Automation: Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure declarative, reproducible infrastructure. 
 - Performance Engineering: Fine-tune container runtimes and resource quotas (CPU/Memory pinning) for latency-sensitive applications. 
 - Observability: Implement deep-stack monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to trace requests across microservices. 
 - Security & Policy: Enforce cluster security using Network Policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, and automated vulnerability scanning for container images. 

Required Skills / Experience

- Professional Experience: 3+ years in DevOps/SRE (6+ for Senior roles) with a heavy focus on containerization. 
 - Kubernetes Mastery: Deep internal knowledge of K8s components (Etcd, API Server, Scheduler) and CRD development. 
 - Linux Systems: Strong proficiency in Linux internals (namespaces, cgroups, eBPF) and shell scripting. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Expert-level experience with Terraform or Pulumi. 
 - Service Mesh: Practical experience with Istio or Linkerd for traffic management and mTLS. 
 - Programming: Proficiency in Go (preferred for K8s operators) or Python. 
 - Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related technical field.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer - DevOps
data.description:
Job Summary: 

We're looking for a Senior Staff Platform Engineer to join our Developer Productivity & Platforms group. This role blends traffic engineering (API gateway, CDN, service-to-service routing) with core responsibilities, including automation, observability, reliability engineering, CI/CD workflows, and internal tooling that accelerates developer efficiency. 

You'll own critical systems responsible for managing API traffic - both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service communication) - across a global, multi-cloud environment. You'll architect resilient routing systems, edge integrations with CDNs, and observability hooks that ensure everything you build is secure, debuggable, and automated. 

This is a hands-on role with high visibility and impact. You'll work across platform, SRE, and developer experience teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, observable, and developer-friendly - from traffic routing to deployments to production operations. 

One of your key responsibilities will also be to design and build a unified traffic abstraction layer - a foundational platform that maps backend services deployed across various compute environments to their respective configurations on CDNs (e. g. , Akamai, Fastly). This framework will centralize control over routing, metadata inventory, configuration tracking, and automated failover across CDNs. This capability does not currently exist and will be built from the ground up. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Own the technical vision and long-term evolution of the API Gateway and traffic platform supporting both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service) traffic, operating at scale across a multi-cloud environment. 
 - Architect and drive a unified traffic abstraction layer that decouples backend services from CDN-specific implementations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare), enabling centralized policy control, metadata-driven routing, automated multi-CDN failover, and future extensibility. 
 - Set architectural standards and design patterns for ingress, traffic routing, and API management, influencing multiple teams and ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and reliability across the organization. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team initiatives spanning networking, platform, SRE, security, and observability teams to deliver resilient, cloud-agnostic ingress solutions that account for varying network topologies, latency characteristics, and failure modes. 
 - Design and govern CI/CD and GitOps workflows for critical traffic infrastructure, defining best practices for safe deployments, progressive rollouts, automated validation, and rollback strategies across environments. 
 - Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes, establishing reusable modules, golden paths, and guardrails that enable teams to deploy and operate traffic components safely and independently. 
 - Build and evolve foundational tooling and services (primarily in Go or Python) that improve visibility, control, scalability, and operational efficiency of API traffic systems at scale. 
 - Define observability strategy and standards for ingress and internal traffic systems, including metrics, logs, tracing, and SLOs; partner closely with observability and SRE teams to ensure systems are diagnosable and production-ready by default. 
 - Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, reviewing high-impact designs, unblocking teams, and raising the overall quality bar for platform engineering and distributed systems practices. 
 - Anticipate future needs and risks, proactively identifying scaling limits, security gaps, and reliability concerns, and driving strategic investments before they become production issues. 

Skills and Attributes to Success: 

- Expert-level programming capability in Go or Python, with a track record of designing and delivering production-grade platforms, internal tooling, and services that operate reliably at scale; able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and velocity. 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with API Gateway platforms in large-scale production environments, including ownership of architecture, rollout strategies, failure handling, and long-term evolution of ingress and traffic management systems. 
 - Strong understanding of CDN architectures and integrations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare or similar), including cache strategies, request routing, edge security, failover mechanisms, and best practices for high-availability API delivery across regions and providers. 
 - Advanced proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, leveraging Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm to design reusable modules, define platform standards, and enable self-service while maintaining strong operational and security guardrails. 
 - Deep knowledge of networking and distributed systems fundamentals, including TLS termination, L4/L7 routing, traffic shaping, rate limiting, retries, circuit breaking, and failure isolation, with the ability to reason about system behavior under load and partial failure. 
 - Proven ability to design systems with observability, automation, and resiliency as first-class concerns, defining metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, and automated remediation strategies in partnership with SRE and observability teams. 
 - Strong architectural judgment and systems thinking, able to navigate ambiguity, evaluate multiple solution paths, and influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews and technical leadership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical multiplier, mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and helping teams ship safer, faster, and more reliable systems. 

Preferred Education & Experience: 

- B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university. 
 - 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery. 

About Us

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. 

JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected

Overview

Are you a customer-obsessed, AI-curious problem-solver who thrives in an inclusive, collaborative global team? Join Engineering Operations (EngOps), the organization driving operational excellence across the Microsoft Cloud to strengthen quality, reliability, security, and customer trust. 

Our mission is to prevent issues before they happen by turning operational signals into action through AI-powered automation, enabling measurable customer impact at cloud scale. Our culture of empowerment, inclusion, and growth mindset defines how we work. 

Within EngOps ACES, the Agent Fleet Operations (AFO) team is looking for an AI-first software engineer to join the Cloud Operational Demand Engineering (CØDE) organization and help advance our mission of driving operational demand to zero. We're seeking a hands-on engineer with a DevOps background - CI/CD and release engineering, safe deployment, observability, and always-on production operations - who pairs that discipline with AI engineering skills and a learn-it-all mindset. 

You are passionate about applying AI to solve real customer problems and energized by the challenge of eliminating operational toil. 

In this role, you will build and ship production AI solutions that reduce operational demand and improve customer outcomes. You will contribute to the technical execution that turns unresolved cases into autonomously resolved, customer-delighting outcomes - and help build the release, observability, and reliability practices that let a fleet of agents run safely in the customer path. 

Role summary

As an individual contributor, you will be hands-on building and improving the agentic patterns that reduce operational demand and improve customer satisfaction. This is a DevOps and production-operations engineering role applied to autonomous AI: you own the delivery, quality, and production health of the components you build, not just their design. This role suits an engineer who has built and shipped production-scale AI systems - and ideally the CI/CD, safe-deployment, and reliability practices around them - and who wants to go deep on agentic resolution while collaborating closely across the team. 

Team charter

Build, operationalize, and scale AI-native support experiences for Broad Commercial customers by transforming supportability knowledge into reusable, versioned, testable, and measurable assets that power product experiences, support engineers, and autonomous agents. The team reduces support demand, engineering toil, and time-to-resolution through AI-driven resolution capabilities that continuously learn from customer signals, unresolved cases, and operational insights. 

AFO operates a fleet of autonomous agents that resolve customer support cases with human oversight. This is a production DevOps discipline, not a set of prototypes: agents run continuously in the customer path and released, observed, and improved with the same rigor as any always-on service. You and your team will build and run this system across several planes of a single AIOps suite: 

- Fleet execution and live safety: operating the agents that execute individual cases end to end - evidence acquisition, diagnosis, reasoning, response composition, and safe escalation - alongside the live-safety services that continuously watch sentiment, risk, and unsafe or irreversible actions and can pause autonomy or transfer a case to a human. 
 - Evaluation and repair: running the evaluation systems that judge per-turn and completed-case quality, and the repair pipelines that turn failures into durable fixes - documentation, diagnostics, prompt/routing/policy changes, reusable skills, or product work items routed to the right engineering team. 
 - A control and learning plane: owning the lifecycle state machine that moves every change from observed → detected → diagnosed → repair candidate → independently evaluated → approved → shadowed → canaried → released → production-verified, with explicit expand, pause, revise, 

Responsibilities

- Build agentic resolution capabilities for AFO
 - Build and improve agentic patterns that raise autonomous resolution rate, accuracy, and customer satisfaction, contributing to the team's technical execution. 
 - Deliver engineering for Agentic AI solutions
 - Deliver end-to-end features across autonomous AI systems, including orchestration, reasoning, retrieval, action execution, and human escalation workflows. Take capabilities from prototype through production across support surfaces while partnering effectively across dependent engineering teams. 
 - Contribute to technical direction and engineering standards
 - Help shape the technical foundation for agent development by implementing architectures, design patterns, evaluation frameworks, and reusable platform capabilities. 
 - Apply and help improve standards for prompts, tool interfaces, testing, versioning, code quality, CI/CD, and safe deployment practices (shadow, canary, progressive rollout, automated rollback) so agent behavior remains reliable, observable, and scalable. 
 - Build evals that improve customer confidence that our agents are trustworthy in understanding customer sentiment and intent and in validating agentic actions. 
 - Contribute to production health and reliability
 - Help run the service with a DevOps/SRE operating model. Support availability, latency, cost per resolution, SLOs and error budgets, regression detection, incident response, and the on-call rotation for a fleet of agents acting autonomously in the customer path. Build the observability needed to explain why an agent did what it did, and drive durable fixes rather than repeated mitigations. 
 - Build and maintain evaluation systems
 - Contribute to the evaluation framework that determines whether agents are safe and effective in production. Build and maintain golden datasets, rubrics, judge agents, frozen anchors, and offline/online evaluation pipelines. Use evaluation signals to gate releases and continuously improve quality through production feedback loops. 
 - Contribute to measurable business impact
 - Help move key business outcomes, including support demand reduction, autonomous resolution rate, resolution quality, time-to-resolution, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction. Ensure the capabilities you build are measurable and directed toward the highest-impact opportunities. 
 - Turn Customer Signals into Engineering Insight
 - Build mechanisms that convert unresolved cases, customer feedback, and dissatisfaction signals into actionable engineering insights. Help ensure recurring failure patterns improve future agent capabilities and route product fixes back to the appropriate engineering teams. 
 - Grow your craft and share learnings
 - Deepen your agentic AI and DevOps craft, and extend the team's impact by sharing proven patterns, tools, and operational learnings with your peers. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND +8 years technical engineering experience in software engineering, applied AI/ML, or distributed systems, OR equivalent experience. 

- 8+ years of IT experience and 3+ years of experience using Agentic AI
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience building and shipping AI or machine learning systems in production. 
 - Demonstrated DevOps or SRE background: hands-on experience with CI/CD and release engineering, safe-deployment practices (e. g. , blue/green, canary, progressive rollout, automated rollback), observability and monitoring, and participation in production incident response and on-call for always-on services. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, or a related field. 
 - Experience building and shipping multi-agent orchestration systems or agentic AI services in production. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation frameworks: rubrics, golden datasets, judge agents, offline and online evaluation. 
 - Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Familiarity with agent security patterns: prompt injection defense, tool access controls, data boundary enforcement. 
 - DevOps/SRE toolchain depth: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, and progressive-delivery tooling (shadow, canary, feature/rollout gating, automated rollback). 
 - Observability engineering: building tracing, metrics, and logging for distributed or agentic systems and using them to drive durable fixes rather than repeated mitigations. 
 - Reliability practice: working with SLIs/SLOs and error budgets and taking part in the operational rhythm (live-site reviews, post-incident reviews, repair-item and corrective-action tracking) that keeps a fleet healthy. 
 - Experience contributing to cross-org or co-development engineering delivery with partner teams. 
 - Business acumen, with the ability to connect engineering work to measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 - Background in customer support engineering, supportability, or customer experience platforms. 
 - Experience operating always-on production services, including on-call participation and incident response. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. data.title: SAP ABAP Development Lead
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

IS Manager

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own how SAP ABAP is built across our ERP landscape: the development standard, the quality gates, the AI-assisted development practice, and who works on what. Each day, you will spend at least half your time writing production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA, taking on the hardest objects and the first build of every new pattern. You will also showcase your expertise by leading a central team of three developers, growing to six, who serve projects across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales. You will help us choose between agentic AI development platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, and then make the chosen platform part of how the team builds every day. 

This role will be Reporting to the VP of IT and the Head of Core Business Applications (ERP), you will be the team's hands-on technical lead, not an additional management layer. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. 

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the SAP BTP architecture and development team; the integration team; and SAP Basis. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC and S/4HANA every week, and closing team commitments on the promised date, chasing what is blocked rather than waiting. 
 - Owning the ABAP development standard: coding guidelines, naming, enhancement rules, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, applied the same way across the team. 
 - Leading AI-driven development: testing agentic AI platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, hands-on with our own code; recommending one; and making it a daily practice, with rules for use, review of generated code, and automated quality and compliance checks. 
 - Allocating and growing the team: deciding who works on what across competing demand, removing single points of knowledge, coaching developers, and setting practical clean core rules for S/4HANA. 

Our team dynamics

You will join a small, hands-on expert team where everyone builds, and everyone supports. AI is expected here, not merely tolerated. Done means in use by the business, not just transported, and an honest "I don't know yet" is welcome. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- You have 12+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with deep, current ABAP experience in ECC, and you still write code and can show recent work. 
 - You have heavy, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, ideally with agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct, or with SAP Joule for developers. If not, you have a strong drive to adopt them and can show what you built or automated with AI on your own initiative. 
 - You have a demonstrated track record of finishing concrete production outcomes with numbers, including work that was stuck before you picked it up. 
 - You are highly skilled in SAP S/4HANA development, including CDS, RAP, and ABAP Cloud, with a practical view of clean core from real implementations. 
 - You have established skills in defining and enforcing development standards that others followed, including rules for AI-generated code, and in leading developers technically. 
 - You are passionate about getting things done through people you don't manage, and about keeping quality and security controls intact while moving fast. 
 - You are at ease communicating in English, verbally and in writing. 

What's in it for you?

You will work hands-on with the newest agentic AI tools for SAP development and decide how a whole team uses them. You will shape the team's standards and tooling from the start, keep building rather than just reviewing, and see your decisions applied across the ERP landscape as we move to S/4HANA. 

More About Us (Mandatory)

At ABB, we're pioneers in digital industries and power grids, driving sustainable transformation across industries. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+, abilities, and generations-creating an environment where every voice matters. 

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www. abb. com. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

data.title: SAP ABAP Development Lead
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

IS Manager

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own how SAP ABAP is built across our ERP landscape: the development standard, the quality gates, the AI-assisted development practice, and who works on what. Each day, you will spend at least half your time writing production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA, taking on the hardest objects and the first build of every new pattern. You will also showcase your expertise by leading a central team of three developers, growing to six, who serve projects across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales. You will help us choose between agentic AI development platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, and then make the chosen platform part of how the team builds every day. 

This role will be Reporting to the VP of IT and the Head of Core Business Applications (ERP), you will be the team's hands-on technical lead, not an additional management layer. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. 

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the SAP BTP architecture and development team; the integration team; and SAP Basis. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC and S/4HANA every week, and closing team commitments on the promised date, chasing what is blocked rather than waiting. 
 - Owning the ABAP development standard: coding guidelines, naming, enhancement rules, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, applied the same way across the team. 
 - Leading AI-driven development: testing agentic AI platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, hands-on with our own code; recommending one; and making it a daily practice, with rules for use, review of generated code, and automated quality and compliance checks. 
 - Allocating and growing the team: deciding who works on what across competing demand, removing single points of knowledge, coaching developers, and setting practical clean core rules for S/4HANA. 

Our team dynamics

You will join a small, hands-on expert team where everyone builds, and everyone supports. AI is expected here, not merely tolerated. Done means in use by the business, not just transported, and an honest "I don't know yet" is welcome. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- You have 12+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with deep, current ABAP experience in ECC, and you still write code and can show recent work. 
 - You have heavy, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, ideally with agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct, or with SAP Joule for developers. If not, you have a strong drive to adopt them and can show what you built or automated with AI on your own initiative. 
 - You have a demonstrated track record of finishing concrete production outcomes with numbers, including work that was stuck before you picked it up. 
 - You are highly skilled in SAP S/4HANA development, including CDS, RAP, and ABAP Cloud, with a practical view of clean core from real implementations. 
 - You have established skills in defining and enforcing development standards that others followed, including rules for AI-generated code, and in leading developers technically. 
 - You are passionate about getting things done through people you don't manage, and about keeping quality and security controls intact while moving fast. 
 - You are at ease communicating in English, verbally and in writing. 

What's in it for you?

You will work hands-on with the newest agentic AI tools for SAP development and decide how a whole team uses them. You will shape the team's standards and tooling from the start, keep building rather than just reviewing, and see your decisions applied across the ERP landscape as we move to S/4HANA. 

More About Us (Mandatory)

At ABB, we're pioneers in digital industries and power grids, driving sustainable transformation across industries. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+, abilities, and generations-creating an environment where every voice matters. 

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www. abb. com.

 - Ability to interact with senior management and multiple stakeholders. 
 - Effective organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and presentation skills. 
 - Effective data analysis skills including proficiency in the use of MS Excel/PowerPoint / Power BI. 

Who WE are

AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don't just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it. 

How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty. 

With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward. 

Learn more at axaxl. com

What we OFFER

Inclusion

AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That's why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It's about helping one another - and our business - to move forward and succeed. 

- Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe. 
 - Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements 
 - Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits 
 - Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index 
 - Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl. com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Total Rewards

AXA XL's Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do. 

We're committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence. 

Sustainability

At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called "Roots of resilience", focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations. 

Our Pillars

- Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society - are essential to our future. We're committed to protecting and restoring nature - from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard - by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans. 
 - Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions. 
 - Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We're training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting. 
 - AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL's "Hearts in Action" programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day - the Global Day of Giving. 

For more information, please see axaxl. com/sustainability.

Lead Software Engineer - Data Management Service - Change Management

What Makes Us, Us

If you like

The DMS Change team is part of the SimCorp Managed Business Services Team. The team works directly with Data Management Service Business Operations using Data Management Platform, which is a single instance, software as a service (SaaS) based product. It provides Reference Data Management and Valuation solutions for many of the world's leading and most innovative financial institutions, including regional and global banks and asset management firms. 

The Lead Software Engineer in the DMS Change Team owns the technical direction for the customer layer of the product, drives design and architecture decisions, and leads a group of developers responsible for building, testing, and ensuring compatibility with the broader enterprise and solutions architecture through modern development technologies. 

The Lead Software Engineer will also define and drive new capabilities that support Data Management Service Business Operations, set technical standards across the team, and engage with multiple development teams sitting in different service stacks to align delivery and design.

Good to have

 - Capital Markets domain knowledge, preferably with BUY SIDE firms and experience.

Prior formal people-management or team-lead experience. 

Benefits

NEXT STEPS

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Search Quality
data.description:
P-1408

The Mission

We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization's data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight. 

The Role

- As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company. 
 - You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users": 
 - The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren't trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions. 
 - The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces. 

The Technical Challenge

This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form: 

- Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent). 
 - Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context. 
 - High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality. 
 - Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics. 

Why This is the Place to Be

- You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let's talk. 

What We're Looking For

- The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms. 
 - The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K). 
 - The Bridge Builder: You're excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20, 000 organizations worldwide - including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 - rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. data.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

This is a senior technical lead role that pairs deep platform engineering expertise with the thought leadership needed to bring AI into production operations. The person owns the build, hardening, patching, and lifecycle of the operating system and platform estate, and serves as the top escalation point for complex incidents - while simultaneously identifying where AI and automation can replace manual toil, reduce incident volume, and shorten recovery times. Success depends as much on change leadership as on engineering: shaping standards, winning stakeholder buy-in, and guiding 1st line operations through new AI-enabled ways of working without disrupting service levels. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform engineering depth - packaging and hardening approved OS builds, management agent stacks, patch currency, and configuration standards across the estate
 - AI-driven operations innovation - identifying, piloting, and scaling AI/automation use cases for incident triage, root cause analysis, runbook execution, and predictive monitoring
 - Thought leadership and evangelism - articulating an AI-for-operations vision, authoring white papers and R&D positions, staying ahead of emerging tooling
 - Change management and adoption - driving organizational uptake of new practices, coaching 1st line teams, managing risk and resistance while protecting SLAs
 - Incident, problem, and change discipline - major incident leadership, RCA, and rigorous change control in a regulated production environment
 - Service improvement measurement - instrumenting and evidencing reductions in incident volume and MTTR from process redesign and automation
 - Solution design and implementation planning - translating requirements into physical builds, costed designs, and multi-workstream delivery plans
 - Automation and infrastructure-as-code fluency - scripting, configuration management, and pipeline-driven platform delivery
 - Standards, compliance, and documentation - run books, technical policies, and AI governance/guardrails to document-control standards
 - Cross-functional influence - partnering with architecture, security, development, vendors, and the business to land change. 

Required Qualifications

- Provides a high level of technical and subject matter expertise in one or more technologies and serves as a point of escalation for technical issues related to specialty. 
 - Produces, delivers, and maintains appropriate documentation for systems in accordance document control standards and procedures. 
 - Provide input to records, quality systems and management reports as required
 - Contributes to the definition and implementation of improved operability on new and current systems. 
 - Uses innovative methods including the redesign of process and providing technical solutions to reduce the volume and mean time to recover incidents in assigned business unit. 
 - Identifies risks & issues and takes ownership to deliver appropriate resolutions. 
 - Provides technical expertise for root cause analysis and problem management. 
 - Provides detailed implementation/project plans across multiple, complex work streams according to agreed standards and ensures project processes and timelines are understood and followed. 
 - Works and cooperates with internal and external groups when required in order to fully support environments and maintain service. 
 - Adheres to change management procedures in defining, planning and implementing change in such a way that ensures appropriate coordination with other teams, minimizes service disruption, and ensures adherence to Service Level Agreements. 
 - Improves change management processes and procedures to ensure the most efficient processing of change within appropriate service risk constraints. 
 - Provides specialist support during complex and/or major incidents. 
 - May be asked to lead recovery efforts during major incidents within business unit. 
 - Deputize for the team manager as required. 
 - Contributes to or author technical documentation such complex changes instructions. 
 - Reviews, and updates as appropriate, operations procedures, standards, and technical policies. 
 - May be asked to assist with production of white papers on technical R&D projects
 - Collaborates with business, third party vendors, developers, application support and technical operations groups to determine appropriate hardware/software needed and to resolve any issues impacting the application processes. 
 - Stays abreast of recent developments in related technical community, including new technology and business news that may impact vendors' ability to provide service. 
 - Responsible to seek out all information and to fully understand all aspects of each device's technology configuration and uses all approved engineering tools available to implement conforming change.
