 - Stays abreast of recent developments in related technical community, including new technology and business news that may impact vendors' ability to provide service. 
 - Responsible to seek out all information and to fully understand all aspects of each device's technology configuration and uses all approved engineering tools available to implement conforming change. 
 - Leads the analysis and design of complex solutions and requirements definition, including translating technical and business requirements into physical installations, costing design elements, and obtaining agreement to proposed solutions. 
 - Reviews and coordinates the implementation of proposed modifications, and changes to the production environment. 
 - Provides direction into standards and procedures for monitoring, capacity planning, tuning, maintenance, performance optimization, backups and recovery; ensures infrastructure will meet capacity requirements to deliver projects on time. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Provides direction for: proactive health and performance monitoring of databases, indexes and logs, and troubleshooting of reported issues. 
 - Reviews implemented scripts, stored procedures, and reports generated by automated database maintenance scripts. 
 - Participates in the technical design process as it relates to database implementations, reviews technical documents, and communicates any risks or issues using the appropriate escalation procedures. 
 - Provides directions to Technical Recovery plans (Database Standby and Replication, Backup and Recovery). 
 - Platform Engineer: 
 - Packages company approved hardened versions of targeted operating systems. 
 - Ensures stack of agents for management systems are properly installed and connected. 
 - Maintains patch levels in accordance with change management and security standards. 
 - Storage Engineer: 
 - Provides leadership for storage-related projects, including switch installations, disk consolidations, disk assignments, replication, and more.

 - Application Engineer: 
 - Fully familiarizes self with all aspects of the developed code. 
 - Recognizes design problems and errors and takes corrective action from a design perspective on the object code Environment. Interfaces with development teams on system design enhancements and the elimination of intermittent hardware/software problems. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

data.title: SOAR Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

Information Security Engineer Role

Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Python and security automation to join our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be adept at developing and implementing automated security solutions to protect our systems and data, as well as reviewing, validating, and hardening code and workflows produced by AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic systems. This role requires a proactive individual who can work independently and collaboratively to enhance our security posture in an environment where both humans and AI agents write and operate code. In addition, proficiency and experience using a SOAR for automation and security incident response is required. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain security automation scripts and tools using Python to a high standard of reliability and efficiency, including reviewing and hardening code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Integrate security tools and solutions, including developing and managing APIs, to automate security processes and workflows. 

Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential threats. 

Monitor security systems and respond to incidents with automated solutions, implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Tines, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect) to streamline response activities. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement security controls, and write clear technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for tools and processes. 

Govern enterprise use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including tenant restrictions, access scoping, and compliance/audit logging. 

Design and enforce security controls for agentic AI systems, including tool-permission boundaries, prompt injection defenses, and agent identity/access governance. 

Utilise Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for threat detection and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to analyse security data. 

Implement CI/CD pipeline automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) to ensure secure code deployment and infrastructure provisioning. 

Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field. 

Proven experience as a Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on Python and security automation. 

Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing automation scripts and tools, as well as reviewing and validating code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners. 

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes). 

Experience with API development and integration, including RESTful APIs. 

Proficiency in implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect). 

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint security. 

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication, including writing technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience securing AI/LLM-based agentic systems, including prompt injection defense, tool-permission boundaries, and agent identity governance. 

Experience governing enterprise AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), including compliance/audit logging, tenant restrictions, and CI/CD supply-chain hardening against AI-related risks. 

Desirable

Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) for querying and analysing security data. 

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or GIAC. 

Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). 

Understanding of network protocols and security architecture. 

Familiarity with the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e. g. , tool misuse, agentic supply-chain risk, unexpected code execution, human-agent trust exploitation). 

Experience with AI red-teaming and evaluation methodologies for agentic and LLM-based systems. 

Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and other agent-tool integration risks. 

Skills

AI Security, Python, Cloud Security, IDS/IPS, LLMs, Vulnerability Assessment, SOAR, Container Security, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

data.title: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation
data.description:
Company: Upstox

Location: Bengaluru

Work arrangement: 5 days in the office

Function: Insurance - B2B Sales (SDR / Lead Generation team)

About Upstox

At Upstox, we're building the future of investing - simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast - we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place. 

The Role: Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you'll own the top of this funnel - building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month. 

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you'll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you. 

What You'll Own

Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management

- Lead management framework: Design and own the end-to-end framework - sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads. 
 - Ideal customer profile: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data. 
 - Outreach playbooks: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events. 
 - Renewal-cycle planning: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates. 

Target Account List Building

- Target list: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership. 
 - Research & data tools: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data. 
 - Data hygiene & prioritisation: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert. 

Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team

- Qualified pipeline: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month. 
 - Monthly targets: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals. 
 - Feedback loop: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly. 

Team Leadership & Motivation

- Hiring & training: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e. g. , Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life). 
 - Targets & reviews: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards. 
 - Coaching & culture: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture. 

Individual Contribution

- Personal target: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - CXO outreach: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team. 
 - Lead from the front: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate. 

Tools, Reporting & Analytics

- Lead management stack: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team. 
 - Dashboards & MIS: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement. 
 - Data-led allocation: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaboration: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering. 

How Success Is Measured

- Qualified leads delivered: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target. 
 - Meetings held: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker. 
 - Funnel conversion: Lead → meeting → proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel. 
 - Team productivity: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week. 
 - Self-outreach target: The Manager's personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - Data quality: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records. 

Who You Are

- 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets. 
 - Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover. 
 - Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools - CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms. 
 - Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly. 
 - Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team. 
 - Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS. 
 - Excellent communication skills. 
 - Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru. 

Good to have

- Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e. g. , HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS). 
 - Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment. 
 - Graduate degree; MBA preferred. 

Why This Role Rocks

- You'll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms. 
 - You'll have high ownership and visibility - your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business. 
 - You'll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs. 
 - You'll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product. 
 - Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families. 

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice. 

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

data.title: Manager Account Analytics
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive. 

How You'll Make An Impact

The Manager, Account Analytics Development is a hands-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team - today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you. 

We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists. 

What You'll Build

Interpretation. Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business-relevant interpretation - what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization. 

Client knowledge. A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilon's relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki. 

Media investment planning. Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning - putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Systems Design

- Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning. 
 - Design evaluation before you design the solution. Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop. 
 - Establish the engineering standards - source control, testing, documentation, deployment - that let a three-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Write production code. 
 - Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded. 
 - Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them. 

Team Leadership

- Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level. 
 - Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review. 
 - Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to. 
 - Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team. 

Business Partnership

- Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage - and where they do not. 
 - Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non-technical partners. 
 - Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client-facing workflows and have to keep working. 
 - Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights

Qualifications

- 8+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects. 
 - Strong Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM-based systems in production - agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs - not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone. 
 - Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as "interpret this analysis" and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did. 
 - A considered point of view on evaluating non-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it. 
 - Working familiarity with marketing measurement - attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance - sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. 

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Preferred Technical Experience

- Agentic development environments - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar - used as a daily working tool rather than tried once. 
 - Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms. 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice. 
 - Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow. 
 - Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background. 
 - Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints. 

How You Work

- You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to. 
 - You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it. 
 - You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands. 

Additional Information

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. 

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9, 000 employees around the world. 

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. 

- People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. 
 - Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. 
 - Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. 
 - Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. 
 - Flexibility: We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. 

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. 

- Act with integrity
 - Work together to win together
 - Innovate with purpose
 - Respect all voices
 - Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. 

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows. 

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you. 

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care. 

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams' partner closely with U. S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions. 

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U. S. healthcare ecosystem. 

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong experience in building and scaling cloud-native, microservices-based applications. You will be a key contributor to the design, development, and delivery of backend systems, working closely with architects, product managers, and other engineers to build reliable and high-performance solutions. 

Experience in the healthcare domain is a plus, particularly in environments that require high standards for security, compliance, and data integrity. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain microservices using Java
 - Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, utilizing services such as EKS and S3
 - Containerize applications using Docker and deploy them via Kubernetes (EKS)
 - Develop and optimize data persistence layers using Aurora (PostgreSQL) and PostgreSQL
 - Implement caching and performance optimizations using Redis
 - Write, maintain, and review high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business and functional requirements into technical solutions
 - Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decision-making
 - Support CI/CD pipelines; experience with GitLab CI/CD is a plus
 - Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability and performance
 - Follow best practices for security, scalability, and observability

Required Qualifications

- 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience
 - Strong proficiency in Java and backend development
 - Hands on experience building front end applications using React or Angular
 - Hands-on experience building microservices and RESTful APIs
 - Experience with AWS cloud services, especially EKS and S3
 - Practical experience with Docker and containerized deployments
 - Solid experience with relational databases, preferably Aurora (PostgreSQL) or PostgreSQL
 - Experience with Redis or similar caching technologies
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, and distributed systems
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments
 - Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools
 - Experience with GitLab CI/CD or similar CI/CD platforms
 - Prior experience in the healthcare domain (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR, etc. )
 - Exposure to cloud security and compliance best practices. 

Why Join Availity India?

- Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences. 
 - Global exposure: Partner with U. S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities. 
 - Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development. 
 - Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models. 
 - Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs. 
 - Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward. 
 - Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

data.title: Evaluation Engineer - Intern
data.description:
Aura Cloud is an AI-embedded, cloud-native Core and Agentic platform for the financial sector. API-first and cloud-agnostic, the Aura platform spans Loans, Deposits, Cards, Payments and more, with multi-currency and multi-entity support for global scalability. Over 2, 000 APIs, ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, and trusted by financial institutions to run and grow their core business. 

We are embedding AI across the platform - in how it's built, how it's evaluated, and increasingly in how it operates. That changes what software quality means, and it's why this role exists. 

Role Overview

We are looking for curious, analytical, AI-oriented Evaluation Engineers to evaluate features across our AI-embedded banking platform. You'll turn requirements into evaluation scenarios, define what correct looks like, exercise the platform against it, and analyse results to establish functionality, accuracy and reliability - using AI tools throughout to design scenarios, generate data and extend coverage. 

As more of the platform becomes agentic, so does the scope of this role - and the engineers who know the platform best will be the ones defining how we evaluate it. 

The ideal candidate has a genuine interest in AI-assisted development of software, and correctness as a problem worth solving. 

Key Responsibilities

- AI Evaluation Frameworks:   Build AI-based frameworks for evaluation of AI-generated code. 
 - AI-Assisted Scenario Design:   Use AI tools to design use cases, evaluation scenarios and workflows for validating platform features. 
 - Feature Evaluation:   Understand platform requirements and evaluate whether new features meet them. 
 - Analysis  - Run evaluation scenarios, compare actual against expected outcomes, and identify gaps, inconsistencies and failure modes. 
 - AI Tool Utilisation  - Generate scenarios and data, automate and improve coverage and speed. 
 - Failure Analysis  - Diagnose failures to the point of knowing what broke and why; classify failure modes, document them, and drive issues to closure. 
 - Evaluation Automation  - Build the harnesses and pipelines that operate repeatably and at scale. 
 - Documentation  - Maintain clear records of use cases, evaluation criteria, results, observations and issues. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration  - Work closely with Engineering through the feature lifecycle. 
 - Continuous Improvement  - Explore new AI tools, evaluation techniques and methodologies to strengthen coverage and effectiveness. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- B. Tech / B. E. / B. Sc. (2026 & 2025 batches) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Working knowledge of generative AI tools, Large Language Models, backed by project work on GitHub. 
 - Sound grasp of software development concepts, programming fundamentals and evaluation principles. 
 - Working ability in at least one language - Python, JavaScript, to call an API, parse the response and assert something about it. 
 - Strong analytical and logical reasoning, with the ability to identify patterns, inconsistencies and likely failure scenarios. 
 - The instinct to ask "how would I know if this were wrong?"
 - Clear written and verbal communication, with attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation. 
 - Willingness to learn quickly and work in a fast-paced product. 

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Using AI tools to design evaluation scenarios, generate data, and assess software output. 
 - Automating repeatable checks, debugging, and working with Git. 
 - REST APIs, JSON, SQL and database fundamentals. 
 - Reasoning about coverage: functional, regression and edge-case scenarios. 

Key Competencies

- Translating requirements into evaluation scenarios that actually catch failures. 
 - Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving. 
 - Precision, and a bias toward proving correctness rather than assuming it. 
 - Ownership, adaptability, and speed of learning. 
 - Clear communication and cross-functional collaboration. 

Learning & Growth Opportunities

- Depth in evaluation design, automation and API-level validation on a production core banking platform. 
 - Hands-on work with AI-assisted development and evaluation workflows. 
 - Experience evaluating AI-embedded systems in a regulated domain - a capability few engineers have today. 
 - Direct collaboration with senior platform engineers, Product and Business Analysis.

This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.

data.title: Head of AI Division – Enterprise AI, Generative AI & Agentic Platforms
data.description:
Role Overview

Our company is seeking an accomplished Head of AI Division to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. This is a senior leadership position responsible for defining the AI vision, building and scaling AI capabilities, establishing enterprise AI platforms, and driving measurable business transformation across the organization's engineering, product, and operational ecosystems. 

The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. 

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions. 

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Business Transformation

- Define and execute Solartis' enterprise AI strategy, vision, and multi-year transformation roadmap. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered decision systems across products and business functions. 
 - Translate business objectives into scalable AI initiatives with clearly defined outcomes, investment priorities, and measurable ROI. 
 - Establish enterprise AI reference architectures, technology standards, implementation frameworks, and reusable accelerators. 
 - Advise executive leadership on AI adoption, emerging technologies, investment priorities, opportunities, and associated risks. 
 - Drive an AI-first engineering and product development culture across the organization. 2. AI Division Leadership & Organizational Development

- Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AI division comprising AI architects, AI/ML engineers, Generative AI specialists, platform engineers, and research or innovation teams. 
 - Define the organizational structure, operating model, hiring strategy, capability development plans, and performance expectations for the AI division. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability across AI strategy, architecture, engineering, platform development, and production operations. 
 - Mentor senior technical leaders and develop a strong leadership pipeline within the AI organization. 
 - Foster collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business stakeholders. 
 - Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, technology investments, and AI program budgets. 3. Enterprise Generative AI & Foundation Model Strategy

- Lead the evaluation, selection, architecture, and enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source foundation models. 
 - Establish model selection, routing, orchestration, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and deployment strategies aligned with business requirements. 
 - Drive the adoption of platforms and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other relevant foundation models. 
 - Define strategies for balancing model performance, security, latency, scalability, licensing, and inference costs. 
 - Oversee the development of enterprise AI services, reusable frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and shared platform capabilities. 4. Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Intelligence Platforms

- Lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms and knowledge intelligence systems. 
 - Establish scalable architectures integrating structured and unstructured enterprise data, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge graphs. 
 - Drive improvements in retrieval accuracy, contextual relevance, response quality, grounding, and hallucination mitigation. 
 - Oversee enterprise knowledge assistants, AI copilots, intelligent search solutions, and domain-specific AI applications. 
 - Establish standards for data access, source attribution, information security, and evaluation of knowledge-grounded AI systems. 5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

- Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration. 
 - Lead the design and deployment of AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, task execution, and controlled decision support. 
 - Drive Agentic AI adoption across software engineering, testing, customer support, business operations, and relevant domain-specific workflows. 
 - Establish frameworks for agent orchestration, memory management, human-in-the-loop controls, exception handling, and safe execution. 
 - Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability. 
 - Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries. 6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

- Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments. 
 - Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive the development of production-ready AI applications using robust APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Establish end-to-end AI evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, and cost. 
 - Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support. 
 - Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations. 7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

- Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows. 
 - Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery. 
 - Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Promote responsible adoption of AI development tools while maintaining software quality, intellectual property protection, and security standards. 8. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Define policies for model access, data protection, prompt injection mitigation, sensitive information handling, and AI application security. 
 - Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, explainability, and traceability for AI-assisted and agent-driven decisions. 
 - Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Architecture teams to establish risk-based controls for enterprise AI adoption. 
 - Implement governance mechanisms for model evaluation, production approval, change management, incident response, and continuous monitoring. 9. Technology Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

- Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, orchestration technologies, and industry developments. 
 - Establish strategic technology partnerships and guide build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Convert promising AI experiments into scalable production capabilities with clear adoption and business-value criteria. 
 - Represent the organization in strategic technology discussions and provide thought leadership to executive management. 10. Portfolio, Budget & Business Outcome Management

- Own the AI division's delivery portfolio, investment priorities, resource utilization, and operational performance. 
 - Establish governance for AI project prioritization, delivery milestones, dependencies, and risk management. 
 - Define measurable business cases for AI initiatives and track their impact on productivity, operating costs, quality, customer experience, and revenue opportunities. 
 - Communicate portfolio performance, investment requirements, delivery risks, and realized business value to executive stakeholders. 
 - Ensure that AI investments deliver sustainable outcomes rather than isolated proofs of concept. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 20+ years of overall experience in software engineering, technology architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology leadership. 
 - Significant experience leading large engineering, architecture, AI/ML, or platform engineering organizations. 
 - Strong hands-on technical foundation in AI/ML and Generative AI, with demonstrable experience designing and deploying enterprise AI solutions in production. 
 - Proven track record of defining technology strategy and translating it into successful enterprise-scale implementation. 
 - Experience building and scaling technical teams, leading senior architects and engineering managers, and managing complex technology portfolios.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, application security, and production engineering. Mandatory Technical Expertise

Candidates must demonstrate substantial expertise across the core areas below. Equivalent technologies are acceptable where the candidate has strong architecture and implementation experience. 

Generative AI & Foundation Models

- LLMs, SLMs, prompt engineering, model evaluation, fine-tuning, embeddings, inference optimization, and model orchestration.

- Strong proficiency in Python and practical understanding of AI application development. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, enterprise integration, and production software engineering.

- Experience in Insurance, InsurTech, Financial Services, Healthcare, or enterprise SaaS environments.

 - Experience leading AI transformation across multiple business units or large engineering organizations. 
 - Exposure to enterprise risk management, regulatory requirements, responsible AI, and security governance. 
 - Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, strategic partnerships, and executive-level reporting.

- Enterprise-level strategic thinking combined with strong technical judgment.

About the Role

We're looking for a Java Developer with strong backend skills and experience building calculation-heavy, finance-related applications. 

Key responsibilities

- Design, build and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. Break requirements into modules, write the code end to end, and keep it maintainable as features grow. 
 - Build secure, well-structured REST APIs with proper request validation, error handling, status codes and versioning. Document APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI so other teams can use them easily. 
 - Write clean, readable and testable code that follows SOLID principles and team coding standards. Refactor older code when needed and keep technical debt under control. 
 - Implement business logic for multi-step calculations such as rates, slabs, percentages, fees, rebates and penalties. Make sure every result is accurate, repeatable and easy to trace. 
 - Implement double-entry postings, map each transaction to the correct finance/account codes, and handle reversals, refunds and adjustments without breaking ledger balances. 
 - Write and optimise complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and reports. Design tables and indexes that keep data consistent and queries fast as volume grows. 
 - Write unit and integration tests for all business logic, with extra focus on calculation edge cases and boundary values. Keep test coverage high so changes can be released with confidence. 
 - Investigate and fix production issues, including calculation or data mismatches. Do root-cause analysis and put permanent fixes in place, not just workarounds. 
 - Take part in code reviews, sprint planning and technical discussions. Work closely with QA, business analysts and finance teams to clarify rules and confirm expected results. Required skills and experience

- 4-8 years of hands-on Java development (Java 11 or later; Java 17 preferred), with at least 2 years on enterprise or transaction-heavy applications. 
 - Strong command of OOP concepts, Collections, Generics, Multithreading and concurrency utilities, Exception Handling, Streams and Lambdas. Able to explain why one approach is better than another, not just use it. 
 - Solid experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and Spring Security. Understands dependency injection, bean lifecycle, profiles and configuration management. 
 - Has built and consumed RESTful services, including authentication (JWT/OAuth2), validation, pagination and global exception handling. Has integrated with third-party APIs such as payment gateways or banks. 
 - Strong SQL on PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL - complex joins, subqueries, window functions, indexing, stored procedures and query tuning using execution plans. 
 - Clear understanding of ACID, isolation levels, optimistic and pessimistic locking, and idempotency. Knows how to prevent duplicate entries and race conditions in multi-user systems. 
 - Uses BigDecimal correctly for money, with defined scale and rounding modes. Knows why double/float must not be used for financial values. 
 - Understands ledgers, journal entries, debits and credits, chart of accounts and finance code structures. Can translate a finance rule into correct and testable code. 
 - Writes unit tests with JUnit 5 and Mockito, and integration tests for APIs and database layers. Comfortable with test-driven thinking for logic-heavy code. 
 - Comfortable with Git branching, Maven or Gradle, Jenkins or other CI/CD tools, and basic Linux commands for deployment and log checks. 
 - B. Tech / BE / MCA in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

data.title: SENIOR/ STAFF / PRINCIPAL ENGINEER — NAND SILICON DESIGN VALIDATION (SDV)
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

ROLE

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration. 

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. 
 - Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions. 
 - Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features. 
 - Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions. 
 - Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies. 
 - Proven ability to leverage AI‐assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
 - Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflowApplying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency

Required Qualifications

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level. 
 - Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following: 
 - Mixed-signal verification
 - Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
 - Post-silicon validation and characterization
 - Memory validation
 - Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations. 
 - Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments. 
 - Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results. 
 - Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python. 
 - Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration. 
 - Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

data.description:
Senior Manufacturing & Production Quality Lead - LifeBand

Location: India - predominantly on-site in Chennai

Engagement: Contract, Full Time

Reporting to: Equivital UK Product & Operations Leadership

Product: Equivital LifeBand - first high-volume production run of 2, 000 units

Role purpose

Equivital is seeking experienced electronics manufacturing professional to provide hands-on leadership and oversight of the first high-volume production run of approximately 2, 000 LifeBand devices at our manufacturing partner in India. 

This is a critical production-launch role. The successful candidate will act as Equivital's senior on-site manufacturing representative and will be responsible for ensuring that the production process is properly controlled, technically robust and capable of delivering a consistently high-quality product at the required yield. 

The individual will work closely with the manufacturing company in Chennai and quality teams, Equivital's UK engineering and product teams, and other technical stakeholders. 

The role requires someone who is comfortable working directly on the factory floor, identifying problems, challenging poor processes, implementing corrective actions and communicating clearly with both factory personnel and senior technical teams in the UK. 

Key objectives

The successful candidate will be accountable for: 

- Excellent build quality across the 2, 000-unit production run. 
 - High first-pass yield and minimal rework/scrap. 
 - Successful integration of the new ATE into the production process. 
 - Implementation and control of the new final DFT testing process. 
 - Robust control and verification of the LifeBand welding process. 
 - Ensuring welded assemblies meet the required mechanical and electrical specifications, particularly those affecting pogo-pin performance. 
 - Accurate material, component and finished-goods traceability. 
 - Improved stock control and production material management at Manufacturing plant. 
 - Rapid identification, containment and resolution of production issues. 
 - Accurate production reporting to the UK team. 
 - Establishment of a repeatable production process that Manufacturing company can continue to operate after the launch phase. Key responsibilities

1. Production launch and daily manufacturing oversight

- Be Equivital's principal technical and operational representative on-site during the production run. 
 - Work closely with Manufacturing company production, engineering and quality personnel. 
 - Review and approve production readiness before volume manufacturing begins. 
 - Establish clear daily production targets and monitor actual performance. 
 - Monitor production flow from incoming components through assembly, welding, programming, testing, final inspection and packing. 
 - Identify bottlenecks, recurring defects and process weaknesses. 
 - Challenge processes that are not producing the required quality or yield. 
 - Have authority to recommend or initiate a production stop where there is a significant quality or product-risk issue. 2. ATE implementation

The successful candidate will: 

- Work with Equivital engineering and manufacturing company to embed the ATE into the production process. 
 - Ensure operators understand the correct test procedure. 
 - Verify that the ATE is correctly configured and being used consistently. 
 - Establish appropriate test records and traceability. 
 - Monitor ATE failure rates and identified abnormal trends. 
 - Distinguish genuine product failures from test-equipment/operator/process failures. 
 - Ensure failed units are correctly quarantined and investigated. 
 - Ensure that production does not bypass required ATE testing. 
 - Work with engineering to refine the ATE process where necessary. 3. Final DFT implementation

Final Design-for-Test / DFT testing is a new element of the LifeBand production process. 

The role will be responsible for: 

- Implementing the final DFT test process on the production line. 
 - Ensuring appropriate test fixtures, equipment and procedures are available. 
 - Training and supervising operators. 
 - Ensuring 100% of required devices receive the defined final testing. 
 - Ensuring test results are recorded and traceable to individual units. 
 - Monitoring DFT failure modes and trends. 
 - Working with Equivital engineering to investigate recurring failures. 
 - Preventing units from progressing to final packing without completing the required tests. 4. Welding process control

A particularly important responsibility will be oversight of the LifeBand welding process. 

The successful candidate must have practical experience of manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies and understand the failure modes associated with welding/joining processes. 

They will: 

- Establish and document the required welding process parameters. 
 - Verify that the welding equipment is correctly set up and maintained. 
 - Ensure operators are trained and following the approved process. 
 - Establish appropriate first-off and periodic inspection requirements. 
 - Monitor weld quality throughout production. 
 - Identify potential weld defects before they become downstream failures. 
 - Ensure appropriate mechanical/electrical verification of the weld. 
 - Investigate weld-related failures and implement corrective actions. 
 - Pay particular attention to the impact of the welding process on the alignment, positioning and reliability of the LifeBand pogo-pin interface. 
 - Ensure the finished assembly meets the required mechanical tolerances and electrical performance requirements. Experience with welding or joining of small electronic assemblies, plastics, metals, flexes, contacts or similar precision components would be highly desirable. 

5. Quality and yield management

Establish and maintain a clear production-quality dashboard covering, at minimum: 

- First-pass yield (FPY)
 - Overall yield
 - Scrap
 - Rework
 - ATE failures
 - DFT failures
 - Welding defects
 - Pogo-pin/contact failures
 - Functional test failures
 - Component/assembly defects
 - Repeat failure modes
 - Units quarantined
 - Units released
 - Production throughputThe successful candidate will identify trends rather than simply report numbers. 

Where yield deteriorates, they will determine the likely root cause and drive corrective action. 

6. Factory process discipline and stock control

Manufacturing company currently requires improved production discipline and material control. 

The role will therefore include: 

- Verification of component availability before production starts. 
 - Physical verification of critical stock where required. 
 - Improving accuracy between recorded and actual stock. 
 - Ensuring components are correctly identified and traceable. 
 - Preventing uncontrolled substitution of components. 
 - Ensuring rejected/failed components are segregated. 
 - Establishing appropriate quarantine and disposition processes. 
 - Identifying shortages before they stop production. 
 - Ensuring finished and semi-finished units can be reconciled against production records. 7. Non-conformance and root-cause analysis

The individual will lead or coordinate investigation of manufacturing defects. 

They should be comfortable using appropriate techniques including: 

- CAPA
 - Non-Conformance
 - Process capability analysis where appropriateThe objective is not simply to repair defective units but to prevent recurrence. 

8. Communication with the UK team

Provide a concise daily/weekly production report to Equivital UK covering: 

Production

- Units planned, completed, passed, failed, yield, Rework/scrapQuality

- Top defects, ATE failures, DFT failures, Welding defects, Contact/pogo-pin issues, Open NCRsOperations

- Stock/component issues
 - Production constraints
 - Staffing/process issues
 - Risks to scheduleActions

- Corrective actions completed
 - Actions in progress
 - Decisions required from the UK teamSignificant quality issues should be escalated immediately rather than waiting for the weekly report. 

Authority

The individual must have sufficient authority to: 

- Stop or pause production where a significant quality issue is identified. 
 - Quarantine suspect product. 
 - Require re-testing or additional inspection. 
 - Challenge production processes that do not meet the agreed specification. 
 - Escalate unresolved issues directly to Equivital UK leadership. The role is not intended to be a passive inspection position. 

Required experience

Essential

- Significant experience in electronics manufacturing. 
 - Experience managing or overseeing production of electronic devices/products. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with production testing and test equipment. 
 - Experience implementing or managing ATE or automated production testing. 
 - Experience with DFT/functional testing. 
 - Experience with precision manufacturing processes involving small components. 
 - Practical experience with welding, joining or equivalent manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies. 
 - Strong understanding of process control, yield and defect analysis. 
 - Strong communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work directly with factory operators, engineers and management. 
 - Comfortable working on the factory floor rather than purely in an office environment. Highly desirable

- Experience with wearables, medical devices, IoT devices, consumer electronics, industrial electronics or similar products. 
 - Experience with high-volume electronics manufacturing. 
 - Experience with SMT/PCBA and final assembly. 
 - Experience with pogo pins, spring contacts, connectors or similar electrical interfaces. 
 - Experience establishing production test fixtures and traceability systems. 
 - Experience working with international companies or overseas engineering teams within regulated manufacturing environment. 
 - Experience with ISO 9001, ISO 13485 or similar quality systems. 
 - Engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or a related discipline. Personal characteristics

The successful candidate will be: 

- Technically credible. 
 - Hands-on and practical. 
 - Highly organised. 
 - Detail-oriented without losing sight of production objectives. 
 - Comfortable challenging poor processes. 
 - Calm under production pressure. 
 - Commercially aware. 
 - Strong enough to represent Equivital's interests with the manufacturing partner. 
 - Excellent at communicating technical issues simply and clearly to UK-based colleagues.

You will design, build, and operate a container-based delivery platform (artifacts shipped as containers) and maintain reliable development and runtime environments across both virtualized (e. g. , Azure VMware Solution) and physical server landscapes. - Containerization & orchestration

- Service-oriented architecture enablement
 - Support teams in designing, deploying, and operating service-oriented/microservice-style systems (interfaces, contracts, runtime concerns).

 - RHEL and Windows

- Quality engineering & reliability
 - Drive code quality practices: Clean Code, code reviews, static analysis, linting, formatting, and dependency hygiene. 
 - Ensure automated testing strategy coverage (integration/system), pipeline gating, and reproducible environments. 
 - Own troubleshooting across the stack (pipelines, containers, OS, network, runtime issues) and improve operability via metrics/logging/tracing. 

- Security & compliance proof
 - Implement and document security controls, including CIS hardening for OS and container images. 
 - Provide CVE reporting, vulnerability remediation workflows, and evidence suitable for audits (e. g. , baselines, reports, exceptions). 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-5 years of experience in DevOps role. 
 - Proven experience with ownership, mentoring, decision-making. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with containerization (Docker/OCI), image build optimization, and secure image practices. 
 - Solid experience with CI/CD design and operations (pipelines, gating, promotions, automation). 
 - Practical expertise with Kubernetes and container operations concepts (deployments, config, secrets, networking basics). 
 - Strong Python skills for automation/tools and Ansible for configuration management and OS provisioning. 
 - Experience administering and hardening RHEL and Windows (golden images/baselines, patching, configuration).

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with Azure and/or Azure VMware Solution operations and integration patterns. 
 - Experience generating/maintaining SBOMs, signing images, and supply chain security (e. g. , provenance/attestation).

What Success Looks Like (Outcomes)

- A reliable, fast, and secure container-based CI/CD process with clear promotion paths and traceability. 
 - Standardized, hardened, and maintainable RHEL/Windows baselines for both virtual and physical environments. 
 - Measurable improvements in code quality, test automation, and operational stability.

You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks. 

What you'll do: 

- Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.

 - Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.

 - Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.

 - Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs. 
 - Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.

data.title: Co-Founder & CTO
data.description:
I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me. 

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business. 

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising. 

What you'll be building: 

- Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development. 
 - Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure. 
 - Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future. 
 - Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users. 
 - Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow. 
 - Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions. 
 - Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features. Who I'm looking for: 

- 7-12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers. 
 - Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything. 
 - A problem solver who understands business as much as technology. 
 - Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow. 
 - Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee. One thing you should know. 

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort. 

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves. 

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5-10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there. 

This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement. We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently. 

I don't expect you to know everything. 

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers. 

I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me. 

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo. 

Kush Chauhan | Born at 41. 

kush@snapzo. in

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Manage production issues, troubleshoot problems, and ensure timely resolution. 
 - Support Salesforce users through training, guidance, and effective change management. 
 - Manage external Salesforce vendors and partners where required.

Required Skills & Experience

- 12+ years of Salesforce experience, with experience in a lead or managerial role. 
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud. 
 - Experience with Salesforce configuration, automation, security, reports, and dashboards. 
 - Experience managing Salesforce integrations with other enterprise systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, APIs, and integration concepts. 
 - Experience managing Salesforce projects and working with Agile teams. 
 - Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional and central technology teams. 
 - Good understanding of Salesforce governance, release management, and platform best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Salesforce Administrator
 - Salesforce Advanced Administrator
 - Salesforce Platform App Builder
 - Salesforce Platform Developer
 - Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant
 - Salesforce Application Architect or related certifications. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Engineering Manager

Accelerate Performance. 

About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner. 

With 6, 200+ active customers worldwide and a market-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45+ years of industry expertise with modern AI-driven execution - helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact. 

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company. 

CAI India

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust. 

CAI Software is seeking an **Engineering Manager** to join our Discrete Manufacturing business unit in Bangalore. This is a hands-on, full-stack, player-coach role owning engineering for two Microsoft-stack products: MatTrace (formerly Endeavor), our material traceability and shop-floor data collection platform, and LLumin CMMS, our maintenance management product. You will lead the team, serve as senior technical authority for architecture and difficult development issues, write and review code, own critical customer escalations, and drive modernization from . NET Framework 4. 8 to current . NET. The role reports to the VP of Engineering. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture of MatTrace and LLumin CMMS; review designs and resolve architectural and cross-service issues (API contracts, authentication, data model, mobile sync, ERP integration)
 - Lead the . NET modernization roadmap and set engineering standards (layering, DI, code review, CI/CD in Azure DevOps)
 - Fix the hardest defects, prototype architectural changes, and unblock the team on complex C#, SQL, Angular and React Native problems
 - Diagnose production issues end to end, from browser or device through Web API and Entity Framework to the database, including query tuning
 - Act as engineering owner for Severity 1/2 customer escalations: lead triage and root-cause analysis, communicate remediation plans to customers and stakeholders, and partner with Support and Professional Services on hotfix cadence and defect backlogs
 - Build, mentor and manage a multi-product team of full-stack developers, QA and DevOps engineers; own hiring and performance
 - Plan and deliver releases across both products with clear reporting to BU leadership
 - Own test strategy, automation coverage and production readiness (including mobile sync compatibility), and ensure secure SDLC practices
 - Champion AI-assisted development lifecycle (AI-DLC) practices across specification, code and QA automation

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineering teams and 3+ years as an architect or technical lead on enterprise web applications
 - Strong, current full-stack hands-on skills: C# and . NET (Framework 4. 8 and . NET 8+), ASP. NET MVC/Web API, Entity Framework, and SQL Server (schema design, T-SQL, query tuning); able to read, debug and write production code daily
 - Proficiency in at least one modern front-end technology (Angular, React or React Native), with the ability to review and contribute to TypeScript/JavaScript code
 - Proven ability to resolve architectural and difficult development issues in large, layered codebases, including . NET Framework to . NET migration or legacy modernization experience
 - Demonstrated ownership of customer escalations; experience with REST API design, OAuth2/OIDC authentication, background services and enterprise integration patterns (WCF/SOAP, REST, database-level)
 - Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD experience; effective across US and India time zones
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master's preferred)
 - Preferred: domain exposure to manufacturing execution, material traceability, barcode data collection, warehouse operations or CMMS/EAM
 - Preferred: ERP integration experience (IFS, Epicor, Syteline, Dynamics, SAP)
 - Preferred: familiarity with Oracle, Redis/SignalR, . NET MAUI, multi-tenant SaaS, VB. NET or WPF/WinForms
 - Preferred: team-scale use of AI coding assistants and AI-driven SDLC/QA automation

What Success Looks Like

- Predictable, high-quality delivery against roadmap commitments made with Product Management. 
 - Measurable adoption and impact of AI-led development practices within the team. 
 - A well-documented, well-governed engineering process in ADO, Aha!, and Confluence that stakeholders trust. 
 - An engaged, growing engineering team with clear goals and strong retention. 

Why Join CAI

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6, 200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like - and we are building the team to lead that work. 

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers - and how we work: 

- Built to Fit - Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
 - Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays. 
 - Built to Deliver - AI turns action and insights into measurable performance. 
 - Built to Scale - Sustains and scales performance without disruption.
