data.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected OperationsTM Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Platform & Infrastructure organization, which is responsible for building foundational systems that drive software products. Examples include areas such as Reporting/Automations/Enterprise capabilities to support our rapidly growing footprint of customers and foundational infrastructure capabilities such as container orchestration/data storage/real-time data ingestion/GraphQL execution to power Samsara engineering. 

As a Staff Engineer at Samsara, you will help us spearhead the technical direction for the organization, be a technical leader that brings fresh ideas and expertise to guide the team's technical design and architecture and enable increasingly complex features and customer use cases. You will work on specific projects critical to Samsara's needs alongside other highly-skilled Samsara engineers and push Samsara's technical capabilities forward.   

This role is hybrid - 3 days per week in the office. Office address: PRESTIGE TECH PARK, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 - You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. 
 - You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. 
 - You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win-together. In this role, you will:   

- Drive technology choices, implementing services, and/or establishing architectural patterns that have a broad and lasting impact on Samsara's platform
 - Identify opportunities and initiate strategic conversations to influence the direction of platform technology and engineering culture
 - Architect, design, and develop software that enables Samsara to operate at scale
 - Lead teams in delivering products and capabilities that contribute to Samsara's products and revenue
 - Deliver impact by solving the hardest technical problems and enabling products to reach the market quickly and successfully with high quality
 - Keep a platform-first approach while collaborating with our infrastructure and product teams to build products, tools, and solutions. 
 - Act as a multiplier for the team, elevating the impact and output of every team member
 - Contribute to Samsara's engineering brand by representing Samsara in external-facing forums
 - Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new officesMinimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience
 - 12+ years of experience in software design, development, and algorithm-related solutions with at least 4 of those years in an architect or leadership role
 - Stellar programming/coding fundamentals
 - 4+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems
 - 4+ years of experience leading cross-organization projects
 - Expertise working with web services at a massive scale deployed on Cloud providers such as AWS, GCP or AzureAn ideal candidate also: 

- Has 15+ years of relevant industry experience in software development
 - Enjoys leading and mentoring engineers to think about systems - their life cycles, edge cases, and failure modes
 - Enjoys fostering collaboration among engineers with different focuses (frontend, mobile, firmware, vision, ML)
 - Is an expert in writing high-quality, performant, and maintainable code in a modern programming language
 - Production experience working with Javascript and/or client-side code
 - Expertise working on large-scale enterprise software applications
 - Demonstrated ability to ship production-quality software in a dynamic environment
 - Expert-level knowledge of at-scale stream-processing decision engines

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 

Flexible Working  

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. 

Accommodations  

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara. com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. 

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. 

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara. com, @us-greenhouse-mail. io or @mail3. guide. co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here.

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes. 

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them. 

Why This Role Matters

A lawyer won't file anything on the strength of an answer they can't check. In ParamAIQ, the interface is where trust is won or lost. Every answer has to show where it came from, how sure we are, and whether the law it cites is still good, and the lawyer has to be able to verify it in one click. 

You'll build that. This is a senior, hands-on role: you make the frontend architecture calls, and you write the code that matters most. 

What You'll Own

- The product: The architecture and the code of the app lawyers and firms log into. 
 - Search: Millions of judgments, orders, and statutes, with filters by court, judge, section, and date, and results a lawyer can scan in seconds. 
 - The research assistant: Answers that stream in, live progress while it searches and reads, and a citation on each claim that opens the source at the right paragraph. 
 - Evidence on every answer: Sources, confidence, and whether a cited judgment has since been overruled. 
 - The drafting editor: Citations and defined terms as live objects, formatting that follows each court's rules, and PDF and Word export that's ready to file. 
 - The document viewer: Long judgments in PDF or text, with the cited passage highlighted. 
 - Matter workspaces: Where a firm keeps its research and drafts, visible only to the people who should see them. 
 - Speed in real conditions: Long documents, streamed answers, mid-range laptops, and office connections that drop. 
 - The design system: Built with our designer, so the product looks and behaves as one thing. 
 - Internal tools: The software our legal, research, and operations teams run on, with the same care as the product. 

The Hard Problems You'll Take On

- Showing uncertainty without hiding the answer: Making it visible, claim by claim, when an answer is part grounded, part inferred, or leans on an overruled judgment, without burying the lawyer in warnings. 
 - Making slow, fallible AI feel dependable: Show progress honestly, handle partial and failed results gracefully, and never present a half-finished answer as a finished one. 
 - An editor that knows what it contains: Clauses, citations, and defined terms as structured objects that can be checked and flagged when the law changes, while the lawyer still types as freely as in Word. 

What You Bring

- You've shipped a complex web app that people use for real work, in TypeScript and React or a similar framework, and can talk through a hard architecture call you made in it
 - Deep browser knowledge: you can profile a slow page, find what's blocking it, and keep a large interactive screen fast against Core Web Vitals
 - Streaming and async UI: server-sent events or WebSockets, cancellation, and the error and partial states most apps skip
 - Accessibility and tests are part of done for you, not a later ticket
 - Comfort working with backend and research to decide what an answer must carry, so the screen can show it honestly
 - Happy to be in the code, down to the empty states

Bonus Points

- A rich-text editor built on ProseMirror, Lexical, or similar, taken well past the default setup
 - AI products: streamed model output, citations, confidence, or human-review interfaces
 - Document-heavy interfaces: PDF rendering, virtualised long documents, highlights and annotations
 - A design system built from zeroThis Isn't the Role If

- You think a spinner is a finished design for a ten second wait. Most of the hard work is in the states between "loading" and "done. "
 - You want a mature design system to work inside. We're building it. 
 - You want the backend to hand you finished data. 
 - You want to architect and hand off. 

What You Get

- Real ownership of frontend architecture and the code that matters most, from day one
 - The chance to build a design system from zero, alongside our designer
 - Work shoulder to shoulder with practising lawyers on a product built for real legal work
 - A hand in making justice more accessible in one of the largest judicial systems on earth

data.title: Elixir Developer
data.description:
About Jetbro
Jetbro is a technology consulting and systems integration firm that builds reliable, scalable digital systems for organizations where technology is central to operations. We work across custom product development, enterprise applications, and infrastructure-led digital transformation for clients ranging from Fortune 500 companies to high-growth startups across India, Australia, and Canada. 

Our philosophy is simple: build systems that work quietly, predictably, and under pressure. We value clarity over complexity and reliability over noise. 
About the Role
We are looking for an Elixir Developer to join our team building backend services for scalable, production-grade applications. This is not a role where you simply execute PRDs. Instead, you will be a business-minded engineer who deeply understands the product use cases, business objectives, and strategic implications of technical decisions. 

You will design and extend backend services using the Ash Framework, working across resources, actions, and data layers to ship features fast without sacrificing correctness. Our backend is Elixir/Phoenix with Ash as the core application framework, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on Fly. io. You will spend most of your time inside Ash's resource-oriented patterns rather than hand-rolling boilerplate. 

This is a framework-deep role with a business-first mindset. You will actively collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and leadership to understand the why behind features, ask clarifying questions, and contribute to strategic technical decisions. You will use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as everyday tools, and you'll also work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) to build AI-powered features, not just use AI to write code. We expect you to be proficient with them, not just familiar. 
Key Responsibilities
Business & Product Collaboration: 

- Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases, market context, and business objectives before diving into technical implementation

- Ask critical questions about business impact, trade-offs, and long-term implications of technical decisions

- Communicate technical constraints, risks, and opportunities in business-friendly language to non-technical stakeholders

- Contribute to architectural and strategic decisions by providing context on how technical choices affect business outcomes 
 Technical Design & Development: 

- Design and build Ash resources, actions, calculations, and policies for core product features with a deep understanding of their business purpose

- Write clean, testable Elixir code following OTP and Phoenix conventions

- Build interactive, real-time UI where needed using Phoenix LiveView

- Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and query performance with business scalability in mind

- Build and extend APIs (GraphQL/REST via AshGraphql/AshJsonApi or Phoenix controllers) that serve real production traffic 
 AI & Advanced Features: 

- Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) and vector databases into product features (semantic search, embeddings, retrieval-based workflows)

- Use AI coding assistants effectively to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality

- Understand the business implications of AI-powered features and their impact on user experience and product strategy 
 Operations & Ownership: 

- Instrument features with product analytics (PostHog) to track usage and inform iteration

- Maintain Docker-based dev containers for a consistent, reproducible local development setup

- Deploy, monitor, and scale services on Fly. io

- Own features end-to-end: from understanding requirements and business context to deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement

- Participate in production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning with an eye toward business impact 
 Team & Process: 

- Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, product managers, and project leads in a cross-functional environment

- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions with a focus on business value

- Champion clear thinking and ownership mindset within the engineering team 
 What You'll Work On

- Resource-driven backend architecture using Ash (resources, actions, relationships, policies, calculations, aggregates)

- Workflow logic, versioning, and multi-step business processes modeled declaratively in Ash

- Real-time, interactive features built with Phoenix LiveView

- Vector DB-backed features such as semantic search, embeddings storage, and retrieval-augmented workflows

- Background jobs and async processing (Oban or similar)

- Database design, query optimization, and migrations in PostgreSQL

- Integration with third-party services and internal microservices

- Local development standardized via Docker and dev containers

- Deployment, release management, and scaling on Fly. io

- Production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning 
 Tech Stack

- Languages: Elixir

- Frameworks: Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Ash Framework (AshPostgres, AshGraphql/AshJsonApi, Ash Authentication as applicable)

- Databases: PostgreSQL, Vector DB (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)

- AI/LLM: Claude, Gemini (API-level integration), Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

- Analytics: PostHog

- Infrastructure: Fly. io, Docker, Dev Containers, CI/CD pipelines

- Other: Oban/background jobs, GraphQL/REST APIs, Git

Requirements

Who is this Role for?
This role is a great fit if you: 

Technical Foundation: 

- Have hands-on experience with Elixir, and specifically the Ash Framework (not just Phoenix alone)

- Understand Ash's resource/action/policy model well enough to extend it, not just follow existing patterns

- Have built real-time or interactive features with Phoenix LiveView

- Have worked with vector databases and understand embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval patterns

- Have integrated LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) into production features, not just used them as coding tools

- Are comfortable using product analytics tools like PostHog to inform engineering decisions\

- Are comfortable working in Docker-based dev container environments

- Have experience deploying and operating applications on Fly. io (or similar platforms)

- Actively use AI coding assistants and understand their strengths and limits

- Care about writing code that other people can read and maintain 
 Business & Collaboration Mindset: 

- Genuinely enjoy understanding the business context behind features, not just executing specifications

- Are comfortable asking "why" and challenging assumptions to ensure decisions align with business goals

- Have experience collaborating with product, business, and non-technical stakeholders

- Can translate between technical and business language effectively

- Enjoy working on systems that serve real users at real scale and care about user impact

- Demonstrate ownership mindset: you think about long-term implications, not just shipping code

- Learn fast and don't need to be told twice

- Are curious about how your work affects the broader business and product strategy 
 What we care more about than your resume

- Real Ash Framework experience > general Elixir/Phoenix experience alone

- Business acumen and product thinking > years of experience

- Communication and collaboration skills > individual technical prowess

- AI-fluency (both as a coding tool and as a feature you build) > years of experience

- Clear thinking and strategic mindset > buzzwords

- Ownership mindset and business impact focus > following instructions

- Side projects, experiments, GitHub repos, or well-documented failures are a big plus 
 Bonus

- Experience with AshAdmin, AshStateMachine, or AshPaperTrail

- Experience building RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipelines

- Exposure to observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, or similar)

- Experience in product-driven or cross-functional engineering environments

- Familiarity with Specification-Driven Development (SDD) or similar methodologies

Benefits

Growth at Jetbro
If you do well, this role can grow into: 

- Senior Backend Engineer

- Platform / Infrastructure Engineer

- System Architect (longer term) 
 We invest heavily in people who invest in learning.

data.title: QA Engineering
data.description:
The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom. 

Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure-global, regional, or sectoral-across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning). 

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90, 000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region. 

This is not an 'offshore' support role. Our India team is a core product hub, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust. 

The Role: Engineering Confidence

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline. 

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe. "

Here's what you can look forward to in this role. 

- Engineer the Safety Net: You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast. 
 - Shift Quality Left: You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase. 
 - Pragmatic Quality: While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually. 
 - Drive CI/CD Velocity: You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately. 
 - Guardian of the Client Experience: You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss. 

Our Tech Stack

- Web Automation: We use Playwright for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications. 
 - Backend Automation: We use Cucumber-Scala to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure. 
 - Mobile Automation: We leverage Maestro E2E and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps. 
 - Ops: We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on CI/CD to run your tests on every commit. Want to look under the hood? Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at tech. endowus. com

What Success Looks Like

- First 30 Days (Immersion): You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release. 
 - First 90 Days (Ownership): You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage. 
 - First 6 Months (Impact): You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a "founder mentality". 

What You Bring (Requirements)

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline: 

Must-Haves: 

- 4+ Years of Test Engineering: You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation. 
 - Strong Coding Fundamentals: You are proficient in at least one major language (Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding. 
 - Automation Framework Competence: You have experience using and extending frameworks like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. You can write stable, maintainable scripts. 
 - API Testing DNA: You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states. 
 - Collaborative Mindset: You don't wait for a "hand-off. " You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests betterNice-to-Haves: 

- Mobile Automation: Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro. 
 - Performance Testing: Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter. 
 - FinTech Domain: You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

Why Endowus?

- Modern Stack, Serious Business: You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup. 
 - World-Class Engineering Talent: You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture. 
 - Career Growth with Upside: We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category. 
 - Leadership Pedigree: Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more. 

Why NOT Endowus?

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment. 

- You prefer 100% Automation: If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you. 
 - You prefer a Centralized QA Structure: If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging. 
 - You prefer executing over planning: If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves. 
 - You want 100% Remote: We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

The Interview Process

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient. 

- Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission. 
 - Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
 - Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios. 
 - System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management. 
 - Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Product UI and Design)
data.description:
About Lexsi Labs

Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab working toward aligned, interpretable and safe superintelligent systems. Our near-term mission is to build safety-aware autonomous systems for mission-critical settings such as banking, insurance, government and healthcare. We believe the institutions that deploy AI should be able to audit, correct and own the risk of the models they rely on, and we build the research and the platform that make that possible. 

Our research spans AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundation model research across language, structured and tabular data, and autonomous systems. We have published 25+ papers in the past 15 months across conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris and London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behaviour. 

About the Role

We are building the platform through which institutions own the AI they depend on. Post-training, alignment, evaluation, deployment and monitoring run inside the customer's own environment, on the methods our labs publish. 

The people using it vary widely. Post-training scientists and AI researchers run experiments at the edge of what current methods can do. AI and ML engineers take models and agents into production. Data scientists build and validate models on enterprise data. Platform and infrastructure teams operate the compute and services underneath. Inside banks, insurers and public institutions, model risk, validation and audit teams need to understand and sign off on results without writing code, and business owners need to see what is running and how it is performing. The same screen often has to serve a researcher and a risk reviewer. 

The interface decides whether frontier model science stays in research papers or becomes something every institution can operate. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write production React and TypeScript most of the week, own the frontend architecture of the platform, and make the final call on its flows, information architecture and visual design. You will work with a product designer and one or two frontend engineers, setting the standard through code and review rather than management. Expect roughly 70% of your time on building and 30% on design decisions, review and direction. 

What you'll work on

- Own the frontend architecture of a large React and TypeScript application: routing and layout, code splitting, state boundaries, and the contracts between the UI and backend services. 
 - Own the component library and design tokens as a single system used across the application, evolving it incrementally in a live codebase without pausing feature work. 
 - Design and build data-dense interfaces: virtualised tables over large result sets, live metrics and log streams, trace and graph visualisations, side-by-side comparisons, and code and configuration editors. 
 - Build a real-time data layer over SSE and WebSockets with reconnection, backpressure and cache semantics that stay consistent with request-response queries. 
 - Build schema-driven form systems for deeply nested, conditional configuration, validated against backend schemas. 
 - Design interfaces that work for users with very different levels of technical depth, from researchers to risk reviewers, without splitting the product in two. 
 - Make the final call on information architecture, interaction and visual design, and take your decisions from Figma to production yourself. 
 - Set and enforce performance budgets: render profiling, bundle size, and interaction latency on locked-down enterprise machines. 
 - Ship builds that run in restricted and fully offline networks, with reproducible builds, self-hosted assets and no runtime dependence on external hosts. 
 - Meet enterprise requirements in the UI: SSO, role-aware interfaces, auditability, accessibility, and internationalisation including right-to-left layouts. 
 - Raise the engineering bar across the frontend: type safety, testing strategy, tooling and code review. 
 - Work directly with researchers and platform engineers to turn new methods into usable product, often before the method has settled. 

You may be a good fit if you have

- 8+ years building production web applications, including several years as the technical lead on a complex product UI. 
 - Expert-level TypeScript and React, including React 19 rendering and concurrency behaviour and hands-on performance profiling. 
 - Owned the architecture of a large frontend codebase and improved it materially while the team kept shipping. 
 - Led an incremental migration in a live application, such as a component library, state management approach, router or build system. 
 - Built interfaces where performance was the hard problem: tens of thousands of rows, high-frequency streaming updates, large JSON or log payloads, or complex interactive charts. 
 - Deep, practical experience with TanStack Query or equivalent, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form with Zod, Vite and pnpm. 
 - Built or maintained a design system with tokens, theming, accessibility to WCAG standards and documentation in Storybook. 
 - Designed and shipped product yourself, with a portfolio that shows both the decisions you made and the code that implemented them. 
 - Built for multiple user types with different expertise in the same product, and made it work for each of them. 
 - A testing discipline built on Vitest or Jest, Playwright and API mocking. 
 - Worked without a product manager or a full spec, decided what to build, and defended the decision with evidence. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication of trade-offs to engineers, researchers and leadership. 

Strong candidates may also have

- Built developer tools or ML tooling, such as experiment tracking, training dashboards, evaluation or observability products. 
 - Visualisation depth with ECharts, D3, or canvas and WebGL rendering. 
 - Built graph or trace viewers (React Flow or similar) and embedded code editors (CodeMirror or Monaco). 
 - Shipped software into on-premise, regulated or air-gapped environments. 
 - Built right-to-left and multi-locale products. 
 - Used state machines such as XState for complex multi-step flows. 
 - Instrumented frontends with OpenTelemetry and web vitals. 
 - Shipped LLM-powered product features. 
 - Contributed to open-source frontend libraries. 

If you meet most of this but not all, we would still like to hear from you. 

What this role is not

- Not a people management role at the start. There are no direct reports, and influence comes through code, review and design decisions. 
 - Not a visual design role. You will design, but you will be measured on what ships to production. 
 - Not a ticket-implementation role. You will be expected to question specs and decide what should be built. 

What we expect in the first six months

- Own a set of redesigned core flows end to end, from information architecture through to production. 
 - Establish the component system and tokens as the single source of truth for the application. 
 - Set performance budgets for the heaviest views and bring them within budget. 
 - Put test coverage in place across the core flows. 

How we will evaluate

- A review of shipped work where you can show both the design decisions and the code. 
 - A build exercise on a data-dense screen, assessed on code quality, structure and performance. 
 - A design critique of a flow in our product, where you decide what changes and why. 
 - An architecture conversation on component systems, data and streaming layers, and offline deployment.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Description: 

Join AlmaShines Technologies as a Full Stack Engineer

Location: Ahmedabad, India

Employment Type: Full-time, Onsite

Experience: 1-2 Years

CTC: ₹5L - ₹6L / Year

The Role: 

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer who builds like an owner. You will take features from business need to production, including new modules, AI capabilities, automation, and internal tools, across frontend, backend, database, and cloud. You will work closely with your Product Owner and with our tech leadership. 

This is not a ticket-taking role. We expect you to question designs or tech decisions, suggest better approaches, and help shape the product. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1) Build and Own Features End to End

- Turn business needs into sound technical structures, build them, release them and own the architecture and code quality of your work. 
 - Maintain and improve existing modules that you and your squad own. 2) Build AI into the Product

- Find where AI genuinely improves the product for our clients and communities, and build it: RAG, large-data profiling systems, and more. 
 - Know when AI is the wrong tool, and say so. 3) Integrate and Automate

- Work with our 50+ external integrations (payment gateways, email providers, WhatsApp messaging, CRM tools, clients' internal tools) and 20+ infrastructure-level integrations on AWS, and add new ones quickly as needs arise. 
 - Build automation and internal tools that make the team and our clients faster. 4) Engineer for Scale and Security

- Build for 2, 000+ institutes and 1 crore+ users: failure handling, performance, security, and monitoring are part of the job, not extras. 
 - Notice what a requirements document leaves out and raise it before you build. 5) Improve What Exists

- Suggest better alternatives, challenge weak designs, and take part in product and technical decisions. 
 - Grow into mentoring junior developers and leading technical direction for your squad. 

What We're Looking for: 

Must-Have: 

- 1-2 years of experience building and shipping real software. 
 - Hands-on skills in React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on the frontend, and in Node. js or Python on the backend with relational and non-relational databases. 
 - Hands-on experience building with AI beyond calling an LLM API, for example a RAG pipeline (embeddings, vector search, chunking, evaluation) or a large-data profiling system. 
 - Strong fundamentals: coding basics, data structures, frontend and backend, databases, and web technologies. 
 - Very good debugging: you find root causes, not only symptoms. 
 - Practical learning: you pick up new frameworks, APIs, and cloud services by building, rather then just following tutorials or courses. 
 - Evidence of initiative: something you built or improved that nobody asked you to, in a job, freelance work, a side project, or open source, and a clear reason why you did it. 
 - The ability to explain your decisions and the alternatives you considered. 
 - An understanding of what changes when software serves lakhs of users: failure handling, performance, and security. 

Good to Have: 

- Experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, SES, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, Lambda, etc. 
 - Experience integrating third-party systems: payment gateways, messaging platforms, CRM tools. 
 - Judgment about which AI features are worth building for a product, and how to shape them with a Product Owner. 
 - Familiarity with AngularJS, PHP (CodeIgniter), FastAPI, or Cordova. 
 - GitHub repositories, personal projects, or scripts that show your coding habits. 

Growth Path: 

We hire engineers who want to lead. Here is the path we expect you to take. 

- First 3 months: get productive in our stack and deliver your first impactful projects. You start owning the architecture and code quality of your own work in your first quarter. 
 - By 6 months: full ownership of your own architecture and code, shipping projects at a steady pace. 
 - By 12 months: you own your squad's architecture and code quality, not only your own. You mentor junior developers, suggest new initiatives, and work closely with your Product Owner. 
 - 1-2 years: you grow into the tech lead of a squad, including new squads as we grow. 

About AlmaShines: 

AlmaShines, founded by 3 IIT Kanpur alumni, is India's largest and fastest-growing community management platform, trusted by 2, 000+ institutes and used by over 1 crore users, with 4 lakh+ active users across 15+ countries every month. We help institutions, organizations, NGOs, and professional networks build meaningful communities through robust technology, smart automation, and tailor-made configurations. 

We are a bootstrapped, product-first company. That means every engineer here has real ownership and direct impact on something millions of people use. 

Website: www. almashines. io

Why Join AlmaShines: 

- Build at real scale: a live platform with 1 crore+ users means your work has direct, visible impact
 - Ownership from day one: you own features from requirement to production, and your decisions shape the product. 
 - An AI-first product: build AI capabilities that reach real communities, not demos. 
 - Learn broadly: web, mobile, AWS, and 70+ integrations, with problems that keep changing. 
 - A clear path to lead: we are building tech leads for our squads, and this role is the start of that path. 
 - Bootstrapped and product-first: a small team where engineering has a real seat at the table. 

How We Hire: 

Our process might include a short take-home project before the interview, where you build a small feature and explain the decisions behind it. You are welcome to use AI tools, as long as you understand what you built and can explain it. We care more about your curiosity, thought process, and learning ability than a polished submission. 

Compensation and Perks: 

CTC: ₹5, 00, 000 - ₹6, 00, 000 / Year (based on skills and experience)

Medical Cover: Medical insurance and wellness perks

Leaves: 24 paid leaves per year

Culture: High-growth environment with ownership, learning, and meaningful impact

We've learned from experience that the profile we're looking for is very specific. You'll thrive here if you're a curious coder, a quick learner, a hustler who wants ownership, and someone who takes responsibility for the product, not only the task. If that sounds like you, this is the perfect place for you.

data.title: Distinguished, Software Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer in Walmart's Data & AI Organization, you are one of the most senior technical leaders responsible for defining the long-term architecture, strategy, and execution of enterprise-scale data, AI, and software platforms. You combine deep expertise in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, AI Platforms, Security, Governance, and Enterprise Architecture to build trusted, scalable, and AI-ready systems that power Walmart's customer, associate, and business experiences globally. 

You operate with Executive-level influence, driving cross-organizational technology decisions, shaping engineering standards, and solving the most complex technical and business challenges. You are expected to be hands-on, leading architectural design, reviewing code, guiding platform strategy, driving security and compliance by design, and mentoring senior technical talent across the organization. 

What You'll Do

Enterprise Data & AI Strategy

Define and execute the multi-year technology vision for Data, AI, Agentic AI, Analytics, Real-Time Platforms, and Customer Data ecosystems. 

Align platform strategy with Walmart's enterprise AI, data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and business objectives. 

Drive standardization, platformization, and modernization initiatives across multiple product and engineering organizations. 

Architecture & Platform Leadership

Architect global-scale data and software platforms supporting batch, streaming, AI/ML, Agentic AI, and real-time processing workloads. 

Design highly scalable, secure, resilient, and observable systems spanning Data Lakes, Data Products, APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architectures, and AI and Agentic Platforms. 

Serve as the final technical authority on complex architectural decisions affecting multiple organizations and markets. 

Security, Governance & Trust

Champion security-by-design, privacy-by-design, and responsible AI principles across platforms and products. 

Establish enterprise standards for identity, access management, data governance, lineage, compliance, risk mitigation, and operational resilience. 

Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Infrastructure teams to ensure platforms meet regulatory and enterprise requirements. 

Engineering Excellence

Raise the engineering bar across Data Engineering and Software Engineering disciplines. 

Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Observability, Reliability Engineering, Testing Automation, and AI-assisted development. 

Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and operational excellence initiatives

AI & Innovation Leadership

Enable enterprise-scale AI and Agentic AI capabilities through reusable platforms, metadata foundations, governance frameworks, evaluation systems, and secure integration patterns. 

Drive innovation in areas such as intelligent automation, AI-ready data platforms, knowledge systems, and next-generation engineering productivity tools. 

Influence the adoption of emerging technologies while balancing risk, scalability, maintainability, and business value. 

Organizational Leadership

Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior Engineers across the organization. 

Build strong technical communities, promote knowledge sharing, and develop future engineering leaders. 

Foster a culture of innovation, inclusion, continuous learning, and operational excellence. 

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Enterprise Architecture. 

Proven expertise building and operating large-scale data platforms, real-time systems, and cloud-native applications. 

Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, AI/ML platforms, security architecture, governance, and software engineering best practices. 

Strong hands-on coding experience in Java, Scala, Python, SQL, and modern cloud technologies. 

Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide architecture and platform transformations. 

Experience influencing senior executives and driving alignment across large engineering organizations without direct authority. 

Proven track record of mentoring senior technical leaders and scaling engineering excellence. 

Experience building enterprise Data & AI platforms supporting analytics, personalization, customer intelligence, optimization, and Agentic AI solutions. 

Expertise in data platform modernization, platform engineering, security engineering, and cloud transformation. 

Experience operating across global markets and highly regulated environments. 

- Contributions to patents, publications, open-source projects, or industry thought leadership. Previous experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or equivalent senior technical leadership role. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people. 

Minimum Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications. 

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 6 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Option 2: 8 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Preferred Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications. 

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 4 years' experience in software engineering or related area, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart's accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture. 

Primary Location. . . Block- 1, Prestige Tech Pacific Park, Sy No. 38/1, Outer Ring Rd Kadubeesanahalli , India

data.title: KYC Operations Team Lead
data.description:
As a KYC Operations Team Lead you will oversee the daily operations of a team of KYC Analysts. Your team is responsible for conducting thorough customer due diligence reviews, analyzing various customer and business activities, and ensuring that our KYC records are kept up to date according to our internal policies. The KYC Operations Team Lead is a people lead with a mindset focused on building processes that put our customers first while being aware of the risks surrounding the industry and the wider regulatory environment. 

Job Responsibilities

Team Leadership

Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning

People management: Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviors, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions

Operational management

Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations

Performance management

Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit

Expertise Sharing

Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership

Planning and execution

Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals

data.title: Associate Software Engineer
data.description:
About Ryewalk

At Ryewalk, we go beyond solving problems - we engineer smart, scalable solutions that drive business success. 

- Salesforce Experts - We don't just implement CRM solutions; we tailor Salesforce to fit our client's business, ensuring seamless adoption and maximum impact. 
 - Cloud Strategists - We design and build cloud architectures in AWS that are robust, scalable, and ready for the future. 
 - Tech Trailblazers - When technology challenges stall progress, we step in, streamline, and deliver. No jargon, no fluff-just outcomes that matter. If it's a complex tech challenge, we're the team that makes it work. 

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate Software Engineer (6 months - 2 years experience) to join our team

and grow into building robust, scalable applications that power business-critical solutions. 

This is an early-career role, and we have designed it that way. You will work alongside senior

engineers on real production features from day one, with code reviews, pairing, and mentorship built

into how we work. We are less interested in how many technologies you have already used and more

interested in how you think, how you debug, and how quickly you pick things up. 

If you have solid fundamentals in modern web development, enjoy figuring out why something broke, 

and want to learn distributed systems and cloud-native architecture properly rather than superficially, 

you will thrive at Ryewalk. 

What You'll Do

• Build and ship features in Node. js, TypeScript, and React, starting with well-scoped work and

taking on larger pieces as you grow. 

• Write and consume REST APIs with proper validation, error handling, and documentation. 

• Work with PostgreSQL day to day - writing queries, understanding schemas, and learning how

to spot slow ones. 

• Debug production issues with support from the team, and learn to read logs, traces, and

metrics. 

• Write unit and integration tests as a normal part of shipping, not an afterthought. 

• Participate in code reviews - both receiving feedback and, over time, reviewing others' work. 

• Learn our microservices and event-driven patterns by working inside them, with guidance from

senior engineers. 

• Collaborate with product, QA, and delivery teammates to take features from ticket to production. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

• 6 months to 2 years of hands-on development experience. Internships, apprenticeships, and

substantial personal or open-source projects count. 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript, including async/await and promises. 

• Experience building React components, with familiarity with hooks and state. 

• Comfort with SQL and relational databases - you can write joins and reason about tables. 

• Familiarity with Git in a team workflow (branches, pull requests, resolving conflicts). 

• A basic understanding of how HTTP and REST APIs work. 

• Strong problem-solving instincts - you break problems down and know when to ask for help.

QA Automation Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical QA Automation Engineer to anchor the quality, reliability, and precision of our Enterprise AI and core software systems. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust test automation frameworks using Python with Playwright, Java with Selenium, and TOSCA. Alongside core automation, you will establish verification layers for enterprise AI systems and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, ensuring web applications, API microservices, data pipelines, and AI components are resilient and production-ready.

·              API & Backend Automation:   Architect and execute automated test suites for RESTful microservices and backend systems using RestAssured and Postman. 

·              Data & ETL Testing:   Perform rigorous data feed validation, verify reporting processes, and conduct market data verification. Leverage advanced SQL to ensure data pipeline integrity. 

·              CI/CD, Version Control & BDD:   Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps). Manage version control via Git (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket). Author BDD test coverage using Cucumber and TestNG.

Required Experience and Qualifications

·              Overall Experience:   7 to 10 years of professional experience in software QA automation and testing complex distributed systems. 

·              Mandatory Core Skills:   Extensive hands-on experience with Python + Playwright and Java + Selenium. Proficiency with TOSCA is highly desirable. 

·              API & Backend Testing:   Strong expertise in testing APIs and microservices using RestAssured and Postman. 

·              Frameworks & Methodologies:   Deep knowledge of Hybrid Page Object Model (POM), TestNG, and Cucumber (BDD). 

·              Data & ETL Testing:   Proficient in SQL, with a background in data feed validation, reporting processes, and market data verification. 

·              AI & LLM Testing Foundations:   Hands-on experience testing AI/ML pipelines, LLM orchestrations (e. g. , LangChain, LlamaIndex), and validating RAG architectures. 

·              CI/CD & Version Control:   Experience integrating tests using Git and CI/CD tools (Jenkins or Azure DevOps). 

·              Certifications:   ISTQB Certified Tester and ICAgile Certified Professional credentials. 

Preferred Qualifications

·              Performance Testing:   Experience with performance and load testing frameworks (e. g. , Locust, JMeter) for measuring API response times. 

·              Cloud & Infrastructure:   Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), Docker, and cloud API gateways.

data.description:
Job Title: Senior Design Manager

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India

Experience: Minimum 15 years overall; 7+ years in leadership

Working Days- Monday-Saturday

Employment Type: Full-time

  

Role summary

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design-for-manufacturability and cost‐efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands-on involvement in complex sheet‐metal product development. 

  

Key accountabilities-

- Team leadership and people management

  - Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters). 

  - Establish clear role descriptions, career ladders, KPIs, and individual development plans. 

  - Conduct regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, succession planning, and calibration with HR and senior leadership. 

  - Promote a culture of ownership, continuous learning, safety, and cross-functional collaboration. 

  

- Technical ownership and hands-on design

  - Provide hands-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‐metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings. 

  - Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries. 

  - Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‐built documentation. 

  

- Product development lifecycle & project leadership

  - Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full-scale production. 

  - Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices). 

  - Lead cross-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders. 

  

- Manufacturability, cost optimization & supplier engineering

  - Own DFMA for sheet‐metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection. 

  - Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead-time management. 

  - Drive cost-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume-based sourcing strategies. 

  

- Quality, compliance & reliability

  - Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements. 

  - Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective & preventive actions. 

  - Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required. 

  

- Process improvement & systems

  - Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management. 

  - Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model-based definition (MBD) where applicable. 

  - Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 

  

- Stakeholder management & reporting

- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements. 

  - Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership. 

  - Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings. 

  

Deliverables & success metrics

- Deliverables

  - Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production. 

  - DFMEA, tolerance stack-ups, verification & validation plans, prototype test reports. 

  - Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials. 

  

Required qualifications & experience (expanded)

- Education: B. Tech/B. E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M. Tech/M. S. preferred. 

- Experience: Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‐metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity. 

- CAD skills: Expert-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‐metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent. 

- Manufacturing knowledge: Thorough understanding of sheet‐metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes. 

- Systems: Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions. 

- Process skills: DFMA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development. 

- Leadership: Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience. 

- Communication: Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 

- Mobility: Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required). 

  

Preferred / differentiating skills

- Certifications: CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent. 

- Domain experience: Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense. 

- Simulation: Experience with sheet‐metal forming simulation (e. g. , AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization. 

- Tooling & fixtures: Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies. 

- Software: Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar. 

- Manufacturing exposure: Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains. 

Interested candidates can share their resume at 8750604449-Harshita Joshi or at payal@metaguise. com

Job Title: AWS DevOps Architect

Job Type: Full-Time

Duration: Long Term

Work Preference: Onsite

Experience: 10+ Years

Work Location: Gondia, MH/ Pune, MH

Immediate joiner preferred

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Architect to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices. 

The ideal candidate combines strong AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define enterprise AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures. 
 - Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments. 
 - Architect CI/CD pipelines for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure. 
 - Establish Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation. 
 - Design containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR. 
 - Define deployment strategies including Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback. 
 - Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments. 
 - Implement DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement. 
 - Design AWS networking patterns involving VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity. 
 - Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards. 
 - Implement observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana.

 - Implement secrets and encryption management using AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS. 
 - Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity. 
 - Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators. 
 - Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS. 
 - Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging. 
 - Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams. 
 - Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership. 

Required Experience

 - 3+ years in a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer role.

 - ECR
 - API Gateway
 - Route 53

 - Secrets Manager and KMS

 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild. 
 - Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell. 
 - Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:

data.title: Software Development Engineer - BackEnd (Staff - Level 4) , IND
data.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.     

  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

  

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

About our Team
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You will Do

  

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
 - Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
 - Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
 - Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
 - Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
 - Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
 - Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
 - Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
 - Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
 - Stay hands-on with coding and system design
 - Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
 - Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements  

What We're Looking For

Technical

  

- 8-12 years of backend engineering experience
 - Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
 - Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
 - Strong coding and problem-solving abilityBeyond the technical bar: 

  

- A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks - initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
 - Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
 - Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
 - Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help  

Nice to Have

  

- Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
 - Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
 - Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
 - Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments  

    

  Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview - click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.   

  

Discover more about working at Agoda
 - Agoda Careers  https: //careersatagoda. com
 - Facebook  https: //www. facebook. com/agodacareers/
 - LinkedIn  https: //www. linkedin. com/company/agoda
 - YouTube  https: //www. youtube. com/agodalife  

Equal Opportunity Employer  

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics. 

We  will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy. 

Disclaimer

We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency's representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.
