data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.

 - Self-driven, highly motivated, outcome-focused, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Technical Expertise

 - LangChain and LangGraph, including state graphs, nodes, edges, conditional routing, parallel execution, retries, sub-agents, checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) , IND
data.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.     

  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

  

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

  

About our Team
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You will Do

  

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
 - Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
 - Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
 - Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
 - Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
 - Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
 - Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
 - Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
 - Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
 - Stay hands-on with coding and system design
 - Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
 - Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements  

What We're Looking For

Technical

  

- 8-12 years of backend engineering experience
 - Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
 - Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
 - Strong coding and problem-solving abilityBeyond the technical bar: 

  

- A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks - initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
 - Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
 - Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
 - Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help  

Nice to Have

  

- Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
 - Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
 - Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
 - Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

The organization is certified in ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015, and ISO 45001: 2018, and maintains a robust QHSE culture focused on zero accidents. Sangreen's vision is to delight the world through sustainable, scalable engineering solutions that foster innovation, empower communities, and positively impact the environment. 

1. JOB DETAILS

Job Title:   Manager - Process Excellence

Department / Business Unit:   Process Excellence / Business Excellence

Location:   Head Office / Project Sites, as required

Employment Type:   Full-time, Permanent

Experience Required:   5 to 7 years of relevant experience

Industry:   EPC / Infrastructure

Travel Requirement:   Travel to project sites and operating locations, as required

2. JOB PURPOSE

The Manager - Process Excellence is responsible for identifying operational problem areas, conducting structured root cause analysis and designing practical solutions that improve process effectiveness across the  organisation. The role facilitates development and implementation of operational processes at the Head Office and project sites, secures stakeholder alignment, monitors compliance, conducts regular audits and supports long-term process sustenance. 

3. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Problem Identification & Root Cause Analysis

•  Identify operational problem areas and opportunities for process improvement across functions and project locations. 

•  Conduct structured root cause analysis and define clear problem statements. 

•  Evaluate process gaps, recurring issues and barriers affecting operational flow and execution. 

Solution Design & Stakeholder Alignment

•  Design practical process solutions based on the identified problem statement and root causes. 

•  Develop detailed solution elements, operating requirements and implementation actions. 

•  Obtain buy-in from key stakeholders and align affected teams on the proposed solution. 

•  Coordinate with operational teams to incorporate functional and site-level inputs into process design. 

Process Development & Implementation

•  Facilitate the development of operational processes with inputs from relevant operational teams. 

•  Guide the establishment and implementation of processes at the Head Office and project sites. 

•  Define appropriate issue-escalation mechanisms to support timely resolution at the required  organisational  level. 

•  Support the transition of approved solutions into regular operating practices. 

Governance & Leadership Reviews

•  Conduct fortnightly and monthly steering committee meetings with leadership. 

•  Present initiative status, key issues, risks, decisions required and implementation progress. 

•  Align  organisational  efforts and stakeholder actions towards approved process-excellence initiatives. 

•  Track agreed actions and facilitate timely follow-up and closure. 

Process Compliance & Sustenance

•  Ensure compliance with agreed processes by relevant stakeholders. 

•  Understand flow-management principles and solutions developed for different business verticals. 

•  Conduct regular audits to reinforce approved systems and processes. 

•  Act as the custodian of agreed solution elements and process standards across the  organisation. 

•  Guide teams in sustaining implemented processes and addressing deviations. 

Continuous Improvement

•  Propose and deploy solutions to improve existing operational processes. 

•  Promote improvements that increase operational flow and strengthen process effectiveness. 

•  Use audit findings, stakeholder feedback and operating issues to identify further improvement opportunities. 

4. KEY RESULT AREAS / PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

•  Timely identification and structured analysis of operational problems and process gaps. 

•  Quality, practicality and stakeholder acceptance of proposed process solutions. 

•  Timely establishment and implementation of approved processes at the Head Office and project sites.

data.title: QA/QC ENGINEER LECTRONICS
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

We are looking for a passionate QA/QC Engineer - Electronics to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware. 

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Quality Assurance Leadership: Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices. 
 - Design Phase Integration: Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design. 
 - Reliability & Circuit Analysis: Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities. 
 - AIT & Environmental Compliance: Review and validate environmental qualification test results-including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing-and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP). 
 - Audit & Configuration Control: Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control. 
 - Non-Conformance Management: Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems. 
 - Standards & Compliance: Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles. 
 - Technical Expertise: Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills. 
 - Methodologies: Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks. 
 - Core Competencies: Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes. 
 - Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices. 
 - Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads. 
 - Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt). 

WHY JOIN US?

- Pioneering Impact: Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit. 
 - End-to-End Exposure: Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness. 
 - Innovation Culture: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment. 
 - Career Growth: Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Automation Engineer - Python based in India.

You will design, develop, and execute automated and manual testing strategies to identify defects early and deliver dependable software solutions. Working closely with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders, you will validate application functionality, test APIs and web applications, and strengthen overall test coverage. You will use Python and Pytest to build and maintain automated test suites while applying your knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, and software development lifecycles. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to continuous quality improvement within a collaborative, technology-driven environment. You will also help optimize testing processes, communicate quality risks, and ensure that software releases meet established functional and technical standards. 

Accountabilities

- Test Planning and Strategy: Analyze business and technical requirements to define test scenarios, prepare test plans, establish testing strategies, and determine appropriate testing coverage. 
 - Test Automation: Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Python and Pytest to validate application functionality, reliability, and expected behavior. 
 - Manual and Functional Testing: Perform manual, functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing to identify defects and verify that applications meet specified requirements. 
 - API Testing: Test REST APIs and backend services to validate endpoints, request and response structures, data integrity, error handling, and integration behavior. 
 - Web Application Testing: Validate web application workflows, user interactions, business logic, and cross-component functionality to ensure a consistent and reliable user experience. 
 - Database Validation: Write and execute SQL queries to verify database records, validate data consistency, and investigate discrepancies between expected and actual results. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects with clear steps, supporting evidence, and expected versus actual outcomes; collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolution. 
 - Regression Testing: Build and maintain reusable regression test suites, verify bug fixes, and ensure that new features and code changes do not negatively affect existing functionality. 
 - QA Documentation and Reporting: Maintain comprehensive test cases, test plans, test strategies, execution reports, defect logs, and quality documentation. 
 - SDLC/STLC Compliance: Apply established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) practices throughout the development and release process. 
 - Version Control and Collaboration: Use Git and related development workflows to manage test automation code and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. 
 - Quality Reviews: Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and requirement reviews from a quality assurance perspective, identifying potential risks and recommending improvements. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance automation coverage, testing efficiency, defect prevention, and QA processes through best practices and appropriate tools. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Communicate test results, defect trends, release readiness, quality risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Cross-Functional Delivery: Work closely with developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to support timely releases and ensure that software meets quality expectations. 

Requirements

- At least 4 years of professional experience in quality assurance and test automation, preferably involving Python-based applications and services. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, with mandatory hands-on experience using Pytest for automated testing. 
 - Solid understanding of manual testing, automation testing, functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and test execution methodologies. 
 - Experience preparing and maintaining test cases, test plans, test strategies, test reports, and other QA documentation. 
 - Practical experience testing REST APIs and web applications, including validating API requests, responses, data flows, and error scenarios.

 - Understanding of SDLC and STLC processes, software testing methodologies, defect life cycles, and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Familiarity with Git or other version control systems for managing automation scripts and collaborating with development teams. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and the capacity to identify complex defects and edge cases. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document defects clearly and communicate testing outcomes to stakeholders.

 - Exposure to applications powered by large language models (LLMs), including experience validating AI-generated outputs, response consistency, reliability, and edge cases.

data.title: QA Engineer / Product Operations Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Engineer / Product Operations Engineer based in India. 

As a QA Engineer / Product Operations Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of an innovative digital marketplace powered by artificial intelligence and additive manufacturing technologies. You will combine software testing, product analytics, operational monitoring, and light engineering to improve platform performance and customer experience. Working across customer and supplier applications, you will validate critical workflows, investigate technical issues, and identify opportunities to optimize product functionality. You will also analyze user behavior, build dashboards, and transform product data into actionable insights that support informed decisions. The role offers the opportunity to explore the intersection of software engineering, AI-driven manufacturing, and 3D printing while collaborating closely with technical and product teams. If you enjoy solving problems, working across disciplines, and taking ownership in a fast-paced startup environment, this remote opportunity offers a chance to make a tangible impact on a growing technology platform. 

Accountabilities

- Product Quality Assurance and Testing
 - Test customer-facing and supplier-facing web applications across essential workflows, including registration, authentication, part uploads, file processing, printability analysis, supplier matching, requests for quotation (RFQs), quote submissions, and order management. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute QA checklists, test cases, regression test plans, and validation procedures. 
 - Test applications across different browsers, devices, file formats, and edge cases to identify potential usability and functionality issues. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document, and prioritize software defects, clearly outlining expected versus actual behavior. 
 - Verify bug fixes before release and help maintain product quality as new features are introduced. 
 - Application Monitoring and Reliability
 - Monitor production applications to ensure critical workflows remain operational and perform as expected. 
 - Identify failed file uploads, broken pages, API errors, background job failures, and unusual user activity. 
 - Investigate incidents, document findings, escalate critical issues, and collaborate with engineers on root-cause analysis. 
 - Help maintain platform availability and customer confidence by identifying issues before they significantly affect users. 
 - Develop or maintain internal dashboards, alerts, and monitoring tools to track product health and system reliability. 
 - 3D Printability Review and Manufacturing Support
 - Review customer-uploaded CAD files, technical drawings, PDFs, and part metadata to assess their suitability for additive manufacturing. 
 - Evaluate potential printability risks related to geometry, material selection, dimensions, tolerances, wall thickness, unsupported features, overhangs, small holes, warping, and file quality. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams and manufacturing specialists to improve printability scoring systems and analysis workflows. 
 - Develop internal review checklists and part-classification processes to support consistent and reliable assessments. 
 - Compare automated printability analysis results with human evaluations, identify discrepancies, and recommend improvements to the underlying workflows. 
 - Customer Behavior and Product Insights
 - Analyze platform usage patterns to understand how customers interact with the product and complete key workflows. 
 - Identify onboarding challenges, abandoned processes, unsuccessful uploads, and points where users fail to complete RFQs or other important actions. 
 - Review customer feedback, support tickets, uploaded part data, and usage trends to uncover recurring issues and improvement opportunities. 
 - Translate observations into actionable bug reports, product recommendations, and clear technical requirements. 
 - Help product and engineering teams understand customer needs and distinguish actual user behavior from expected application behavior. 
 - Analytics and Reporting
 - Build and maintain dashboards that track product usage, customer activity, part uploads, RFQs, supplier responses, conversion funnels, and system errors. 
 - Monitor key performance indicators, including user registrations, active users, upload success and failure rates, file types, printability analysis completion, RFQs submitted, supplier response rates, and customer drop-off points. 
 - Use analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics, PostHog, Mixpanel, Metabase, Looker Studio, Supabase, SQL, or comparable platforms. 
 - Prepare regular product quality and usage reports that help teams monitor performance and prioritize improvements. 
 - Translate data into clear, actionable insights that support product decisions and operational efficiency. 
 - Bug Fixing and Light Engineering
 - Investigate defects across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, and third-party integrations. 
 - Implement small code fixes independently where appropriate and collaborate with engineers to resolve more complex issues. 
 - Improve error handling, application logging, input validation, and user-facing error messages. 
 - Review code changes from a quality assurance, usability, and product reliability perspective. 
 - Contribute to internal tools, scripts, dashboards, and test automation to improve operational efficiency. 
 - Collaborate through version control, code reviews, pull requests, and deployment workflows. 
Requirements

- 2-5 years of professional experience in quality assurance, software testing, technical support engineering, product operations, analytics, software development, or a related field. 
 - Strong experience testing web applications, validating user workflows, identifying edge cases, and documenting reproducible software defects. 
 - Basic full-stack development skills, ideally involving TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node. js, SQL, and REST APIs. 
 - Ability to read and understand application code, debug technical issues, and implement small code fixes independently. 
 - Familiarity with browser developer tools, application logs, network requests, API debugging, and database investigation. 
 - Experience with product analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics, PostHog, Mixpanel, Metabase, Looker Studio, Supabase, or SQL-based dashboards. 
 - Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, unusual behavior, and potential failure scenarios. 
 - Understanding of software testing practices, regression testing, defect tracking, and release validation. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically and recommend practical solutions. 
 - Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear bug reports, technical documentation, and product quality summaries. 
 - Ability to work independently, prioritize competing tasks, and escalate technical issues promptly and effectively. 
 - Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment where responsibilities span testing, analytics, technical investigation, and product operations. 
 - Enthusiasm for learning additive manufacturing and 3D printing technologies; prior professional experience in this domain is not mandatory. 

Additional 3D printing and manufacturing knowledge that would be advantageous: 

- Familiarity with CAD and technical drawing formats such as STEP, STL, 3MF, IGES, DXF, DWG, and PDF. 
 - Basic understanding of additive manufacturing processes, including FDM, SLS, MJF, SLA, and metal 3D printing. 
 - Ability to interpret mechanical components, engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and material specifications. 
 - Exposure to slicer software, CAD viewers, mesh repair tools, or 3D printing workflows. 
 - Interest in manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, industrial components, or physical product development. 

Additional Skills That Would Be a Plus

- Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Jest. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring, alerting, and error-tracking tools such as Sentry, Datadog, LogRocket, or New Relic. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms and deployment environments such as AWS, Azure, Render, Vercel, or Supabase. 
 - Knowledge of GitHub, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and software release workflows. 
 - Experience in CAD, mechanical engineering, 3D printing, manufacturing software, or related technical domains. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience building operational or product analytics dashboards. 
 - Previous experience in a startup or small engineering team with broad responsibilities and rapidly evolving priorities. 

Benefits

- Fully remote work arrangement, offering the flexibility to work from India. 
 - Full-time employment with the opportunity to contribute to an innovative AI-powered manufacturing marketplace. 
 - Exposure to emerging technologies at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, product analytics, and additive manufacturing. 
 - Opportunities to develop a diverse skill set across QA testing, product operations, application monitoring, analytics, and light software development. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern development frameworks, cloud platforms, monitoring tools, and product analytics technologies. 
 - Opportunities to influence product quality, customer experience, and engineering priorities through actionable insights. 
 - Exposure to practical 3D printing and manufacturing workflows, including CAD file processing, printability analysis, and supplier matching. 
 - A dynamic, fast-moving environment that encourages initiative, independent problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Opportunities to contribute directly to product improvements and help shape processes as the platform evolves. 
 - Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, bonuses, and other employment benefits: Specific details were not provided in the original job description and can be clarified during the recruitment process. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an SMTS (Backend Engineer) based in India. 

As an SMTS (Backend Engineer), you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of cloud-native software products that power modern private cloud infrastructure. You will work on innovative technologies that help enterprises simplify IT operations and transform existing hardware into scalable, reliable, and future-ready cloud environments. Collaborating with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams, you will help shape product roadmaps, develop robust backend services, and solve complex infrastructure challenges. You will play an important role in improving system performance, scalability, and reliability while supporting deployments and troubleshooting production issues. This position offers the opportunity to work with cloud-native architectures, virtualization technologies, and modern infrastructure platforms in a dynamic, data-driven environment. If you enjoy solving challenging engineering problems, taking ownership of your work, and continuously learning new technologies, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful technical impact. 

Accountabilities

- Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of cloud-native products, backend services, and infrastructure software. 
 - Collaborate with engineering team members and relevant stakeholders to define technical solutions and implement product roadmap initiatives. 
 - Develop reliable, efficient, and maintainable software using programming languages such as Python or Golang. 
 - Support cloud infrastructure deployments using private cloud products, diagnosing technical issues and implementing effective solutions. 
 - Monitor and continuously improve product performance, scalability, availability, and overall system reliability. 
 - Investigate complex backend and infrastructure problems, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement long-term corrective measures. 
 - Work with Linux/Unix systems, networking technologies, storage infrastructure, and virtualization environments to develop and optimize cloud-native solutions.

 - Take ownership of assigned projects and technical deliverables, ensuring solutions align with product requirements, quality standards, and business objectives. 

Requirements

- A bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5-8 years of professional experience in software development, backend engineering, or a related engineering role. 
 - Proficiency in Python or Golang, with the ability to develop, debug, and maintain production-quality software. 
 - Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems, including system-level troubleshooting and performance analysis. 
 - Experience or solid technical exposure to networking protocols, networking infrastructure, or storage systems. 
 - Understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, virtualization technologies, and infrastructure software. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to investigate and resolve complex technical challenges. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams. 
 - A proactive, self-motivated approach, adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies. 
 - A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality software in a data-driven organization. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes, or cloud platforms and development environments such as OpenStack and DevStack, is an advantage. 
 - Experience with the Linux networking stack, identity and access management (IAM), kernel modules, or device drivers is a plus. 

Benefits

- Remote work opportunity, with preferred locations including Bengaluru, Pune, Noida, and Hyderabad, India. 
 - Full-time employment offering the opportunity to contribute to impactful cloud infrastructure products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native technologies, private cloud platforms, virtualization, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Opportunities to tackle challenging backend engineering problems and contribute to the evolution of enterprise infrastructure solutions. 
 - Collaboration with experienced engineering professionals in a technically driven and innovative environment. 
 - Opportunities for continuous learning, technical development, and exposure to emerging technologies. 
 - The opportunity to take ownership of engineering initiatives and influence product performance, scalability, and reliability.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world's largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo's automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700, 000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. 
 - Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering. 
 - Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions. 
 - Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners. 
 - Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: 

- This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager

RingCX is RingCentral's next-generation AI-powered Contact Center solution, designed to deliver seamless, intelligent, and personalized customer experiences across digital and voice channels. Join us in shaping the future of customer engagement - where speed, empathy, and intelligence converge. Be part of a team that's redefining how the world connects. 

We're currently looking for: Senior Engineering Manager This role will play a critical leadership role in driving RingCX's Analytics roadmap, modernizing our analytics stack, ensuring KPI integrity, and building long-term analytics ownership in India. 

To succeed in this role you must have experience in the following: 

- Hands-on experience in Java designing and operating ETL pipelines using tools such as Airflow, Spark, Apache Beam, or AWS Glue.

data.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Lead Software Engineer to join the Air Traffic Business to support the design, development, integration and delivery of modern software solutions at the integration center in Pune, India. This role is ideal for a well-rounded software developer who brings strong traditional software engineering fundamentals along with experience or interest in developing and integrating AI-enabled capabilities. 

The Lead Software Engineer will serve as a technical leader and work as part of an Agile development team to build scalable, secure, and reliable applications while leveraging modern development practices, cloud technologies, automation, and emerging artificial intelligence tools and frameworks. The Software Engineer will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to delivery predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety critical environment. The candidate will work on software that directly supports air traffic operations, applying AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and enhance system reliability. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of a team, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining source code within an Agile environment. 
 - Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, product owners, and other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into working software. 
 - Work within Agile/Scrum development environments and participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions. 
 - Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and services. 
 - Develop software using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, C#, or similar technologies. 
 - Develop automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality and reliability. 
 - Utilize modern DevOps and CI/CD practices to automate software builds, testing, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Troubleshoot complex software issues and continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and performance

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline with relevant professional software development experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience or a Master's Degree and 6+ years of relevant experience
 - Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to effectively collaborate with team members and present reports and status. 
 - Professional experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#. 
 - Experience with object-oriented programming, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and source control tools such as Git. 
 - Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, or distributed applications. 
 - Experience with modern software development methodologies and the SDLC. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases. 
 - Understanding of cloud-based application development using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Exposure to or experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application development. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in the aviation industry or a similar high-tech field is a plus. 
 - Experience with large-scale distributed systems
 - Experience working with safety critical or high availability software
 - Experience integrating with legacy systems
 - Experience reading and understanding large existing codebases
 - Experience working in a global or multicultural environment is a plus
 - Experience developing cloud-native applications and working with cloud-based AI services. 
 - Experience developing software in highly secure, regulated, mission-critical, or enterprise environments. 

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo - because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 - and moving faster than anyone else dares. 

Original Posting

For U. S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. 

Pay Range

Pay Range -

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. 

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47, 000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16. 7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www. Leidos. com. 

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www. leidos. com/careers/pay-benefits. 

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos' name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i. e. , ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i. e. , send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos. com automated system - never from free commercial services (e. g. , Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e. g. , about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos. com. 

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U. S. Federal Trade Commission. 

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. data.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
data.description:
Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)

About The Role

What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress-test AI-powered applications and infrastructure - identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Conduct penetration tests against AI-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
 - Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
 - Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry-standard tools and methodologies
 - Simulate real-world attack scenarios - from reconnaissance through exploitation and post-exploitation
 - Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
 - Evaluate AI-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
 - Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
 - Work independently on task-based engagements on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK)
 - Proficient with industry-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
 - Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
 - Able to think like an attacker - creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
 - Strong written communication skills - you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
 - Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments

Nice to Have

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
 - Experience with AI/ML security testing - adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red-teaming
 - Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
 - Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
 - Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
 - Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
 - Experience conducting security assessments in compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc. )

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - work when and where it suits you
 - Freelance autonomy with access to high-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
 - Be at the forefront of AI security - a rapidly growing field with massive demand
 - Sharpen your skills against novel AI-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
 - Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

Job Description

Role title: Staff Engineer, Data Platform

Salary range: $130, 000 - $180, 000 USD

Location: Chicago-based Hub or fully r emote

The opportunity

Applied engineers the platforms, data, and intelligent systems moving insurance forward. The work runs in production across agencies and carriers, where quality, speed, reliability, and sound technical judgment matter. In this role, you will lead architecture and technical decision-making across Applied's customer-facing data platform. 

This newly created individual contributor role reports directly to the leader of Data and Analytics and serves as the senior engineering lead across Data Lake, Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization, and Data Science. You will help modernize the platform supporting internal products and customers, raise engineering standards, and remain hands-on when the work calls for it. You will influence how data moves from its source through ingestion, preparation, visualization, and consumption by Applied products, AI solutions, and customers. 

What You'll Own

- Lead architecture and technical decision-making across the end-to-end data lifecycle, from source ingestion and streaming through preparation, visualization, and consumption by products, AI solutions, and customers 
 - Drive modern engineering approaches through proofs of concept, technology evaluation, and reimagining existing solutions when a more scalable or efficient path is available 
 - Improve the scalability, reliability, accuracy, completeness, and observability of data flowing into and through the Data Lake 
 - Guide and contribute to major initiatives, including reducing streaming latency, strengthening observability across more than 4, 000 agency GCP projects, and modernizing database architecture away from SQL Server 
 - Partner with Software Engineering, Data Engineering, BI Engineering, Data Science, product teams, and senior leadership to resolve difficult technical problems and align teams around sound platform decisions 
 - Remain hands-on by designing, prototyping, troubleshooting, reviewing code, and contributing directly to implementation when needed 
 - Mentor engineers and build a culture of strong software engineering practices, experimentation, platform thinking, AI-enabled work, and shared technical ownership

What You'll Bring

- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of strong technical impact 
 - Deep data-focused software engineering experience, with the ability to reason across ingestion, streaming, storage, transformation, visualization, and consumption 
 - Strong cloud data platform experience in Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure, including architecture and production problem-solving at scale 
 - Experience designing or operating data lake and streaming systems, with practical knowledge of data accuracy, stability, availability, and performance 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the software development lifecycle, source control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and production operations 
 - Hands-on programming experience with Python, Go, or comparable languages, plus strong SQL and data architecture fundamentals 
 - A track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams without direct reporting authority while balancing strategic guidance with direct technical contribution 
 - Experience leading complex platform design or migration decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly to technical and business stakeholders, or equivalent practical experience

What Could Set You Apart

- Production experience with GCP technologies such as BigQuery , Dataflow or Apache Beam, Pub/Sub, AlloyDB or Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, and Redis 
 - Experience with change data capture tooling such as Debezium or an equivalent technology 
 - Experience applying AI or machine learning within data platforms or using AI and automation to accelerate engineering work 
 - Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS data platforms, particularly in insurance or another regulated industry 
 - A record of modernizing legacy systems, leading low-disruption migrations, and creating engineering standards that teams adopt 
 - An entrepreneurial approach that includes testing ideas, building proofs of concept, questioning existing assumptions, and starting fresh when the outcome justifies it

Your background may bring strengths we have not listed here. If the role and its impact interest you, we encourage you to apply. 

Build a career that moves an industry

Applied is the connective intelligence transforming how insurance works. We build the platforms , data, and intelligent systems that connect agencies and carriers across the insurance lifecycle. 

Here, careers move with the work . You can own meaningful decisions, build what reaches the market, expand your scope as the business evolves, and work alongside people who bring expertise , curiosity, and care to what they create. 

What You Can Expect

- Work with reach: Build products, services, or programs that support agencies, carriers, and teammates across the insurance lifecycle . 
 - Ownership with context: Make decisions with a clear view of customer needs, business priorities, and the teammates who bring the work to market . 
 - Growth through scope: Expand your impact through meaningful projects, cross-functional exposure, learning opportunities, and stretch work as the business evolves . 
 - Built by people: Work with people who bring expertise , curiosity, and care to what they build, and who share accountability for moving the work forward . 

Benefits And Support

Our benefits support your health, time, and life beyond work. 

NORTH AMERICA

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
 - Holiday and vacation time 
 - Health and wellness days 
 - A day off for your birthday

Compensation Transparency

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $130, 000 - $180, 000 USD. Starting pay reflects the role's scope and the successful candidate's relevant experience, skills, and location.

In this position, you will serve as a DevSecOps Scrum Master, guiding Agile/SAFe processes while actively contributing to the design, development, and implementation of software solutions. You will foster effective collaboration across cross-functional teams and partner closely with the Product Owner, Systems Engineers, and development teams to align priorities and drive successful delivery.  - Provide timely status, risk, and dependency reporting to the Release Lead and management, including sprint execution, team availability, and issues impacting delivery. 
 - Design, develop, document, configure, test, and debug applications and frameworks across the full software development life cycle, serving as a key contributor to system enhancements and new features. 
 - Assist with deployment, diagnosis, and resolution of critical issues in lab and operational systems as required. 
 - Collaborate with and mentor junior team members to meet sprint commitments and project milestones. 
 - Communicate effectively with cross-functional internal teams, stakeholders, and, when necessary, external partners to ensure alignment and successful delivery.

data.title: Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems) based in India. 

We are seeking a technically minded specialist to support, test, and improve a radio communications application used in a professional telecommunications environment. In this role, you will combine application support, system and integration testing, JavaScript scripting, and defect management to ensure reliable application performance. You will help users resolve technical issues, maintain system rules and models, and contribute to continuous product improvement. Working within a small, established Agile team, you will collaborate with colleagues to identify issues, enhance functionality, and strengthen software quality. This remote contract opportunity is well suited to someone who enjoys troubleshooting, communicating with users, and developing their technical skills in radio systems and cloud-based testing. 

Accountabilities

- Application Support: Provide timely technical assistance to users, investigate application issues, guide users through troubleshooting steps, and deliver application training when needed. 
 - Integration and System Testing: Plan and execute comprehensive integration and system tests in cloud environments to validate application functionality, reliability, and performance. 
 - Defect Tracking and Resolution: Identify, document, track, and manage software defects using Jira, collaborating with the team to investigate issues and verify fixes. 
 - JavaScript Scripting and System Configuration: Develop and maintain Radio Online (ROL) system rules and models using JavaScript, including variables, loops, functions, and related scripting techniques. 
 - Agile Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members in an established Agile environment to refine application functionality, prioritize issues, and support iterative improvements. 
 - Application Quality and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to testing practices, troubleshoot recurring issues, and recommend improvements to application stability, usability, and support processes. 
 - Technical Learning and Development: Participate in advanced JavaScript training and specialized workshops covering ROL testing methods, continuous integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - User Communication: Explain technical concepts and troubleshooting procedures clearly, helping users understand solutions and use the application effectively. 

Requirements

- Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in engineering or a technical discipline, together with at least three years of engineering, IT, or technical experience; alternatively, five or more years of relevant engineering, IT, or technical experience. 
 - Application Support: Experience or demonstrated capability in technical troubleshooting, application support, and helping users resolve software-related issues. 
 - Testing and Quality Assurance: Understanding of integration testing and system testing, ideally with experience validating applications in cloud-based environments. 
 - JavaScript Fundamentals: Familiarity with JavaScript or the ability to develop scripting skills involving variables, loops, functions, and system logic. 
 - Defect Management Tools: Ability to document and track defects systematically; experience with Jira is valuable. 
 - Agile Collaboration: Willingness to work within an Agile team, collaborate on application improvements, and contribute to structured development and testing workflows. 
 - Communication Skills: Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical steps in straightforward language and support users with patience, empathy, and professionalism. 
 - Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: A methodical approach to investigating issues, identifying root causes, validating fixes, and improving application reliability. 
 - Preferred Radio Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with digital or analog radio technologies, radio communications systems, or dispatch consoles is an advantage. 
 - Learning Mindset: Motivation to develop expertise in JavaScript, specialized radio application testing, and CI/CD practices. 

Benefits

- Health Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance coverage. 
 - Employee Wellbeing: A wellness program with a focus on mental health. 
 - Recognition and Rewards: Employee recognition initiatives and company incentive programs. 
 - Paid Leave and Time Off: A range of leave options, including holiday, maternity, paternity, birthday, bereavement, and paid personal leave. 
 - Remote Work: Remote working opportunities for greater flexibility. 
 - Work-Life Balance: A focus on supporting a healthy balance between professional and personal commitments. 
 - Learning and Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development, technical training, and continued learning. 
 - Immigration Support: An immigration program that may support relocation to Canada for eligible employees. 
 - Contract Opportunity: A remote contract position based in India. Specific compensation details and contract duration were not provided in the original job description. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
