data.title: T24 Senior Test Analyst (Perm)
data.description:
As a T24 Senior Test Analyst, you will manage testing deliverables for Temenos Core Banking systems. You will lead test planning, create functional and non‐functional test cases, define automation strategies, and ensure quality delivery across SIT, UAT, and BAU support. 

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Test Planning & Execution

- Manage T24 testing team deliverables and track schedules to meet project timelines. 
 - Create functional and non‐functional test cases based on designs from analysts and developers. 
 - Prepare test data, execute test cases, and report progress with recovery planning if delays occur. 
 - Identify, log, track, and report defects, clarifying issues with analysts and developers. 
 - Define automation and performance test strategies. 
 - Support user acceptance testing (UAT). 
 - Provide BAU support for branches including troubleshooting and QA. 

Collaboration & Governance

- Liaise with IT and business partners to ensure test coverage. 
 - Collaborate across teams to align testing with project objectives. 
 - Ensure timely communication of progress, risks, and issues. 

We'd Love to Hear From You If. . . 

Experience

- You have 4-6+ years of experience testing Temenos Core Banking (T24). 
 - You have knowledge of T24 retail/corporate banking modules including Accounts, Funds Transfer, Teller, FX, Money Market, Loans and Deposits, SWIFT, reporting, Letters of Credit, General Ledger, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Miscellaneous Deals, and Non‐Stop modules. 
 - You have team management experience. 
 - You have experience in full SDLC (advantageous). 
 - You have experience testing in MUFG or other financial institutions (advantageous). 

Technical Expertise

- You have a bachelor's degree in Computing or a relevant field (e. g. , B. Tech, B. E, MCA). 
 - You have proven skills in developing automation strategies, frameworks, and scripts using Selenium or Playwright. 
 - You have experience with DevOps and defect management tools such as JIRA and Azure DevOps. 
 - You have experience using AI technologies (e. g. , Copilot). 
 - You have Unix/Linux knowledge. 

Ways of Working

- You are proactive, motivated, and results‐driven with strong accountability. 
 - You work effectively under pressure and meet challenging deadlines. 
 - You have strong logic, math, algorithmic, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - You demonstrate independence, teamwork, and urgency in prioritising work. 
 - You have excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. 
 - You have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and accuracy. 
 - You understand controls in a banking environment. 

---

Who We Are

Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan-Asian presence. We focus primarily around technology-driven consulting, adoption of value-added bespoke solutions, enabling enhanced decision support through data analytics, and embracing possibilities in the cloud. We are heavily inclined towards building capabilities collaboratively with clients and believe strongly in improving grounded and practical outcomes. 

This approach is possible through our partnership with leading global technology providers and internal R&D teams. Our clients come from Financial Services, Banking, Telco, Government, Healthcare, and Consumer-oriented organisations.

data.title: Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer based in India. 

Join an innovative cloud security engineering environment where you will help validate and strengthen the security of modern cloud infrastructure and runtime environments. In this role, you will design automated testing frameworks and ensure that advanced security features perform reliably across major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will work with Python, eBPF, Linux kernel technologies, containers, and Kubernetes to test security capabilities and identify complex technical issues. Collaborating closely with software and kernel engineers, you will investigate runtime behaviour, reproduce challenging issues, and improve the quality and reliability of security solutions. You will also contribute to continuous integration pipelines that enable faster, more consistent validation of new features. This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious engineer who enjoys automation, cloud-native technologies, and solving complex security challenges in a fast-evolving engineering environment. 

Accountabilities

- Cloud security validation: Design, implement, and maintain automated validation strategies for cloud security features and runtime protection capabilities. Ensure that security functionality performs as expected across different cloud environments and deployment configurations. 
 - Python test automation: Develop and maintain Python-based testing frameworks using tools such as pytest. Create reusable test cases, validate REST APIs, process JSON and YAML configurations, and automate repetitive validation tasks to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - eBPF and runtime observability testing: Build and maintain test hooks and validation frameworks for eBPF-based capabilities. Work with kernel-level observability mechanisms to verify runtime security functionality and help ensure accurate detection of relevant system and application behaviour. 
 - Multi-cloud environment management: Configure, deploy, and test security sensors and agents across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Validate feature behaviour under different infrastructure configurations and investigate platform-specific issues. 
 - Linux kernel investigation: Collaborate with kernel engineers to reproduce, investigate, and debug runtime security issues. Analyse relevant Linux kernel behaviour, system calls, namespaces, and control groups to identify root causes and support effective fixes. 
 - Continuous integration and automated pipelines: Integrate automated security validation into CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Improve test execution reliability, provide timely feedback on code changes, and help detect regressions early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Container and Kubernetes testing: Validate security functionality across Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, pods, and related cloud-native environments. Investigate issues involving container isolation, runtime behaviour, and infrastructure configuration. 
 - Infrastructure automation and observability: Use tools such as Terraform to provision and manage test environments. Leverage monitoring and visualisation tools such as Grafana to support troubleshooting, test analysis, and performance investigation. 
 - Serverless container validation: Test security capabilities in serverless container environments, including AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run, ensuring consistent behaviour across different deployment models. 
 - Cross-functional engineering collaboration: Work closely with security, platform, and kernel engineering teams to understand technical requirements, improve test coverage, investigate defects, and strengthen the quality and reliability of cloud security features. 
 - Continuous improvement: Identify gaps in existing validation processes, improve test frameworks and automation practices, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of cloud security testing methodologies and engineering standards. 

Requirements

- Cloud engineering experience: Hands-on experience configuring and working with at least one major cloud platform, with practical familiarity across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The ability to deploy infrastructure, configure cloud services, and troubleshoot cloud-based environments is important. 
 - Python automation expertise: Strong Python programming and test automation skills, including experience with pytest, REST API testing, and structured data formats such as JSON and YAML. You should be able to develop maintainable automation frameworks and reusable validation components. 
 - Linux internals: Familiarity with Linux kernel concepts, including system calls, namespaces, control groups (cgroups), and kernel modules. The ability to investigate low-level system behaviour and troubleshoot runtime issues is highly valuable. 
 - eBPF knowledge: Experience with eBPF technologies and kernel-level observability is highly desirable. An understanding of how eBPF-based instrumentation operates and how to validate its behaviour will be a strong advantage. 
 - Containerisation and orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, and pods. You should understand containerised application environments and be comfortable testing security functionality across cloud-native deployments. 
 - Infrastructure as code and monitoring: Practical familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and Grafana for monitoring and visualisation. Experience creating repeatable test environments and analysing system behaviour is beneficial. 
 - CI/CD and test integration: Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable tools. Understanding test automation, regression detection, and pipeline reliability is important. 
 - Serverless technologies: Exposure to serverless container platforms such as AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run is an advantage, particularly when validating security behaviour across different execution environments. 
 - Analytical and debugging skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a structured approach to investigating complex technical issues. You should be able to reproduce failures, identify potential root causes, and collaborate with engineers to validate fixes. 
 - Communication and teamwork: Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams, explain technical findings clearly, document test results, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Engineering mindset: A proactive, quality-focused approach to software validation, with an interest in cloud security, runtime protection, automation, and emerging infrastructure technologies. 

Benefits

- Full-time employment opportunity based in India. 
 - Opportunity to work on advanced cloud security and runtime protection technologies. 
 - Exposure to major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern technologies such as Python, eBPF, Linux kernel internals, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Opportunity to collaborate with experienced security, platform, and kernel engineers on complex technical challenges. 
 - Scope to influence automated testing frameworks, validation strategies, and the reliability of security products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native, containerised, and serverless infrastructure environments. 
 - Opportunities to deepen technical expertise in cloud security engineering, runtime observability, and test automation. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. data.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Operator
data.description:
HiveWatch is a tech-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we're solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we're building. 

HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less "noise", we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe. 

The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our App Experience team. You'll design, build, and ship AI-powered features in the intelligence layer of our platform: the agents that triage alarms, assess incidents, and recommend or take action the way an experienced security operator would. That means composing frontier models (language, vision, audio) with our own data, tooling, and retrieval into production-grade agent workflows, and working across the full stack to do it, from model orchestration in our Kotlin / Spring Boot / Python services to the React/TypeScript surfaces where operators see and act on the results. 

You'll own the evaluation loop for what you build. You'll define what "correct" means for an agent decision, build the eval sets and harnesses to measure it, and use those results to drive changes to prompts, tools, and architecture. To get there, you'll dig into real customer data, including alarm streams, video, access control events, and operator actions, to form and test hypotheses about where agents get things right, where they drift from human judgment, and why. You'll build the guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and observability that let us trust agents with higher-stakes decisions over time, and that let customers understand why an agent did what it did. 

You'll prototype quickly to learn what works, then harden the winners into reliable, cost-aware features. You'll partner closely with our product team and in-house security operations experts to turn operator intuition into something an agent can act on and to find the next problem worth automating. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build agentic product features that assess security scenarios and make decisions human security operators make today, such as whether to triage, escalate, dismiss, or dispatch. 
 - Form hypotheses about our data, then validate them: query production datasets, analyze results, and turn findings into product and model decisions
 - Orchestrate calls to both self-hosted inference models and frontier models, including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, routing across models, and cost/latency tradeoffs
 - Ship end-to-end features: Python for LLM/inference orchestration and analysis, and our Kotlin / Spring Boot / GraphQL backend to integrate agent capabilities into the platform
 - Work with product, customers, and security operations experts to encode operator judgment into agent behavior
 - Reliably deliver features and services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and modern service delivery practices
 - Mentor junior engineers and drive technical decisions that influence the team's architecture and development practices
 - Support production systems through incident response, troubleshooting, and break-fix activities to maintain service reliability and customer trust
 - Participate in a 24/7 on call rotation approximately 1 week per month as needed. 

Our Tech Stack

- Languages: Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, and Rust
 - Deployments: GitHub Actions, Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm
 - Infrastructure: AWS (Kinesis, Serverless, RDS, EKS), Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3 years in senior roles
 - Strong experience with at least one compiled, object oriented programming language such as Rust, Kotlin, Java, C#, or C++
 - Strong proficiency with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query tuning
 - Experience building full-stack applications in microservice architectures
 - Demonstrated ability to work hypothesis-first with data: framing questions, writing the SQL or analysis code to answer them, and drawing sound conclusions
 - Experience with modern cloud services and cloud-native development
 - Experience with containerization using Docker and deploying applications to Kubernetes
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows
 - Experience using monitoring tools to measure and alert on performance and reliability issues
 - Experience with and enthusiasm for AI native software development practices
 - Strong system design skills and experience with distributed, high-scale applications
 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work in agile environments
 - Data-driven individual who will use metrics to influence decision making

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong experience with AWS
 - Experience designing evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing for agent behavior
 - Experience with real-time or event-driven data (Kinesis, Kafka, or similar)
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code
 - Background in security technology or enterprise software
 - Experience with observability tools and performance optimization
 - Startup experience and/or early-stage SaaS experience

Additional Info

- Salary range for this position: $160, 000 - $200, 000 per year
 - Eligible to participate in HiveWatch Equity Incentive Plan
 - Final offer will be at the company's sole discretion and determined by multiple factors, including years and depth of relevant experience and expertise, location, and other business considerations. 

Benefits & Culture

At HiveWatch, we're passionate about taking care of our people - and it shows in the benefits we offer. Our team enjoys: 

- Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
 - Cutting-edge work in an emerging field with huge growth potential
 - Competitive compensation packages designed to reward top talent
 - A modern, newly renovated HQ right on Main Street in El Segundo, CA
 - 401(k) with a 4% company match to help you invest in your future
 - Flexible paid time off so you can recharge when you need it
 - A family-friendly, compassionate culture that values balance and belonging

We encourage you to challenge the status quo, share your perspective, and leave fear at the (access-controlled) door. 

Our EEO Statement

HiveWatch is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to cultivating a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. We execute our hiring practices so that they are merit-based and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, ancestry, military or veteran status, or other protected characteristic.

data.description:
Description

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon. com. 

WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to 'making zero happen' to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill "the 3 Zeros". We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. 

Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus. 

As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements. 

We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence. 

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different.  - Experience leading technical projects or system architecture reviews. 
 - Experience collaborating with global engineering organizations.

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. 4. Salesforce Architecture & Quality·            Own architecture quality and standards, reviewing data models, security/sharing, scalability, governor limits, integrations, platform performance, and design tradeoffs. 

·            Guide appropriate choices between configuration and customization; ensure Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, event-driven and asynchronous patterns are fit for purpose. 

·            Enforce peer reviews, unit and regression testing, CI/CD, source control, environment management, and release quality gates. 

·            Lead defect root-cause reviews, reduce rework and technical debt, and promote reusable architecture patterns and engineering accelerators. 

·            Provide technical judgment on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and, where relevant, Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce.

·            Work with Finance and Program Delivery to monitor margin performance, effort variance, productivity, and corrective measures. 

·            Forecast demand for Salesforce skills and align technical staffing to pipeline and delivery commitments.

·            Mentor technical managers and leads; establish regular coaching, meaningful 1: 1s, performance feedback, succession plans, and collaborative engineering practices. 

·            Build a high-performing, accountable culture with strong technical ownership, merit-based recognition, continuous learning, and innovation. 

7. Salesforce Capability Development & Innovation·            Establish domain-specific architecture patterns, reference solutions, internal training, certification priorities, and reusable implementation assets. 

·            Develop capabilities in Agentforce and Salesforce AI, AI-assisted development and testing, and integrations with Python, AI services, cloud, and data platforms. 

·            Collaborate with AI/Data and Cloud Technical Delivery Directors on cross-technology solutions. 

8. Client Engagement & Escalations·            Serve as senior technical counterpart for Salesforce clients, clearly presenting architecture tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recovery plans. 

·            Own critical technical escalations and contribute to client trust, delivery acceptance, and account growth. 

Required Qualifications·            12-16+ years in enterprise software engineering and technical delivery, including significant hands-on Salesforce development and solution architecture. 

·            5+ years in Salesforce architecture or senior technical leadership; 4-6+ years managing Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, or sizeable engineering teams. 

·            Demonstrated experience leading multiple enterprise Salesforce projects and organizations of approximately 30-60 technical professionals. 

·            Deep knowledge of Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, Salesforce security/sharing, integration patterns, governor limits, and DevOps/CI-CD. 

·            Proven personal ownership of technical solutioning, enterprise RFPs, architecture selection, estimates, staffing plans, implementation feasibility, and delivery handover. 

·            Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud; strong ability to challenge designs, engineering estimates, and technical decisions. 

·            Accountability for technical effort budgets, quality metrics, engineering capacity, client escalations, and manager development. 

·            Excellent communication with U. S. enterprise stakeholders; ability to work on-site in Noida every working day during core business hours. 

·            Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Technical Architect (CTA), or related advanced credentials

Preferred / Nice-to-Have·            Health Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, and/or Agentforce experience. 

·            Salesforce-native ISV packaging, managed packages, and OEM product architecture. 

·            Complex integration, data migration, AI/GenAI, Python, Azure/AWS, or cloud data-platform experience. 

·            Track record of rescuing troubled projects, building engineering practices, and attracting mid- and senior-level Salesforce talent. 

Key Performance Indicators

Area/ Measures

Technical solutioning / Solution quality, architecture feasibility, technical win support, post-kickoff design changes, estimation accuracy

Delivery predictability / On-time milestones, forecast and schedule variance, delivery acceptance

Engineering quality / Escaped defects, rework, test automation, architecture compliance, technical debt

Economics/ Engineering effort variance, project margin, utilization, capacity accuracy

Leadership and hiring/ Manager effectiveness, critical hiring, coaching, capability growth and retention

Client outcomes/ Escalation trends, recovery effectiveness, satisfaction and acceptance

First 180 DaysDays 1-30 | Assess & Baseline·            Assess assigned Salesforce portfolio, solution architecture, technical skills, current estimates, delivery health, and quality problems. 

·            Establish KPI baselines and identify critical manager, staffing, and technical risks. 

Days 31-90 | Establish Governance·            Implement weekly technical portfolio reviews, solutioning approval and pre-sales handover checks, architecture reviews, estimation standards, and quality gates. 

·            Begin coaching managers, correcting high-risk projects, and recruiting critical roles. 

Days 91-180 | Demonstrate Results·            Improve estimation accuracy, solution quality, milestone reliability, engineering productivity, and defect prevention. 

·            Strengthen managerial ownership, fill approved critical technical roles, and present a Salesforce engineering capability roadmap. 

Ideal CandidateA hands-on Salesforce engineering and architecture leader who has progressed into portfolio delivery leadership, can own solutions from initial client discovery through successful production delivery, can challenge estimates and architecture, and can build a self-sufficient technical management organization.

data.title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
data.description:
Description

Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?

DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions - interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that. 

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights. 

This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide. 

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
 - You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
 - You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
 - Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
 - Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
 - Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
 - Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
 - Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
 - Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language
 - Define and track success metrics including signal to surface latency, configuration deployment time, incident context assembly time, and signal launch velocity
 - Operate with two core principles: Zero Gravity (collapse dependencies into a single orchestrator) and Zero Friction (remove barriers between insight and action)

A day in the life

You will lead a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve reviewing architectural designs for the governed data layer, partnering with upstream platform teams on signal integration, unblocking your engineers on the unified configuration layer, and reviewing predictive model outputs from your data scientists. You will regularly engage with stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, accountability, and legal teams to understand their pain points and translate those into platform capabilities. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands on technical leadership, ensuring your team delivers operationally stable, scalable solutions across multiple countries. 

About The Team

DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely. 

We operate at the intersection of data engineering, applied science, and product development, serving stakeholders from investigators to insurance to DSP owners themselves. We're building from the ground up with a strong vision, executive sponsorship, and the freedom to innovate across the full stack, from governed data pipelines to AI powered agentic experiences. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 3+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. data.title: Lead Engineer/ Architect (.NET) - Finance Group
data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

About Embrace Finance Group

Embrace Finance Group, the financial-services division of Embrace Software Inc. , helps every institution - from regional banks to local credit unions - deliver the speed, intelligence and experience customers now expect in a digital world. Today we serve nearly 450 financial institutions and hundreds of local government agencies. 

We are building an AI-led unified financial services platform spanning digital banking, document automation, item processing and branch modernization, engineered in partnership with the Embrace AI Group. The next generation of our online banking solution is a cornerstone of that platform - and this role will lead it. 

The Role

We are hiring a Lead Engineer/ Architect (. NET), a hands-on technical leader who will accelerate the build-out of the next generation of our online banking platform for US Banks and credit unions on ASP. NET Core and C#. You will spend a significant portion of your time writing production code and owning architecture, while also mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar. 

You will partner day-to-day with Finance Group technology leaders on product and delivery, the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and DevOps standards and Venture Labs / the Embrace AI Group to bring emerging capabilities into the platform. 

At its core this is a forward-deployed engineering (FDE) practice with an AI-first, new-product mandate. You will embed with financial institutions and internal product partners, turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and lead a small team of highly empowered, highly skilled engineers who take ideas from conceptualization to launch in weeks - not quarters. You will go full-stack from modern UX/UI through public REST APIs down to a . NET control plane and treat large language models and agentic AI services as first-class building blocks of the platform rather than bolt-ons. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and hands-on build the new ASP. NET Core / C# online banking platform - system design, service boundaries, data modeling and API contracts. 
 - Design and implement critical features and platform components; lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar. 
 - Lead and mentor a small agile team - run sprints, unblock engineers, own delivery commitments, coach through 1: 1s and pair programming. 
 - Partner with Finance Group technology leaders, product, QA and security to translate business and regulatory needs into robust solutions. 
 - Collaborate with the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and CI/CD standards and with Venture Labs / Embrace AI Group to embed AI capabilities (AI-assisted dev, predictive insights, fraud/risk monitoring) into the platform. 
 - Drive engineering best practices - testing, CI/CD and adoption of modern AI dev tools. 
 - Operate as a forward-deployed engineer - embed with internal product partners to co-design solutions, then rapidly conceptualize, prototype and launch new products, compressing concept-to-production from quarters to weeks. 
 - Lead AI-first, new-product development end-to-end - design and ship LLM- and agent-powered capabilities using services such as Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, with disciplined evaluation, guardrails and cost / latency management. 
 - Build full-stack and real-time - modern, accessible UX/UI, public REST APIs and live experiences via SignalR on . NET Core / C# control plane, with event-driven services through Azure Service Bus / messaging, etc. 
 - Own the cloud and delivery foundation - infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD on GitHub (Actions) and containerized, repeatable deployments across Azure and/or AWS. 
 - Engineer security and compliance in by design - identity and access management (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management and data protection aligned to PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC, with auditability from day one. 
 - Build and empower the team - recruit, coach and unblock a small squad of progressive FDEs, giving them the autonomy, tooling and technical bar to ship safely and fast. 

How We Work - Forward-Deployed & AI-First

- Small, empowered squads: highly skilled FDEs own outcomes end-to-end, from conceptualization to launch, with minimal hand-offs. 
 - AI-first by default: LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows are first-class both as design tools and as product capabilities - we prototype with AI, evaluate rigorously and ship. 
 - Fast and safe: short iteration loops, trunk-based development, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code and progressive delivery behind feature flags. 
 - Polyglot pragmatism: . NET / C# anchors the control plane; we use the best-fit language or service elsewhere and optimize for outcomes, not dogma. 

Our Stack & Tooling

- Control plane & services: . NET (ASP. NET Core, C#), public REST APIs, SignalR for real-time, Azure Service Bus for messaging and eventing. 
 - AI & LLM: Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, LangChain and similar orchestration; vector stores, RAG, plus evaluation and guardrail tooling. 
 - Cloud & platform: Azure and/or AWS, Terraform for IaC, GitHub + GitHub Actions for CI/CD and containers. 
 - Front-end: modern, accessible UX/UI (Angular / React). 
 - Identity, security & compliance: IAM (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management, PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC. 
 - Data: Microsoft SQL Server today, with modern data stores adopted as the platform evolves. 

Requirements

- 5+ years building modern, data-intensive . NET web applications, with a proven tech-lead / lead-developer track record and direct team ownership. 
 - Polyglot. Expert-level C# and . NET (Framework and modern . NET / Core); strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server; solid REST API experience at scale. 
 - Proven experience in financial services / online banking, with strong preference for platforms serving US Banks, credit unions, or other regulated FIs. 
 - Front-end experience with modern Javascript/UI frameworks like Angular / React. Familiarity with classic frameworks like ASP. NET, Razor templates, Htmx, Bootstrap, Orchard Core, etc is a strong plus for modernizing. 
 - Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS), DevOps and CI/CD; understanding of US banking security and compliance (PCI DSS, SOC 2, FFIEC guidance). 
 - Strong communicator across engineering and business stakeholders (Finance Group, Embrace Technology, Venture Labs); excellent ownership and problem-solving. 
 - Comfortable in a highly remote, fast-paced, agile environment. Bachelor's in CS, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - Demonstrated 0→1 product delivery at speed - ideally in a forward-deployed, customer-embedded, or startup / venture environment. 
 - Hands-on AI/LLM application development - prompt and context engineering, RAG and agentic patterns on at least one major platform (Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) with orchestration such as LangChain and a pragmatic grasp of evaluation, guardrails and cost. 
 - Real-time and event-driven experience - SignalR, Azure Service Bus or equivalent messaging - and public REST API design at scale. 
 - Strong platform / DevOps depth - Terraform (IaC), GitHub Actions CI/CD, containerization and multi-cloud (Azure and/or AWS). 
 - Identity, security and compliance depth for regulated FIs - IAM / OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO / MFA, secrets management and PCI DSS / SOC 2 / FFIEC. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience; 100% remote with autonomy. 
 - Career advancement across the Embrace portfolio; the chance to shape a platform used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions with the Embrace AI Group and Venture Labs. 
 - A high-autonomy, AI-first engineering culture where small teams of empowered FDEs take ideas from concept to launch - and see them used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions.

data.title: RF Engineer – Optimization Expert (Nokia/Ericsson | T-Mobile Experience)
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced RF Engineer - Optimization Expert with strong hands-on expertise in Nokia or Ericsson OEM technologies and proven experience supporting T-Mobile projects. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in RF optimization, LTE/5G network performance, and troubleshooting, with the ability to support U. S. -based clients while working from India. 

This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong RF optimization professional who understands T-Mobile network requirements, can analyze network performance, and drive optimization activities to improve coverage, capacity, accessibility, retainability, and mobility. Candidates must have prior T-Mobile project experience, experience working with Nokia or Ericsson equipment, and the ability to join within a maximum notice period of one month. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong experience in RF optimization for LTE and 5G wireless networks. 
 - Mandatory prior experience supporting T-Mobile projects. 
 - Hands-on experience with either Nokia or Ericsson OEM technologies. 
 - Experience analyzing RF performance KPIs, network counters, and performance trends. 
 - Strong knowledge of accessibility, retainability, mobility, throughput, and call-drop optimization. 
 - Experience with drive-test analysis, cluster optimization, and network performance troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to support U. S. -based clients and coordinate with cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Candidates must be based in India and available to join within a maximum of 30 days. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Experience supporting T-Mobile LTE/5G network optimization and performance improvement initiatives. 
 - Strong understanding of 5G NR, LTE, VoLTE, and mobility optimization. 
 - Experience with RF parameter tuning, neighbor optimization, handover optimization, and interference analysis. 
 - Familiarity with tools such as Actix, TEMS, Nemo, and network performance analytics platforms. 
 - Experience working directly with U. S. -based telecom clients and engineering teams. 
 - Experience troubleshooting complex RF issues and recommending corrective actions. 
 - Previous experience working with Nokia or Ericsson OEM teams or projects. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Perform RF optimization activities for T-Mobile LTE and 5G networks. 
 - Analyze network KPIs, performance counters, and drive-test results to identify optimization opportunities. 
 - Troubleshoot coverage, capacity, interference, handover, and accessibility issues. 
 - Optimize RF parameters to improve network performance and customer experience. 
 - Support cluster optimization, network tuning, and performance improvement activities. 
 - Collaborate with U. S. -based clients and cross-functional RF, RAN, and performance engineering teams. 
 - Prepare optimization reports, KPI dashboards, issue summaries, and technical recommendations. 
 - Support network performance reviews and implement corrective actions based on identified issues. 

Tech Breakdown

- 30% RF Performance Analysis and KPI Optimization
 - 25% LTE/5G Network Optimization and Parameter Tuning
 - 20% T-Mobile Network Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution
 - 15% Drive-Test Analysis and Cluster Optimization
 - 10% Client Coordination, Reporting, and Documentation

Daily Responsibilities

- Monitor T-Mobile LTE/5G network performance and analyze key RF KPIs. 
 - Identify performance degradation, coverage gaps, interference, and mobility issues. 
 - Perform RF parameter optimization across Nokia or Ericsson network environments. 
 - Analyze drive-test data, network counters, and performance reports. 
 - Coordinate with U. S. -based client teams to review issues and optimization progress. 
 - Document findings, recommend corrective actions, and track issue resolution. 
 - Provide regular technical updates and optimization reports to stakeholders.

data.title: Senior/Staff Deep Learning Compiler Engineer
data.description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. 

Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21. 

The Opportunity

Quadric is building the world's first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a Deep Learning Compiler Engineer, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads. 

What You'll Do

Deep Learning Compiler Infrastructure & Optimization

- Design, implement, and maintain compiler optimization passes targeting Quadric's processor architecture using frameworks like MLIR, Apache TVM, or LLVM. 
 - Develop lowering pathways from high-level machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) down to optimized low-level kernel code. 
 - Optimize neural network performance for memory throughput, latency, compute unit utilization, and power consumption. 

Neural Network Model Parsing & Graph Transformation

- Implement graph-level optimizations, including operator fusion, layout transformation, quantization (INT8/FP16), and memory allocation strategies.

Preferred

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Product UI and Design)
data.description:
About Lexsi Labs

Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab working toward aligned, interpretable and safe superintelligent systems. Our near-term mission is to build safety-aware autonomous systems for mission-critical settings such as banking, insurance, government and healthcare. We believe the institutions that deploy AI should be able to audit, correct and own the risk of the models they rely on, and we build the research and the platform that make that possible. 

Our research spans AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundation model research across language, structured and tabular data, and autonomous systems. We have published 25+ papers in the past 15 months across conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris and London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behaviour. 

About the Role

We are building the platform through which institutions own the AI they depend on. Post-training, alignment, evaluation, deployment and monitoring run inside the customer's own environment, on the methods our labs publish. 

The people using it vary widely. Post-training scientists and AI researchers run experiments at the edge of what current methods can do. AI and ML engineers take models and agents into production. Data scientists build and validate models on enterprise data. Platform and infrastructure teams operate the compute and services underneath. Inside banks, insurers and public institutions, model risk, validation and audit teams need to understand and sign off on results without writing code, and business owners need to see what is running and how it is performing. The same screen often has to serve a researcher and a risk reviewer. 

The interface decides whether frontier model science stays in research papers or becomes something every institution can operate. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write production React and TypeScript most of the week, own the frontend architecture of the platform, and make the final call on its flows, information architecture and visual design. You will work with a product designer and one or two frontend engineers, setting the standard through code and review rather than management. Expect roughly 70% of your time on building and 30% on design decisions, review and direction. 

What you'll work on

- Own the frontend architecture of a large React and TypeScript application: routing and layout, code splitting, state boundaries, and the contracts between the UI and backend services. 
 - Own the component library and design tokens as a single system used across the application, evolving it incrementally in a live codebase without pausing feature work. 
 - Design and build data-dense interfaces: virtualised tables over large result sets, live metrics and log streams, trace and graph visualisations, side-by-side comparisons, and code and configuration editors. 
 - Build a real-time data layer over SSE and WebSockets with reconnection, backpressure and cache semantics that stay consistent with request-response queries. 
 - Build schema-driven form systems for deeply nested, conditional configuration, validated against backend schemas. 
 - Design interfaces that work for users with very different levels of technical depth, from researchers to risk reviewers, without splitting the product in two. 
 - Make the final call on information architecture, interaction and visual design, and take your decisions from Figma to production yourself. 
 - Set and enforce performance budgets: render profiling, bundle size, and interaction latency on locked-down enterprise machines. 
 - Ship builds that run in restricted and fully offline networks, with reproducible builds, self-hosted assets and no runtime dependence on external hosts. 
 - Meet enterprise requirements in the UI: SSO, role-aware interfaces, auditability, accessibility, and internationalisation including right-to-left layouts. 
 - Raise the engineering bar across the frontend: type safety, testing strategy, tooling and code review. 
 - Work directly with researchers and platform engineers to turn new methods into usable product, often before the method has settled. 

You may be a good fit if you have

- 8+ years building production web applications, including several years as the technical lead on a complex product UI. 
 - Expert-level TypeScript and React, including React 19 rendering and concurrency behaviour and hands-on performance profiling. 
 - Owned the architecture of a large frontend codebase and improved it materially while the team kept shipping. 
 - Led an incremental migration in a live application, such as a component library, state management approach, router or build system. 
 - Built interfaces where performance was the hard problem: tens of thousands of rows, high-frequency streaming updates, large JSON or log payloads, or complex interactive charts. 
 - Deep, practical experience with TanStack Query or equivalent, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form with Zod, Vite and pnpm. 
 - Built or maintained a design system with tokens, theming, accessibility to WCAG standards and documentation in Storybook. 
 - Designed and shipped product yourself, with a portfolio that shows both the decisions you made and the code that implemented them. 
 - Built for multiple user types with different expertise in the same product, and made it work for each of them. 
 - A testing discipline built on Vitest or Jest, Playwright and API mocking. 
 - Worked without a product manager or a full spec, decided what to build, and defended the decision with evidence. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication of trade-offs to engineers, researchers and leadership. 

Strong candidates may also have

- Built developer tools or ML tooling, such as experiment tracking, training dashboards, evaluation or observability products. 
 - Visualisation depth with ECharts, D3, or canvas and WebGL rendering. 
 - Built graph or trace viewers (React Flow or similar) and embedded code editors (CodeMirror or Monaco). 
 - Shipped software into on-premise, regulated or air-gapped environments. 
 - Built right-to-left and multi-locale products. 
 - Used state machines such as XState for complex multi-step flows. 
 - Instrumented frontends with OpenTelemetry and web vitals. 
 - Shipped LLM-powered product features. 
 - Contributed to open-source frontend libraries. If you meet most of this but not all, we would still like to hear from you. 

What this role is not

- Not a people management role at the start. There are no direct reports, and influence comes through code, review and design decisions. 
 - Not a visual design role. You will design, but you will be measured on what ships to production. 
 - Not a ticket-implementation role. You will be expected to question specs and decide what should be built. 

What we expect in the first six months

- Own a set of redesigned core flows end to end, from information architecture through to production. 
 - Establish the component system and tokens as the single source of truth for the application. 
 - Set performance budgets for the heaviest views and bring them within budget. 
 - Put test coverage in place across the core flows. 

How we will evaluate

- A review of shipped work where you can show both the design decisions and the code. 
 - A build exercise on a data-dense screen, assessed on code quality, structure and performance. 
 - A design critique of a flow in our product, where you decide what changes and why. 
 - An architecture conversation on component systems, data and streaming layers, and offline deployment.

The Opportunity

Quadric is building a revolutionary new processor-based SoC architecture. As a Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer, you will join the ground floor of our chip design team, taking technical leadership in architecting and building our SoC-level verification environment from scratch. You will collaborate closely with architects, hardware engineers, and software teams to ensure high quality and complete verification coverage for our next-generation GPNPU-based SoCs. 

What You'll Do

Testbench Architecture & Test Plan Development

- Architect and build novel, scratch-built testbenches for SoC-level verification of our GPNPU-based SoCs. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architects, HW designers, and SW teams to document comprehensive verification test plans. 
 - Implement scalable testbenches using commercial Verification IP (VIP) and/or internal software utilities. 

Test Execution & Verification Coverage

- Develop directed and random drivers, as well as assembly or C++ programs, to efficiently stress-test SoC subsystems and integration. 
 - Verify complex SoC subsystems, including 3rd-party IP (e. g. , NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR). 
 - Leverage VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation environments alongside assembly programming and Python scripting to execute test suites. 
 - Track, analyze, and communicate verification progress across teams using functional and code coverage metrics. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months, you'll: 

- Build out and deploy a fully functional, scratch-built SoC-level UVM verification environment. 
 - Achieve target coverage metrics across all critical SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP blocks. 
 - Establish robust co-simulation pipelines that validate HW/SW execution before tapeout. 

Required

What We're Looking For

- Minimum 5+ years of dedicated design verification experience on complex SoC/ASIC designs. 
 - Deep expertise in UVM methodology and leading SoC-level verification practices. 
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog or Verilog, assembly programming, and scripting languages like Python. 
 - Hands-on experience verifying SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP (e. g. , NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR). 
 - Strong computer architecture background with experience in VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation. 

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: 

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 - Equity with the business
 - Paid Parental Leave
 - PF Retirement Plan
 - Flexible PTO
 - Winter holiday shutdown
 - Catered lunch each day in our office
 - Downtown Pune office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities
 - Collaborative, low-ego culture with significant ownership and impact
 - A work culture focused on innovative disruption

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law

data.title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
data.description:
Company: INNOVERIC

Workplace Type: Remote (Work from Home)

Position: Full-Stack AI Engineer

About the Role

At INNOVERIC, we help companies design, build, and scale intelligent software solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies. 

We're currently hiring an Full-Stack AI Engineer to work on an exciting project focused on building a next-generation AI-powered communication app, bringing intelligent agents, communication channels, and automated workflows together into a unified platform. 

We're looking for a passionate engineer with strong expertise in Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and AI-native software development who enjoys building reliable, scalable, production-ready applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and multi-agent systems. 
 - Build intelligent workflows using LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, or similar frameworks. 
 - Develop agent harnesses, memory management, tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Integrate external services and communication platforms using MCP, A2A, REST APIs, and third-party integrations. 
 - Build scalable backend services and full-stack applications using Python and TypeScript. 
 - Implement agent evaluations, automated testing, monitoring, and observability. 
 - Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate software development while maintaining engineering quality. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions. 

Required Skills & Experience

AI & Agent Engineering

- Hands-on experience with LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of LLM applications, agent orchestration, tool calling, and memory management. 
 - Familiarity with MCP, A2A, REST APIs, and third-party integrations. Software Engineering

- Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript. 
 - Experience with FastAPI, Next. js, React, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with Supabase (PostgreSQL) or other relational databases such as MySQL or SQL Server. 
 - Knowledge of OAuth 2. 0 and authentication systems. Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Scaleway, AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Proficiency with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with unit testing, integration testing, monitoring, and observability. AI-Native Development

- Hands-on experience using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Pi, or similar AI coding agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, agent harness engineering, and modern engineering workflows. What We're Looking For

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and problem-solving abilities. 
 - A builder's mindset with a passion for agentic AI. 
 - Ability to independently design and deliver end-to-end applications. 
 - Experience translating business requirements into reliable software. 
 - Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and modern software engineering practices. 

Why Join Us?

At INNOVERIC, we work on real-world AI applications, from Voice AI and Agentic AI to multi-agent systems, model fine-tuning, and AI-native software engineering. 

But beyond technology, we value people more than technology. We believe great companies are built through trust, genuine human connections, and growing together. 

- Real-world impact: Build AI solutions that solve actual business problems. 
 - People first: We value your ideas, individuality, and contributions beyond your technical skills. 
 - Grow together: As we grow, you grow with us. Your personal and professional growth matters. 
 - No ego, no politics, no games: We believe in transparency, mutual respect, and honest collaboration. 
 - Ownership and opportunity: Take initiative, experiment, make decisions, and grow with the company. No ego. No manipulation. Just meaningful business, genuine human connections, and shared growth. That's the culture we're building at INNOVERIC. 

How to Apply

We want to see what you've built, not just read about it! If you've developed full-stack AI applications, AI agents, or multi-agent systems, we'd love to see your work. 

1. Your CV (Required)

Include your relevant engineering experience and technical projects. 

2. Video Demo of Your Work (Required)

Record a short walkthrough of an AI application or agentic system you've personally developed. Your video should explain: 

- What you built: The problem you're solving and a working demonstration of your application. 
 - How it works: Key features, workflows, and AI capabilities. 
 - System Architecture: Overall architecture, tech stack, and how the components interact. 
 - AI System Design: Agent orchestration, memory, tool calling, data flow, and LLM integration, where applicable. 
 - Engineering Decisions: Architectural choices, trade-offs, and technical challenges you solved. Upload your video to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), Google Drive, or a similar platform and share an accessible link. Please avoid sharing confidential information or proprietary client code. 

3. GitHub Repository (Optional)

Share your GitHub repository or relevant technical documentation, if available. 

How to Submit

- Step 1: Click Easy Apply on this LinkedIn job posting and submit your CV. 
 - Step 2: Email your video demo link to careers@innoveric. com 
 - Email Subject: AI Engineer Application | [Your Full Name] 
 - You may also include your GitHub repository or project documentation in the same email. 

Important: Both your LinkedIn application and video demo are required for your application to be considered complete. 

- A CV tells us about your experience. Your work shows us how you think, design, and build AI systems.

data.title: VP – Engineering & Technical Delivery
data.description:
About Mirketa

Mirketa is a U. S. -headquartered digital transformation, technology consulting, and product engineering company with a delivery center in Noida. We specialize in Salesforce, AI/GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, enterprise integration, and custom application development, and develop products serving healthcare, nonprofits, and other industries. 

Position Overview

We seek a VP - Engineering & Technical Delivery to take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery across client services-from RFPs and solutioning to estimation, staffing, execution, portfolio governance, quality and delivery completion. This hands-on executive will lead Technical Delivery Directors, Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams, while building strong program management capability and an accountable, high-performing culture. 

Mandatory work location: This is a fully on-premises role at the Noida office. Daily physical presence during core business hours is required; hybrid and remote arrangements are not available. 

1. Pre-Sales, RFPs & Solution Estimation

- Own technical responses for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and new business pursuits; partner with U. S. sales and account teams. 
 - Lead architecture, technology selection, delivery approach, implementation strategy, and technical proposal presentations. 
 - Own project sizing, effort estimates, resource plans, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and achievable schedules. 
 - Standardize estimation using historical benchmarks; approve technical estimates and delivery models before commercial commitments. 2. End-to-End Technical Delivery

- Own technical delivery outcomes across client engagements, from design and development through testing, deployment and stabilization. 
 - Lead Technical Delivery Directors and oversee execution through Technology Managers, Architects and Technical Leads. 
 - Ensure projects are properly planned, staffed and executed; resolve technical dependencies, bottlenecks and delivery risks. 
 - Lead technical escalation response and troubled-project recovery; improve execution efficiency and reliability. 3. Portfolio Governance & Program Management

- Lead weekly project and portfolio reviews covering milestones, progress, schedules, effort consumption, budgets, risks, quality and commitments. 
 - Build strong program management practices through a Program Delivery Director, Project Managers and Business Analysts. 
 - Enforce reliable project plans, forecasts, RAID logs, status reporting, change control and corrective action tracking. 
 - Provide executive visibility into project health and ensure proactive risk identification, escalation and resolution. 4. Engineering Quality & Architecture Governance

- Own architecture reviews, technical design approvals, engineering standards, code reviews and delivery quality gates. 
 - Establish effective automated testing, CI/CD, security, performance, release management and defect-prevention practices. 
 - Measure escaped defects, rework, test automation, technical debt and reliability; lead root-cause analyses and corrective actions. 
 - Promote scalable and maintainable designs, reference architectures, and reusable components. 5. Delivery Economics, Resource Planning & Productivity

- Own technical effort budgets, engineering capacity, staffing effectiveness and delivery productivity. 
 - Monitor estimates versus actual effort, utilization, delivery costs and forecasts; partner with Finance on margins. 
 - Improve delivery economics through accurate estimates, skill-based staffing, automation and lower rework. 6. Talent Acquisition, Hiring & Workforce Development

- Own the hiring of technical and program management talent at ALL levels, including junior and mid-level engineers, senior specialists, architects, Technical Leads, Engineering Managers, Project Managers, Business Analysts and Directors. 
 - Personally lead assessment and selection of senior engineering, technical delivery and program management leaders. 
 - Develop workforce plans, competency requirements, interview standards, technical assessments, hiring pipelines and onboarding expectations with HR/Talent Acquisition. 
 - Build hiring pipelines across Salesforce, Python/AI, cloud, data engineering, QA, DevOps and program delivery; evaluate both technical ability and leadership potential. 
 - Use professional networks, referrals and industry relationships to attract strong mid-to-senior technical and program talent, when available. 
 - Improve quality of hire, talent readiness, internal promotions, retention, and succession planning. 7. Leadership Development & Culture

- Lead, coach and develop Technical Delivery Directors, the Program Delivery Director, Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads and program professionals. 
 - Establish clear role accountabilities, performance expectations and manager effectiveness standards. 
 - Partner with HR on individual development plans, regular 1: 1s, mentoring, performance reviews and talent retention. 
 - Build a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture emphasizing merit, ownership, innovation, transparency and continuous learning. 8. Engineering Capability Development & Innovation

- Strengthen Salesforce, Python, AI/GenAI, Azure/AWS, data engineering and enterprise integration competencies. 
 - Build appropriate Centers of Excellence, reusable frameworks, technical training and certification paths. 
 - Drive practical AI-assisted engineering, automated tests and modern practices; develop understanding of agents, RAG, MCP and LLM integration. 
 - Support product engineering with shared architecture standards and engineering best practices. 9. Client Engagement & Escalation Management

- Act as a senior technical executive in strategic client meetings, architecture reviews and critical escalations. 
 - Partner with U. S. stakeholders to align scope, schedules, commitments and technical execution. 
 - Support satisfaction, retention, account growth and technically credible new-business pursuits. 

Required Qualifications

• 18+ years in software engineering, solution architecture and technical delivery, including 7+ years in senior engineering or technical delivery leadership. 

• Prior hands-on engineering and architecture experience; strong Salesforce background preferred, with enterprise integration, cloud and DevOps knowledge. 

• Experience leading approximately 100-300 technical professionals and multiple concurrent complex enterprise programs. 

• Demonstrated accountability for RFPs, pre-sales solutioning, estimates, project portfolio execution, delivery economics and quality. 

• Demonstrated success recruiting technical and program management talent at junior, mid, senior and leadership levels. 

• Proven ability to develop managers, architects, Technical Leads, Project Managers and program delivery leaders. 

• Working knowledge of AI/GenAI, Python, cloud and modern data engineering; strong communication with North American clients. 

• Ability and willingness to work from the Noida office every working day during core hours. 

• Leadership in a mid-sized IT services, Salesforce consulting or digital engineering business. 

• Experience with enterprise SaaS, healthcare technology or AI-enabled solutions. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

• Established professional network and demonstrated ability to bring strong mid-to-senior technical talent-including Directors, Architects, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads and specialist Salesforce, AI, cloud and data engineers-into an organization. 

Key Performanc Metrics for first 180 Days

Days 1-30 - Assess and launch recruitment

• Assess portfolio health, delivery structure, talent, managers, architecture quality, estimation and project risks. 

• Establish delivery and quality baselines and agree accountability, competency requirements and recruitment strategy for three Technical Delivery Directors and one Program Delivery Director. 

Days 31-90 - Establish control and accelerate hiring

• Implement weekly portfolio reviews, architecture governance, sizing practices, project health reporting and performance expectations. 

• Lead sourcing, assessment, interviews and selection for the four Director-level roles; initiate recovery actions on at-risk projects. 

• Meet client stakeholders and create account plan for all key accounts

Days 91-180 - Deliver leadership team and measurable progress

• Successfully hire and onboard THREE Technical Delivery Directors and ONE Program Delivery Director by day 180. 

• Assign clear portfolios, reporting accountabilities, performance measures and operating routines to newly hired Directors. 

• Demonstrate improvements in delivery predictability, engineering quality, manager effectiveness, technical hiring pipeline and governance. 

Compensation: As per experience

Location: Noida (no remote)
