Role Title : AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering. 

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

Job Description

MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software. 

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB. 

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner's product. 

This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements. 

Learn more about here!

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What you'll do at MongoDB

- Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
 - Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
 - Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
 - Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
 - Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
 - Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
 - Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have

- 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
 - Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
 - Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
 - Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
 - Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
 - The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
 - Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

- Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
 - Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
 - MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

What you will learn

- Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
 - Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
 - Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Job Summary

The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

 - Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

- Bachelor's degree in any related field.

data.title: Software Verification & Testing Lead
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Verification & Testing Lead to lead software verification, validation, and quality assurance activities for medical device and connected healthcare applications. 

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing methodologies, test automation, requirement traceability, defect management, and regulatory compliance. The role involves ensuring the reliability, safety, security, and performance of embedded software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and integrated medical device systems. 



Key Competencies

- Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). 
 - Hands-on experience in manual and automated software testing. 
 - Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for test automation. 
 - Strong experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools. 
 - Experience in integration testing, system testing, regression testing, and defect management. 
 - Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail. 
 - Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and database testing. 
 - Experience preparing test plans, test cases, test execution reports, and requirement traceability matrices. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and team management skills. 



Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Validation

- Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and verification protocols based on software requirements. 
 - Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Ensure complete requirement-to-test traceability and maintain verification documentation. 
 - Review software requirements and design specifications to ensure testability and compliance. 
 - Identify, document, track, and resolve software defects in collaboration with development teams. 

Test Automation & Technical Testing

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Perform API testing, database validation, and end-to-end application testing. 
 - Validate data communication and integration between wearable devices, mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms. 
 - Test real-time data acquisition, transmission, processing, and visualization. 
 - Perform reliability testing, including connectivity interruptions, data loss, recovery, and error-handling scenarios. 
 - Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines where applicable. 

Medical Device Quality & Compliance

- Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with applicable medical device standards. 
 - Maintain verification evidence, test reports, defect records, and traceability matrices. 
 - Participate in risk-based testing and verification of safety-critical software functions. 
 - Support design reviews, quality audits, and regulatory documentation. 
 - Collaborate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable requirements. 

Team Leadership & Coordination

- Lead and mentor software verification and testing engineers. 
 - Assign testing activities, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion of verification milestones. 
 - Coordinate with software developers, embedded engineers, system architects, and product teams. 
 - Review test deliverables and communicate testing status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders. 
 - Drive continuous improvements in testing processes, automation, and software quality.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Service line - Position Title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

Your Key Responsibilities

- 10+ years of experience in respective domain. 
 - Solution Architecture
 - Lead end-to-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
 - Lead end-to-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross-workstream integration points. 
 - Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit-to-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations. 
 - Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope. 
 - Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non-SAP systems. 
 - Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices. 

Delivery Governance & Program Leadership

- Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization. 
 - Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision-making discussions. 
 - Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates. 
 - Identify cross-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams. 
 - Prepare leadership-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs. 

Integration, Data & Technical Oversight

- Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event-driven patterns, middleware, and third-party platforms. 
 - Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution. 
 - Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean-core alignment. 
 - Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies. 

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

- Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit-to-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates. 
 - Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post-go-live stabilization reviews. 
 - Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team. 
 - Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Core SAP & Transformation Expertise

- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models. 
 - Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas. 
 - Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications. 
 - Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches. 

Technical Architecture Skills

- Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles. 
 - Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness. 
 - Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction. 
 - Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution. 

Leadership & Consulting Skills

- Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams. 
 - Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams. 
 - Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk management skills. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion".

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

About Us

Sauce Labs is the world's largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions and over 300, 000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. As a Software Engineer in the Platform team, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving core architecture for applications developed in the company. Feature teams implement new ideas and improve existing ones based on the vision of the Product Team and feedback from our customers. Web Platform has high visibility and importance within the company as it's job is to provide common foundations for those teams to build on, merge and deployment strategy, monitoring, and give technological guidance to developers throughout the company. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build and operate backend services for authentication, authorisation and account management. 
 - Model multi-tenant account structures - organisations, teams, membership and roles - and keep the model correct as the product grows. 
 - Design and evolve public and internal APIs, including versioning and backward compatibility. 
 - Integrate enterprise identity: single sign-on over SAML and OIDC, and provisioning over SCIM. 
 - Build event-driven integrations over Kafka, including schema design and compatibility. 
 - Keep services available and fast on the request path, across several regions. 
 - Own what you build in production: metrics, tracing, alerting, and on-call for your own services.

Languages and frameworks: 

- Python 3. 12+ - Expert
 - Go 1. 23+ - Intermediate
 - FastAPI - Advanced
 - Django and Django REST Framework - Advanced

Datastores

- MongoDB - Intermediate - document modelling, indexing, schema migrations, and the trade-offs of denormalisation
 - MySQL - Intermediate - schema migrations, transactions, reasoning about query cost
 - Redis - basics
 - LDAP / directory services - basics

Messaging And API Contracts

- Kafka - basics- consumer groups, partitioning and ordering, idempotent consumption, retries and dead-letter handling
 - REST and OpenAPI - Intermediate

Identity And Access

- Multi-tenancy modelling - Advanced - organisations, teams, membership and roles; the difference between a hierarchy and a relation, and the consequences of each
 - Token-based authentication, JWT - Advanced - issuing, validating, claims design, expiry and revocation
 - OIDC - Advanced
 - SAML - Advanced
 - Session management - Advanced - where a session lives, how it is inspected and revoked
 - Role-based and attribute-based access control - Advanced
 - SCIM provisioning - Familiarity

Infrastructure And Delivery

- Docker - Intermediate
 - Kubernetes - Advanced - deploying, inspecting and debugging a service
 - Helm - Intermediate
 - CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent) - Intermediate

Observability

- OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing - Advanced
 - Prometheus and PromQL - Advanced - diagnosing from metrics, not only reading dashboards
 - Grafana - Advanced
 - Log querying at scale - Advanced

Job Description

The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities. 

The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally. 
 - Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements. 
 - Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems. 
 - Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria. 
 - Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs. 
 - Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives. 
 - Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems. 
 - Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment. 
 - Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles. 
 - Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors. 
 - Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials. 
 - Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development. 
 - Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4. 0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance. 
 - Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. 
 - Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments. 
 - Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies. 
 - Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles. 
 - Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups. 
 - Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. 
 - Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Industry 4. 0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous. 
 - Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred. 
 - Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

Every day, the oil and gas industry's best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Physical Design CAD, Design Methodology, or Backend Design Automation. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering. 
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII implementation and signoff methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools from Synopsys, Cadence, and/or Siemens. 
 - Proficiency in Tcl, Python, Shell, or Perl scripting. 
 - Experience developing CAD automation and methodology solutions for backend design teams. Preferred Skills

- Experience with advanced technology nodes (7nm and below). 
 - Knowledge of PDK, library, and runset enablement. 
 - Familiarity with compute farms, Linux environments, Git, and CI/CD frameworks. 
 - Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills. Join us to drive design automation, methodology innovation, and successful tapeouts across cutting-edge semiconductor products.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. RF Performance Engineer - 5G/LTE Optimization

Remote from India

US work hours

Contract role

RF Performance Engineer - 5G/LTE Optimization | Remote (India) | US Working Hours

We are looking for an experienced RF Performance Engineer to support a US-based telecom network optimization project. This is a remote contract opportunity for candidates based in India who can work US business hours. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Nokia NetAct, 5G/LTE network performance, RF optimization, KPI analysis, and command-line operations, supporting network integration and post-launch performance improvements. 

Are you passionate about solving complex wireless network challenges and optimizing next-generation 5G networks? This is your opportunity to work on high-impact LTE and 5G optimization initiatives, including NR600, NR2500, L2100, L600, and multi-layer network performance projects. You will play a key role in improving network quality, troubleshooting performance issues, and ensuring seamless connectivity across newly integrated network layers. 

Location: 100% Remote - India

Work Schedule: US Business Hours (Mandatory)

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong hands-on experience with Nokia NetAct and command-line operations (Mandatory). 
 - Experience in 5G NR and LTE RF performance optimization, including post-integration performance checks. 
 - Strong understanding of 5G/LTE parameters, baseline configurations, and LMS parameters. 
 - Experience optimizing newly integrated network layers, including NR41, NR600, NR2500, L2100, and L600. 
 - Experience with ENDC (E-UTRA NR Dual Connectivity) configuration and optimization. 
 - Strong expertise in LTE/VoLTE KPI monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and optimization. 
 - Experience identifying and resolving network performance issues, including handover failures, throughput degradation, dropped calls, and RACH/access failures. 
 - Experience with multi-layer cluster optimization across 4G LTE and 5G NR networks. 
 - Ability to analyze daily KPI reports, identify degraded sites, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Knowledge of RF Optimization Layer 3 analysis and radio network parameter tuning. 
 - Experience with network performance monitoring, trending, reporting, and troubleshooting. 
 - Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting US business hours. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Experience supporting large-scale 5G NR600, NR41, L600, and Anchor projects. 
 - Experience generating and analyzing TrueCall plots to evaluate network coverage changes. 
 - Understanding of Master Node configuration and ENDC profile enablement. 
 - Experience with LTE/VoLTE accessibility, retainability, mobility, and throughput optimization. 
 - Familiarity with post-integration acceptance testing and network performance validation. 
 - Experience supporting US telecom operators and multi-band network deployments. 

What You Will Be Doing

You will support post-integration RF performance validation and optimization of LTE and 5G networks. Your responsibilities will include analyzing network KPIs, identifying performance degradation, troubleshooting network issues, and optimizing radio parameters to maintain network quality. 

You will work extensively with Nokia NetAct, reviewing daily performance reports, validating newly integrated cells and layers, enabling ENDC profiles, and optimizing network performance across NR600, NR2500, L2100, and L600 deployments. 

You will also perform Layer 3 analysis, evaluate coverage changes using TrueCall plots, and implement parameter adjustments to improve network accessibility, retainability, mobility, and throughput. 

Tech Breakdown

- 40% - Nokia NetAct, KPI Monitoring & Performance Analysis
 - 30% - 5G NR/LTE RF Optimization & Parameter Tuning
 - 20% - Network Troubleshooting, Layer 3 Analysis & ENDC
 - 10% - Reporting, Coverage Analysis & Performance Validation

Daily Responsibilities

 - 25% - Perform post-integration checks and optimize NR600, NR2500, L2100, and L600 network layers. 
 - 20% - Troubleshoot handover failures, throughput issues, dropped calls, and accessibility problems using Nokia NetAct and Layer 3 analysis. 
 - 10% - Validate ENDC profiles, baseline parameters, and LMS configurations. 
 - 10% - Generate performance reports, review TrueCall coverage plots, and coordinate optimization activities.

data.title: Principal Scientist - Firefly Enterprise
data.description:
Principal Scientist: Firefly Enterprise India

The Opportunity

Firefly Enterprise brings Adobe's generative AI and creative technology into the heart of enterprise content production by helping large organizations create, adapt, and deliver on-brand content at production scale, inside the tools their teams already use. 

Our charter spans two areas: 

- Audio/Video Solutions: The media-processing backbone for enterprise-scale content production: ingesting, transforming, generating, and delivering audio and video reliably at production volume. 
 - Extensibility: Enterprise agentic workflows and plug-ins that surface Firefly's enterprise capabilities directly inside Figma and other Adobe creative applications. 

We're looking for a Principal Scientist to be the technical anchor of a small, fast-growing team; a player-coach who is as comfortable in the architecture and the codebase as in a design review or a customer conversation. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You won't carry direct reports or own headcount, but you will set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and mentor a team of software and machine-learning engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering managers on people leadership, and you'll be instrumental in interviewing and holding the hiring bar high. 

Impact You'll Make

- Set the long-term technical architecture and vision across both charter areas. 
 - Make enterprise-scale reliability and resiliency a first-class property of everything the team ships. 
 - Bring AI capabilities into the product and into how the team builds, raising both customer value and engineering velocity. 
 - Grow a scaling team of software and machine-learning engineers through hands-on work and mentorship, i. e. , lifting the technical bar by example. 
 - Turn customer and field insight into a credible, deliverable roadmap in partnership with adjacent teams. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture for enterprise-scale audio/video media-processing pipelines by designing for throughput, latency, cost, and operational resilience at production volume. 
 - Architect the extensibility platform: agentic enterprise workflows and plug-ins that expose Firefly's enterprise capabilities inside Figma and other Adobe creative apps. 
 - Stay hands-on by writing code, leading design and architecture reviews, and setting the engineering standards the team builds to. 
 - Mentor developers and specialists in machine learning alike, growing their technical judgment through the work. 
 - Play an instrumental role in hiring: interview, calibrate, and keep the bar high. 
 - Interface directly with customers and field/sales teams to identify real problems and collaborate across adjacent teams to shape the roadmap and deliver solutions. 
 - Manage collaborators and expectations across engineering, product, and the field; with clarity and follow-through. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities to improve both what customers get and how the team develops software. 

What You'll Bring

- 15+ years building large-scale distributed software systems. 
 - Proven experience operating at enterprise scale with a deep focus on reliability and resiliency. 
 - Strong backend engineering in Java, Python, or comparable technologies, with a solid command of distributed systems and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Experience with at least one of the team's two domains, and the ability to ramp on the other: 
 - Media processing: audio/video pipelines, transcoding, streaming, or large-scale media workflows. 
 - Extensibility: SDKs, plug-in architectures, integration frameworks, or agentic systems. 
 - A track record of mentoring both software engineers and machine-learning engineers and raising the technical bar across a team. 
 - Comfort working directly with customers and field/sales teams to translate problems into solutions. 
 - Strong collaborator management with the ability to set expectations and align across engineering, product, and the field. 
 - Excellent communication and the ability to make complex architecture legible to engineers, product leaders, and executives. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience employing AI capabilities for both customer-facing value and internal product development. 
 - Familiarity with LLM application architectures, RAG, AI orchestration frameworks, MCP, or agentic systems. 
 - Experience building integrations or plug-ins for Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, or comparable creative ecosystems.

data.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
data.description:
Company Description PYAAS is a DPIIT-recognized, FSSAI-licensed dairy startup that brings full transparency to India's milk supply chain through farm-level traceability. Every PYAAS pack carries a QR code that lets customers see the farms involved, the farmer's name, milk composition, adulteration checks, and time of milking and chilling. The company currently sources milk from family farms in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, and serves homes in Lucknow with single farm and family farm milk, small-batch Bilona cow ghee, and doorstep Parag dairy delivery. All services run on the PYAAS mobile app for Android and iOS, supported by the PYAAS Digital Agent Network (P-DAN) of local milk agents and shop owners. Day-to-day responsibilities include guiding architecture and design decisions, overseeing end-to-end software development for new features, and ensuring reliability and performance of distributed systems that power traceability, logistics, payments, and customer experiences. Its platform combines an expert-curated policy library with cloud-native technology to automate claims editing and help healthcare payers make more accurate payment decisions. Following its strategic merger with Exponential AI, Rialtic is bringing together healthcare payment accuracy, enterprise technology, and AI capabilities to advance its platform and product offerings.

We are looking for an exceptional  Vice President of Engineering  to lead engineering strategy, architecture, execution, and team development for a mission-critical healthcare technology platform. You will partner closely with executive leadership and Product to shape the technology roadmap, strengthen engineering execution, and embed AI into how software is designed, developed, tested, and delivered.

- Own the engineering strategy, technical architecture, and execution roadmap in alignment with business and product priorities. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of scalable, cloud-native, enterprise-grade software platforms. 
 - Drive sound architectural decisions across application design, APIs, data systems, integrations, security, performance, and reliability.

- Apply a strong understanding of healthcare payer operations and the technology underpinning claims and payment workflows. 
 - Lead engineering solutions that address healthcare payment accuracy, claims editing, policy application, and related payer technology challenges. 
 - Ensure systems can support complex business rules, evolving healthcare policies, large-scale data processing, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Partner with Product and domain experts to translate healthcare requirements into robust technical solutions. 4. Engineering Execution and Operational Excellence

- Improve delivery predictability, release quality, engineering throughput, and production reliability. 
 - Establish clear engineering metrics, operating rhythms, technical standards, and accountability. 
 - Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident management, and continuous improvement. 
 - Make informed build-versus-buy, modernization, and technology investment decisions. 5. Leadership and Team Development

- Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams and leadership capabilities. 
 - Establish a culture of technical ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Partner with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and business leadership to deliver shared outcomes. 
 - Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, priorities, and progress effectively to executive stakeholders.

- 20+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience leading engineering organizations and delivering complex production software. 
 - Mandatory healthcare insurance experience:   Direct experience building or leading technology for health insurers, healthcare payers, health plans, or healthcare insurance technology platforms. 
 - Demonstrated technical depth across full-stack engineering, including frontend and backend systems, APIs, databases, integrations, and distributed applications. 
 - Proven experience owning architecture and engineering delivery for scalable, cloud-based enterprise products. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering managers and senior technical teams, with accountability for delivery, quality, and operational outcomes. 
 - Practical experience adopting AI-assisted software engineering tools or AI-enabled development workflows, with the ability to demonstrate measurable impact or concrete implementation outcomes. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, security, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience partnering with Product and executive stakeholders to establish roadmaps, prioritize investments, and deliver business outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication, strategic judgment, and the ability to remain technically credible while operating at an executive level. 
 - Ability to work from Hyderabad, India. 

Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with payment integrity, claims editing, claims adjudication, medical policy rules, clinical coding, or healthcare cost-containment platforms. 
 - Experience in healthcare enterprise SaaS or mission-critical systems processing large volumes of sensitive data. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations through rapid growth, platform modernization, or significant product transformation. 
 - Familiarity with applicable healthcare data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience establishing measurable engineering productivity and AI adoption programs. What Success Looks Like
 - A clear, business-aligned engineering roadmap and scalable technical architecture. 
 - Faster, more predictable software delivery without compromising quality or reliability. 
 - Measurable improvements in engineering productivity through effective AI adoption. 
 - Robust, secure, and maintainable products that address complex healthcare payer requirements. 
 - Strong engineering leadership, clear accountability, and effective cross-functional execution. Who Should Apply?This role is best suited to an experienced engineering executive who combines  deep software engineering fundamentals, proven organizational leadership, practical AI adoption, and substantial healthcare insurance domain experience. 

Candidates without direct healthcare insurance or healthcare payer technology experience will not be considered. 

- Please highlight the healthcare insurance platforms you have worked on, the engineering organizations you have led, the scale and complexity of systems you have delivered, and measurable outcomes from your engineering and AI initiatives.

data.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
data.description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22, 000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere. 

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart. 

About The Role

We are seeking a Manager, Clinical Operations to join our team in Bengaluru in a onsite capacity. As a Manager, Clinical Operations, you will oversee a team and support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in study execution, regulatory compliance, and the delivery of high-quality project deliverables on time. You will resource client projects with suitably developed professionals, develop and retain your team, and provide clinical consultation to project teams, working independently under the supervision of a Senior Manager, Associate Director, or Director. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. 

Responsibilities include overseeing project delivery and team performance, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes. Your leadership shapes how efficiently and effectively new therapies move from study planning to the patients who need them. 

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through project delivery excellence, talent development, and client partnership. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Manager, Clinical Operations can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research. 

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor performance through close interaction with project and functional leadership, ensuring project documentation and correspondence are accurate and complete, and serve as an ongoing liaison with project teams, sponsors, and management regarding the performance of direct reports. 
 - Manage and oversee team activities, including appropriate resourcing of staff, staff assignments, quality control, and the efficiency of project deliverables. 
 - Produce accurate resourcing plans with appropriate project team members, and monitor resource needs throughout the project. 
 - Develop action plans with management and project leadership to keep projects on time and within budget, and facilitate metrics collection. 
 - Recruit, retain, and develop a skilled, experienced, and motivated team through training, mentoring, and allocation of staff according to their ability. 
 - Conduct quality checks of deliverables and take appropriate remedial action to ensure departmental and project productivity and quality metrics are met. 
 - Provide technical support and clinical consultation to project teams, ensuring staff have the knowledge required to fulfill their duties. 
 - Support staff in improving their efficiency and effectiveness at prioritizing work, and participate in formal staff review processes, including performance and salary reviews. 
 - Serve as a senior-level contributor on project teams, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of your own deliverables and generating study-specific status reports for study teams, sponsors, and management. 
 - Maintain working knowledge of, and ensure compliance with, ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practice, regulatory agency requirements, and Parexel and sponsor SOPs. 
 - Where appropriate, contribute to project bids, client presentations, and business lead generation. 

Candidate Profile

You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring

- Strengths in managing and motivating direct reports, developing talent, and resourcing projects effectively
 - Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
 - The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
 - A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
 - Comfort working with resourcing plans, project metrics, and quality control processes

Required Qualifications

- Educated to degree level, or an equivalent nursing qualification or relevant clinical or other equivalent experience
 - Substantial monitoring or data management experience, or equivalent experience in clinical research, with a strong understanding of the clinical trials environment
 - Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
 - Experience with study documentation and quality control processes, including Central File documentation
 - Competency in the local language and written English
 - Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Degree in a biological science, pharmacy, or other health-related discipline
 - Oral English competency

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research. 

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

The ThousandEyes Efficiency & Performance team is responsible for improving the reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency of the ThousandEyes cloud platform. The team partners closely with engineering, platform, finance, product, and leadership team members to drive infrastructure optimization, cloud cost governance, performance improvements, and operational excellence across AWS environments. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer in the Efficiency & Performance team, you will play a key role in managing and optimizing ThousandEyes cloud infrastructure cost, improving AWS efficiency, driving FinOps practices, and helping engineering teams make data-driven decisions around cost, performance, and scalability. 

Your Impact

- Own and drive AWS cost optimization and efficiency initiatives across ThousandEyes infrastructure. 
 - Analyze cloud usage across compute, storage, databases, observability, networking, and data platform workloads to identify savings opportunities. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to improve application and infrastructure performance while reducing cloud wastage. 
 - Drive FinOps practices including cost visibility, tagging hygiene, showback/chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, anomaly detection, and cost allocation. 
 - Improve infrastructure efficiency through better resource utilization, autoscaling, right-sizing, and capacity planning. 
 - Build automation, dashboards, reports, and guardrails to improve cost governance and operational visibility. 
 - Support ThousandEyes cost reviews, OKR tracking, leadership updates, and stakeholder communications. 
 - Collaborate with product, finance, engineering, and platform teams to align cost optimization with business priorities. 
 - Identify and reduce underutilized infrastructure, idle resources, over-provisioned workloads, and inefficient service usage. 
 - Improve observability, alerting, and monitoring for cost, performance, and platform health indicators. 
 - Influence engineering teams to adopt cost-aware architecture, reliable design patterns, and performance-efficient implementation practices. 
 - Provide senior-level technical leadership, mentor engineers, and independently drive cross-functional initiatives to closure. 
 - Balance reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency in all platform decisions. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8-12 years of relevant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Production Engineering, or Performance Engineering. 
 - Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, EMR, Lambda, CloudWatch, OpenSearch, ElastiCache, IAM, VPC, and related cloud-native services. 
 - Practical experience in cloud cost optimization, FinOps, AWS billing analysis, cost allocation, tagging, budget tracking, forecasting, and cost governance. 
 - Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, infrastructure optimization, and reliability improvements for large-scale cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Puppet, Ansible, or similar. 
 - Strong scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, Shell, or similar languages for automation, reporting, and operational tooling. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as ThousandEyes, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenSearch, Datadog, or similar. 
 - Strong Linux systems knowledge and understanding of distributed systems. 
 - Experience in incident management, production support, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. 
 - Ability to analyze large-scale infrastructure, performance, and cost data and convert findings into actionable engineering recommendations. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical, performance, and cost insights to engineering teams, finance, leadership, and multi-functional stakeholders. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and managing priorities across multiple teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting or optimizing large-scale SaaS platforms in AWS. 
 - FinOps certification or equivalent experience with cloud financial management practices. 
 - Experience with AWS Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, Spot adoption, Graviton migration, storage lifecycle optimization, workload right-sizing, and commitment planning. 
 - Experience with cloud cost management tools such as AWS Cost Explorer, AWS CUR, Cloud-ability, Cloud-Health, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience with performance tuning of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, databases, data pipelines, and high-scale services. 
 - Experience with data platforms or large-scale infrastructure components such as EMR, Kafka, OpenSearch, RDS, Airflow, Spark, Redis, Cassandra, or similar. 
 - Experience driving cross-team cost optimization programs, efficiency OKRs, governance reviews, executive reporting, and measurable savings outcomes. 
 - Ability to influence engineering teams toward cost-conscious architecture, performance-aware design, and operational standard methodologies. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure cost optimization, capacity planning, GPU/accelerator cost governance, or AI-driven efficiency tooling is a plus. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

data.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead
data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation. 
 - AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation. 
 - Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection. 
 - Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations. 
 - AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices. 
 - Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace. 
 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions. 
 - Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills. 

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!
