We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Associate Director, EAS Observability Product & Delivery Lead drives business application adoption of DTCC's observability capabilities, enabling Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), Enterprise Application Support, and Client Operations, Application Development teams to deliver more reliable, resilient, and efficient business services. The successful candidate will work closely with business application teams and key engineering stakeholders to drive adoption of observability services, influence product direction through customer feedback, lead delivery execution through an agile squad, and scale observability capabilities that enhance service reliability, accelerate operational excellence, and support DTCC's evolution toward AI-enabled operations. Through this leadership opportunity, the candidate will play a critical role in shaping how developers, Site Reliability Engineers, Application Support Engineers, Client Operations teams, and technology leaders leverage observability to improve service reliability, accelerate problem resolution, and enhance the stability of DTCC's mission-critical financial services ecosystem. 

Your Responsibilities

Customer Engagement, Adoption and Value Realization- Own the customer relationship lifecycle from intake and discovery through delivery, adoption, and outcome review. 

- Guide application teams to the appropriate service-catalog offerings and drive successful consumption of approved observability services. 
 - Translate observability capabilities into measurable operational, reliability, productivity, and customer outcomes; track adoption, utilization, value, and onboarding friction. 
 - Represent EAS Observability with business-unit and application stakeholders, ensuring engagements align with established observability priorities, standards, and strategic objectives. 

Product Ownership and Delivery- Translate customer needs and strategic priorities into product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans. 

- Own and prioritize the squad backlog using business value, enterprise priorities, risk, dependencies, capacity, and technical input. 
 - Lead Agile delivery activities with the Scrum Master and technical leads; coordinate cross-functional execution and actively manage risks, decisions, impediments, and dependencies. 
 - Provide concise, decision-oriented reporting on roadmap execution, adoption, delivery health, risks, and outcomes. 

Service Catalog and Self-Service- Operate and continuously improve the observability service catalog as the primary customer engagement and service-consumption mechanism. 

- Standardize intake, onboarding, documentation, enablement, and support to move suitable services toward repeatable self-service consumption. 
 - Convert recurring needs and onboarding friction into backlog improvements, reusable patterns, automation, documentation, and enablement materials. 
 - Lead organizational rollout and adoption of approved new services, products, and features. 

Capability Design and Governance Alignment- Contribute customer, product, delivery, and adoption perspectives to service and feature design. 

- Translate business needs into product requirements, and work with the observability squad to introduce new capabilities, features, and service improvements that increase customer value and adoption. 
 - Remain informed of new products and features, assess customer and catalog impacts, and coordinate rollout after direction and design decisions are established. 
 - Align delivery with approved observability standards, technology controls, operational-readiness expectations, and applicable risk, compliance, and audit requirements. 

People and Squad Leadership- Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, including a Scrum Master and assigned developers. 

- Mature Scrum Master capability across facilitation, delivery discipline, transparency, impediment management, metrics, and continuous improvement. 
 - Set clear goals and accountability, provide feedback and development support, delegate effectively, and foster an inclusive, outcome-oriented engineering culture. 

Qualifications- 10+ years of related experience in technology product ownership, product management, delivery, engineering, platform operations, business analysis, or a comparable field. 

- Proven ownership of technology products or services from stakeholder discovery and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement. 
 - Strong stakeholder engagement and influence skills in complex, cross-functional, and cross-regional organizations. 
 - Significant delivery experience in financial services, fintech, capital markets, banking, or another highly regulated, mission-critical environment. 
 - Experience leading direct reports and cross-functional Agile teams, including coaching Scrum or delivery-management capability. 
 - Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into customer journeys, prioritized work, adoption plans, and measurable business outcomes. 
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience. 

Preferred Experience- Observability, monitoring, reliability engineering, SRE, platform engineering, production support, or operational resilience. 

- Metrics, logs, traces, alerting, APM, synthetic monitoring, SLI/SLO practices, and operational dashboards; exposure to Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, Open Telemetry, or comparable technologies. 
 - Technology service catalogs, standardized onboarding, automation, self-service, platform migration, cloud transformation, or modernization programs. 
 - CSPO, PSPO, or comparable products or Agile certification. 

Talents Needed for Success- Business-value orientation and strong customer leadership. 

- Product judgment, execution discipline, and clear priority management. 
 - People leadership, coaching, delegation, and accountability. 
 - Technical curiosity and effective partnership without displacing technical authority. 
 - Enterprise mindset, risk awareness, and concise executive communication.

data.title: Assistant Manager - FQA (Mechanical)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to uphold and enhance the quality and integrity of mechanical components and systems through rigorous inspection and testing procedures. This includes coordinating for site inspections, conducting tests, overseeing boiler and pressure part surveys, and managing welder qualifications. The role also involves preparing and reviewing quality assurance plans and field quality plans, as well as leading quality training sessions to ensure high standards of workmanship and engineering practices. 

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection: 

- Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards. 
 - Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares. 
 - Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries. 
 - Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures. 
 - Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity. 
 - Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc. 
 - Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification). 
 - Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment. 

Quality Control And Testing

- Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records. 
 - Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages. 
 - Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents. 
 - Operational Excellence and Compliance: 
 - Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system. 
 - Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes. 

Resource Management, Training, And Innovation

- Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning. 
 - Provide innovative ideas and recommendations. 
 - Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site. 
 - Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works. 

Business Sustainability

- Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 
 - Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols. 
 - Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments. 
 - Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm. 
 - Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards. 
 - Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies. 

Digitization And Automation

- Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency. 
 - Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy. 
 - Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 
 - Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

- Maintenance Mechanical
 - Operations & Maintenance
 - Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External

- Agencies and contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification: 

Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution. 

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

6+ years of experience in quality assurance/control, with a significant portion in a leadership role within the power sector or related heavy industries. 

Preferred Industry

Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing , Chiller
data.description:
Role: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing , Chiller

Location: Sricity

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate. carrier. com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier. 

About The Role

The General Manager - HVAC Chillers will lead end-to-end manufacturing operations for a comprehensive range of HVAC chiller products, including air-cooled chillers, water-cooled chillers, centrifugal chillers, scroll chillers, and data center cooling chillers. 

The role is responsible for production execution, manufacturing planning, quality control, engineering collaboration, laboratory testing, customer witness testing, and material availability. The position requires close coordination with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective manufacturing while meeting customer delivery commitments and product performance requirements. 

Job Responsibility

- Manufacturing and Production Operations
 - Lead daily manufacturing operations for air-cooled, water-cooled, centrifugal, scroll, and data center chillers. 
 - Ensure production targets, customer delivery schedules, productivity, and capacity utilization are achieved. 
 - Establish standardized work processes, manufacturing procedures, and shop-floor operating discipline. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce manufacturing costs, minimize waste, and optimize resource utilization. 
 - Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, operational standards, and applicable manufacturing procedures. 
 - Production Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute production plans aligned with customer demand, sales forecasts, and delivery commitments. 
 - Coordinate with Planning, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Sourcing teams to ensure timely availability of critical components and materials. 
 - Monitor production schedules, work-in-progress, capacity constraints, and material shortages to minimize line stoppages. 
 - Identify production risks and implement recovery plans to protect customer deliveries. 
 - Optimize production sequencing, manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and manufacturing lead times. 
 - Quality Control and Process Excellence
 - Ensure process quality throughout all stages of chiller manufacturing, assembly, testing, and dispatch. 
 - Work closely with Quality teams to establish and maintain process controls, inspection standards, and corrective-action systems. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions for manufacturing defects, rework, and customer complaints. 
 - Ensure adherence to engineering specifications, product standards, approved processes, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Promote a culture of first-time-right manufacturing and continuous quality improvement. 
 - Engineering and New Product Development
 - Collaborate with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Design Engineering teams on new product introductions, engineering changes, and product improvements. 
 - Support first-of-a-kind (FoAK) builds, prototype builds, pilot production, and transition to serial or mass production. 
 - Ensure manufacturing readiness through process validation, tooling readiness, work instructions, operator training, and capacity planning. 
 - Provide manufacturing feedback to Engineering on design-for-manufacturability, assembly processes, serviceability, and cost optimization. 
 - Support the resolution of technical issues encountered during product development, production, and performance testing. 
 - Laboratory Testing and Customer Witness Testing
 - Ensure readiness and effective utilization of chiller testing laboratories and associated test infrastructure. 
 - Possess a strong understanding of chiller performance testing, functional testing, test procedures, instrumentation, and test data interpretation. 
 - Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, and Laboratory teams to ensure products meet specified performance and reliability requirements. 
 - Plan and manage customer witness testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and other customer inspection requirements. 
 - Ensure test documentation, results, traceability, and customer approvals are completed on schedule. 
 - Coordinate the resolution of test failures, technical deviations, and customer observations before product release. 
 - Procurement, Sourcing, and Material Availability
 - Work closely with Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, and Supplier Quality teams to ensure uninterrupted availability of production materials. 
 - Review critical material shortages, supplier delivery performance, long-lead-time components, and supply constraints. 
 - Participate in supplier recovery planning and escalation to resolve material availability issues affecting production. 
 - Support supplier development, localization initiatives, alternate-source qualification, and cost-reduction programs. 
 - Align material procurement plans with the production schedule, product mix, and customer delivery priorities. 
 - People Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Lead and develop production, planning, and manufacturing teams, building a strong culture of accountability and ownership. 
 - Establish clear performance objectives, operational reviews, and capability-development plans for the team. 
 - Work collaboratively with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, and Customer Service to resolve business challenges. 
 - Drive structured daily management, performance reviews, escalation processes, and cross-functional problem-solving. 
 - Develop technical capabilities within the organization through training, standardization, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Operational Performance and Business Excellence
 - Monitor and improve key operational metrics, including safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, inventory, and manufacturing lead time. 
 - Drive lean manufacturing, waste elimination, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop and manage operational budgets, manufacturing cost targets, and resource requirements. 
 - Identify capacity expansion and process improvement opportunities to support business growth, particularly in data center cooling applications. 
 - Provide regular operational performance updates, risk assessments, and improvement plans to senior management. 
 - Qualifications and Experience
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - A postgraduate qualification in Operations Management or Business Administration is desirable. 
 - Typically 15+ years of experience in HVAC, industrial refrigeration, chiller manufacturing, or related engineering and manufacturing operations, including significant leadership experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing production operations and planning for complex HVAC equipment or industrial cooling systems. 
 - Strong technical knowledge of air-cooled chillers, water-cooled chillers, centrifugal chillers, scroll chillers, and data center cooling solutions. 
 - Practical understanding of chiller assembly processes, performance testing, quality systems, and factory acceptance or customer witness testing. 
 - Experience in new product introduction, first-unit builds, manufacturing scale-up, and mass-production readiness. 
 - Proven experience in cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Sourcing, and Supply Chain teams. 
 - Technical and Leadership Competencies
 - Strong knowledge of HVAC chiller systems, manufacturing processes, and product performance requirements. 
 - Understanding of chiller testing, laboratory operations, performance validation, and customer acceptance requirements. 
 - Expertise in production planning, capacity management, material planning, and delivery execution. 
 - Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams and driving cross-functional accountability. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, decision-making, and customer-facing skills. 
 - Ability to balance customer commitments, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and cost objectives. 
 - Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance Will Be Measured Against The Following Key Indicators

- Safety: EHS compliance, incident reduction, and adherence to safe operating practices. 
 - Delivery: On-time production completion and on-time customer delivery performance. 
 - Quality: First-pass yield, defect rate, rework, warranty issues, and customer complaints. 
 - Productivity: Production output, labor productivity, capacity utilization, and manufacturing lead time. 
 - Material Availability: Production line stoppages due to material shortages and supplier delivery performance. 
 - Testing and Customer Satisfaction: On-time completion of laboratory testing, customer witness tests, and factory acceptance testing. 
 - New Product Introduction: Timely completion of FoAK builds, production readiness, and mass-production ramp-up. 
 - Cost and Inventory: Manufacturing cost improvement, scrap reduction, inventory control, and working capital optimization. 
 - People Development: Team capability, technical competency, employee engagement, and leadership development. 
 - Expected Outcome

The General Manager - HVAC Chillers will ensure a safe, reliable, quality-driven, and customer-focused manufacturing operation capable of delivering the full chiller portfolio on time. The role will strengthen cross-functional execution, improve material availability and production efficiency, support product development and industrialization, and build the manufacturing capabilities required to support future business growth, particularly in data center cooling and high-performance chiller applications. 

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and wellbeing programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees' health, security, and success. 

- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave 
 - Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities 
 - Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Apply Now!

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

data.title: Principal Architect
data.description:
At S&W, we help our clients thrive by simplifying the complex, illuminating new paths, and shaping solutions that make a difference. As one of the UK's top 10 fastest-growing accountancy firms, we have been a trusted partner since 1881-helping businesses and individuals meet challenges and seize opportunities across generations. 

Built on expertise and driven by ambition, we provide a comprehensive range of services, including tax and accountancy, advisory and assurance, corporate finance, and restructuring. We are defined by our purpose-to help navigate challenges, unlock potential, and achieve the extraordinary. 

S&W acquired ClearViewIP in September 2025 to complement the existing advisory services that S&W currently offers its clients including corporate finance, valuations, transaction services and forensic services, along with business tax, audit, consulting and business outsourcing services. 

The ClearViewIP team comprises experienced IP professionals, with decades of experience in managing, protecting and commercialising innovation and ensuring best practice IP approaches are deployed to help clients win in the market. 

Job Description

Principal Architect - AI-First IP Intelligence Platform

We are transforming a global IP intelligence organization from expert-driven workflows into an AI-first, scalable platform architecture. Our mission is to convert complex, knowledge-intensive IP workflows-prior art search, patent landscape analysis, FTO, competitive intelligence-into modular, explainable, enterprise-grade AI systems. 

- Location: Gurugram, India
 - Working format: 5 days per week in the office

The Role

You will work closely with the Director and Head of the Workbench Program in the UK, and partner with the India operations team to understand how the work is done today and translate that into the platform. This is an architecture role with long-term platform ownership and significant technical influence. It is not about maintaining existing systems. The foundations are being laid now, and you will be shaping them hands-on: 

- AI-native workflows that reason over long technical documents and cite evidence
 - Backend services that orchestrate large analytical workloads across a data platform, and the APIs around them. 
 - Modern frontend experiences built for reviewing output at scale (React/NodeJS or equivalent) - a near-term critical path for this hire
 - Secure, enterprise-grade Azure-based deployments, with Databricks as the current leading platform for the data/AI layer. 
 - Robust DevOps and MLOps foundations, including model evaluationYou will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels-designing long-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company's growth. 

Qualifications

Technical Strengths

- 12-15+ years in software engineering, with significant architectural ownership
 - Experience building large-scale, distributed, enterprise-grade systems
 - Proven, hands-on track record designing and building modern backend AND frontend architectures - frontend/UI depth is essential, not a nice-to-have, for this role
 - Strong experience in Azure cloud deployments; hands-on Databricks experience (PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow) strongly preferred

Technical Depth

- Polyglot capability (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Node. js or similar)
 - Data storage and query design: SQL, Delta / Lakehouse patterns, search indexes
 - Structured extraction from long documents; structured-output contracts with LLMs
 - Batch inference at scale, and the failure modes of long-context model calls
 - Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline design
 - APIs and service design
 - Desirable: vector databases, semantic search, RAG architectures - though our work leans more on verified structured extraction than on retrieval alone
 - Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs

Domain Advantage (Preferred)

- Experience in IP analytics, patent intelligence, legal tech, or other knowledge-intensive domains
 - Exposure to patent data formats, citation networks, IPC/CPC classifications
 - Experience building explainable systems in regulated or high-trust environments

data.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Level AI is a Mountain View-based conversational intelligence company building the AI platform that powers modern contact centers. Our systems analyze millions of customer interactions to surface insights, automate quality assurance, and drive real-time agent guidance. We work at the frontier of applied speech and language AI, and our research directly shapes products used by enterprise customers every day. 

We are looking for a Principal AI Research Engineer to set the technical direction for our most ambitious AI initiatives. You will lead research on large language models, speech understanding, and retrieval systems-then translate that research into production capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world deployment, and who can raise the technical bar across the entire AI organization. 

What You'll Do

- Define and drive the research roadmap for core AI capabilities spanning LLMs, ASR/speech understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic systems. 
 - Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art models, taking them from prototype to robust, production-grade systems. 
 - Lead the architecture of scalable training and inference pipelines that operate reliably on real customer-scale data. 
 - Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and quality bars for model performance, safety, and reliability. 
 - Partner closely with product, platform, and ML engineering teams to ship research into customer-facing features. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, set technical standards, and act as a force multiplier across the AI org. 
 - Stay ahead of the field, evaluate emerging techniques, and represent Level AI's technical work externally where appropriate. 

What You'll Bring

- Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience; typically 7+ years applying ML/AI in production settings. 
 - Deep expertise in modern deep learning, with strong command of LLMs, transformers, and at least one of speech/ASR, NLP, information retrieval, or multimodal modeling. 
 - A track record of taking research from idea to deployed, scaled product-not just publications, but shipped impact. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Python and a major deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred), with strong software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience training and serving large models, including distributed training, optimization, and efficient inference. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction, mentoring engineers, and influencing across teams. 
 - Clear communicator able to convey complex technical ideas to both research and product audiences. 

Nice to Have

- Experience in conversational AI, contact center, or speech analytics domains. 
 - Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, Interspeech) or significant open-source contributions. 
 - Experience with agentic frameworks, tool use, and orchestration of LLM-based systems. 
 - Familiarity with model safety, alignment, and responsible AI evaluation. 

Why Level AI

- Work on AI problems that ship to real enterprise customers at scale, with measurable impact. 
 - Join a small, high-caliber team where your technical decisions shape the product and the org. 
 - Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. 
 - A culture that values research depth and pragmatic, production-focused execution in equal measure. 

Level AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Our Team

We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in Site Reliability, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. 

Main responsibilities

We are looking for people with a passion to learn, and who bring a continuous improvement mentality to our team!

SREs maintain Service Level Objectives for the systems they own. Constantly measuring and improving availability, latency, and overall system health is at the core of our team's purpose. 

Write automation to scale systems sustainably, prevent service issues, or when they occur, quickly recover service. 

Partner with development teams to improve system reliability, observability, and release velocity. 

Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, postmortems, and root cause analysis and resolution. 

Be a vocal advocate of strong/sound engineering practices that allow us to build, deploy, and run scalable, reliable, and performant services. 

Enablers for Cloud migration working with foundation and migration teams from the inception of the projects performing architectural reviews, operational acceptable testing and configuring Datadog dashboards and metrics. 

Be part of continuous learning and development culture. 

Minimum Qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience with scripting languages such as: Shell, Python, or similar. 
 - Experience in maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. 
 - Hands on Experience with one of the following cloud platforms: Azure/AWS. 
 - Knowledge on Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Observability tools like Datadog, Dynatrace or similar. 
 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Incident response and running blameless post-mortems. 
 - Proficient in Git workflows. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Minimum 8-10 years in the industry 
 - Experience on DevOps concepts and way of working 
 - Experience with algorithms and data structures. 
 - Understanding of identity and access management, and application security. 
 - Native Azure relational databases. 

We use Datadog and BigPanda for our observability stack, Terraform for our cloud infrastructure, and EntraID as our IAM solutions but we're very open to incorporating your experience with any other tools. 

Does this sound like a challenge you'd be interested in taking on? Join us!

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Senior CAD Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing - an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. 

We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows - coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10, 000+ hosts, serving over 1, 000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins-like CI/CD backbone - a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally - evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters. 
 - Owning the architecture of one or more platform components - defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve. 
 - Leading the modernization of legacy services - evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team. 
 - Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare-metal Linux hosts. 
 - Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows. 
 - Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality-of-results data to improve flows and catch regressions. 
 - Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team. 
 - Helping invent next-generation semiconductor design methodology. 
 - Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products - a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer. 

What We Want To See

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience). 
 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems. 
 - Strong software architecture and design skills - experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces. 
 - Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies. 
 - Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale. 
 - Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support. 
 - Comfort owning and debugging Linux-based production services. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar). 
 - Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding. 
 - Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores. 
 - Exposure to Static Timing Analysis or VLSI physical design. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce - we want to hear from you.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Engineer Lead
data.description:
Description

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- LLM Engineering Standards Across Agent Pods
 - Define and own LLM engineering standards across all Agent Stream pods - agent framework conventions, prompt lifecycle standards, eval harness design patterns, guardrail implementation, and confidence threshold calibration methodology that all Senior AI/ML Engineers follow. 
 - Own the Langfuse observability framework at platform level - instrumentation standards, trace validation patterns, eval pipeline design, prompt regression testing, and model version regression detection. Pod-level Langfuse usage is consistent because this role defines how it is done. 
 - Standardise RAG pipeline architecture across pods - embedding strategy, vector database selection and management, retrieval strategy, reranking, and structured output design for financial document reasoning. Shared RAG infrastructure is your design. 
 - Review and challenge agent design proposals from pod AI/ML engineers - raise the bar on prompt design, memory architecture, evaluation rigour, and production reliability across the stream. 
 - Contribute to AI/ML hiring - define the technical bar for AI/ML engineers across the stream, participate in interviews, and ensure hiring standards are consistent across pods. 
 - Memory Architecture Ownership
 - Own the memory architecture strategy for the AI Platform - designing the personalised, complex memory layer that agents depend on for continuity, context, and adaptive behaviour across sessions and users. 
 - Design and implement the tiered memory architecture for agent workflows - working memory (in-context), episodic memory (past interactions), semantic memory (extracted facts and preferences), and procedural memory (agent instruction updates). Select and implement the right memory framework for each tier: LangMem for LangGraph-native flows, Mem0 for managed personalisation, Zep/Graphiti for temporal and knowledge-graph reasoning, or Letta for explicit OS-style memory management. 
 - Define memory hygiene standards - extraction policies, deduplication, contradiction resolution, and forgetting policies for agents that write aggressively to memory at scale. 
 - Own context window management strategy - how long-running agent workflows handle context pressure, when to compress, when to retrieve from memory, and how to maintain coherence across multi-step financial close workflows. 
 - Platform AI/ML Contribution
 - Contribute hands-on to Platform Team AI capabilities - working with the Platform Architect on how RAG, memory, and eval infrastructure is exposed as shared platform services that agent pods consume. 
 - Stay current on the LLM and agent engineering landscape - evaluate new frameworks, protocols, and tooling (MCP, A2A, new memory systems, emerging eval approaches) and bring informed recommendations to the Director of Engineering on what to adopt and when. 
 - Identify and address systemic AI/ML quality gaps across pods - inconsistent eval practices, weak guardrail implementations, or memory architectures that will not scale. 
Who You Are

- Extensive experience in AI/ML engineering, LLM engineering, data science, software engineering, or a related technical discipline, including experience delivering production-grade AI or ML solutions. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with production-grade LLM agent development, including LangChain, LangGraph, or similar agent frameworks. 
 - Experience defining platform-level engineering standards, architecture patterns, reusable frameworks, or technical practices across multiple teams or product areas. 
 - Strong understanding of prompt lifecycle management, including prompt versioning, rollback, environment-specific configuration, evaluation harnesses, and regression testing. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation and observability practices, including confidence threshold calibration, guardrail design, model regression detection, trace validation, and tools such as Langfuse or similar platforms. 
 - Experience designing RAG pipeline architecture, including embedding strategies, vector database selection, retrieval strategies, hybrid search, reranking, and structured output design. 
 - Experience designing or implementing agent memory systems, context management strategies, or long-running agentic workflows. 
 - Strong data science foundation, including model evaluation, statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding of model behavior in non-deterministic or edge-case scenarios. 
 - Production engineering experience with Python and related API frameworks, such as FastAPI or similar tools. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, pgvector or similar vector database technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure OpenAI or equivalent LLM providers. 
 - Ability to evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, make informed architecture recommendations, and guide technical decisions across teams. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, technical leadership, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with Ragas or equivalent RAG evaluation frameworks preferred. 
 - Experience with model fine-tuning or RLHF preferred. 
 - Experience with financial close, Record-to-Report, accounting, or enterprise finance software preferred. 

At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values - Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.

data.title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
data.description:
Description

UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization - establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act - protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet. 

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale. 

This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch. 
 - Improve the static stability of authentication - ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery. 
 - Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet. 
 - Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events. 
 - Own pipeline and release health for SDK components - keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy. 
 - Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews. 
 - Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Role Summary

The Power Platform & Copilot Developer leads the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise AI chatbot and low‐code solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft Power Platform to support LCS strategic business use cases. This role serves as a technical and functional lead, providing architectural guidance, governance oversight, and mentorship while ensuring measurable business outcomes from AI investments. 

The role partners closely with business leaders, AI governance teams, and platform stakeholders to establish a scalable, governed low‐code AI operating model, build Copilot Studio subject‐matter expertise (SME), and drive adoption across LCS. 

We are hiring for Pune, Noida and Bangalore location. 

Key Responsibilities

AI & Copilot Technical Leadership

- Lead the end‐to‐end architecture, design, and delivery of Copilot Studio solutions and AI chatbots
 - Define conversational AI patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption
 - Review and approve solution designs to ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability
 - Drive continuous improvement of AI agents based on usage analytics, feedback, and business outcomes

Power Platform Solution Architecture

- Lead development of complex Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse solutions supporting Copilot use cases
 - Establish best practices for low‐code / pro‐code extensibility, integrations, and APIs
 - Ensure alignment with enterprise application architecture and data strategies

Governance, Security & Compliance

- Own and enforce governance standards for Copilot and Power Platform solutions
 - Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure Responsible AI, data protection, and audit readiness
 - Guide environment strategy, DLP policies, access controls, and solution lifecycle management

Capability Building & Team Enablement

- Act as a Copilot Studio SME and mentor, cross‐training Power App developers into AI solution builders
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and enablement of incremental Copilot development capacity
 - Contribute to a Center of Excellence / RCC delivery model, defining intake, prioritization, KPIs, and capacity planning

Stakeholder & Program Leadership

- Partner with business owners and AI leadership to identify, prioritize, and roadmap high‐value AI use cases
 - Provide executive‐level updates on progress, risks, ROI, and adoption metrics
 - Represent the Copilot low‐code capability in enterprise forums (e. g. , AI2)

Required Skills & Experience

- Advanced hands‐on experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
 - Strong experience designing and delivering solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio
 - Proven experience leading enterprise‐scale low‐code or AI initiatives
 - Strong understanding of conversational AI design, UX, and performance optimization
 - Experience with governance, security, and compliance in regulated enterprise environments
 - Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder‐management skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Microsoft certifications (Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI)
 - Experience operating within a Center of Excellence (CoE) or shared services model
 - Experience defining and tracking KPIs, ROI, and adoption metrics for AI solutions
 - Familiarity with change management and enterprise adoption strategies

Success Measures

- Successful delivery of high‐impact LCS AI chatbot use cases
 - Adoption and reuse of standardized Copilot solutions across teams
 - Establishment and growth of Copilot Studio SME capability
 - Compliance with enterprise governance and Responsible AI standards
 - Demonstrated ROI and measurable business value from AI initiatives

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- 2 to 8 years of relatable work experience in a fast-paced business environment
 - Strong troubleshooting and technical support skills. 
 - Experience maintaining project documentation and managing system updates. 
 - Excellent stakeholder communication and relationship-building abilities. 
 - Familiarity with data governance and compliance standards. 
 - Skilled in creating engaging content and presentations. 
 - Comfortable with multi-channel communication platforms. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
 - Company volunteer and donation matching program - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
As a Principal Data Platform Engineer at RWS, you will be the most senior technical authority on our data platform. You will architect and implement a scalable Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data platform, setting the engineering standards, patterns and guardrails that the wider Data Engineering team builds on. This is a hands-on role: you will write the Terraform, the pipelines and the automation that make the platform repeatable, secure and cost-effective at scale. 

You'll own the platform end to end - from infrastructure as code and CI/CD through to the data pipelines running on top of it - and you'll push the boundaries of how we deliver, including leveraging AI agents to scale up pipeline delivery. Your work will directly enable our Analytics and AI teams to build the future of global language services. If you enjoy designing systems that other engineers depend on, you'll find a home here. 

About Product & Technology

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. Additionally, we oversee the development and maintenance of core applications essential for the seamless operation of various functions across the organization. We are committed to driving and executing future roadmaps that are in line with the overall strategic direction of RWS. 

With a global reach, Product & Technology provides support services to over 7500 end users worldwide. We take pride in managing the information security operation and safeguarding all our assets. Our core functions encompass Enterprise & Technical Architecture, Network & Voice, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Service Operations, Data & Analytics, Security & Quality Compliance, Transformation, Application Development, Enterprise Platforms, With a dedicated team of over 500 staff, Product & Technology ensures a strong presence across all regions, enabling efficient and effective support to our global operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Job Overview

- Architect the GCP Data Platform: You'll design and implement a scalable, secure GCP data platform that serves as the foundation for analytics and AI across RWS. 
 - Build Infrastructure as Code: You'll create a reusable, modular Terraform codebase so that provisioning new environments and data products is fast and repeatable. 
 - Automate Delivery: You'll implement CI/CD pipelines that give us automated, controlled and auditable deployments of both infrastructure and data code. 
 - Engineer Data Pipelines: You'll design and build pipelines using native GCP services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Cloud Composer and Knowledge Catalog. 
 - Scale Delivery with AI: You'll leverage AI agents and automation to accelerate pipeline delivery and raise the throughput of the wider engineering team. 

Skills & Experience

- Infrastructure Automation: Expert-level Terraform, with GitHub Actions or similar for automated build and deployment. 
 - Expert Cloud Architecture: Deep, predominantly GCP experience - BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataform, Cloud Composer and Pub/Sub. 
 - Cloud Security and Networking: Strong working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, VPC design and firewall configuration. 
 - Software Engineering: Strong programming skills in Python, and experience with Java or Scala. 
 - Data Engineering at Scale: Solid ELT/ETL design experience and hands-on work with Apache Spark. 

Bonus points if you have: 

- Multi-Cloud Exposure: Experience with Azure alongside GCP. 
 - Container Orchestration: Experience packaging and deploying workloads with Helm and Kubernetes. 
 - AI-Assisted Engineering: Practical experience using AI agents or copilots to accelerate engineering delivery. 
 - Data Products: Knowledge or experience of implementing data products and data mesh principles. 

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood , then you'll love life at RWS. 

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career. 

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients. 

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics. 

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right - Partner, Pioneer, Progress - and we ́ll Deliver together as RWS. 

Recruitment Agencies: RWS Holdings PLC does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward any unsolicited resumes to any RWS employees. Any unsolicited resume received will be treated as the property of RWS and Terms & Conditions associated with the use of such resume will be considered null and void.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer – Tooling & Platform (Terraform)
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

We are seeking an experienced and technically influential  Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Cloud Tooling and Pipelines team. This pivotal team is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our core Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (leveraging Spinnaker and custom tooling), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) execution engines (primarily Terraform), and a suite of supporting microservices. These systems are critical for enabling and managing our extensive resource footprint across AWS ECS and EKS. 

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a key contributor, driving the implementation of scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. Your deep expertise in software engineering principles and cloud-native development will be essential in building and enhancing our critical tooling for infrastructure provisioning, vulnerability management, and IaC deployments. You will also play a vital role in mentoring other engineers and influencing the team's technical roadmap. If you have a strong passion for building robust software systems that empower operational efficiency at scale, we encourage you to apply. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Design and Develop Core Platform Components: Lead the design and development of scalable and reliable microservices and tools that form the backbone of Okta's Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (including components for Spinnaker, Terraform, and custom tooling). 
 - Build Infrastructure as Code Automation: Develop sophisticated software solutions and APIs that empower engineering teams to provision and manage infrastructure, execute production changes, and deploy code with high reliability and efficiency. 
 - Architect and Implement Deployment Workflows: Contribute to the architectural design and hands-on implementation of robust CD pipelines and Terraform-based IaC workflows, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security for application deployments. 
 - Develop High-Quality Automation Software: Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code (primarily in Java, Python, or Go) for microservices with a strong focus on automation, operational excellence, and self-service capabilities. 
 - Collaborate for Operational Efficiency: Partner closely with DevOps, SREs, and Product teams to proactively identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Then, lead the software development efforts to create scalable and reliable automation solutions. 
 - Champion Software Engineering Best Practices: Advocate for and implement industry best practices in software design, development, testing, and deployment to ensure the highest quality and maintainability of our tooling. 
 - Integrate Security by Design: Apply and promote security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle of our tooling and infrastructure automation to ensure a secure and compliant operational environment. 
 - Enable Self-Service Capabilities: Proactively identify opportunities to build self-service automation for infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, and other operational tasks, reducing manual effort and improving developer velocity and onboarding. 
 - Provide Technical Guidance and Mentorship: Serve as a technical mentor and role model for other engineers on the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence in software engineering. Required Qualifications
 - 4+ years of professional experience in Software Development, with a strong focus on developing and maintaining automation tools, platforms, or microservices for cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or similar). 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience in Java, Go, Python, or similar backend languages, specifically building scalable and reliable platform components, tooling or automation. 
 - Experience working on backend microservices stack and distributed services is a nice-to-have. Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and practical experience with tools such as Terraform. 
 - Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) platform development, including familiarity with tools like Spinnaker or similar. 
 - Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and ECS, from a software development perspective. 
 - Proficient in using Docker and experienced with building applications that interact with underlying Linux and networking fundamentals. 
 - Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, etc. ) in the context of application development and operational management. 
 - A strong passion for solving complex operational challenges through innovative software solutions and automation. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills within a software development context. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

data.title: Computer Scientist 2
data.description:
What you'll do

- Own the cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform that hosts services end-to-end - provision, upgrade, and operate multi-cloud (AWS + Azure) clusters. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code - Helm charts, ARM/CloudFormation templates, cloud-init, and Python automation for cluster creation, CNI, node scaling, machine health checks, and workload identity. 
 - Bake and harden machine images using Packer + Ansible for Linux and Windows, validate them with automated image tests (goss), and manage the container image supply chain. 
 - Run observability and alerting - Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk (OTel collectors, saved searches/alerts)
 - Lead production support and on-call - triage incidents, perform RCA, remediate issues and manage node/pod health, capacity, and autoscaling. 
 - Design and operate CI/CD and release pipelines using Jenkins and deployment pipelines. 
 - Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot platform services - Spring Boot services, node agents, and containerised engine workloads - across Kubernetes and clouds. 
 - Optimize scalability, cost, and security - right-size clusters, tune autoscaling/workload placement, enforce network policies and admission control. 
 - Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code. 
 - Participate in code/infra reviews, cross-functional collaboration, and mentor junior engineers. 

What you need to succeed

- 6-8 years in software/platform engineering with strong DevOps / SRE / infrastructure focus and end-to-end production ownership. 
 - Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience - Cluster API / kubeadm, Helm, networking/CNI (Calico), autoscaling, and Linux/Windows node/container workloads. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS and/or Azure experience across compute, storage, networking, identity/IAM, and managed services; multi-cloud is a strong plus. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code and automation proficiency - Helm, ARM/CloudFormation/Terraform, Packer + Ansible + Python
 - Proven production-operations experience - monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk/OTel, with on-call ownership. 
 - CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions, including staged releases, rollbacks, and change management. 
 - Database operations experience across relational/NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL/SQL Server, Cosmos DB/DynamoDB/MongoDB, and Redis. 
 - Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code. 
 - Application and platform security fundamentals - OWASP, Vault/CyberArk, IAM/least-privilege, network policy, OAuth2/OIDC/SAML. 
 - Messaging/micro-services familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/Service Bus, and event-driven operations. 
 - Git proficiency, Agile/Scrum experience, excellent communication, and cross-functional/cross-time-zone collaboration. 
 - Fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development/ops tooling to accelerate delivery and operations.

data.title: Product Operations Analyst
data.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. 

At our labor marketplace tech company, we believe that even in the age of AI, the core of success comes down to good people doing honest work. We're seeking a detail-oriented and automation-savvy Product Operations Analyst to help us optimize our operational processes and ensure data accuracy across our platforms. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your career at the intersection of operations, data, and intelligent automation. 

Who You Are: 

- Automation Enthusiast: You're passionate about eliminating manual work through automation. You've built workflows using tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make. com, and you're always looking for the next process to optimize. 
 - AI-Powered Problem Solver: You actively leverage AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or other LLMs to enhance your productivity, solve complex problems, and generate insights. You see AI as a powerful co-pilot in your daily work. 
 - Data-Driven & Analytical: You're comfortable diving into databases using SQL, analyzing trends in Excel or Google Sheets, and creating dashboards to visualize operational metrics. You use data to drive decisions and measure impact. 
 - Technical Tinkerer: You enjoy building solutions using no-code/low-code platforms like Replit, Retool, or similar tools. You're not afraid to write simple scripts or work with APIs to connect systems and automate workflows. 
 - Process Optimizer: You have a natural instinct for identifying inefficiencies and redesigning processes. You're organized, detail-oriented, and obsessed with creating scalable, repeatable systems. 
 - Self-Starter & Collaborative: You can work independently to manage multiple projects while also partnering effectively with cross-functional teams including Biz-Ops, product, sales, and payroll. 

What You'll Do: 

- Own Data Quality & Integrity: Implement and maintain robust processes for validating and verifying data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across all platforms. Develop and enforce data quality standards that become the foundation of operational excellence. 
 - Build & Deploy Automation Solutions: Design and implement automation workflows using N8n, Zapier, or custom scripts to eliminate repetitive manual tasks. Identify bottlenecks in current processes and create scalable automation solutions that improve team efficiency. 
 - Leverage AI for Operational Excellence: Utilize AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs to automate data processing, generate insights, create documentation, and enhance decision-making. Experiment with new AI capabilities to continuously improve operational workflows. 
 - Manage End-to-End Projects: Own short-term and long-term operational projects with comprehensive documentation and strict adherence to timelines. Define performance metrics, accuracy benchmarks, and provide proactive updates to stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Drive Process Improvements: Continuously identify opportunities to streamline operations through automation, better tooling, and process redesign. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions that reduce manual work and improve data accuracy. 
 - Partner Across Functions: Work closely with Biz-Ops, product management, engineering, billing ops, and sales teams to understand data requirements and operational needs. Collaborate on initiatives that enhance data accessibility and usability for all stakeholders. 

Nice To Have: 

- Bachelor's Degree: Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred but not required if you have equivalent practical experience. 
 - Scripting & Development Skills: Experience with Python, JavaScript, or other scripting languages for building custom automation solutions and data processing scripts. 
 - API & Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and system integrations to connect disparate platforms and automate data flows. 
 - Data Visualization Skills: Experience creating dashboards and reports using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar visualization tools to communicate insights to stakeholders. 
 - Startup Experience: Previous experience working in a fast-paced startup environment where you wore multiple hats and adapted quickly to changing priorities. 

Our Values

- Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don't shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback. 
 - Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it's OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct! 
 - Always Be Learning We're a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry. 
 - Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description. 

About Instawork

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation's leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies-and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we're doing it at scale. 

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We're looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www. instawork. com/about.

A fast-scaling AI-powered e-commerce enablement platform, we build intelligent, LLM-driven QA systems that validate Shopify storefronts, automate regression testing, and ensure flawless generative experiences at scale. Our AI QA engineers work at the intersection ofShopify ecosystems, large language models, and test automation to ship reliable, customer-centric digital experiences across global merchant bases.

- Design and execute AI-powered test cases for Shopify themes, LLM-generated content, and AI-driven checkout flows.

 - Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to define test heuristics for LLM outputs-accuracy, hallucination detection, prompt fidelity, and tone alignment. 
 - Leverage synthetic test data and prompt engineering to simulate edge-case user journeys across Shopify stores. 
 - Integrate QA pipelines with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to enable shift-left testing for AI-enhanced Shopify features.
