As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently own significant features, contribute to technical design and architecture decisions, and work closely with networking, platform, quality, and product teams. 

Your Impact

In this role, your work will directly enhance the connectivity, reliability, and configuration of L2/L3 protocols on Cisco switching platforms. You will own medium-to-large features from design through delivery, troubleshoot complex device and customer issues, and help raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment and mentorship. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and own networking components that are simple, scalable, reliable, and supportable. Develop firmware and system software for Cisco switching products. 
 - Analyze requirements and problem statements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and produce clear software designs, detailed design documents, and functional specifications. 
 - Write high-quality C/C++ code and unit tests. Apply strong white-box testing and automation practices. Triage, debug, and root-cause software bring-up issues, regressions, crashes, performance problems, and customer failures. 
 - Work with local and remote teams to review product requirements, software functional/design specifications, unit and integration test plans, and validation strategy. Partner closely with system test and quality teams to ensure feature readiness. 
 - Contribute innovative ideas that improve product architecture, debuggability, performance, reliability, and engineering productivity, including opportunities to create intellectual property. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, EE/ECE, or a related field, with typically 4-8 years of relevant software/firmware development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in C/C++ with solid data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, memory management, and debugging skills. 
 - Hands-on experience developing firmware, embedded software, or system software for networking products. 
 - Strong experience with concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization, and IPC/RPC mechanisms. 
 - Strong L2/L3 networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP/LAG, ARP, IPv4/IPv6, routing fundamentals, packet flow, and network troubleshooting. 
 - Strong Linux/system programming fundamentals and hands-on debugging experience using tools such as GDB, core dumps, packet captures, Wireshark/tcpdump, and traffic generators/analyzers such as IXIA or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of medium-to-large technical features, including design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production/customer support. Ability to mentor engineers and contribute effectively to design and code reviews. 
 - Hands-on experience using GenAI-assisted development tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and security. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on development and debugging experience with networking protocols and switching features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MST, LACP/LAG, UDLD, Storm Control, QoS, OSPF, BGP, ECMP, multicast, DHCP relay, SLAAC, or VRRP. 
 - Experience with Python or another scripting language for test automation, debugging, tooling, or developer productivity. 
 - Experience with hardware/software bring-up, SDK/ASIC interaction, packet processing, or high-performance data-plane software is a plus. Cisco networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE are desirable. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: EDA Simulation Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a hands-on EDA Simulation Automation Engineer to join our AI-native product development team at onsemi. The role sits at the intersection of power semiconductor module simulation and engineering automation: you bring deep, practical experience running electrical, thermal, and mechanical simulations across industry-standard EDA tools, and you partner with our software and AI agent engineering team to codify that expertise into repeatable, automatable workflows. Today, every design cycle waits on a few subject-matter experts to configure tools, run simulations, and extract KPIs by hand. Your job is to break that bottleneck by defining standardized inputs, outputs, and KPI extraction logic that our platform can orchestrate and scale across engineers, teams, and products. You will also identify where commercial EDA tool licensing or concurrency limits constrain simulation throughput, and research, evaluate, or build custom and open-source alternatives that can be integrated into the platform's automation pipeline. 

Success Expectations

You would become the platform's trusted domain authority for simulation configuration, execution, and KPI extraction - defining clear, documented automation contracts for each supported EDA tool, validating that automated and agent-driven simulation runs match expert-derived results, and steadily expanding the set of tools and KPIs the platform can orchestrate without manual SME intervention on every cycle. 

Responsibilities

- Own hands-on simulation execution for power module characterization across electrical, thermal, and mechanical domains using tools such as Ansys Discovery, Q3D, HFSS, IcePak, Mechanical, OptiSLang, Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, Calibre (DRC/LVS/PEX), SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, and PLECS. 
 - Define and validate KPI extraction logic from raw simulation outputs, including loop inductance, on-resistance (RDS(on)), switching energy, junction temperature (Tj, max), thermal resistance (Rth), and power-cycling lifetime. 
 - Design standardized, parameterized test-bench definitions and post-processing rules that convert raw tool outputs into compliance-ready KPI values. 
 - Document tool-specific configuration, input/output file schemas, and scripting hooks (Python, tool APIs, batch/command-line modes) so engineering can automate configuration, dispatch, and result ingestion for each tool. 
 - Partner with software and SDET engineers to build and validate simulation regression pipelines, ensuring automated or agent-driven runs reproduce trusted, manually-derived golden results. 
 - Capture and formalize simulation best practices, known-good configurations, and troubleshooting knowledge that today lives only with individual SMEs, so it can be reused across teams and products. 
 - Support AI agent tool-calling integrations for EDA tools by defining safe, well-scoped automation boundaries, required parameters, and expected outputs for each tool. 
 - Research, evaluate, and prototype custom or open-source alternatives to commercial EDA tools where per-seat licensing or concurrency limits throttle agentic, parallelized simulation throughput, and propose where such alternatives can safely substitute or supplement licensed tools. 
 - Review and sign off on automated simulation results and generated KPI/compliance reports against domain expectations before release certification. 
 - Collaborate with model-generation and layout/GDS teams to ensure electrical and thermal models feeding simulations remain accurate and traceable. 
 - Provide simulation domain expertise during project scoping, test-suite definition, and requirements-to-KPI mapping discussions. 

Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience running simulations for power semiconductor or power module design, with direct, practical use of at least two or three of: Ansys Discovery, Q3D, HFSS, IcePak, Mechanical, Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, Calibre, SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, or PLECS. 
 - Solid understanding of power module electrical, thermal, and mechanical characterization and the KPIs engineers derive from each (parasitics, loop inductance, resistance, thermal resistance, junction temperature, lifetime/reliability metrics). 
 - Practical experience configuring simulation inputs (parameters, test benches, boundary conditions) and interpreting/post-processing raw simulation outputs into engineering KPIs. 
 - Scripting ability in Python sufficient to automate tool configuration, batch execution, and output parsing. 
 - Working knowledge of GDS/layout-based design flows and how layout, parasitic extraction, and model generation feed downstream simulation. 
 - Ability to translate tribal SME knowledge into clear, documented, repeatable procedures that a software or AI agent engineer can implement without deep tool expertise. 
 - Comfort researching and evaluating open-source, custom-built, or alternative simulation/extraction methods to work around commercial tool licensing or concurrency bottlenecks. 
 - Strong attention to detail in validating automated results against known-good manual runs, with a rigorous approach to signing off on release-quality simulation data. 
 - Good collaboration and communication skills to work closely with software engineers, SDETs, and AI coding agents on a shared automation roadmap. 

About Us

onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world's most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in Design for Testability (DFT) techniques, including LBIST (Logic Built-In Self-Test), ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation), DFT DRC (Design Rule Checking), MBIST (Memory Built-in Sefl-Test), Boundary Scan, JTAG and Analog/Phy DFT.

 - Strong knowledge of LBIST, ATPG, DFT DRC, Scan compression, Low power DFT Techniques, MBIST, Boundary Scan, Analog DFT, JTAG Architecture, DFT STA Constraint development. 
 - Hand-on experience/expertise in Siemen's DFT EDA tools for Scan stitching, DRC, ATPG, Coverage improvement, MBIST, Boundary Scan.

- Education: B. Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.

 - Leadership Style: A hands-on operational leader who split time between tracking timelines via project management tools and doing high-audit site visits in the field. What's in it for You:

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Experience: 5. 00 + years

Salary: Confidential (based on experience)

Expected Notice Period: 15 Days

Shift: (GMT+05: 30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Office ()

Placement Type: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: Pet Health and Wellness Company)

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - Pet Health and Wellness Company)

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

Fastify, LLM, Prisma, Java, PostgreSQL, Python, Node Js, Agentic AI, multi-tenant SaaS, AI-native coding

Pet Health and Wellness Company is Looking for: 

Engineering Manager

Years of Experience : 5-8 years (3+ in architecture or solutioning)

Location : Nashik, Maharashtra

Reports to: Operations Manager

Manages: A team of 3 junior full-stack developers

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to own the technology of a multi-tenant AI-native SaaS platform + a media-engine infrastructure. The current stack runs Node. js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and Prisma - but we are hiring your architectural judgement, not your stack expertise. 

About The Role

You own the architecture of the multi-tenant SaaS platform serving multiple verticals AND the AI agent layer (orchestration, tool execution, HITL approval architecture) AND the media-engine infrastructure. You report to the Operations Manager. 

You lead a team of 3 junior full-stack developers and partner with the existing senior engineering talent on the team. 

What You'll Do

- Set the architecture for the multi-tenant SaaS platform (tenant isolation as a security boundary, not a filter)
 - Design the AI agent layer: orchestration, tool calling, context management, evaluation, HITL approval
 - Design the media-engine infrastructure: multi-agent pipelines, prompt versioning, automation workflows
 - Ship code yourself 30-40% of the time (you set the bar by shipping, not by reviewing)
 - Run code review for 100% of the junior dev PRs
 - Hire, mentor, and develop the junior full-stack developers
 - Set the engineering bar: AI-native coding (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot), shipping cadence, code review standards
 - Hold the production reliability bar: CI/CD, deploy reliability, platform uptime

Agentic AI in Your Day-to-Day

AI-native coding is already a must-have above - Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot used daily. This section is about the layer above that: agents as managed production infrastructure you own, not autocomplete you use. 

Your Roles And Responsibilities

- Boilerplate, CRUD endpoints, test scaffolding, migration scripts - Agent-generated code inside your review loop, not outside it
 - CI/CD diagnosis - Agent that traces the pipeline config against the last structural repo change and returns a ranked hypothesis set
 - Incident first-response - Agent that opens the incident, gathers logs/metrics/deploy history, and drafts the timeline before you wake to it
 - Code review triage - Agent pre-reviews PRs for convention breaches, missing tests, and tenant-scoping smells. You review the diffs it clears and the ones it cannot
 - Log triage across services - Agent correlates deploy logs against the last commit and returns likely causes
 - Regression test generation - Agent generates the test you decide whether the test is real or merely present
 - Junior onboarding - Agent reads the codebase and generates a scoped, task-ordered first-week plan per new developer
 - Documentation drift - Agent diffs the codebase against the docs repo and opens a PR when they diverge

What Stays With You, Always

Agent fluency does not replace architectural judgement: 

- Approval architecture. Where enforcement lives and why. A client-supplied flag must never bypass it. 
 - Tenant isolation as a security boundary. Not a filter. The enforcement point, and the mechanism that makes it verifiable. Your agent pre-reviewer flags tenant-scoping smells - you own the boundary itself. 
 - Agent reliability engineering. How agents fail differently from ordinary software - hallucination, looping, confident wrong output - and how you detect, contain, and measure that in production. 
 - Build-vs-buy and rewrite-vs-revise calls. Standing principle: the spec is the final target, the platform is the starting point. Audit first, then revise targeted gaps. 
 - The 30-40% hands-on shipping rule. Agents do not set the bar. You do, by shipping. 

How You Run Agents As a System

You will treat agents as managed infrastructure, not as autocomplete. 

- Agent inventory. Every agent we run has a named owner, a written purpose, a versioned prompt, and an evaluation set. If it has no eval set, it does not go into production. You set the standard and you hold it. 
 - Prompt versioning. Prompts are version-controlled artefacts with change history. A prompt change that alters agent behaviour goes through review like a code change. 
 - Human-in-the-loop tiers. Tier 1 auto-executes. Tier 2 executes with logging and a reversible path. Tier 3 blocks until an authorised human approves. You own where that line sits per tenant, and you own proving it cannot be bypassed. 
 - Eval harness. "This agent is working correctly" has to be a measurable metric. You define correctness per agent and run the harness on every prompt or model change. An eval regression blocks the release. 
 - Cost and latency budgets. Every agent carries a token cost and a latency target. Voice agent latency currently runs 2-3s against a ~300ms target - that gap is an architecture problem you own, not a ticket you forward. 
 - Context engineering. Long-running agent sessions fail on context, not model capability. You decide what goes into context, what gets summarised, what gets retrieved. 

What We're Looking For (Must-Have)

- 3+ years of architecture or solutioning experience owning the technical direction of a product, within a 5-8 year total career span
 - Demonstrated depth in shipping production-grade systems
 - Has shipped AI agent systems to production and knows where they fail (orchestration, tool calling, context
 - management, evaluation)
 - Multi-tenant SaaS expertise: tenant isolation as a security boundary
 - AI-native coding: uses Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot daily
 - Cloud infrastructure at production scale (AWS: containers, managed databases, cost control)
 - Has led engineers and made them better
 - Ships first, refactors on the way

What We're Looking For (Preferred)

- Compliance-constrained environments (HIPAA, PCI) and BYOC / on-prem deployment
 - LLM evaluation and observability
 - Early-stage startup experience (first engineering hire or founding engineer)
 - Productive in Node. js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma in week one (or transferable expertise in Python, Go, or Java)

Who Excels In This Role

- Takes ownership - treats the role as their own operation ships the work end-to-end
 - Proactive - sees the next move before being asked ships the fix and reports
 - Domain expert - has real, hands-on depth in the discipline this role covers
 - Out-of-the-box thinker - when the obvious move stops working, finds the non-obvious one quickly
 - Performs under stress - triages and ships in real-time when things break
 - Calibrated about AI - knows where you overrode an agent and why, and where you would never delegate

What Success Looks Like

The team ships production code daily with high quality. The architecture scales to the next 10x without a rewrite. Junior developers ramp to owning features independently within 4-6 months. The Operations Manager trusts your architectural decisions enough to step back from day-to-day. 

Hiring Process

The process is the same for every senior role in this pack: 

- Intro call (30 min) - mutual fit and role expectations. We give you the compensation band in this call. 
 - 24-hour take-home task - a real exercise from our day-to-day work
 - Role deep-dive (60-90 min) - a walkthrough of real work you have done
 - Team + culture conversation (45 min) - with the Operations Manager and the team you would work with
 - Offer + onboarding plan

Benefits

- Direct report to the Operations Manager
 - Start: immediate joining priority
 - Growth path: the engineering team scales under you
 - monthly KPI bonus structure (paid monthly, on outcomes) + promotion ladder

How to apply for this opportunity?

- Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal. 
 - Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
 - Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

About Uplers: 

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement. 

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well). 

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

data.description:

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2, 200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. About Albertsons Companies India: 

At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company's technology journey to support millions of customers' lives every day. 

At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Senior Engineering Manager, AI-SDLC at Albertsons. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Skills Required: Gen AI, Agentic AI, Autonomous Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence

Experience Range: 12 - 15 years

Job Title: Sr. Manager - AI-SDLC (Autonomous Software Engineering Platform)

Role Overview: 

- The Sr. Manager - AI-SDLC will lead the design, engineering, and rollout of Albertsons' next-generation AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI-SDLC) platform - a system where autonomous AI agents plan, write, test, review, and ship software collaboratively with human engineers in the loop. 
 - This role is pivotal in reimagining how Albertsons builds software: shifting from developers writing every line of code to developers directing, reviewing, and governing fleets of autonomous coding agents that handle requirements analysis, code generation, testing, code review, deployment, and incident triage - with humans retaining control at critical decision points. 
 - You will lead an engineering team responsible for architecting and operationalizing platform components including agent orchestration for the SDLC, autonomous coding/testing agents, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, code-quality and safety guardrails, CI/CD integration, and developer experience tooling that lets engineering teams safely delegate work to AI agents. 
 - This is a hands-on leadership role ideal for someone who has built agentic AI platforms, developer tooling, or autonomous automation systems in large enterprises or high-velocity startup environments, and who is excited to redefine how software gets built. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Platform Architecture & Engineering: 

- Lead end-to-end design and engineering of Albertsons' AI-SDLC platform, enabling autonomous, semi-autonomous, and human-in-the-loop software delivery workflows. 
 - Architect core components including: 
 - Agent orchestration layers for the software development lifecycle (planning, coding, testing, review, deployment) using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Assistants, or similar frameworks. 
 - Autonomous coding and testing agent frameworks (e. g. , patterns similar to OpenGPTs, n8n workflows) capable of executing multi-step engineering tasks. 
 - Human-in-the-loop checkpoints and approval gates that let engineers review, correct, and approve agent-generated code, tests, and deployments before they progress. 
 - Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, We aviate, Chroma, pgvector) for codebase retrieval, context grounding, and RAG over internal engineering knowledge. 
 - Prompt engineering libraries, reusable agent tools, code-review templates, and evaluation harnesses to measure agent code quality. 
 - Secure tool/function calling into source control, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure, with policy-as-code and responsible AI guardrails. 
 - Build scalable APIs, SDKs, and services that make autonomous SDLC capabilities reusable across engineering and product teams. 

Team Leadership: 

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI platform engineers, LLM engineers, MLOps engineers, and agentic workflow developers building the AI-SDLC platform. 
 - Establish engineering best practices, code quality standards, and DevOps processes for AI-authored and AI-assisted software. 

Innovation & Architecture: 

- Evaluate and integrate emerging open-source technologies (e. g. , LangChain, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, Dust, n8n, OpenGPTs, Haystack) for autonomous software engineering use cases. 
 - Drive architectural decisions for multi-model support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Llama) across coding, testing, and review agents. 
 - Partner with Data Engineering, Cloud Infra, Security, and Digital Product teams to ensure the AI-SDLC platform integrates seamlessly with existing engineering toolchains (source control, CI/CD, ticketing). 

Platform Operations & Governance: 

- Implement governance, compliance, and auditability mechanisms so every autonomous agent action in the SDLC is traceable, reviewable, and reversible by a human. 
 - Design human-in-the-loop review and escalation policies that balance developer velocity with code quality, security, and risk controls. 
 - Oversee observability, telemetry, monitoring, and cost optimization for agentic workloads across the development lifecycle. 
 - Ensure high availability, performance, and secure access controls (SSO, RBAC, secrets management) for agents operating on production codebases. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: 

- Work closely with product managers, engineering leaders, Data Science, AI Research, and Engineering teams to enable rapid adoption of autonomous development workflows. 
 - Partner with the AI Governance Council to operationalize safety, privacy, ethical AI, and model explain ability for AI-generated code (interpretability tools, etc. ). 

Execution & Delivery: 

- Translate the AI-SDLC vision - autonomous agents building software with humans in the loop - into concrete platform features and a delivery roadmap. 
 - Deliver iterative platform increments with measurable impact on developer productivity, code quality, and delivery speed. 
 - Ensure successful rollout, adoption, and developer onboarding for autonomous AI-SDLC tooling across the enterprise. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 12+ years of total experience in software engineering, developer platform engineering, or large-scale distributed systems. 
 - 3-5+ years of hands-on experience building GenAI or LLM-based systems, agentic frameworks, or autonomous software engineering / developer tooling platforms. 

Strong expertise in: 

- Python, TypeScript/Node. js, FastAPI, microservices. 
 - LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI function calling, agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Workflow automation engines (n8n, Temporal, Airflow) or agent orchestration tools applied to CI/CD and SDLC automation. 
 - Vector DBs: FAISS, Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma, Weaviate. 
 - Cloud platforms: GCP, Azure, or AWS with AI/ML stack experience. 
 - Software engineering fundamentals: source control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code review practices - essential for designing agents that operate safely within them. 
 - Solid experience with MLOps / LLMOps: CI/CD for models, evaluation, monitoring, prompt versioning. 
 - Experience designing human-in-the-loop systems, approval workflows, or safety guardrails for autonomous/agentic systems. 
 - Experience handling system performance, cost management, and scaling LLM/agentic workloads. 
 - Proven leadership experience in managing high-performance engineering teams. 

Nice to Have: 

- Prior experience building or rolling out internal developer tools / platform engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with AI code-review, AI testing, or AI code-generation tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot Workspace, Devin, Cursor, SWE-agent style systems).

data.title: Senior Engineer II - SRE (AI-First)
data.description:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system. 

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time. 

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program. 

Learn more at www. contentstack. com. 

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!

What you will be working on

- Reliability of a multi-tenant platform under growth: Defining SLIs and SLOs for the services in your area, instrumenting them honestly, and having the error-budget conversation when one is at risk. 
 - Making releases boring: Progressive delivery through Argo CD - canary and blue/green, automated verification, fast rollback - so a bad change is contained in minutes rather than escalated. 
 - Release management at pace: Coordinating what ships and when across [N] services, with change gates that catch problems without becoming a queue. 
 - Helm as a product, not a pile of charts: Reusable, tested, versioned charts that other teams can depend on. 
 - Incident response and what happens after: Leading incidents on the platform, then writing the postmortem and landing the follow-up work - the part most teams skip. 
 - Removing toil rather than absorbing it: Every recurring manual task is a candidate for automation in Python, Bash, or Ansible, and you'll have the time budget to actually do it. 
 - Deciding what AI should and shouldn't touch in our delivery path: Reviewing AI-authored Helm and pipeline code before it reaches production, keeping secrets and customer data out of agent context, scoping the credentials our CI agents hold. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Service level management: Define and operate SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for platform services; make reliability legible to engineering and product; drive the follow-through when budgets are burned. 
 - Production on-call and incident response: Hold primary on-call, act as incident commander, and run blameless postmortems with tracked actions. Escalate cleanly to Infra SecOps where infrastructure or credential changes are required. Use AI-assisted analysis to improve triage, root-cause identification, anomaly detection, and MTTR. 
 - Observability: Build and maintain the instrumentation, SLO monitors, and dashboards in Datadog that make failure visible before customers see it; reduce alert noise as deliberately as you add alerts. 
 - CI/CD engineering: Design, operate, and optimise build and deployment pipelines - caching, parallel execution, automated testing, security scanning, deployment verification. Manage artifacts and dependencies in the Artifactory. 
 - Release management and progressive delivery: Own the release process end-to-end; implement GitOps with Argo CD including canary and blue/green rollouts, automated validation, and rollback; run change management so that shipping is routine rather than an event. 
 - Helm and deployment configuration: Build and maintain production-grade Helm charts and libraries with testing, versioning, policy validation, and reusable standards across services. 
 - Kubernetes day-2 operations: Operate and troubleshoot production Kubernetes - scheduling, autoscaling, resource management, add-on lifecycle, workload networking - at a depth that holds up at 3am. Cluster provisioning sits with Infra SecOps; you'll partner with them on upgrades and capacity changes. 
 - Toil reduction and automation: Identify and eliminate recurring operational work with automation in Python, Bash, and Ansible. 
 - Capacity and resilience: Workload-level capacity planning and resource tuning, resilience and failover testing, and feeding infrastructure capacity requirements into Infra SecOps ahead of need. 
 - AI guardrails and review: Define how AI-generated deployment and pipeline code is reviewed before it reaches production, keep secrets and customer data out of prompts and agent context, scope CI agent credentials to least privilege, and maintain provenance for generated code. 
 - Cross-team partnership: Review and raise pull requests against Infra SecOps' Terraform where platform changes are needed, and keep the interface between the two teams working. 
 - Technical leadership: Contribute to design and architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the bar on availability, deployment speed, and developer experience. 

Mandatory Skills

- Production on-call ownership: You've held the pager for a SaaS platform, led incidents end-to-end, and written the postmortems. 
 - SLO practice, not SLO vocabulary: You've defined SLIs and SLOs for real services and can describe a decision and an error budget changed. 
 - Kubernetes in production: Deep, hands-on day-2 operation and troubleshooting of EKS - scheduling, autoscaling, resource management, add-ons - not just deploying onto it. 
 - Helm depth: You've written charts and libraries that other teams depend on, with tests and CI behind them. 
 - CI/CD engineering: You've built and owned pipelines at scale, not just consumed them - and you can talk about what you did to make them fast and trustworthy. 
 - Release engineering judgement: Practical experience with progressive delivery and rollback - Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent. 
 - Observability: Hands-on with Datadog or equivalent - you've built the monitors and dashboards, not just read them. 
 - Systems fundamentals: Strong Linux, load balancing, and application clustering; you can debug from logs, stack traces, and core dumps. 
 - Demonstrated AI-assisted workflow: Show us something you built - an agent or MCP integration, a prompt/context library your team uses, an AI-assisted review or incident workflow - and tell us where you decided not to use it. 
 - Works well across a boundary: You've operated in a model where some remediation needs another team, and you know how to make that fast rather than resentful. 

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a**hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected. 

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining. . . 

To review our Privacy Policy, please click here.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. 

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. 

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients' systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that's shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Summary

As a Senior AI Native Engineer (IC3) at Keyloop, you will be a technical leader within your team, owning complex, multi-sprint projects and setting the standard for engineering quality. You will design and implement robust, scalable solutions, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and be a key driver of team culture and process improvements. We are tech stack agnostic: we believe a strong engineer with deep fundamentals and AI-assisted tooling can master any technology. This role is for engineers who combine deep technical expertise with strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence technical direction at the team level. 

Competency Expectations

Competency Expectations

Aligned with the Keyloop Engineering Career Framework, this role is assessed across five core competency domains: 

Competency Domain

What We Expect

Technical Mastery & Innovation

Designs and implements robust, scalable solutions for complex, team-sized projects. Is a recognized technical expert within the team. Drives architectural decisions and champions engineering best practices. 

Execution & Delivery

Owns the delivery of large, complex, multi-sprint projects. Is accountable for the operational health of the team's systems. Proactively identifies and mitigates technical risks. 

Leadership & Influence

Consistently mentors and coaches IC1s and IC2s. Is a key driver of team culture and process improvements. Builds consensus around technical decisions and influences team direction. 

Communication & Collaboration

Communicates complex technical ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Facilitates technical discussions, design reviews, and cross-functional alignment. 

Product & Business Impact

Deeply understands the team's product domain and user needs. Actively participates in product planning, shaping technical approaches based on business context and customer value. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement robust, scalable software solutions for complex, team-sized projects spanning multiple sprints
 - Lead technical design and architecture discussions within the team, ensuring solutions align with platform strategy
 - Own the end-to-end delivery of major features: from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
 - Drive engineering best practices including code quality standards, testing strategies, CI/CD improvements, and effective use of AI-assisted development tools
 - Mentor and coach IC1 and IC2 engineers, accelerating their technical growth through pairing, code reviews, and guidance
 - Be accountable for the operational health and reliability of the team's systems, including incident response and post-mortems
 - Facilitate technical discussions and build consensus on architectural and design decisions
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and stakeholders to shape the team's roadmap and technical approach
 - Identify and drive process improvements that increase team velocity, quality, and developer experience
 - Proactively identify technical debt, risks, and opportunities, proposing and leading initiatives to address them
 - Produce high-quality technical documentation including design documents, ADRs, and runbooks
 - Represent the team's technical perspective in cross-team discussions and planning forums

Technical Skills & Qualifications

Required: 

- . net AWS cloud . NET 8+, . NET Core, ASP. NET MVC, ASP. NET Web API, Entity Framework
 - Deep software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns, system design, and distributed systems principles
 - Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, with a proven track record of picking up new languages, frameworks, and paradigms quickly
 - Proven ability to design and implement scalable, maintainable, and well-tested software systems regardless of the underlying tech stack
 - Strong experience with modern development practices: TDD/BDD, CI/CD, code reviews, and automated testing
 - Solid understanding of cloud-native concepts, infrastructure patterns, and platform-level thinking
 - Experience with data modelling, query optimization, and working across different database paradigms
 - Understanding of API design, service-oriented architectures, event-driven patterns, and integration strategies
 - Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management practices
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted and AI-driven development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, agentic coding workflows) to accelerate development, architectural exploration, and technical problem-solving
 - A tech stack agnostic mindset: we value engineers who master fundamentals and use AI-assisted tooling to work effectively across any technology

Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated growth in scope and complexity

Nice to Have: 

- Experience working across multiple programming languages, frameworks, or tech stacks in production environments
 - Experience with containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code concepts
 - Experience leading or contributing to cross-team technical initiatives
 - Experience in the automotive, DMS, or SaaS product domain
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-driven development workflows (agentic coding, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering) to solve complex engineering problems
 - Experience coaching or enabling teams to adopt AI-assisted development practices
 - SAFe or Agile certifications

Soft Skills & Behaviours

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex ideas to diverse audiences
 - Strong mentoring and coaching ability, with a genuine commitment to developing others
 - Proven ability to build consensus and influence technical direction without formal authority
 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with accountability for the team's technical outcomes
 - Ability to facilitate productive technical discussions and navigate disagreements constructively
 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to user value and business outcomes
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first 3 months, you have a deep understanding of the team's domain, codebase, and systems, and you are already leading design discussions and delivering complex features
 - Within 6 months, you are the go-to technical authority on your team, owning multi-sprint projects end-to-end and driving measurable improvements to code quality and engineering practices
 - Within 12 months, you have mentored IC1 and IC2 engineers with visible growth in their capabilities, and you have led at least one significant initiative that improved team velocity, reliability, or developer experience
 - You consistently identify and address technical debt and risks before they become blockers, and you proactively propose solutions
 - You are recognized across the team as someone who builds consensus, facilitates productive discussions, and connects technical decisions to product and business outcomes
 - You leverage AI-assisted and AI-driven tools not just for your own productivity, but to elevate the team's engineering practices and adoption of modern workflows

What Sets This Role Apart

- confined to one. We invest in senior engineers who master fundamentals and leverage AI-assisted tooling to work effectively on any stack
 - AI-first engineering culture: as an IC3, you will shape how your team adopts AI-driven development practices within Keyloop's AI-Driven Development Program, influencing the next generation of engineering workflows
 - True technical ownership: you will own the architecture, delivery, and operational health of critical systems, with the autonomy to drive meaningful change
 - A clear, transparent career framework with defined competency expectations and pathways to Staff Engineer (IC4), Engineering Lead (M1), or other tracks that match your ambitions
 - Real platform impact: you will work on the Fusion Automotive Retail Platform, designing solutions that connect every phase of the vehicle lifecycle at scale
 - Investment in your leadership growth through continuous coaching, a Personal Development Plan (PDP), and the AI Champions enablement program

Our Guiding Principles

We are Bold: We challenge the status quo, explore new technologies, and champion high standards for quality. 

We are Authentic: We engage in open, honest, and respectful dialogue. We admit when we are wrong and are transparent about risks. 

We are United: We adopt a platform-first mentality, collaborate seamlessly across teams, and actively mentor others to elevate the entire team. 

Why join us?

We're on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. 

An inclusive environment to thrive

We're committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day. 

Be rewarded for your efforts

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. 

Keyloop doesn't require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials. 

We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. 

"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity. "

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics. 
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design. 
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale. 
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments. 
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers. 
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues. 

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure. 
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash. 
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico. 
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia). 
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes. 
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment. 
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization. 

Qualifications & Skills

- 5+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC). 
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM). 
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico. 
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale. 
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet). 
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS). 
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing. 
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays. 
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes. 
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics. 
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives. 
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous. 
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture. 

Diversity & Inclusion

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

This role is remote.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Scopely is looking for a smart, technically strong, and process-adaptive Senior QA to join our Royal Lounge Casino team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis. 

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

With 30M+ downloads, Grand Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more! Team members are distributed across the globe with hubs in Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, among others

What You'll Do

- Write, maintain, and execute test cases for studio games across mobile and web platforms, covering a broad range of devices, operating systems, and browsers. 
 - Perform functional and non-functional testing of mobile applications, including network traffic, API responses, and log analysis. 
 - Collaborate closely with Scrum teams, Producers, Developers, and QA Leads/Managers to ensure releases meet high quality standards. 
 - Communicate proactively with Developers and business stakeholders during defect triage to reduce defect ageing and drive timely resolution. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for defects and provide corrective and preventive action plans. 
 - Work effectively in an Agile environment to support timely and high-quality product delivery. 
 - Identify quality trade-offs, project risks, and appropriate mitigation strategies. 
 - Develop a detailed understanding of studio games, including gameplay flows, player journeys, edge cases, and game-specific scenarios. 
 - Create and maintain QA documentation, including test cases, test plans, test reports, training material, and process documentation. 
 - Mentor junior QA team members and support their technical and domain growth. 
 - Partner with the QA Lead to continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and release quality. 
 - Support team coordination and delivery in the absence of the QA Lead. 

What We're Looking For

- 4-7 years of experience in software testing, preferably across mobile, web, or gaming products. 
 - Strong familiarity with mobile and web platforms from a QA perspective. 
 - Good understanding of client-server architecture, APIs, application data flow, and network debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience in test design, test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and risk-based testing. 
 - Strong exploratory testing skills, with the ability to select the right test approach based on feature complexity and risk. 
 - Experience using QA tools such as Jira, TestRail, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, browser developer tools, or similar tools. 
 - Ability to create clear and comprehensive QA documentation, including test cases, test plans, test reports, and training material. 
 - Good understanding of software testing processes, SDLC/STLC, and Agile methodologies. 
 - Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts. 
 - Strong communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills. 

Bonus Points

- Experience testing mobile games, web games, or live-service products. 
 - Passion for gaming, with a genuine interest in playing and understanding casual games. 
 - Strong gaming mindset, including an understanding of player behaviour, engagement mechanics, progression, rewards, and LiveOps. 
 - Prior experience testing Slots, Casino, or other real-money/social casino-style games. 
 - Exposure to test automation frameworks and AI-driven testing approaches. 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world's most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time "MONOPOLY GO!" and "Pokémon GO, " along with "Stumble Guys, " "Star TrekTM Fleet Command, " "MARVEL Strike Force, " "WWE Champions, " the Scrabble® franchise, "Yahtzee® With Buddies, " and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry - bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. 

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team - including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely's position as the #1 mobile games company in the U. S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like "MONOPOLY GO!" from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses - Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. 

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and "Best Workplaces for Innovators, " Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good - creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. 

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https: //www. scopely. com/. 

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely. com. 

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely. com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice. 

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25, 000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. 

Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report. 

Bechtel's India offices support the execution of projects and services around the world. Working seamlessly with Bechtel's global business units, project sites, customers, and suppliers, our teams have delivered more than 125 projects since 1994. With offices in Gurgaon, Vadodara, and Chennai there are exciting career opportunities for candidates who are passionate about delivering projects that make a lasting, meaningful difference for people and communities around the world. 

Project Overview

Please use this field to provide any standard language being used externally to describe the project (typically the first few sentences used to describe the project on the http: //bechtel. com website or in press releases) . If no overview is available, please remove this section and Talent Acquisition will add a general description for the GBU. 

Job Summary

Performs assignments that will develop professional work knowledge and abilities through the application of standard engineering techniques, procedures and criteria. Exercises limited but increasing judgment in performing assigned tasks. Using prescribed methods, performs specific and limited portions of a broader assignment of an experienced engineer. 

Supervision Received

- Receives technical and administrative supervision from Senior Engineer or Engineering Group Supervisor. 

Supervision Exercised

- Provide technical direction as appropriate to drafters, technicians and GETs who perform specific design support assignments. 

Contacts

- Maintains contact with the immediate work group or discipline and interfaces with other disciplines as specifically directed. 

Major Responsibilities

- Preparation of Design Criteria for Controls and Instrumentation. 
 - Preparation of Field Instrumentation, Control Valves & Pressure Safety Valves Data Sheet in Smart Plant Instrumentation. 
 - Perform Control Valve, Flow Element and Thermowell sizing calculations and preliminary analyses. 
 - Development of Spec, MR, Technical Bid Evaluation and Vendor Print Review of Field Instrument Packages, Control Valves, On Off Valves, Instrument Bulks. 
 - Assists in developing or reviews discipline material quantity estimates. 
 - Preparation of Complex Loop Control Narratives, Cause and Effect Matrix for Process and F&G System, logic narratives. 
 - Development of I/O data base for DCS, SIS, F&G and Mechanical Vendor Packages. 
 - Preparation of Instrument Index, Data Sheet, Wiring and Loop Diagrams, Loop Folders, Calculation in Smart Plant Instrumentation. 
 - Preparation of Level Sketches and Cable Block Diagrams. 
 - Preparation of Instrument Installation Details Bulk Material Take off and assist designers in Modelling of instruments and junction boxes. 

Education And Experience Requirements

- B Tech in Instrumentation & Control (4 Years Course) from a recognized university with 8-11 years of industry experience
 - Engineering and Design experience in Oil & Gas Feed & EPC Projects

Required Knowledge And Skills

- Basic technical knowledge of Control System engineering in Oil and Gas. 
 - Thorough knowledge of discipline engineering techniques, the design of engineered systems, and engineering and design calculations. 
 - Understanding of industry regulatory codes and standards. 
 - Broad knowledge of the application of engineering to plant constructability as applied to construction methods and materials. 
 - Job knowledge of various types of field Instrumentation, DCS, PLC, Hazardous areas is essential. 
 - Design experience or Basic knowledge of DCS / PLC and SCADA Networks, Fiber optic and CAT 6 is essential. 
 - Basic awareness industry standards Application Programs such as SPI, SPR, Flowel. 
 - Basic skills in oral and written communication

Total Rewards/Benefits

For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards

Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary

As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent. 

We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team, " respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. data.title: Senior Engineer- Instrumentation & Control
data.description:
Job Description

WSP's Resources subsector, part of our Energy, Resources & Industry (ERI) business line, supports mining and heavy industrial clients across Canada. Our teams deliver engineering and project execution excellence across the full project lifecycle-from conceptual studies and detailed design to commissioning, optimization, and beyond. 

This is your opportunity to shape high-impact infrastructure, drive innovation in automation and process control, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams delivering transformative outcomes across Canada and globally. 

Based in Noida office, as an Instrumentation & Control (I&C) Engineer, you will support instrumentation and controls engineering for both new construction and brownfield mining, metals and other heavy industrial projects, influencing project outcomes from concept through completion. Your work will help our clients operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. 

Responsibilities

The I&C Engineer shall have experience in Detailed Engineering Design and Consultancy in sectors such as Oil & gas, Bulk Material Handling, Crushers, Grinding Mills. Experience in Power Plant, Coal Grinding, Cement industry will be an added advantage and will be responsible for the following minimum services: 

- Prepare control philosophy, system architecture, and functional specifications for complex process systems
 - Coordination with other engineers internally, CA team leads and deliver the output as per the project schedule. 
 - Ensure that all deliverables are complying project & client requirements

Key Competencies / Skills

- I & C Engineer with detailed knowledge and proven application in all general instrumentation & control designs pertaining to Mining and Bulk Material Handling industry domains including statutory aspects. 
 - Strong Experience in Field Instrumentation, Control and Automation systems of Mining and Bulk Material Handling, 
 - Strong Experience in PLC, SCADA, DCS and process automation platforms. Proven ability to develop control narratives, P&IDs, loop diagrams, and I/O lists
 - Experience in executing tasks such as Owners & Lenders Engineer Consultancy, Detailed design projects, prefeasibility & FEED studies, performance testing and operational support consultancy services within the power industry, 
 - Experience in leading the Technical Meeting with Client and Contractor and prepare the MOM. 
 - Proficient in Instrumentation and control design aspects for basic, detailed & review engineering of Mining and Bulk Material handling projects. 
 - Adept to assess designs and support the project team with queries/ comments/ observations/ clarifications. 
 - Electrical understanding of the control system and how the system components interact. 
 - Ability to develop and review P&ID, electrical schematics and Logic Diagrams, control wiring diagrams, cable schedules etc. 
 - Prepare and review control systems/equipment control philosophy, specifications, data sheets, bid evaluations etc. 
 - Able to understand, verify, analyse & implement design modification requests / deviations etc. requested by client/contractors/consultants
 - Ability to maintain document database for all engineering designs, drawings and project wise technical data as per company procedures/standards. 
 - Capable of multi-tasking and managing multiple projects with the ability to predict the time required as accurately feasible to complete the deliverables. 
 - Experience in attending factory acceptance testing (FAT) of major equipment, 
 - Experience in Building Automation, CCTV, Telecom industry will be added advantage
 - Provide the engineering hours details during the Consultancy tender submission to win the project, 
 - Willingness to travel in India and overseas as and when required. 
 - Understanding of project lifecycles and the implementation in the project environment
 - Working proficiency in French language is desirable and will be considered an asset. 

Key Competencies / Skills

- Relevant experience on Oil & Gas or Power Plant or Mining/mineral processing consultation industry, EPC projects will be an added advantage. 
 - Strong knowledge of DCS, PLC and SCADA. 
 - Excellent skills in English verbal and non-verbal communication. 
 - Working hours will require up to 4 hours of overlap with North American time zone, until 12: 00 a. m. IST. 

Qualifications

- A Degree in Instrumentation and Control Engineering or related Engineering discipline. A master's degree in Instrumentation & Control Engineering is certainly advantageous. 
 - At least 10 Years proven industry experience in detailed design and consultancy of Instrumentation and control systems. 
 - Membership of relevant professional bodies is desirable. 
 - Professional Engineer (P. Eng. ) designation or eligibility in Canada. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration. 
 - Maintain product quality and cultural integrity. 
 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: 

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.
