data.title: Senior SDET –
Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering [T500-30261]
data.description:
Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

About DIRECTV: 

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer. 

About DIRECTV India GCC: 

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what's next. It's a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world's most dynamic talent markets. 

Our Purpose: 

We're here to reimagine what's possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer's needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day. 

Our Values and Culture: 

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate. 

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we're building a future better than yesterday - for our colleagues, our customers, and our company. 

Functional EVP: 

Engineer quality into every stage of delivery

Quality at DIRECTV starts long before a product reaches the customer. As part of DQE, you'll work alongside engineering teams to strengthen how software is designed, tested and released. You'll drive automation, testing and quality practices across products and platforms, helping teams identify issues earlier, improve reliability and deliver with greater confidence. 

Position Summary: 

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a talented and innovative Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering to join our Non-Functional Quality Engineering organization. This role is responsible for designing, executing, and advancing security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and AI application security capabilities that support DIRECTV's enterprise technology ecosystem. You will partner with engineering, architecture, security, and quality engineering teams to improve application resilience, identify vulnerabilities, and strengthen enterprise security posture. 

The ideal candidate combines strong offensive security expertise, a passion for application security, and a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous innovation. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Security Engineering: 

- Perform application, API, and infrastructure security assessments. 
 - Conduct penetration testing against web, mobile, API, cloud, and enterprise systems. 
 - Identify vulnerabilities and work with engineering teams to implement remediation strategies. 
 - Support ongoing security validation efforts across critical technology platforms. 

Quality & Security Delivery: 

- Partner with developers, architects, and platform teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Conduct threat assessments, vulnerability reviews, and security validation activities. 
 - Support secure development practices and DevSecOps initiatives. 
 - Contribute to continuous testing and enterprise quality engineering objectives. 

Security Automation & Innovation: 

- Develop and support automation solutions that improve security testing effectiveness. 
 - Evaluate emerging security technologies and tooling. 
 - Contribute to AI application security and LLM security testing initiatives. 
 - Support continuous improvement efforts across quality and security engineering practices

Qualifications: 

Required Experience: 

- 4-6 years of software engineering, cybersecurity, or application security experience. 
 - Experience performing offensive security and penetration testing activities. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software development principles. 
 - Experience identifying and remediating application vulnerabilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. 
 - Experience working within Agile software delivery environments. 

Required Technical Skills: 

- Offensive Security & Penetration Testing
 - Web Security
 - API Security
 - OWASP Top 10
 - OWASP API Security Top 10
 - Network & Cloud Security
 - Security Automation & Tooling
 - AI / LLM Application Security

Preferred Skills & Experience: 

- Threat Modeling
 - Security Frameworks
 - Vulnerability Remediation Programs
 - Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
 - DevSecOps Practices
 - Cloud Security Assessment Experience
 - Security Automation Initiatives

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent

Note: This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune. 

Talent Value Proposition statement: 

At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey. 

Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that. 

DIRECTV is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, qualifications, merit, and performance, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics under applicable laws.

data.title: AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation
data.description:
AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation - Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6: 00 PM and 12: 00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule. 

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About The Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. Our products include Assess and Zenflow, which support assessments, care management, clinical workflows, and operational delivery . 

We are a startup, not a department. We are building an AI-native engineering team where quality must scale at the same speed as development. 

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Software Engineer focused on QA Automation. 

This is not a manual testing role. 

This is not a role for someone who simply clicks through test cases. 

This is a software engineering role for someone who builds systems that prove whether the product works. 

Our developers build with AI agents. That means code can arrive faster than traditional QA can review it by hand. We need a QA automation engineer who can build the testing harness, automated checks, synthetic data, test environments, and agent-driven QA workflows that keep up with agent-speed development . 

Here is the test: can you build a test system, seed a real bug, prove the test catches it, and explain what is still unverified?

We are not looking for someone who signs off work because it "looks fine. " We are looking for someone who demands evidence. 

Our AI-Native QA Vision

QA at Zenara is not a downstream gate. It is an engineering platform. 

We are building toward a system where product requirements can become test plans, test data, automated browser and API checks, evidence reports, failure routing, and release confidence - with agents helping create and run the work, and engineers governing the quality. 

You will help design and operate this QA system, including: 

- Browser and API test runners
 - Synthetic test data
 - Isolated test environments
 - Requirement-to-test workflows
 - Automated checks on every change
 - Agent-driven QA workflows
 - Evidence generation for releases
 - Flaky-test reduction
 - Failure routing and debugging
 - Quality metrics and release confidence

The goal is not to automate bad testing. The goal is to build a system that catches real defects before customers do. 

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain the QA automation harness across browser, API, data, and workflow layers. 
 - Create automated checks that run on every meaningful change. 
 - Build synthetic test data and isolated test environments. 
 - Own the UAT/QA automation pipeline from requirement to test plan to run to evidence
 - Use AI agents to help generate, execute, improve, and debug tests. 
 - Build independent agent-driven QA workflows that test the work of code-writing agents. 
 - Prove tests work by reintroducing known bugs and showing they fail correctly. 
 - Reduce flaky tests and distinguish real product failures from environment noise. 
 - Produce reliable QA evidence for releases. 
 - Work with engineering and product to define quality gates for critical user journeys. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong software engineering ability: you can design, write, debug, and maintain code. 
 - Experience with test automation using Playwright, Cypress, API testing frameworks, or similar tools. 
 - CI/CD experience and comfort wiring tests into build and release workflows. 
 - Practical experience using AI agents to create or improve tests. 
 - Strong judgment about whether a test actually proves anything. 
 - Ability to seed a bug, run a test, and demonstrate that the test catches the failure. 
 - Comfort debugging flaky tests, environment issues, and test data problems. 
 - Skeptical, evidence-driven thinking. 
 - Clear communication around risk, coverage, and release confidence. 

Our Current Stack

- TypeScript 
 - Node. js, Hono 
 - React 
 - Prisma, PostgreSQL 
 - Redis, BullMQ 
 - Playwright 
 - Azure AKS, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry 
 - Terraform, Helm, CI pipelines 
 - Medplum / FHIR 
 - Flowable 
 - Claude Code, Codex 
 - Dify-based AI workflows

What "AI-Native QA" Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can: 

- Use agents to generate test ideas, test code, and edge cases
 - Review agent-created tests critically
 - Build workflows where agents test independently from the agents that wrote the code
 - Use AI to analyze failures and propose debugging paths
 - Create repeatable quality gates that scale with development speed
 - Measure whether AI-generated tests are actually useful
 - Avoid false confidence from tests that pass without proving behavior

The point is not to have more tests. The point is to have trustworthy evidence. 

Nice to Have

- Healthcare or regulated-software experience. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered features, including output quality. 
 - Experience building test environments and synthetic data. 
 - Performance or load testing experience. 

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will map the current QA setup, agree the highest-risk user journeys, and deliver one automated end-to-end QA lane that runs on every change and catches a known bug . 

Within your first 90 days, key journeys for Assess and Zenflow will be covered automatically, every release will have QA evidence, and flaky-test rate and run time will be measured and improving . 

Over time, success means building a mature agentic QA platform where escaped defects are low and QA throughput keeps pace with agent-speed development . 

Outside required collaboration, we care about output, reliability, and quality. 

Compensation And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
 - Fully remote work
 - Equipment allowance
 - Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
 - The opportunity to build the QA function as an engineering platform from the ground up

Who Will Thrive In This Role

This role is well suited to someone who: 

- Thinks like an engineer, not a manual checklist executor
 - Enjoys building tools, systems, and automation
 - Is naturally skeptical and evidence-driven
 - Cares about proving behavior, not just producing green checkmarks
 - Wants to make QA scale with AI-native development
 - Likes working in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments

You may struggle if you only have manual testing experience, cannot code, sign off work without evidence, or write tests that pass regardless of whether the product is correct . 

If you want to build the quality system for an AI-native software team, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Specialist, Quality Engineer
data.description:
If you're passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide's Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, "on your side" goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we're looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. 

Role Summary

Specialist QA Engineer - Job Requirements

We are seeking a Specialist QA Engineer to strengthen quality across web applications, APIs, and integrated services. The role requires hands-on API and performance testing, alongside test automation, observability practices, and CI/CD integration to help teams deliver reliable software at pace. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience in software quality engineering, including designing test strategies and translating requirements into clear, risk-based test coverage. 
 - Strong programming experience in at least one of: Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain automated test code. 
 - Practical experience developing browser automation with Playwright and/or Selenium; able to create maintainable, reusable tests and troubleshoot failures. 
 - Experience applying the Page Object Model (POM) or an equivalent page/component abstraction to organize UI automation. 
 - Experience with BDD-style testing and Cucumber, including writing or maintaining readable feature scenarios and step definitions. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and tools such as Harness; familiarity with Rancher-based environments is an advantage. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and executing API tests for REST and SOAP services and validating integrations, including systems built with Mule or MuleSoft; able to verify functional behavior, error handling, and end-to-end flows across dependent services. 
 - Hands-on experience planning and executing performance and load tests using JMeter, analyzing results, identifying bottlenecks, and communicating performance risks and findings. 
 - Experience with database testing, including data validation and verification of application-to-database behavior; familiarity with Oracle Database and relational and non-relational database concepts. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, New Relic, and Splunk (or equivalent platforms) to investigate test and production issues. 
 - Experience using AI prompting to support QA work, such as generating or refining test scenarios, test data ideas, and defect-analysis summaries; able to validate AI-generated output for accuracy, security, and suitability before use. 
 - Familiarity with Jira for managing test-related work, tracking defects, and communicating status within a delivery team. 
 - Experience working within Agile methodologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams through planning, refinement, execution, and retrospectives. 
 - Strong defect investigation, root-cause analysis, test reporting, and communication skills; able to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and operations teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building AI agents is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting test automation in containerized or Kubernetes environments, including deployments managed with Rancher. 
 - Experience combining UI, API, integration, and performance testing in a cohesive quality strategy. 
 - Familiarity with test data management, mocking/stubbing, parallel test execution, and reducing flaky tests. 
 - Experience contributing to continuous-delivery quality gates and release-readiness decisions. 

What Success Looks Like

- Automated tests are maintainable, useful, and integrated into delivery pipelines. 
 - Test results provide actionable feedback, and defects are identified early with clear evidence and reproducible steps. 
 - Performance and observability signals are used to help teams diagnose risk and improve service reliability. 

Job Description Summary

If you're enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

As a Quality Engineer you will plan and conduct a wide range of software quality tests and analyses to ensure all application products and services meet organizational standards aligned to their quality management approach, as well as, end-user requirements. All Quality Engineers perform quality planning, quality design and execution. 

You will focus on a blend of skills enabling efficient execution of risk-based testing, test automation, performance testing, test data management, test environment management, continuous integration and continuous deployment all improving speed to delivery for our business partners. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Carries out procedures to ensure all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements.

 - Applies secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities. 
 - Plans for the proper mix of manual, automated, and exploratory testing methods.

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns - they are part of the product . . 

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us. 

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations. 

This is not a narrow DevOps ticket role. 

This is not a compliance paperwork role. 

This is a hands-on platform ownership role. 

Today, platform, security, and compliance work is spread across people who are already covering other responsibilities. We need one full-time owner who keeps systems running, backed up, updated, monitored, secure, and HIPAA-ready . . 

You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and a part-time senior security and compliance consultant . . 

Here is the test: can you prove that backups restore, deployments roll back, secrets are controlled, alerts work, access is locked down, and compliance evidence exists before a customer asks for it?

We are looking for a calm, methodical operator who automates the boring things, finds the scary things, and closes the important gaps. 

Our Platform Vision

We are building an AI-native healthcare software company. That means our platform must support speed without creating unacceptable risk. 

The platform should make the safe path the easy path: reliable deployments, observable systems, tested recovery, controlled access, documented evidence, automated checks, and continuous security awareness. 

You will help build this operating system, including: 

- Deployment and rollback workflows
 - Monitoring and alerting
 - Backups and restore verification
 - Secrets and access management
 - Cloud configuration reviews
 - Security checks on new code and infrastructure
 - HIPAA compliance evidence
 - Vendor and AI-tool risk tracking
 - Daily automated security and compliance checks
 - Incident response basics
 - Platform documentation and runbooks

The goal is to create a platform that lets a small engineering team move fast without gambling with production or patient data. 

What You'll Do

- Own production platform operations: deployments, monitoring, alerts, updates, and reliability. 
 - Own backups and regularly prove restores work . 
 - Manage access control, secrets, cloud configuration, and security checks. 
 - Organize HIPAA-related policies, controls, audit evidence, and customer security documentation . 
 - Identify, prioritize, and close platform and security gaps. 
 - Build a daily security and compliance agent that sweeps systems and reports findings . 
 - Work weekly with a senior security and compliance consultant. 
 - Create runbooks, checklists, and automation for repeatable operational work. 
 - Support incident response, recovery, and prevention. 
 - Help free other team members from ad hoc platform and security work. 

What We're Looking For

- Hands-on experience keeping startup systems and platforms running
 - Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, and recovery experience
 - Experience with access control, secrets management, cloud configuration, and security basics
 - Ability to prove backups restore and systems recover
 - Ability to code and automate routine platform or security tasks
 - Comfort using AI agents to build automation and operational workflows
 - Calm judgment during incidents and production issues
 - Strong ownership and documentation habits
 - Practical mindset: you can prioritize risks rather than create endless theoretical lists

Our Current Stack

- Azure AKS / Kubernetes
 - Azure Blob Storage
 - Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
 - Terraform
 - Helm
 - CI pipelines
 - PostgreSQL
 - Redis
 - Some AWS
 - TypeScript applications using Node. js / Hono and React
 - Medplum / FHIR
 - Healthcare data, HIPAA, patient-data protection, vendor risk, and AI-tool risk

What "AI-Native Platform Engineering" Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can: 

- Use agents to inspect configurations, draft runbooks, and automate checks
 - Build recurring security and compliance sweeps
 - Use AI to accelerate infrastructure review without blindly trusting it
 - Create workflows that surface risks before humans remember to check
 - Automate operational evidence gathering
 - Maintain human approval for sensitive actions
 - Keep permissions, secrets, and production access tightly controlled
 - AI should help you create a more reliable platform, not become another unmanaged risk

Nice to Have

- Healthcare or HIPAA experience
 - Security background, such as cloud security, SOC, or incident response
 - Compliance framework experience, especially HIPAA or SOC 2
 - Azure and AKS production experience
 - Kubernetes at production scale

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review the current setup, agree the top platform and security gaps, demonstrate a backup restore and deployment rollback, and produce a prioritized improvement list . . 

Within your first 90 days, monitoring and alerting will be in place, top security gaps will be closed, the first version of the daily security/compliance agent will be running, and compliance evidence will be organized . . 

Over time, success means Zenara has a reliable, secure, HIPAA-ready platform, clean customer security reviews, and platform work no longer depends on non-specialists. 

Schedule

Live collaboration requires overlap with the US team. For engineering roles, the current collaboration window is approximately 6: 00 PM to 12: 00 AM IST, though final expectations should be confirmed during the hiring process. 

Production incidents and critical deployments may occasionally require availability outside normal collaboration windows. 

Compensation And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
 - Fully remote work
 - Equipment allowance
 - Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
 - Support from a senior security expert

Who Will Thrive In This Role

This role is well suited to someone who: 

- Is calm, methodical, and reliable
 - Likes automating operational work
 - Cares about security but can still move pragmatically
 - Wants broad ownership across DevOps, security, and compliance
 - Can operate independently without a large platform team
 - Understands that healthcare data requires discipline

You may struggle if you want a large ops team around you, only want one narrow specialty, treat compliance as paperwork only, cannot automate, or are careless with secrets and access. 

If you want to build the operating foundation for an AI-native health-tech company, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description: 

The Senior Controls Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle management of software for industrial automation and control systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, industrial networking, and machine automation using Siemens, Beckhoff, Bosch Rexroth, B&R automation platforms or a combination of these automation platforms. 

Essential duties and responsibilities: 

- Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning. 
 - Develop PLC, HMI/SCADA, motion control, safety, and industrial communication software. 
 - Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices. 
 - Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation. 
 - Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support. 
 - Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Participate in the review of electrical designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 
 - Troubleshoot control systems and optimize machine performance. 
 - Participate in software code reviews and maintain software quality standards. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives, software standardization, and engineering best practices. 
 - Maintain project schedules and communicate technical progress to project stakeholders. 

Requirements & Experience

- Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning. 
 - Experience designing and implementing control systems for custom automation projects. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, and motion control. 
 - Experience integrating servo systems, drives, motors, robotics, sensors, and vision systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols including: 
 - Profinet
 - EtherCAT
 - Ethernet/IP
 - Modbus TCP
 - OPC UA
 - Experience with Safety PLCs and machine safety devices. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and commissioning skills. 
 - Experience with software version control and software lifecycle management. 
 - Ability to prepare technical documentation including: 
 - Functional Design Specifications
 - Software Architecture
 - I/O Lists
 - User Manuals
 - Electrical Documentation
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams). 

Education

- Bachelor's Degree in one of the following disciplines: 
 - Electronics & Communication Engineering
 - Instrumentation & Control Engineering
 - Mechatronics Engineering
 - Electrical Engineering
 - Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning. 

Key Result Areas: 

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI applications for custom machine automation. 
 - Deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable control software. 
 - Follow software change management procedures and maintain version control. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine commissioning, and production startup. 
 - Provide technical support during installation and post-deployment activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with engineering standards and customer requirements. 
 - Deliver assigned projects on time while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction. 

Travel: 

- Domestic and international travel may be required, up to 20%, depending on project requirements.

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

 - Ladder Logic

 - Structured Text

 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage.

- Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
 - Develop individual engineers through regular 1: 1s, coaching, and honest feedback
 - Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast-moving workstream as scope grows

Delivery and operations

- Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
 - Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
 - Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

- Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
 - Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
 - Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders

Strategy and growth

- Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
 - Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
 - Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development

What We Value

Ownership and independence You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through. 

Management experience You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement. 

Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off. 

Communication clarity You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums. 

Result orientation and a growth mindset You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's. 

Distributed team experience and empathy Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus. 

Structured thinking in ambiguous situations AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision. 

Collaborative by default You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back - and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader's network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India's Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group's Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it's a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet "Blue Darter" with honour. 

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India's supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 

Position Overview: 

The Service Centre Incharge - Operations (Non Metro / BDO) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities across one or more assigned Non Metro Branches, Business Development Offices (BDOs) or Service Centres. The role oversees inbound and outbound shipment processing, pickup and delivery coordination, customer service support, manpower deployment and operational governance to ensure seamless day-to-day operations. 

Reporting to the Assistant Manager - Operations (Area Operations), the incumbent provides frontline leadership to operational teams, ensuring adherence to service commitments, operational productivity, safety, compliance and Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures while delivering consistent customer experience and supporting business continuity across the assigned locations. 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage end-to-end shift operations across assigned Non Metro Branches and BDO locations by ensuring efficient shipment processing, timely pickups and dispatches, optimal workforce utilisation, operational discipline and consistent service delivery while maintaining safety, compliance and customer satisfaction. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

End-to-End Shift Operations

- Lead and supervise all inbound, outbound, pickup and dispatch activities during the assigned shift. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, processing, sorting, scanning, loading and dispatch of shipments in line with operational timelines. 
 - Monitor operational workflow across assigned BDOs and Service Centres to ensure seamless shipment movement. 
 - Ensure operational readiness to manage daily volumes, peak periods and contingency situations. 

Shipment Processing & Service Quality

- Ensure accurate scanning, sorting, bagging, routing and reconciliation of all shipments.

 - Support resolution of operational issues impacting deliveries and pickups. 
 - Coordinate with transport, network and customer service teams to ensure smooth operational execution. 

People Leadership & Shift Management

- Plan and deploy manpower effectively across operational activities and assigned locations.

 - Conduct daily shift briefings covering operational priorities, safety and productivity expectations. 
 - Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline and workforce productivity while promoting teamwork and accountability. 

Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline

- Ensure adherence to Blue Dart Standard Operating Procedures, operational guidelines and statutory requirements. 
 - Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with safety standards and security procedures. 
 - Ensure prescribed uniform, identity card and personal protective equipment are used wherever applicable. 
 - Maintain high standards of housekeeping, operational discipline and ethical conduct across all assigned locations. 

Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement

- Monitor daily operational performance and productivity against defined targets. 
 - Ensure timely completion of operational documentation, system updates and shift reports. 
 - Conduct effective shift handovers and escalate operational risks or service issues promptly. 
 - Support implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet, Security, Network Operations and Area Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery. 
 - Build effective working relationships across internal teams and operational partners. 
 - Support implementation of new operational initiatives, business priorities and process improvements. 
 - Act as the primary operational contact for assigned locations during the shift. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

Education: 

- Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university. 

Experience: 

- 2-5 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, warehousing, distribution or supply chain operations. 
 - Experience in managing end-to-end Service Centre operations, including inbound, outbound, pickup and delivery activities. 
 - Proven experience in leading frontline operational teams and coordinating shift operations. 
 - Exposure to shipment processing, scanning, sorting, reconciliation, dispatch and customer service operations. 
 - Experience working with operational systems, handheld scanners and operational reporting will be an advantage. 

Skills & Capabilities: 

Technical Skills: 

- End-to-End Shift Operations Management

 - Shipment Processing & Dispatch Management 
 - Pickup & Delivery Coordination 
 - Workforce Planning & Shift Management 
 - Productivity & Resource Utilization 
 - Operational Reporting & MIS 
 - Operational Systems & Scanner Usage 
 - Safety & Regulatory Compliance 
 - Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Key Competencies: 

- Operational Leadership 
 - Planning & Organising 
 - Decision Making 
 - Customer Focus 
 - Team Leadership & Coaching 
 - Problem Solving 
 - Accountability & Ownership 
 - Communication & Collaboration 
 - Integrity & Ethical Conduct 
 - Operational Discipline 
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset

Key Performance Indicators: 

KRAs

KPIs

Operational Performance

Inbound & Outbound SLA adherence; On-time shipment processing; Dispatch timeliness

Service Quality

Shipment accuracy; Scanning compliance; Reduction in shipment exceptions and operational errors

Pickup & Delivery Performance

Pickup & Delivery SLA adherence; Timely vehicle turnaround; Customer service support

Productivity

Shift productivity; Manpower utilization; Resource optimization

Safety & Compliance

SOP adherence; Audit compliance; Safety & security compliance; Housekeeping standards

Operational Governance

Shift reporting accuracy; Timely documentation; Effective shift handover; Timely escalation of operational issues

People Leadership

Team productivity; Coaching & capability development; Attendance & workforce discipline

Continuous Improvement

Participation in process improvement initiatives; Productivity and service enhancement

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you're not just taking a job-you're becoming part of a purpose-led movement that's reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don't just deliver parcels-we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day. 

Here's what makes us stand out: 

- Great Place to Work® Certified-a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being. 
 - Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact. 
 - Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever. 
 - Best-in-class benefits-from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off. 
 - A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking-where your voice is heard and your contributions matter. 
 - Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that's not just a logistics leader-but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

data.title: Lead GenAI Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Lead GenAI Engineer - Generative AI, Agentic AI & Azure

Location: Hybrid - Bengaluru

Employment : Full Time With VDart Digital

Joining Preference: Immediate Joiners / Short Notice Preferred

Role Overview

- We are seeking an experienced GenAI Lead Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Python, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Microsoft Azure to lead the technical design and delivery of enterprise-grade AI solutions. 
 - The ideal candidate will combine deep software engineering capabilities with expertise in LLM architectures, multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and Azure AI services. This role involves driving technical decisions, establishing engineering best practices, mentoring engineers, and delivering scalable, secure, and production-ready AI applications. 
 - The candidate should be capable of translating business objectives into robust technical solutions while remaining hands-on with architecture, development, integration, and deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, architecture, development, and deployment of Generative AI and Agentic AI applications using Python and Azure AI services. 
 - Design and implement agentic workflows involving planning, reasoning, tool calling, multi-agent collaboration, and autonomous task execution. 
 - Architect scalable LLM-based solutions using RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. 
 - Drive technical implementation using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and other relevant Azure services. 
 - Develop and review production-grade Python applications, backend services, APIs, and reusable AI components. 
 - Establish best practices for prompt engineering, context management, model selection, agent orchestration, and response grounding. 
 - Lead the implementation of AI orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Design enterprise integrations connecting AI agents with APIs, databases, business applications, and external tools. 
 - Define strategies for LLM evaluation, agent testing, hallucination mitigation, observability, latency optimization, and cost management. 
 - Ensure AI solutions follow security, privacy, governance, responsible AI, and enterprise compliance requirements. 
 - Lead code reviews, technical design discussions, engineering standards, and troubleshooting of complex production issues. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers, collaborate with architects and stakeholders, and drive technical delivery across the AI development lifecycle. 
 - Work with DevOps, cloud, security, and platform teams to establish reliable CI/CD pipelines and production deployment practices. Required Skills and Experience

- 8 to 12 years of software engineering experience
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering production-grade Generative AI applications. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Agentic AI, agent orchestration, tool calling, and multi-step or multi-agent workflows. 
 - Deep understanding of LLM architectures, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, and context management. 
 - Strong practical experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, particularly Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search or equivalent Azure AI capabilities. 
 - Experience architecting and developing scalable Python-based applications, APIs, and microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or comparable agent frameworks. 
 - Experience designing enterprise-grade AI integrations with APIs, databases, document repositories, and business systems. 
 - Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, agent reliability, hallucination mitigation, security guardrails, and production observability. 
 - Experience with application architecture, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, Docker, and cloud deployment. 
 - Ability to make technical decisions, solve complex engineering challenges, and translate business requirements into practical AI solutions. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, technical leadership, and mentoring capabilities. Preferred Skills

- Experience designing secure, scalable AI solutions using Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, AKS, or other Azure hosting services. 
 - Knowledge of Azure identity and security capabilities, including Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, and role-based access control. 
 - Experience with AI tracing, monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and production performance optimization. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, responsible AI practices, data privacy, and access-controlled retrieval. 
 - Experience establishing reusable AI engineering frameworks, reference architectures, and development standards. 
 - Exposure to MLOps, LLMOps, infrastructure automation, and enterprise-scale AI platform integration.

The ideal candidate will independently design, develop, and own scalable, secure, and reliable applications across the full technology stack. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, React, microservices, relational databases, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies. Experience with event-driven architectures, observability, and AI/LLM integration is a strong plus. 

  

What you will do

- Design, develop, and maintain Java/Spring Boot services and RESTful APIs, taking end-to-end ownership of features and services.

 - Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews, providing technical guidance and constructive feedback. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to improving engineering practices across the team. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Design, Security, and other engineering teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, API specifications, architecture decisions, and operational runbooks. 
 - Identify and drive opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Evaluate and integrate AI/LLM capabilities into product features where appropriate, including LLM APIs, RAG-based solutions, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.   

What you will have

- 6+ years of professional software development experience with strong hands-on full-stack development experience. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and microservices architecture. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, hooks, component design, and state management. 
 - Solid understanding of OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, and SAML. Experience with Okta, Azure AD, or similar identity providers is highly desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and software architecture. 
 - Experience designing and developing applications for scalability, availability, reliability, performance, and security. 
 - Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, SQL optimization, and troubleshooting. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with Helm and/or Terraform and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Experience with production troubleshooting, observability, monitoring, and incident management. 
 - Strong understanding of automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. 
 - Ability to independently own complex features and make effective technical decisions with minimal supervision. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction.   

Nice to have

- Experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, digital certificates, or PKI. 
 - Experience with Kafka or other event-driven/event-streaming architectures. 
 - Experience designing and operating highly available distributed systems at scale. 
 - Familiarity with feature flags, blue/green deployments, canary releases, or progressive delivery strategies. 
 - Experience building AI-powered product capabilities using LLM APIs, RAG, prompt engineering, or generative AI. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into Java and/or React applications. 
 - Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives or architecture improvements. 
 - Contributions to engineering standards, technical strategy, or developer productivity initiatives. 
 - Experience leading technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams.   

Benefits

- Generous time off policies
 - Top shelf benefits
 - Education, wellness and lifestyle support

data.title: Lead - Digital Construction [T500-28816]
data.description:
About Suffolk: 

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment through Suffolk Technologies. 

With more than $10 billion in annual revenue and projects across healthcare, life sciences, higher education, mission critical, aviation, transportation, commercial, and other complex sectors, Suffolk is redefining how America builds through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. 

About Suffolk Global: 

Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds. 

By partnering closely with teams across the United States, Suffolk Global will help drive quality, scalability, and innovation while creating new opportunities for technical professionals to contribute to some of the most complex construction projects in North America. 

About Digital Delivery: 

Suffolk is building the next generation of Digital Delivery capabilities to transform how buildings are designed, coordinated, and constructed. By combining Building Information Modeling (BIM), data-driven workflows, automation, and emerging technologies, our goal is to create a more connected, efficient, and predictable project delivery process. 

As part of this vision, Suffolk Global is establishing a high-performing Digital Delivery team in Bangalore that will partner directly with project teams across the United States. Together, we will develop scalable modeling standards, improve coordination workflows, enhance quality through digital reviews, and create innovative solutions that support some of the most complex construction projects in North America. 

This is an opportunity to help build a new capability from the ground up and play a leadership role in defining how Digital Delivery services are delivered globally. 

Lead - Digital Construction

Title: Digital Delivery Lead

Location: Bangalore, India (Onsite)

Role Summary; 

The Digital Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple projects and teams. This role provides technical oversight, resource coordination, quality management, and team leadership to ensure the successful delivery of BIM models, coordination services, constructability reviews, and digital project deliverables. 

The Digital Delivery Lead serves as the primary connection between project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and production staff, ensuring that work is delivered efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with Suffolk standards. This role is responsible for developing team capability, driving accountability, and establishing a culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Delivery Leadership: 

- Lead execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple concurrent projects. 
 - Coordinate project assignments, priorities, and workloads across Digital Delivery Engineers and Senior Digital Delivery Engineers. 
 - Monitor project schedules, deliverables, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution. 
 - Identify delivery risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for technical and project delivery challenges. 

Team Leadership & Development: 

- Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentoring for Digital Delivery team members. 
 - Support onboarding and development of new staff. 
 - Conduct regular reviews of work quality and performance. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Support career development planning and technical skill growth across the team. 

Quality & Standards Management: 

- Ensure compliance with Suffolk Digital Delivery standards, workflows, and governance processes. 
 - Oversee QA/QC reviews across assigned projects. 
 - Monitor model quality, coordination performance, and deliverable consistency. 
 - Drive adoption of standards, templates, content libraries, and best practices. 
 - Review lessons learned and implement corrective actions where needed. 

Technical Oversight: 

- Provide technical guidance related to BIM modeling, coordination, constructability analysis, and content development. 
 - Support resolution of complex technical issues and project challenges. 
 - Collaborate with Senior Digital Delivery Engineers to maintain standards and technical consistency. 
 - Ensure proper application of modeling workflows and coordination processes. 

Stakeholder Management: 

- Collaborate with U. S. -based project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and project stakeholders. 
 - Support project planning and workload forecasting activities. 
 - Communicate project status, risks, resource needs, and delivery performance. 
 - Build strong working relationships across project and operational teams. 

Operational Excellence: 

- Monitor team utilization and workload balancing. 
 - Support staffing and resource planning activities. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and delivery performance. 
 - Drive implementation of process improvements and operational best practices. 
 - Contribute to the growth and scalability of Suffolk Global's Digital Delivery organization. 

Required Qualifications: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline. 

Experience: 

- 8-12 years of experience in BIM, Digital Delivery, VDC, architecture, engineering, or construction technology. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading BIM delivery teams or coordination teams on complex building projects. 
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities. 

Technical Skills: 

- Expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit. 
 - Strong experience with BIM coordination and clash detection workflows. 
 - Deep understanding of BIM standards, model governance, QA/QC processes, and digital delivery best practices. 
 - Experience with BIM content development, template management, and standards implementation. 
 - Strong understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP systems. 

Leadership Skills: 

- Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams. 
 - Strong organizational and planning skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance technical quality with delivery commitments. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with Navisworks Manage. 
 - Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360. 
 - Experience with point cloud and Scan-to-BIM workflows. 
 - Experience developing BIM standards and enterprise delivery processes. 
 - Experience supporting global or distributed project teams. 

Success Measures: 

A successful Digital Delivery Lead will: 

- Deliver projects on schedule and in accordance with quality expectations. 
 - Maintain high levels of team productivity and utilization. 
 - Improve model quality, QA/QC performance, and coordination outcomes across projects. 
 - Successfully develop and mentor Digital Delivery team members. 
 - Ensure consistent adoption of Digital Delivery standards and workflows. 
 - Build strong partnerships with project teams and stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the growth, scalability, and operational maturity of the Digital Delivery organization.

data.title: Systems Engineering Technical Coordination Lead
data.description:
About Acron Aviation (Avionics - Surveillance)

Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle. 

Job Title

Systems Engineering Technical Coordination Lead India

Position Summary

Acron Aviation is seeking a Systems Engineering Functional Lead & HCL Coordinator to lead independent systems development and verification and validation (IV&V) activities for safety-critical avionics products. This role serves as the primary offshore focal point between Acron Aviation engineering teams and HCL delivery teams, ensuring execution quality, technical rigor, schedule alignment, and certification readiness. 

The successful candidate will combine hands-on technical development and verification expertise with team leadership, partner coordination, and day-to-day execution management. This individual will provide technical direction, oversee work assignments, review deliverables, drive issue resolution, and maintain alignment across software, systems, hardware, certification, and program stakeholders. 

This is a highly visible role requiring strong ownership, technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision across globally distributed teams. This role may require occasional international travel to Acron Aviation sites, customer locations, certification events, and engineering integration activities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Coordination
 - Act as the primary interface between Acron Aviation U. S. engineering teams, Acron India engineering teams, and HCL delivery teams, ensuring alignment of priorities, resources, deliverables, and schedules. 
 - Lead daily execution of systems activities for avionics products
 - Plan, assign, review, and monitor Development and V&V work packages while ensuring quality, schedule, and technical objectives are achieved
 - Identify and escalate technical risks, resource constraints, dependencies, and schedule impacts proactively
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including process optimization, automation, AI-enabled tools, and verification efficiency enhancements
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance to offshore Development and V&V team members
 - Support onboarding of new team members, including tool access, process training, and development environment setup
 - Systems and Software Verification
 - Define, review, and execute verification activities for system requirements, interface requirements, and integration requirements
 - Develop and execute requirements and requirements-based testing, analysis, inspections, and reviews in accordance with certification objectives
 - Author and maintain systems requirements, test procedures, test cases, automated test assets, test reports, and verification artifacts
 - Partner with systems development teams to investigate coverage gaps, resolve anomalies, and close certification findings
 - Certification and Compliance Support
 - Support certification activities in accordance with FAA and EASA expectations
 - Participate in Systems Reviews (SR) and Stage of Involvement (SOI) audits and certification reviews
 - Prepare and review certification evidence packages and compliance documentation
 - Author or review requirements, verification plans, procedures, test reports, traceability data, coverage reports, and certification support documentation
 - Ensure requirements and design evidence is complete, traceable, and audit-ready
 - Requirements Traceability and Defect Management
 - Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements, design artifacts, source code, tests, verification results, and problem reports
 - Utilize approved requirements, configuration management, and defect tracking tools
 - Lead defect triage activities for software and integrated system anomalies
 - Support root cause investigations, corrective action verification, and objective evidence collection
 - Cross-Functional Leadership
 - Coordinate across systems, software, hardware, quality, configuration management, certification, and program teams
 - Lead technical reviews, readiness reviews, and status meetings
 - Create clear work instructions and tasking packages that enable consistent execution across distributed teams
 - Provide regular status reporting, metrics, risk visibility, and closure plans to program and engineering leadership

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
 - 8-12 years of experience in avionics systems verification, software verification, IV&V, or embedded systems validation within regulated environments
 - Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required to support engineering, certification, and program activities. 
 - Experience leading small to medium-sized engineering teams, work packages, or supplier-delivered activities
 - Strong knowledge of ARP-4754A and systems lifecycle verification activities
 - Familiarity with ARP4754, DO-178 and DO-254 concepts and systnes/hardware/software integration environments
 - Experience supporting certification programs involving FAA, EASA, or equivalent regulatory authorities
 - Hands-on troubleshooting experience within avionics or embedded systems environments
 - Experience using requirements, configuration management, and defect tracking tools such as: 
 - IBM DOORS
 - Matlab
 - Windchill
 - ClearCase/ClearQuest or equivalent tools
 - Strong verbal and written English communication skills
 - Experience using automation and AI tools to streamline workflows and improve operational efficiency
 - Demonstrated a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to evaluate processes and implement more effective ways of working
 - Ability to adopt and promote automation and AI tools to improve team speed, quality, and execution

Preferred Additional Skills

- Experience supporting offshore engineering delivery models and external engineering partners
 - Experience working directly with HCL or similar engineering service organizations
 - Familiarity with ARP4754A, ARP4761, and DO-330
 - Knowledge of avionics communication protocols, including: 
 - ARINC 429
 - MIL-STD-1553
 - ARINC 664 (AFDX)
 - CAN
 - Ethernet
 - Serial interfaces
 - Experience with SIL, HIL, and avionics integration laboratories
 - Exposure to AI-enabled engineering tools and workflow automation
 - Current valid U. S. business visa (B1/B2 or equivalent) and ability to travel internationally on short notice. 
 - Previous experience supporting global engineering programs requiring travel to customers, certification, or company sites. 
 - Candidates who already possess a valid U. S. business visa (B1/B2 or equivalent) are strongly preferred.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary

The Flex Solution Principal Engineer serves as the technical owner and primary engineering contact for assigned OEM customer programs, working directly with OEM engineering leaders and Qualcomm's senior technical stakeholders. The role drives customer-specific Flex Platform development and leads cross-functional teams spanning platform, ADAS software, validation, and build engineering. The role also models and assesses system performance for digital cockpit and ADAS workloads by comparing projections with real-world implementations. 

The principal engineer shall enable successful, scalable adoption of Qualcomm Digital Cockpit Platform and ADAS solutions across OEM programs by orchestrating multi-party alignment, ensuring robust integration, and driving safety, performance, and time-to-market outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Collaborate directly with OEM engineering teams to understand vehicle E/E architectures, backend systems, functional requirements, performance targets, and real-world constraints. 
 - Act as a senior hands‐on technical leader, directly involved in system design decisions, integration trade‐offs, issue triage, and root‐cause analysis across Digital Cockpit and ADAS domains. 
 - Manage multiple OEM Flex and ADAS program solution teams, supported by technical leads reporting to this role. 
 - Provide senior technical leadership across Qualcomm Automotive engineering teams to shape and deliver customer-specific features. 
 - Define the Flex Solutions team's technical roadmap to anticipate evolving customer needs for automotive middleware across Flex and ADAS systems. 
 - Perform Flex‐based Digital Cockpit system integration using QNX RTOS, AUTOSAR Classic and Adaptive stacks and Android including configuration, integration, and validation. 
 - Integrate ADAS software stacks (Perception and Drive Policy), analyse end‐to‐end data flows and latency, and actively profile, assess, and tune system performance to meet Flex platform characterization and workload targets. 
 - Lead BSP and driver bring-up on customer hardware, troubleshoot low-level boot and runtime issues, and configure Qualcomm software products on customer hardware. 
 - Develop deep, practical expertise in Qualcomm Digital Cockpit and ADAS platforms at the SoC, system, and software stack levels. 
 - Co-Work with customer/Tier 1 team for Flex solution system budgets, conduct system performance analysis against worst case customer and suggest solutions interfacing with internal technical teams

Drive Continuous integration of software components for digital cockpit/ADAS subsystems and triage regressions

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

- 3+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc. 

Key Responsibilities

Flex Solution integration on Reference and Customer Hardware

- Tier 1/OEM support for integration of Flex Platform BSP and ADAS stack on the customer's hardware

Flex Characterization for mixed criticality Systems· Perform system characterization by executing envelope and stress use‐case tests that simulate worst‐case workload conditions, validating that the Flex Platform solution provides sufficient performance headroom to support OEM‐specific extensions and future scalability. Program Execution & Delivery

- Provide overarching technical leadership for identified the OEM, across all phases (concept, development, validation, SOP, and maintenance). 
 - Coordinate and synchronize Qualcomm internal engineering teams (HW, SW, systems, safety, security, tools, test) to meet customer milestones. 
 - Drive resolution of critical technical issues, ensuring timely escalation and clear communication to both customer and Qualcomm management. 
 - Support design reviews, technical workshops, joint debugging sessions, and on-site integration activities as needed. 

Technical Thought Leadership & Mentoring

- Act as a technical role model: hands-on, detail-oriented, and able to deep-dive into complex system issues when required. 
 - Guide and mentor cross-functional Qualcomm teams working on the customer, helping them prioritize and solve problems effectively. 
 - Contribute to the best internal practices for customer engagement and ADAS solution definition. 

Customer Technical Leadership

- Act as the chief technical counterpart to the OEM's engineering leadership for all ADAS and related programs. 
 - Serve as the main technical point of contact covering SoC, platform software, algorithms, tools, and system integration topics. 
 - Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with the customer's engineering executives, architects, and program leads. 

Customer Roadmap & System Architecture

- Develop and maintain a detailed understanding of the customer's
 - E/E and compute architecture (in-vehicle and backend/cloud)
 - ADAS/AD roadmap and feature roadmap
 - Safety, security, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements

- Anticipate customer needs and translate them into Qualcomm platform requirements, features, and solutions. 

Required Qualifications

- 18+ years of experience in senior engineering roles in the Digital Cockpit/ADAS / AD domain at an OEM, Tier-1, semiconductor, or relevant technology supplier. 
 - Experience working directly with major global OEMs on large-scale mixed critical Digital Cockpit/ADAS programs. 
 - Strong background in Tier 1 automotive systems engineering with focus on: 
 - BSP Integration, Performance analysis, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) management (multi virtual machine)
 - Compute platform architecture (SoC, GPU/DSP, accelerators) - Hypervisor /Virtual Machine
 - Embedded SW stacks (OS such as QNX/Linux/Android, middleware, frameworks, toolchains, AUTOSAR (Classic/Adaptive))

Multivac Technology Solutions India Private Ltd is a wholly owned subsidiary of the MULTIVAC Group.

This position will be responsible for Bought out parts Quality Assurance to ensure high quality product & on time delivery for Power Tools and Lifting products manufactured in Sahibabad plant. This person will also support for the customised project parts qualification for quality aspect. - Proficient in Engineering Drawing reading & GD&T.

 - Handling knowledge of CMM, Contour Tracer, Roughness Tester, Hardness Tester & 2D height Gauge.
