data.title: Head of Product & Technology
data.description:
Job Description: Head of Product & TechnologyCompany: ISCAP

Department: Product, Technology & Engineering

Experience: 5-10+ years

Qualification: Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, Product Management, or a related field

Industry: SaaS, EdTech, Digital Platforms

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana / Hybrid / Remote, depending on business requirements

Key Responsibilities1. Product Strategy & Roadmap
 - Define ISCAP's product vision, technology strategy, and phased development roadmap. 
 - Convert business objectives and user feedback into product requirements, user stories, and release plans. 
 - Prioritise features based on business value, user needs, cost, and scalability. 
 - Collaborate with academic, operations, sales, marketing, and leadership teams. 2. Learning Platform & Course Delivery
 - Develop, implement, integrate, or optimise ISCAP's Learning Management System (LMS). 
 - Support course discovery, enrolment, payments where applicable, learning content, assignments, assessments, progress tracking, and certification. 
 - Establish workflows for course creation, publishing, cohort management, and content updates. 
 - Enable trainers and administrators to manage courses, assessments, and learner progress efficiently. 3. Student, Trainer & Partner Portals
 - Student portal: Registration, enrolment, learning resources, assessments, progress tracking, certificates, and career opportunities. 
 - Trainer portal: Course management, cohort tracking, assignment evaluation, learner feedback, and progress monitoring. 
 - College portal: Institution onboarding, student nominations, bulk enrolments, cohort tracking, and program reporting. 
 - Employer portal: Internship and hiring requirements, eligible learner profiles, candidate shortlisting, and application tracking, subject to permissions and consent. 
 - Administrator portal: User management, role-based permissions, course administration, approvals, reporting, and operational monitoring. 4. Product Design & User Experience
 - Design intuitive, user-friendly experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 
 - Map user journeys, identify friction points, and improve registration, enrolment, learning, and partner workflows. 
 - Collaborate with designers and stakeholders on wireframes, prototypes, and product specifications. 
 - Conduct user testing and continuously improve usability and accessibility. 5. Technology Architecture & Engineering
 - Establish secure, scalable, and maintainable technology architecture. 
 - Evaluate programming frameworks, databases, cloud infrastructure, hosting, and third-party solutions. 
 - Lead or coordinate frontend, backend, QA, DevOps, and external development teams. 
 - Establish coding standards, version control, testing, documentation, and release management. 
 - Make informed build-versus-buy decisions to balance cost, speed, flexibility, and long-term ownership. 6. Automation & Integrations
 - Identify manual processes across admissions, enrolments, course delivery, assessments, certification, partnerships, and reporting. 
 - Automate notifications, reminders, approvals, task assignments, and status updates. 
 - Integrate relevant CRM, LMS, payment, communication, analytics, and support systems. 
 - Build reliable APIs, data synchronisation, error handling, and self-service workflows. 
 - Reduce duplicate data entry while retaining human oversight for decisions requiring review. 7. Security, Privacy & Reliability
 - Implement authentication, role-based access control, encryption, and appropriate security measures. 
 - Establish backup, recovery, monitoring, logging, and incident response procedures. 
 - Coordinate security testing, vulnerability remediation, and software updates. 
 - Protect student records, partner information, and confidential business data. 
 - Consider applicable privacy, data protection, accessibility, and contractual requirements. 8. Analytics & Continuous Improvement
 - Define KPIs for platform adoption, enrolment conversion, learner engagement, completion, satisfaction, and reliability. 
 - Use analytics, support tickets, and user feedback to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Develop dashboards for platform usage, enrolments, learner progress, course performance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Evaluate AI-enabled features where they deliver measurable value and can be implemented responsibly. 9. Team, Vendor & Budget Management
 - Build and manage product and technology teams as business needs evolve. 
 - Coordinate developers, designers, testers, consultants, and implementation partners. 
 - Define milestones, responsibilities, quality standards, and delivery expectations. 
 - Manage technology budgets, infrastructure costs, software subscriptions, and vendor performance. 
 - Ensure critical systems are properly documented and not dependent on a single person or vendor. Mandatory Deliverable: ISCAP Unified Digital PlatformWithin the first 90 days, the selected candidate must establish a practical roadmap and deliver or demonstrate an agreed working product increment. 

Key deliverables: 

- Technology audit: Review the existing website, applications, infrastructure, databases, integrations, and manual workflows. 
 - Product requirements document: Define user journeys, functional requirements, permissions, and priorities. 
 - Technology architecture: Document the proposed architecture, data model, hosting, security, integrations, and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Unified user management: Define registration, authentication, onboarding, roles, and account management. 
 - LMS roadmap: Plan course management, learning content, assignments, assessments, progress tracking, and certification. 
 - Partner workflows: Define institutional onboarding, student nominations, employer requirements, and partnership tracking. 
 - Automation roadmap: Identify and prioritise manual processes for automation. 
 - Operational dashboard: Define reporting requirements for enrolments, course progress, assessments, platform usage, and support. 
 - Security and reliability plan: Establish security controls, backups, monitoring, and recovery requirements. 
 - Working pilot/MVP: Deliver or demonstrate a testable solution for an agreed high-priority workflow. 
 - 6-12-month roadmap: Present milestones, budget estimates, resource requirements, dependencies, and success metrics. The objective is to establish a reliable foundation within 90 days, not necessarily to build the entire platform from scratch. The approach must account for ISCAP's existing technology, budget, and team capacity. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 - Delivery of approved product milestones. 
 - Adoption and successful usage of core platform workflows. 
 - Reduction in manual administrative effort and duplicate data entry. 
 - Platform uptime, performance, and incident resolution. 
 - Reliable course delivery, assessment, and certification workflows. 
 - User satisfaction across students, trainers, colleges, employers, and administrators. 
 - Integration reliability and reporting accuracy. 
 - Timely remediation of identified security risks. 
 - Development delivery predictability and budget adherence. 
 - Reduction in recurring support issues through product improvements. Numerical targets will be established following the initial technology audit. 

Required Qualifications & Experience
 - 5-10+ years of experience in SaaS, EdTech, software engineering, or digital product development. 
 - Demonstrated experience building, implementing, or scaling web applications and digital platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of product roadmaps, requirements gathering, and agile delivery. 
 - Experience with architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and software quality. 
 - Familiarity with security, access controls, monitoring, backups, and privacy requirements. 
 - Experience leading technical teams or managing development vendors. 
 - Strong business understanding, communication, analytical thinking, and execution skills. A relevant degree is preferred. Equivalent practical experience and demonstrated product delivery are also valued. 

Preferred Candidate Profile
 - Experience with LMS platforms, SaaS products, multi-role portals, marketplaces, or B2B/B2C platforms. 
 - Familiarity with CRM, payment integrations, analytics, and workflow automation. 
 - Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, and API-first development. 
 - Experience working in startups or managing technology within budget constraints. 
 - A hands-on, product-minded leader who avoids unnecessary complexity and focuses on measurable business outcomes. First 90-Day Success PlanDays 1-30: Audit & Discovery

- Audit existing technology, tools, integrations, workflows, and risks. 
 - Understand requirements across students, trainers, colleges, employers, and administrators. 
 - Prepare the initial product requirements document and prioritised roadmap. Days 31-60: Architecture & Planning

- Finalise architecture and build-versus-buy recommendations. 
 - Define user roles, workflows, integrations, security requirements, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Prepare resource plans, cost estimates, and delivery milestones. 
 - Begin implementation of the highest-priority product increment. Days 61-90: Pilot & Validation

- Deliver or demonstrate the agreed working MVP or priority workflow. 
 - Conduct functional testing, user acceptance testing, and appropriate security checks. 
 - Gather user feedback and document improvements. 
 - Present the 6-12-month roadmap, risk register, delivery dashboard, and resource plan. 
How to ApplyInterested candidates should submit their resume and a brief overview of their experience in product development, SaaS platforms, technology architecture, or digital transformation. 

Candidates should highlight a product or platform they have built, scaled, or improved, their individual contributions, key technical decisions, and measurable results. Confidential information need not be disclosed. 

ISCAP seeks a product-minded technology leader who can combine strategic thinking, technical judgement, and hands-on execution to build a reliable, scalable digital ecosystem.

data.title: Senior Staff, Emulation Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Connectivity Business Unit at Marvell is at the forefront of delivering high-performance silicon for the world's most demanding data infrastructure, spanning Optical DSPs, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices. Within the BU, the Pre-Silicon Emulation team plays a critical role in program execution-bridging RTL design and real-world system behavior before a single chip is taped out. Our team owns emulation model development, test execution, and system-level debug across Marvell's emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), enabling early firmware bring-up, hardware/software co-validation, and risk reduction on the path to silicon. We work closely with design, verification, firmware, software, and post-silicon teams to ensure emulation is a productive, schedule-driving resource-not a bottleneck. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems at the intersection of hardware and software, and want your work to directly impact the success of next-generation connectivity silicon, we'd love to hear from you. 

What You Can Expect

Execute emulation model bring-up, test development, and debug for connectivity silicon programs, including ODSP, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices, on platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, and Zebu. 

Work with design, validation, and firmware teams to understand emulation hardware and software requirements, and implement platform configurations, transactors, speed bridges, protocol adapters, and firmware/software stacks. 

Engage with EDA and emulation hardware vendors to resolve platform, tooling, and model issues and maintain a productive emulation environment. 

Develop and maintain HW/SW enablement flows and scripts to support RTL validation and improve emulation model usability for firmware, driver, and system software development. 

Collaborate with pre-silicon validation, design, firmware, and post-silicon teams to identify and resolve emulation bottlenecks and improve validation coverage. 

Build and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure to improve emulation environment productivity, reliability, and utilization within assigned programs. 

Minimum Requirements

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's/PhD with 3+ years of experience. 

Hands-on experience with one or more SoC emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), including building and maintaining emulation models for SoC designs. 

Background in test planning, simulation, and debug in Verilog/SystemVerilog environments. 

Experience with SoC development flows, emulation-based debug, and system-level validation. 

Scripting and automation skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, and/or UNIX shell. 

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including design, validation, firmware, and vendor partners. 

Good to Have

Experience with emulation of networking devices or mixed-signal designs, including systems containing PHY or Layer-2/Layer-3 functionality. 

Exposure To Connectivity-focused Silicon, Such As

Optical DSPs (ODSP)

High-speed Ethernet PHYs

AEC/AOC enablement devices

Familiarity with firmware or software bring-up using emulation platforms. 

Experience contributing to or improving emulation infrastructure within a project or product line. 

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

data.title: Senior CAD Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a CAD Engineer specializing in Digital Verification to build, enhance, and support scalable verification infrastructure, methodologies, and EDA automation flows for ASIC/SoC development. 

The role focuses on enabling verification teams with robust regression systems, automation frameworks, and advanced methodologies (UVM, coverage, Continuous Integration flows) to improve productivity, debug efficiency, and time-to-tapeout. 

Digital Verification CAD Support & Methodology Enablement

- Act as the primary support interface for Design & Verification (DV) teams to troubleshoot issues in simulation, regression, coverage, and debug flows
 - Collaborate with DV teams to identify bottlenecks and provide practical solutions or workarounds
 - Support adoption of modern verification techniques (coverage-driven, formal, emulation) through guidance and issue resolution
 - Deploy, integrate, and maintain CAD tools, scripts, and environments supporting digital verification flows
 - Provide day-to-day support for EDA tools (VCS, Xcelium, Verdi, vManager, etc. ) and resolve tool/flow-related issues
 - Work closely with EDA vendors (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens) to track, debug, and escalate tool issues, and support tool evaluations and rollouts
 - Support and maintain regression and CI/CD systems, ensuring stable execution and timely issue resolution
 - Monitor and optimize infrastructure usage (compute farms, LSF environments) to ensure efficient job execution and resource utilization
 - Analyze DV flow issues and performance bottlenecks, and provide improvements or recommendations for optimization

data.description:
Job Details

Job Title: Head - Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)

Job Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Work Model: Work from Office

Job Level: Head / Senior Leadership

Employment Type: Full-time

Candidate Expectations

Total Experience: 15+ years preferred. 

Relevant Experience: Significant experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, academic administration, quality frameworks, and institutional ranking processes within higher education. 

Candidate Location: Chennai preferred; candidates willing to relocate may be considered. 

Mandatory Skills

Leadership of IQAC or institutional quality assurance functions. 

NAAC accreditation processes, assessment, and documentation. 

Institutional ranking frameworks and data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Outcome-based education, academic quality metrics, and continuous improvement. 

Preparation of institutional reports, evidence repositories, and performance dashboards. 

Stakeholder coordination and team leadership. 

Preferred Industry: Universities, higher education institutions, medical colleges, engineering institutions, and multidisciplinary educational institutions. 

Leadership Expectations: Ability to lead institution-wide quality initiatives, coordinate accreditation and ranking activities, and establish robust quality assurance and governance mechanisms. 

Education & Certification

Mandatory: Ph. D. or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline, as appropriate to the institution's requirements. 

Preferred: Ph. D. with substantial experience in higher education administration, academic quality assurance, or institutional governance. 

Good to Have: Training or certifications related to NAAC accreditation, NBA accreditation, quality management systems, academic auditing, outcome-based education, or institutional assessment frameworks. 

Additional Preference: Experience in multidisciplinary institutions covering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education. 

Detailed Job Description

Role Overview

The Head of IQAC will be responsible for establishing, leading, and strengthening the institution's internal quality assurance framework. The role will oversee institutional quality processes, accreditation readiness, NAAC-related data and documentation, institutional ranking submissions, academic and administrative audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

The position will work closely with senior management, academic leaders, department heads, faculty, and administrative teams to ensure institutional performance is measured, documented, evaluated, and improved in line with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

Institutional Quality Assurance & Governance

Develop and implement institution-wide quality assurance policies, frameworks, procedures, and annual quality plans. 

Lead the functioning of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell and establish mechanisms for continuous academic and administrative improvement. 

Define quality indicators, monitoring systems, review mechanisms, and accountability structures across departments. 

Ensure quality initiatives are aligned with institutional objectives and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

NAAC Accreditation & Assessment

Lead institutional preparedness for NAAC accreditation, assessment, and applicable quality assurance processes. 

Coordinate the collection, verification, consolidation, and presentation of data and supporting evidence required for accreditation. 

Oversee preparation and review of relevant institutional submissions, including the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR), Self-Study Report (SSR), and other applicable documentation. 

Track accreditation criteria, performance indicators, evidence gaps, and improvement requirements. 

Coordinate with academic and administrative departments to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines. 

Institutional Rankings & Performance Data

Lead institutional ranking-related data collection, validation, analysis, and submission activities for relevant national and other applicable ranking frameworks. 

Coordinate with departments to compile verified information relating to academics, research, faculty, student outcomes, infrastructure, outreach, and institutional performance. 

Establish centralised data repositories and evidence-tracking mechanisms to improve data accuracy, consistency, and auditability. 

Analyse ranking performance, identify gaps, and recommend initiatives to strengthen institutional outcomes. 

Monitor ranking criteria, submission timelines, and applicable framework updates. 

Academic Quality & Continuous Improvement

Monitor academic quality indicators, teaching-learning processes, curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and student outcomes. 

Promote outcome-based education, programme outcome mapping, feedback mechanisms, and academic quality enhancement initiatives, where applicable. 

Facilitate internal academic audits, administrative audits, and periodic departmental reviews. 

Identify performance gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans. 

Encourage evidence-based decision-making and a culture of continuous quality improvement. 

Data Management, Documentation & Reporting

Establish standardised processes for data collection, validation, documentation, and record maintenance. 

Develop dashboards and institutional reports to track quality indicators, accreditation readiness, ranking performance, and improvement initiatives. 

Ensure the availability of reliable supporting evidence for audits, assessments, accreditation reviews, and ranking submissions. 

Implement document control, version management, and evidence verification practices. 

Present periodic quality performance reports and improvement recommendations to institutional leadership. 

Stakeholder Coordination & Capacity Building

Work closely with senior management, academic leadership, faculty, department coordinators, and administrative teams on quality-related initiatives. 

Establish departmental quality coordinators and define clear responsibilities for data submission, verification, and compliance. 

Conduct awareness sessions and capacity-building programmes on accreditation criteria, documentation standards, quality metrics, and institutional ranking requirements. 

Facilitate internal quality review meetings and monitor the closure of agreed action items. 

Build institution-wide ownership of quality assurance and accreditation readiness. 

Regulatory Compliance & Quality Audits

Monitor applicable quality assurance and accreditation requirements relevant to the institution and its academic programmes. 

Coordinate internal reviews to assess compliance with prescribed academic, administrative, and documentation standards. 

Ensure timely identification, escalation, and closure of quality-related gaps. 

Maintain readiness for external assessments, inspections, audits, and accreditation visits. 

Coordinate with relevant institutional departments to ensure consistency between submitted data, supporting evidence, and official records. 

Strategic Planning & Institutional Improvement

Translate accreditation and ranking findings into measurable institutional improvement plans. 

Benchmark institutional performance against relevant peer institutions and applicable quality frameworks. 

Recommend process improvements, governance mechanisms, and digital tools to strengthen quality management. 

Track implementation of improvement initiatives and report progress to institutional leadership. 

Contribute to long-term institutional planning through quality analytics and performance insights. 

Key Skills

Mandatory Skills

IQAC leadership and institutional quality assurance. 

NAAC accreditation and related documentation. 

Institutional rankings and performance data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Data validation, evidence management, and institutional reporting. 

Quality indicators, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Stakeholder coordination and institutional governance. 

Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration. 

Good-to-Have Skills

Exposure to NBA accreditation and other applicable programme-level accreditation frameworks. 

Experience in multidisciplinary universities offering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes. 

Knowledge of outcome-based education, programme outcome assessment, and academic quality frameworks. 

Experience with institutional dashboards, data analytics, and digital documentation systems. 

Exposure to national ranking frameworks, benchmarking, and institutional performance improvement. 

Research, academic administration, and university-level governance experience. 

Other Specific Remarks

Candidates should have substantial experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, and ranking-related activities, rather than general academic administration alone. 

Demonstrated ownership of NAAC-related data, documentation, assessment readiness, and institutional quality processes is preferred. 

Strong expertise in data accuracy, evidence validation, reporting, and coordination across academic and administrative departments is essential. 

Candidates should be capable of leading institution-wide quality initiatives and presenting performance insights to senior leadership. 

Experience in a university or large multidisciplinary higher education institution will be an advantage. 

Candidates with exposure to both Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education are preferred. 

The role requires a detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong analytical, documentation, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities.

About the role: 

The Intelligent Automation Developer will serve as a primary hands-on technical resource supporting Boston Scientific's Robotic Process Automation (RPA) portfolio as part of the HR AI & Automation product team. 

The role will focus primarily on the development, enhancement and technical support of Automation Anywhere A360 solutions across a portfolio of more than 100 production automations. Approximately 75% of the role will focus on hands-on development, with additional responsibility for production troubleshooting, defect resolution, enhancements and continued improvement of existing solutions. 

This position requires demonstrated hands-on Automation Anywhere A360 development experience and the ability to enter a complex, established automation environment and contribute quickly. The developer must be comfortable understanding solutions developed by others, diagnosing technical issues, modifying existing automations and designing new solutions using scalable and maintainable development patterns. 

While RPA is the primary focus, the developer will also support other intelligent automation capabilities, including low-code/no-code solutions, conversational AI/automation and configuration within the Moveworks. ai platform. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Serve as a primary hands-on Automation Anywhere A360 developer supporting the delivery and ongoing operation of enterprise RPA solutions. 
 - Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain new Automation Anywhere A360 solutions based on documented business and technical requirements. 
 - Understand, troubleshoot and enhance existing automations developed by other resources across a mature portfolio of more than 100 production automated processes. 
 - Develop scalable and maintainable solutions using reusable components, configuration-driven design and established development standards. 
 - Design and implement integrations using REST APIs and other appropriate integration methods. 
 - Apply effective exception handling, logging, configuration management and troubleshooting practices to improve solution resiliency and supportability. 
 - Diagnose production defects, perform root-cause analysis and implement controlled fixes and enhancements. 
 - Partner closely with business systems analysts to translate business requirements, process maps, user stories and acceptance criteria into technical solutions. 
 - Provide technical input during requirements and solution design, including identifying technical constraints, dependencies and alternative approaches. 
 - Identify opportunities to refactor or enhance existing automations to improve reliability, scalability, performance and maintainability. 
 - Perform unit testing, support user acceptance testing and participate in peer reviews to ensure solutions meet functional and technical requirements. 
 - Develop and maintain technical documentation, configuration documentation and operational support materials. 
 - Support configuration, troubleshooting and development activities within the Moveworks. ai platform and other low-code/no-code automation technologies as needed. 
 - Collaborate with developers, analysts and AI product resources across the HR AI & Automation product team to determine and deliver appropriate automation solutions. 
 - Follow established development standards, governance, security requirements and change-control practices. 
 - Contribute to the continued evolution of intelligent automation development standards, reusable assets and technical best practices. Qualifications: 

Required qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - Minimum of 3 years' experience in RPA development, intelligent automation, application development or a related technical field. 
 - Hands-on development experience with Automation Anywhere A360, including the ability to independently develop, troubleshoot, modify and support production automations. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and developing workflow-based automated solutions from business and technical requirements. 
 - Experience supporting production automation solutions, including debugging, root-cause analysis, defect resolution and enhancement development. 
 - Experience working with APIs and system integrations. 
 - Demonstrated understanding of reusable development patterns, configuration-driven design, exception handling, logging and maintainable automation development practices. 
 - Ability to understand, troubleshoot and modify complex automation solutions developed by other resources. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with business analysts, developers and business stakeholders. Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience with UiPath, Blue Prism, Microsoft Power Platform or other RPA and low-code/no-code technologies. 
 - Experience designing, consuming or integrating with REST APIs. 
 - Experience with SQL and relational database management systems. 
 - Experience with Python. 
 - Experience working with JSON and XML. 
 - Experience with VBScript or Power Query. 
 - Experience integrating with or automating processes across ServiceNow or SAP SuccessFactors. 
 - Experience with Moveworks. ai or comparable conversational AI, chatbot or low-code/no-code platforms. 
 - Experience with generative AI, large language models, conversational AI, AI agents or other AI-enabled automation capabilities. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery models and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Python)
data.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer (SDET) to join NetApp's ONTAP Engineering team, focusing on SAN and block storage solutions. ONTAP is a feature-rich storage platform used in mission-critical environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments. As an Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable test frameworks, automation infrastructure, and validation pipelines that ensure high product quality for complex distributed storage systems. You will work across multiple subsystems, understand end-to-end customer workflows, and drive quality at scale. This is an advanced IC role requiring strong technical depth, ownership of features/modules, and the ability to operate with limited supervision while influencing test strategy, automation direction, and cross-team quality outcomes. 

Job Requirements

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and infrastructure using Python and related technologies
 - Own end-to-end validation for SAN/block storage features, including test design, execution, and defect lifecycle management
 - Collaborate with development teams to understand feature design, define validation strategies, and drive testability improvements early in the cycle. 
 - Develop functional, integration, stress, and scale tests for distributed storage systems
 - Drive automation-first testing approaches and improve code/test coverage across components
 - Analyze failures, debug complex issues across software layers, and drive root cause resolution. 
 - Participate in product design discussions and contribute to improving reliability, observability, and diagnosability
 - Lead or significantly contribute to test planning, quality reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Work across cross-functional teams (Dev, QA, Field Support) to understand customer use cases and ensure production readiness. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and influence engineering best practices within the team. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python (mandatory) with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with system-level testing and debugging of distributed systems
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, multithreading, and system internals
 - Experience in storage technologies, with strong preference for SAN protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF)
 - Understanding of file systems, data paths, replication, or high-availability systems
 - Experience in test automation for scale, performance, and stress scenarios
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and modern development workflows. 
 - Strong debugging skills across software and system layers. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 8-12 years of relevant industry experience Proven track record of owning and delivering quality outcomes for complex subsystems
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately to highly complex problems and drive solutions Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep expertise in SAN/block storage domain (ONTAP, SnapMirror, SVM, HA/MetroCluster, etc. )
 - Experience in large-scale system validation and customer scenario testing
 - Exposure to cloud-integrated storage or hybrid cloud architectures
 - Prior experience in SDET roles driving automation strategy at team level

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. 

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment-you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. 

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. 

Submitting an Application

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support-rather than replace-human decision-making.

data.title: Sr SW Development Engineer
data.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. 

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. 

Job Description

Meet the Team: 

We are hiring for a Sr Software Engineer to join our team in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the Data Platforms team and the larger Dexcom Software and Data Organization. You will work with Data Platform Engineers to build the infrastructure to support our data pipelines, storage, and API through which reliable, clean, meaningful data is provided to internal and external stakeholders. At Dexcom, you can use your data engineering skills for the greater good. We develop software for medical devices and systems, adhering to the rigorous requirements of regulatory agencies such as ISO and FDA. If you enjoy connecting the dots, using data-driven engineering decisions, and innovating through the server side of our entire platform stack, you'll enjoy this job. 

Where You Come In

- You will build cloud-based, event-driven software systems with high availability, scalability, and resilience, as part of a multi-disciplinary team that works within an Agile methodology environment. 
 - You will work with the data scientist team to build machine learning pipelines. 
 - You will contribute to software across the development lifecycle, including software design and architecture, code development, functional and performance testing, and documentation and design verification. 
 - You will identify, champion, and work to implement improvements in internal processes, including automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and optimizing software infrastructure for better scalability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. 
 - You will contribute to code reviews and champion best practices for quality control, software testing, and code development/deployment in an agile environment. 
 - You will participate in on-call rotation for production systems when required. 
 - You will protect the confidentiality and security of client data. 

What Makes You Successful

- You must have strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Golang
 - You have experience with message brokers, queues, and buses like Kafka, Azure Service Bus, ZeroMQ, NoSQL databases etc. 
 - You have experience with relational databases like MySQL and NoSQL databases like Cassandra. 
 - You are familiar with using relevant, modern software test tools and equipment.

data.title: Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence
data.description:
Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence

- The OpportunityAliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand-we're building the world's most admired tattoo company. 

With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders. 

We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations. 

We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners. 

If you thrive in high-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you. 

As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region. 

- The MandateYou will own quality across the entire studio network end to end - compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself - what gets checked, how often, through what method - and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on. 

- What you'll be doingChecking every studio against its own standard - how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run - through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported. 

Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all - you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change. 

Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it - real visits and unannounced ones - so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to. 

Owning the physical readiness of every studio - hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on - and catching what's broken before a customer does. 

Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted - and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it. 

Building the entire audit system from nothing - the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask - designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day. 

Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale - holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something. 

- What we're looking forYou've done this before - run quality or audit work across multiple locations. 

You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all. 

Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past - the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later. 

You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen. 

You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone - a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior - you report what you found, not what's comfortable. 

Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both - the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once. 

Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline - what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before. 

- What success looks likeevery studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses. 

The audit system runs as a system - not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping. 

- Practical detailsEducation: Bachelor's degree, any discipline

Preferred Industry - Retail Only

A quality or process-audit certification - Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent - This is optional, However this is an added advantage

data.description:
Job Description

Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is inviting applications from 2026 graduates and a limited number of 2025 graduates for our 2027 project expansion plans.

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career. 

Unlike conventional training programs, this is a real-time industry learning opportunity where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects. 

Who Should Apply?

- Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch. 
 - Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain. 
 - Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career. 
 - Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training.

 - Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement. 
 - Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance. 
 - Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments. 
 - Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development. 

This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary. 

Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance. 

Who Should Not Apply?

Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying. 

Candidates Should Not Apply If They

- Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry. 
 - Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship. 
 - Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity. 
 - Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.

 - Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation. 
 - Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance. 
 - Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills. 
 - Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance. 
 - Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization. 
 - Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment. 

Important

This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience. 

Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program. 

This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to: 

Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career

 - Work on real client and internal projects. 
 - Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

 - Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.

Selection Process

Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a 5-working-day assessment.

 - Sincerity and commitment
 - Professional ethics
 - Ownership and accountability
 - Communication skills
 - Adaptability
 - Consistency in task completion
 - Overall suitability for the internship program

Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility

Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1-3 75 working days No stipend Block 4 25 working days ₹5, 000* Block 5 25 working days ₹5, 000* Block 6 25 working days ₹5, 000* Total 150 working days Up to ₹15, 000*

Block-Wise Performance Assessment

 - Professional behaviour

data.title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
data.description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets - safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights. 

Overview

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities. 
Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation. 

  
Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities
Strategic Focus

- Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities. 
 - Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features. 
 - Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management. 
 - Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare. 
 - Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation. 
 - Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns. 
 - Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms. 
 - Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance. 
 - Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose. 
 - Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues. 
 - Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues. 
 - Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases. 
 - Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption. 
Operational Management

- Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues. 
 - Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions. 
 - Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk. 
 - Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation. 
 - Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria. 

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership  
   

- Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners. 
 - Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors. 
 - Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits. 
 - Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams. 
Governance, Security and Risk

- Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements. 
 - Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners. 
 - Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance. 
 - Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options. 
 - Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer. 
The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs. 

  
Experience & Personal Attributes

- Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation. 
 - Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous. 
 - Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI. 
 - Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support. 
 - Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes. 
 - Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous. 
 - Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation. 
 - Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review. 
 - Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including structured diagnosis of complex integration, data, security and configuration issues. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong planning, prioritisation and delivery discipline, with the ability to manage concurrent initiatives and production priorities. 
 - High standards of integrity, discretion and care when handling employee and organisational data. 
 - Practical, collaborative and outcomes-focused, with the confidence to work with limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, challenge weak assumptions and escalate material risks.

Engineering Manager - Infrastructure Security
data.description:
About the team

The Platform & Infrastructure Engineering team owns the foundational estate that everything else runs on. The team designs, builds, automates, and operates scalable cloud-native systems across networks, security, data & storage, and compute. It carries significant regulatory and operational responsibility, with its platforms directly underpinning critical customer-facing systems such as payments and banking, so security and availability are not optional. 

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Infrastructure Security at slice. You will own charters like cloud security, network security, and software supply chain security and build a team that makes the secure path the default path for every engineer. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the architecture, hire and grow the team, and be accountable for measurable, auditable security outcomes across our cloud and hybrid estate. 

What You will do

- Lead, hire and scale the Infrastructure Security team, setting goals, mentoring engineers, and developing technical leaders. 
 - Own the cloud and hybrid network security architecture and roadmap, balancing security, reliability, scalability, velocity and cost. 
 - Establish secure-by-design principles, guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts, organizations and future cloud regions. 
 - Drive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform automation to ensure security controls are version-controlled, tested, repeatable and consistently enforced. 
 - Own IAM, SSO/Identity Center, PAM, least-privilege access, just-in-time access and secrets management. 
 - Enforce encryption, KMS/HSM key management, certificate lifecycle management and data protection standards. 
 - Secure Kubernetes (EKS), compute workloads and container images through hardening, runtime protection and automated patching. 
 - Design secure network architecture, including VPC segmentation, hybrid connectivity, egress controls, firewalls, DNS security, IDS/IPS, and zero-trust access. 
 - Protect internet-facing services and APIs using DDoS mitigation, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and API security controls. 
 - Harden CI/CD pipelines and implement DevSecOps practices, including short-lived credentials (OIDC), SCA, image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and provenance. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and admission controls to prevent misconfigured infrastructure and untrusted or vulnerable artifacts from reaching production. 
 - Govern open-source and third-party dependencies through vulnerability management, license compliance, and remediation of SLAs. 
 - Establish security metrics for control coverage, policy violations, exposure and remediation timelines; continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations and security drifts. 
 - Partner with Cybersecurity, AppSec, GRC and SOC teams to address security and compliance gaps and support audits. 
 - Lead infrastructure security incident responses, including DDoS attacks and cloud misconfigurations, and drive blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Strengthen resilience through availability planning, disaster recovery, capacity management, incident readiness, and recovery exercises for critical infrastructure. 

What You will need

- 9+ years in infrastructure, cloud or security engineering, including 2+ years managing and building high-performing teams. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise in AWS/GCP/Azure security (IAM, Organizations/SCPs, KMS, Security Hub, Guard Duty or equivalents) and cloud security architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of IAM, SSO, PAM, secrets management, encryption and key management. 
 - Deep expertise in cloud and data-center networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection and IDS/IPS. 
 - Practical experience with CI/CD hardening, SCA and image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and policy enforcement. 
 - Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (e. g. , Terraform) and experience building guardrails at scale. 
 - Solid grounding in observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience designing infrastructure for high-scale, highly available environments. 
 - Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments. 
 - Experience with RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, CERT-In guidelines, PCI DSS or NPCI audits. 
 - Depth in admission controllers, policy engines and runtime security tools. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CCSP, CISSP or CKS. 
 - Contributions to security tooling, open source or the wider security community. 

Life at slice

Life so good, you'd think we're kidding: 

- Competitive salaries. Period. 
 - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We'll love you and take care of you, our promise. 
 - Flexible working hours. Just don't call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. 
 - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. 
 - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. 
 - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. 
 - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you'll forget the term "colleagues can't be your friends".

Location: Mangalore - India

Summary

We are looking for a Manager - Software Engineering (Data Extraction) to lead and scale UniCourt's core data extraction and processing systems in the Legal Tech domain. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with strong expertise in Python-based backend systems, data pipelines, and automation frameworks. You will be responsible for driving innovation in large-scale data ingestion, transformation, and standardization while maintaining the highest levels of accuracy, reliability, and performance. This role requires close collaboration with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure timely delivery, process consistency, and adherence to UniCourt's values of innovation, transparency, and excellence in data quality. 

About the Job

Our company creates some of the world's most cutting-edge software solutions in the legal industry. We solve difficult problems, work on innovative technology, and build world-class platforms for people and enterprises to interact with court records and other public data sets. With some of the best minds in the industry, we're one of the most sought-after learning and career destinations in the world of legal tech. If you're looking to work at a company with opportunities to forge your career path in technology, UniCourt is the right place for you. Our customers range from individuals who interact with court records a few hours in a month to enterprise clients who spend several hours every day on our SaaS platform. 

About Us

UniCourt is a leader in making court data more accessible and useful with our Legal Data as a Service (LDaaS). We provide real-time access to court data through our APIs and online app for business development and intelligence, litigation analytics, litigation tracking, case research, investigations, background checks, due diligence, compliance, underwriting, machine learning models, and process automation. 

We provide access to court data from state and federal courts to a diverse list of clients, including Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw firms and industries such as legal, insurance, finance, investigations, government, education, nonprofits, and consumers. 

UniCourt is a legal technology company focused on using technology to unlock the potential of legal data. We are based in both California and Mangalore, India and our team includes legal professionals, data scientists, physicists, computer engineers, and sales and marketing, professionals. 

Role & Responsibilities

1. Sprint & Resource Management

a) Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and re-planning with Product and QA leadership. 

b) Ensure equitable resource allocation and optimize team productivity. 

c) Track sprint progress, manage interdependencies, and ensure timely delivery of data extraction milestones. 

2. Requirements & Functional Design Ownership

a) Own and finalize High-Level Requirements Documents (HLRs) in collaboration with Product Managers, CTO, and data stakeholders. 

b) Create and manage Jira Epics, User Stories, and Tasks for data-related projects. 

c) Lead the creation of Functional Design Documents (FDDs) for data workflows, defining success metrics for extraction accuracy, coverage, and timeliness. 

d) Review Interface Design Documents (IDDs) related to API integrations and provide improvement feedback. 

3. Data Quality & Testing Collaboration

a) Review and approve QA test plans for data extraction, validation, and transformation workflows. 

b) Define CI/CD pipeline requirements ensuring that regression, integration, and data consistency tests block faulty deployments. 

c) Partner with QA and data engineering teams to identify recurring data issues, optimize extraction logic, and improve validation frameworks. 

d) Oversee release management processes, ensuring smooth rollouts and detailed release documentation. 

4. Delivery Excellence

a) Ensure that all data extraction projects are delivered on time, meeting quality and scalability standards. 

b) Communicate deviations in requirements or timelines proactively to stakeholders. 

c) Oversee hotfix and quick sprints to resolve critical data or pipeline issues efficiently. 

5. Incident & Production Management

a) Escalate and report critical data incidents with detailed root cause analysis and corrective actions. 

b) Maintain dashboards for tracking extraction performance, job failures, latency, and data freshness. 

c) Share periodic reports on system health, coverage, and performance with leadership. 

6. Process Management & Governance

a) Define and enforce development and release processes tailored for data extraction pipelines. 

b) Establish checklists for requirements approval, design reviews, coding standards, testing, documentation, and release readiness. 

c) Keep data extraction architecture and process documentation up-to-date in Confluence or similar tools. 

7. Cost & Tool Optimization

a) Monitor cloud (AWS) costs related to crawling, storage, and data pipeline execution. 

b) Evaluate and implement new Python libraries, frameworks, or tools to improve data extraction accuracy and efficiency. 

c) Lead POCs to test and adopt scalable approaches using technologies like Scrapy, FastAPI, Airflow, or AWS Lambda. 

d) Track and prioritize initiatives impacting data quality and client deliverables. 

8. Team Building & Hiring

a) Build and structure the team with focus on scalability, performance, and automation. 

b) Collaborate with HR to drive recruitment for Python developers, data engineers, and automation specialists. 

c) Design level-specific technical assessments for Python and data pipeline skills and ensure structured feedback documentation. 

9. Coaching, Mentoring & Performance Development

a) Conduct regular 1: 1s to guide team members on career growth, technical development, and performance improvements. 

b) Mentor engineers on advanced Python coding practices, data engineering standards, and architectural best practices. 

c) Identify and nurture high-potential employees and build succession plans for key roles. 

10. Strategic & Analytical Thinking

a) Apply strong analytical thinking to improve data accuracy, reduce processing time, and enhance maintainability. 

b) Drive initiatives that align with organizational KPIs and client impact metrics. 

c) Anticipate data-related risks and implement proactive solutions at scale. 

11. Leadership & Communication

a) Lead with empathy, integrity, and transparency. 

b) Encourage innovation and collaboration across cross-functional teams. 

c) Communicate clearly with stakeholders on goals, challenges, and project updates, maintaining alignment at all levels. 

Qualifications

1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science

Required Skills

1. 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 2-3 years in a leadership or management role. 

2. Strong expertise in Python, with experience in frameworks like FastAPI, Django, Flask, or Scrapy. 

3. Strong experience in containerising application with Docker to deploy on Kubernetes K8S

4. Hands-on experience with data extraction, web scraping, ETL pipelines, and data processing frameworks. 

5. Proficiency with AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, CloudWatch) and CI/CD tools. 

6. Familiarity with Airflow, Kafka, or Celery for workflow orchestration and automation. 

7. Strong understanding of Agile, SDLC, and DevOps principles. 

8. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. 

9. Experience in Legal Tech, Data Analytics, or SaaS environments is a strong plus.
