data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Browse and Discovery Platform
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. As we strive to influence the future of television globally, including TV advertising, the ongoing success depends heavily on our investment in the Content Management System. With Roku providing millions of movies, episodes, news, and channels, the Content Management System plays a vital role in managing content ingestion, selection, enrichment, and curation. We are seeking engineers capable of developing, designing, and deploying highly scalable, dependable applications, tools, and automation frameworks essential for efficiently handling the vast volume of content in our pipeline. 

  

What is the role?As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering on the Browse and Discovery Platform team, you will own engineering for featured experiences and lead key components of the browse platform. You will lead and grow a team of backend engineers building the services and APIs that connect content, product capabilities, and user experiences across Roku devices. This role requires strong technical leadership in distributed systems, cloud services, and backend architecture, paired with the ability to translate evolving product requirements into reliable, scalable solutions. You will define technical direction, guide architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver new experiences from concept through launch. The successful candidate will balance product delivery with long-term platform development while developing engineers and promoting a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and accountability. 

  

How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain - coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  

What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Lead and manage a team of backend engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to foster professional growth and development
 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery of featured experiences and key browse platform services, from design and implementation through launch and ongoing operation
 - Architect and evolve highly available, distributed services and APIs that support content discovery and engaging user experiences at scale
 - Build reusable capabilities for configuring, publishing, scheduling, and delivering featured experiences across Roku devices
 - Collaborate with product management, design, client engineering, and content teams to define requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver new capabilities
 - Drive improvements in service reliability, performance, observability, and operational efficiency while enabling experimentation and rapid product iteration
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes to ensure high-quality software delivery
 - Conduct performance evaluations, set clear objectives, and provide mentorship to foster professional growth and development across the team
 - Work closely with senior leadership to align engineering efforts with overall business objectives and timelines  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 10+ years of software development experience with deep technical expertise in building high-availability, large-scale distributed systems and services
 - 5+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing engineering teams and driving software development projects from conception to delivery
 - Proven track record of building and managing high-performing engineering teams
 - Strong proficiency in Java or a similar backend programming language, with experience designing and developing APIs and cloud-based services
 - Deep understanding of backend technologies, architecture patterns, and best practices, including microservices, RESTful APIs, message queues, caching, and databases
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
 - Experience operating production services at scale, including performance optimization, observability, and incident response
 - Strong ability to make practical trade-offs and drive programs with autonomy
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
 What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

data.title: STAFF, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve Walmart's next-generation International Pricing platforms. 

The International Pricing team enables Walmart's mission of Every Day Low Price (EDLP). At its core, the team is responsible for the systems that help set, manage, approve, and execute prices for first-party items across Walmart's international markets. 

The platforms you build will support multiple countries, each representing a multi-billion-dollar business. You will solve complex engineering and business problems involving large-scale data processing, pricing recommendations, rules and workflows, downstream price execution, resiliency, auditability, and market-specific requirements. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write production-quality code, lead architecture and design, review critical technical decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. 

About The Team

Walmart International Technology enables our stores, eCommerce operations, associates, and customers across markets outside the United States. 

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets. 

What You'll Do

Remain hands-on and contribute production-quality code for critical platform capabilities, complex integrations, and technically challenging initiatives. 

Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for International Pricing platforms. 

Write high-quality design documents, including HLDs, LLDs, Architecture Decision Records, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams, and operational readiness plans. 

Review architecture and technical designs produced by engineering teams and ensure alignment with platform standards, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Design and build scalable, high-throughput, and low-latency Java- or Kotlin-based microservices deployed on cloud infrastructure. 

Build extensible pricing capabilities using domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, Kafka, API-first principles, and well-defined service boundaries. 

Design solutions for pricing recommendations, rule evaluation, approvals, simulations, publishing, execution, auditability, and downstream-system integration. 

Own data-modelling and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data stores, with a strong focus on data accuracy, lineage, consistency, and traceability. 

Design resilient distributed workflows using appropriate patterns such as orchestration, outbox, retries, circuit breaking, idempotency, and dead-letter processing. 

Define REST and gRPC APIs with clear contracts, backward-compatibility guarantees, versioning strategies, and consumer-driven contract testing. 

Design for multi-market and multi-tenant use cases while balancing global platform consistency with market-specific business requirements. 

Identify and proactively address systemic risks, including scaling bottlenecks, single points of failure, data-integrity gaps, operational dependencies, and technical-debt accumulation. 

Drive architecture and integration alignment with shared platforms and downstream systems responsible for price calculation, price publishing, execution, catalogue, analytics, and store operations. 

Represent International Pricing in cross-organizational architecture and engineering forums. 

Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security validation, canary deployment, rollback, and production verification. 

Drive observability-first engineering through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, actionable alerts, and business-flow monitoring. 

Ensure that services comply with enterprise security, privacy, infrastructure, and software-development standards. 

Lead production-readiness reviews, incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reliability-improvement initiatives. 

Mentor junior, mid-level, and senior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, pairing, and structured feedback. 

Establish engineering standards for design quality, code quality, automated testing, performance, security, release readiness, and operational excellence. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Business, Program, Quality Engineering, and other platform teams to translate complex pricing requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Promote a platform-first mindset by creating reusable and configurable capabilities that enable multiple markets and engineering teams without duplicating solutions. 

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value. 

Make sound technical decisions and solve complex problems efficiently in a high-impact, fast-moving environment. 

What You'll Bring

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed-system fundamentals, design patterns, and software-engineering principles. 

Strong experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms and asynchronous processing patterns. 

Experience designing and operating systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 

Advanced experience with cloud infrastructure such as Azure, GCP, or AWS. 

Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, service-to-service communication, autoscaling, resource management, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

Experience designing systems that process large data volumes while maintaining strong consistency, traceability, performance, and availability. 

Demonstrated ability to author clear technical designs and influence architecture across multiple teams. 

Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, messaging, and data layers. 

Experience driving engineering excellence through automated testing, performance optimization, reliability improvements, operational readiness, and incident prevention. 

Experience integrating machine-learning inference APIs or model endpoints into production services. 

Familiarity with GenAI-assisted engineering tools and their responsible use across software-development workflows. 

Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus-building skills. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical capabilities of the broader team. 

Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform architecture and sustainability. 

Experience building or operating large-scale retail, eCommerce, pricing, promotion, markdown, or revenue-management platforms. 

Understanding of retail pricing concepts such as EDLP, competitive pricing, price rules, simulations, approvals, price execution, regional pricing, and markdown optimization. 

Experience building multi-tenant or multi-market platforms with shared global capabilities and configurable market-specific behaviour. 

Experience integrating with complex upstream and downstream enterprise systems. 

A continuous drive to simplify, automate, improve, and optimize platforms, tools, development workflows, and operational processes. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Job Description

You will partner with Product, Architecture, DevOps and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful technology solutions across a complex digital ecosystem. 

You will independently define and deliver large-scale, multi-phase projects, mentor engineers, and shape technical strategy. The role also includes leveraging LLMs and GenAI-driven tools to enhance engineering productivity, reduce cycle time, and build the next generation of internal developer experience tools. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

 - Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact, multi-team engineering initiatives. 
 - Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, pragmatic technical solutions. 
 - Define technical roadmaps, sequence projects into phases, and ensure timely execution across teams. Software Engineering & System Design

 - Solve complex cross-system issues through deep debugging, performance tuning, and root cause analysis.

data.title: Full-Stack Flutter Developer -
data.description:
About Cladbe

India sold over ₹6 lakh crore of new homes in its top seven cities, and much of it still runs on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and tools never built for real estate. Cladbe is building the operating system a real-estate developer runs the whole business on: every enquiry, site visit, booking, payment schedule and handover in one place. It connects to property. new, our marketplace built to show buyers every RERA-registered project in a city, checked and current. 

We're building toward commercial launch and hiring a Full-Stack Flutter Developer to join our core engineering team and build features end to end, from the screen to the API behind it. 

Where you'll work: for the first few months, the core team builds together in Bareilly. After that, the whole team moves to Noida, where the role is based. 

What you'll do

- Build our platform in Flutter across web and mobile, from first screen to release. 
 - Turn complex real-estate workflows into screens that are fast and simple to use, on a desktop in a sales office or a phone at a site. 
 - Write the backend your features need: Node. js and TypeScript services and the APIs behind them. 
 - Model data in PostgreSQL that stays correct when many people work on the same records at once. 
 - Keep every screen in step with live data, and keep the app usable on a weak connection: cached data, queued actions, and a clear sign when something is still syncing. 
 - Own quality end to end: performance, releases and tests. 

The stack

- Flutter and Dart, for web and mobile
 - Node. js and TypeScript, on PostgreSQL

Must have

- Flutter and Dart in production, including Flutter Web
 - State management with Riverpod or BLoC
 - Node. js and TypeScript: you've built APIs, not just called them
 - PostgreSQL: schema design, transactions and indexing
 - Real-time sync and offline-first patterns in Flutter: local cache, queued writes and resolving conflicts when they sync
 - Profiling and fixing performance issues on web and mobile

Nice to have

- Event-driven systems (message queues, event buses)
 - Apps shipped to the Play Store or App Store
 - B2B SaaS or real-estate products

Why join us

Join early enough that your decisions shape the platform behind a new way India's homes are marketed and sold. Dense workflows made simple, live data that has to be right, and a product built to be used every day by people who sell homes for a living. You'll work in a small team, close to the founder, where what you build ships. 

If that sounds like your kind of work, apply.

data.description:
Job Description

This is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g. , Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2. 4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e. , electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!

data.title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform Engineering)
data.description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world's leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit  www. saviynt. com. 

This is a Principal position within the  Platform Engineering organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated Platform Engineering hat, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience. 

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering-working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams-while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- 
12+ Years of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure. 

- 
Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production. 

- 
Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane. 

- 
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies. 

- 
Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends. 

- 
GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience-building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams. 

- 
Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale-module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases. 

- 
Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems. 

- 
Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures. 

- 
Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters. 

- 
Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs. 

- 
Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability. 

- 
Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs. 

- 
Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP). 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOINGInternal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal

- Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning. 

- Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles. 

- Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails. 

- Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach. 

Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations

- Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses. 

- Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments. 

Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes

- Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users. 

- Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams. 

- Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level. 

- Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations. 

GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure

- Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption. 

- Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows. 

- Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure. 

API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure

- Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives. 

- Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths. 

Infrastructure Automation & IaC

- Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default. 

- Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane).

data.title: Senior Backend and DevOps Engineer
data.company: Mogi I/O   OTT/Podcast/Short Video Apps for you
data.description:
About Mogi I/OWe build video infrastructure - live streaming, video-on-demand, transcoding and protected delivery - for media companies, creators and government projects. Our platform runs on Kubernetes across AWS and GCP, and our engineers own their systems end to end, from code to production. 

What You'll DoYou will design, build and run the Go services and infrastructure that keep our streams fast, secure and available under heavy load. 

Backend & Distributed Systems
 - Design and build high-throughput, concurrent Go services (goroutines, channels, context) that serve tens of millions of requests per day. 
 - Plan capacity and optimise services as traffic grows by an order of magnitude. 
 - Build safeguards against cascading failures - timeouts, retries, circuit breaking, rate limiting - so the platform holds up during traffic spikes. 
 - Build stateless, horizontally scalable APIs backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and RabbitMQ. 
Streaming & Media
 - Own live-streaming pipelines over RTMP/RTMPS, HLS and WebRTC, and push end-to-end latency down to a few seconds. 
 - Build and maintain transcoding and packaging pipelines with FFmpeg and Shaka Packager (CMAF, fMP4), tuned for low-bandwidth devices and fast startup. 
 - Build HLS encryption, URL signing and protected delivery through AWS CloudFront. 
 - Run re-streaming to third-party platforms such as YouTube and Instagram. 
Cloud, Kubernetes & DevOps
 - Operate multi-region, multi-cluster Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) and GCP (GKE), including cross-cluster ingress and load balancing. 
 - Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform across production and test environments. 
 - Ship through GitOps with Argo CD and CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins and Docker. 
 - Build serverless components on AWS Lambda where they fit, such as scheduling and EPG jobs. 
Reliability & Performance
 - Run distributed load tests (Locust) to validate performance and failure behaviour before launches. 
 - Instrument services with Prometheus and Grafana, and own their alerts and dashboards. 
 - Review code, mentor engineers and set backend standards for the team. 
What We're Looking ForYou have 4+ years building backend systems and running the cloud infrastructure they deploy on, with Go services in production at scale. 

- Strong Go: concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, context, profiling and memory tuning. 
 - Proven work on distributed systems that handle millions of requests per day, with measurable gains in latency, throughput or reliability. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one of FFmpeg, HLS, RTMP/RTMPS or WebRTC. 
 - Production Kubernetes and Docker on AWS or GCP. 
 - Infrastructure as code with Terraform, plus CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar). 
 - PostgreSQL or MongoDB, Redis, and a message broker such as RabbitMQ. 
 - Comfort with networking fundamentals: TCP, WebSockets, load balancing, CDNs. 
 - Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, and experience debugging live incidents. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
Nice to Have
 - GitOps with Argo CD. 
 - Packaging with Shaka Packager, CMAF and fMP4; DRM or HLS AES encryption. 
 - AWS Lambda, CloudFront and signed-URL delivery. 
 - Multi-region or multi-cluster Kubernetes with cross-cluster traffic management. 
 - Load testing at scale with Locust, k6 or similar. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or Node. js. 
 - Open-source work or side projects in high-concurrency networking - for example WebSocket servers, TCP servers or P2P systems. 
Why Join Mogi I/O
 - Work on real scale: live and on-demand video serving tens of millions of requests a day. 
 - Own systems end to end - design, infrastructure, deployment and on-call. 
 - Ship work with visible impact, from sub-5-second live latency to national-scale government projects. 
 - A small, senior team where your decisions shape the platform. 
 - Competitive salary, based on experience. 
Compensation & Salary PackageAnnual Compensation: ₹12, 00, 000 (₹12 LPA)

We offer a competitive annual compensation package of ₹12 LPA for this position, providing an opportunity to work on large-scale video infrastructure and high-impact engineering projects. 

How to ApplySend your resume and GitHub profile to hr@mogiio. com with the subject line "Senior Backend and DevOps Engineer". 

Tell us about one system you scaled or one latency problem you solved, with the numbers. 

Learn more about us at mogiio. com.

data.title: Embedded Software Manager
data.company: TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited
data.description:
Company Description TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited is the India arm of NEXTY Electronics, a 100% subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho, a major general trading company in Japan. Established in April 2000 in India, the company specializes in local distribution of electrical components and delivers stable production support through a robust supply chain. Building on decades of expertise in electronics, NEXTY Electronics provides comprehensive one-stop solutions, including system solutions, bespoke software development, and connected solutions for logistics and fleet management. The company collaborates with partner EMS providers for production services and is committed to quality service and innovative, customer-focused solutions. 

Role Description A Senior Embedded Software Manager -PMSM Motor Control leads the design, development, and team execution of firmware, control algorithms, and software architectures for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) & it's related peripherals, communications etc. This role spans automotive traction/Motor drives, industrial automation systems, and high-volume consumer appliances. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end embedded software and system architectures for 3-phase PMSM motor control Electronic Control Units (ECUs), industrial drives, and appliance control boards. 
 - Algorithm & Control Design: Oversee implementation of Field-Oriented Control (FOC), maximum torque per ampere (MTPA), field-weakening, sensorless/sensored commutation, and advanced observers. 
 - Application Scope Strategy: Drive software engineering for diverse applications including EV traction drives, automotive thermal management (electronic water pumps, cooling fans), industrial servo drives, and consumer motor control applications like air conditioning compressor controls. 
 - People & Program Management: Lead, mentor, and scale cross-functional embedded software and motor-control engineering teams. Handle sprint planning, milestone tracking, and cross-department collaboration. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to industry safety and quality standards, managing software lifecycles compliant as per industry needs e. g. ISO 26262 (Automotive ASIL), IEC 61508 (Industrial), IEC 60730 (Consumer Safety), ASPICE, and MISRA C guidelines. 
 - Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with power electronics, inverter hardware, and systems engineering for debugging, HIL/SIL/MIL validation, and motor dynamometer testing.

data.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we're on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We're looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. 

What You'll Do

As an experienced software engineer utilizing test instrumentation with a broad scope for implementing Viasat's test and measurement strategies, you will provide technical insights and skill to the product test engineering organization. You will drive long-term improvement of the organization's testing processes and growth in a multi-customer/multi-vendor/multi-configuration environment. 

You will need to think long-term and lay out scalable and maintainable solutions solving issues impacting customer test systems, with effective test measurement tools. You will need a clear understanding of the Test Development Life Cycle and consistently look beyond the current solutions and may have several deliverables not tied to a particular test process and platform. You will deal with broad issues and will be expected to provide solutions along with support. You will use your knowledge of software engineering processes, measurement methodologies, and instrumentation to continually improve all aspects of Viasat's test software solutions. 

You will work together with test engineers of different groups to improve their teams test strategies and make sure test coverage is complete among different teams and areas. In short, you will assist in defining the high-level testing strategies, while implementing the low-level frameworks and tools which make those strategies possible. This includes implementing and leveraging drivers, abstractions, libraries, and frameworks. 

In addition, you will have wide-reaching scope, impact and influence that extend beyond the confines of the Test organization and span the entire organization. Ultimately, you will be responsible for ensuring a quality test platform, delivered across all parameters, both functional and non-functional including performance, security, usability, etc. Sound interesting? Keep reading. . .

Viasat's Instrumentation test and driver development. 

Develop measurement strategies. 

Unit test, integration and automation test for testing.

- Minimum 6 years of professional experience working with RF and digital test instrumentation (e. g. , Spectrum and Network Analyzers, Oscilloscopes) and measurement techniques and methodologies (e. g. , Noise Figure, Spurious Emissions, IP3)

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in India. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute your technical expertise to the training and evaluation of next-generation artificial intelligence systems. You will design realistic software engineering challenges that assess AI models' ability to write reliable code, implement features, resolve bugs, refactor complex codebases, and optimize performance. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical capabilities of AI-generated software through rigorous testing and deterministic verification. You will draw on your experience in backend development, algorithms, system design, debugging, and software quality assurance to create meaningful technical assessments. Working independently in a fully remote, flexible contract role, you will have the opportunity to apply your engineering judgment to cutting-edge AI development. Previous experience in AI is not required; strong software engineering skills and a commitment to high-quality technical work are what matter most. 

Accountabilities

- Coding task development: Design realistic, challenging software engineering problems that evaluate AI systems across feature implementation, bug fixing, code refactoring, and performance optimization. 
 - Reference solution development: Create accurate, efficient, and maintainable reference implementations that demonstrate sound engineering practices and meet defined technical requirements. 
 - Automated verification: Develop deterministic verification mechanisms, validation scripts, and comprehensive test cases to assess solution correctness and distinguish acceptable implementations from incomplete or incorrect submissions. 
 - Backend engineering: Apply expertise in backend systems, scalable services, API design, asynchronous processing, and distributed architectures to create practical engineering challenges. 
 - Debugging and troubleshooting: Investigate complex defects, identify root causes, analyze performance bottlenecks, and design tasks that test effective problem-solving approaches. 
 - Testing and quality assurance: Develop robust testing strategies, build and maintain comprehensive test suites, diagnose flaky tests, and improve software reliability through automated validation. 
 - Code review and evaluation: Assess implementations for correctness, readability, maintainability, security, performance, and compliance with established software engineering standards. 
 - Refactoring and optimization: Create challenges that evaluate an AI system's ability to modernize legacy code, simplify complex implementations, improve algorithms, and optimize resource utilization. 
 - Technical reasoning assessment: Evaluate AI-generated solutions involving algorithms, architecture, debugging, system design, and implementation decisions. 
 - Documentation: Clearly document task specifications, expected behavior, reference solutions, test coverage, and acceptance criteria to ensure consistent and reproducible evaluations. 
 - Continuous improvement: Analyze model failures, identify recurring weaknesses, and refine coding tasks and evaluation methods to improve the quality and reliability of AI-generated software. 

Requirements

- Significant professional experience in software engineering, particularly backend development and production-grade applications or services. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Python 3, Java, Rust, TypeScript, C++, Node. js, Go, or comparable technologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable services, APIs, and reliable backend systems. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computer science fundamentals, system design, and software architecture. 
 - Extensive practical experience debugging complex applications, conducting root-cause analysis, resolving defects, and optimizing performance. 
 - Strong knowledge of automated testing, test design, regression testing, integration testing, unit testing, and software quality assurance. 
 - Ability to identify edge cases, implementation errors, inefficient algorithms, architectural weaknesses, and potential reliability issues. 
 - Proven experience with code reviews, refactoring, maintainable software design, and established engineering best practices. 
 - Excellent analytical thinking, technical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex engineering challenges independently. 
 - Strong written communication skills and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear, reproducible coding tasks and verification criteria. 
 - Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and consistently deliver high-quality results in a remote, contract-based environment. 

Additional Skills That Would Be Advantageous

- Experience designing and maintaining large-scale test suites and automated testing frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), distributed systems, microservices, and architectural design patterns. 
 - Experience diagnosing flaky tests and improving regression testing, integration testing, and unit testing processes. 
 - Knowledge of deterministic evaluation frameworks, automated code verification, or AI coding agent assessment. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy systems and improving production reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 - A track record of establishing testing standards and improving engineering quality across development teams. 

Previous AI industry experience is not mandatory. Candidates with strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent debugging skills, and sound technical judgment are encouraged to apply. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation: Advertised pay ranges from $30 to $100 per hour, depending on the engagement and applicable compensation arrangements. 
 - Flexible part-time schedule: Work approximately 15 hours per week, with the flexibility to choose your working days and hours, including weekends if preferred. 
 - Fully remote opportunity: Work remotely from India without a daily office commute. 
 - Contract-based engagement: Participate in project-based assignments focused on software engineering, coding challenges, and AI evaluation. 
 - Meaningful technical impact: Contribute to improving the performance, reliability, and capabilities of next-generation AI systems. 
 - Advanced technical challenges: Apply your expertise to complex problems involving backend systems, algorithms, automated testing, debugging, and code optimization. 
 - Independent work environment: Use your professional judgment and engineering experience to complete assignments with flexibility and autonomy. 
 - Potential for rapid onboarding: The selection process can move quickly, with some positions filled within approximately 48 hours. Successful candidates should be prepared to start their first tasks within 24-48 hours after onboarding. 

Important Engagement Details

- Compensation is output-based, with payment tied to tasks that satisfy the defined specifications and acceptance criteria. Actual completion time may vary depending on task complexity and individual experience. 
 - Minimum submission requirements apply, including a specified minimum number of tasks per week. 
 - The selection process may include application screening, an approximately 30-minute AI interview, a technical assessment where required, and a hiring manager review. 
 - Candidates must complete interviews, assessments, and project assignments independently, without assistance from AI tools or other individuals, in accordance with the engagement requirements. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: E&I Engineer
data.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems. 

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 
 - Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms. 
 - Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues. 
 - Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones. 

Essential Requirements

- Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience. 
 - Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory). 
 - HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent. 
 - Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP. 
 - Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives. 

Desirable Experience

- Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects. 
 - Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems. 
 - Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). 
 - OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443). 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

data.title: Founding Engineer – Full Stack (Compliance Automation)
data.description:
About the Company

Seclodian develops secure, reliable, and user-friendly technology products. We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer who can contribute to both frontend and backend development while maintaining high standards for security, performance, scalability, and code quality. 

About the role

You'll be one of Seclodian's first engineers. You'll work directly with the founders to turn compliance requirements into a product that auditors trust and auditees actually like using. You'll ship across the whole stack (Go, PostgreSQL, Next. js) and help decide how the platform grows. 

This role suits you if you've seen compliance from the inside. Maybe you built features for a GRC, audit, privacy or regtech product. Maybe you were the engineer who gathered the evidence and closed the findings during a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit. Either way, you now want to build the tool you wished you'd had. 

What you'll build

- Data models for frameworks, controls, tests and evidence, so one control can map across SOC 2, ISO 27001 and DPDP without duplicate work. 
 - Auditor and auditee workflows: engagements, control assignment, evidence upload and review, remediation, and report approval. 
 - PostgreSQL schemas, migrations and queries for multi-tenant data, where one customer must never see another customer's data. 
 - Secure Go APIs (chi, pgx) with authentication and role-based access for auditors, auditees and admins. 
 - Fast, accessible Next. js and React screens (Tailwind, shadcn/ui) built from our Figma designs. 
 - Audit trails that record who did what and when, in a form an auditor will accept. 
 - One product shipped three ways: an on-prem binary on the client's own server, Docker, and serverless on AWS. 
 - Work with our AI document-intelligence service, which reads policies and evidence and suggests answers with citations, while people stay in control of what gets accepted. 
 - Tests, code reviews, production fixes and better monitoring. 
 - With the founders and compliance experts, turning framework language into clear product behaviour. Must-have

- 2+ years of professional software engineering, building and shipping full-stack products. 
 - Hands-on compliance experience, in at least one of these ways: 
 - You built features for a compliance, GRC, audit, privacy or regtech product, or
 - You worked as an engineer through a SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR or DPDP audit or assessment, producing evidence, fixing findings or putting controls in place. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one of those frameworks. You know what a control is, what counts as evidence and why auditors ask for it. 
 - Production backend experience in Go. Strong engineers from Java, C# or TypeScript/Node are welcome if they're ready to go deep on Go quickly. 
 - Professional frontend experience with React and Next. js in TypeScript. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, indexes, transactions, constraints and migrations. 
 - You've built authentication, authorization and input validation, and you know the OWASP Top 10. 
 - You write automated tests and can debug problems you didn't create. Nice to have

- Experience in other regulated domains: fintech, healthtech, insurance. 
 - Privacy features you've built: consent capture, data retention and deletion, or data subject requests under GDPR or DPDP. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS, audit logging, or append-only or tamper-evident records. 
 - Integrations that pull evidence automatically from tools like AWS, Google Workspace, GitHub or Jira. 
 - Docker, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD. 
 - Background jobs and queues (Redis, SQS), structured logging, metrics and tracing. 
 - LLM or RAG systems in production. 
 - A certification or coursework in ISO 27001, CISA, CISSP or similar (not required). Why join now

- Shape the core product and architecture as one of the first engineers. 
 - Work directly with the founders on product and engineering decisions. 
 - Work on a problem that's growing fast in India as DPDP Act obligations come into force. Equal Opportunity Statement

Seclodian is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

HealthEdge is seeking a Manager, DevOps to lead the offshore DevOps engineering team supporting HealthRules® Payer (HRP) and related platforms. This role owns day-to-day delivery, technical direction, and people leadership for the India-based DevOps organization, reporting to the Director, DevOps (India). The Manager will partner closely with onshore DevOps leadership, HRP Engineering, Release Management, InfoSec, and Infrastructure Platform teams to execute the CI/CD modernization, AWS migration, and security remediation roadmap while building a resilient, well-coached team. 

This is a hands-on people-management role: the Manager is expected to run day-to-day operations, remove blockers, coach engineers, and represent the offshore team's work and capacity accurately to onshore leadership - not simply relay status upward. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery Management

- Manage and coach a team of offshore DevOps engineers, including 1: 1s, performance feedback, and career development plans. 
 - Own sprint and quarterly planning for the offshore DevOps workstreams, ensuring realistic capacity allocation across CI/CD, security remediation, and AWS migration initiatives. 
 - Identify and remediate single-point-of-failure (SPOF) risk within the team by building cross-training plans and documented ownership for critical systems (CI/CD infrastructure, release tooling, environment automation). 
 - Provide regular, accurate status reporting to the Director, DevOps and onshore leadership using a decision-focused format (hot topics, upcoming milestones, blockers, risks). 
 - Escalate ownership, scope, or resourcing conflicts early, with clear recommendations rather than status updates alone. 

CI/CD & Platform Engineering Oversight

- Guide execution of the Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions migration, including EKS-based runner architecture, GitHub Apps authentication, and CI/CD pipeline modernization. 
 - Oversee Infrastructure-as-Code (CDK/Ansible) provisioning for internal environments (Dev, QA, Perf, Shared, Preprod), maintaining the boundary that DevOps owns internal environments while Release Management owns customer-facing environments. 
 - Drive the Azure-to-AWS migration workstream for internally owned environments, coordinating with Infrastructure Platform and networking teams to resolve cutover blockers. 
 - Ensure code release, build, and deployment tooling (Nexus, Sonar, Jenkins) is kept current, secure, and migrated per the platform roadmap. 

Security & Compliance Execution

- Lead the offshore team's execution of Q4 security initiatives originating from InfoSec, including dependency-tree generation, secrets detection/rotation, vulnerable-commit blocking, and Wiz runtime integration. 
 - Own DevOps' portion of the secrets remediation program: guardrail tooling, Secrets Manager/Vault integration, and coordination with repo owners and Release Management on rotation. 
 - Maintain clear RACI boundaries when scoping security work - DevOps owns pipeline-level guardrails; repo and environment owners drive remediation; Release Management owns customer-environment actions. 
 - Support FedRAMP 20x and CMS POC evidence requirements as they relate to DevOps-owned controls (STIG AMIs, TLS, Secrets Manager, GitHub Apps, IaC). 

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Partner with the Director, DevOps, onshore senior ICs, and HRP Engineering leadership to align on architecture, release cadence, and upcoming platform changes before they reach the team mid-quarter. 
 - Represent the offshore team in the monthly DevOps/Engineering cadence and biweekly senior IC forums, surfacing toil, risk, and proactive architectural concerns. 
 - Coordinate with Infrastructure Platform, InfoSec, and Release Management to resolve cross-team ownership gaps before they become production issues. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Platform Engineering roles, with at least 2-3 years in a people-management or team-lead capacity. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing distributed or offshore engineering teams, including performance management and coaching plans. 
 - Strong hands-on background in CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK, Ansible, Terraform), and cloud platforms (AWS required; Azure a plus). 
 - Working knowledge of GitHub administration, including GitHub Apps, PAT-to-App migrations, and repository governance at scale (400+ repositories). 
 - Experience with artifact and dependency management tooling (Nexus, Sonar) and secrets management platforms (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager). 
 - Familiarity with security remediation workflows: vulnerability scanning, dependency-tree analysis, secrets rotation, and runtime security tooling (e. g. , Wiz). 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to produce concise, decision-focused updates for senior leadership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve single-point-of-failure risk and to build redundancy into critical operational functions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting healthcare technology, claims processing, or other regulated/compliance-heavy platforms. 
 - Familiarity with FedRAMP, HITRUST, or similar compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) for CI/CD runner infrastructure or application workloads. 
 - Exposure to DORA metrics and engineering-productivity measurement programs. 
 - Prior experience operating in a matrixed organization with distinct onshore/offshore reporting lines. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 6 Months

- Offshore team capacity, ownership, and SPOF risks are documented and actively being mitigated through cross-training. 
 - Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions and AWS migration workstreams are progressing against a jointly owned, realistic timeline with clear blockers surfaced early. 
 - Security remediation items owned by DevOps show measurable burn-down, with clean ownership boundaries agreed upon with InfoSec and Release Management. 
 - The Director, DevOps and onshore leadership have consistent visibility into offshore delivery through structured, decision-focused reporting.

Job Title: Lead Quality Engineer / MDM Test Engineer

Role Overview

We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our Reltio MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match & merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes - ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness. 
 - Test match & merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations. 
 - Validate integration pipelines (batch and real-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. 
 - Perform data quality testing - profiling, validation, and reconciliation - across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub. 
 - Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium. 
 - Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar. 
 - Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations. 
 - Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria. 
 - Validate data migration activities - pre-migration, mid-migration, and post-migration - ensuring data integrity and completeness. 
 - Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles. 
 - Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports. 
 - Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 3+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1-2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar). 
 - Hands-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts - entities, relationships, match & merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows - sufficient to design meaningful test cases. 
 - Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools. 
 - Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy). 
 - Experience with data quality testing concepts - completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness. 
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy. 
 - Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines. 
 - Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus. 
 - Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. ) for automated testing workflows. 
 - Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects. 
 - Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements. 
 - Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services. 

Key Competencies

- Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset. 
 - Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams. 
 - Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks. 
 - Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions. 

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale. 

Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles

- Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
 - Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
 - All Support needed for the realization of business goals, 
 - Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO)

About Codewinglet

Codewinglet Pvt. Ltd. is an AI-first engineering company building modern software products and solutions across AI, web, backend, and cloud technologies. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to build, automate, secure, and maintain reliable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. You will work with cloud, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, and monitoring tools to improve deployment efficiency and production reliability. 

You will take ownership of infrastructure and delivery tasks from implementation through troubleshooting and continuous improvement, collaborating closely with development and engineering teams. You will also contribute to technical design decisions, infrastructure reviews, incident resolution, and knowledge sharing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and application deployments across environments. 
 - Provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices. 
 - Manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. 
 - Monitor systems, investigate incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventive improvements. 
 - Apply cloud security best practices, manage secrets, and support vulnerability remediation. 
 - Optimize cloud costs, performance, availability, and resource utilization. 
 - Follow change-management practices and maintain technical documentation. 
 - Collaborate with development teams on automation, infrastructure design, and release reliability. 

Required Technical Skills

- Linux & Networking: Linux administration, troubleshooting, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls, load balancers, and AWS networking (VPC, subnets, routing, security groups). 
 - Git & Scripting: Git workflows, branching strategies, and Bash or Python scripting. 
 - Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, and hands-on Helm chart development, configuration, releases, and troubleshooting. 
 - CI/CD: Practical experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or an equivalent platform; automated builds, testing, deployments, and rollbacks. 
 - AWS: Hands-on experience with services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and EKS or ECS. 
 - Terraform: Infrastructure provisioning, reusable modules, remote state, state locking, environment separation, and plan/apply workflows. 
 - Monitoring & Security: Metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, incident troubleshooting, least-privilege IAM, secret management, and vulnerability scanning. 

Good To Have (Preferred Skills)

- Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux. 
 - DevSecOps tools such as Trivy, Gitleaks, SonarQube, or Snyk. 
 - OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SRE practices, or FinOps. 
 - Relevant certifications such as AWS SAA / DOP, CKA, CKAD, or Terraform Associate. 

Eligibility Criteria

- Experience: 1-6 years in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering.

 - Certifications: Cloud, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications are preferred but not mandatory. 
 - Willingness to work onsite in Surat and participate in operational support as required. 

What You Will Gain

 - Opportunities to work on infrastructure design, automation, security, and cloud optimization. 
 - Structured learning paths, learning materials, and support for professional development. 
 - Growth opportunities toward Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or SRE roles. 

Soft Skills We Value

- Ownership, systematic problem-solving, curiosity, clear communication, collaboration, proactiveness, composure, and continuous improvement. 

Why Join Codewinglet?

 - Real-time AI projects, including AI Agents and GenAI systems. 
 - High-growth, fast-paced learning environment. 
 - Exposure to the latest technologies and live projects. 
 - Supportive and transparent leadership. 
 - Clear career growth and performance-based appraisals.
