data.title: Senior Software Engineer- Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Golang/Python
data.description:
About The Job

The Red Hat Engineering team is looking for a talented and versatile Senior Software Engineer. 

Our mission is to deliver a next generation platform for building, testing and releasing artifacts to deliver Red Hat products and services using open hybrid cloud technologies while focusing on innovation and security. 

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing the next-gen productization pipeline, optimizing our systems, and ensuring a seamless user experience in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 

This position requires a proactive problem solver who is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions and continuously improving our systems. 

You will work with Red Hat's latest open source technologies, such as Kubernetes, Tekton, ArgoCD, Terraform and OpenShift. You will also work closely with Red Hat's leading product development teams, QE, SRE, product management, and other stakeholders worldwide, working with a stable team in an agile environment to deliver services for Red Hat teams and customers. 

What you will do?

- Design, develop, and implement new features based on evolving business requirements. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software defects. 
 - Ensure that all code changes maintain or improve system stability and performance. 
 - Assist users by troubleshooting issues and providing technical support when needed. 
 - Gather user feedback and suggest improvements to enhance user experience. 
 - Monitor system performance and implement optimizations to improve efficiency and scalability. 
 - Conduct code reviews and refactor existing code to maintain code quality and performance. 
 - Deploy changes to staging and production environments following established processes and best practices. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth and reliable operation of software in production. 
 - Stay updated with industry trends and technologies to bring innovative ideas to the team. 
 - Contribute to the improvement of internal processes, tools, and standards. 
 - Work with open source communities such as Tekton and Kubernetes and submitting code in these upstream communities for review
 - Work in a global team, including teams in EMEA, NA, and APAC
 - Work with developers, quality engineers, PMs, SRE and customers
 - Learn about the latest AI tools and how to apply them to solve existing problems

What you will bring?

- Ability to work with new and fast-changing technologies with a high level of uncertainty, reacting to changes in requirements quickly
 - Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for learning and adapting to new challenges. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent working experience
 - At least 5 years of experience writing code in Golang, JAVA, or Python
 - Experience working on shared codebases using source control management (SCM) systems like GitHub or GitLab
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. 
 - Experience working with Linux as a developer
 - Experience with building & debugging applications on Kubernetes clusters
 - Experience building and running containerized applications and controllers
 - Experience with cloud-based infrastructure (e. g. , AWS) and microservices architecture

The Following Is Considered a Plus

- Experience with IBM cloud
 - Experience in Terraform
 - Experience in Tekton or ArgoCD
 - Experience building CICD pipelines
 - Experience in Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk
 - Experience in Open Source development
 - Experience defining requirements between application components
 - Experience in DevSecOps or Product Security 
 - Experience with Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM)

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world's leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. 

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat's culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. 

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. 

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Department: LAPS Development, Enterprise IT & Quality

As PEMS (Production Environment Monitoring System) developer you will design, develop and support solutions on the LabVantage LIMS platform for QC laboratory operations and the PEMS system. You will build features and interfaces, resolve complex application issues and contribute to reliable releases in a regulated GxP environment. By combining strong technical delivery with close business collaboration, you will help improve system functionality, data integrity and the day-to-day experience of laboratory users. 

What You'll Bring

You are a hands-on developer who takes ownership, learns independently and works effectively across technical and business teams. You will bring: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or an equivalent discipline. 
 - 4-6 years of software development experience using Java and database technologies, including application development, configuration and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong development skills in Core Java, JavaScript, JSP, REST APIs, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL. 
 - Experience debugging application issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes. 
 - Experience authoring and reviewing FDS, TDS, API documents, risk assessments and test documentation. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, verbal and written communication, analytical and decision-making skills. 
 - A proactive, self-driven approach with ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing and the ability to work within defined processes and deadlines. 

Useful, But Not Essential

- Experience with hands on PEMS development in the Lab Vantage ecosystem is a plus
 - Experience operating and maintaining a GxP or business-critical IT system is a plus

What You'll Do

- Design and development: Develop LabVantage LIMS features, interfaces, configurations and proofs of concept for the PEMS system. 
 - Technical troubleshooting: Perform root cause analysis, resolve application issues, deliver bug fixes and patch sets, and address support tickets requiring technical analysis. 
 - Specifications and quality: Create, update and review FDS, TDS and API documentation; perform code reviews and maintain relevant CIL updates. 
 - Release and upgrade delivery: Contribute to PEMS upgrades and releases by developing changes, assessing risk, designing and executing tests, and deploying to validation and production environments. 
 - Testing and validation: Prepare and execute SIT and OQ test cases and support compliant delivery across the end-to-end release cycle. 
 - Business collaboration: Work with users, system owners, system managers, product and project stakeholders, IT SMEs, service providers, consultants and vendors to deliver high-quality solutions.

 - Agile delivery: Contribute actively in daily stand-ups, PI Planning, team channels and other Agile delivery activities. 

Who You'll Work With

You will join the LAPS Development and work globally with colleagues supporting QC laboratory operations and the PEMS system. Your partners will include line-of-business users, system owners and managers, product and project stakeholders, department managers, IT subject-matter experts, service providers, external consultants, vendors and the Release Train Engineer. 

You will collaborate with these groups throughout development, support, release and improvement activities, presenting solutions and coordinating vendor contributions to keep delivery aligned with business needs and quality expectations. 

What You Can Expect Here

You will work in an international, regulated environment where technical quality, compliance and dependable laboratory systems matter. The role offers broad ownership across development, problem solving, validation, stakeholder collaboration and release delivery, with opportunities to deepen your LabVantage expertise and influence future improvements. 

You will be encouraged to bring forward ideas, share knowledge, mentor colleagues and take initiative on complex challenges while helping the team deliver trusted systems and services. 

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build and improve LabVantage LIMS solutions that support QC laboratory operations, apply for the PEMS application developer role.

data.title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
data.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world. 

SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations. 

What You Will Do

- Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems. 
 - Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers. 
 - Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data. 
 - Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues. 
 - Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions. 
 - Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes. 
 - Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas. 
 - Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses. 
 - Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations. 
 - Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes. 
 - Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks. 
 - Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas. 
 - Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior. 
 - Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions. 
 - Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.

Job Description Summary

This position is part of the R&D Validation and Verification (V&V) team. The R&D team is responsible for designing, implementing, and testing embedded software for protection and control applications, primarily in the electrical distribution and transmission industry. 

The role also includes the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, and Agentic AI to enhance R&D V&V activities, including intelligent test automation, automated test-case generation, test-result analysis, anomaly detection, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of verification and validation processes. 

Job Description

- Define and implement comprehensive Verification & Validation (V&V) strategies, test plans, and frameworks for power-system, protection, control, embedded software, and industrial communication products. 
 - Review system requirements, communication specifications, use cases, interfaces, and architecture to establish complete test coverage, traceability, and validation criteria. 
 - Design and execute system-level, integration, communication, functional, regression, interoperability, performance, robustness, and negative testing. 
 - Develop and maintain Python-based automated test frameworks, communication simulators, protocol test tools, and test infrastructure. 
 - Plan and execute validation of industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104 (T104), T103, T101, TCP/IP, Ethernet, and Serial communication. 
 - Perform communication interoperability and integration testing between IEDs, protection relays, RTUs, SCADA systems, gateways, PLCs, control systems, and substation automation systems. 
 - Validate communication functions including data exchange, command/control, time synchronization, event reporting, configuration, fault handling, timeout, recovery, redundancy, and performance. 
 - Develop Python-based tools for protocol message generation, packet analysis, device simulation, communication monitoring, automated validation, and fault injection. 
 - Analyze communication traces, network packets, relay event records, system logs, and test results to identify communication and system-level issues. 
 - Troubleshoot complex communication, embedded software, firmware, and system-integration issues and perform structured root-cause analysis. 
 - Work closely with Power Systems, Protection, Hardware, Firmware, Software, Systems Engineering, and Continuous Engineering teams to resolve defects and improve product reliability. 
 - Validate Protection & Control systems for generators, transmission lines, transformers, motors, busbars, substations, and digital control applications. 
 - Test protection schemes including Overcurrent/Earth Fault, Differential, Distance, Generator, Motor, Transformer, and Busbar protection. 
 - Validate protection relays, IEDs, RTUs, SCADA interfaces, digital control systems, gateways, and embedded software/firmware. 
 - Apply AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI to communication and V&V activities. 
 - Develop AI Agents that can analyze communication requirements, generate test scenarios, orchestrate approved test workflows, analyze protocol logs, detect anomalies, classify failures, and assist with root-cause analysis. 
 - Develop Agentic AI-based communication testing solutions capable of interacting with approved testing tools, simulators, protocol analyzers, and V&V infrastructure. 
 - Apply AI-assisted analysis to IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, T104, TCP/IP, Ethernet, and serial communication logs and traces to accelerate troubleshooting and defect identification. 
 - Implement intelligent workflows for automated test-case generation, regression-test optimization, communication anomaly detection, test-result analysis, and automated V&V reporting. 
 - Ensure AI/Agentic AI-based testing remains traceable, explainable, repeatable, deterministic where required, and subject to engineering validation and human approval. 
 - Establish and maintain CI/CT-based automated V&V pipelines for continuous communication and system testing. 
 - Use JIRA, Xray, Confluence, Git, and other engineering tools for requirements traceability, test management, defect tracking, documentation, and configuration management. 
 - Continuously improve communication testing methodologies, automation frameworks, AI-assisted V&V capabilities, test coverage, and product reliability. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Communication Engineering, Instrumentation, or Power Systems Engineering. 
 - Minimum 3+ years of experience in communication testing, system V&V, embedded software/firmware testing, automation, or R&D engineering. 
 - Strong Python programming skills for automation, scripting, protocol testing, data analysis, and tool integration. 
 - Strong understanding of industrial communication, power-system automation, protection, control, and embedded systems. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of: 
 - IEC 61850
 - DNP3
 - Modbus
 - IEC 60870-5-104 (T104)
 - T103
 - T101
 - TCP/IP
 - Ethernet
 - Serial communication
 - Experience with communication troubleshooting, protocol analysis, packet capture, message decoding, interoperability testing, and network diagnostics. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI applied to testing, automation, communication analysis, or engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of AI Agent architecture, tool/function calling, RAG, APIs, Python-based AI automation, and intelligent workflow orchestration is desirable. 
Power System & Protection Knowledge

- Understanding of electrical distribution and transmission systems. 
 - Knowledge of Protection & Control systems for generators, transmission lines, transformers, motors, busbars, and substations. 
 - Knowledge of IEC and ANSI standards related to protection, control, automation, and communication. 
 - Understanding of CT/VT calculations and protection relay settings is advantageous. 
 - Experience with ABB, Siemens, SEL, and other major relay manufacturers is an advantage. 

AI & Agentic Communication Engineering

- Develop intelligent communication-testing agents capable of: 
 - Analyzing communication requirements
 - Generating protocol test scenarios
 - Creating test data
 - Executing approved test workflows
 - Monitoring communication traffic
 - Analyzing protocol logs
 - Detecting communication anomalies
 - Identifying failure patterns
 - Supporting root-cause analysis
 - Generating automated test reports
 - Combine Agentic AI + Python + industrial protocols + power-system domain knowledge to create next-generation automated communication V&V solutions. 
 - Apply human-in-the-loop controls and engineering validation for AI-driven decisions in safety- and reliability-critical power-system applications. 
Tools & Processes

- Python, Git, JIRA, Xray, Confluence
 - Protocol analyzers and network diagnostic tools
 - Automated test frameworks and simulators
 - CI/CD and Continuous Testing
 - SDLC, STLC, V-Model, Agile/SAFe
 - White-box, black-box, system, integration, regression, interoperability, and performance testing

Desired Characteristics

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills in industrial communication and embedded systems. 
 - Ability to bridge communication engineering, power systems, protection & control, software automation, and Agentic AI. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills across multidisciplinary R&D teams. 
 - Strong interest in applying AI Agents and intelligent automation to next-generation power-system communication and V&V.

data.title: Full-Stack AI Compute Architect
data.description:
Full-Stack AI Compute Architect

Hyderabad, India | On-site

Experience: 12 + Years

About OXMIQ

OXMIQ provides complete hardware and software GPU IP that lets our customers build their own AI silicon. Founded by Raja Koduri, we recently closed a $35M Series A (co-led by Samsung Catalyst Fund and Fundomo, with MediaTek, Intel Capital, and others), bringing total funding to $60M, with Jim Keller joining our board. 

Our OxCore architecture combines scalar, tensor, SIMT, and orchestration engines on one platform - delivering CUDA compatibility alongside a fully programmable architecture. On top of it runs OxPython, our software stack that runs existing CUDA and PyTorch code unmodified with day-zero support for new AI models. We have an established team and a working stack, and we're now shifting from development to production - hardening the platform and scaling it for inference at real customer scale. 

You'll join the OXMIQ architecture team, which sets the direction of our software, silicon, and systems. You'll help refine our software strategy and deliver the highest-performance solutions by optimizing the whole stack - from AI models and frameworks at the top down to kernel and hardware-level code generation. 

The Scope of This Role

This role spans the AI software stack from models on down - the full vertical path a workload travels: from a model authored in frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or ONNX, through graph capture and the compiler, into the runtime and scheduler, down to individual kernels and the instructions that execute on OxCore. 

We're looking for an architect who is fluent across that whole range - someone who can reason about how a transformer or diffusion model is structured and about warp divergence and register allocation, and who can make the choices that connect those layers into one coherent, high-performance platform. You won't be the deepest specialist at every layer, but you should be able to hold the whole range in your head and drive decisions end to end. 

Key Responsibilities

- Refine the technical direction of OxPython, the OXMIQ software stack - from framework front-ends (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and model ingestion, through graph capture, the compiler, runtime, and driver layers, down to kernels - in close partnership with the existing software team. 
 - Own how AI models map onto the platform: understand how modern workloads (LLMs, diffusion, vision, agentic inference, and beyond) are structured and expressed at the framework level, and shape how they are captured, partitioned, and lowered so they run unmodified with day-zero support and scale efficiently for inference. 
 - Own whole-stack performance: drive optimization end to end, identify and remove bottlenecks at every layer - from graph-level and framework-level inefficiencies down through compiler, runtime, driver, and kernels - and close the gap to peak hardware utilization. 
 - Guide the graph and compiler strategy: MLIR dialect and IR design, lowering pipelines, operator representation, and LLVM backend code generation targeting Oxmiq hardware IP. 
 - Architect work orchestration across OxCore's scalar, tensor, and SIMT engines, and shape the compiler/runtime approach that runs CUDA-optimized models unmodified - preserving day-zero support for new AI models without sacrificing programmability. 
 - Advance the SIMT execution and parallel compute strategy: thread/warp scheduling, divergence handling, occupancy, and the memory hierarchy, and how parallel workloads are expressed, lowered, and mapped onto the hardware. 
 - Refine and optimize the strategy for kernel programming models (including Triton-based and custom op lowering), kernel fusion, and tiling, in collaboration with kernel engineers. 
 - Design for scale and production: ensure solutions grow cleanly with customer workloads, deployment sizes, and model complexity, and harden them for real-world delivery. 
 - Work with architecture and hardware teams to translate performance requirements into efficient code generation and runtime strategies, and feed software needs back into hardware definition. 
 - Drive the software/hardware validation strategy - evolving how the stack and silicon are co-verified as we scale from bring-up through production. 
 - Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions, and mentor engineers across the frameworks, compiler, runtime, and kernel teams. 
 - Guide performance profiling, benchmarking, and root cause analysis for compiler- and runtime-generated code. 

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years building systems and/or AI-infrastructure software, with a track record of owning architecture for a major component or a full stack that spans multiple layers. 
 - Breadth across the AI software stack - you can reason about the problem from the model and framework level down to the kernel and instruction level, and understand how choices at one layer constrain the others. 
 - Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, ONNX) and a solid understanding of how deep learning models are structured, expressed, captured, and optimized - not just at the operator level but as whole graphs and workloads. 
 - Strong expertise in C++ and compiler infrastructure, including LLVM (IR, pass infrastructure, backend code generation) and MLIR (dialect design, conversion passes, progressive lowering). 
 - Deep expertise in SIMT and parallel compute architectures - thread/warp execution models, divergence, synchronization, occupancy constraints, and memory hierarchies. 
 - Proven experience with GPU programming models, including CUDA, and an understanding of what it takes to deliver CUDA compatibility on non-NVIDIA hardware. 
 - Solid command of code generation concepts - instruction selection, scheduling, register allocation, vectorization, and memory hierarchy optimization. 
 - Experience co-designing software alongside silicon or shaping a hardware-software interface. 
 - Strong debugging and performance analysis skills, and a bias toward shipping: you prototype, measure, and make decisions with incomplete information. 
 - Hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development workflows. 

Note: we expect exceptional depth in some of these areas and working fluency across the rest. The essential requirement is the ability to operate across the whole stack, not mastery of every layer. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience architecting compiler backends or runtimes for custom AI accelerators, NPUs, or GPU IP. 
 - Experience with graph-level model optimization, framework integration internals (e. g. , PyTorch compile/inductor, XLA), or serving/inference infrastructure for large models. 
 - Experience with Triton or similar high-level GPU kernel frameworks, and with kernel fusion, operator tiling, and auto-tuning. 
 - Exposure to quantization, mixed-precision, or sparsity-aware compilation techniques. 
 - Experience with performance modeling and roofline analysis for GPU workloads. 
 - Background in deep learning, computer vision, image processing, or video - the workloads our customers run. 
 - Experience bringing up and scaling a software stack on new or pre-silicon hardware into production. 
 - Contributions to open-source compiler, runtime, or ML-framework projects such as LLVM, MLIR, PyTorch, or Triton. 

Education

B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech/MS/Ph. D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Why OXMIQ

You'll join a well-funded company - fresh off a $35M Series A backed by Samsung, MediaTek, Intel Capital, and others, with Jim Keller on our board - with an established team and a proven stack, at the point where we're scaling it into a production platform in customers' hands. You'll work directly with the people designing the hardware it runs on. 

This is a role for an architect who wants to refine and optimize the AI software stack end to end - from models and frameworks down to kernels and silicon - rather than just one layer of it, and measure success in shipped, high-performance solutions. 

Compensation & Benefits

OXMIQ offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, equity participation, comprehensive medical coverage, and the opportunity to contribute to foundational silicon and software technology. 

OXMIQ is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Team Lead - Structural EngineeringAbout TomorrowTech Engineering ServicesTomorrowTech Engineering Services is an engineering services company focused on structural analysis, design, and engineering solutions for telecommunications towers, transmission structures, steel structures, and related infrastructure. 

We work with industry-standard engineering software, structural design codes, and technical analysis methods to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality engineering solutions. 

Our focus is on technical excellence, efficient project execution, teamwork, and continuous improvement. 

Website: www. ttecheng. in

Sister Company: Advanced Tower Structural Solutions (ATSS) - www. atssquare. com

Position OverviewTomorrowTech Engineering Services is seeking a technically capable and responsible Team Lead - Structural Engineering to lead the engineering team and oversee the execution of structural engineering projects. 

The role requires strong structural engineering knowledge, effective team management, project coordination, and the ability to ensure accurate, high-quality deliverables within defined timelines. Experience in steel design, tower design, and the telecommunications or transmission sector will be particularly relevant. 

Key Responsibilities
 - Lead and manage the engineering team to ensure effective execution of assigned projects. 
 - Plan, allocate, and monitor work assignments based on project requirements and priorities. 
 - Manage project execution and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and within defined timelines. 
 - Monitor project progress and ensure adherence to required turnaround times (TAT). 
 - Provide technical guidance and support to team members. 
 - Review project requirements, engineering outputs, and applicable standards to maintain technical quality. 
 - Identify project-related challenges and coordinate appropriate actions for timely resolution. 
 - Maintain effective communication and coordination within the team to ensure smooth workflows. 
 - Manage multiple assignments while maintaining quality, accountability, and delivery commitments. Qualifications & Experience
 - Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering with strong structural engineering knowledge and 3-5 years of relevant industry experience. 
 - A Master's degree in a relevant field is an advantage. Candidates with a Master's degree and at least 2 years of relevant industry experience may also be considered. 
 - Experience in steel design and/or tower design is preferred. 
 - Experience in structural engineering within the telecommunications, transmission, or related steel-structure industry is an advantage. Technical Skills & Knowledge
 - Working knowledge of structural engineering and design software, particularly TNX, SolidWorks, RISA-3D, STAAD. Pro, and AutoCAD, along with relevant connection analysis software. 
 - Knowledge of structural design codes and standards, including AISC, TIA-222, and ASCE 7. 
 - Strong understanding of structural and engineering drawings, structural analysis, steel design, and foundation engineering fundamentals. 
 - Ability to review structural models, engineering calculations, and design outputs for accuracy and compliance with applicable requirements. 
 - Exposure to telecommunications towers, transmission structures, traffic signal structures, luminaire structures, or other related steel structures is an advantage. Leadership & Professional Competencies
 - Strong team leadership and people management skills. 
 - Ability to plan, prioritize, and allocate assignments effectively. 
 - Experience coordinating multiple projects and ensuring timely delivery. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills. 
 - Ability to guide team members, address technical challenges, and maintain efficient workflows. 
 - Strong ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to engineering quality. Work Location & ArrangementLocation: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh

Work Arrangement: On-site, with flexibility to work from home two days per week. 

CompensationCompensation will be determined based on the candidate's relevant experience, technical skills, demonstrated capabilities, and overall suitability for the position. 

How to ApplyInterested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/resume to: 

niteshahuja@atssquare. com

vawasthi@ttecheng. in

Company Website: www. ttecheng. in

Please mention "Application - Team Lead" in the email subject line.

data.title: Python Backend Developer – Distributed & Event-Driven Systems
data.description:
We are looking for a Python Backend Engineer with hands-on experience in distributed systems and event-driven architecture to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and data processing workflows. 

The ideal candidate will have experience building Python-based microservices, implementing event-driven communication using message brokers, handling asynchronous processing, and developing reliable distributed workflows. Strong programming fundamentals and knowledge of API development, concurrency, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant system design are essential. 

The role involves building scalable backend services, processing events asynchronously, managing service-to-service communication, and ensuring the reliability, performance, and resilience of distributed applications. 

Title : Python Backend Engineer

Location : Remote Work

Employment Type: Full-time

Exp Range: 2+ years

Key Responsibilities: 

- Python Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Distributed Systems: Build and maintain distributed backend services, handling service communication, concurrent requests, failures, timeouts, retries, and fault tolerance. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven workflows using message brokers or event streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Messaging & Event Processing: Develop event producers and consumers, process messages asynchronously, and handle message failures, retries, duplicate events, and delivery guarantees. 
 - Microservices Development: Build independent backend services and implement reliable service-to-service communication and integration. 
 - Asynchronous Processing & Task Scheduling: Implement asynchronous operations, background jobs, scheduled tasks, and task queues using asyncio, Celery, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Data Ingestion & ETL Pipelines: Develop data processing workflows to extract, transform, validate, and load data while maintaining accuracy and reliability. 
 - Database Development: Write and optimize SQL queries, manage database interactions, and integrate backend services with PostgreSQL, AlloyDB, or other SQL databases. 
 - Redis & Caching: Implement caching and efficient data access strategies to reduce database load and improve application performance. 
 - Problem Solving & Debugging: Analyze logs, troubleshoot complex backend issues, identify root causes, and optimize application performance. 
 - Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker to package backend services and support deployments and troubleshooting in AWS or GCP environments. 
 - Code Quality & Collaboration: Follow clean coding practices, use Git for version control, participate in code reviews, and write maintainable, testable code. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications: 

- Python Backend Development: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing backend applications and REST APIs using Python, preferably with FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Distributed Systems: Practical understanding of distributed services, service-to-service communication, fault tolerance, timeouts, retries, and failure handling. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Hands-on experience with event-driven workflows, message producers and consumers, and asynchronous messaging. 
 - Message Brokers: Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies. Familiarity with message delivery guarantees, acknowledgments, retries, and dead-letter queues is preferred. 
 - Microservices: Understanding of independent backend services, REST APIs, and service integration patterns. 
 - Asynchronous Processing & Concurrency: Knowledge of asyncio, async/await, concurrent execution, and non-blocking I/O. 
 - Task Scheduling & Background Processing: Experience or working knowledge of background jobs, scheduled tasks, and task queues using Celery or equivalent technologies. 
 - SQL & Database Integration: Working knowledge of SQL and experience with PostgreSQL, AlloyDB, or another relational database. 
 - ETL & Data Processing: Exposure to data ingestion, extraction, transformation, validation, or data pipeline development. 
 - Redis & Caching: Understanding of caching strategies and their impact on backend performance. 
 - Docker & Cloud Fundamentals: Familiarity with Docker and basic exposure to AWS or GCP environments. 
 - Problem Solving & Debugging: Strong analytical skills, ability to troubleshoot backend issues, investigate failures, and write clean, maintainable code. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience building production-grade distributed applications. 
 - Understanding of idempotency, eventual consistency, and message ordering. 
 - Exposure to observability tools, structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines

Specific benefits and programs vary by location. 

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded full-stack engineer who works independently across backend services, modern web application development, and cloud-native architectures, applying sound engineering judgment across a range of situations with only occasional guidance. The role requires familiarity with AI-assisted development practices and the ability to incorporate AI-powered capabilities into business solutions where they add measurable value. This individual demonstrates strong ownership, delivers quality outcomes with minimal oversight, contributes to design and architecture based on approved patterns, and supports and mentors less-experienced engineers while contributing hands-on to the design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications using AWS services and modern engineering practices.

 - Build responsive, performant, and user-friendly experiences in partnership with product owners and business stakeholders.

 - Draft designs and architecture based on approved patterns, and apply best practices for cloud architecture, security, observability, performance, and resiliency. 
 - Design AWS serverless components (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) and containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and proactively identify cost-optimization opportunities. 
 - Optimize database design and queries across relational (Postgres, Aurora, MySQL, Oracle) and non-relational (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis) stores, and contribute to data modeling activities. 
 - Automate deployment, monitoring, and management of cloud applications, and create and maintain operational dashboards in CloudWatch, Sumo Logic, and Dynatracz. 
 - Lead RFCs and support deployments; create effective root-cause analyses for incidents to prevent recurrence.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

 - Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical solutions independently with occasional guidance. 
 - Experience mentoring or guiding junior developers and reviewing peers' pull requests.

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively.

 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III
data.description:
What is Hunch?

Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room. 

With 2. 4M+ daters, 1. 47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world. 

Link to our fundraising announcement

Key Offerings Of Hunch

- One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe. 
 - Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage. 
 - Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections. 
 - Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever. 

About The Role

We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We're looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally. 

What You'll Do

- Own backend features end-to-end - product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket. 
 - Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next. js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy). 
 - Own async & event-driven work - queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler. )
 - Ship LLM-backed product features - tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users. 
 - Keep production legible - tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke. 
 - Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python - strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role. 
 - Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL - schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones. 
 - Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka - producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates. 
 - Service design & delivery - clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD. 
 - End-to-end ownership - you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus. 
 - Engineering hygiene - writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved. 

Preferred Experience

- ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double. 
 - LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus. 
 - Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog). 
 - Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly. 
 - Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products. 

What We Offer

- Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI). 
 - Employee benefits like Medical Insurance. 
 - Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options). 

Life at Hunch

Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room. 

What We Hire For - The ABCs

Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work: 

- Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it. 
 - Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice. 
 - Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions - about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know. 

How We Work

- Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping. 
 - Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters. 
 - Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours. 
 - Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product. 

Backed by Global Investors

Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios. 

Experienced Leadership

Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

data.title: Security Validation Lead
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

In this context, you will be responsible for Camera Image Sensor SoC validation, focusing on Security, Secure Streaming, Cryptographic Validation, and System-Level Functional validation. 

The candidate will be responsible for validating security features across the Camera Image Sensor SoC, ensuring robust implementation of security architectures including Secure Boot, Root of Trust, Authentication, Encryption, Hashing, Secure Firmware Update, Secure Streaming, and Anti-Tamper mechanisms. The role requires deep understanding of imaging pipelines, embedded systems, security protocols, and automation using Python. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate end-to-end security architecture of Camera Image Sensor SoCs. 
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans for hybrid cryptographic schemes combining classical and PQC algorithms: 
 - Secure Boot
 - Chain of Trust
 - Secure Firmware Loading
 - Secure Debug Access
 - Secure Key Provisioning
 - Anti-Tamper Mechanisms
 - Secure Manufacturing Flows
 - Secure video streaming
 - Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms. 
 - Validate OTP -based security configurations. 
 - Perform negative testing and security robustness testing. 
Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. 
 - Knowledge: 
 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.description:
FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc. , a top 20 U. S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company's over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients' greatest ambitions. 

Job Description

Value Proposition

As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at First Citizens Bank, the Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM (Quality Assurance) will serve as the technical leader responsible for defining and driving the quality engineering strategy for enterprise IAM platforms and services. 

This role requires deep expertise in IAM technologies, quality engineering, test automation, and cybersecurity practices. The successful candidate will provide leadership across multiple IAM initiatives, establish testing standards and frameworks, drive automation maturity, and ensure the security, scalability, reliability, and compliance of IAM solutions. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to engineering, architecture, product, and cyber security teams while influencing strategic technology decisions across the IAM ecosystem. 

Job Details

Job Title : Principal Information Security Engineer - IAM

Career Level: P4

Job Category: Assistant Vice President

Role Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bangalore

About The Team

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program supports end-to-end identity governance, access lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, and privileged access management capabilities for employees, contractors, partners, and enterprise applications across the organization. 

Impact

This position resides within the Cyber Security organization and is responsible for establishing the quality engineering vision and testing strategy across IAM platforms. The role will drive test automation, security validation, performance engineering, and quality governance for critical IAM capabilities. 

The Principal Engineer will lead complex testing initiatives, influence architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and ensure enterprise IAM solutions meet security, operational, regulatory, and business requirements. This individual contributor role partners closely with IAM Product Owners, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and Information Security leadership teams. 

Key Deliverables (Duties And Responsibilities)

- Define and drive the enterprise IAM Quality Engineering and Test Automation strategy. 
 - Hands-on experience on Selenium, building test strategy for large scale platforms like SailPoint, Automation using Python or other scripting languages. 
 - Establish testing standards, frameworks, tools, governance models, and best practices across IAM programs. 
 - Lead quality assurance efforts for Identity Governance, Access Management, SSO, Federation, MFA, PAM, and Directory Services initiatives. 
 - Design and build scalable automated test frameworks leveraging modern programming languages and enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Drive continuous testing practices integrated with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps methodologies. 
 - Define quality gates, release readiness criteria, risk assessments, and production validation processes. 
 - Provide technical leadership for end-to-end testing across IAM platforms, APIs, workflows, integrations, and cloud services. 
 - Partner with architecture teams to review solution designs and ensure testability, scalability, resilience, and security requirements are met. 
 - Lead security testing initiatives including authentication, authorization, privilege escalation, API security, and identity lifecycle validation. 
 - Establish performance, load, stress, and resilience testing strategies for IAM platforms. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers on quality engineering, automation practices, and testing methodologies. 
 - Drive adoption of shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles across IAM delivery teams. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, cyber security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards. 
 - Evaluate emerging testing technologies, AI-driven automation capabilities, and industry best practices to improve effectiveness and efficiency.

Functional Skills

 - Proven ability to define testing strategies and quality engineering roadmaps for large-scale IAM programs.

Technical / Business Skills

 - 7+ years of experience supporting IAM technologies and identity lifecycle processes. 
 - Deep understanding of IAM concepts including: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)Single Sign-On (SSO)Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)FederationSAMLOAuth 2. 0OpenID Connect (OIDC)LDAPRole-Based Access Control (RBAC)Privileged Access Management (PAM)

 - Expertise in building enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium, Rest Assured, Postman, Cucumber, JUnit, TestNG, Playwright, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience implementing automated testing within CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab. 
 - Experience testing APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native applications.

 - Experience working in Agile, DevSecOps, and cloud environments.

data.title: Functional Validation Engineer
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Lab validation and characterization

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

The role requires strong expertise in Camera Image Sensors, Imaging Pipelines, Sensor Characterization, High-Speed Interface Validation, Embedded Systems, and Python-based Automation. The candidate will work closely with architecture, design, firmware, and application teams to ensure complete coverage of sensor functionality and system-level performance. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute comprehensive validation plans based on product specifications and architecture requirements. Verify sensor features including: 

- Exposure Control
 - Gain Control
 - HDR Operation
 - Global Shutter and Rolling Shutter Functionality
 - Region of Interest (ROI)
 - Binning and Sub-Sampling Modes
 - Defect Pixel Correction
 - Embedded Data Functions
 - Synchronization and Trigger Mechanisms
 - Multi-Camera Operation
 - Cybersecurity

Validate sensor configuration registers and firmware interactions. 

Perform feature, integration, system-level, regression, stress, and corner-case testing. 

Analyze failures and drive root-cause investigations with design and firmware teams. 

Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities. 
 - Knowledge: 
 - Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Manager Devsecops
data.description:
Job Description

About the Role We are looking for a DevSecOps Manager to lead the team responsible for securing company's cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and CI/CD pipelines. You will manage a team of 5-8 DevSecOps engineers, own the team's roadmap and delivery commitments, and be accountable for the security posture of the infrastructure and deployment platforms on which engineering organization runs on. This is a people and delivery leadership role. You will not be writing production code day to day, but you are expected to have the technical depth to review designs, challenge approaches, make informed tradeoffs, and earn the trust of a senior engineering team. Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and growth of your team, and by measurable improvement in security outcomes. Roles and Responsibilities Team Leadership & People Management Build the Team: Own hiring for the DevSecOps team end to end - define roles and leveling, run a high-signal interview loop, and close senior candidates in a competitive market. Develop Engineers: Run regular 1: 1s, set clear expectations and growth plans, and actively develop engineers toward Senior and Staff scope. Create and defend time for learning and deep work. Performance Management: Give direct, timely feedback. Run fair and well-evidenced performance cycles, recognize strong contribution, and address underperformance early and constructively. Team Health: Own on-call sustainability, workload balance, and retention. Build a psychologically safe environment where engineers surface risk and bad news early. Delivery & Execution Roadmap Ownership: Own the DevSecOps team roadmap. Translate security strategy and engineering priorities into a sequenced, resourced plan with clear owners and dates. Predictable Delivery: Run planning, prioritization, and execution rituals. Deliver committed work predictably and communicate slippage early with options, not surprises. Prioritization & Tradeoffs: Arbitrate between security remediation, platform investment, compliance obligations, and support requests - and make the reasoning behind those calls visible. Dependency Management: Identify and unblock cross-team dependencies with Cloud Security, Product Security, SRE, and application teams before they become delivery risk. Metrics & Reporting: Define and report the team's operating metrics - vulnerability SLA adherence, mean time to detect and remediate, pipeline security coverage, control-automation progress - to engineering leadership. Security Program Ownership Platform Security Posture: Be accountable for the security posture of cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), Kubernetes and container platforms, and CI/CD toolchains. Shift-Left Program: Own the program that embeds automated security testing, static and dynamic analysis, IaC scanning, and dependency scanning into the development lifecycle, with adoption and signal quality as explicit goals. Vulnerability Management: Own the vulnerability lifecycle for the team's scope - intake, risk-based prioritization, SLA definition and enforcement, remediation tracking, and exception governance. Compliance & Audit Readiness: Partner with GRC and Cloud Security to ensure infrastructure and deployments meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and GDPR/CCPA obligations. Drive automated, continuously evidenced controls over manual evidence collection. Standards & Governance: Work with Cloud Security and Product Security to define security standards, policies, and frameworks - then own their rollout and adoption within your scope. Operational Excellence & Incident Response Security Incident Management: Own the team's security incident response readiness. Act as incident commander or escalation point for infrastructure and pipeline security events. Post-Incident Rigor: Ensure every significant incident produces a blameless post-mortem with tracked systemic remediation - not just a closed ticket. Detection Coverage: Hold the team accountable for monitoring and alerting coverage, alert quality, and runbook completeness. Risk Escalation: Maintain a clear-eyed view of accepted risk in your scope and escalate it to leadership with context and recommended options. Technical Judgment & Cross-Functional Partnership Technical Depth: Review designs and architecture proposals, ask the right questions, and make or ratify consequential technical decisions - without becoming the bottleneck. Build vs Buy: Lead tooling evaluation and vendor decisions for security tooling, with cost, integration effort, and operational burden all accounted for. Stakeholder Management: Represent the team to engineering leadership, Security, GRC, and - where needed - enterprise customers and auditors. Security-First Culture: Partner with peer engineering managers to make secure practice the default across development teams through enablement, documentation, and shared goals rather than mandates. What Makes You Relevant for This Role? Required Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience in DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, or Security Engineering roles. 3+ years directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development. Prior experience as a senior individual contributor before moving into management. Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD toolchains such as Jenkins, Tekton, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD - enough to lead technical discussions credibly. Solid understanding of secure infrastructure design, identity and access management, network security, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Demonstrated experience owning a security or infrastructure program with measurable outcomes - vulnerability SLAs, control automation, audit readiness, or incident-response maturity. Experience running incident response and blameless post-mortem practice for production systems. Excellent written and verbal communication; able to brief engineering leadership and translate technical risk into business terms. Preferred Experience managing a DevSecOps, Cloud Security Engineering, or Platform Security team specifically. Hands-on experience taking an organization through SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI-DSS certification or audit. Experience in a multi-tenant SaaS environment handling regulated consumer or financial data. Familiarity with policy-as-code (OPA, Kyverno), secrets management (Vault, KMS), and software supply-chain security (SBOM, artifact signing). Experience building a team from a small base - defining process and operating cadence where little existed. Exposure to securing AI/ML workloads and agentic systems. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKS, or AWS Certified Security - Specialty. Why this role ? Own the security posture of a cloud-native platform that powers transactions for thousands of dealerships and their consumers. Build and shape a team at a company still early enough that your operating decisions set the standard. Direct access to engineering leadership and a real seat in platform and security strategy. Work with some of the smartest minds in the industry on complex security problems at genuine scale. An innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture where good ideas move quickly. 

Required Skills

['Kubernetes', 'DevSecOps', 'Docker', 'Security']

Additional Information

Look out for people with devops & security knowledge
