data.description:
Job Description

The Service & Operational Insights organization is seeking a Lead Service Data Engineer to join our growing Service & Operational Data team. This candidate will build, scale, and operationalize the data platform that powers service reliability, operational visibility, and data-driven decision-making across technology operations, partnering closely with the Enterprise Architect, Service & Operational Data, and other key stakeholders to translate target-state architecture, canonical data models, and governance standards into robust, production-grade pipelines and data products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement the target architecture: Translate the operational data architecture and roadmap (incidents, changes, problems, alerts/events, CMDB, SLOs/SLIs, capacity, cost) into concrete, well-engineered pipelines, implementing canonical schemas such as service topology, event normalization, and incident timelines. 
 - Own pipeline reliability and operations: Build batch and streaming pipelines ingesting data from ITSM, observability platforms, cloud logs/metrics/traces, CI/CD, and infrastructure systems - with strong monitoring, alerting, and on-call practices. 
 - Operationalize data quality and trust: Implement data contracts, validation rules, testing frameworks, and lineage tracking; enforce dataset SLAs/SLOs and drive remediation when breached. 
 - Deliver operational data products: Build and maintain curated datasets, semantic layers, and metrics definitions powering dashboards, analytics, and automation use cases (AIOps, correlation, anomaly detection). 
 - Drive engineering excellence and mentorship: Establish coding standards, CI/CD practices, and reference implementations; provide technical direction through design/code reviews and mentor team members. 
 - Partner cross-functionally: Work with the Architect and Service Reporting team to influence data model design; collaborate with SRE, IT Ops, Security, and Analytics stakeholders to prioritize high-value use cases (incident reduction, alert noise reduction, change failure rate, capacity planning). 
 - Implement governance and security controls: Build RBAC/ABAC enforcement, retention policies, encryption, and auditability into pipelines and platforms. 
 - Support the roadmap: Provide engineering estimates, identify technical risks, and help sequence delivery of the operational data roadmap. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, with 10 + years of experience as a Data Engineer working with complex, large-scale data
 - Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with proven experience designing and delivering production-grade batch and streaming data pipelines
 - Experience building data products (curated datasets, semantic layers, metrics definitions) and applying security governance principles (RBAC/ABAC, encryption, retention, auditability)
 - Familiarity with ITSM, observability, and cloud data sources (incidents, changes, alerts/events, CMDB, logs/metrics/traces), along with data quality practices (contracts, testing, lineage)
 - Strong problem-solving skills with minimal supervision, excellent communication, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in parallel. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting AIOps, correlation, or anomaly detection use cases
 - Familiarity with SLA/SLO enforcement frameworks for data platforms
 - Experience with capacity planning, cost, and reliability engineering data domains

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. 

We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. 

What You Will Do

Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 

Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 

Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 

Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 

Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 

Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 

Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 

Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 

Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 

Troubleshoot complex, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 

Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 

Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 

Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 

Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 

Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 

Hands-on experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 

Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 

Working knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 

Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 

Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 

Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 

Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 

AI-assisted engineering is a must: hands-on use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 

Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 

Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 

Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 

Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 

Model-driven telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Expectations

The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead complex investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability.

data.title: GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer to build, configure, deploy, and maintain GPU-enabled infrastructure for AI/ML and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with GPU server setup, on-premises AI infrastructure, Linux administration, NVIDIA GPU drivers, CUDA, containerization, infrastructure automation, and GPU workload deployment. 

Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM), GPU cluster bring-up, InfiniBand networking, and LLM application deployment will be highly preferred. Candidates with experience across different GPU hardware vendors and cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments are welcome. 

Key Responsibilities

- Set up, configure, and maintain GPU-enabled servers, compute nodes, and AI infrastructure. 
 - Build and deploy on-premises AI infrastructure and GPU compute clusters. 
 - Perform end-to-end GPU cluster bring-up, including provisioning, configuration, validation, and testing. 
 - Configure and manage NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for cluster deployment and management, where applicable. 
 - Install and configure operating systems, GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, libraries, and supporting software. 
 - Deploy and maintain GPU workloads on bare-metal servers, cloud platforms, and hybrid environments. 
 - Configure GPU-enabled Docker containers and Kubernetes workloads. 
 - Deploy and manage LLM applications using frameworks such as vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face Text Generation Inference (TGI), or NVIDIA Triton. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot GPU hardware, driver compatibility, CUDA initialization, memory utilization, and workload execution issues. 
 - Support InfiniBand networking and high-speed interconnects for multi-GPU or multi-node environments. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment using appropriate scripting and automation tools. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments. 
 - Monitor GPU utilization, memory, temperature, power consumption, system health, and performance. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, health checks, and automated recovery using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Optimize GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, inference latency, throughput, and overall infrastructure performance. 
 - Troubleshoot Linux, networking, storage, container, hardware, and application deployment issues. 
 - Perform infrastructure upgrades, patching, maintenance, capacity planning, and resource scaling. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, installation procedures, configuration guides, and troubleshooting records. 
 - Collaborate with AI/ML, development, platform, and infrastructure teams to support production workloads. Required Technical Skills

GPU Infrastructure and Hardware

- Hands-on experience with GPU server setup, configuration, and operations. 
 - Knowledge of GPU hardware, server components, PCIe, power requirements, cooling, and hardware compatibility. 
 - Experience with GPU models such as NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, L40S, RTX series, or equivalent GPU platforms. Linux, Drivers, and CUDA

- Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Experience installing and configuring GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, and supporting libraries. 
 - Ability to validate GPU detection, driver functionality, CUDA compatibility, and workload execution. AI Infrastructure and HPC

- Experience building or maintaining on-premises AI infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of GPU cluster provisioning, compute nodes, and cluster validation. 
 - Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) is preferred. 
 - Experience deploying on-premises GPU infrastructure without BCM is also valuable. 
 - Knowledge of InfiniBand, RDMA, and high-speed networking for GPU clusters is an advantage. DevOps and Containerization

- Experience with Docker and GPU-enabled containers. 
 - Kubernetes experience for GPU workload deployment and orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure automation using Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, configuration management, and infrastructure monitoring. LLM Deployment and Performance

- Experience deploying LLM applications on GPU-enabled cloud instances or on-premises GPU servers. 
 - Familiarity with vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face TGI, NVIDIA Triton, or equivalent model-serving frameworks. 
 - Understanding of API-based model serving and GPU resource allocation. 
 - Experience troubleshooting GPU memory issues and optimizing inference performance. 
 - Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA SMI, or DCGM for GPU monitoring. Experience Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering. 
 - At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience working with GPU environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience in at least one real-world GPU infrastructure or AI deployment project. 
 - Ability to explain the infrastructure architecture, GPU hardware used, individual responsibilities, deployment process, and technical issues resolved. 
 - Experience supporting production environments is preferred. Preferred Qualifications

- End-to-end GPU cluster deployment using NVIDIA BCM. 
 - Hands-on InfiniBand configuration and troubleshooting. 
 - Bare-metal GPU server installation and configuration without Docker. 
 - Multi-GPU or multi-node cluster deployment. 
 - Production LLM serving and GPU performance optimization. 
 - Experience across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments. Candidate Profile

We are looking for engineers with practical infrastructure experience who can independently configure GPU environments, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support reliable AI/ML and HPC deployments. 

Candidates must be able to explain real projects they have worked on, the GPU hardware and tools used, their individual contributions, and the challenges they successfully resolved.

data.title: Senior Developer, Artificial Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

A QA Engineer for AI Initiatives is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, fairness, and performance of AI/ML-powered products and systems. Unlike traditional QA, this role requires deep understanding of non-deterministic model behavior, data quality, and AI-specific failure modes such as hallucinations, bias, and model drift. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test strategies specifically for AI/ML models, LLM-based applications, and data pipelines
 - Develop automated test frameworks for model validation, regression testing, and performance benchmarking
 - Evaluate model outputs for accuracy, consistency, relevance, hallucination, and bias across diverse inputs
 - Test RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, chatbots, recommendation systems, and other AI-driven features
 - Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to define acceptance criteria and quality thresholds
 - Build and maintain evaluation datasets, ground truth sets, and adversarial test cases
 - Monitor models in production for drift, degradation, and anomalous behavior
 - Validate data quality, data pipelines, and feature stores that feed AI systems
 - Document defects, edge cases, and failure patterns specific to AI behavior
 - Ensure AI systems meet ethical, fairness, and compliance standards (bias audits, explainability checks)

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 - 3-6 years of QA experience, with at least 1-2 years in AI/ML quality assurance
 - Strong proficiency in Python for test automation and data analysis
 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, LangSmith)
 - Hands-on experience with testing tools: Pytest, Selenium, Postman, or similar
 - Understanding of ML lifecycle - training, validation, deployment, and monitoring
 - Knowledge of data quality tools and pipeline testing (Great Expectations, dbt tests)

Nice to Have

- Experience with prompt engineering and red-teaming LLMs
 - Familiarity with MLOps platforms (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI) 
 - Knowledge of vector databases and embedding quality evaluation
 - Understanding of AI safety, responsible AI principles, and fairness frameworks
 - Experience with A/B testing and shadow deployment strategies

Soft Skills

- Analytical and inquisitive mindset - comfortable challenging model outputs
 - Ability to think like both a user and an adversary (red-team thinking)
 - Strong documentation and communication skills
 - Collaborative approach with data science, engineering, and product teams
 - High attention to detail with a quality-first attitude

Preferred Location: 

Bangalore

data.description:
About Us: 

Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1, 000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Know our story: https: //www. mobileum. com/

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Dubai, Germany, Greece, India, Portugal, Singapore and UK with global HC of over 1800+. 

Join Mobileum Team

At Mobileum we recognize that our team is the main reason for our success. What does work with us mean? Opportunities!

Position: Director - Quality Engineering. 

Reports To: VP - Quality Engineering

Position Summary: 

The Director of Quality Engineering for the Roaming Network Services will lead the global QE transformation and operations across multiple product lines. This hands-on technical leader will be responsible for redefining quality beyond defect detection to include product design excellence, building a high-performing automation-first QE organization, and ensuring delivery of highly reliable, scalable, and secure products across Mobileum's roaming solutions portfolio. 

The ideal candidate will bring a powerful combination of technical depth, transformational leadership, strategic thinking, and extensive experience in telecommunications, particularly in roaming, signaling, mobile core technologies, and cloud-native architectures. This leader must thrive in fast-paced environments, drive meaningful change, and consistently deliver results while building technical excellence. 

Key Transformation Initiatives & Responsibilities: 

Quality Evolution & Product Excellence

- Redefine Quality Metrics beyond defect detection to include product design efficacy, user experience, and overall solution value
 - Establish Product Quality Frameworks that address not just functional correctness but architectural soundness, scalability, security-by-design, and performance at scale
 - Pioneer Quality-as-a-Strategy approach where QE insights actively influence product roadmaps and design decisions
 - Implement Early Quality Indicators to identify product design deficiencies before development begins
 - Drive Product Efficacy Assessments to ensure solutions fully address customer needs and deliver maximum business value

Automation Transformation

- Lead Comprehensive Automation Strategy covering functional, performance, security, and infrastructure testing with CI/CD pipeline integration
 - Architect Next-Generation Test Frameworks that are scalable, maintainable, and deliver actionable insights
 - Implement "Automation-First" Culture where manual testing is the exception, not the rule
 - Establish Automation KPIs that measure both coverage and effectiveness
 - Drive Shift-Left Practices including automated design reviews, code quality gates, and security scanning
 - Spearhead GenAI Adoption in QE by implementing AI-driven test case generation, intelligent test selection, and predictive quality analytics
 - Develop LLM-Based Test Automation capabilities for natural language test creation, automated API testing, and complex scenario generation
 - Implement AI-Powered Defect Analysis to automatically categorize, prioritize, and suggest root causes for identified issues
 - Lead ML-Based Performance Testing initiatives that can predict scalability issues and optimize resource utilization
 - Create GenAI Testing Center of Excellence to research, pilot, and scale emerging AI technologies in quality engineering. 

High-Performance Team Building

- Transform Team Structure and Capabilities to align with modern QE practices and cloud-native technologies
 - Implement Agile QE Methodologies to increase delivery velocity while maintaining quality standards
 - Cultivate Technical Excellence through hands-on mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning
 - Create Centers of Excellence for specialized areas like performance engineering, security testing, and test automation
 - Develop QE Career Paths that recognize and reward both technical depth and leadership capabilities

Core Operational Responsibilities

- Collaborate Across Functions with Product Management, Development, Support, and DevOps to ensure high-quality delivery of releases and patches
 - Drive Interoperability Testing across multi-vendor and multi-network environments including 2G/3G/4G/5G
 - Manage Compliance, Performance, and Security Testing for global roaming standards (GSMA, IR. 21/IR. 85, VoLTE, VoWiFi, etc. )
 - Execute Quality Risk Assessments, identifying bottlenecks early and driving mitigation plans
 - Optimize QE Processes to support increased release velocity without compromising quality

Desired Profile: -

- 15+ years of experience in software quality engineering with 8+ years in transformational leadership roles
 - Deep Technical Expertise in test automation, CI/CD, cloud architectures, and modern QE practices
 - Hands-On Technical Leadership with ability to code, architect solutions, and guide technical implementations
 - Strong Domain Knowledge in Roaming Protocols (SS7, Diameter, GTP, MAP, SIP), core network elements, signaling flows, and cloud-native architectures
 - Proven Experience in leading and transforming large-scale QE teams across distributed geographies
 - Track Record of successfully implementing automation frameworks, DevOps practices, and quality metrics that deliver measurable results
 - Experience operating in fast-paced, startup-like environments with high delivery velocity

Technical Skills

- Telecom Protocols & Technologies including SS7, Diameter, GTP, MAP, SIP, and SCTP
 - Mobile Core Network Architecture across 2G/3G/4G/5G technologies
 - Roaming & Interconnect Services including voice, SMS, data, and emerging IoT/M2M scenarios
 - Signaling Flow Analysis for complex call and session scenarios
 - Network Testing Tools such as protocol analyzers, load generators, and signaling simulators
 - Advanced Test Automation frameworks, tools, and methodologies
 - CI/CD Environments and DevOps pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. )
 - Containerization & Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cloud-native testing approaches
 - Performance Engineering tools and methodologies
 - Security Testing practices for telecom and cloud environments
 - Generative AI Technologies including LLMs, ML-based testing tools, and AI-driven analytics platforms

Leadership Capabilities

- Transformational Leadership skills with proven ability to drive change
 - Hands-On Technical Guidance with willingness to dive deep into technical challenges
 - Strategic Vision combined with tactical execution
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration skills to align quality initiatives across the organization
 - Talent Development capabilities to grow the next generation of QE leaders

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Mobileum's roaming and fraud management solutions
 - Experience implementing GenAI solutions for telecommunications testing
 - Experience with data-driven and AI/ML-powered testing methodologies
 - Understanding of Regulatory Compliance in telecom (e. g. , GDPR, telecom fraud detection standards)
 - Background in SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) practices

Work Experience: 15+ years

Educational Qualification: BE. / B. Tech. , M. E. /M. Tech. or M. Sc. in Computer Science or any related qualification.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Kernel/BSP
data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

About The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on the Wind River Linux team, you're the senior technical anchor for a safety-critical embedded Linux platform - and this is a build-and-decide role, not a keep-it-running one. You own the architecture-level calls across the Yocto build system, Linux kernel, and multiple BSPs; you drive where we go upstream; and you build the engineering workflows the whole team runs on. Yes, you'll keep the platform solid - but the reason this role exists is to move it forward: the tooling migration, the AI-native engineering stack, the upstream strategy, and the cross-layer problems no single track owner can close. 

You're the person the team leans on when a problem spans the kernel, the BSP, the build system, and a customer's field deployment all at once - and the one who decides how we solve that class of problem for good, not just this once. 

What You'll Do

Linux Kernel & Low-Level Development

- Drive determinism, real-time (PREEMPT_RT), and reliability improvements that hold up under safety-critical scrutiny - you set the technical bar here. 
 - Debug the deepest kernel, driver, networking, and boot issues across ARM/x86 (and PPC/RISC-V where relevant) with GDB, JTAG, ftrace, and perf. 
 - Own kernel maintenance across LTS lines as the baseline - backports, CVE remediation, -stable rebases, local-patch discipline - and, more importantly, decide the strategy that shrinks that burden over time. 

Multi-BSP & Yocto Build System

- Own the Yocto/OpenEmbedded architecture - layers, templates, recipe design, and the build-farm topology that produces the release matrix. 
 - Serve as the technical expert across multiple BSPs (Intel x86, ARM/Zynq MP, NXP i. MX, TI, NVIDIA Tegra, and the growing edge-AI board set): machine configs, kernel provider resolution, layer architecture, and platform bring-up. 
 - Resolve the cross-layer, cross-repo problems (recipe + BSP + kernel + template) that no single track owner can close alone. 

Build the Way the Team Works

- Drive AI-native engineering - CVE triage, test generation, build diagnosis - as the person who builds the workflows the team runs on, not just consumes them. 
 - Make and own the architecture calls on the tooling migration: source host, CI, issue tracking, and the CVE-automation stack. 
 - Own the reliability of release-critical systems - OOBE/Sanity gates, the CVE-verification pipeline, SBOM/IP flow, and the CI that ties them together. 

OSS & Upstream

- Define and drive the upstream strategy - what we push upstream vs. carry as local patches - and represent WRLinux's technical direction in OSS communities. 
 - Champion upstream-first CVE handling. 

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

- Provide technical direction, design reviews, and code reviews that raise the whole team's bar. 
 - Mentor engineers and compress their ramp-up under an AI-paired model. 
 - Remove single points of failure by documenting and systematizing product knowledge. 
 - Support customer escalations as the deep technical specialist of last resort. 

What You Bring

- BE/BTech or ME/MTech in CS/ECE/EE or equivalent; 8-12 years in embedded Linux. 
 - Deep expertise in Linux kernel (architecture, drivers, debugging) and C; strong Python for tooling/automation; C++ a plus. 
 - Extensive hands-on Yocto/OpenEmbedded and BSP experience, multi-board bring-up, layer/recipe architecture, hardware-software integration. 
 - Proven technical leadership and mentoring of engineering teams. 
 - Strong debugging with GDB, JTAG, kernel tracing, and performance tooling. 
 - Familiarity with ARM/x86 (PPC/RISC-V a plus), networking, and virtualization. 
 - Agile + CI/CD fluency; Git/Linux daily driver. 
 - Excellent communication and cross-functional stakeholder skills; effective in a globally distributed team. 

Nice to Have

- OSS/upstream contribution track record (kernel or Yocto layers). 
 - Edge-AI inference stacks on embedded silicon (TensorRT, OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, TF Lite)

WHY JOIN US?

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‐critical AI systems-built for an AI‐first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges. 

Wind River is a global leader in mission‐critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines. 

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging. 

Your Benefits At Wind River

- Named Top Workplace for the 10th year in a row
 - Wind River's strong commitment to DEIB
 - Birthday and Volunteer Time Off
 - Competitive Salary & Benefits Package
 - Extensive Learning Programs
 - Wellness benefits through Unmind

APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET'S CHANGE TOMORROW!

Wind River is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

#RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we're on a mission to end cyber risk. 

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity. 

More than 3, 000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference. 

We're constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level. 

About The Position

At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. 

If you're looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that's redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We're looking for a Team Lead to be part of making this happen. 

Position Overview And Objective

Responsible for guiding a software development team to deliver high‐value, performant, and secure software solutions. This role ensures that day‐to‐day development activities align with the R&D Department goals and processes. 

The Team Lead provides direction, coaching, and technical oversight for developers through the design, implementation, and automated/integration testing of software. They work closely with the Project Lead (who owns project planning, status reporting, estimation, and delivery) to ensure work is executed effectively. The Team Lead focuses on people leadership, roadmap execution, and team performance, but may support the architecture and development if needed. 

Responsibilities

As a Team Lead at Arctic Wolf, you will: 

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers. 
 - Provide day-to-day technical guidance and remove obstacles impacting delivery. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and career development discussions. 
 - Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, tools, and team effectiveness. 
 - Build strong partnerships with Product Management, Architecture, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Ensure adherence to software development standards, security policies, and engineering best practices. 

Technical Leadership & Software Delivery

- Guide the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software solutions. 
 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver roadmap commitments. 
 - Provide technical oversight on architecture, implementation, code quality, and troubleshooting activities. 
 - Promote secure coding practices, automated testing, and engineering excellence. 
 - Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements. 
 - Support software development activities as needed through hands-on technical contributions. 

People Management & Operations

- Support team planning, capacity management, and resource allocation. 
 - Approve vacation requests, expenses, and training budgets. 
 - Partner with Engineering Leadership and HR on performance management and compensation planning. 
 - Participate in hiring activities, including candidate screening, interviewing, and selection. 
 - Support onboarding and development of new team members. 

Experience & Requirements

- 7+ years of experience in software development or a related technical role. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to engineering teams. 
 - Strong background in designing, developing, and delivering software applications. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. 
 - Experience driving engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile practices. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 
 - Knowledge of secure coding standards, software security principles, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members in a collaborative environment. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work - USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work - Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company - Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. 

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees 
 - 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
 - Training and career development programs 
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

Security Requirements

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business and customer information. 

Depending on the role, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws where applicable. 

Your next big opportunity starts here - apply today and help us end cyber risk.

data.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to spearhead the modernisation of a large-scale enterprise application from legacy ASP. NET to a modern . NET 10 Web API and React stack. You will own the technical direction of a cross-functional delivery pod, mentor a team of developers, and drive hands-on engineering across both frontend and backend. 

This is a hands-on leadership role - you will write production code, lead architecture decisions, and be accountable for the technical quality of everything your pod delivers. You will work in a structured Agile environment, collaborating closely with the Solution Architect, QA leads, and client stakeholders across a multi-year, multi-phase modernisation programme. 

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end technical delivery of your pod - architecture, design, coding, code review, and quality gates
 - Lead the migration from legacy ASP. NET (MVC / Web API / Web Forms) to . NET 10 REST APIs and React 18 frontend
 - Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, and PR review process across the pod
 - Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for all significant technical choices
 - Conduct structured code reviews covering architecture, security, performance, and maintainability - not just syntax
 - Identify and resolve technical debt proactively; maintain a tech debt register visible to stakeholders
 - Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) with quality gates: SonarQube, unit coverage, OWASP dependency scan
 - Collaborate with Solution Architect on cross-pod API contracts, shared services, and infrastructure decisions

Hands-On Engineering

- Design and build . NET 10 Web API microservices using Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design patterns
 - Build React 18 SPAs: component architecture, Redux Toolkit / Zustand state management, routing, and performance optimisation
 - Implement OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT authentication and role-based access control
 - Design and optimise relational database schemas (SQL Server / PostgreSQL); write complex LINQ and EF Core queries
 - Build and consume RESTful APIs with versioning, error handling, and OpenAPI documentation
 - Write unit, integration, and contract tests as a core part of the Definition of Done

Migration & Modernisation

- Lead the technical approach for migrating legacy ASP. NET code to . NET 10 - analysis, characterisation testing, phased migration, parity validation
 - Use GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate migration while maintaining review discipline
 - Identify breaking changes, deprecated dependencies, and third-party package migration paths
 - Establish repeatable migration patterns that the whole pod can follow consistently across modules
 - Ensure all migrated code has adequate unit test coverage before merge - parity tests are non-negotiable

Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Lead a pod of 4-6 engineers (mix of senior, mid, and junior developers)
 - Run daily technical standups, remove technical blockers, and escalate risks to the Architect early
 - Mentor mid and junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and 1: 1 technical guidance
 - Create a learning environment - internal tech talks, documentation, actionable review feedback
 - Make resourcing recommendations and flag capacity risks to the Delivery Manager

Agile Delivery (Added Advantage)

- Participate in Scrum ceremonies - Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Backlog Grooming
 - Collaborate with the Product Owner / BA to refine user stories, provide technical input on acceptance criteria, and raise technical stories
 - Provide accurate SP estimates; track sprint progress and flag scope risk early
 - Support the Scrum Master in removing impediments with a technical root cause
 - Champion the Definition of Done - ensure every story that ships meets quality, test, and documentation standards

 - Relevant domain experience is an important requirement for this role, as the position involves working closely with financial-market data, products, and technologies.

At Global Financial Datafeeds LLP, we are a growing fintech SaaS company and pioneers in developing high-performance, real-time SaaS-based products for the stock market and financial data domain. We build the infrastructure that empowers traders, investors, and institutions with ultra-low latency data feeds and advanced charting solutions. 

As we continue to grow and expand our product ecosystem, we are looking for a tech-savvy Delivery Manager - FinTech SaaS & Market Data to manage our product delivery lifecycle, improve engineering efficiency, and work closely with our 20 Engineering & Product team on-site in Mumbai/Nashik. 

What You'll Do

- Own Delivery: Lead the end-to-end delivery of our SaaS stock market platforms and data-feed solutions from scoping to production. 
 - Optimize Agile Culture: Establish and fine-tune Agile/Scrum/DevOps workflows to support fast-paced financial market requirements. 
 - Drive Scalability: Work with engineering teams to identify and address technical bottlenecks, data streaming latency, performance, and security risks critical to live market applications. 
 - Lead & Collaborate: Coordinate and support a high-performing 20 member team consisting of Developers, QA Testers, and Product Engineers. 
 - Manage Operations: Support delivery planning, resource allocation, project tracking, and critical third-party integrations such as market data feeds and cloud delivery pipelines. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Work closely with product, technology, and business stakeholders to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery. 
 - Track Performance: Monitor project progress, identify delivery risks, and ensure issues are resolved within defined timelines. 

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 5 - 8 years of experience in software delivery, project management, product development, or a related technology role. 
 - Domain Expertise: Direct experience in the Stock Market, Capital Markets, Market Data, Real-Time Financial Data, Trading Platforms, Wealth Management, Mutual Funds, or related fintech technology/products will be strongly preferred. 
 - Technical Understanding: Practical understanding of cloud technologies such as AWS/Azure/GCP, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and real-time data streaming technologies such as WebSockets and Kafka. 
 - Delivery Skills: Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, project planning, risk management, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Leadership & Collaboration: Ability to coordinate with engineering, QA, product, and business teams in an on-site, collaborative work environment. 
 - Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced fintech environment.

data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About the Role: 

We are looking for an exceptional Staff Engineer to shape the architecture and evolution of our data infrastructure as we scale. 

Our engineering ecosystem operates multiple database technologies, handles large volumes of data and traffic, and supports a growing number of services and engineering teams. 

We need a strong individual contributor who has built and scaled distributed data systems, understands database technologies at a fundamental level, and can solve complex infrastructure challenges across multiple engineering teams. 

This role goes beyond operating existing databases. You will design systems, build infrastructure capabilities, challenge architectural limitations, and drive technical initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, performance, and infrastructure economics. 

What You'll Do: 

- Architect for scale: Design and evolve distributed data architectures capable of supporting significant growth in traffic, data volume, and engineering complexity. 
 - Build infrastructure platforms: Develop reusable infrastructure components, frameworks, and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to build scalable systems. 
 - Drive architectural evolution: Identify fundamental limitations in existing systems and lead large-scale initiatives involving data distribution, sharding, replication, migrations, and architectural modernization. 
 - Shape technical strategy: Influence database technology choices, architectural patterns, and long-term infrastructure direction across the company. 
 - Improve infrastructure economics: Lead engineering initiatives that materially improve scalability, resource efficiency, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Engineer for reliability: Design systems that remain available and resilient under high throughput, infrastructure failures, and changing workload patterns. 
 - Create organizational leverage: Establish engineering standards and reusable solutions that eliminate recurring problems across teams. 
 - Lead through technical influence: Work with senior engineers and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, company-level challenges into executable technical programs. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 9+ years of strong software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale data platforms, with demonstrated Staff-level technical impact. 
 - Strong software engineering background with experience designing and building production infrastructure, not only operating or administering it. 
 - Experience architecting systems handling multi-terabyte datasets and 30K-50K+ operations per second, or comparable large-scale distributed workloads. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, concurrency, fault tolerance, and data distribution. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with both relational and NoSQL database architectures, including their design principles, scalability characteristics, and trade-offs. 
 - Experience leading complex architectural initiatives involving multiple systems and engineering teams. Ability to identify systemic technical problems and design solutions that improve infrastructure across the organization. 
 - Strong technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to influence architectural decisions without formal authority. 

Tech Experience: 

We value engineering depth and architectural understanding over familiarity with a long list of technologies. 

Strong experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, combined with experience in one or more distributed database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar systems, is highly relevant. 

Experience with distributed SQL, search infrastructure, analytical databases, or other large-scale storage systems is an advantage. 

We do not expect expertise in any particular combination of database products. What matters is the ability to understand their internals, evaluate trade-offs, and design scalable infrastructure around them. 

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role: 

You have previously taken ownership of challenging infrastructure problems where the solution required more than improving an individual service or database. 

You have designed or significantly evolved distributed architectures, built infrastructure adopted by multiple teams, led complex technical transformations, or enabled systems to operate at substantially greater scale. 

You are equally comfortable discussing database internals, distributed systems trade-offs, and long-term architecture as you are working with engineers to turn those decisions into production systems. 

Your impact is measured by the systems you enable, the architectural problems you eliminate, and the engineering capabilities you leave behind.

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. Description

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional PMTS / LMTS to lead the engineering vision for AgentExchange's Search and Personalization services - the AI-powered discovery layer that sits at the heart of how customers find and engage with solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem. 

As a Principal Engineer or Lead on the Search & Personalization team, you will be the technical authority for the systems that determine what customers see, find, and click on across AgentExchange. You'll design and deliver the next generation of agentic search - multi-turn, context-aware, and enriched with AI overviews, next-best query suggestions, and personalized recommendations - alongside the indexing infrastructure and contextual discovery services that power embedded surfaces across Agentforce, Slack, Setup, and beyond. 

AgentExchange is building the next generation of our ecosystem marketplace, extending the base and boundaries of our platform while infusing intelligence through every step of our partners' and customers' journey. The new ecosystem enables packaging, publishing, and listing solutions across multiple technologies - Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, and Slack - while delivering full transactability (Discover → Purchase → Provision). The One AppExchange Framework is our dynamic, extensible data and services platform that expands the tenancy capabilities of the AgentExchange site. 

This is not a search-maintenance role. You will own the technical vision for discovery at scale, drive AI-native engineering across the search stack, and set the bar for relevance, latency, personalization, and observability across one of the most strategically important surfaces in the AgentExchange.

 - Data Pipelines: Experience with real-time and near-real-time data pipelines for indexing and signal ingestion. 
 - Production Reliability: Strong commitment to engineering excellence: observability, telemetry, latency SLOs, CI/CD, service ownership, safe change practices, and production reliability. 
 - Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills - able to influence and build consensus across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Agentic Systems & MCP: Hands-on experience with agentic systems, MCP tools/resources, or A2A patterns - particularly catalog and metadata requirements for new AI-native asset types.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
Position Summary

The Senior AI Engineer is a highly experienced individual contributor responsible for solving complex, high-impact problems through the applied use of AI in production software systems. 

This role goes beyond execution alone. The Senior AI Engineer will define how AI is built and used by setting implementation patterns, quality standards, and technical guardrails that can scale across engineering teams. 

The role involves leading critical initiatives end to end, working effectively in ambiguous problem spaces, and making high-impact technical decisions involving models, agentic systems, architecture, and engineering trade-offs. 

The ideal candidate will build and operate AI-enabled systems that meet enterprise expectations for reliability, performance, cost efficiency, security, and safety. 

This is not a research or theoretical machine learning role. The focus is on applied, production-grade AI, including agentic systems, model-driven workflows, AI automation, and integration of AI capabilities into real-world software products. 

Key Responsibilities

Advanced AI Engineering & System Design

- Design, build, and operate sophisticated AI-enabled software systems that solve complex business and product challenges. 
 - Architect and implement agentic systems capable of autonomous tool selection, multi-step goal execution, and controlled decision-making in production environments. 
 - Define and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for managing tools, context, memory, policies, and system boundaries at scale. 
 - Make informed decisions on model selection, composition, and deployment by balancing reasoning quality, latency, cost, and reliability. 
 - Treat model behavior, agent flows, prompts, and contextual inputs as core system components that are designed, versioned, tested, and observable. 
 - Design scalable AI architectures and contribute to system and architecture design decisions for AI-powered applications. 

Technical Leadership & Initiative Ownership

- Serve as a technical lead for high-impact AI initiatives, owning architecture, execution strategy, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Break down ambiguous and open-ended problems into clear technical approaches and guide implementation. 
 - Identify system-level risks, failure modes, and technical trade-offs early and address them through appropriate design and safeguards. 
 - Influence technical direction across teams through technical expertise, judgment, and strong engineering practices. 
 - Take ownership of the long-term technical health and scalability of AI-enabled systems. 

AI-First Development Practices & Standards

- Define and evolve effective AI development practices across engineering teams, including: 
 - AI-assisted and AI-generated code
 - Agent-based engineering workflows
 - AI-driven testing, debugging, and refactoring
 - AI-enabled documentation and observability
 - Establish standards and best practices for: 
 - Agent behavior and autonomy
 - Prompt and context design
 - Model selection and usage
 - AI evaluation and regression detection
 - Safe and explainable AI behavior in production
 - Promote AI as an integrated capability within engineering workflows rather than an experimental or standalone initiative. 

Mentorship & Capability Building

- Mentor AI Engineers through technical guidance, design discussions, pairing, and code reviews. 
 - Improve AI engineering practices, system thinking, and technical rigor across teams. 
 - Share reusable patterns, lessons learned, and failure analyses. 
 - Act as a technical resource for complex AI, GenAI, and agentic system challenges. 

Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver AI-powered features end to end. 
 - Translate product requirements into scalable and maintainable technical architectures. 
 - Balance development speed, quality, security, safety, and maintainability when making technical decisions. 
 - Communicate complex AI and agentic system concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Help product and engineering teams understand AI capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs. 

Quality, Reliability & Accountability

- Ensure AI-enabled systems meet high standards for security, performance, reliability, and compliance. 
 - Design and implement evaluation, monitoring, and safeguard strategies for AI behavior in production. 
 - Address areas such as: 
 - Hallucination and error detection
 - Traceability and explainability
 - Behavioral regression and drift
 - Model performance and reliability
 - Cost and latency optimization
 - Monitor and improve the operational stability, scalability, and cost efficiency of AI systems. 

Continuous Improvement & Learning

- Stay current with AI tools, platforms, models, frameworks, and agentic patterns relevant to production systems. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and responsibly incorporate proven approaches into engineering practices. 
 - Continuously improve how AI systems are designed, developed, evaluated, and operated. 
 - Contribute to a culture of disciplined execution, continuous learning, and technical excellence. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Extensive experience building and operating complex production software systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and operating Agentic AI systems in production, including autonomous tool usage and multi-step workflows. 
 - Strong technical expertise in Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent approaches. 
 - Strong understanding of modern AI and foundation models, including: 
 - Model names, versions, and parameter scales
 - Context window limitations and optimization strategies
 - System prompts vs. user prompts
 - Model selection and trade-offs
 - Latency, cost, reasoning quality, and reliability considerations
 - Experience working with both frontier and open-source models and making informed decisions between them. 
 - Proven experience scaling AI systems and addressing: 
 - Latency optimization
 - Cost optimization
 - Caching
 - Parallelization
 - Model selection
 - System scalability
 - Proven ability to take complex AI systems from prototype to production and maintain them over time. 
 - Strong system design and architecture skills with the ability to make technical decisions for scalable AI applications. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience defining engineering standards, patterns, or platforms adopted by multiple teams. 
 - Experience designing AI platform architectures or shared agentic frameworks. 
 - Experience with cloud-native, SaaS, or platform-oriented environments. 
 - Experience working with enterprise, regulated, or mission-critical systems. 
 - Experience with modern AI development tools and AI-assisted software engineering workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of observability, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring for AI systems. 

What We're Looking For

We value engineers who see AI as a force multiplier rather than a novelty. The ideal Senior AI Engineer is a strong builder and technical leader who takes ownership of outcomes, designs systems that scale safely, and uses AI to improve both product capabilities and engineering effectiveness. 

If you are excited about designing and operating production-grade agentic AI systems, solving complex engineering problems, and shaping how AI is built and used across teams, this role is an opportunity to make a significant technical impact.

data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Process Manager - Operational Risk & Audit Quality

Location - Mumbai / Pune

Function: Operational Risk & Quality Assurance | Reporting: Audit Quality Head

Role Summary

Own the end-to-end delivery and quality of assigned Class 1 audits across BFSI client engagements. Lead risk-based scoping, control testing, evidence review, finding articulation, stakeholder readouts, and remediation tracking while strengthening audit discipline, preventive controls, and team capability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan and execute risk-based audits covering process governance, transaction accuracy, SOP/SLA adherence, regulatory and client requirements, and key operational controls. 
 - Lead walkthroughs, risk and control assessments, sample testing, data analysis, and evidence validation; maintain complete, traceable, and defensible working papers. 
 - Review audit files and deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, evidence sufficiency, and appropriate application of audit methodology and risk ratings. 
 - Draft clear findings covering condition, criteria, root cause, risk/impact, recommendation, owner, timeline, and closure evidence; identify repeat or systemic issues. 
 - Conduct insightful readout sessions with Operations, Risk/Compliance, and client stakeholders; manage challenge constructively while preserving audit independence. 
 - Facilitate RCA using 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, Pareto, or control mapping: challenge corrective and preventive actions for sustainability and proportionality. 
 - Track findings to closure, validate implementation evidence and effectiveness, and escalate overdue, high-risk, repeated, or inadequately remediated actions. 
 - Maintain audit dashboards and governance reporting covering plan versus completion, ratings, themes, action aging, repeat findings, and decisions required. 
 - Calibrate review quality, and improve checklists, test scripts, sampling, analytics, and audit automation. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, Economics, Risk, or a related field; master's preferred. 
 - 8-12 years' BFSI, investment banking operations, or financial-services KPO experience across operations, audit, risk, controls, quality assurance, incidents, or remediation. 
 - Experience leading process or audit reviews, control assessments, RCA, corrective-action tracking, reporting, and senior stakeholder management preferred. 
 - CA, CPA, CIA, CISA, FRM, Lean Six Sigma, or relevant domain certification preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of TQM, process standardization, defect prevention, quality measurement, and continuous improvement. 

Core Skills and Knowledge

Audit and risk: Risk-based auditing, control design/operating-effectiveness testing, sampling, evidence assessment, finding writing, rating calibration, RCA/CAPA, and closure validation. 

Leadership and communication: Analytical judgment, attention to detail, professional skepticism, ethical conduct, concise writing, confident readouts, stakeholder management, coaching, and execution under tight deadlines. 

Tools and improvement: Advanced Excel; exposure to Power BI/Tableau, SQL/Alteryx, GRC tools, VBA/RPA, continuous monitoring, and governed AI use is advantageous.

data.title: Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer
data.description:
Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer

About L4B Software

L4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity. We work with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, board support packages (BSPs) and real-time embedded systems to develop reliable, secure and maintainable software platforms. 

Our engineering work supports industries including medical devices, consumer electronics and other connected embedded products where security must be integrated throughout the product lifecycle. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Product Cybersecurity Engineer with strong hands-on experience securing embedded devices and connected products, particularly in consumer electronics or medical-device environments. 

This is a hands-on engineering position, not a general IT cybersecurity, SOC, network security or compliance-only role. 

You will work directly with embedded software, platform and product-engineering teams to design, implement, test and maintain security mechanisms across device hardware, bootloaders, operating systems, firmware and software-update infrastructure. 

We are particularly interested in engineers who have contributed to security architectures and controls in real products, from development and integration through production release and ongoing maintenance. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Embedded Product Security Architecture

- Design and implement security architectures for Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP and other embedded platforms. 
 - Perform device-level threat modeling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments. 
 - Identify threats involving physical device access, debug interfaces, firmware extraction, communication interfaces and software vulnerabilities. 
 - Translate security requirements into practical technical controls and engineering tasks. 
 - Collaborate with hardware, BSP, platform and application engineers to implement security by design. 2. Secure Boot, Device Identity and Cryptography

- Implement and validate Secure Boot, Verified Boot and chain-of-trust mechanisms. 
 - Work with hardware-backed security technologies such as TPM, HSM, secure elements, ARM TrustZone and OP-TEE, as applicable. 
 - Design secure device identity, key provisioning, key storage and key lifecycle mechanisms. 
 - Implement cryptographic signing, integrity verification and secure firmware authentication. 
 - Support secure manufacturing provisioning and device lifecycle security. 3. Embedded Linux and Android Platform Hardening

- Implement security controls within Embedded Linux and, where applicable, Android/AOSP platforms. 
 - Harden bootloaders, Linux kernels, operating-system configurations and device services. 
 - Work with Linux security mechanisms such as SELinux, AppArmor, dm-verity, dm-crypt and filesystem protection. 
 - Reduce attack surfaces by securing services, ports, permissions, interfaces and debug capabilities. 
 - Collaborate with Yocto/BSP engineers to integrate security controls into production firmware images. 4. Secure Firmware Updates and Product Lifecycle Security

- Design and implement secure firmware and OTA update mechanisms. 
 - Ensure firmware authenticity, integrity, rollback protection and secure recovery. 
 - Support secure update architectures for connected and field-deployed products. 
 - Investigate product vulnerabilities and contribute to remediation across supported software versions. 
 - Help establish security maintenance practices for products throughout their operational lifecycle. 5. Vulnerability Management and Security Verification

- Perform vulnerability analysis across embedded firmware, operating systems, libraries and third-party components. 
 - Work with CVE databases, software composition analysis and SBOM generation. 
 - Assess vulnerability exploitability and product-specific security impact. 
 - Support static analysis, dynamic analysis, firmware analysis and penetration-testing activities. 
 - Develop or integrate security verification into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Document security findings, remediation actions and verification evidence. 6. Product Security and Engineering Collaboration

- Work closely with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, BSP, hardware, DevSecOps, QA and product-engineering teams. 
 - Participate in security design reviews and technical risk assessments. 
 - Support security requirements, verification and traceability for regulated or security-sensitive products. 
 - Contribute to product-security documentation and technical security decisions. 
 - Independently investigate and resolve complex embedded security issues. Required Qualifications and Experience

- Strong professional experience in embedded software engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for embedded product cybersecurity. 
 - Professional experience securing consumer electronics, medical devices or comparable connected embedded products. 
 - Strong understanding of embedded hardware, firmware, bootloaders, operating systems and device security boundaries. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing security controls in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP or comparable embedded platforms. 
 - Demonstrated practical experience in several of the following: 
 - Secure Boot, Verified Boot or hardware root of trust. 
 - Secure key storage, provisioning and cryptographic integration. 
 - Embedded Linux security hardening. 
 - Secure firmware updates and rollback protection. 
 - Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction. 
 - Embedded vulnerability analysis and remediation. 
 - Strong Linux debugging and embedded systems troubleshooting skills. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting with Python or Bash. 
 - Ability to independently own technical security tasks from design through implementation and verification. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional product-development teams. Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, multimedia devices, wearables or other commercially deployed embedded products. 
 - Experience developing or securing medical-device software, connected medical equipment or regulated healthcare products. 
 - Practical experience with ARM TrustZone, OP-TEE, TPM, secure elements or hardware security modules. 
 - Experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded, U-Boot, Linux kernel configuration and BSP security integration. 
 - Android Verified Boot (AVB), Android security architecture or SELinux policy development. 
 - Secure OTA frameworks and firmware-signing infrastructure. 
 - Experience with SBOM tooling, CVE assessment and software composition analysis. 
 - Familiarity with applicable product-security standards and guidance, such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 or relevant EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements. 
 - Experience supporting security verification, technical documentation and product-security audits.
