Job Title: 

Principal Engineer-High Speed Interface Pre-Silicon Validation/Verification

We Are: 

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. 

You Are: 

You are a driven and insightful Emulation Expert, passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in ASIC digital design. With a deep understanding of IP interfaces--especially PCIe and DDR--you are skilled in leveraging advanced emulation platforms like Zebu to accelerate verification and product development. Your career is marked by a proven ability to deliver robust, production-ready IP through rigorous emulation and verification cycles. You thrive in highly collaborative, matrixed, and international environments, bringing together diverse teams and perspectives to solve complex challenges. 

Your hands-on approach and proactive attitude make you a go-to resource for bridging gaps between Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring seamless integration and verification of both Controller and PHY components. You have a keen eye for detail and are committed to right-first-time development, always ensuring traceability and completeness across verification requirements. You stay ahead of industry trends, standards, and evolving technologies, and are adept at translating these into actionable insights for your teams. As an excellent communicator and natural collaborator, you are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and driving change within the organization. Your adaptability, resilience, and commitment to continuous learning set you apart as a leader in your field. 

What You'll Be Doing:

 - Staying ahead of evolving industry standards, interpreting future changes, ECNs, and specification errata, and integrating this knowledge into Emulation and Design IP teams.

The Impact You Will Have: 

- Enhancing cross-functional collaboration to elevate product quality and end-customer satisfaction. 
 - Transforming the approach to Emulation IP usage in validating cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures. 
 - Driving innovation by defining and refining requirements for IP product development, particularly in emulation contexts. 
 - Championing the adoption of best-in-class verification methodologies across the organization. 
 - Standardizing and optimizing verification workflows to boost efficiency, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Influencing the next generation of emulation and verification solutions, positioning Synopsys as an industry leader. 
 - Accelerating time-to-market for high-performance silicon solutions through advanced emulation strategies. 

What You'll Need: 

- 15+ years of relevant experience in emulation, verification, or IP product development. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe/ DDR / Ethernet interfaces, including protocol and verification strategies. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP verification. 
 - Demonstrated track record in leading IP product development initiatives with a focus on emulation. 
 - Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, with an ability to drive consensus and deliver results. 
 - Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire change across diverse teams. 
 - Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and international environment. 

Who You Are: 

- A proactive and collaborative problem-solver with a passion for excellence. 
 - Innovative thinker who embraces change and seeks out opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Strong communicator, able to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Resilient and adaptable, thriving in dynamic environments and embracing new challenges. 
 - Committed to mentoring others and fostering an inclusive, team-oriented culture. 

The Team You'll Be a Part Of: 

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys.

Job Description - QA/QC Engineer

Reports to:                   Senior QA/QC Engineer            

Job Description: 

The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities to ensure compliance with applicable quality, safety, regulatory, and contractual requirements while supporting the organization's strategic objectives and vision. The role is responsible for maintaining and continually improving the Quality Management System (QMS), monitoring compliance with established quality standards and procedures, supporting quality assurance and control activities across projects and operations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives under the guidance of the Senior QA/QC Engineer. 

Duties and Responsibilities: 

- Plan, implement, and monitor Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities throughout project execution to ensure compliance with client contractual requirements, approved quality documentation, applicable codes, standards, and the Company's Integrated Management System (IMS). 
 - Ensure per IMS, QA Document creation work flow fully understood and implemented all the time. 
 - Participate in Internal Kick-Off Meetings (KOM) with relevant stakeholders to gain a comprehensive understanding of project scope, technical requirements, contractual obligations, technical clarifications, and lessons learned from previous projects. 
 - Preparation of Master Quality Specification Extracts-Quality for key international clients (e. g. , Saudi Aramco, PDO, Shell DEP, ADNOC, and others) for review and approval by the Line Managers prior to inclusion in the quality database. Ensure client-specific technical quality requirements are accurately captured to minimize technical risks, standardize quality documentation, and provide a reliable reference for future projects, thereby improving efficiency in the preparation and review of project quality documents. 
 - Preparation of Project Specific Specification Extracts-Quality by identifying and consolidating project-specific quality requirements from client specifications, applicable codes, and standards to support the accurate and efficient preparation of quality documentation, minimize technical errors, and ensure compliance throughout project execution. 
 - Preparation of quality documentation, including Material Purchase Specifications (MPS), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) / Manufacturing Process Plan (MPP), and quality procedures, in accordance with client project specifications, and applicable international codes and standards to ensure technical requirements and compliance throughout project execution. 
 - Review of vendor quality documentation, including Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), manufacturing and testing procedures, welding documentation, and Non-Destructive Examination (NDE) procedures, to confirm compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable codes and standards. 
 - Participate in internal audits within the organization and second-party audits at supplier facilities, as directed by the Head quality to assess compliance with the Quality Management System (QMS). 
 - Execute Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities throughout project execution in accordance with approved quality documents, project requirements, and company procedures, utilizing established quality management systems such as the Event Note System, Inspection Database, and Job Hub to ensure effective quality monitoring, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Maintain and update the QA planning database dynamically to ensure project quality deliverable. 
 - Collaborate with Project Managers during the early stages of project execution to support contract reviews, identify and resolve quality-related conflicts, review technical deliverables, and address project-specific quality requirements to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, applicable standards, and successful project delivery. 
 - Manage technical queries (TQs) related to materials, welding, inspection, and other quality-related matters, ensuring timely review, resolution, and issuance of technical clarifications prior to project commencement to support smooth project execution and minimize potential quality risks. 
 - Participate in project kick-off meetings, pre-inspection meetings, and other quality-related meetings for critical items and packages. Coordinate Quality Control (QC) activities at supplier facilities and liaise with Jord Inspection Engineers /Third-party inspection agencies and client inspectors as and when required to ensure compliance with approved quality requirements, inspection plans, and project specifications. 
 - Identify and document quality non-conformances, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), monitor and verify the implementation of corrective and preventive actions, ensure effective close-out of NCRs, and recommend improvement opportunities to enhance quality performance and prevent recurrence. 
 - Perform inspection and verification activities in accordance with the latest approved drawings, project specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), quality procedures, and other applicable project quality documents to ensure compliance with contractual requirements. 
 - Ensure full compliance with all company policies, procedures, and Integrated Management System (IMS) requirements while executing QA/QC activities, maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence. 
 - During inspections stop working when: 
 - People's health and safety are at risk, i. e. , due to non-usage of PPE, lack of safety equipment, poor quality equipment and machinery. 
 - Quality related processes and relevant approved documentation are not strictly followed. 
 - The above duties and responsibilities are at a minimum, however, based on job needs there may be additional work required to ensure quality needs are met. 
 - Adhere to all Jord company policies and IMS requirements. 

Skills and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Minimum 5 years of hands-on shop/fabrication experience in the manufacturing of pressure vessels and heat exchangers in accordance with ASME Section II, Section V, Section VIII, and Section IX requirements. Experience with API 661, Air-Cooled Heat Exchangers (ACHE), and Air-Cooled Condensers (ACC) is highly preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge and practical experience in Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities within manufacturing and project execution environments. 
 - Sound understanding of manufacturing processes and product characteristics, including foundry operations, fabrication, machining, welding, Non-Destructive Examination (NDE), heat treatment, surface preparation, painting, and coating activities. 
 - Knowledge and experience in inspection methods, testing techniques, measuring instruments, and quality verification processes. 
 - Ability to interpret, understand, and effectively apply on international codes, standards, procedures, client specifications, and project quality requirements during project execution to ensure compliance and successful project delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, with experience in supporting, coordinating, and managing skilled technical professionals. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, suppliers, clients, and other stakeholders. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to prepare technical documentation, reports, and professional correspondence.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) - Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) -Senior

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY- GDS Consulting - Enterprise Risk (ER) - Regulatory Compliance -Senior - GxP AI Validation/Testing

As part of our EY-ER- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance senior actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you'll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives. 

The opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and detail‐oriented senior with strong expertise in validating AI/ML models, Generative AI (GenAI) systems, and multi‐agent workflows within GxP‐regulated and quality‐critical environments. The ideal candidate will ensure the reliability, fairness, robustness, and regulatory compliance of AI solutions while supporting cross‐functional teams in designing, testing, and maintaining production‐ready, inspection‐ready AI systems. 

This role is responsible for leading AI validation and testing activities across the full model lifecycle, including model development, training, testing, deployment, and post‐deployment monitoring, in alignment with GxP principles, risk‐based validation, and data integrity expectations. The consultant will play a key role in embedding Responsible AI, quality‐by‐design, and governance‐by‐design practices, enabling the safe, trustworthy, and explainable use of AI and agent‐based solutions in regulated life sciences and pharmaceutical contexts. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the validation strategy for AI/ML and GenAI-enabled business solutions, ensuring compliance with GxP, CSV, CSA, risk management, and applicable regulatory expectations. 
 - Author and maintain Validation Plans, Validation Strategies, Traceability Frameworks, Acceptance Criteria, and Validation Summary Reports for AI-integrated platforms and use cases. 
 - Define risk-based testing approaches for AI-enabled user workflows, focusing on functional suitability, business process integrity, intended use verification, and compliance requirements. 
 - Oversee front-end validation activities for AI-powered applications, ensuring user interactions, outputs, workflows, and decision-support functionalities perform as intended across business scenarios. 
 - Establish validation deliverables throughout the AI solution lifecycle, including requirement review, test planning, change assessment, release readiness reviews, and post-deployment monitoring support. 
 - Provide compliance oversight for AI solution delivery, ensuring validation evidence, documentation, and audit trails are complete, traceable, inspection-ready, and aligned with organizational quality standards. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Data Scientists, Engineers, and Quality teams to translate business requirements into testable validation and compliance objectives. 
 - Leverage observability and monitoring frameworks to assess AI system behaviour trends, identify deviations impacting validated state, and support ongoing compliance assessments. 
 - Coordinate defect triage, impact assessment, root cause discussions, and remediation activities while ensuring appropriate documentation and closure in accordance with quality processes. 
 - Manage release governance and stakeholder communications by facilitating validation reviews, compliance sign-offs, deployment readiness assessments, status reporting, and executive-level updates throughout the implementation lifecycle. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in AI/ML, GenAI, software testing, validation, or quality engineering roles. 
 - Experience creating user stories, test scripts, validation plans, or AI solution prototypes. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Consulting or client‐facing experience preferred. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

Must-Have Skills And Attributes

- Strong understanding of Computer System Validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), GAMP 5, and risk-based validation approaches within regulated environments. 
 - Hands-on experience authoring Validation Plans, Validation Strategies, Test Plans, Traceability Matrices, Validation Summary Reports, and release readiness documentation. 
 - Proven experience leading validation activities for AI/ML-enabled, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Expertise in defining risk-based testing strategies, user acceptance criteria, and compliance-focused test approaches for AI-integrated business processes. 
 - Sound understanding of AI/ML system lifecycles, including data ingestion, model deployment, retraining considerations, and operational controls. 
 - Experience overseeing release management, defect management, deviation handling, and change control activities within validated environments. 
 - Knowledge of AI governance, validation documentation, audit preparedness, and regulatory expectations for AI-enabled systems. 
 - Ability to assess and maintain the validated state of AI solutions through monitoring, periodic review, and lifecycle management activities. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across business, quality, product, engineering, and data science teams. 
 - Experience working within Agile/Hybrid delivery models while ensuring adherence to quality and compliance requirements. 
 - Experience in client-facing roles, managing expectations and delivering solutions
 - Strong communication and presentation skills
 - Experience in IT project management and validation planning
 - Ability to troubleshoot application issues and recommend solutions
 - Familiarity with change control, deviation handling, and CAPA processes
 - Proven ability to mentor junior staff and lead validation teams
 - Experience in training and cross-skilling resources
 - Strong teamwork and collaboration mindset

Good-to-Have Skills And Attributes

- Understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and multi-agent architectures. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability and monitoring frameworks, including model monitoring, drift detection, traceability, explainability, and operational risk tracking. 
 - Exposure to AI validation regulations and emerging industry guidance related to GxP AI systems and Responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience validating cloud-hosted AI platforms and solutions deployed on Azure AI, AWS AI/ML, or Google Vertex AI environments. 
 - Working knowledge of AI quality metrics, model performance indicators, and evaluation methodologies for supervised and unsupervised learning systems. 
 - Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Langfuse, Arize, WhyLabs, MLflow, Azure AI Foundry Monitoring, or equivalent platforms. 

What We Look For

- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills. 
 - An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide. 
 - Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Locale Testing
data.description:
Job Requirements

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

Hrs As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travellers Stay, Work, and Pay.

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

The HRS AI Workflow team serves as a pivotal force in transforming customer support by harnessing the power of advanced AI technologies. Our primary goal is to enhance customer satisfaction by providing swift, intelligent solutions to inquiries, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels. By focusing on proactive support and personalised interactions, we empower customers to resolve issues autonomously, significantly reducing response times and minimising frustration. Through continuous improvement and real-time insights, the AI Workflow team plays a crucial role in elevating service quality, allowing our support agents to concentrate on complex tasks that drive operational excellence and foster innovation. 

POSITION

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to architect, implement, and maintain our AWS-centered cloud infrastructure. This role is vital in ensuring the scalability, reliability, security, and performance of our AI-driven customer support platform. The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer must have strong hands-on experience with AWS and will be responsible for designing and managing AWS cloud resources, implementing infrastructure as code, and establishing robust CI/CD pipelines. This position requires deep expertise in AWS cloud technologies and DevOps practices to support our mission of delivering exceptional customer service through technological innovation. 

PERSPECTIVE

HRS is, at its heart, a platform company. To provide the market-leading Lodging-as-a-Service platform, we hire people with a broad set of technical skills (and from a wide variety of backgrounds) who are ready to take on some of the most challenging problems in the industry - from reliably handling 100M API requests per day, to building adaptive machine learning as a result of years of data science and infrastructure work, and enabling corporates worldwide to create a unique lodging experience for their employees. 

We look at HRS as a constant work in progress and the same is true of our people; for all of us, we believe the best is yet to come. We're here to support each other in our curiosity and creativity - which we pursue through thoughtful discussion and knowledge-sharing among a diverse set of peers and colleagues. 

We're a highly cross-functional organisation and view that as part of the fun: we design our space to encourage as much collaboration as possible. We also have a culture of transparency that we carry through to communication, ensuring that colleagues all around the world have the information they need to make good local decisions. 

CHALLENGE

 - Identity and Access Management (IAM): Implement and manage IAM solutions across multiple cloud providers and SaaS platforms, ensuring secure access control and data privacy. Implement federated identity management and single sign-on (SSO) solutions.

data.title: Chief Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Company: CGH Earth Experience Hotels

Location: Dasada, Gujarat

Designation: Chief Engineer

Department: Engineering & Maintenance

Role Overview

CGH Earth is looking for an experienced, dynamic, and hands-on Chief Engineer to direct all engineering, maintenance, and asset management at our luxury resort in Dasada, Gujarat. 

The resort combines heritage accommodation, nature, wildlife, wellness, and curated guest experiences. The Chief Engineer is fully responsible for all MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and civil infrastructure, ensuring operational efficiency while upholding CGH Earth's standards for sustainability, resource conservation, and responsible hospitality. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Overall Operations & Preventive Maintenance (PPM)

- Direct day-to-day engineering operations, predictive maintenance, and utility networks (power, water, refrigeration, automation) to prevent service disruptions. 
 - Inspect plant rooms, BOH areas, and public spaces daily to maintain safety, presentation, and SOP compliance. 
 - Design and execute PPM programs across all 25 guest cottages, public zones, and offices. 
 - Enforce a strict 15-minute turnaround target for guest-room maintenance requests. 
 - Maintain guest room HVAC units, plumbing, water pressure, hot water delivery, and room amenities to luxury hospitality standards. 

2. Pre-Opening Staging & Asset Commissioning

- Lead structural snagging, testing, calibration, and formal commissioning for all MEP installations in new structures. 
 - Establish contractor handover protocols, securing all operation manuals, blueprints, and wiring diagrams. 
 - Set up the initial maintenance database, tag all equipment assets, and build the critical spare parts inventory. 

3. Sustainability, Zero-Waste & Energy Management

- Supervise the daily operation, chemical dosing, and testing of the biological Sewage Treatment Plant (STP). 
 - Manage the on-site glass water bottling line, solar PV grids, solar hot-water arrays, and rainwater harvesting systems. 
 - Track daily energy, fuel, and water consumption; execute load-shedding and timer controls to optimize utility draw. 
 - Maintain power-factor correction units and LED/high-efficiency lighting systems. 
 - Compile monthly utility, carbon footprint, and ESG metrics for corporate reporting. 

4. Financial Management & CAPEX/OPEX

- Prepare and control the annual engineering operating budget (OPEX) in coordination with Finance. 
 - Formulate annual Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) plans with ROI justifications for machinery upgrades. 
 - Track monthly spending on DG fuel, electricity, STP/pool chemicals, and technical spares under strict approval trails. 

5. Heritage Preservation & Specialist Systems Support

- F&B Engineering: Maintain commercial kitchen equipment (Flamingo restaurant & premium wing), walk-in freezers, dishwashers, and food waste macerators. Set up temporary MEP networks for outdoor bush/desert dining events. 
 - Heritage Architecture: Preserve local Kooba and Bhunga mud/thatch architecture, blending modern waterproofing with ethnic building mediums to prevent structural and pest damage. 
 - Pools & Water Systems: Manage 'Desjoyaux' single-skin shell swimming pools, water chemistry, deep-well pump stations, booster pumps, and water softeners. 
 - IT & Automation: Support site-wide fiber optic networks, Wi-Fi, telecom lines, server room climate controls, and UPS battery systems. 

6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

- Serve as primary Safety Officer; oversee fire hydrants, smoke detectors, alarm systems, and emergency generator grids. 
 - Conduct regular engineering safety drills, blackout simulations, and technical risk assessments. 
 - Secure and maintain statutory permits, boiler licenses, elevator certifications, and Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) clearances. 

7. Leadership, Training & Administration

- Lead, roster, and mentor the engineering team to provide seamless 24/7 technical coverage. 
 - Deliver technical training on HVAC, plumbing, high-voltage safety codes, SOPs, and CGH Earth sustainability standards. 
 - Negotiate and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for DG sets, STPs, and central pumps; supervise third-party contractors on site. 
 - Maintain auditable equipment logs, work orders, fuel drops, and task completions in the resort ERP system. 

Candidate Profile

- Education: Bachelor's Degree or   Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or Hotel Engineering. Certifications in High-Voltage Systems, Industrial Safety, or Project Management preferred. 
 - Experience: 10 years in luxury hospitality maintenance, with 3-4 years as Chief Engineer, Assistant Chief Engineer, or Engineering Manager. Hands-on pre-opening and remote resort experience highly valued. 
 - Technical Skills: Troubleshooting HVAC, single/3-phase power, DG sets, biological STPs, water filtration, and pool systems. 
 - Financial & Digital Capability: Proven experience managing OPEX, CAPEX, P&L lines, maintenance management software, and ERP systems. 
 - Languages: Fluency in English and Hindi is required; proficiency in Gujarati is highly preferred. 

Role Expectation

The Chief Engineer is the ultimate custodian of the property's physical infrastructure, capital assets, safety compliance, and ecological standards-balancing long-term asset planning with active daily operational leadership.

data.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About Us

We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. 

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. 

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. 

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. 

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. 

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. 

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. 
 - Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. 
 - Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. 
 - Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. 
 - Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. 
 - Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. 
 - Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. 
 - Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. 
 - Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. 
 - Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. 
 - Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. 
 - Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. 
 - Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. 
 - Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. 
 - Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. 
 - Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. 
 - A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. 
 - Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. 
 - Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. 
 - Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. 
 - Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. 
 - Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. 
 - The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. 
 - Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. 

Especially Valuable Experience

- Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. 
 - Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. 
 - Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. 
 - Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. 
 - Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. 
 - Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. 

Growth, Responsibility And Compensation

Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. 

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. 

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. 

What We Offer

- A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. 
 - Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
 - The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. 
 - Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. 
 - Close collaboration with startup leadership. 
 - The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. 

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. 

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. 

How To Apply

We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. 

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: 

- A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. 
 - An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. 
 - Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. 
 - A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. 
 - Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. 
 - Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. 

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.title: Principal Engineer – Node.js / TypeScript / AWS
data.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Node. js, TypeScript, distributed systems, microservices, and AWS cloud technologies. 

The role will focus on designing, developing, scaling, and supporting highly available backend services and APIs for customer-facing applications. The ideal candidate will have strong ownership of backend architecture, application performance, production reliability, security, observability, and cloud-native engineering practices. 

Experience with React and/or Java/Spring Boot is a plus but not mandatory. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 7-9 years of overall software engineering experience, including at least 5 years of strong backend development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience with Node. js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. 
 - Strong experience developing RESTful APIs, backend services, and microservice-based applications. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software architecture. 
 - Experience designing and developing scalable and maintainable distributed systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Amazon DynamoDB, including: 
 - Partition key and sort key design
 - Global and local secondary indexes
 - Query and access-pattern-based data modeling
 - Performance and scalability considerations
 - Strong experience with AWS services including ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch. 
 - Experience developing asynchronous, queue-based, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Experience building secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available applications. 
 - Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines, including Jenkins or equivalent platforms. 
 - Strong experience with Git-based source control and development workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of application monitoring, debugging, observability, incident management, and production support. 
 - Good understanding of API security, authentication/authorization, error handling, resiliency, and performance optimization. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Primary Skills - Must Have

- Node. js
 - TypeScript / JavaScript
 - Backend Development
 - RESTful APIs
 - Microservices
 - Distributed Systems
 - Amazon DynamoDB
 - AWS: ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch
 - Event-driven / asynchronous architecture
 - Docker
 - CI/CD
 - Unit & Integration Testing
 - Production Troubleshooting & Observability
 - Performance, Scalability, Security & Reliability

Secondary Skills - Good to Have

- Java / Spring Boot
 - React
 - MySQL / PostgreSQL
 - Redis / Amazon ElastiCache
 - AWS Step Functions, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, EC2
 - Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation
 - Kubernetes
 - NestJS / Express. js
 - OpenTelemetry, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar tools
 - Messaging, event streaming, or distributed workflow platforms

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node. js and TypeScript. 
 - Build reliable, secure, and highly available microservice-based and distributed applications. 
 - Design efficient data models and access patterns using Amazon DynamoDB. 
 - Build cloud-native and event-driven solutions using AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch. 
 - Develop asynchronous processing workflows, background jobs, integrations, and messaging-based architectures. 
 - Define service boundaries, API contracts, data flows, and backend architecture. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex production and customer-facing issues. 
 - Identify and address performance, scalability, stability, security, availability, and extensibility challenges. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews. 
 - Develop automated unit, integration, API, and service-level tests. 
 - Monitor production applications using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Support and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, containerization, and deployment processes. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, QA Engineers, Architects, and globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Work in an Agile/Scrum environment. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of backend features from design and implementation through deployment and production support. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to backend engineering standards and architectural best practices.

data.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About Us

We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. 

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. 

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. 

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. 

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. 

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. 

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. 

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. 
 - Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. 
 - Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. 
 - Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. 
 - Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. 
 - Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. 
 - Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. 
 - Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. 
 - Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. 
 - Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. 
 - Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. 
 - Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. 
 - Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. 
 - Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. 

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. 
 - Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. 
 - Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. 
 - Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. 
 - Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. 
 - A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. 
 - Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. 
 - Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. 
 - Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. 
 - Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. 
 - Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. 
 - The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. 
 - Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. 

Especially Valuable Experience

- Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. 
 - Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. 
 - Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. 
 - Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. 
 - Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. 
 - Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. 

Growth, Responsibility And Compensation

Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. 

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. 

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. 

What We Offer

- A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. 
 - Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
 - The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. 
 - Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. 
 - Close collaboration with startup leadership. 
 - The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. 

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. 

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. 

How To Apply

We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. 

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: 

- A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. 
 - An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. 
 - Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. 
 - A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. 
 - Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. 
 - Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. 

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one - but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. 

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment. 

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50, 000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J. P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies. 

About The Role

What you'll do: 

Customer first, always

- Find and remove friction across key customer journeys on web and mobile, from onboarding to day-to-day usage
 - Use support tickets, contact drivers, app reviews and product analytics to decide what to fix next
 - Build self-service capabilities that let customers resolve issues without contacting support
 - Own and evolve the customer support AI bot: improve answer quality and resolution rate, connect it to product data and actions, and hand off smoothly to human agents when needed
 - Treat bugs and incidents through the customer's eyes: fix the root cause, not only the symptom

Build

- Write production code across frontend and backend, spending around 80% of your time hands-on
 - Own technical design for the squad's work and set a high bar for quality, performance and reliability
 - Instrument every change so we can measure its impact on customer behaviour and contact rate
 - Run experiments and A/B tests to validate improvements before scaling them

Lead

- Lead, coach and grow a squad of 2 engineers, and help hire as the team grows
 - Work with the Product Manager and Designer to shape the roadmap and turn problems into shippable increments
 - Partner with engineering teams across Aspire to land changes in code your squad does not own
 - Work closely with Customer Support and Operations to understand pain points and close the feedback loop

What We're Looking For

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading engineers as a tech lead
 - Strong, recent hands-on experience on both frontend (e. g. React, TypeScript) and backend (APIs, services, databases)
 - A genuine obsession with customer experience: you notice friction, care about the details and use the product yourself
 - A track record of shipping improvements that moved a customer metric, and you can explain how you measured it
 - Experience working across team boundaries in a multi-team engineering organisation, influencing without authority
 - Good product sense: you can push back, propose simpler solutions and trade off scope against impact
 - Comfortable with data: you can read dashboards, define events and query data to answer your own questions
 - Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have

- Experience in fintech, banking or another regulated industry where security and compliance shape the product
 - Mobile development experience (e. g. React Native)
 - Built self-service or support tooling: help centres, in-app guidance, chatbots or AI-assisted support
 - Hands-on with product analytics and observability tools (e. g. Mixpanel, PostHog, Sentry, Datadog)
 - Experience with accessibility, web performance and front-end design systems
 - Worked in a B2B or SME-focused product across multiple markets

How We'll Measure Success

In your first 90 days

- You know the top customer contact drivers and the journeys behind them
 - You have shipped at least one measurable friction fix end to end
 - You have working relationships with the engineering teams that own our most critical flows

Over time

- Contact rate goes down and self-service and AI bot resolution rates go up
 - Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and app store ratings improve
 - Retention improves in the journeys the squad has worked on
 - The squad ships predictably, with high quality and few regressions

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Aspire. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Aspire may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Aspire's Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.title: Quality Assurance Lead

As a QA Lead, you will be responsible for driving the organization's quality assurance and process excellence initiatives by ensuring compliance with CMMI, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and ISO 20000-1 standards. You will lead quality governance activities, define and monitor quality metrics, conduct audits and gap assessments, identify process improvement opportunities, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and compliance. ·              Conduct gap analysis to identify deviations between existing processes and quality standards such as CMMI, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and ISO 20000-1. 

·              Lead initiatives to improve processes, enhance operational efficiency, and strengthen quality compliance. 

·              Develop, implement, and maintain quality frameworks, procedures, standards, and best practices.

Risk Management

·              Track quality-related issues and drive resolution through structured corrective actions. 

Project Quality Governance

·              Communicate quality policies, process updates, and improvement initiatives across the organization.

Continuous Improvement

·              Promote a culture of quality, accountability, and operational excellence within the organization.

·              Proficiency in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and quality governance practices. 

·              Experience in defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics and KPIs. 

·              Strong capability in conducting gap analysis and compliance assessments. 

·              Expertise in process improvement, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

·              Experience in planning, conducting, and managing internal and external audits. 

·              Knowledge of risk assessment, risk mitigation, and quality risk management. 

·              Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and issue resolution. 

·              Experience in quality reporting, documentation management, and compliance tracking. 

·              Ability to review project deliverables, process documentation, and quality records for compliance and accuracy. 

·              Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for reporting, analysis, and presentations.

We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
