 - Experience with ML lifecycle tools, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and model governance. 
 - Visualization: 
 - Python-based dashboarding/analytics (Streamlit, Dash, Plotly). 
 - Security & Compliance: 
 - Secure cloud design, IAM, encryption, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Published Work / Open Source: 
 - Contributions to AI/ML communities, conference presentations, or technical publications.

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

Learn More About Our Benefits Here. 

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

Automation Lead will functionally guide SRE practices, enable production-grade automation from federated development teams, and ensure platform stability, risk management, and audit readiness. Key Responsibilities

 - Define platform standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures for enterprise service automation.

 - Background in highly regulated industries (banking, financial services, healthcare, utilities).

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you. 

, , JR2024865

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Real Time Index Engineering(Java)
data.description:
FTSE Russell is a leading global provider of financial services, specialising in the creation and management of indexes, data, and analytic solutions. As part of the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we support investors worldwide in making informed decisions across asset classes, investment strategies, and market segments. Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk. 

Job Summary

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Reliability, security, and data quality are non-negotiable as we modernise the platform that underpins our entire real-time franchise. 

The ideal candidate is a self-sufficient, technically excellent engineer who can lead through architectural clarity, thorough code review, and hands-on delivery. You combine strong expertise in low-latency, event-driven system design, data modelling, and debugging with genuine passion for how AI tooling is redefining software engineering. This is an individual contributor role where you will lead through the quality of your thinking and your engineering standards. 

AI-First Engineering This team operates with an AI-first approach. We expect hands-on experience with AI development tooling: terminal-based agents, AI-augmented IDEs, and automated workflows. You are ultimately accountable for production quality, security, and correctness. This means owning infrastructure review, security validation, system observability, and operational guardrails. 

What You'll Do

- Build low-latency, event-driven calculation engines that price indices accurately through market events. 
 - Operate a cloud-native, horizontally scalable, always-on platform, built as resilient and managed through infrastructure as code. 
 - Own data foundations for real-time market and reference data, with strong modelling, quality and auditability. 
 - Deliver secure APIs and streaming, event-driven distribution that make real-time index data easy to consume. 
 - Help bring advanced and multi-asset methodologies to market (e. g. volatility-controlled, options/futures-based, long-short). 
 - Modernise the operations experience: replace manual workflows with intuitive tooling and observability. 
 - Lead through architecture, code review and test strategy, partnering across product, operations and client-facing teams. 

Tech Stack

- Development: Java, C#, , Python, SQL, OpenAPI
 - Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required)
 - Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres
 - IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab
 - AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e. g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

Experience We Value

- 9+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong expertise in system design, distributed and event-driven systems, and relational data modelling. 
 - Solid experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS. 
 - Ability to write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent). 
 - Experience designing test strategies at multiple levels of the testing pyramid. 
 - Proficiency with AI development tooling and a clear understanding of how to use AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality. 
 - Strong debugging skills across distributed systems. 
 - Basic understanding of financial services or capital markets. 
 - Effective collaboration and the ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical audiences. 

How We Work

The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools. 

- Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution. 
 - Customer driven. Work backwards from client needs and build products to address real-world problems. 
 - Technically courageous. Go beyond your comfort zone and push boundaries to deliver excellence. 
 - Learn and be curious. Continuously seek feedback, learn in formal and informal settings, actively share knowledge. 
 - Act as owners. Operate as though it is your business. Make thoughtful trade-offs and deliver long-term value. 
 - Lead with data. Validate assumptions, stay close to the details, act decisively. 
 - Build responsibly, deliver incrementally. Look for the small opportunities and milestones to build ambitious solutions. 
 - AI-native by default. Use AI tooling as a force multiplier, frame problems clearly, validate continually, and own the output.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, with 6+ years of relevant industry experience and demonstrated technical leadership at lead or head of engineering level. 

• Experience working with international teams and coordinating quality across multiple projects and external partners. 

• Strong foundations in design, engineering and manufacturing, supported by experience solving real industrial engineering problems. 

• Hands-on expertise in CAD and FEA, with sufficient breadth to evaluate CFD work alongside specialists and recognise the limits of an analysis. 

• Experience reviewing and approving other engineers' work, challenging assumptions, and making defensible technical decisions. 

• Proficiency in relevant CAD and simulation tools, such as SolidWorks, Ansys, Abaqus, Fluent, or Simcenter.

The Core Engineering's 2, 000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: 

- Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm's risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions 
 - The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics 
 - Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm's financials and a wide range of reporting functions

Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, including Large Language Models, to solve complex, mission-critical problems in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to safeguarding a leading global financial institution?

Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the MILE team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure. 

Within SCHIE, the Microsoft Silicon Engineering and Solutions team is seeking passionate, driven and intellectually curious engineers to join our Central Front-End Tools, Flows and Methodology (TFM) group, based in Bangalore, India. We are seeking an experienced and dynamic UK Highways Design Leaders to lead the delivery of complex highway infrastructure projects for our UK business.  - Conduct deep-dive code reviews and architectural walkthroughs ensuring correctness, maintainability, and TypeScript-first quality
 - Champion automated testing strategy - unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage using Jest, Vitest, and Playwright
 - Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Antigravity) to accelerate development and model best practices for the team. 

People & Delivery Management (30%)

- Lead and grow a team of 6-12 engineers - manage hiring, onboarding, and career development
 - Set clear goals, expectations, and performance benchmarks - conduct regular 1: 1s and structured performance reviews
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers toward technical leadership; build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into engineering roadmaps and delivery plans
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (QA, DevOps, Design, Product) to ensure smooth delivery and consistent quality
 - Manage project timelines, dependencies, and technical risk - communicate status and blockers to leadership proactively
 - Stay current with emerging technologies - AI agents, edge computing, WebSockets, MCP - and drive continuous adoption of better engineering practices. 

Technology Skills In Order Of Priority

- TypeScript - 10+ years; deep expertise in strong typing, generics, and TypeScript-first

architecture on both frontend and backend. TypeScript is the primary language - not Python. 

- AI Agents - hands-on experience with Cloudflare Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Flue, or similar; prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and AI-powered feature integration
 - Cloud Providers - AWS (S3, Athena, k8s/EKS) and/or Azure; hands-on infrastructure and deployment experience
 - REST APIs, WebSockets & MCP Servers - designing, governing, and consuming APIs; real-time services and Model Context Protocol server integration

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

Job Description Summary

At GE Vernova, we are tackling some of the world's most challenging energy problems. Joining our team means you will work on technology that powers the world, surrounded by people who are committed to safety, innovation, and sustainability. We believe that diverse perspectives drive the best solutions; that is why we foster an inclusive environment where your voice is heard, your curiosity is encouraged, and your professional development is a priority. We offer the opportunity to take true technical ownership of complex hardware while working alongside world-class experts who are dedicated to mentoring the next generation of engineering leaders. 

As a Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, analysis, and optimization of components across our gas power portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to deliver high-quality solutions, drive product upgrades, and ensure our designs meet rigorous performance and safety standards. This role requires a balance of technical ownership, innovative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design & Analysis: Execute mechanical design and analysis (stress, modal, lifing) for Stationary components in gas turbines, steam, generators, and accessory systems. 
 - Technical Stewardship: Take ownership of mechanical hardware; perform validation testing; and evaluate designs for factors like thermal growth, manufacturing variation, and assembly stack-up to ensure optimal product behavior. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering experts, manufacturing, and sourcing teams to optimize sub-systems and components. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Lead root cause analyses (RCA) to improve reliability, quality, and yield. Apply Lean principles to streamline processes and drive innovation. 
 - Project Delivery: Manage milestones through formal/informal technical reviews, ensuring compliance with NPI processes and design practices. 
 - Mentorship: Foster a collaborative environment by coaching team members and building strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Principal and Chief Engineers. 

What You'll Bring - Basic Qualifications

- Master's or bachelor's in engineering with specialization in Mechanical, Design and Applied Mechanics
 - Minimum of 4 years of Engineering experience. 

What Will Make You Stand Out - Desired Qualifications

- Additional 1-2 years of relevant engineering experience
 - Technical proficiency in engineering software (ANSYS-Classic/Workbench, NX) and programming languages (Python, Excel VBA) for data analysis. 
 - A "Lean" mindset, familiarity with AI-driven tools, and a passion for innovative design.

data.description:
Company Overview

At Cosmoserve Space, we are pioneering a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through innovative technology focused on active debris removal. Our mission is to safeguard the orbital environment by developing high-tech, cost-effective solutions that lead the market in addressing the growing challenge of space debris. With a passionate team of engineers and a commitment to cutting-edge engineering, Cosmoserve is driving the next generation of responsible space activities, ensuring that the space remains accessible for future missions. 

Position: Avionics Hardware Lead

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: CEO

Location: Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

We are looking for an Avionics Hardware Lead to own the onboard electronics of our spacecraft, from system specification to tested flight hardware. The role covers defining avionics requirements from mission goals and designing microcontroller-based circuits, power electronics and subsystem interfaces. The Lead will drive circuit simulation, PCB layout, component selection and testing, and ensure every board meets space-grade quality and reliability standards. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Lead will head a team of engineers, set design and documentation standards, and work closely with the GNC, AIT and QA teams to deliver reliable hardware on schedule. 

Key Responsibilities

•  Translate mission and system goals into clear avionics system specifications. 

•  Lead design and development of electronic circuits built around microcontrollers. 

•  Run circuit simulations and review PCB layouts before fabrication. 

•  Select, design and test low-power DC-DC converters and power distribution circuits. 

•  Define and implement interfaces between avionics units over serial and parallel buses, with signal conditioning using op-amps and current-to-voltage converters. 

•  Select components suitable for space applications, including qualified use of industrial-grade parts. 

•  Apply QA practices in line with MIL-STD-883, ISO and AS9100 requirements. 

•  Prepare and maintain design documents, test procedures and reports. 

•  Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of avionics engineers. 

Qualifications

Education: BE / B. Tech or M. Tech in ECE or EEE with specialisation in Electronics / Instrumentation. 

Work Experience: 8 to 10 years

Required Skill Set (Major)

•        Experience in design and development of electronic circuits with microcontrollers. 

•        Experience in preparing system specifications for system goals and functions. 

•        Good knowledge of circuit simulation in KiCad, PSpice or similar tools. 

•        Knowledge of PCB layout. 

•        Knowledge of power electronics such as low-power DC-DC converters, including selection and testing. 

•        Good knowledge of interfacing various avionics systems using serial or parallel buses, op-amps, current-to-voltage converters, etc. 

•        Knowledge of QA aspects related to MIL 1553 STD, ISO and AS standards. 

•        Good knowledge of component selection for space applications. 

•        Knowledge of building systems for space using industrial-grade components. 

•        Experience in leading a team of engineers. 

•        Good documentation aptitude. 

•          Added Advantage

1.       General knowledge of space systems for satellite building. 

2.       Firmware knowledge

Required Soft Skills

•          Ability to lead, guide and motivate a team of engineers. 

•          Strong sense of ownership from design through to testing. 

•          Clear communication with engineers, management and vendors. 

•          Works well with GNC, mechanical, AIT and QA teams. 

•          Methodical approach to debugging and root cause analysis. 

•          High attention to detail and discipline in following quality processes. 

•          Good planning and prioritisation in a fast-paced startup. 

•          Adaptable to changing requirements and limited resources. 

•          Willing to mentor juniors and give constructive design reviews.

data.title: Lead AI Engineer (LLM Agents)-Immediate
data.description:
Location: Remote (India), working with a San Francisco-based founding team

Engagement: Full-time, long-term, dedicated

Experience: 8-10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years building production LLM applications and agents

Openings: 1

Time zone: Flexible hours, with a daily live overlap with the founders

About the ClientOur client is an early-stage AI startup in San Francisco, founded by alumni of Harvard and MIT. The company is in stealth. It is building an agent-based product that takes complex, high-stakes paperwork off the hands of US families: working out what applies to them, researching official sources, handling correspondence and following up over weeks, with every step checked and backed by evidence. 

Parts of the product are already built and running in test. The team today is two co-founders and one engineer. As Lead Engineer, you will be the most senior technical person on the team. You will be the founders' technical partner, own the architecture, and lead the product into production with real users. 

The Role: CTO Judgement, Builder's HandsWe are looking for someone with the judgement of a CTO who still writes code every day. Expect roughly 70-80% of your week to be hands-on: designing, building, reviewing and shipping. The rest goes into technical direction, standards and growing the team. 

•      Own the architecture end to end, and be accountable for how the system behaves in production. 

•      Be the founders' technical partner: shape the roadmap, make build-vs-buy calls, size work honestly, and push back when something is the wrong thing to build. 

•      Set the engineering bar for code review, testing, evals, security and releases. 

•      Lead and mentor the engineers on the team, and help interview future hires. 

•      Lead from the front in production: when something breaks, you're on it, and you make sure it doesn't break the same way twice. 

This role is not for you if you haven't shipped production code in the last 12 months, or you'd rather manage engineers than build alongside them. 

What You'll Own•      Agent platform architecture: design the agent harness, with tool-calling loops that have budgets, stop conditions and failure recovery, and a check on every output before it reaches a user or an outside party. 

•      Model layer: route across model vendors with fallbacks, manage prompts and versions, and weigh the cost, latency and quality behind each choice. 

•      Durable, long-running workflows: agent runs that wait days or weeks for a reply, survive restarts and deployments, and can be audited afterwards. 

•      Evaluation and safety: build the eval framework that decides when an agent is correct, when it can act without a person approving, and when it must escalate. Trace and observe every run. 

•      Data, security and compliance: store sensitive personal records securely, with row-level access control, encryption, secrets management and audit trails. Get the platform ready for the security reviews (e. g. SOC 2) that customers and partners will ask for. 

•      Infrastructure and reliability: AWS and Azure architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. Build performance-critical services in Go, Rust or Python where TypeScript is not the right tool. 

•      Full-stack product: you will still ship features end to end, from the agent to the screen a family sees on phone or desktop. 

Milestones•      First 30 days: ship code in week one. Review the existing system, then agree an architecture, a risk list and a 90-day technical plan with the founders. 

•      By 90 days: the core agent harness, eval framework and production infrastructure are in place, and the first real users are live. 

•      By six months: the platform runs in production with real users, with measurable reliability and eval coverage, and the team ships to your standard. 

Core RequirementsSeniority and leadership•      8-10+ years of professional software engineering. In recent years you have worked as a tech lead, principal or staff engineer, founding engineer or CTO in early-stage startups, and still written production code throughout. 

•      You have owned the architecture of a production system from early design through scale, and lived with the consequences of your decisions. 

•      0-to-1 experience: you have taken a product from prototype to real users, at an early-stage startup or on a new product line. 

•      You have led or mentored a small team (2-8 engineers) without big-company process around you. 

Agents and AI systems (hands-on, in production)•      2+ years building LLM applications, including at least one agent system you architected, shipped to real users and ran in production. 

•      Deep understanding of agent architecture: 

-      tool and function calling

-      planning vs. execution, and single vs. multi-agent designs

-      context and memory management

-      human-in-the-loop approvals and guardrails

-      defence against prompt injection

•      You know the frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, MCP) well enough to know when to write the loop yourself. 

•      Structured output and failure handling: you get typed, schema-validated output from models, and you handle the cases where the model gets it wrong with retries, repair and fallbacks. 

•      Evaluation at production level: you have built eval sets and graders (including calibrated LLM-as-judge), wired regression gates into CI, and used the results to decide whether to ship. 

•      Running models in production economically: caching, routing, batching, and choosing the right model for each task. 

•      Designing around interfaces, so a model vendor, cloud or database can be swapped without a rewrite. 

Engineering depth•      Expert TypeScript across the stack: Node. js on the server and React in the browser. 

•      Production depth in at least one of Go, Rust or Python. 

•      Designing and running systems on AWS or Azure, with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi). 

•      PostgreSQL: data modelling, query performance and row-level security. 

•      Durable workflow engines and queues in production (e. g. Temporal, Inngest, Step Functions, Celery). 

•      Security engineering for sensitive personal data: threat modelling, access control, encryption, secrets handling and audit logging. 

•      Observability and incident response: tracing, metrics, alerting and post-mortems. 

•      Automated testing as a habit, including tests of behaviour that depends on a model. 

•      Heavy daily use of AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). You set the team's standard for reviewing what they produce. 

Nice to Have•      Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. 

•      A previous founder, co-founder or CTO role at a startup. 

•      Research agents that search the web and cite sources; browser automation or voice agents; MCP servers you have built. 

•      Document processing: OCR and pulling data from scans and PDFs. 

•      Compliance work such as SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR. 

•      Products in high-stakes, regulated areas such as legal, financial, government or healthcare paperwork. 

•      Public repos, technical writing, talks or open-source work on agent systems. This will make your application stand out. 

What We Look For Beyond Code•      A founder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, owns outcomes, and cares about the people using the product. They are going through a hard time, so every screen, message and automated action matters. 

•      "Evidence before claims": when you say something works, you show the test, the log or the screenshot. 

•      A clear technical communicator: you can explain a trade-off to non-technical founders in plain words, and write a design doc engineers can build from. 

•      Excellent written and spoken English. You are comfortable on video: a daily stand-up with cameras on, plus short recorded video updates. 

•      A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and your own laptop (32 GB RAM preferred, disk encryption on). 

Working HoursThe founders are in San Francisco, and the wider team works across time zones. You should be open to any of these patterns (India time), agreed with the founders: 

•      9: 30 a. m. - 6: 30 p. m. 

•      2: 30 p. m. - 11: 30 p. m. 

•      8: 00 a. m. - 5: 00 p. m. 

Engagement Details•      Full-time, long-term engagement through Metric Tree Labs, working only with this client as part of its core team. 

•      Target start: as early as possible. The joining date is agreed on selection. 

•      Senior, competitive compensation, reviewed after six months.

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Team

Financial Integrity team at Rippling is on a mission to safeguard the integrity of every financial transaction across Rippling products. We operate at the intersection of finance and engineering, ensuring that all money movements across Rippling are accurate, compliant and reliable. 

The team is structured into four key focus areas: 

- Financial Crime Compliance - Ensure all Rippling financial products meet regulatory requirements across jurisdictions, maintaining strict adherence to government regulations. 
 - Credit Risk - Actively identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to fraud activities, credit exposure and financial anomalies across critical products like Payroll , EOR, COR and Spend, etc. 
 - KYC & Onboarding - Deliver a secure and seamless onboarding experience through strong KYC (Know Your Customer/Business) compliance and automation, ensuring only verified and trustworthy entities enter our ecosystem. 
 - Financial Integration Platform - Build and scale a robust integration platform that connects financial systems, internal products and external partners, enabling secure data exchange, streamlined operations and faster product expansion. 

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity for an exceptional engineering leader to build, scale and lead a high-performing team at the heart of Finance, Risk, Compliance and KYC. You will set the technical vision, drive execution and take ownership of mission-critical systems that demand uncompromising reliability, scalability and accuracy. Beyond delivering features, you will shape strategy, develop strong engineers, influence product direction and solve complex problems with measurable business impact. 

About The Role

Join Rippling as the Engineering Manager for the Financial Integrity team and shape the future of our financial platform architecture. In this high-visibility, high-impact leadership role, you will bring a founder's mindset to build and scale a world-class engineering team responsible for the mission-critical systems that power Rippling's growth. 

You will operate at the intersection of complex distributed systems and core financial strategy-balancing big-picture vision with hands-on execution. If you thrive on deep ownership, technical rigor, and developing high-performing engineers, this is your opportunity to define the foundation of financial integrity at scale. 

What You'll Do

- Lead & Empower: Build, mentor, and inspire a team of passionate engineers known for taking ownership and driving end-to-end impact. 
 - Architect & Execute: Stay hands-on with technical design, code reviews, and system architecture to ensure the delivery of resilient, complex distributed systems. 
 - Act Like an Owner: Bring a founder's mindset to challenge conventional approaches, identify growth opportunities, and define the technical roadmap across Risk and Compliance in close partnership with Product and Business leadership. 
 - Raise the Engineering Bar: Enforce engineering best practices, foster a high-performance culture of accountability, and champion automated solutions that boost operational efficiency. 
 - Scale for Growth: Build scalable systems and team structures that enable the organization to grow smoothly alongside expanding business demands. 

What you will need

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who has a strong technical-foundation, thrives in high-ownership environments and . Key expectations from the role include: 

- Technical Foundation: Candidate should have deep technical hands-on experience and sound understanding of tech and be able to guide and review effectively. 
 - Team development skills: Ability to set a roadmap and goals for a team and every one of its members, delegate intelligently, offer engineering advice, deliver frequent and transparent feedback, work with team members to grow in their careers and ensure everyone delivers quality results
 - Product Development Experience: Hands-on experience building scalable products end-to-end. Should have been closely involved in defining and delivering both small and large-scale projects. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, both within India and globally. Strong collaboration and coordination skills are essential. 
 - Execution-Driven: Should be execution-oriented with a clear understanding of how to set up roadmaps, define milestones, and drive outcomes. 
 - Experience Range: Minimum of 2-3 years in a managerial role and prior experience of 7-8 years as an Individual Contributor. Must have experience leading engineering teams and mentoring engineering with total experience of 8-12 years.

Expect to turn broad engineering needs into technical strategy, lead initiatives that span several teams, and set standards that get adopted beyond your own pod. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Data, ML, and Infrastructure to balance delivery speed against reliability, security, cost, and maintainability. As Hinge Health expands its use of AI across the software development lifecycle and the care platform, you will also help make those AI and ML workloads reliable, cost efficient, and responsibly run. 

The problems in this role are foundational. Fixing them makes every engineering team at Hinge Health more effective, and the software they ship helps make healthcare more accessible and affordable. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Own a multi-quarter technical roadmap for one or more Service Enablement domains, based on what internal engineering teams actually need. 
 - Lead architecture and design for highly available, secure, and maintainable platforms and services that cross pod boundaries. 
 - Build and maintain paved roads for service development, deployment, observability, reliability, and operational ownership. 
 - Improve developer productivity with automation, reusable frameworks, self-service workflows, and documentation that people can follow. 
 - Set practical standards for SLOs, alerting, incident response, capacity management, service ownership, and production readiness. 
 - Work with product and engineering teams to run AI and ML workloads reliably and cost efficiently, including inference systems where they make sense. 
 - De-risk ambiguous problems with prototypes, spikes, and experiments that produce measurable results. 
 - Write and lead RFCs, design reviews, and technical decision records. Explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Take part in production operations and eliminate recurring failure modes with systemic fixes. 
 - Deliver large initiatives from strategy through production adoption, and measure the result: platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, cost, or reduced operational toil. 
 - Mentor engineers, coach senior engineers into broader technical leadership, help with hiring, and raise the bar for engineering practice across the organization. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8: 30 pm - 10: 30pm IST). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
 - 10+ years of professional software development, or equivalent depth building and operating production systems. 
 - 4+ years with at least one modern programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python. 
 - 4+ years across the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations. 
 - 4+years of experience in cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads such as AWS, Kubernetes, or EKS. 
 - Experience in software design and distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, performance, failure modes, and API or platform contracts. 
 - Experience operating production systems, including observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement. 
 - Experience treating internal platforms and developer experience as products, with attention to usability, adoption, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, Claude etc

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building internal developer platforms, service templates, golden paths, CI/CD systems, or self-service infrastructure. 
 - Experience with platform security, identity and access management, compliance controls, or secure-by-default engineering. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML teams with inference infrastructure, model serving platforms, evaluation workflows, or cost and performance optimization. 
 - Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, workflow orchestration, service networking, or large-scale data and messaging infrastructure. 
 - Experience defining platform metrics such as adoption, deployment lead time, change failure rate, availability, developer satisfaction, or operational toil. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers or acting as technical lead for a platform migration, modernization effort, or organization-wide launch. 
 - Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare - starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care - from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation - through personalized, evidence-based care. 

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2, 550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http: //www. hingehealth. com/

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth. com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth. com.

data.title: Design Verification - Technical Leader
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. 
 - Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. 
 - Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. 
 - Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e. g. , I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. 
 - Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e. g. , JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. 
 - Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. 
 - Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. 
 - Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. 
 - Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. 
 - Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. 
 - Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 
 - 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. 
 - Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology - testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. 
 - Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. 
 - Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e. g. , JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. 
 - Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA, MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. 
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. 
 - Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. 
 - Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. 
 - Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. 
 - Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. 

Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. 

What We Offer

- A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. 
 - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. 
 - Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. 
 - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. 
 - Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. 

Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For

Be great fun to work with. 

At AWS, we have a credo of "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact. 

Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers. 

You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS. 

Key job responsibilities

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
 - Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
 - Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
 - Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc. 
 - Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
 - Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
 - Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally

A day in the life

- Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
 - Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
 - Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
 - Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities

About The Team

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner. 

The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Staff Reltio Architect, you will serve as the principal technical authority for our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) ecosystem. You will lead the architectural design, configuration, and integration of the cloud-native Reltio Connected Data Platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex business data needs and cutting-edge cloud architecture, ensuring high-performance entity resolution, robust data governance, and seamless real-time data streaming. 

Job Description

You will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction and architecture of our cutting-edge enterprise master data and healthcare data platform solutions. You will be responsible for designing and guiding the implementation of complex, cloud-native master data management (MDM) systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across various platforms. 

Responsibilities: **

- Lead the architectural design and development of enterprise MDM solutions, translating complex healthcare data requirements into robust and scalable technical designs using the Reltio Connected Data Platform. 
 - Define and enforce best practices for API Development, ensuring seamless real-time data integration, streaming, and interoperability across downstream and upstream healthcare systems. 
 - Architect and optimize MDM solutions leveraging Cloud Technology, aligning multi-tenant SaaS capabilities with organizational considerations for cost, security, compliance, and performance. 
 - Provide expert guidance in Computer Programming and Databasing, selecting appropriate graph database concepts, NoSQL stores, and data structures to optimize Reltio L1/L2/L3 configurations. 
 - Drive the adoption of DevOps principles and practices, fostering continuous integration, deployment, and automated configuration management (JSON/UI) across tenant environments. 
 - Design and implement solutions incorporating Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture, ensuring real-time data syndication and golden-record lookup capability for connected medical devices. 
 - Contribute to Full Stack Development efforts, ensuring architectural coherence from data-layer crosswalks and survivorship strategies to backend integrations and customer-facing UI/data steward consoles. 
 - Integrate Machine Learning (ML) capabilities into software products, utilizing advanced probabilistic matching, anomaly detection, and automated entity resolution. 
 - Design and evolve Microservices Architecture, promoting modularity, resilience, and independent deployability of data connectors and event-driven data streaming pipelines. 
 - Ensure adherence to Network Protocols and stringent healthcare security standards (including HIPAA, HITRUST, and data encryption) in all software designs. 
 - Champion Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, promoting clean, maintainable, and extensible codebases for custom integration wrappers and data handlers. 
 - Oversee Performance Testing strategies and execution, ensuring high-throughput batch loading and low-latency API response times meet stringent performance requirements. 
 - Lead Software Design Architecture reviews, mentoring and guiding data engineering and MDM development teams on match/merge and survivorship logic. 
 - Provide technical leadership and oversight in Software Project Management, ensuring successful delivery of enterprise data-domain and architectural initiatives. 

Qualifications: **

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software development, with at least 3 years in a lead architect role specifically focused on master data management (MDM) platforms. 
 - Proven expertise in API Development and designing robust REST APIs and event-driven architectures (e. g. , Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Extensive experience with Cloud Technology (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native architectures; direct experience with the Reltio SaaS environment is highly preferred. 
 - Strong proficiency in various Computer Programming languages and paradigms (e. g. , Java, Python). 
 - Deep understanding of Databasing technologies, including graph databases, document stores, relational systems, and cloud data warehouses like Snowflake or Databricks. 
 - Solid experience implementing DevOps practices, automated tenant deployments, and CI/CD tools. 
 - Familiarity with Edge Computing and Embedded Systems Architecture principles as they relate to real-time distributed data consumption. 
 - Proficiency in Full Stack Development concepts, including data modeling, pipeline architecture, and front-end interface adjustments (JSON configuration). 
 - Experience with Machine Learning (ML) integration, matching algorithms, and automated data curation deployment. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in Microservices Architecture design and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of Network Protocols, secure data transmission, and distributed systems. 
 - Mastery of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. 
 - Experience with Performance Testing methodologies, API load testing, and volume data optimization. 
 - Exceptional skills in Software Design Architecture, data modeling, pattern recognition, and entity resolution framework design. 
 - Proven ability in Software Project Management and leading technical initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with data stewards, product managers, and executive stakeholders. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of your career building and verifying silicon that actually ships, not just passes simulation. You know that verification is where the real complexity lives, where assumptions break, and where a good engineer becomes a great one by catching the corner case no one thought to write down. Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about building engineers who think critically, ask the right questions, and take ownership of the hard problems. 

You have been in the room when a design looked perfect on paper but fell apart under real stimulus. That experience taught you to build verification environments that stress the design in ways the architect did not anticipate. Mentorship matters to you because you remember the engineers who shaped how you think, and you want to do that for others. 

Managing multiple projects does not overwhelm you because you have learned to prioritize what matters, push back when timelines do not match reality, and keep your team focused on the work that moves the needle. You are technical enough to review a testbench architecture and organizational enough to keep three projects on track without losing sight of the people doing the work. 

At Synopsys, you will lead verification for complex ASIC designs that power the products our customers build, and you will do it with a team that values depth, rigor, and getting it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of design and verification engineers in Noida, managing performance, growth, and day-to-day execution across multiple ASIC projects
 - Own the verification strategy and environment architecture for complex, high-speed protocol designs, defining testplans and coverage models that catch real issues
 - Drive technical decisions around verification flows, including SystemVerilog, UVM, behavioral modeling, and coverage-driven verification
 - Work directly with architects, RTL designers, and VIP teams to align on design intent, resolve ambiguities, and ensure functional correctness before tapeout
 - Identify design gaps and propose corrective actions when documented functionality does not match implementation or customer requirements
 - Reproduce and resolve customer-reported issues through deep technical analysis, working backward from symptoms to root cause
 - Continuously improve verification methodologies, tooling, and execution efficiency across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver functionally correct, high-performance silicon designs that ship to customers and power next-generation products
 - Build a team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and solve hard problems without waiting for perfect direction
 - Reduce time-to-market by catching design issues early through rigorous verification and well-architected testbenches
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, architecture, and verification, ensuring alignment and reducing late-stage surprises
 - Influence verification best practices across Synopsys, shaping how teams approach coverage, automation, and testbench design
 - Resolve customer issues faster and more thoroughly, building trust and long-term partnerships
 - Set the technical bar for what great verification looks like, raising the standard across projects and teams

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC design and verification, with deep expertise in high-speed protocols and complex digital systems
 - Strong proficiency in Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog for RTL design and verification
 - Proven experience building UVM-based verification environments, including testbench architecture, coverage analysis, and constraint-driven stimulus
 - Solid scripting skills in BASH, TCSH, PERL, PYTHON, or TCL for automation, flow development, and productivity tooling
 - Track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, balancing technical leadership with people development
 - Experience working through ambiguous requirements, incomplete specs, or shifting priorities without losing momentum

Who You Are

- You can review a verification plan and immediately spot what is missing, whether it is a corner case, a coverage gap, or an unrealistic timeline
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that checks a box during a review cycle
 - You are comfortable saying no when a project plan does not match reality, and you can explain why in a way that moves the conversation forward
 - You manage multiple projects without losing track of the details that matter, knowing when to dive deep and when to trust your team
 - You write and communicate clearly in English, whether it is a technical document, a status update, or a difficult conversation with a stakeholder
 - You adapt quickly when priorities shift, helping your team stay focused on what matters most without creating chaos

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

As a Design Manager - Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems. 

You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery-from concept through detailed and construction design. 

Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams. 

Key duties include

- Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems. 
 - Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation. 
 - Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables
 - Equipment sizing & selection
 - Mechanical design calculations
 - Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
 - P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
 - Mechanical data sheets and specifications
 - Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design. 
 - Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‐Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements. 
 - Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews. 
 - Manage and own key design management documents
 - Project Responsibility Matrix
 - Basis of Design
 - Overall Design Programme
 - Schedule of Deliverables
 - Design Risk Register
 - Design Change Register

 - Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling. 
 - Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability. 
 - Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation. 

We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects. 

Here's what you'll need

Key software tools

- PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
 - Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
 - Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
