data.title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
data.description:
About This Role

Business Overview

The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock's fiduciary and enterprise risks. RQA's principal objectives are to advance the firm's risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes. 

RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders. We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose. 

Role Description

The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i. e. BlackRock, Inc. , or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team's focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements. 

The AI Validation Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office. 

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage. 
 - Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards. 
 - Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses. 
 - Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use. 
 - Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases. 
 - Execute functional and performance tests. 
 - Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios. 
 - Document validation findings, provide recommendations 
 - Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments. 
 - Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees 
 - Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness. 

Experience, Skills And Qualification

- With 3-7 years' works experience in the IT or financial industry. 
 - Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field. 
 - Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures. 
 - Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar). 
 - Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively. 
 - Experience with one or more of the following: 
 - Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
 - Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
 - AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
 - AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
 - Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment 
 - MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
 - Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
 - Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
 - Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

data.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

-Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Company: WillWare Technologies

Role: Senior DevOps Engineer - SDLC

Experience: 9-15 Years

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Noida, Mumbai, Kolkata, Gurugram

Work Mode: Hybrid

Job Description

Qualifications & Experience

- Significant experience in software engineering or DevOps roles, with a focus on SDLC tooling and automation in enterprise environments. 
 - Knowledge and experience with SDLC tooling such as source control (e. g. , Git), CI/CD platforms (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), artifact repositories, and deployment automation. 
 - Proven ability to implement and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines. Experience integrating tools for code quality, security scanning, and release orchestration. 
 - Solid understanding of software development practices, version control strategies, branching models, and configuration management principles. 
 - Familiarity with software lifecycle processes and best practices for continuous integration and delivery in complex environments. 
 - Experience with monitoring SDLC tools, analysing performance metrics, and driving improvements to reliability and efficiency. 
 - Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, security, and operations. Skilled in translating technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance. 
 - Strong capability to troubleshoot issues within SDLC pipelines and tooling, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Knowledge of secure development practices and compliance requirements within the SDLC ecosystem. 
 - Commitment to staying current with emerging technologies, DevOps practices, and industry trends to enhance the SDLC ecosystem. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps / Platform Engineering roles, with a focus on SDLC tooling and automation in enterprise environments
 - Strong hands-on expertise with: 
 - GitHub Enterprise (Admin-level)
 - GitHub Actions (workflow design, reusable actions, security)
 - Self-hosted GitHub Runners (preferably on Kubernetes)
 - GitHub Org RBAC
 - GitHub Teams and Repository automation
 - JFrog Artifactory administration and automation
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD principles, branching models, and SDLC methodologies. 
 - Experience developing reusable workflow templates, shared actions, and automation frameworks. 
 - Experience optimising large enterprise CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Solid experience with Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE), Docker, and container orchestration. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell). 
 - Experience with IaC tools (Terraform, Helm, Kustomize). 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps tools-secret management, code scanning, dependency scanning, etc. 
 - Experience with Jira Software: workflow schemes, screens, issue type hierarchies/epics, custom fields, permission & notification schemes, automation rules. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP). 
 - Familiarity with software lifecycle processes and best practices for continuous integration and delivery in complex environments. 
 - Strong capability to troubleshoot issues within SDLC pipelines and tooling, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions. 

Nice to Have

Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to elevate your software engineering career. 

As a Software Engineer III - AI Automation Test Engineer at JPMorgan Chase, you will be an integral part of the Consumer & Community Banking. Collaborating with experienced engineers, managers, and business teams, you will contribute to building digital products and services utilized by our engineering partners across the organization. Your role as a test engineering expert will involve enhancing and scaling test automation frameworks, championing modern test engineering practices, and driving automation coverage throughout the development lifecycle. 

Job Responsibilities

- Review requirements, specifications, and technical design documents; provide timely, meaningful feedback. 
 - Create comprehensive, well-structured test plans/cases; analyze and develop complex test data sets. 
 - Design, develop, and implement automation scripts, automated tests, and test environments. 
 - Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities, including test scenarios and acceptance tests. 
 - Develop test infrastructure tools across multiple platforms (web, mobile, desktop). 
 - Partner with developers, program managers, and design teams on technical implementation and user scenarios; identify/eliminate or automate recurring issues to improve operational stability. 
 - Collaborate with deployment teams to troubleshoot and resolve system issues. 
 - Monitor and improve testing effectiveness across the SDLC using insights from all stages. 
 - Automate and maintain in-sprint and regression suites (Java/Cucumber/Selenium, API automation via Java/Rest Assured) and drive UAT automation within front-end frameworks as the tooling point of contact. 
 - Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e. g. , code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. 
 - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts with applied experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, and developing business-driven development automated frameworks using Cucumber, including writing feature files (Gherkin) and step definitions from scratch. 
 - Experience in designing and developing UI automated scripts (Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright) and API (REST and SOAP) automated frameworks (RestAssured, SOAP UI), including data mocking and stubbing (Mockito). 
 - Experience in designing and developing performance testing frameworks (Blazemeter, Apache JMeter). 
 - Experience in developing mobile automated testing frameworks (Appium). 
 - Proficient in tools such as Gradle, Maven, Git, Bitbucket, JIRA, Confluence, qTest, JMeter/Load Runner. 
 - Experience in setting up, configuring, and running automated tests in parallel across different environments/browsers/mobile (Saucelabs Mobile and Web Integration, Selenium Grid). 
 - Experience in automating desktop applications (UiPath, Blue Prism, Ranorex). 
 - Experience working in a scrum team Agile setting, writing and documenting test cases/scenarios, test execution, defect reporting, and supporting production validation testing. 
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Hands-on experience using AI tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot and similar) to accelerate development and maintenance of test automation suites. 
 - Experience with automated and scheduled deployments via CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins Pipelines) across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure). 
 - Proficient in at least one object-oriented language and SQL; working knowledge of accessibility, security, and resiliency testing. 

ABOUT US

Aboud Gartner Information Security: 

Gartner Information Security enables the business to move quickly and confidently by protecting our people, data, and ideas. We are a global team of defenders, investigators, engineers, and lifelong learners who solve complex security challenges together. 

You will join an inclusive, security-first culture where expertise is shared, thoughtful challenge is encouraged, and strong ideas can come from anyone. If you are curious, practical, and motivated to strengthen the security posture of a global organization, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact here. 

About the role: 

We are seeking an experienced Lead Security Engineer specializing in Privileged Access Management (PAM) to join our Identity Management team. In this mission-critical role, you will provide technical leadership for the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise PAM capabilities that secure privileged access across on-premises infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and multi-cloud environments. 

You will be responsible for defining technical strategy, driving architectural decisions, and leading the delivery of PAM initiatives that reduce organizational risk while enabling business agility. In addition to hands-on engineering responsibilities, you will mentor team members, establish engineering standards, and drive execution of complex security projects from inception through operationalization. 

What you'll do: 

- Provide technical leadership for the IAM PAM engineering function, driving architecture, engineering standards, and operational excellence across privileged access solutions. 
 - Engage with technology leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to drive the delivery of secure, scalable, and resilient solutions, ensuring critical systems are protected and aligned with organizational objectives. 
 - Lead the design, implementation, and operationalization of privileged access management solutions, including enterprise vaults, secrets management, privileged session management, privileged endpoint controls, and Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) workflows. 
 - Work within an agile environment to define requirements, prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and ensure successful delivery of PAM capabilities. 
 - Develop and oversee automation, integrations, and self-service capabilities that improve security posture and operational efficiency. 
 - Troubleshoot complex PAM issues and serve as a technical escalation point, providing guidance to engineers, stakeholders, and partner teams. 
 - Analyze enterprise privileged access use cases and develop detailed technical requirements, governance frameworks, and operational support models. 
 - Drive adoption of security-by-design principles across cloud, infrastructure, and application platforms. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers by providing technical coaching, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and guidance on engineering best practices. 
 - Ensure the reliability and availability of mission-critical IAM systems and participate in the IAM On-Call rotation. 
 - Define, track, and communicate PAM metrics and key performance indicators to demonstrate risk reduction, operational maturity, and program effectiveness. 

What you'll need: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 
 - 6 to 8 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and cybersecurity, including six or more years of experience implementing and operating enterprise PAM platforms such as CyberArk or similar solutions. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of enterprise-scale PAM programs and complex security initiatives. 
 - Experience working with fast-paced operations and development teams; experience with DevOps practices is required. 
 - Knowledge of information security technologies, regulations, controls, and industry standards. 

Must have: 

- Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM platforms, including credential vaulting, privileged session management, secrets management, and privileged access governance. 
 - Experience with Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), Just-in-Time (JIT), and other modern privileged access management controls. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud IAM and PAM capabilities and familiarity with IaaS and PaaS architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP, and other enterprise cloud platforms. 
 - Experience developing automation and integrations using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies. 
 - Ability to build and deploy automation on cloud platforms, with familiarity in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. 
 - Working knowledge of IAM services, LDAP, Active Directory, single sign-on (SSO), and federation protocols. 
 - Working knowledge of PKI fundamentals, certificate lifecycle management, and secrets management best practices. 
 - Experience defining technical requirements, engineering standards, governance models, and operational support processes. 
 - Proven ability to lead complex technical projects from solution design through implementation and operationalization. 

Nice to have: 

- Familiarity with AI Agent Identity security concepts, including credential governance, delegated authorization, runtime access controls, and lifecycle management for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems. 
 - Experience securing non-human identities, including service accounts, workloads, APIs, automation platforms, and AI agents within enterprise PAM and Identity Security programs. 
 - Knowledge of machine identity authentication frameworks and standards, including SPIFFE/SPIRE and Zero Trust concepts. 
 - Relevant industry certifications such as CyberArk Defender/Sentry, CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent credentials. 
 - Experience working in highly regulated environments with stringent compliance, audit, and security requirements. 

Who you are: 

- A lifelong learner with a desire for continuous personal and professional development. 
 - Someone with proven communication, collaboration, and critical thinking skills. 
 - Able to build trusting, meaningful relationships with peers, stakeholders, partners, and suppliers. 
 - Capable of defining and communicating risk in a business-relevant language to both non-technical and technical audiences, including Leadership teams. 
 - Someone who can apply expert knowledge to solve complex business/technical issues.

data.description:
Project Role : Quality Engineer

Project Role Description : Enables full stack solutions through multi-disciplinary team planning and ecosystem integration to accelerate delivery and drive quality across the application lifecycle. Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end-to-end testing process. 

Must have skills : Java Full Stack Development

Good to have skills : Spring Boot

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who leads from the trenches - writing production-grade code daily while simultaneously driving team delivery and technical strategy. This is not a purely supervisory role. You will be an active contributor to Java Spring Boot backend services, React frontends, and API development, while managing a team of engineers and owning end-to-end delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who has grown into leadership without stepping away from the keyboard. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Technical Contribution

Independently design, develop, and ship full stack features using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React (frontend) with minimal direction. 

Architect and build RESTful APIs and microservices from scratch, owning the full lifecycle from design through deployment. 

Write complex Oracle SQL queries, manage schema design, performance tuning, and indexing strategies directly. 

Personally contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization, and OpenShift deployment - not just review others' work. 

Debug, optimize, and refactor production code to meet performance and scalability standards. 

Actively use and champion AI development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) as a daily part of your own engineering workflow. 

Technical Leadership

Set architectural direction and make independent technical decisions on system design, API contracts, and data modeling. 

Conduct meaningful code reviews rooted in your own current coding experience, not just managerial instinct. 

Define and enforce engineering standards, security practices, and documentation expectations across the team. 

Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, or patterns based on direct hands-on assessment. 

Team Management & Delivery: 

Lead a team of engineers through agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and delivery milestones while remaining a committed coder yourself. 

Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code walkthroughs, and real-time technical coaching. 

Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions - and then build them yourself. 

Manage delivery risk, technical debt, and cross-team dependencies without delegating your own engineering accountability. 

Required Qualifications: 

7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience. 

Currently active and proficient in Java Full Stack Development - you write Spring Boot and React code regularly, not just in the past. 

Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns. 

Strong Oracle Database and SQL skills - query writing, performance tuning, indexing, and data modeling done independently. 

Direct experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and containerized deployments. 

Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments with minimal oversight. 

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (15 years full-time education preferred). 

Preferred Qualifications: 

OpenShift or Kubernetes hands-on deployment experience. 

Experience with API security (OAuth2, JWT) and cloud-native design patterns. 

Prior experience as a senior individual contributor who transitioned into a working management role.

data.title: Software Development Manager ,  Supply Chain Services
data.description:
Description

Merchants should be able to use Amazon's fulfillment capabilities wherever they sell. Making that possible requires software that connects sales channels with fulfillment services, simplifies complex supply chain workflows, and gives merchants visibility into what happens after an order is placed. 

Amazon's Multi-Channel Commerce and Fulfillment team is looking for a Software Development Manager in Hyderabad to lead an engineering team building these capabilities. Our work helps merchants access Amazon's supply chain services beyond the Amazon marketplace and manage their businesses through connected, intuitive experiences. 

In this role, you will own the technical direction and delivery of a

product and services portfolio, from merchant-facing workflows to the distributed systems behind them. You will partner with product managers and engineering teams across Amazon to translate customer problems into a focused roadmap, make architectural decisions, and deliver reliable software. The technical challenges include coordinating workflows across independently owned services, maintaining consistent order and shipment state, and making complex integrations easier for merchants to use. 

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can develop engineers, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, and balance delivery speed with long-term system health. You will have end-to-end accountability for your team's software and its customer outcomes, including architecture, execution and production operations. 

Key job responsibilities

Set technical direction: Own your team's architecture and engineering roadmap, making explicit tradeoffs across customer value, reliability, delivery timelines and operational cost. 

Deliver customer outcomes: Partner with product and program leaders to turn merchant needs into well-scoped initiatives with measurable success criteria. 

Build dependable systems: Lead the design and delivery of distributed services and customer experiences that integrate with Amazon's fulfillment and supply chain platforms. 

Develop the team: Hire and coach engineers, provide actionable feedback, and create opportunities for technical growth and increasing ownership. 

Own operational performance: Establish metrics for service health and customer experience, strengthen testing and observability, and address recurring defects at their source. 

Lead across team boundaries: Align partner teams on interfaces and dependencies, resolve technical disagreements, and communicate decisions and risks clearly to leadership. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.description:
About The Role

About the Team Uber's Merchant team helps restaurants build successful businesses on Uber Eats. This mission spans the entire merchant lifecycle, from onboarding to getting and fulfilling orders. 

The Merchant Fulfillment organization is the operational backbone of this mission. We own the critical "Order Lifecycle" technologies that ensure millions of orders are received, processed, and fulfilled reliably every day. We are also the guardians of the merchant's financial health, managing the complex workflows for disputes, cancellations, and operational reliability. 

About the Role As a Senior Engineering Manager for Merchant Fulfillment in India, you will lead a geographically distributed team of 50+ Engineers and Engineering Managers. You will be responsible for delivering business-critical projects and platforms that merchants and restaurants rely on to run their daily operations. 

This is a high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly impact merchant experience, sentiment and the operational trust of our merchant partners globally. You will partner with Product, Ops, and Design leaders in India and the US to define the strategy for how Uber Eats fulfills orders at scale. 

What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points

- What the Candidate Will Do

Lead at Scale: Manage and mentor a high-performing org of ~50 engineers and managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, operational rigor, and customer empathy. 

Drive Reliability: Own the "Uber Eats Orders" (UEO) tablet experience and the underlying reliability systems that ensure 99. 99% uptime for order injection and processing. 

Solve Complex Disputes: Build intelligent, automated platforms for Chargebacks, Cancellations, and Disputes, reducing financial losses for merchants and Uber while improving fairness. 

Unlock New Growth: Lead the BYOC (Bring Your Own Courier) charter, building the "To-Go" and courier onboarding tech that allows merchants to fulfill orders with their own fleets. 

Operational Efficiency: own the "Defect Reduction" mandate, using technology to predict and prevent order failures before they happen. 

- Basic Qualifications

Experience: 12+ years of engineering experience with 6+ years in people management, ideally leading managers and larger organizations (50+). 

Technical Depth: Strong background in building high-scale, distributed systems. You can dive deep into architecture discussions on reliability, eventual consistency, and real-time data processing. 

Strategic Vision: Ability to translate complex business goals (e. g. , "Reduce Partner Avoidable Failures") into a concrete technical roadmap. 

Customer Obsession: A passion for solving real-world operational problems. You understand that a "bug" in our system means a lost dinner for a customer and lost revenue for a small business. 

Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global setup, influencing stakeholders across time zones and functions to drive consensus. 

- Preferred Qualifications

Frontend Depth: Deep familiarity with modern frontend ecosystems (React, Next. js, Micro-frontends) and mobile platforms (React Native).

This isn't just about writing code; it's about setting the technical direction for an entire organization in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment. You will need to move the needle for the business by building systems that are not only highly available and reliable but also developer-friendly, enabling rapid innovation across ML and Product teams. data.description:
About The Role And Team

FinTech is part of the CFO's organization and is responsible for innovating and building Financial Products & Systems. Our DNA is customer obsession, high-quality products, teamwork, and transparency. We provide systems for compliance, data reliability, and audit, ensuring timely availability of business-critical data. 

This Role Has Two Halves, Split Roughly Evenly

- Automation delivery (~50%) : lead a 15-20-member external vendor team that builds and supports our RPA (robotic process automation) bots. 
 - System controls & SaaS security (~50%) : keep our financial systems, including cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, Coupa, etc secure, well-controlled, and SOX-compliant. 

The two halves belong together. Automation is how we turn manual controls into automated, continuous ones. Strong controls are what make our bots safe to run on financial systems. 

What You'll Do

Lead Automation Delivery

- Manage and mentor a 15-20 person vendor team across development and production support. 
 - Set development standards, review designs, and sign off on solutions before they go live. 
 - Own bot reliability: SLAs, escalations for critical failures, and root-cause fixes so problems don't repeat. 
 - Run the vendor relationship: scope, staffing, performance scorecards, and quarterly reviews. 
 - Choose the right tool for each job. Use an API or native integration where it will outlast a screen-based bot. 
 - Manage the MS Power Automate Platform, deployment pipelines, and licensing. 

SaaS ERP Security & Identity Management

- Design and maintain user roles and access in FinTech applications and cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM Cloud, Coupa), including role-based access (RBAC), so each person has only the access they need. 
 - Find and fix segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflicts, including conflicts that span two apps. 
 - Govern single sign-on, MFA, user provisioning and de-provisioning, access requests, access certifications, and privileged/emergency admin access (PAM). 
 - Track every system and bot account: who owns it, what it can access, and when its credentials rotate. 
 - Work with the IAM team on the integrations, APIs, workflows, rules, and reporting that FinTech applications need. 
 - Review vendor SOC reports and make sure we run the controls each vendor expects from us. 
 - Check each quarterly vendor release for security and control impact before it goes live, and make sure security is built into the development lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Monitor tenant configuration and audit logs for risky changes, and lead efforts to strengthen the overall security of FinTech applications. 

Own SOX & System Controls

- Manage IT general and application controls: user access reviews, change management, SoD, and SDLC. 
 - Act as the main point of contact for SOX audits of FinTech applications, including evidence, walkthroughs, and auditor questions. 
 - Track control deficiencies through to remediation, working with Financial Risk Management. 
 - Partner with the IAM team on access requests, certifications, and role-based access. 

Automate Controls

- Identify manual controls that can be automated, starting with high-risk, repetitive ones, and deliver them through the RPA team. 
 - Explore AI for anomaly detection and continuous control monitoring. 

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience, including 3+ years leading teams of 15 or more. Experience leading external vendor teams is preferred. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Automate (Desktop and Cloud). Exposure to UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism is a plus. 
 - Proven experience with SOX audits, IT controls, and identity & access management . 
 - Hands-on security experience with a cloud ERP . Oracle Fusion is preferred; SAP, Workday, or NetSuite are also considered. 
 - Functional knowledge of Oracle EBS R12 and/or Oracle Fusion Financials . 
 - Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, and scripting (Python or PowerShell). 
 - Clear communication with finance, audit, and technical stakeholders. Able to hold a vendor accountable while keeping the relationship strong. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with SailPoint, Okta, Coupa, Oracle EPM Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud, or access-governance tools. 
 - Experience with an on-premise to cloud ERP migration. 
 - Exposure to AI-driven automation (Copilot Studio, AI Builder, document processing).

Job Purpose

To design system solutions, prepare user document and monitor UAT plan execution, aid in prioritization of projects and UATs and monitoring production issue resolution on a daily basis.

Job Context: To design system solutions, prepare user document and monitor UAT plan execution, aid in prioritization of projects and UATs and monitoring production issue resolution on a daily basis. 

The role is also responsible for designing and documenting the workflow and making appropriate recommendations that will positively impact operational effectiveness. 

Job Challenges:

 - Downloading the business requirement to IT team who lacks the required end to end process expertise. 
 - Downloading the business needs/criticalities to the vendors who lack the required domain expertise to address BSLI system requirements. 
 - Executing multiple projects simultaneously within their defined timelines with various iterations and limited resources. 
 - Aligning the work schedule basis constantly shifting organisational priorities. 
 - Managing user expectations considering the system limitations and process constraints.

- Understand the business needs, and ensure that requirement is accurately documented in requirement template.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

About the Role: 

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer - Senior to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI automation solutions for global clients. This role emphasizes deep hands-on engineering expertise, focusing on optimizing AI systems, improving model performance, and delivering scalable, production-ready AI-enabled automation. 

You will work under architect guidance while owning key solution components, leading small workstreams, and delivering high-impact AI solutions across consulting engagements. The role requires a strong blend of software engineering, applied AI, optimization techniques, and secure development practices. 

The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to independently implement and optimize AI-driven systems, contribute to reusable accelerators, and mentor junior engineers while operating in a client-facing consulting environment. 

Key Responsibilities:

Relevant certifications (preferred):

 - Establish data engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, reliability, versioning, and backward-compatible data product contracts. 
 - Optimize platform, pipeline, and query performance through workload testing, partitioning and clustering, caching, concurrency management, and cost-aware lifecycle practices. 
 - Lead capabilities from POC to production by defining non-functional requirements, resolving engineering risks, integrating with platform services, and enabling operational support and SLA readiness. 
 - Engineer AI-ready data products with trusted, well-governed, semantically enriched data, incorporating context engineering, ontologies, embeddings, vector indexing, and RAG patterns.

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services.

 - Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization. 
 - Proven experience building and operating enterprise Lakehouse and data platforms using Snowflake and Databricks, supporting high-concurrency analytical, near-real-time, and AI-ready workloads. 
 - Strong cloud engineering experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including cloud-native data services, security, networking, infrastructure automation, portability, and cost management. 
 - Working expertise with open data architectures and metadata ecosystems, including Apache Iceberg, schema evolution, table optimization, catalog federation, zero-copy sharing, data virtualization, and multi-engine access. 
 - Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns 
 - Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation). 
 - Expertise in AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot or Claude Code Assistant.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. data.description:
Job Description

As a Lead Cyber Security Architect/Engineer at Honeywell, you will play a critical role in leading the design, development, and implementation of cyber security projects. You will provide technical guidance to the project team while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure a smooth integration of new initiatives. Your expertise will be instrumental in protecting critical assets and information across industries, ensuring the security and resilience of businesses worldwide. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to support project team members
 - Oversee the execution of cybersecurity initiatives and projects
 - Ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope
 - Conduct regular security assessments and risk analyses
 - Identify vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to understand and address security requirements
 - Lead the response to security incidents promptly and decisively
 - Contribute to the creation of security awareness materials for the organization

Qualifications

Lead Cyber Security Architect, Building Automation Product Security

As a Lead Cyber Security Architect here at Honeywell Technologies Building Automation, you will provide expert-level technical leadership in the design and implementation of cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions for our Building Automation group. You will be responsible for fortifying defenses against emerging threats and acting as the subject matter expert for technical challenges. Your work will directly impact on the safety and integrity of systems that ensure the security and resilience of buildings worldwide. Join us at Honeywell Technologies, where cybersecurity meets innovation, and together, we'll build a safer and more secure future!

In this role, you will impact critical cybersecurity initiatives and drive technical excellence within the organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of cybersecurity technology within a company known for its commitment to excellence. Let's shape the future together!

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design and implementation of cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions for building automation systems. 

- Conduct in-depth security assessments and risk analysis to identify vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures into the development lifecycle of products and systems. 
 - Act as a technical mentor, providing guidance and support to junior cybersecurity professionals. 
 - Participate in incident response activities, contributing technical expertise to resolve security incidents promptly. 

YOU MUST HAVE

- 10+ years software development experience required with at-least 2 years in developing secure systems. 
 - Are part of the BA Product Security organization for at least 2 years running. 
 - Product architecture and development background. Secure software development lifecycle experience, understanding of security by design principles and architecture level security concepts. 
 - Experience in security requirements reviews, performing threat modeling, security architecture & design review, secure code review, vulnerability assessment and risk management. 
 - Experience with widely used security tools for security requirements, OSS scanning (BlackDuck Hub), Threat modeling, SAST, DAST, Vulnerability management and monitoring tools. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, frameworks, and best practices
 - Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to facilitate diverse groups, help negotiate priorities, and resolve conflicts among projects stakeholders. Ability to lead direct and indirect reports by influence. 
 - Excellent communication and ability to convey complex technical concepts to stakeholders. 

WE VALUE

- Bachelor's or Advanced Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or another related field. 
 - Up to date knowledge of current and emerging security threats and techniques for exploiting security vulnerabilities. 
 - Understanding of Agile software development practices. 
 - Certifications in security and privacy demonstrating deep practical knowledge such as CSSLP or CISSP will be a differentiator. 
 - Ability to work within a diverse and international teams, develop rapport and trust. 
 - Excellent communication skills. 
 - Self-Driven and motivated to be part of a team with high expectations in terms of Cyber due diligence. 
 - Drive and participate in BA level initiatives, engage with engineering priorities with outcomes that improve the BA PS teams contributions beyond the day-to-day engagements. 

THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell Technologies Building Automation (BA) is a leading global provider of products, software, solutions, and technologies that enable building owners and occupants to ensure their facilities are safe, energy efficient, sustainable, and productive. BA products and services include advanced software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and upgrades of systems. Revenues in 2022 for BA were $6B and there are approximately 18, 000 employees globally. 

Honeywell Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Associate , Physics AI
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge SimcenterTM portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing. 

We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities. 

In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results. 

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results. 
 - Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities. 
 - Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate. 
 - Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment. 

Qualifications

- 4-6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation. 
 - 1-3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products. 
 - Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results. 
 - Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications. 
 - Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data. 
 - Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing. 
 - Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing. 
 - Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer

Position Summary

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation-creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster. 

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX's data platform remains a competitive advantage. 

Is this role for you?

- YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems. 
 - NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture. 

Responsibilities

- Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e. g. , Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level. 
 - Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate. 
 - Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e. g. , specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.

data.title: System Software Manager - Power Profiling and Infrastructure
data.description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, powering breakthroughs in AI, graphics, autonomous vehicles, and scientific simulation. 

Inside NVIDIA, the Software Power Profiling team is the power measurement authority for our most strategic platforms - RTX Spark, DGX Spark, discrete GPU desktop and notebook, and data center. The team measures power and performance-per-watt, qualifies power targets, co-engineers battery life with OEMs, runs nightly regression farms across the device fleet, and builds the profiling infrastructure - frameworks, analytics dashboards, and automated regression farms - that the rest of NVIDIA relies on to understand and optimize power. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead, grow, and mentor a cross-site team of power and infrastructure engineers across Pune and Bangalore - setting individual and team roadmaps, development plans, and clear ownership across all mandates. 
 - Drive the team's power profiling authority across the full product lifecycle: pre-silicon power engagement, power target qualification, regression monitoring, battery-life validation, and external software release qualification - including nightly development-branch and release-branch power and perf/watt monitoring across discrete GPU and data-center platforms. 
 - Own the physical lab - run a temperature-controlled, instrumented measurement lab across two sites, covering DUT fleet management, board procurement, intake and logistics, board instrumentation and rework, DAQ and power-path integrity, rack build-out, and cross-geo capacity planning. 
 - Shape measurability from pre-silicon through production - engage pre-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips. 
 - Close power gaps and own release readiness - quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop. 
 - Lead cross-company power engagement - converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co-engineer shared battery-life targets, conduct joint root-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug-and-analysis stream. 
 - Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance - drive the in-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production-grade shared assets; deliver energy-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off-mode power) required to clear product release gates. 

What we need to see

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of overall industry experience. 
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex software and infrastructure at velocity across distributed teams. 
 - Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power - with hands-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power-stack debugging. 
 - Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab - instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive. 
 - Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle - from pre-silicon power modeling through bring-up, qualification, and post-commercialization sustaining. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions. 

Ways to stand out from the crowd

- Hands-on power profiling experience - DAQ-based external rail capture, on-board sensor validation, or telemetry-driven regression root cause. 
 - Intimate knowledge of Windows on Arm or client SoC platforms - battery-life scenario methodology, Modern Standby measurement, or energy-efficiency regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience leading silicon bring-up power profiling - firmware sensor validation, first-power baselines, and bring-up-phase engagement with hardware teams. 
 - Track record of building or leading power regression infrastructure or automated test/analysis pipelines at scale. 
 - Experience with AI/agentic workflow development applied to lab automation, failure triage, or report generation. 
 - Prior cross-company lab convergence work - aligning methodology, build synchronization, and shared tooling between two or more power or validation labs.

We seek outstanding engineers who are passionate about building amazing teams which at the same time enjoy the exposure to various parts of the system software stack, from bare metal firmware to middleware and application development. 

If you are similarly excited about groundbreaking technologies as we are, and you want to help us forming an amazing team here at Arm, we want to hear from you. 

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will architect and evolve scalable CI/CD and software productization infrastructure for firmware, drivers, and low-level system software. The role drives build, integration, automated testing, packaging, and release automation to enable reliable and efficient software delivery. A key responsibility is enabling continuous delivery by ensuring pipelines remain stable, available, and release-ready at all times. This includes improving pipeline observability, proactively identifying failures, driving rapid recovery, and continuously improving delivery efficiency and developer productivity. The role also involves building automation and test infrastructure, solving hardware-software integration challenges, and providing technical leadership across firmware, system, integration, validation, and infrastructure teams. Responsibilities include developing and reviewing high-quality Python and Bash code, while taking end-to-end ownership from architecture and implementation through deployment and sustained operation. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering with 12+ years of experience in SoC/embedded software development and CI/CD across the semiconductor development lifecycle. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in system firmware development, with proficiency in Embedded C and Python and/or Bash. Solid understanding of Linux, Arm architectures, open-source software development, versioning, licensing, SDL, and software delivery, complemented by strong system-level debugging and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Good experience in architecting and maintaining scalable CI/CD infrastructure for large, multi-component repository structures, build systems, dependency management, variant management, automated testing, packaging, and release automation. 
 - Proven experience enabling continuous software delivery, with a strong focus on pipeline availability, stability, automation, observability, rapid failure recovery, and release readiness!
 - Strong end-to-end technical leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across teams and drive continuous improvement. 

Desirable Skills & Qualities

- Experience with embedded software ecosystems and technologies such as Zephyr, Yocto, Bazel, Copybara, Git, Jenkins, Repo-structures, test automation framework, DevOps, C++, or Rust. 
 - Familiarity with system software and open-source projects such as TF-A, TF-M, U-Boot, Xen, ROS etc!
 - Experience working in automotive, robotics, functional safety, embedded security, or other sophisticated SoC/system domains. 
 - Experience in leading team in CICD is an added advantage. 

If this sounds like you, please don't hesitate to apply. 

Our 10x mindset guides how we engineer, collaborate, and grow. Understand what it means and how to reflect 10x in your work: https: //careers. arm. com/en/10x-mindset

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

About the Role: 

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer - Senior to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI automation solutions for global clients. This role emphasizes deep hands-on engineering expertise, focusing on optimizing AI systems, improving model performance, and delivering scalable, production-ready AI-enabled automation. 

You will work under architect guidance while owning key solution components, leading small workstreams, and delivering high-impact AI solutions across consulting engagements. The role requires a strong blend of software engineering, applied AI, optimization techniques, and secure development practices. 

The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to independently implement and optimize AI-driven systems, contribute to reusable accelerators, and mentor junior engineers while operating in a client-facing consulting environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and optimize AI-driven automation solutions using LLMs, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms. 
 - Own and deliver end-to-end implementation of solution components, including integration into enterprise systems and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Develop and enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, re-ranking, and embeddings optimization. 
 - Implement and optimize fine-tuning strategies, including dataset preparation, prompt tuning, and model evaluation workflows. 
 - Build and productionize agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents.

 - Contribute to AI harness frameworks, reusable accelerators, and enterprise AI development standards.

 - Mentor and review work of junior AI Automation Engineers, ensuring engineering quality and best practices. 
 - Collaborate closely with architects to translate high-level designs into scalable implementations. 
 - Ensure adherence to secure coding, DevSecOps, and AI security best practices.

 - API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management, secure SDLC

 - Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, adversarial testing
