 - Cloud Platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP
 - AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
 - Vector Databases: Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search, Weaviate, or equivalent
 - Observability & Evaluation: LangSmith, PromptLayer, Azure Monitor, or equivalent tools
 - DevOps & CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar
 - Prototyping Tools: Replit, notebooks, rapid experimentation frameworks
 - Core Concepts: RAG optimization, prompt engineering, embeddings, model fine-tuning (LoRA/basic), evaluation frameworks, agentic workflows

Soft Skills and Attributes: 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
 - Ability to lead small teams and guide junior engineers
 - Effective communication and client interaction skills
 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments
 - Strong ownership mindset and focus on delivery excellence

Performance Expectations / KPIs: 

- Improvement in model performance metrics (accuracy, relevance, hallucination reduction)
 - Optimization of inference cost and latency
 - Number and impact of AI automation use cases delivered
 - Contribution to reusable assets, frameworks, and accelerators
 - Quality of mentoring and team capability uplift

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
 - 4-8 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or automation engineering
 - Strong hands-on experience in implementing and optimizing AI/LLM-based solutions
 - Experience working in client-facing consulting environments

Relevant certifications (preferred): 

- Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate
 - AWS Machine Learning Specialty
 - Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

What We Offer: 

- Opportunity to work on advanced AI engineering and optimization use cases
 - Exposure to global clients and large-scale enterprise AI transformations

 - Collaborative environment with strong focus on engineering excellence and growth

 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality for assigned modules/features and ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases.

data.title: Software Engineer Principal
data.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. 

As senior / Lead developer on innovation team will design and build Microservices, MCP

servers, and productize agentic AI capabilities that empower existing development teams across Life cycle collaboration products. You will create reusable frameworks, SDKs, policies, and integrations that enable secure, reliable, and measurable code generation, autonomous workflows, and retrieval-augmented solutions. Design, develop, modify, and implement software programming for products (both internal and external) with focus on surpassing customer expectations, on achieving high quality and on- time delivery. Responsible for ensuring the overall functional quality of the released product on all required platforms and mechanisms. Ability to understand complex products, solutions, and problems. Creates, documents, and executes software designs which may involve significant re-architecture of important systems, defining and coordinating implementation of wide-reaching impacts. Acts as Technical lead of major projects within one area of a product. Technical Lead in guiding junior engineers. 

Essential Functions: 

- Lead the design, implementation and maintenance of complex software modules and subsystems within the company EDA software suite 
 - Collaborate with product management and other stakeholders to define software requirements and specifications 
 - Architect scalable and efficient software solutions that address performance, reliability, and usability requirements 
 - Ensure each business problem is satisfied by a single technical solution 
 - Complete implementation strategy and get stakeholders agreements
 - Collaborate across projects and teams 
 - Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback and mentors team members / interns / students to foster a cutler of continuous learning and improvement 
 - Investigate and resolve technical issues reported by customers or identified during testing and validation activities 
 - Support for transition major U. S. customers from Teamcenter On premises to Teamcenter X cloud product 
 - Contribute to planning effort, provide accurate estimation of task 
 - Report accurate status to scrum master and help refine breakdown 
 - Keep project tools like git issue board, polarion-to-date 
 - Ensure product change like merge request includes unit test 
 - Maintain first time quality - no avoidable merge request rework 
 - Drive achievement of zero defects in delivered enhancements / features and no acceptance criteria failures 
 - Work to ensure there no regression in units / performance due to release node promotes
 - Complete timely and accurate status updates to story / defect scraped 
 - Ensure escalation response - customer reported priority1 issues have daily update and one working week response cycle 
 - Adopt best practices while generating code using LLM (large language models) 
 - Ensure architecture consider best practices for microservice development 
 - Ensure architecture evaluates best programming language choice for enterprise level product implementation 
 - Ensure architecture makes appropriate decision for on-prem solution vs cloud platform like AWS, Azure, Google etc 
 - Ensure architecture includes AI based agentic framework while Design and maintain agent runtimes, secure function-calling, tool integrations, and orchestration patterns 
 - Ensure AI architecture direction, reference architectures, guardrails, and adoption roadmaps for engineering and products 
 - Ensure architecture includes Observability and Reliability: Instrument agentic services for metrics, logs, and traces; define SLIs/SLOs and operational runbooks. 
 - Advise senior stakeholders on AI opportunities, architecture, investment, dependencies, and risks, translating strategy into implementable plans 
 - Guide Select cloud, hybrid, or Local AI approaches based on data sensitivity, IP, residency, connectivity, latency, security, and cost 
 - Assess customer, domain, operational, and regulatory needs with product teams; determine where AI adds value and recommend an evidence-based approach. 
 - Guide suitable product AI opportunities from discovery through design, validation, release, and operation with product, systems, engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and operations teams. 
 - Define reusable product patterns for data, models, retrieval, inference, integration, and deployment across Local AI, hybrid, and cloud, aligned to product context. 
 - Establish risk-appropriate verification, human oversight, monitoring, updates, incident response, fallback, and rollback practices are followed

Skills and Abilities Required: 

- Strong time management skills and the ability to be self-directed Experience with service-oriented architecture and web application/services development 
 - Experience with Object Oriented modern JavaScript Frameworks (Angular JS, Ember JS, Dojo, etc. ) 
 - Experience with UI/UX design for complex workflows and/or for technical end users / domain experts 
 - Experience building complex, scalable, high-performance software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers 
 - Active on Github or StackOverflow 
 - Comfortable with the Linux command line and Git 
 - Sharp analytical abilities and proven design skills 
 - Experience with distributed computing and enterprise-wide systems 
 - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior management to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy 
 - Experience leading and mentoring junior software engineers, and make them more effective, product software engineers 
 - Understanding of microservice development and best practices

Education and Experience Requirement: 

- Typically requires eight to eleven years of experience and a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent. 
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering best practices 
 - Knowledge of Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, Google) and experience in building microservices 
 - Agent Frameworks: Design and maintain agent runtimes, secure function-calling, tool integrations, and orchestration patterns. 
 - Developer Accelerators: Create SDKs, APIs, templates, and IDE extensions that enable code generation, test creation, and documentation synthesis. 
 - Enablement and Adoption: Pair with Product management onboard use cases, deliver workshops, playbooks, and office hours; remove blockers and ensure successful rollout. 
 - Quality and Safety: Implement error analysis, spec-driven development, and BDD-based testing; enforce guardrails, privacy, and policy compliance. 
 - Observability and Reliability: Instrument agentic services for metrics, logs, and traces; define SLIs/SLOs and operational runbooks. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with Dev ops, Platform Engineering, Security, and Product to deliver end-to-end outcomes and measurable ROI. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Capture feedback, iterate on accelerators, and publish reference architectures and best practices. 

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

About Vanguard

Vanguard India

The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery. 

Responsibilites

- Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.

 - Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.

 - Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines. 
 - Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders. 
 - Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery. 
 - Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred. 
 - This is a player coach role. The Engineering Manager is expected to not only lead people, but is also accountable for the delivery outcomes of the team and is expected to actively participate in engineering activities, multiple years of experience managing engineers. 
 - Mid-Level Developer understanding and hand-ons experience with Java/Python, AWS Services, CI/CD Pipelines (Github, Bitbucket, Bamboo) TDD/BDD practices
 - User level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb, Cloud Watch, Open Telemetry; Understands observability concepts
 - Well versed in Confluence, JIRA
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering Tools (Claude Code, Github CoPilot) effectively to improve the software development process. Ability to mentor/coach others on the team on the effective use of AI Tools
 - High Level understanding of automated testing concepts
 - Previous people leadership experience. Ability to lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers. Ability to set clear performance expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports career growth. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive delivery outcomes and implement strategic platform initiatives. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in software development and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders. 
 - Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions. 
 - Must have skills: Node. js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes, Kore. AI, Android, iOS development
 - Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Your Responsibilities: 

- Lead mechanical engineering execution across proposal support, order/project engineering, design reviews, release, and field modification support, ensuring quality, cost, schedule, and customer requirements are achieved. 
 - Lead, coach, and mentor the mechanical engineering team; plan and allocate work based on capability, capacity, priorities, and project requirements while improving productivity and technical competency.

 - 10 or more years of relevant experience in industrial automation, mechanical design, and engineering execution. 
 - Experience leading technical teams and delivering work across a complete project lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on experience with mechanical design, CAD modeling, drawings, assemblies, design reviews, and manufacturing processes. 
 - Working knowledge of drives, motor control centers, electromechanical systems, quality management systems, and applicable engineering standards. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- Experience with Creo, AutoCAD, SAP, PLM/Windchill, and product lifecycle management processes.

About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering, test automation, and reliability across a fintech technology ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have strong programming expertise, hands-on experience building scalable automation frameworks, and a deep understanding of API-driven, distributed, and cloud-native systems. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to ensure the quality, security, performance, and reliability of financial applications, payment workflows, and transaction-processing systems. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Develop automated test solutions using C#/. NET, Java, Python, or other suitable programming languages. 
 - Build and maintain automated test suites for REST APIs, microservices, GraphQL, databases, and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Validate financial transaction workflows, payment processing, transaction status updates, data integrity, and error-handling scenarios. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and reliable releases. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, scalability, and reliability testing. 
 - Design and execute load and stress tests to evaluate system behaviour under peak transaction volumes. 
 - Investigate and troubleshoot complex defects across distributed systems and cloud-native applications. 
 - Collaborate with developers, architects, product managers, and DevOps teams to define test strategies and quality standards. 
 - Develop reusable automation libraries, test utilities, service mocks, and test data management solutions. 
 - Work with containerised applications and Kubernetes-based environments to validate service reliability and deployment quality. 
 - Monitor test execution results, analyse failures, and provide actionable insights through test reports and quality metrics. 
 - Test security-sensitive workflows, access controls, data validation, and negative scenarios. 
 - Mentor junior SDETs and contribute to automation best practices, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Own quality engineering activities from test planning and design through execution and release validation. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field with 8+ years of experience
 - 8+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, and quality engineering, including substantial hands-on automation development. 
 - Must have strong coding experience of Java/ groovy, Selenium and Database(relational) Unit Testing framework and performance testing. 
 - Hands on experience in building testing framework(s) BDD Cucumber/TestNG
 - Must have hands on experience in Frontend automation using Selenium/appium or any other tool
 - Must have hands-on experience in Web Services Automation using Java/groovy. 
 - Must have hands-on experience in Database testing. Well versed with writing complex SQL. 
 - Must have knowledge of any build tool Gradle/Maven/ANT etc. 
 - Must have good knowledge of CI/CD on Jenkins/ Gitlab
 - Experience with Agile Methodologies, Tools (JIRA, Confluence). 
 - Must have hands-on knowledge in AI usage and AI tools. 
 - Must have exposure to design custom automation framework
 - Must have exposure in Continuous Integration using Bamboo/Jenkins
 - Must have exposure of Agile Methodology
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event-driven workflows. 
 - Good to have knowledge in performance & Security testing
 - Exposure of stored procedure and PL/SQL
 - Working knowledge of Unix commands
 - Good to have exposure in Mobile Automation using Appium/browserstack. 
 - Exposure of monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace etc. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and analytical skills; attention to detail, thoroughness and strong ownership of work. 
 - Strong expertise in API automation and REST API testing; familiarity with GraphQL is an advantage. 
 - Experience in performance and scalability testing, including load generation, bottleneck identification, and system behaviour analysis. 
 - Proficiency with Git-based workflows, debugging, troubleshooting, and code reviews. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment. 

Preferred Qualification

- Experience in fintech, payments, digital banking, prepaid cards, or other financial technology platforms. 
 - Familiarity with payment processing workflows, transaction lifecycle management, reconciliation, and financial data validation. 
 - Knowledge of security testing principles, OWASP guidelines, authentication, authorisation, and secure API testing. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6. 
 - Familiarity with service virtualisation and mocking tools such as WireMock. 
 - Experience with Helm, service mesh technologies, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 
 - Exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk. 
 - Experience with test reporting, quality metrics, and automation coverage analysis. 

What We're Looking For

- A quality-focused engineer who builds robust automation solutions rather than relying solely on manual testing. 
 - A proactive problem-solver who identifies risks early and improves product reliability through effective test strategies. 
 - An engineering professional who can troubleshoot complex technical issues across services and infrastructure. 
 - Someone who values clean code, reusable frameworks, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Note: This position is based out of Noida, Uttar Pradesh (India). Request candidates based out of India to apply.

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 

Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. .

They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

data.title: Software Development Engineer – Routing Platforms(4 to 8 Years)
data.description:
Meet the Team

Our Routing SD-WAN Group is at the forefront of innovation, delivering intelligent, secure, and scalable WAN edge solutions that empower enterprises to connect and protect their networks from the edge to the cloud. Within this group, the Routing Platform Software team builds industry-leading headend SD-WAN and edge routing platforms. We are a high-energy group working on next-generation routing and services at a global scale, connecting thousands of devices and millions of users. 

Your Impact

We are looking for a software engineer to develop and evolve the forwarding and platform software that powers SD-WAN and edge routing. In this role, you will collaborate with ASIC, hardware, and cross-functional engineering teams to define new architectures, implement high-performance packet forwarding, and deliver robust, production-ready features. You will leverage modern AI tools to enhance software development practices, helping to drive greater efficiency, quality, and innovation across the team. 

Responsibilities

- Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with hardware engineering teams to bring up new platforms, develop low-level drivers, and integrate Network Interface Modules (NIMs). 
 - Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain ROMMON and bootloader software to ensure secure and reliable system initialization. 
 - Forwarding Plane Optimization: Develop and tune high-performance forwarding plane software to meet the rigorous demands of modern secure routing environments. 
 - Performance Debugging: Perform deep-dive analysis into performance bottlenecks at the kernel and hardware-abstraction layers, including the control plane. 
 - Modern Development Practices: Utilize modern development workflows, including AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex) and integrated development environments like VSCode, to accelerate the development lifecycle. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 4-8 years of industry experience with end-to-end software development in networking, including platforms, system software, kernel/user-space drivers, bootloaders, and BIOS. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ with a focus on systems programming and Linux environments. 
 - Proven experience in developing device drivers and working with RTOS/Linux kernels. 
 - Solid understanding of routing architectures and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking protocols (e. g. , Ethernet, VLANs, STP). 
 - Experience with bootloaders (ROMMON), hardware bring-up, and board support packages (BSP). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of high-speed interfaces (PHY, MAC, MACSEC) and DPDK. 
 - Debugging experience with hardware interfaces (i2c, PCIe) and hardware/software debuggers (e. g. , GDB, Arium, BDI). 
 - Knowledge of x86 or ARM assembly code, instruction sets, and ABIs. 
 - Experience with AI/ML techniques and tools for development (e. g. , code assistants, static analysis tools, test automation platforms). 
 - Strong collaborative skills and the ability to debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, and software layers. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.description:
Company Description

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems. 

To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You'll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way. 

Job Description

We are hiring a hands-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical-first: you will own the end-to-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical-path features), while partnering with a global, cross-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI-powered development practices-including spec-driven development and agentic coding tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex)-and design AI-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows. 

What You'll Do (Hands-On)

- Architecture + Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows). 
 - Distributed Systems: Design and build event-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well-defined event contracts and versioning strategies. 
 - Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent-driven automation within business process flows. 
 - Front-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next. js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro-frontend considerations where relevant). 
 - Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations. 
 - Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices-threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments. 
 - Authentication & Authorization: Implement end-to-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service-to-service identity (e. g. , managed identities). 
 - Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues. 
 - Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against. 
 - AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows-using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines-with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls for regulated environments. 
 - Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices-spec-driven workflows, AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation-to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance. 

Patterns We Expect You to Use

- Event-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate) 
 - Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure-mode design, consistency tradeoffs) 
 - Domain-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti-corruption layers) 
 - Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks. 

AI-Enabled Delivery Expectations

- Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support). 
 - Comfortable using a spec-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices-spec-driven development, AI-assisted coding, and agent-based automation-as standard ways of working. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope). 
 - Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross-border considerations). 
 - Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI-enabled features and agent-based automation. 
 - Strong experience architecting Next. js and/or React applications at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience with event-driven and distributed system design and production operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, spec-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI-assisted delivery workflows. 
 - Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns. 
 - Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates). 
 - Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics. 
 - Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus. 
 - Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e. g. , using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks). 
 - Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. 

Additional Information

- This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
 - We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
 - Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

data.description:
Join Barclays as a Lead AI Engineer role, where you will design and build core AI/ML solutions that power our enterprise AI capabilities. You will take ownership of significant AI subsystems - from agentic workflows and LLM applications to evaluation pipelines and MLOps tooling - delivering production-grade solutions that are secure, scalable, and aligned with our architectural vision. You bridge the gap between AI architecture and hands-on implementation, driving technical delivery while mentoring junior engineers. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it. 

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills: 

- Bachelor's degree (or above) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related discipline
 - 8+ years software engineering experience with at least 3 years building AI/ML systems, scalable ML infrastructure, or model serving platforms at enterprise scale
 - Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, asyncio) and/or Go/Java, with production experience building APIs and microservices serving high-throughput, low-latency workloads
 - Hands-on experience developing agentic AI systems and LLM applications including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, planning frameworks, and deployment of multi-step AI workflows
 - Solid technical knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and modern agentic frameworks (Strands, LangGraph, Google ADK) with ability to build and optimise agent-based solutions
 - Working experience with GenAI/LLM systems - prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model serving (vLLM), and OpenAI-compatible API surfaces
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture - microservices, cloud platforms, API design (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), and event-driven architectures
 - Experience with AWS services - EC2/EKS, S3, IAM, RDS, and at least one AI service (Bedrock, SageMaker)
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes - containerising applications and deploying to orchestrated environments
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation, Terraform), and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing)
 - Ability to work on system design from ideation through completion with limited supervision; effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below

- Experience building evaluation frameworks for agentic systems including agent benchmarking, reasoning traces, and monitoring observability for multi-step AI workflows in production
 - Experience in vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and memory systems for stateful agents with understanding of retrieval optimisation and context management
 - Experience implementing AI safety controls - content filtering, guardrails, prompt injection detection, PII redaction
 - Knowledge of AI security frameworks - NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10
 - Familiarity with model fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, RLHF, supervised fine-tuning) for domain-specific SLMs
 - Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, and security considerations for autonomous systems

data.title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC

Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence

Level

Lead DBRE

Domain

Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure

Primary Focus

Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution

Work Expectations

U. S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

- Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline. 

Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation. 

- Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility. 

Dimension

Expectation at This Level

Scope of Ownership

Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements. 

Technical Depth

Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems. 

Technical Leadership

Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions. 

Execution

Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure. 

Communication

Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible. 

Automation and Standards

Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - Oracle RAC Platform Ownership
 - Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations. 
 - Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices. 
 - Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures. 
 - Performance and Incident Leadership
 - Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics. 
 - Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions. 
 - Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability
 - Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior. 
 - Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards. 
 - Automation and Observability
 - Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies. 
 - Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives. 
 - Required Qualifications and Experience
 - 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC. 
 - Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior. 
 - Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics. 
 - Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change. 
 - Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills. 
 - Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling. 
 - Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience. 
 - Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities. 
 - Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling. 
 - Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials. 
 - Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
 - Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement. 
 - Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability. 
 - Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams. 
 - Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments. 
 - What This Role Does Not Include
 - This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership. 
 - This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on. 
 - This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected. 
 - This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design. 
 - The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process. 
 - Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U. S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

Position Title

Job Summary

The DevOps Engineer designs, builds, automates, and operates secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platforms and delivery capabilities. The role supports AWS and GCP environments, with working awareness of Azure, and uses Git and GitHub, Terraform, Linux, Python or PowerShell, and CI/CD practices to standardize infrastructure, accelerate software delivery, and improve operational performance. Working across internal developer platforms, cloud foundations, automation, observability, networking, FinOps, and AI-assisted engineering, the position enables product teams to deliver efficiently while meeting architecture, security, resilience, cost, and compliance standards. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design, build, configure, and operate secure cloud foundations and shared platform services across AWS and GCP, with awareness of Azure services and integration patterns. 
 - Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Terraform and related infrastructure-as-code practices, ensuring repeatable provisioning, configuration consistency, and controlled change. 
 - Create, improve, and support CI/CD pipelines using Git and GitHub-based workflows, automated quality gates, security checks, artifact management, and reliable deployment patterns. 
 - Contribute to the Internal Developer Platform by delivering reusable templates, self-service capabilities, paved-road patterns, documentation, and developer enablement tools. 
 - Automate operational and engineering tasks using Python or PowerShell and apply strong Linux fundamentals to administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and platform support. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and service health practices that strengthen observability, availability, performance, and operational readiness. 
 - Apply basic networking concepts-including DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, connectivity, and certificates-to diagnose and resolve cloud and delivery issues. 
 - Partner with software engineers, architects, cybersecurity, operations, and product teams to improve delivery flow, platform adoption, reliability, and incident resolution. 
 - Embed FinOps practices through tagging, cost visibility, usage optimization, rightsizing, and actionable recommendations that balance performance, resilience, and cloud spend. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, and automation while validating outputs and protecting company data and intellectual property. 

Competencies

- DevOps and platform engineering mindset focused on automation, self-service, standardization, reliability, security, and developer experience. 
 - Hands-on analytical problem solving across Linux, cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, source control, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and networking. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and GCP cloud foundations, with transferable understanding of Azure and multi-cloud operating principles. 
 - Ability to write maintainable automation in Python or PowerShell and collaborate effectively through Git and GitHub workflows. 
 - Understanding of observability, secure engineering, operational resilience, incident management, and continuous improvement. 
 - Collaboration, communication, ownership, and customer focus in a global, cross-functional, and multicultural environment. 
 - Practical awareness of FinOps and AI-assisted engineering, including cost-conscious design, output validation, prompt discipline, privacy, security, and ethical use. 

Key Performance Indicators

- Reliability, availability, performance, and security of supported cloud foundations, platform services, and delivery pipelines. 
 - Lead time, deployment frequency, change success rate, and recovery performance improved through effective CI/CD and automation. 
 - Adoption and reuse of Internal Developer Platform capabilities, templates, standards, and self-service workflows. 
 - Quality, maintainability, documentation, and policy compliance of infrastructure automation, scripts, GitHub workflows, and platform components. 
 - Reduction in recurring incidents, manual effort, alert noise, and time to detect and resolve operational issues. 
 - Cloud cost visibility and optimization outcomes achieved through tagging, usage analysis, rightsizing, and FinOps recommendations. 
 - Appropriate use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity without compromising quality, security, or compliance. 

Minimum Qualifications (if applicable include physical requirements to comply with ADA): 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
 - Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and foundational knowledge of the other major cloud platforms, including Azure. 
 - Working knowledge of Git and GitHub, CI/CD concepts, automated delivery workflows, and infrastructure discovery or automation using Terraform or comparable tooling. 
 - Strong Linux fundamentals and practical scripting experience with Python or PowerShell. 
 - Understanding of monitoring and observability concepts, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and service health. 
 - Foundational networking knowledge covering IP addressing, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, connectivity, and TLS certificates. 
 - Exposure to Internal Developer Platforms, cloud foundations, automation, FinOps, operational support, and secure engineering practices.

Job Description

As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people management to enable PitchBook's data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational stability of our enterprise Contact Center platforms. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud, Genesys Cloud APIs, AWS services (particularly EventBridge), contact center technologies, database systems, and observability tools such as Grafana and Sherlock. 

This role will focus on proactive monitoring, incident management, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of mission-critical contact center services and integrations.

 - Develop automated monitoring, alerting, self-healing, and operational recovery solutions. 
 - Proactively identify and resolve production issues before they impact cusomers or contact center operations. 
 - Establish and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and operational performance metrics.

 - Strong hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX architecture, APIs, integrations, and operational troubleshooting.

 - Troubleshoot complex issues involving voice, chat, email, messaging, callbacks, and workitem routing.

 - Working knowledge of AWS Lambda, CloudWatch, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, IAM, and related cloud services. 
 - Monitor and troubleshoot asynchronous processing, event delivery failures, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter queues. 
 - Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant integrations between Genesys Cloud and downstream enterprise applications. 
 - Understand AWS security, access controls, logging, and cloud infrastructure reliability. 
 - Monitoring, Observability & Troubleshooting
 - Experience with Grafana and Sherlock for application monitoring, operational dashboards, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Develop and maintain dashboards covering service health, API latency, error rates, throughput, and availability. 
 - Analyze logs, metrics, and distributed traces to identify performance bottlenecks and recurring production issues. 
 - Implement proactive alerting and anomaly detection to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR). 
 - Correlate events across Genesys Cloud, AWS, databases, and integrated services to identify root causes. 
 - Database & Data Reliability
 - Working knowledge of NuData and NuGraph databases or data platforms. 
 - Experience investigating data inconsistencies, missing records, processing delays, and integration failures. 
 - Ability to develop and execute queries for troubleshooting, reconciliation, and operational analysis. 
 - Monitor data processing pipelines, ingestion failures, and database performance. 
 - Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data integrity, consistency, and availability across contact center systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 6+ years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering, production engineering, or a closely related reliability-focused role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud APIs, including API authentication, analytics queries, conversation details, routing, and platform integrations. 
 - Solid understanding of enterprise contact center technologies, including ACD, IVR, CTI, voice, digital channels, and interaction routing. 
 - Experience working with AWS, particularly EventBridge and event-driven architectures. 
 - Knowledge of NuData and NuGraph databases or internal data platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Grafana and Sherlock for monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed applications, APIs, cloud services, and data integrations. 
 - Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Shell, or equivalent languages. 
 - Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2. 0, and asynchronous integration patterns. 
 - Demonstrated experience in incident management, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and production support. 
 - Strong communication, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting large-scale, enterprise contact center environments with thousands of concurrent agents. 
 - Familiarity with Genesys Cloud Architect, predictive routing, workforce engagement management (WEM), and analytics. 
 - Experience with Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or other infrastructure automation and CI/CD tools. 
 - Knowledge of AWS CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and distributed tracing. 
 - Experience with load testing, capacity planning, resilience testing, and disaster recovery. 
 - Familiarity with contact center integrations involving CRM, workforce management, recording, quality management, and speech/text analytics platforms. 
 - Experience building operational automation or AI-assisted incident detection and troubleshooting solutions.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, SDKs & Open Source
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

About the Team  Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service. 

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers. 

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models. 

About the role  We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, . NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language. 

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

ResponsibilitiesSet the direction: 

- Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team. 
 - Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community

 - Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it. Own the Platform:   

- Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, . NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from. 
 - Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting. 
 - Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples. 
 - Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions  
 - Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute. Requirements

 - Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/. NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several. 
 - Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling.

data.title: System Software Manager - Power Profiling and Infrastructure
data.description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, powering breakthroughs in AI, graphics, autonomous vehicles, and scientific simulation. 

Inside NVIDIA, the Software Power Profiling team is the power measurement authority for our most strategic platforms - RTX Spark, DGX Spark, discrete GPU desktop and notebook, and data center. The team measures power and performance-per-watt, qualifies power targets, co-engineers battery life with OEMs, runs nightly regression farms across the device fleet, and builds the profiling infrastructure - frameworks, analytics dashboards, and automated regression farms - that the rest of NVIDIA relies on to understand and optimize power. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead, grow, and mentor a cross-site team of power and infrastructure engineers across Pune and Bangalore - setting individual and team roadmaps, development plans, and clear ownership across all mandates. 
 - Drive the team's power profiling authority across the full product lifecycle: pre-silicon power engagement, power target qualification, regression monitoring, battery-life validation, and external software release qualification - including nightly development-branch and release-branch power and perf/watt monitoring across discrete GPU and data-center platforms. 
 - Own the physical lab - run a temperature-controlled, instrumented measurement lab across two sites, covering DUT fleet management, board procurement, intake and logistics, board instrumentation and rework, DAQ and power-path integrity, rack build-out, and cross-geo capacity planning. 
 - Shape measurability from pre-silicon through production - engage pre-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips. 
 - Close power gaps and own release readiness - quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop. 
 - Lead cross-company power engagement - converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co-engineer shared battery-life targets, conduct joint root-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug-and-analysis stream. 
 - Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance - drive the in-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production-grade shared assets; deliver energy-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off-mode power) required to clear product release gates. 

What we need to see

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of overall industry experience. 
 - 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex software and infrastructure at velocity across distributed teams. 
 - Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power - with hands-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power-stack debugging. 
 - Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab - instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive. 
 - Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle - from pre-silicon power modeling through bring-up, qualification, and post-commercialization sustaining. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders. 
 - Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions. 

Ways to stand out from the crowd

- Hands-on power profiling experience - DAQ-based external rail capture, on-board sensor validation, or telemetry-driven regression root cause. 
 - Intimate knowledge of Windows on Arm or client SoC platforms - battery-life scenario methodology, Modern Standby measurement, or energy-efficiency regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience leading silicon bring-up power profiling - firmware sensor validation, first-power baselines, and bring-up-phase engagement with hardware teams. 
 - Track record of building or leading power regression infrastructure or automated test/analysis pipelines at scale. 
 - Experience with AI/agentic workflow development applied to lab automation, failure triage, or report generation. 
 - Prior cross-company lab convergence work - aligning methodology, build synchronization, and shared tooling between two or more power or validation labs.

Test Data & Environment Management

 - Apply secure configuration practices across pipelines secrets management and data platforms to reduce operational risk and safeguard sensitive information used in knowledge centric applications.

 - Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that hybrid work arrangements change windows and release plans align with day shift operations while avoiding disruption to key business services. 

Qualifications

- Bring strong hands on experience with Airflow configuration DAG design and pipeline optimization demonstrating the ability to orchestrate complex data workflows in production environments. 
 - Show advanced proficiency in Python development including packaging dependency management and testing practices that enable scalable and maintainable automation and data processing solutions. 
 - Offer practical experience administering Snowflake with a focus on resource monitoring role based access control and performance tuning that supports reliable analytics and reporting platforms. 
 - Demonstrate solid background in DevOps practices such as CI and CD infrastructure as code and environment automation that contribute to faster and more stable application and data deliveries. 
 - Contribute domain awareness in content and knowledge management by understanding how metadata taxonomy and search driven scenarios depend on well orchestrated data and application pipelines. 
 - Exhibit familiarity with hybrid work models and remote collaboration tooling that support effective communication documentation and coordinated releases across distributed teams.

As Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Experience / Head of Developer Experience, you will report directly to the Director of Platform Engineering and be responsible for how every engineer at Tide builds, tests and ships software. You will: 

- Own the Developer Experience strategy for Tide, setting the vision and roadmap for developer tooling, CI/CD and the internal platform. 
 - Lead the design, build and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, reducing friction and lead time across the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Define, track and report on DevEx and engineering productivity metrics (e. g. DORA, SPACE), using data to identify bottlenecks and prioritise investment. 
 - Own and evolve Tide's service catalogue (Backstage), establishing it as the single source of truth for the ICT Asset Register and driving adoption across engineering. 
 - Manage the Developer Productivity function, responsible for building and maintaining Java/Spring and Python 'paved road' templates that give product teams a fast, secure and consistent way to start new services. 
 - Own the internally developed libraries for authentication and other common functionality, ensuring they are well documented, kept up to date, and widely adopted across product teams. 
 - Build, lead and mentor a team of platform, developer experience and developer productivity engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship and continuous improvement. 
 - Prepare Tide's engineering platform for agentic development, ensuring our tooling, paved roads and guardrails allow AI coding agents (e. g. Claude Code) to contribute safely and effectively alongside human engineers. 
 - Define the platform, tooling and operating model for running AI-developed applications in production, covering observability, security, testing and governance for agent-authored code. 
 - Partner closely with engineering leaders, security and compliance stakeholders across Tide's product and platform teams to identify friction points and shape the platform roadmap. 

What We Are Looking For

Tide is seeking an experienced Head of Developer Experience to lead our efforts in making our engineers as productive and effective as possible. The ideal candidate will have: 

- A proven track record leading Developer Experience, Platform Engineering or DevOps/SRE teams at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling in a modern cloud environment. 
 - Experience with Backstage, or a comparable internal developer portal / service catalogue tool, including rollout and adoption. 
 - Experience running a developer productivity or paved-road function, including building and maintaining project templates (e. g. Java/Spring, Python) and shared libraries (e. g. authentication, common functionality) used by product teams. 
 - Working knowledge of engineering productivity frameworks such as DORA metrics or SPACE, and experience using them to drive improvement. 
 - Familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted development tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), and a point of view on the guardrails, governance and infrastructure needed to run AI-developed applications safely in production. 
 - Strong people leadership skills, with a track record of building, growing and developing high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to influence engineering leaders across multiple teams and locations. 
 - Experience in financial services or another regulated, technology-driven scale-up environment is a plus. 

OUR TECH STACK

Our platform and developer experience tooling includes: Terraform, Helm, Crossplane, Kubernetes (K8S), GitHub, AWS, GCP, Claude, and Backstage as our developer portal and service catalogue. Our product teams build on Java/Spring Boot and Python. 

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
