Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and Power products, plus winning combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Position Summary

As a Senior Staff Test Engineer, you will be responsible to apply a broad level of expertise and knowledge in test discipline, leading and contributing to the development of the company objectives and principles to achieve goals in creative and effective ways. 

This position will work on significant and unique issues, where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles. You will be required to apply conceptual thinking to understand advanced issues and their implications. It will be necessary to exercise independent judgement in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results, for which you will be held responsible and may impact the larger business. 

In the more senior role in this range, you will be expected to create formal networks involving coordination among groups, focusing on providing thought leadership while working on projects that affect the broader organization, and will require an understanding of the larger business. 

This role will require conveying advanced information and persuading a diverse set of stakeholders as needed. In this role you will be expected and acknowledged as a subject matter expert and may direct the activities of others as a technical lead. You will be fully accountable for the results of yourself and your team members. In the more junior role, you will work as a part of the technical team executing the objectives understood to expected milestones, with accountability on results. 

In both cases, you will work with your team/leadership to set schedules and to meet commitments. You will endeavor to identify enablement or readiness gaps and close them. Senior people will provide technical support as needed to their peers, and more junior members will request support as required to stay on track. When conflict in priorities occur, you will work resolve them and/or set updated expectations. 

Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling investing in power delivery business. Products include Point of loads (POL), Hotswap/Efuse, drivers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop best of class test programs to support key NPI, quality & capability initiatives

- Support qualification, characterization, and correlation of developed products

- Train and guide more junior team members, building their skill sets and capabilities for independent success

- Work with leadership to implement processes, procedures, guidelines and specifications that define and drive execution and quality for the test group

- Implement and develop baseline software and hardware solutions for scaling the broader team or organization

- Determine and report ROI inputs for planning and test flow with revenue, COGS and capacity mindfully in focus

- Complete quality planning, hardware and software reviews for the test group

- Coordinate with product engineering and operations to enable seamless production ramp and release

- Support production yield and customer return activities for quality

- Act as a test platform expert on the ATE equipment in use for the test group

- Serve as a mentor for younger and less experienced engineers

- Support the tech/lab team in dealing with equipment calibration and maintenance issues and planning as required

- Manage 3rd party relationships and building success with external technical teams

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or Computer Science 
 - 10 to 12+ years of experience working with Automated Test Systems (ATE). 

- 10 to 12+ years of hands-on experience in ATE test development for analog, digital and mixed signal, with a strong focus on analog power product testing and high current testing. Experience on ATE platforms like DMDX, STS8300 is a plus. 

- Experience in programming such as C++, basic, Perl, python, etc. 

- Experience in testing and collecting data on IC chips or circuits using standard tools such as Oscilloscopes, Multimeters, Spectrum Analyzers, etc. 

- Proficient with ATE analog digital instruments, PCB layout parasitic reduction, and strong debug/troubleshooting experience

- Hands-on experience in debugging analog products with serial bus interfaces

- Experience with test hardware and test program development

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: AI System Test Engineer
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Engineering function is responsible for all engineering activities within a firm to ensure that business objectives are met. Includes the creation, development, design and improvement of products, equipment, facilities, services, standards and procedures in all engineering fields. The Quality Assurance area is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, and projects meet defined quality standards. Develops, conducts, and evaluates application audits and testing processes. Staff often have in-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches. The Quality Assurance Engineering focus specializes in debugging software using automated tests to achieve quality standards for firm products. Develops, modifies and executes software test plans, automated scripts and programs for testing to ensure program functionality, consulting with development engineers in resolution of issues. Provides guidance and feedback in the preparation of technical appraisals of programming languages and systems, computational software, and related technology. This job family is in the professional level category and works independently with flexibility and authority over daily work priorities. Incumbents in this job level category may provide work direction to other employees but would not typically have the authority to discipline or reward other employees. There are different levels available that provide clarity on contribution expectations based on knowledge, application, problem solving, and collaboration. 

Your Impact

As an AI System Test Engineer, your responsibilities will include: 

Designing and developing AI/ML-based tools and frameworks for functional testing of Cisco products, ensuring quality and stability from a system/solution perspective that simulates customer environments with IIoT deployments

- Work with AI/ML tools in developing, testing, and maintaining AI-driven solutions for network monitoring, automation, and optimization. 
 - Participate in automation initiatives using scripting, AI tools, and modern networking frameworks. 
 - Stay updated with emerging trends in AI, networking technologies, and automation practices. 
 - Contribute to internal tools, proofs-of-concept, and innovation projects related to AI-enabled network
 - Collaborate with senior engineers to design, test, and deploy network and AI-based features or enhancements. 
 - Monitor system performance, investigate anomalies, and contribute to root-cause analysis and resolution. 
 - Support day-to-day network engineering activities, including configuration validation, troubleshooting, and performance analysis. 
 - Supporting the test team in expanding their knowledge of AI/ML, testing technologies and networking by staying updated with the latest industry developments. 
 - Contributing to the department's knowledge retention by systematically archiving meaningful documentation and equipment. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related engineering field, with 2-4 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, implementation or related areas
 - Demonstrated strong knowledge of AI/ML concepts with the ability to apply them effectively in practical scenarios
 - Excellent programming or scripting skills (Python)
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and communication skills. 
 - Familiarity with networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network protocols, is a plus. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.title: Network Development Engineer, Code Quality
data.description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2, 500 of the world's largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain's platform. 

What We Need

NetBrain is looking for a Network Development Engineer with a focus on Code Quality to join our Platform team. You will champion software quality across the codebase by designing robust unit tests, driving CI/CD pipeline health, and applying static analysis to prevent regressions before they reach production. This role requires strong Python skills and a genuine passion for testing philosophy and software craftsmanship. 

You will directly influence the reliability and maintainability of a platform that automates network operations for the world's largest enterprises. Your testing mindset and code quality standards become the foundation everyone else builds on. The ideal candidate has a philosophy about testing - not just experience with testing tools. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement comprehensive unit test suites: test design, mocking, fixtures, and edge case coverage. 
 - Establish and maintain static analysis tooling and enforce code quality standards across the platform. 
 - Contribute to and improve CI/CD pipelines to ensure automated quality gates are effective and reliable. 
 - Drive testing philosophy across the team - from unit tests through integration and regression testing. 
 - Debug complex issues using systematic, structured debugging approaches. 
 - Contribute Python (primary) and a second language (JavaScript/Node. js preferred) to platform quality initiatives. 
 - May need to work on customers' platform cases when needed. 

What You Bring

- 2-4 years of Python development with a strong focus on testing, debugging, and code quality. 
 - Demonstrated experience with unit test design: mocking, fixtures, test coverage strategies, edge case handling. 
 - Hands-on experience with static analysis tools (e. g. , pylint, flake8, mypy, SonarQube) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - A clear testing philosophy: ability to articulate trade-offs between test types and coverage strategies. 
 - Proficiency in a second programming language; JavaScript/Node. js is a strong asset. 
 - Systematic debugging approach with the ability to isolate, reproduce, and resolve complex issues. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Nice to have: JavaScript/Node. js experience; familiarity with AI-assisted development tools; networking fundamentals. 

NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities. 

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. 

If you have a disability that prevents or limits your ability to use or access the site, or if you require any other accommodation in the application process due to a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation. To make a request, please contact our People Team at: people@netbraintech. com and we will be happy to assist you. 

In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions. 

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

data.title: Field Quality Analyst
data.description:
Job Description

- Perform end-to-end Failure Analysis (FA) on physical hardware samples, including board-level debug and component diagnostics, and document findings in issue-tracking databases. 
 - Conduct on-site technical audits at repair centers and manufacturing partners, including inventory checks, root-cause data collection, and physical hardware verification to validate repair procedures. 
 - Prepare detailed technical reports based on failure-analysis investigations and data analysis, providing clear diagnostic evidence to support engineering decisions. 
 - Execute SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze field performance metrics, repair data, and telemetry logs; identify and flag data anomalies for quality assessment. 
 - Monitor bug trackers and quality databases to follow investigation progress, identify technical bottlenecks, and escalate issues based on data trends. 
 - Prepare regular standardized field-quality reports using established templates and communicate key findings to relevant cross-functional stakeholders. 

Key Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience. 
 - 4 years of relevant experience in field quality, hardware failure analysis, repair engineering, manufacturing quality, or related technical areas. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, cleaning, and analysis. 
 - Familiarity with board-level diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and failure-analysis software. 
 - Practical experience applying 5-Why analysis, Fishbone diagrams, or similar root-cause identification methods in a hardware environment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot hardware issues and derive data-backed insights with limited guidance. 
 - Ability to travel approximately 30-50% to service centers and manufacturing sites to conduct independent diagnostic and audit work. 
 - Good written and spoken English. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in high-volume consumer electronics manufacturing, connected-device repair, service operations, or factory production environments. 
 - Hands-on exposure to repair-center audits, manufacturing-site audits, or field-quality investigations. 
 - Experience working with technical issue-tracking systems, quality databases, or standardized reporting tools. 
 - Professional fluency in spoken and written Hindi and English to support local vendor communication, site activities, and regional cross-functional collaboration.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
data.description:
About Smart Working

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally. 

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 

  

About the Role

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening. 

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality. 

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
Who We Are

At Platform Science, we're working to connect everything that moves. Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe. 

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team. 

About The Role

Platform Science is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Core Product Development team in Chennai. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust manual and automated test suites across our web and mobile applications, ensuring our edge-to-cloud IoT solutions meet strict performance, stability, and quality standards. 

You will play an integral role across the complete software development lifecycle-designing automated UI and API tests, driving exploratory test sessions, and identifying system malfunctions early. Additionally, you will coordinate seamlessly across time zones, collaborating closely with our distributed teams and stakeholders in both India and the US. 

Essential Responsibilities (Measures Of Success)

- Full-Lifecycle Quality Assurance: Participate actively across all stages of product development, including new feature releases, platform upgrades, functional enhancements, performance testing, and defect resolution. 
 - Test Automation & Execution: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated UI and API test frameworks for web applications and mobile platforms (iOS and Android). 
 - Exploratory & Manual Testing: Execute rigorous exploratory tests on new features and bug fixes, blending manual validation with automated test suites. 
 - Defect Lifecycle Management: Identify, document, isolate, and track software defects in Jira with thorough root-cause investigations, logs, and clear reproduction steps. 
 - Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Proactively communicate project status, risks, and technical blockers; balance working hours between Indian and US time zones to attend client/sync calls and address critical production issues. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Research, evaluate, and adopt industry best practices in Quality Engineering, test automation, and Continuous Integration (CI). 

Target Capabilities & Skills

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Software QA Engineer or SDET. 
 - Core Programming: Strong coding proficiency in Java; knowledge or experience with Kotlin or JavaScript is a significant advantage. 
 - Mobile Test Automation: Proven hands-on experience authoring automated test scripts for native and hybrid mobile applications (iOS and Android) using Appium, Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Deep understanding of backward compatibility testing across varying operating system versions and device configurations. 
 - Test Design Methodologies: Strong applied knowledge of test design techniques, including Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and Use Case testing. 
 - Agile QA Practices: Practical experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and exploratory testing patterns. 

Other Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (equivalent practical QA engineering experience will be considered in place of a degree). 
 - Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills to interact productively with engineering teams, leadership, and global stakeholders. 
 - Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex architectural documents, technical specs, diagrams, and data models. 
 - Mindset & Ownership: Demonstrates intellectual humility (learning actively from mistakes), self-motivation, high ownership, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision. 

Benefits

The company offers various benefits to regular, full-time employees including: 

- Provident fund and gratuity in accordance with applicable laws. 
 - Paid vacation, sick leave and holidays, in accordance with applicable laws. 
 - Twenty-Six weeks of paid maternity leave in accordance with applicable laws. 

(Note: The compensation details listed in India role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. )

Legal & Privacy Disclaimers

Platform Science collects your personal information to support its business operations, including for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and other business-related purposes as well as to be in legal compliance. You can review further details of such collection and use in our Privacy Policy (https: //www. platformscience. com/privacy-notice). 

Please note: This document is a description of a potential position with our company. Nothing within this document may be construed as an offer for employment or a promise of benefit or remuneration. Further, any representation made within this document is subject to the laws and restrictions of the jurisdiction where employment may be deemed to occur. The parameters and availability of this position are subject to change and based solely within the discretion of the company. In addition, the duties, responsibilities, and scope of this position may not be fully represented in this description or may change as required by the Company. 

Platform Science is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

We are looking for a QA Engineer with 2+ years of experience in Manual and Automation Testing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Selenium WebDriver with Java, TestNG, Page Object Model (POM), Appium, and Playwright with JavaScript.

 - Java

About Smart Working

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn't just another remote opportunity - it's about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you're welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. 

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you're empowered to grow personally and professionally. 

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world. 

  

About the Role

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening. 

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality. 

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

- Add data-test-ids to React code where missing

- Validate correct database state using SQL

- Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive

- Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned

- Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications

- Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly

- Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation

- Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases

- Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline

- Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript

- 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript

- 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin

- 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright

- 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests

- 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication

- 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL

- 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction

- Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction

- Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications

- Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient

Nice to Have

- Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps

- Experience with Appium or Flutter integration_test

- Experience reading and working with React front-end code

- Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework

- Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC

data.title: Engineering Manager - Mechanical
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

This Engineering Manager position will lead the CST Mechanical Engineering team supporting the Neuroscience portfolio. The role is responsible for people leadership, technical and project oversight, resource planning, capability development, and delivery of product development and sustaining engineering initiatives. The manager will collaborate with global business and cross-functional partners to align priorities, strengthen engineering ownership, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality engineering solutions. 

Primary Responsibilities: 

- Lead and develop a team of mechanical engineers supporting product development, sustaining engineering, technology advancement, and lifecycle management initiatives across the CST Neuroscience portfolio. 
 - Provide functional, technical, and operational leadership while establishing clear priorities, objectives, roles, and accountability across the team. 
 - Partner with global engineering and business leaders to understand portfolio priorities, define engagement models, and align team capabilities and resources with current and future program needs. 
 - Provide engineering leadership for the development, sustainment, and lifecycle management of spinal implants and instrumentation, electrosurgical devices, and related enabling technologies, ensuring alignment with technical, quality, regulatory, and business requirements. 
 - Oversee the planning and execution of multiple engineering projects, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, schedule, quality, cost, and technical objectives. 
 - Provide technical oversight for mechanical design, engineering analysis, design verification, validation, documentation, risk management, engineering changes, and product release activities. 
 - Ensure robust technical reviews and engineering decision-making to verify that designs meet safety, reliability, manufacturability, quality, regulatory, and performance requirements. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable Design Controls, quality-system requirements, engineering procedures, and medical device regulations throughout product development and sustaining activities. 
 - Guide teams in developing and maintaining technical specifications, engineering analyses, drawings, design history documentation, and product lifecycle records. 
 - Support risk-management activities, including Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), risk assessments, hazard analyses, and associated mitigation strategies. 
 - Establish resource and capacity plans based on portfolio demand, project priorities, technical complexity, and required engineering competencies. 
 - Monitor execution, proactively identify risks and constraints, and work with stakeholders to implement timely mitigation and recovery plans. 
 - Build organizational capability in mechanical design, product development, design controls, engineering analysis, verification and validation, risk management, and medical device lifecycle processes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices, standard work, design quality, productivity, execution consistency, and knowledge management. 
 - Promote the effective use of automation, modeling, simulation, digital engineering, and AI-enabled tools to improve engineering efficiency, quality, and decision-making. 
 - Recruit, onboard, coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent while building appropriate succession and capability-development plans. 
 - Establish individual and team goals, conduct regular one-on-one discussions, provide timely feedback, and support employee performance and career development. 
 - Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-accountability environment that encourages innovation, knowledge sharing, and effective cross-functional teamwork. 
 - Communicate project status, engineering risks, resource needs, operating metrics, and business impact clearly to leadership and global stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with external suppliers, development partners, and consultants to ensure technical alignment and timely delivery. 
 - Support departmental planning and responsible management of engineering resources, infrastructure, tools, budgets, and operating expenses. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 15+ years of relevant engineering experience in medical device product development, sustaining engineering, or related engineering disciplines within a regulated environment. 
 - At least 8 years of progressive people leadership experience, including responsibility for leading engineering teams, developing talent, managing performance, and delivering technical and business objectives. 
 - Proven track record of leading global engineering teams supporting product development and sustaining engineering programs. 
 - Strong experience in medical device product development throughout the product lifecycle, including concept development, feasibility, design controls, design verification, design validation, product release, sustaining engineering, and post-market support. 
 - Strong knowledge and practical application of FDA Quality System Regulations, including 21 CFR Part 820 Design Controls, Design History File (DHF) requirements, engineering change management, and product lifecycle processes. 
 - Strong knowledge of risk management principles and standards, including application of DFMEA, risk assessments, and design risk mitigation strategies. 
 - Experience working within regulated quality systems and applying FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and applicable regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholder groups. 
 - Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including mechanical design, materials, manufacturing processes, tolerance analysis, engineering documentation, and product development methodologies. 
 - Experience with CAD platforms such as PTC Creo (Pro/ENGINEER), SolidWorks, or equivalent engineering design tools. 
 - Strong understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), tolerance stack-up analysis, and engineering drawing standards. 
 - Experience planning and prioritizing engineering work, managing resources, addressing execution risks, and supporting delivery across multiple projects. 
 - Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers while establishing clear objectives, expectations, and accountability. 
 - Experience managing engineering resources, portfolio priorities, organizational growth, and stakeholder relationships. 
 - Experience working with global cross-functional teams across engineering, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, operations, sourcing, and program management functions. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage. 



This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

data.title: Principal Engineer - C++
data.description:
Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Principal Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. 
 - Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

- Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
 - Modern C++ Expertise: 8+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. 
 - HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. 
 - Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. 
 - Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std: : atomic). 
 - Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e. g. , vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). 
 - Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc. )

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e. g. , ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). 
 - Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. 
 - Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. 
 - Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. 
 - Functional domain awareness - CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

- Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
 - Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. 
 - Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. 

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily. 

Circana Behaviors: 

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: 

- Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
 - Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
 - Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
 - Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
 - Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
 - Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
 - Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim To Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation

data.title: Australian Migration (GSM) Documentation Specialist
data.description:
Job description: 

The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories. 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Setting the Quality Standard

-Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved

-Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward

-Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it

-Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure

2. Checking Files Before Submission

-Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority

-Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements

-Gives final approval - nothing gets lodged without QA sign-off

3. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules

-Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines

-Updates the team quickly whenever rules change

-Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements

4. Improving How Things Work

-Creates clear step-by-step processes for the team to follow

-Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly

-Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening

5. Reducing Errors and Rejections

-Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from

-Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened

-Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again

-Works toward getting files right the first time, every time

6. Reporting to Leadership

-Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing

-Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends

-Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly

7. Working With Other Teams

-Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff

-Makes sure quality is not just a QA job - it runs through the whole business

-Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk

8. Training the Team

-Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills

-Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes

-Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager

9. Protecting Client Information

-Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private

-Follows all legal and company rules around data protection

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

-Has a relevant degree

-Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services

-Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years

-Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires

-Has used case management or CRM systems before

-Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus

At Airtribe, we're reimagining how professionals upskill and grow in the age of AI. We run cohort-based, expert-led programs that focus on real-world application, not just passive learning. Our instructors come from companies like Gojek, Razorpay, Uber, Coinbase, Microsoft, and Meta, and more than 5, 000+ professionals have already trusted Airtribe to accelerate their careers. If you're looking to learn sales in a high-ownership, fast-paced startup, this role will push you to grow quickly.

As our sales team scales, maintaining consistency and quality across conversations becomes increasingly challenging. Great sales outcomes are not just driven by volume, but by how conversations are handled, how problems are understood, and how trust is built. This role exists to build a strong feedback and quality engine that helps the sales team improve continuously and perform better over time. 

The Role: 

As a Sales Quality Analyst, you will own the evaluation and feedback loop for sales conversations. You will work closely with sales and training teams to identify gaps, highlight best practices, and contribute to building a more structured and effective sales system. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of sales, data, and coaching. 

What You'll Own: 

- Evaluating sales calls across Pre-Sales, Sales, and Post-Sales functions. 
 - Reviewing and scoring 20-30 calls per week using a structured evaluation framework 
 - Writing detailed and actionable feedback for individual agents 
 - Identifying high-quality calls and best practices for team-wide learning 
 - Maintaining QA scorecards and tracking agent performance 
 - Supporting training initiatives through insights and real call examples 
 - Collaborating with sales and training teams to improve quality standards 
 - Ensuring QA insights are integrated into performance reviews and improvement plans. 

What Problems You'll Solve: 

- Inconsistency in sales conversations across agents 
 - Lack of structured feedback for performance improvement 
 - Identifying why deals are not converting and where drop-offs occur 
 - Bridging the gap between training and real-world sales execution 
 - Building visibility into quality metrics across the sales function

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding sales processes, evaluating calls, and delivering consistent feedback. Over time, you will contribute to refining evaluation frameworks, improving training inputs, and building scalable QA systems. This is not a passive or checklist-based evaluation role. We are not looking for someone who only scores calls. We are looking for someone who understands conversations, identifies patterns, and helps improve outcomes.

- Opportunity to build and shape the QA function from the ground up 
 - Direct exposure to a high-performance, data-driven sales team 
 - Close collaboration with sales and operations leadership 
 - High ownership with visible impact on team performance

data.description:
Job Title: 

- Principal Engineer-High Speed Interface Pre-Silicon Validation/Verification

We Are: 

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. 

You Are: 

You are a driven and insightful Emulation Expert, passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in ASIC digital design. With a deep understanding of IP interfaces--especially PCIe and DDR--you are skilled in leveraging advanced emulation platforms like Zebu to accelerate verification and product development. Your career is marked by a proven ability to deliver robust, production-ready IP through rigorous emulation and verification cycles. You thrive in highly collaborative, matrixed, and international environments, bringing together diverse teams and perspectives to solve complex challenges. 

Your hands-on approach and proactive attitude make you a go-to resource for bridging gaps between Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring seamless integration and verification of both Controller and PHY components. You have a keen eye for detail and are committed to right-first-time development, always ensuring traceability and completeness across verification requirements. You stay ahead of industry trends, standards, and evolving technologies, and are adept at translating these into actionable insights for your teams. As an excellent communicator and natural collaborator, you are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and driving change within the organization. Your adaptability, resilience, and commitment to continuous learning set you apart as a leader in your field. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

- Bridging and closing gaps between the available or required Emulation IP feature set and the Design IP verification for all functions, spanning both Controller and PHY domains. 
 - Reporting key metrics and driving continuous improvement initiatives in Emulation IP quality and performance. 
 - Providing technical leadership and expertise to define requirements for Emulation IP, ensuring its correct implementation and deployment within verification strategies. 
 - Staying ahead of evolving industry standards, interpreting future changes, ECNs, and specification errata, and integrating this knowledge into Emulation and Design IP teams. 
 - Reviewing and validating test plans for both Emulation IP and Design IP, guaranteeing best-in-class function, feature coverage, and product quality. 
 - Collaborating cross-functionally to optimize workflows, standardize methodologies, and ensure compliance with organizational goals. 
 - Mentoring and guiding junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. 

The Impact You Will Have: 

- Enhancing cross-functional collaboration to elevate product quality and end-customer satisfaction. 
 - Transforming the approach to Emulation IP usage in validating cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures. 
 - Driving innovation by defining and refining requirements for IP product development, particularly in emulation contexts. 
 - Championing the adoption of best-in-class verification methodologies across the organization. 
 - Standardizing and optimizing verification workflows to boost efficiency, traceability, and compliance. 
 - Influencing the next generation of emulation and verification solutions, positioning Synopsys as an industry leader. 
 - Accelerating time-to-market for high-performance silicon solutions through advanced emulation strategies. 

What You'll Need: 

- 8+ years of relevant experience in emulation, verification, or IP product development. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol and verification strategies. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP verification. 
 - Demonstrated track record in leading IP product development initiatives with a focus on emulation. 
 - Strong background in cross-functional collaboration, with an ability to drive consensus and deliver results. 
 - Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire change across diverse teams. 
 - Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and international environment. 

Who You Are: 

- A proactive and collaborative problem-solver with a passion for excellence. 
 - Innovative thinker who embraces change and seeks out opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 - Strong communicator, able to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Resilient and adaptable, thriving in dynamic environments and embracing new challenges. 
 - Committed to mentoring others and fostering an inclusive, team-oriented culture. 

The Team You'll Be a Part Of: 

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits: 

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

I. The Mission

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a technical visionary who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. 

The Director of Application Development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams and foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

II. The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
 - The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. 
 - Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features. 
 - Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability. 
 - Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
 - Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. 
 - Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security. 
 - Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. 
 - Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. 
 - Organizational Mentorship
 - Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. 
 - Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. 

III. Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)

- Academic Excellence: B. Tech / B. E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA). 

IV. Experience & Skills

- Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). 
 - Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration. 
 - Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. 

High-Weightage Qualifications

- Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e. g. , LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing). 
 - Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures. 
 - A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. 
 - System Reliability: Maintaining 99. 99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. 
 - Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors. 
 - Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. 

V. Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

data.description:
Job Description

The RADAR product line is a rapidly expanding business within TI, investing to address the fast-growing segment in Industrial & automotive markets. This product line will enable a scalable portfolio using DSP and ARM multi-cores to support high-end applications in ADAS, body & Chassis and in Industrial space. Radar systems process digital information from sources like digital cameras, lasers, radar and other sensors to perform tasks such as lane departure warning or parking assistance. The processed information can be displayed on screens or announced via acoustical warning signals. The system has multifaceted features such as High precision ADC, extremely accurate chirp, wide range visibility and Faster scene processing abilities. As a Verification Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced RADAR products. You will be responsible for the verification of IP, Subsystem (SS), and System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, contributing to the development of robust verification methodologies, strategies and team. 

Responsibilities

Complete ownership of IP/subsystem/SOC DV ownership right from spec definition till the post silicon verification and solving the customer issues on need basis. This includes: 

- Build, Mentor and scale high preforming verification team across IP, Subsystem and SoC level
 - Lead verification activities for overall verification strategy, methodology, infrastructure and execution plans across multiple SoC programs. 
 - Verification strategy definition along with Verification plan to meet 100% spec to regression traceability along with signoff metrics. 
 - IP/SS/SOC verification covering functional and Firmware scenarios in RTL/PARTL, GLS/PAGLS modes. 
 - DV Environment ownership: TB development/enhancements including checkers and coverage monitor definitions along with DV flow updates as per the project needs 
 - Active collaboration with cross functional teams -Architecture, RTL, PD, DFT, Systems, Analog, FW and application teams -to enable the Verification goals for IP/Subsystem/SOC starting from spec definition till post silicon verification closure activities
 - Final SoC DV signoff based on Regressions, coverage metrics, DV to spec traceability using C and/or SV-UVM adhering to ISO26262 guidelines 
 - Active involvement in the customer reviews and certifications (ISO26262/ISO21434). 

Qualifications

Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of DV experience in IP/SS/SOC/Post silicon DV with a Bachelor or Master's degree in EE/ECE/CS or related specializations

Skills

- Strong people management skills along with experience in leading DV projects 
 - First pass success silicon success enablement by working closely with team members as well as various cross functional teams
 - Experience in one or more of the following areas: C-based SoC design verification (DV), firmware verification exposure, scripting knowledge (Perl/Python/AI/ML based DV), DV flow ownership for functional/firmware verification, deep understanding of UVM/SystemVerilog, Specman, GLS/PAGLS/CPF/UPF based verification, post-silicon verification, etc. 
 - Thorough knowledge of standard protocols, such as AXI, AHB, APB, CAN, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, UART, and high-speed interfaces like CSI and Ethernet. 
 - Work experience in a C-based environment with complex ARM/DSP multi-processor systems, including power-aware simulations, is a significant plus. 
 - Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals, computer organization and architectures, and bus protocols. 
 - Excellent Analytical, debugging skills with Verilog/VHDL designs. 
 - Good problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with Cadence tools (Xcelium/vManager/Formal JG applications/safety simulator) or similar tools/DV flows. 
 - Proficiency in AMS, CDC digital verification, formal verification, and post-silicon verification, along with familiarity with functional safety and cybersecurity processes, would be advantageous. 
 - Effective communication skills to interact seamlessly with all stakeholders. 
 - Must be highly focused and committed to achieving project goals.
