data.title: Manager, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering will lead a software engineering organization responsible for the development and lifecycle management of software used in a high-acuity care environment. This role combines engineering leadership, organizational leadership, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and AI-enabled transformation. 

The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering software that is safe, secure, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. The role requires close collaboration with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, Program Management, and Operations. 

In addition, the Senior Manager will lead the adoption of AI-augmented engineering practices across software development, verification, documentation, planning, and operational workflows. The leader will ensure AI is used responsibly, securely, and effectively to improve productivity, quality, decision-making, and delivery performance while maintaining appropriate human oversight, regulatory compliance, and patient safety. 

Designs, programs, documents, tests, and fixes bugs involved in creating and maintaining applications and frameworks involved in a software release lifecycle resulting in a digital product. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Has significant input into priorities. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Technical & Delivery Leadership
 - Own software development execution within the team's area of responsibility. 
 - Lead design, development, verification, maintenance, and release activities for regulated software products.

 - Establish and monitor engineering metrics related to quality, predictability, productivity, technical debt, and delivery performance. 
 - Partner with architecture, systems engineering, and product leadership to define technical direction and execution strategy.

 - Track and communicate measurable improvements resulting from AI adoption, including cycle time, quality, automation, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Drive an AI-first mindset while maintaining human accountability for engineering quality, safety, and business outcomes. 
 - People & Organizational Leadership

 - Collaborate with Product Management and Systems Engineering to align technical execution with customer and business needs.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer,  Now
data.description:
Description

Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering - Amazon Now - delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters - with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection - curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
 - Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters - store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations - ensuring architectural coherence across them
 - Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
 - Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
 - Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
 - Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
 - Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life

You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs - weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for a team building AI-native products on the ServiceNow platform. You'll shape how we design, build, and operate systems where AI agents, LLM-driven workflows, and traditional platform engineering work together. This is a hands-on role with broad influence: you'll make architectural calls, raise the engineering bar, and help the team move from AI-assisted development to AI-native delivery. 

What You Get To Do In The Role

- Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-functional features across the platform, from architecture through production operations. 
 - Build AI-native capabilities, including LLM-integrated workflows, agentic patterns, prompt and context design, and evaluation pipelines, with reliability and governance built in. 
 - Define and drive how the team uses AI tools across the development lifecycle: code generation, test automation, review, triage, and documentation. Measure the impact and share what works. 
 - Design for ServiceNow platform internals: Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Decision Management etc
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and set standards for code quality, observability, and safe AI usage. 
 - Partner with product, UX, and other engineering leads to turn ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable plans. 
 - Own production quality for your area, including defect triage, release readiness, and gate reviews. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the staff level or equivalent. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or another language relevant to the platform, plus solid system design skills. 
 - Hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-based features: prompt design, retrieval or context management, evaluation, and cost/latency tradeoffs. 
 - Working knowledge of agentic architectures, including tool use, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily work, with an opinion on where they help and where they don't. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief senior leaders and align multiple teams. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS, multi-tenant systems, and secure, compliant software delivery. 

Nice to have

- Experience with ServiceNow platform development or Flow Designer internals. 
 - Background in workflow automation, or approval systems. 
 - Experience designing AI governance, guardrails, or responsible AI controls. 
 - Contributions to internal or external AI engineering standards or tooling. 

Why this role matters

You'll help define how a 60+ person engineering organization builds with AI, and the patterns you set will shape how customers experience intelligent workflows on the platform. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U. S. data.title: Senior Manager - WSMD Lab (Copper Concentrate)
data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Job Purpose

The QA Lab Head in a copper mining and smelting operation ensures the highest standards of quality across all stages of production by overseeing various lab functions. The role involves managing multiple labs, ensuring compliance with industry regulations, optimizing testing processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve quality control and operational efficiency. 

Responsibilities

Lab Operations Planning and Execution: 

- Manage daily and shift-wise laboratory testing activities in line with smelter production priorities. 
 - Ensure timely receipt, preparation, analysis, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and related process streams. 
 - Coordinate with production, process, and quality teams to prioritize urgent samples and ensure quick analytical feedback for operational decisions. 
 - Monitor adherence to sample collection, labelling, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols to maintain reliability of results. 

Process Optimization And Continuous Improvement

- Identify improvement opportunities in sample preparation, testing turnaround time, analytical accuracy, and laboratory workflow efficiency. 
 - Support implementation of standard methods, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives within WSMD laboratory operations. 
 - Track routine operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the Lab Head and concerned departments. 
 - Assist in adoption of improved analytical practices, automation support, and digital tools for better lab productivity and data reliability. 

Quality Assurance And Control

- Ensure execution of quality control checks, calibration verification, standardization, and validation of analytical results as per defined procedures. 
 - Maintain compliance with approved laboratory SOPs, test methods, internal quality standards, and applicable statutory or customer requirements. 
 - Review routine test data for abnormalities, deviations, or inconsistencies and escalate critical issues to the WSMD Lab Head. 
 - Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for testing errors, repeat analysis, delays, and non-conformities. 

Equipment Readiness And Troubleshooting

- Ensure availability, calibration, routine checks, and proper functioning of laboratory instruments and equipment used for WSMD analysis. 
 - Coordinate with maintenance, OEMs, and service providers for troubleshooting, breakdown resolution, AMC support, and instrument reliability. 
 - Maintain equipment logbooks, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and breakdown history for audit readiness. 
 - Support safe and correct operation of instruments by lab chemists, technicians, and shift personnel. 

HSE And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure strict adherence to HSE requirements, PPE usage, chemical handling procedures, waste disposal norms, and emergency response protocols inside the WSMD Lab. 
 - Conduct routine safety observations, housekeeping checks, and compliance follow-ups in coordination with the Lab Head and Safety team. 
 - Support compliance with environmental and statutory requirements related to laboratory chemicals, residues, samples, and waste streams. 
 - Promote safe work practices among lab team members and ensure timely closure of safety observations and audit points. 

Cost Management And Budgeting

- Monitor consumption of chemicals, reagents, gases, standards, glassware, spares, and other laboratory consumables to support uninterrupted operations. 
 - Assist the Lab Head in inventory planning, PR follow-up, vendor coordination, and cost control initiatives for routine lab requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, optimize reagent usage, and improve cost efficiency without compromising testing quality. 
 - Maintain records of consumable usage, stock levels, and critical inventory items for operational planning and audit purposes. 

Shift Team Coordination And Capability Building

- Coordinate daily work allocation for lab chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel as per testing load and operational requirements. 
 - Guide team members on standard test procedures, safe lab practices, instrument handling, documentation, and quality expectations. 
 - Support training, skill development, and multi-skilling of laboratory team members to build operational flexibility. 
 - Ensure continuity of laboratory operations during shifts, peak workload, audits, and absence of senior leadership, while developing readiness to succeed the WSMD Lead role in future. 

Reporting And Data Analytics

- Ensure timely preparation, review, and submission of routine analytical reports, shift reports, quality summaries, deviation reports, and MIS data. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation of sample records, test results, calibration data, corrective actions, and audit-related information. 
 - Analyze lab performance trends such as turnaround time, repeat testing, deviations, equipment uptime, and sample load to support improvement actions. 
 - Escalate critical quality trends, abnormal results, and urgent operational issues to the WSMD Lab Head and concerned stakeholders. 

Digitization And Tech Adoption

- Support use of SAP Lab/LIMS and other digital systems for sample tracking, result entry, report generation, and data traceability. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate digital updating of test results, equipment records, calibration schedules, and lab MIS. 
 - Assist in implementation of automation, dashboards, and data-driven reporting practices to improve laboratory efficiency. 
 - Promote disciplined data entry, record retention, and system compliance among lab team members. 

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related science/engineering discipline

Master's degree in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

Over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the Copper Manufacturing industry

Relevant experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process lab functions, preferably in copper smelting, metals, mining, chemicals, or process industry environment; suitable for Senior Manager level with team coordination, operational ownership, and future leadership readiness

Certifications

Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance

data.title: Architect - System Performance Verification and Analysis
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. 

NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. Our work spans the full pre-silicon and post-silicon lifecycle: performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon bringup. We catch bugs early, influence architecture and design decisions, and help ensure that the final product delivers the performance that our customers depend on. If you are passionate about building the hardware that underpins the future of AI and computing, this is where you belong. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner with System Architecture, Usecase Modeling, Unit Architecture/PV, and Design/Verification teams to define comprehensive performance test plans that reflect real product usecases. 
 - Drive full-chip SoC performance verification across all real engines and subsystems, running realistic concurrent workloads that represent how the product will be used by customers in the field. 
 - Execute performance test plans across the full verification stack: cycle-accurate performance models, RTL simulation, emulation platforms, and silicon, identifying bottlenecks and regressions at each stage. 
 - Debug performance failures through waveform analysis, signal-level queries, trace analysis, and system-level profiling to root-cause issues in the memory subsystem, fabric, or individual engines. 
 - Influence architecture and microarchitecture decisions by surfacing performance data and trade-off analysis to the design and architecture teams early in the product development cycle. 
 - Develop and maintain performance workloads, test suites, and infrastructure - including testbench components, performance simulators, analysis scripts, and automated regression flows. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools and automation to accelerate repetitive analysis tasks, improve coverage, and free up engineering time for higher-level problem solving. This includes using LLM-based assistants for querying results and specs, AI-driven triage of regressions, and intelligent tooling that improves over time. 
 - Drive methodology improvements to reduce verification turnaround time, improve coverage of representative workloads, and enable earlier performance insight in the product development cycle. 

What We Need To See

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. S. /M. Tech (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 3+ years of relevant experience in SoC or system-level architecture, performance verification, or hardware validation. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC architecture including GPU and CPU pipelines, memory subsystem design (caches, DRAM controllers, coherency), Network-on-Chip (NoC)/fabric architecture, and high-speed IO interfaces. 
 - Hands-on experience with RTL simulation and debug, including waveform-based debug and signal-level querying to isolate performance failures. 
 - Solid programming skills in Python and C/C++; scripting proficiency in Bash/Python for automation and analysis. Exposure to Verilog/SystemVerilog or SystemC/TLM is a strong plus. 
 - Strong debugging, data analysis, and statistical analysis skills - ability to synthesize large volumes of performance data into actionable insights. 
 - Experience with or exposure to pre-silicon performance analysis methodologies, including performance models, cycle-approximate simulators, or emulation platforms. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a large, globally distributed engineering organization. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Deep experience with RTL-level performance debug - particularly the ability to formulate precise signal queries and interpret waveforms to root-cause complex system-level interactions. 
 - Background in system-level performance analysis for GPU, AI accelerators, or high-bandwidth memory subsystems, with knowledge of bottleneck identification across multiple concurrent engines. 
 - Demonstrated use of AI and LLM-based tools (e. g. , NVIDIA NIM/NeMo, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or similar agentic frameworks) to measurably improve your own engineering productivity - whether for automated analysis, natural-language querying of data, intelligent triage, or workflow automation. 
 - Experience building or deploying ML/AI-assisted tooling in an engineering or EDA context (e. g. , regression analysis, anomaly detection, test generation, coverage closure). 
 - Expertise in data analysis and visualization - ability to build dashboards and tooling that surface performance trends clearly to both engineering and architecture stakeholders.

data.title: Quality Specialist - Bengali, AGI Data Services - Quality
data.description:
Description

Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence. 

Key job responsibilities

- Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
 - Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
 - Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
 - Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
 - Analyze data trends and develop solutions
 - Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
 - Create and maintain quality metrics reports
 - Handle customer escalations and recommendations
 - Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
 - Support process documentation and implementation. 

A day in the life

Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows - reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 

About The Team

The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 - Advanced-level proficiency or C1+ in Bengali language (Strong verbal and written communication skills, with fluency in speaking, listening, and writing. )
 - Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
 - Experience in creating and maintaining process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e. g. , Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
 - Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
 - Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams

The Opportunity

ACA believes that we can deliver the world's best GRC software to our blue-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. We are seeking top talent to join us in our journey to build and deliver "The Salesforce of Compliance". Compliance Officers in finance have been stuck in the past, with inefficient, manual effort driving their compliance programs. ACA's ComplianceAlpha is deployed at 800+ clients, with more added daily, to help modernize that. We are investing significantly to drive technology adoption among our clients. 

The SDET role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each SDET will be part of a geo-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint. 

We are looking for an imaginative self-starter with a passion for great software and a curiosity for developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills. 

What To Expect Day To Day

- Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team.

 - Collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage. 
 - Investigate failures, identify root causes, and help improve the overall quality of our platform. 
 - Explore and adopt new testing techniques, tools, and automation strategies.

Required Skills

Skills and attributes for success

- Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies.

data.description:
About Team

The Data Services team within Global Technology Platform powers mission-critical data infrastructure across the enterprise, enabling SQL, NoSQL, and messaging services for tens of thousands of deployments across Walmart Global Tech. These platforms support multi-petabyte-scale data, millions of requests per second, and extremely high availability requirements for applications used across Walmart stores, digital channels, supply chain, and internal enterprise systems. 

The candidate will shape the architecture and evolution of database capabilities across the organization, with a strong focus on Search & Cache systems. You will work on some of the most complex database challenges in the industry including automated scaling, recovery, large scale system design and schema registry. 

As a Distinguished Engineer, you will operate as a hands-on technical leader, influencing platform strategy, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering closely with application teams to design and operate complex, high-scale systems. You will help build sophisticated tooling and platforms on top of open-source and commercial database technologies, tailoring them to Walmart's scale, reliability, security, and developer productivity needs. 

What You'll DoDefine and drive the long-term technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the data services teams. 

Lead the design and evolution of highly available, scalable, secure, and operationally efficient NoSQL platforms that support mission-critical workloads at enterprise scale. 

Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across large installations, including performance degradation, query regressions, replication issues, availability incidents, capacity constraints, and operational bottlenecks. 

Build and influence sophisticated tooling, automation, and platform capabilities that improve database reliability, performance, observability, developer productivity, and operational simplicity. 

Partner with application engineering teams to design, review, and optimize database architectures for complex distributed systems and high-throughput workloads. 

Establish technical standards, best practices, reference architectures, and operational patterns for database usage across the organization. 

Influence senior engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and execution plans. 

Mentor principal and senior engineers, raising the technical bar across database engineering, distributed systems, performance engineering, and production operations. 

What You'll Bring12+ years of software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or database engineering experience, with significant depth in database systems. 

Deep hands-on expertise in any database system at scale, preferably NoSQL databases with strong understanding of database internals. 

Proven experience debugging and operating complex database deployments in production, including high-availability, high-throughput, and low-latency environments. 

Experience designing and operating database platforms with strong reliability, availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, observability, security, and compliance characteristics. 

Strong systems engineering background, with the ability to reason deeply about distributed systems, concurrency, networking, storage, failure modes, and capacity planning. 

Experience building automation, tooling, or platform capabilities around open-source or commercial database systems. 

Proven ability to define technical strategy, drive architecture across teams, and influence large-scale engineering direction without relying solely on formal authority. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex database and platform concepts to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Strong track record of mentoring engineers, reviewing architecture, and raising engineering standards across a large organization. 

Strong programming experience in one or more systems or platform languages such as Java, Python, C++, Go. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Flexible Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 6 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Option 2: 8 years' experience in software engineering or related area. 

Preferred Qualifications. . . Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications. 

Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 4 years' experience in software engineering or related area, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. 2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart's accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.

data.title: AI Engineering Manager
data.description:
Manager/Team Lead - Agentic AI, ML

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Summary

As Manager - AI Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering GenAI-powered solutions, agentic AI systems, LLM-integrated applications, machine learning models, and retrieval-enabled intelligent products. This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement. 

This is not a lightweight line-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands-on technical direction across LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Lead AI Engineers, Lead Data Scientists, Platform teams, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable engineering work and durable product outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth
 - Own end-to-end delivery of GenAI, agentic AI, and ML-enabled solutions - from discovery, design, and backlog shaping through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
 - Guide architectural and design decisions across LLM-powered systems, embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool-enabled workflows, ML model pipelines, APIs, and cloud-native application services
 - Oversee the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of machine learning models for predictive, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, optimization, or other business use cases where applicable
 - Ensure strong practices across feature engineering, experimentation, validation, model performance assessment, explainability, drift awareness, and MLOps readiness
 - Translate business and product priorities into executable engineering and data science plans, technical workstreams, model delivery milestones, and sustainable release outcomes
 - Review and challenge implementation choices to ensure systems and models are scalable, secure, observable, cost-aware, and maintainable
 - Partner with Product Managers and engineering leadership to prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and align delivery with roadmap goals
 - Establish strong SDLC and build-own-operate practices within the team, including design reviews, code reviews, model reviews, automated testing, release readiness, production support, reliability improvement, and technical debt management
 - Drive reuse and productivity by scaling frameworks, shared components, prompt templates, orchestration patterns, feature templates, modeling utilities, evaluation frameworks, and internal accelerators across the team
 - Promote a culture of responsible AI and operational excellence, emphasizing security, token and cost governance, model safety, quality, observability, reproducibility, and supportability
 - Coordinate with cloud platform, DevOps, Security, Integration, Architecture, and data teams to ensure enterprise readiness of all deployments
 - Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance development, and growth plans for both the AI Engineering and Data Science team members
 - Track and communicate KPIs related to delivery, GenAI adoption, model quality, latency, business impact, reliability, experimentation outcomes, and production performance
 - Act as the primary technical and delivery escalation point for the team, helping remove blockers and resolve design, modeling, execution, and operational issues

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI / ML engineering, data science, solution engineering, or technology delivery, including strong experience building and operating production-grade intelligent systems
 - 4 to 5 + years of experience delivering or leading AI / ML / GenAI / LLM-powered solutions in enterprise or product environments
 - Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams or technical pods delivering LLM-powered products, agentic AI workflows, machine learning models, or AI-enabled application capabilities, with accountability for both technical quality and delivery outcomes
 - Strong technical depth in Python, modern backend engineering, machine learning solution delivery, API-first architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native application delivery
 - Strong hands-on or design-level experience with LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise GenAI delivery
 - Strong experience designing or guiding implementations involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, vector search, grounding strategies, and retrieval optimization using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of machine learning model development, including feature engineering, model training, validation, tuning, evaluation, performance interpretation, and production-readiness considerations
 - Practical experience guiding or reviewing MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection, retraining readiness, and reproducibility
 - Experience building and deploying AI- and ML-enabled cloud-native services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness for AI-driven and ML-enabled systems
 - Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction models, memory / context management approaches, and other distributed AI coordination patterns
 - Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent platforms, including monitoring of reliability, latency, cost, runtime behavior, and model / workflow health
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI implementation patterns, including multi-step orchestration, tool calling, context management, and workflow decomposition
 - Experience integrating AI- and ML-enabled solutions with REST APIs, enterprise systems, workflow platforms, event-driven services, or downstream business applications
 - Demonstrated ability to translate business and product needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI / ML engineering solutions, while guiding teams on implementation trade-offs, experimentation choices, and delivery sequencing
 - Strong SDLC ownership mindset across design, build, testing, deployment, support, reliability improvement, model lifecycle management, and long-term maintainability
 - Proven ability to raise engineering and data science quality through code reviews, model reviews, design guidance, architectural mentoring, coaching of senior engineers and data scientists, and reinforcement of reusable patterns and standards
 - Strong people leadership capability, including coaching, feedback, performance management, capability development, and fostering accountability and engineering excellence
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data science, product, platform, architecture, DevOps, and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading implementations involving agentic AI workflows, multi-agent coordination, tool-enabled automation, reusable orchestration abstractions, or structured task delegation patterns
 - Experience with AI observability, prompt safety, runtime guardrails, hallucination mitigation, evaluation frameworks, quality monitoring, and enterprise governance practices for GenAI systems
 - Familiarity with broader enterprise AI and ML platforms such as Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, PromptFlow, MLflow, Databricks, or equivalent AI / ML lifecycle and experimentation ecosystems
 - Experience leading or supporting teams working on forecasting, optimization, recommender systems, anomaly detection, classification, NLP, or hybrid ML + GenAI solutions

ChangeMan developer with open systems experience to drive our VSCode extension and Git integration roadmap

 - Partner with the mainframe/ChangeMan team to ensure the two worlds stay in sync

Required Qualifications

- Strong TypeScript/Node. js; hands-on experience building VSCode extensions
 - Deep Git experience branching/merge models and Git internals, not just CLI usage
 - Solid CI/CD engineering (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent)
 - Containerization experience (Docker/Kubernetes)
 - REST/API design experience, including integrating with backend systems you don't control end-to-end
 - Working cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building GitOps-based deployment models
 - Microservices delivery patterns and trunk-based development practice, not just familiarity
 - Experience designing platform/control-plane abstractions for hybrid or multi-target delivery

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. 

Department Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active SIP based microservices across multi-site deployments. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and architect high-throughput, stateless SIP microservices using Go, achieving strict performance targets such as 5, 000+ TPS and sub-15ms latency budgets. 
 - Implement complex protocol translation layers to convert inbound SIP-over-TCP/TLS traffic from load balancers into high-speed SIP-over-ZeroMQ traffic for internal stateless services. 
 - Engineer advanced concurrency models utilizing ZeroMQ Router/Dealer socket pooling and internal thread-bridging patterns to prevent mutex bottlenecks and ensure thread-safe message passing under heavy load. 
 - Integrate distributed state and security mechanisms, including automated cryptographic key rotation using discovery tools for leader election and secured vaults for private key storage. 
 - Enforce surge protection and reliability by building multi-layered throttling, distributed batch schedulers, and exponential backoff handling
 - Partner with Network and Infrastructure teams to define advanced load balancer routing frameworks, DNS SRV query logic, and implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) for end-to-end observability. 

Basic Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

- Knowledge of SIP/VOIP & related telecom protocols. 
 - Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in c++/c
 - Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, stateless proxies and Finite State Machines (FSM). 
 - Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC and RabbitMQ. 
 - Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain. 
 - Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and ElasticSearch. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. 
 - Industry Experience - 8+ years

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. 

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you'd like to join our team but feel that you don't quite meet all of the preferred skills, we'd still love to hear why you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

data.title: Principal AI Engineer
data.description:
Bring more to life. 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher's 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives-and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. 

You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher's system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact - innovating at the speed of life. 

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory's role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1. 2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making-we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence. 

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. 

The Principal AI Engineer - R&D is a senior individual-contributor technology leader responsible for defining the architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction for enterprise AI solutions that transform research and development across Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. This role combines hands-on solution design and development with cross-functional technical leadership to build, validate, and scale production-grade AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, and intelligent engineering workflows across product development, systems engineering, software engineering, verification and validation, quality, and regulatory activities. The Principal AI Engineer partners with R&D and technology leaders to identify high-value opportunities, establish reusable architecture patterns and responsible AI controls, mentor engineering teams, and deliver secure, observable, compliant solutions that improve productivity, product quality, traceability, and speed to market. This position reports to the AI Transformation Leader and is part of the Global Technology Organization located in Bangalore, India and will be an on-site role. 

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

- Architect and deliver production-grade AI agents, engineering assistants, and agentic workflows that improve requirements development, systems engineering, risk management, design reviews, technical documentation, and end-to-end traceability. 
 - Design and scale intelligent solutions that accelerate software development, code and test generation, verification and validation, defect investigation, technical data analysis, and repetitive engineering work. 
 - Develop secure and scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions grounded in engineering documentation, standards, technical reports, design history files, and lessons learned. 
 - Own the technical direction for agent architecture, orchestration frameworks, model selection and evaluation, reusable design patterns, enterprise integration, and standards for AI governance, validation, security, observability, model risk management, and responsible AI. 
 - Partner with R&D, quality, regulatory, security, and technology teams to prioritize high-value use cases, lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and scale solutions that deliver measurable improvements in productivity, product quality, traceability, and speed to market. 

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical discipline. 
 - 14+years of experience developing enterprise software solutions using Python, C#, Java, or similar languages in medical device industry. 
 - Experience building AI applications utilizing LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, and cloud AI services (Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent). 

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements: if applicable for role

- 25% Ability to travel domestic and international
 - Must have a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record
 - Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 25lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in: 

- Medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries. 
 - Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), requirements management, risk management, or engineering lifecycle tools. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. 

For more information, visit www. danaher. com.

data.title: R&D Principal Technologist, Product Development
data.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. 

Job Title: R&D Principal Technologist, Product Development

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement

The Job

At AVEVA, we're looking for an experienced R&D Principal Technologist to join the Predictive Analytics product team. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building modern, scalable enterprise applications that work with large-scale industrial and time-series datasets and deliver rich, responsive user experiences. 

The role requires strong full-stack development expertise with a primary focus on frontend engineering using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS, along with solid experience in C#/. NET, REST APIs, and backend services. 

You will design and deliver complex product features across the full stack, contribute to frontend architecture and modernization, and work closely with Product Management, UX, QA, Architecture, and other R&D teams. You will also help establish frontend engineering practices that improve performance, maintainability, usability, and developer productivity. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop modern, responsive, and maintainable web applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS. 
 - Lead the design and implementation of complex frontend features, reusable components, services, and common UI patterns. 
 - Contribute across the full stack, developing and integrating C#/. NET APIs, services, and backend components as required. 
 - Design user experiences that remain responsive and performant when working with large datasets, complex visualizations, and data-intensive workflows. 
 - Identify and resolve frontend performance bottlenecks, including rendering, memory usage, network utilization, data loading, and application responsiveness. 
 - Apply modern Angular architecture and development practices, including component design, state management, reactive programming, routing, forms, and asynchronous data handling. 
 - Collaborate closely with UX and Product Management to translate product and usability requirements into intuitive and consistent user experiences. 
 - Develop reusable UI components and frameworks that improve consistency, maintainability, and development efficiency across the product. 
 - Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services, ensuring efficient data transfer, error handling, security, and reliability. 
 - Champion engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, secure coding, accessibility, performance optimization, and clean coding practices. 
 - Contribute to product modernization, technical discovery, prototyping, and evaluation of new frontend technologies and frameworks. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to raising frontend and full-stack engineering capability within the team. 

Essential Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of professional software development experience building enterprise web applications. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS. 
 - Strong understanding of Angular architecture, component design, services, dependency injection, routing, reactive programming/RxJS, and modern frontend development patterns. 
 - Experience designing complex, reusable, and maintainable UI components and frontend frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization, particularly for applications working with large datasets and data-intensive user interfaces. 
 - Experience developing responsive, accessible, and cross-browser enterprise applications. 
 - Good hands-on experience with C#/. NET, REST APIs, and backend service development, with the ability to contribute across the full technology stack. 
 - Strong understanding of API integration, asynchronous programming, error handling, authentication/authorization, and client-server application architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, design patterns, automated testing, Git, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience with frontend testing frameworks and approaches covering unit, component, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Experience building data-intensive, analytics-driven, or visualization-heavy enterprise applications. 
 - Experience optimizing large-data workflows across UI rendering, API calls, pagination, caching, lazy loading, virtualization, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Experience with modern UI component libraries, data grids, charting/visualization frameworks, and complex interactive controls. 
 - Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, reusable component libraries, and application modernization. 
 - Experience with web accessibility, responsive design, localization/internationalization, browser compatibility, and frontend security. 
 - Experience working with modern authentication and authorization patterns such as OIDC and JWT. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native application development, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Azure-based environments. 
 - Understanding of backend and distributed-system concepts including microservices, asynchronous messaging, caching, and resiliency. 
 - Strong production-first mindset with experience troubleshooting UI, API, performance, and integration issues in enterprise applications. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and their responsible use for development, testing, documentation, and engineering productivity. 
 - Experience with industrial analytics, process data, historian platforms, time-series data, or similar data-intensive products is an advantage. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed Agile/Scrum product development teams. 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. 

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. 

You'll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® CertifiedTM in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

About The Team / Role

At WEX, we simplify the business of running a business. Our WEX Benefits solutions reduce complexity and help manage costs of benefits administration for our clients and partners. We are looking for passionate technologists, collaborators, and problem solvers to join our Benefits Technology team as we build the next generation of employer benefits solutions and services. 

As a Software Engineering manager on the WEX Benefits Technology team, you will lead a team that partners closely with Product Managers and customers to learn about the challenges employers face while navigating the competitive employee benefits landscape. You will design solutions that solve problems in ways our customers love and work for our business. You will build the highest quality software in the latest technologies and test driven development practices. 

You will hire and groom engineers, work with stakeholders to define technology and product roadmaps. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Collaborate with stakeholders to learn about our customers biggest challenges. 
 - Measure, inspect, and drive decisions using data. 
 - Design, test, code, and instrument new solutions. 
 - Strengthen and drive our engineering process with TDD and BDD, Microservice and Vertical Slice Architectures. 
 - Support live applications, promote proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and continuous improvement. 
 - Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements. 
 - Mentor and learn from your peers, foster continuous learning within your team and organization. 
 - Lead initiatives for your team by using your wide-ranging experience and deep technical knowledge to make decisions on method and approach to solving issues. 
 - Hold your team accountable for delivering quality results using defined OKRs. 
 - Interact with Senior Managers to discuss plans, results, and advise on complex matters. 

Experience You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; OR demonstrable equivalent experience. 
 - At least 10 years of experience in software engineering. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Passionate about keeping up with modern technologies and design. 
 - Strong proficiency in Angular and/or React
