data.description:
Location

Pune

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10054453

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg delivers billions of data points to hundreds of thousands of customers daily. When markets move, our customers need their data immediately and without fail. That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole product. 

The Data License Reliability & Analytics group exists to make sure that promise holds - and to make sure we keep it efficiently. Our new Pune-based DL Optimization & Automation team will build the AI tooling and the context layer that lets engineers, SREs, and AI agents across Data License reason about our systems the way our most experienced people do: which pipelines feed which products, where capacity is wasted, which risks are real, and what to fix first. 

Role

In this role, you'll build and lead a team that puts AI to work on one of the most demanding data platforms in financial services. Your team will create intelligent systems that make Data License leaner, safer, and easier to run: 

Smarter use of infrastructure - finding where compute, storage, and other system resources are over-provisioned or idle, and turning that insight into action. 

Sharper data products - analyzing how the datasets in our Data License packages are built, delivered, and used, so we can keep improving what we offer clients. 

Security, risk, and compliance on autopilot - automating the evidence-gathering, tracking, and reporting that keep us ahead of evolving regulatory and security requirements. 

Maintenance that runs itself - finding the routine upkeep that consumes engineering time and handing it to machines. 

Underpinning all of this is an AI context layer you'll help design: a living, machine-readable understanding of our systems, data, and dependencies that lets engineers and AI agents answer hard questions in minutes instead of weeks. 

You will lead a team of four engineers, setting its technical direction and driving projects from idea to delivery. You'll work closely with engineering teams across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure - as well as our reliability teams in New York and Dublin - turning their hardest operational questions into tools they rely on every day. 

What You'd Actually Be Working On

- Building and leading the team. Build and grow a team of four engineers. Set a high bar for engineering quality and analytical rigor, run the team's planning and delivery, and create an environment where people ship useful things quickly and learn fast. You'll stay hands-on - this is a lead who writes code and reviews designs, not just one who runs meetings. 
 - The AI context layer. Design and evolve the knowledge foundation our AI tools stand on: architecture knowledge bases, semantic models and ontologies of our data and services, and knowledge graphs that connect code, configuration, telemetry, and incident history. You'll own retrieval quality across RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, decide how knowledge is structured, verified, and kept fresh, and make sure an agent's answer can always be traced back to a source. 
 - AI-driven optimization of systems, processes, and architecture. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable tooling. Build analytics that find underused machines and tenancies, unneeded storage and datasets, and architectural bottlenecks - and quantify the impact of acting on them. If we answered a question once by hand, you'll be figuring out how to answer it on demand. 
 - Agents and MCP tooling. Build MCP servers and AI agents that expose Data License systems and knowledge to engineers and to other agents, and use agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns to compose them into multi-step workflows. Work on context retrieval, prompt and tool design, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make these systems more accurate over time. 
 - Risk and compliance analytics. Own the automated analytics behind regulatory and risk programs such as emerging cyber-resilience regulation and enterprise risk management: scanning codebases and inventories, tracking remediation, and producing evidence that holds up to scrutiny from auditors and leadership. 
 - Tools people actually use. Build the web applications, dashboards, and reports (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) that put these insights in front of engineers, managers, and leadership, and make them self-service. 
 - Shaping the AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). Help define how Data License builds software with AI agents - agentic development workflows, guardrails, and evaluation. Your team will be an early adopter and an example for the rest of the organization. 
 - Partnering across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure. Work directly with application, platform, and SRE teams to understand their problems, review designs, and bring data to architecture decisions. You'll be the person teams come to when they want to know what a change will really cost, what it will save, and what it might break. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years writing production software, with strong Python and solid JavaScript/TypeScript
 - 2+ years leading engineers - as a team lead, tech lead, or in a role where you owned a team's technical direction and delivery
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent hands-on experience
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs: RAG pipelines, prompt and tool design, agents, or evaluation of AI output quality
 - Experience building full-stack applications, including React front-ends and Python back-end services and APIs
 - A data-driven mindset: you measure before you optimize, you show your evidence, and you're skeptical of conclusions - including an AI's - that can't be traced to a source
 - Strong communication skills. You'll lead a team in Pune while partnering with teams in New York, Dublin, and elsewhere, so you need to explain trade-offs clearly and build consensus without authority
 - Willingness to pick up new tools fast - this field changes month to month

What Would Set You Apart

- Experience with GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic modeling
 - Building or deploying MCP servers, multi-agent systems, or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols in production
 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for LLM and agent systems - retrieval accuracy, groundedness, regression testing
 - Background in SRE, observability, or infrastructure analytics: capacity planning, cost and utilization optimization, telemetry (metrics, logs, traces)
 - Familiarity with data platforms such as Spark, Iceberg, Trino, or PostgreSQL
 - Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud or virtualized compute environments
 - Exposure to software supply-chain security, regulatory compliance, or risk management programs
 - A track record of building a team from the ground up, or of hiring and growing engineers into leads
 - Experience in a consulting or advisory role where you influenced engineering decisions across multiple teams

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime, feel free to have a look at this: 

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.

data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers in the technology field. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. The NVIDIA Silicon Co-Design Group is seeking a versatile engineer to join our High Speed SERDES IO electrical validation team. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

This role focuses on industry-leading high-speed interconnects such as PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, and UFS. You will perform bring-up and electrical validation with a strong emphasis on quality, stability, and efficiency. Additionally, you will leverage AI-assisted workflows, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance validation quality, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve engineering efficiency. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, technology-driven environment influencing product lines that span artificial intelligence, consumer graphics, self-driving cars, and more. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Execute electrical validation for PCIe, Ethernet, USB3, and UFS interfaces for NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SOCs, ensuring adherence to signal integrity standards. 
 - Engage with cross-functional engineering teams to facilitate the design and development process, leveraging your knowledge of firmware/driver interactions and circuit design. 
 - Analyze complex HSIO bugs by applying strong debugging techniques and collaborating with various teams for rapid resolution. 
 - Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. 
 - Develop and apply test/debug programs using scripting languages (such as Perl and Python) to perform stress and failure analysis on high-speed interfaces. 
 - Innovate methodologies that leverage AI-assisted workflows and data-driven analytics to enhance debugging efficiency and improve validation quality. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electronics Engineering (or equivalent experience) with at least 3 years of relevant experience. 
 - Deep high-speed/SERDES electrical validation and tuning experience, with strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. 
 - Proven experience in building AI solutions specifically in the context of electrical and silicon validation, including designing and implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation frameworks to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality. 

If you are energized by challenging problems, real ownership, deep work, and AI-enabled engineering at scale, we'd love to talk to you. 

, , JR2025319

The Role Of The Principal Engineer Includes

 - Technical Leadership

 - Partner with a dedicated Design Lead to deliver high-confidence designs
 - Verify designs implemented in SystemVerilog RTL using industry-standard methodologies. 
 - Domain Expertise
 - Contribute to the development and enhancement of verification technologies and methodologies. 
 - Cross Functional Responsibility
 - Collaborate with Software and Validation teams to deliver devices that integrate into a wider system. 
 - Participate in Product Validation during the prototype stage of development. 
Requirements/Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
 - 8+ years related experience
 - Excellent analytical and debugging skills and the ability to proactively solve issues
 - Proven ability to thrive on, learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies
 - Strong coding skills
 - Experience using one or more of System Verilog/Verilog/VHDL, Tcl/Perl/Python, C/C++

data.title: QA Engineer - Networking L2/L3 Testing | 4 - 8 yrs
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco IOS XR Routing and BNG Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco's carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across Layer 2, Layer 3, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, and web-scale customers operating some of the world's largest and most demanding networks. 

Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing and Broadband Network Gateway capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations. 

Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing and BNG features. 
 - Validate BNG subscriber technologies, including IPoE, PPP, PPPoE, DHCPv4/DHCPv6, DHCP relay, Prefix Delegation, RADIUS, AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, subscriber policies, and session lifecycle management. 
 - Test Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies such as Ethernet, VLAN, QinQ, LACP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, Segment Routing, L2VPN, L3VPN, EVPN, ECMP, BFD, QoS, and high-availability mechanisms. 
 - Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools. 
 - Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms. 
 - Validate control-plane, forwarding-plane, subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, software upgrade, rollback, process restart, route churn, and subscriber churn scenarios. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data. 
 - Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing. 
 - Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation. 
 - Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. 
 - 4 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering. 
 - Strong knowledge of BNG architecture and subscriber-management technologies, including PPP/PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS, AAA, accounting, and subscriber session management. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including TCP/IP, Ethernet, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and MPLS. 
 - Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios. 
 - Strong Linux or Unix skills and experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working experience of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack. 
 - Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools. 
 - Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development life cycle. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing BNG and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, or NCS 5500/5700. 
 - Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent. 
 - Knowledge of advanced BNG features, including subscriber QoS, dynamic policy activation, etc. 
 - Experience with L2VPN, EVPN, telemetry, and network programmability. 
 - Familiarity with scale and performance characterization. 
 - CCNP Service Provider, CCIE Service Provider, DevNet Professional, or equivalent technical knowledge. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Software Engineer

Job Overview

You'll join the Real Time Payments (RTP) Platform, Tooling & Engineering Enablement team as a senior technical individual contributor. We uplift engineering across RTP and act as a force multiplier for the program. We align RTP to Mastercard standards and push beyond them across platform, CI/CD, and governance, while driving developer experience and AI enablement. You'll bring deep SME knowledge and experience to complex and open problems across the RTP program. You'll work with many teams across RTP Engineering, while owning your time and output. 

How success is measured

The Team Is Measured On Four Key Areas

- Developer Experience - DX improves across RTP and stays above the Mastercard benchmark
 - Innovation & Architecture - the right technology comes into RTP, and what works is shared back with the enterprise
 - AI Enablement - AI is adopted consistently and acts as a force multiplier across RTP
 - Standards & Governance - Mastercard and RTP standards embedded, with teams, including our own, held to them

Major Accountabilities

- Bring SME expertise to drive significant improvements to how RTP builds, tests, and ships software
 - Architect secure, resilient, and scalable solutions with clear, well-documented designs
 - Take on open and uncertain problems, analysing data and areas of failure or inefficiency, and turn findings into clear recommendations
 - Look ahead at engineering practice, identifying where approved technology can improve how RTP works
 - Drive practical AI adoption across RTP Engineering teams using approved tools
 - Help embed standards and governance by driving adoption, auditing how we work, and turning gaps into actions we own or items for the program tech roadmap
 - Support program-wide teams, customers, and initiatives
 - Make complex technical topics accessible to leadership through clear communication and reporting
 - Coach and mentor engineers across cross-functional teams

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering, or equivalent experience

Knowledge / Experience

- Strong experience in software engineering and architecture, with Java desired
 - Strong experience in platform engineering and cloud
 - Strong experience in CI/CD
 - Experience in technical leadership, setting direction on complex technical problems
 - Experience using AI in day-to-day engineering, such as AI coding assistants and agents, and driving its adoption across teams
 - Experience embedding engineering standards, including design, secure coding, and testing
 - Experience preparing and delivering executive-level presentations to business and technology audiences
 - Experience mentoring and developing engineers in a high-performance culture
 - Experience influencing teams without direct authority
 - Knowledge of payments, or experience working in a regulated industry

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description: 

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Platform architecture and evolution

Function - Infrastructure & Operations

Coverage - Across all clients

Role Overview

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is the senior technical owner of Merkle Denmark's cloud platform architecture. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the cloud foundations, guardrails, and platform capabilities that underpin client operations - ensuring environments are reliable, secure, and well-governed. 

The role is a hands-on specialist position. It sets the direction for how cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and hardened across client accounts, and provides deep technical input on complex incidents, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. People leadership, resource allocation, and day-to-day team direction sit with the Engineering Director. 

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering

- Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments. 
 - Define secure-by-design patterns, guardrails, and platform standards for Cloud Operations to operate within. 
 - Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery. 
 - Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of the platform approach, ensuring it evolves with client needs and industry practice. 
 - Provide specialist guidance to Cloud Operations Engineers during complex incident investigations, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. 
 - Assess and respond to critical CVEs and security advisory items, coordinating with dentsu EMEA security where required. 

Operational Governance

- Define platform-level patterns that support incident management, change management, SLA governance, and on-call practice. 
 - Provide senior technical input on P1/critical incidents and client-impacting situations where infrastructure or platform expertise is needed. 
 - Ensure platform ownership responsibilities are clearly defined and applied - Cloud Ops owns production stability; Cloud Infrastructure owns design and evolution. 
 - Maintain platform design standards that support audit-readiness, NIS2, and client contractual obligations. 
 - Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics. 

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

- Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise. 
 - Collaborate with Project Managers and delivery teams on change planning, release readiness, and deployment governance. 
 - Contribute to account-level technical conversations, including architecture reviews and SLA design. 
 - Support pre-sales and proposal work where infrastructure architecture or managed operations expertise is required. 

Must-Have Skillset -

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer -Over 8+ years of exp

- Cloud Architecture Expertise (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC)Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments
 - Cloud Security & Compliance Secure-by-design architecture principles Platform-level security controls, vulnerability/CVE management Understanding of compliance frameworks, governance, and audit requirements
 - Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Design and implementation of DR, backup, restore, and resilience strategiesHigh availability and fault-tolerant architecture design
 - ITIL / ITSM Knowledge Strong understanding of: Incident Management hange Management Problem Management SLA Governance
 - Critical Incident & Escalation Management Experience providing technical leadership during P1/P0 incidents Root cause analysis and architecture-level problem resolution
 - Operational Governance Define platform standards, operational patterns, and best practices Support incident, change, and service management frameworks
 - Client & Stakeholder Management Act as senior technical advisor during architecture reviews Experience working directly with enterprise clients and stakeholders
 - Multi-Cloud & Managed Services Experience Experience in professional services, managed operations, or multi-client environments Understanding of contractual obligations, SLAs, and service delivery models
 - Technical Skills Networking (VNet/VPC, VPN, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls)Windows/Linux Server Administration Containers & Kubernetes Monitoring & Observability tools Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
 - Experience with NIS2, GDPR, and data processing regulations
 - Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD expertise
 - Excellent written and verbal English communication Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders

Nice-to-Have

- Danish language proficiency
 - Public sector or enterprise platform experience

Working Context

The role sits within the Merkle Denmark engineering organisation, reporting to the CTO and working closely with the Engineering Director, Infrastructure & Operations. The Infrastructure & Operations function is distributed across Denmark, Bulgaria, India, and the Philippines, and operates across multiple client accounts including public sector and enterprise digital platforms. 

The function works within a ticket-first, evidence-driven operational model. Production is owned by Cloud Operations; platform architecture and guardrails are owned by Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. This separation of duties supports governance, auditability, and clear accountability.

DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid

Merkle

Full time

Permanent#DGS

data.title: Senior Engineer-Full Stack
data.description:
Why Ryan?

- Global Award-Winning Culture
 - Flexible Work Environment
 - Generous Paid Time Off
 - World-Class Benefits and Compensation
 - Rapid Growth Opportunities
 - Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation
 - Exponential Career Growth

As a Senior Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, development, and delivery of robust, scalable, and secure software systems. You'll be expected to own complex components, lead critical feature implementation, and drive engineering best practices within your squad. This role bridges the execution gap between high-level design and detailed implementation, with active participation in solutioning, system integration, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to architectural discussions, and ensure that software solutions align with user needs, business goals, and performance expectations. This role demands hands-on engineering capabilities, a high degree of ownership, and the ability to work independently as well as within a team. 

Key Responsibilities

Software Design and Development

- Translate business requirements into efficient, modular software solutions. 
 - Design and document functional and technical specifications for mid-to-large components. 
 - Implement and review high-quality code using modern software development practices. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews with an emphasis on performance, scalability, and maintainability. 

Applications Integration & Middleware

- Integrate enterprise applications and services using APIs and middleware solutions. 
 - Conduct feasibility assessments and support application interoperability testing. 
 - Troubleshoot integration issues and support optimization of connected systems. 

Cloud, DevOps & Configuration

- Develop and deploy software in Azure cloud environments. 
 - Configure platform-specific deployment scripts and troubleshoot build-release issues. 
 - Participate in infrastructure-as-code practices and cloud performance tuning. 

Testing & Automation

- Design and execute complex unit, integration, and automated test cases. 
 - Analyze and resolve test failures, propose code fixes, and contribute to automation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with QA and DevOps teams to drive CI/CD pipeline enhancements. 

Architecture Support

- Assist in translating high-level architecture into low-level designs. 
 - Develop and maintain design artifacts under the guidance of architects and staff engineers. 
 - Understand existing system architecture and communicate trade-offs during design sessions. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Work closely with product managers, UX designers, and business stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to project planning and estimation for features and enhancements. 
 - Lead technical discussions, mentor junior engineers, and support knowledge sharing. 

Required Competencies

Technical Strength

- Deep understanding of core programming concepts, system design principles, and application performance optimization
 - Proficient in writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code across at least one modern tech stack
 - Ability to debug complex issues and propose effective solutions with minimal guidance

Solution Ownership

- Demonstrates end-to-end ownership of features or components from design to deployment
 - Proactively anticipates risks, raises concerns early, and takes accountability for resolving them
 - Capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable technical work

Collaboration & Influence

- Communicates technical ideas clearly across teams and stakeholders
 - Builds strong partnerships with QA, DevOps, Product, and other engineering teams
 - Provides constructive feedback in code and design reviews, mentors junior engineers effectively

Execution Excellence

- Delivers high-quality, tested, and secure code consistently
 - Prioritizes well and executes in alignment with sprint goals and timelines
 - Manages multiple competing tasks and handles changing priorities with discipline

Continuous Improvement

- Actively contributes to improving team processes, standards, and tooling
 - Stays updated on new technologies and applies relevant practices where appropriate
 - Seeks feedback and adapts to strengthen performance and technical acumen

What You Bring

- 6-9 years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building production-grade systems
 - Proficiency in Python, React + TypeScript
 - Experience with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Nginx, RBAC
 - Strong understanding of data structures, design patterns, and system integration techniques
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containers (Docker), and cloud services (AWS/Azure)
 - Demonstrated ability to design, test, and debug complex systems in a collaborative setting
 - A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to document and present technical concepts clearly
 - Experience in Agentic development

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a company where innovation meets real-world impact. We're building something meaningful, and we want your expertise to help shape the future of our platform. Expect a collaborative environment, intelligent peers, and the opportunity to make technical and business decisions that matter.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Liquidity Book- Java Fullstack
data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

Liquidity Book is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Hyderabad, focusing on the development and improvement of our Order Management System (OMS) platform. This role involves hands-on work across backend Java systems and frontend applications, collaborating with team members to deliver reliable and effective solutions. 

What You'll Do

- Participate in the design and development of OMS features for both new initiatives and existing products. 
 - Contribute to backend service and frontend application development using established technologies. 
 - Support team code reviews, technical discussions, and troubleshooting. 
 - Help maintain engineering best practices and code quality. 
 - Assist with platform improvements, including refactoring and performance enhancements. 
 - Make hands-on technical contributions to software development projects. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in programming in Java and frontend frameworks like reactjs, angular or Vue. 
 - Experience working with distributed systems or large-scale applications. 
 - Solid foundation in software architecture, design patterns, algorithms, and data structures. 
 - Should be comfortable with using AI coding assistance like Claude. 
 - Experience with testing frameworks like JUnit, Vitest/Jest/Mocha, Playwright etc. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) or automation tools. 
 - Effective problem-solving and communication skills. 
 - Willingness to learn and support team growth. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience or knowledge of financial trading applications, especially OMS, EMS, or related systems. 
 - Familiarity with multi-threaded programming and scalable frontend solutions. 
 - Understanding of trading workflows, FIX protocol, or market data integration. 
 - Experience taking part in system upgrades or technology improvements. 

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. 

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

data.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today.

data.title: Senior AI Business Automation Engineer (Dot Compliance) - Technology IT
data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

Signant Health is seeking a Senior AI Business Automation Engineer who works in two modes. In one, you embed with functional Subject Matter Experts - learning their workflows, including the workarounds and group knowledge that never appear in process documents, then designing, prototyping, and delivering the custom technical solutions that transform how those teams operate. In the other, you work on a small, focused delivery squad - leading or contributing - shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. 

Both modes share the same spirit: find business processes ripe for reinvention, rebuild them with an AI-first mindset, and put working code in front of real users fast. The role sits inside IT and carries the full weight of our infrastructure, data, integration, automation, and information security standards required of a clinical-trial technology provider. Code ships to production through regular, incremental delivery against real workflow data - not to a slide deck. Success is measured by how many workflows you've permanently transformed and how consistently your business teams start every task with an AI tool. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

- Flex between two modes: embedded with an assigned cohort of business SMEs, observing how work actually happens - the workarounds, shared spreadsheets, group knowledge - to find the highest-leverage workflows for an AI-first redesign; and contributing to or leading small delivery squads shipping AI-driven automation into a business unit at pace. Either way, the discipline is the same: get close to the real work, find the leverage, rebuild rather than automate as-is. 
 - Design, prototype, and deliver working solutions - custom tools, AI agents, automations, reusable skills - tailored to each engagement's workflows, delivered incrementally against real workflow data so value lands continuously, not just at project end. 
 - Coach and partner with the business users you work alongside - SMEs or squad stakeholders - through a progression: awareness, first win, regular AI integration, full workflow transformation. 
 - Develop and deploy AI agents using LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, end-to-end automations across REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS, and secure data pipelines - built to enterprise standards. 
 - Build every solution for handoff from day one - documentation, observability, and runbooks so other engineers can operate, diagnose, and evolve it without you. 
 - Recognise patterns across engagements and scale what works: a tool built for one SME should become reusable for peers; a proven pattern should be documented for other engineers. 
 - Translate observed business problems into technical solutions and share wins visibly with your cohort and leadership, articulating ROI, effort, and risk honestly enough to make prioritisation easy. 
 - Participate in end-to-end testing and quality validation of AI, automation, and integrated solutions before production deployment. 
 - Use AI development tools fluently throughout the build lifecycle - coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for rapid prototyping, LLMs for mining workflow signals from tickets and transcripts, AI-assisted drafting of designs, runbooks, and tests - while applying rigorous evaluation discipline (golden datasets, eval harnesses, regression suites, hallucination/grounding checks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) before production deployment. 
 - Ensure automation solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, and maintainability, with working knowledge of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements. 
 - Mentor both directions: upskill business users to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows, and support junior engineers with reusable patterns, solution designs, runbooks, and executive-ready status reports. 
 - Participate in and extend internal automation platforms to support more advanced workflows, reusable modules, and greater process autonomy. 

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential: 

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise automation, software development, or IT engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow automation (self-hosted or cloud) with REST API and webhook integrations across enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - 2+ years building with the modern AI development toolkit: LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent), MCP servers and clients, agent frameworks and agentic workflow patterns, AI coding assistants as a daily driver, structured prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation grounded in enterprise data, and eval harnesses for measuring agent accuracy and safety in production. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to engineering teams and executives; experience authoring business cases, solution designs, and implementation roadmaps. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for continuous improvement and delivering measurable business outcomes through technology. 
 - Demonstrated ability to discover real workflows by working closely with practitioners - surfacing workarounds, shared spreadsheets, and undocumented group knowledge that determine whether an AI solution works on real edge cases. 
 - Comfortable operating in small, high-velocity delivery teams - able to lead or contribute on a squad of 2-4 engineers, hold a clear delivery line under time pressure, and partner well with stakeholders who expect working software fast. Desirable: 

- Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, project management, or enterprise automation platforms (e. g. ITIL, PMP, or platform-specific). 
 - Experience with iPaaS integration platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato) connecting ERP, HRIS, CRM, and ITSM systems. 
 - Global experience collaborating with distributed teams to deliver enterprise technology initiatives. 
 - Experience using AI itself to discover and redesign workflows - analysing transaction histories, ticket logs, or content repositories with LLMs to surface bottlenecks, or building agentic prototypes in hours to test a hypothesis before a full build. 

Platform-Specific Requirements - Dot Compliance Track

Essential: 

- 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and extending the Dot Compliance eQMS (built on Salesforce), including CAPA, Deviations, Audits, Change Control, Document Control, and Training Management workflows. 
 - Proven experience building and deploying custom Salesforce Apex triggers/classes, Lightning Web Components, and Flow automations in a validated Dot Compliance production environment. 
 - Proficiency in Apex and SOQL, plus JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, for scripting and integration on the Salesforce/Dot Compliance platform. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into Dot Compliance quality workflows (e. g. automated CAPA root-cause drafting, deviation triage, audit-readiness summarisation) grounded in regulated GxP data. Desirable: 

- Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification and/or Dot Compliance administrator or configuration credentials. 

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment. 

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

The AI Architect defines and guides scalable, maintainable, AI-enabled product architecture for modern product delivery and legacy modernization. Must have skills : . Net Full Stack Development

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Summary

This is a key leadership role within the product engineering organization, responsible for overseeing and guiding complex technical projects, driving innovation leveraging AI, and ensuring the successful delivery of high- quality software products. This role may involve a combination of hands-on technical work, strategic planning, and team leadership among other responsibilities. If you have the drive to lead and mentor engineering teams, the ability to set a technology vision for greenfield/brownfield SaaS products and excellent communication skills to work with cross-functional teams, including product management and other stakeholders, this position is for you

Roles and responsibilities: 

Technical Leadership: Guide the engineering team on best practices, architecture, and technology choices. 

Project Oversight: Ensure successful delivery of projects, from concept to production. 

Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning. 

People Leadership: Lead by example, motivate your team to address complex challenges manage performance and goals for direct reports. 

Stakeholder Collaboration: Excel in global cross-functional teams, including product management and architecture. 

AI Strategy & Execution: 

Define and execute the roadmap for AI integration across our product suite, including Generative AI, NLP, and predictive analytics. 

Experience of coding leveraging AI, with an understanding of Agentic AI architecture. 

Innovation and R&D: Drive innovation by staying current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and trends, and translating them into scalable product features. 

Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by driving engineering excellence, conducting root cause analyses, and implementing feedback loops to enhance code quality, team productivity, and system reliability.

Expertise in object-oriented/modern languages (C#, Java, Python, Go or similar)

Experience in test automation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc. ).

Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams. 

Demonstrated experience leading software development teams, focusing on technical aspects and fostering engineering best practices.

data.title: SONIC Principal Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Prestera SONiC team mission is to drive next-gen switch silicon features while supporting enterprise customers with existing silicon on SONiC. In today's fast-moving industry, we learn and develop next-gen enterprise solutions for Marvell Prestera with a strong open-source presence in the SONiC community. 

What You Can Expect

- Design new enterprise solutions/protocols in SONiC while integrating existing SONiC features into internal releases
 - Contribute new features (or bugfixes) to the SONiC community to keep internal releases closer to upstream SONiC
 - Understand industry trends to drive end-to-end solutions in SONiC and in next-gen Marvell Prestera switch silicon
 - Help drive OCP SAI specifications to bridge enterprise solution gaps from a SONiC point of view
 - Develop unit tests for SONiC features and support the validation team to ensure stable releases

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years of experience designing switch NOS software, with a solid understanding of hardware; familiarity with OCP SAI is a plus
 - Demonstrated significant contributions to NOS solutions such as EVPN, SRv6, etc. 
 - Understanding of memory management, inter-process communication, containers (Docker), and build systems in a typical NOS
 - Proficiency in using AI-assisted tools for faster development
 - Expertise in C++ and Python
 - Preferred / Nice to Have: 
 - Understanding of how to expose switch silicon features to NOS/SONiC in the best possible manner
 - Understanding OCP SAI is preferable

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

data.title: Sr.Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

Sr Principal Software Engineer - Genesys Cloud AI & Industry Solutions

Role Overview

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer and employee experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data, and AI to deliver personalized experiences, automate complex business processes, and improve operational efficiency. 

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer with deep, hands-on Genesys Cloud experience to design and build the next generation of AI-powered applications and industry solutions on the Genesys Cloud platform. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role. The ideal candidate combines deep Genesys Cloud engineering expertise with hands-on experience building advanced conversational or agentic AI applications using Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, or similar platforms. 

The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing applications and integrations on Genesys Cloud and understands how to combine Genesys Cloud APIs, Architect, AI capabilities, experience orchestration, data, and enterprise systems to create production-grade solutions. 

A major focus of this role will be translating industry-specific business processes and customer challenges into reusable AI solutions. You will build AI applications, Digital Teammates, solution accelerators, and industry solutions for areas such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and the public sector. 

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Innovations, customers, and partners to turn emerging Genesys AI capabilities, external AI technologies, and industry requirements into scalable, repeatable, and productized solutions that can be deployed across multiple customers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build production-grade applications and industry solutions on Genesys Cloud, leveraging Genesys Cloud APIs, SDKs, events, integrations, AI capabilities, and platform services. 
 - Develop AI-powered customer and employee applications using Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent capabilities, Copilot, Architect, knowledge, and Experience Orchestration. 
 - Translate industry-specific business processes and use cases into scalable AI applications, combining Genesys Cloud capabilities with enterprise systems, data, knowledge, AI models, and agentic technologies. 
 - Build reusable industry solution accelerators, Digital Teammates, AI agents, workflows, and application components that can be configured and deployed across multiple customers within an industry. 
 - Develop industry solutions addressing complex business challenges across financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and public sector environments. 
 - Design sophisticated Genesys Architect flows and orchestration patterns across voice, digital, AI, workflows, data, and enterprise applications. 
 - Build integrations using Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, Data Actions, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and external APIs. 
 - Integrate Genesys Cloud with industry and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, AWS, CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, healthcare, financial services, and workflow platforms. 
 - Build agentic applications and multi-agent workflows where AI agents can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools and APIs, execute business processes, and collaborate with human employees. 
 - Apply modern conversational and agentic AI patterns learned from platforms such as Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, and similar technologies to build differentiated solutions on Genesys Cloud. 
 - Design AI applications that combine LLMs, enterprise knowledge, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, business rules, and enterprise systems of record. 
 - Create reusable solution patterns that encapsulate industry workflows, business rules, integrations, AI capabilities, and best practices, accelerating time to value for customers. 
 - Work with industry experts, customers, Product, and Engineering teams to identify high-value use cases and convert them into repeatable, productized solutions. 
 - Build prototypes and MVPs using emerging Genesys Cloud AI and other AI technologies and rapidly convert successful concepts into scalable, production-ready industry applications. 
 - Design applications for enterprise-scale requirements including security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, compliance, and governance. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code reviews, and mentorship while remaining a hands-on builder and contributor. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering, application development, or solution architecture experience. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud experience, including designing, developing, integrating, and deploying applications on the platform. 
 - Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud architecture, APIs, Architect, routing, conversations, integrations, Data Actions, and event-driven capabilities. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using modern programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience building AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or agentic applications using enterprise AI platforms and modern AI technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, orchestration, multi-agent systems, conversational AI, and agentic workflows. 
 - Demonstrated experience building reusable enterprise or industry solutions, rather than only one-off customer implementations. 
 - Experience translating complex industry business processes and use cases into technical architectures and production applications. 
 - Experience building applications using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, event streams, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with enterprise applications such as CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, and workflow platforms. 
 - Experience translating AI capabilities into production-grade applications and reusable solutions, including integrations with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, workflows, and business applications. 
 - Experience taking solutions from prototype/MVP through production deployment and operation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in architecture, design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and implementation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent, Copilot, Predictive Engagement, knowledge capabilities, and Experience Orchestration. 
 - Hands-on experience building production AI applications using Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, or similar enterprise conversational and agentic AI platforms. 
 - Experience developing custom applications and reusable solutions using the Genesys Cloud Developer Platform and APIs. 
 - Experience with Genesys Cloud CX voice and digital channels, including routing, Architect flows, bots, messaging, and agent experiences. 
 - Experience designing AI agents that combine conversational intelligence, reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, and business-process execution. 
 - Experience building agentic AI applications that integrate LLMs with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, CRM/ITSM platforms, workflow engines, and other systems of record. 
 - Experience designing or developing industry-specific AI applications and reusable solution accelerators for financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, telecommunications, travel and hospitality, or public sector. 
 - Understanding of industry-specific business processes, regulatory requirements, data models, and enterprise application ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with AI development and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including AI services such as Amazon Bedrock. 
 - Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ecosystems. 
 - Experience taking AI applications from prototype through enterprise production, including security, scalability, observability, governance, and reliability. 
 - Experience working in innovation teams, rapid prototyping environments, or customer co-creation programs. 

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means being able to take an industry business problem or use case and rapidly turn it into a working, production-quality AI application built on Genesys Cloud. 

More importantly, the goal is not simply to solve the problem for one customer. You will identify the common business process, integrations, AI capabilities, and orchestration patterns and turn them into a reusable industry solution that can be deployed across many customers. 

You should be equally comfortable understanding an industry business process, discussing architecture, working with Genesys Cloud APIs, designing an Architect flow, writing application code, integrating enterprise systems, connecting AI models and agents, implementing tool/API calling, debugging interactions, and demonstrating the finished solution to customers and executives. 

You should also be able to bring experience and architectural patterns from leading conversational and agentic AI platforms and apply those concepts effectively within the Genesys Cloud ecosystem. 

This is not a traditional high-level architecture role. We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer who knows Genesys Cloud deeply and can combine its AI, orchestration, API, and integration capabilities with modern agentic AI technologies to build the next generation of AI-powered industry solutions. 

Working at Genesys

- AI at enterprise scale - Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
 - A flexible-first culture - Join a global team of nearly 7, 000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
 - Growth in the AI era - Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
 - Time to recharge and give back - Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
 - Recognized globally - Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. 

What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: 

- Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
 - A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
 - Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
 - We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
 - After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process. 

Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available. 

Get notified about relevant opportunities. 

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together. 

Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral. 

About Genesys: 

Genesys® empowers more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys CloudTM is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www. genesys. ai. 

Reasonable Accommodations: 

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable. accommodations@genesys. com. 

You can expect a response within 24-48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email. 

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation-such as application follow-ups or resume submissions-may not receive a response. 

Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics. 

Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.

Role : Senior C++ Engineer

Location: Chennai

Years: 8+

About Lynk (Name has been changed to Elveo)

Elveo is the inventor of satellite direct to device or D2D technology, and has the world's only commercial license from the FCC to operate a commercial D2D system. Today, Lynk allows mobile network operators' subscribers to send and receive text messages to and from space via standard unmodified, mobile devices. Lynk's service has been tested and proven on all seven continents, has regulatory approvals in more than 30 countries and is currently being deployed commercially based on more than 40 MNO commercial service contracts covering approximately 50 countries. 

Our technology will enable all 8 billion people on the planet to stay connected with the existing standard phone in their pocket. Everywhere. No matter what. 

By joining Lynk, you will have the opportunity to directly touch the lives of billions. Your mission will be to bring mobile broadband to billions, pull hundreds of millions out of poverty, and save countless lives.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Lynk, you will be a technical leader in designing, building, and operating the software that powers our satellites and ground network.
