We're looking for passionate AI Engineers, Data Specialists, Architects, Cloud Engineers, and technology innovators who want to solve complex challenges, build solutions from the ground up, and shape what comes next. 

🔥 Ready to take your AI career to the next level? Explore our open positions and apply now on LinkedIn. Come build the future of Industrial AI with ArcelorMittal!

Job Title - Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead)

Job Nature - Permanent

Work Location - Hyderabad

Experience - 12+ years software engineering, of which 2+ years building production large language model / agentic applications and 4+ years leading engineers

Purpose of the Role

Own ArcelorMittal's agent engineering practice: reusable patterns for agent decomposition, orchestration, tool use, memory, evaluation, safeguards and operational behaviour; reference implementations on approved Microsoft agent frameworks; agent-specific test suites; and coaching of pod engineers so that agentic solutions are measurable, safe and reusable. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define agent decomposition, planning, tool-use, memory, state and orchestration patterns; codify them in the agent engineering standard. 
 - Select and validate implementation approaches across approved Microsoft agent frameworks (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio) and the platform's agent runtime. 
 - Build and maintain reference implementations and reusable components (tools, connectors, orchestration, guardrails) for common agent behaviours. 
 - Define agent-specific tests for task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost and failure recovery; integrate them into CI/CD evaluation gates with the AI Platform Owner. 
 - Review pod implementations, lead code and design reviews, and coach engineers on difficult agent design problems. 
 - Harvest proven components and lessons from the partner-led pods into the CoE pattern library; retire unsafe or untestable patterns. 
 - Lead the ArcelorMittal engineering community of practice for agentic AI across Europe and the India Global Capability Centre. 

Preferred Skills

- Stakeholder orientation
 - Results orientation
 - Courage to challenge
 - Inspire trust
 - Innovation and learning agility
 - Decision making
 - Cross-cultural collaboration
 - Capability building and knowledge transfer

Good to have skills

- Production software engineering in Python and/or C#/. NET with strong testing and CI/CD discipline
 - Hands-on building of large language model / agentic applications: Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI), Agent Service, Semantic Kernel / Agent Framework, function calling / tools, retrieval-augmented generation and grounding
 - Agent evaluation and safety engineering: evaluation datasets, model-as-judge evaluation, red-teaming, content safety, permission boundaries
 - Designing for observability and operations: tracing (OpenTelemetry), telemetry, cost and latency management
 - Technical leadership: code review, pattern definition, coaching
 - Experience in leading team of AI Engineers, providing guidance and technical decision ability, defining strong engineering practices
 - Copilot Studio and Power Platform for low-code agents; Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
 - Microsoft Fabric / SQL for grounding on governed data
 - Container-based runtimes (Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service), Azure API Management, Entra ID
 - Certifications: AI-102, AZ-204, DP-600

Qualifications

Bachelor degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data, Business or a relevant discipline. Advanced degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage

Deliverables

The successful Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead) combines strong professional depth with a practical delivery mindset. The individual must be able to establish clear methods, make sound decisions, develop colleagues and progressively assume ownership from the implementation partner. Success requires confidence working across India and Europe and balanced judgement across delivery speed, reuse, security and Responsible AI. 

This role helps establish a permanent ArcelorMittal AI capability, embeds repeatable engineering and control practices, and reduces dependency on the implementation partner through structured ownership transfer. Success is demonstrated when: 

- Reference patterns are reused across pods; agent behaviour (task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost, failure recovery) is measurable; permission and failure paths are tested before release; duplicated engineering effort declines; ArcelorMittal engineers can build agents independently. 
 - Agent engineering standard; reference implementations; reusable tools and orchestration components; agent evaluation suite; engineering review evidence; failure and recovery patterns; coaching materials. 

Time Zone

India Standard Time (IST) with European working hours (CET/GMT) overlap

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer II nterprise Data Platform
data.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner - with Standard India

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams across the nation, we've been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture, focused on operational excellence, thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary

A Site Reliability Engineer II is responsible for supporting the reliability, availability, and operational health of the Enterprise Data Platform and the critical data workloads and services running on it. This role combines production operations, data platform knowledge, troubleshooting, monitoring, and automation practices to help ensure critical data processing completes successfully, and production services meet established service expectations. The engineer monitors production workloads, investigates failed or delayed data jobs, supports production incident resolution, executes approved data corrections and recovery activities, and works with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, product teams, and other stakeholders to maintain stable and reliable production operations. These engineers independently perform repeatable operational activities and resolve known production issues using established procedures, runbooks, and engineering practices. They work with senior engineers on more complex problems while developing their troubleshooting, automation, and reliability engineering capabilities. The role contributes to improved monitoring, documentation, operational processes, and automation that reduce recurring manual effort and improve the overall reliability of the Enterprise Data Platform. 

Key Responsibility Areas

(35%) Production Operations & Data Workload Monitoring

- Monitor production data workloads, pipelines, scheduled jobs, and platform services to help ensure reliable and timely processing. 
 - Identify failed, delayed, or incomplete data jobs and perform established recovery and troubleshooting procedures. 
 - Monitor workload dependencies, operational alerts, processing status, and production health and escalate issues when appropriate. 
 - Perform approved operational recovery activities including job restarts, reruns, validation, and other documented remediation procedures. 
 - Support day-to-day operational health of the Enterprise Data Platform and its production workloads. 

(25%) Incident Management & Troubleshooting

- Investigate production incidents involving data pipelines, platform services, integrations, data processing, and related dependencies. 
 - Use logs, alerts, job execution information, platform telemetry, and established troubleshooting procedures to identify and resolve production issues. 
 - Restore services using established recovery procedures and escalate complex or unfamiliar problems to senior Site Reliability, Data Engineering, or Platform Engineering resources. 
 - Document incident symptoms, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and relevant findings to support future problem resolution. 
 - Assist senior engineers with investigation and root cause analysis of significant or recurring production issues. 

(15%) Data Corrections & Production Support

- Support investigation and resolution of production data issues and data correction requests. 
 - Execute approved data corrections, reprocessing, and recovery activities using established procedures and controls. 
 - Validate processing results and data corrections to confirm successful completion and expected outcomes. 
 - Coordinate with Data Engineering, product teams, and other stakeholders when additional investigation or engineering support is required. 

(10%) Monitoring, Automation & Reliability Improvement

- Support development and maintenance of automation that reduces repetitive operational activities and manual intervention. 
 - Assist with improvements to monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational telemetry. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and opportunities to improve production support processes. 
 - Contribute scripts, utilities, and operational improvements that increase efficiency and reliability. 

(10%) SLA/SLO Monitoring & Operational Excellence

- Monitor critical production workloads and services against defined SLAs, SLOs, and operational expectations. 
 - Identify processing delays, failures, and other conditions that may affect service commitments and escalate risks appropriately. 
 - Support collection and maintenance of operational metrics related to workload health, incidents, failures, and service performance. 
 - Participate in incident and problem reviews and assist with implementation of assigned corrective actions. 

(5%) Documentation, Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement

- Create and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, support procedures, and knowledge documentation. 
 - Document new operational scenarios and successful resolution procedures for reuse by the team.

 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client.

data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

12

The Team

The role is being established within the Data Quality organisation of S&P Global's Enterprise Data Organization (EDO) to provide independent, enterprise-wide assurance of data quality. The team is accountable for assessing quality across critical data domains, strengthening governance, and building senior leadership confidence in the integrity, reliability, and trustworthiness of our data assets. 

The Impact

This senior leadership role governs enterprise-scale data quality across critical domains, driving quality strategy, governance, and proactive risk prevention to strengthen data integrity and business confidence. By partnering across Product, Technology, and Operations, the role accelerates automation, observability, and quality transformation, enhancing stakeholder trust, regulatory readiness, and sustainable growth. 

What's In It For You

- Enterprise-Wide Leadership Impact - Shape and influence data quality strategy across critical business domains, driving outcomes that directly enhance customer trust, business performance, and organisational growth. 
 - Executive Visibility & Stakeholder Engagement - Partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Technology, Operations, and Data leadership teams, with regular exposure to key decision-makers and strategic transformation initiatives. 
 - Global Scope & Cross-Functional Influence - Lead globally distributed teams and collaborate across regions, business units, and data functions to establish scalable governance, quality standards, and best practices at enterprise scale. 
 - Career Growth Through Transformation Leadership - Play a pivotal role in advancing AI-enabled quality, automation, observability, and data governance capabilities, providing a unique platform to build executive leadership, innovation, and change-management expertise. 
 - Build the Future of Data Quality - Drive the evolution of quality from a control function to a strategic business capability, influencing how one of the world's leading data providers delivers trusted, high-quality data products to customers globally. 

Responsibilities

- Govern domain‐level operations and quality strategy, ensuring consistent execution of controls, RCA discipline, and prevention mechanisms. 
 - Define outcome-based quality metrics, including defect escape rates, recurrence rates, and control effectiveness measures such as precision and recall. 
 - Establish statistical process controls and trend-based insights to detect early signs of performance deterioration and quality risk. 
 - Develop scalable sampling models, including stratified and acceptance sampling, to enhance monitoring effectiveness and quality assurance. 
 - Define a standardized evaluation and governance framework for AI/ML/LLM capabilities, incorporating benchmark datasets, scoring rubrics, regression testing, and failure taxonomy. 

What We're Looking For

- Background in Finance/Statistics and preferred certifications in data quality (Lean Six Sigma, CIMP, DCAM). 
 - Executive presence with strong influencing and decision‐making capability. 
 - Inclusive leadership, accountability, and change‐management mindset. 
 - Demonstrates strong learning agility and digital acumen, with a continuous learning mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving tools and technologies. 

What's In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence. 

Our People

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We're committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. 

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals. 

Benefits

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That's why we provide everything you-and your career-need to thrive at S&P Global. 

Our Benefits Include

- Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body. 
 - Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on. 
 - Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills. 
 - Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs. 
 - Family Friendly Perks: It's not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families. 
 - Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards-small perks can make a big difference. 

For more information on benefits by country visit: https: //spgbenefits. com/benefit-summaries

Global Hiring And Opportunity At S&P Global

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets. 

Recruitment Fraud Alert

If you receive an email from a spglobalind. com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal. com. S&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, "pre-employment training" or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

S&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment. 

If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO. Compliance@spglobal. com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person.

data.title: Senior Substation Automation Engineer - Grid Modernization (IEC 61850)
data.description:
Date: Oct 1, 2026

Location: 

Pune, MH, IN

Company: Black & Veatch Family of Companies

We believe real value is powered by the unique skills and experiences of our professionals. The interchange of ideas from a diverse group of people gives our teams an expanded perspective and the ability to find better solutions for our clients. 

Req Id : 116879

Job Title : Senior Substation Automation Engineer - Grid Modernization (IEC 61850)

Business Unit sector : CPL-BVOPS-ENGR & DEV SVCS

Department: BVCPL BV OPS EDS INSTR & CONTR

Work Location : INPUNE

Opportunity Type : Staff

Relocation eligible : Yes

Full time/Part time : Full-Time

Contract Hire Only for this Project: No

Visa Sponsorship Available: No

Recruiter : Ashwini Dnyanoba Patil

Job Summary

Black & Veatch is expanding its Power SCADA team to support a strategic grid modernization initiative focused on IEC 61850‐based substation automation and virtual substation technologies. As a founding member of the Virtual Protection, Automation, and Control (vPAC) Alliance, Black & Veatch is collaborating with industry leaders to advance open, secure, and vendor‐agnostic digital substation solutions that replace traditional, hardware‐intensive architectures with virtualized, software‐defined platforms. Following successful pilot efforts, BV is now transitioning virtual substations into production environments. This role is being created to bring in experienced SCADA professionals who can help design, implement, standardize, and support production‐ready Power SCADA solutions that enable resilient, flexible, and future‐ready grid infrastructure

In this role, you may have the opportunity to: 

- Lead the transition of IEC 61850‐based digital and virtual substations from pilot to production, shaping real-world grid modernization outcomes. 
 - Design and standardize secure, vendor‐agnostic substation automation architectures that improve resilience, flexibility, and scalability. 
 - Serve as a technical leader and subject‐matter expert, influencing system architecture, best practices, and emerging standards. 
 - Collaborate with utilities, technology partners, and industry groups (including vPAC Alliance) to help define the future of protection, automation, and control

Key Responsibilities

IEC 61850 Engineering & Modeling

- Develop SCL engineering artifacts including ICD, CID, and SCD files, datasets, logical node mappings, reporting and control blocks, and GOOSE publications and subscriptions. 
 - Configure and validate MMS, GOOSE, and SV messaging for protection, automation, monitoring, and SCADA applications. 

Substation Networking & Time Synchronization

- Design and document station-bus and process-bus network architectures using PRP/HSR, VLANs, QoS, multicast management, and traffic segmentation practices. 
 - Design deterministic real-time networking paths for time-sensitive protection and automation applications, incorporating latency budgeting, PTP timing performance, and behaviors defined for substation-class devices meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Diagnose and optimize real-time network behavior through traffic-capture analysis, timing-accuracy evaluation, and system-level tuning techniques for time-critical digital-substation workloads. 
 - Develop PTP-based time-synchronization architectures including grandmaster, boundary, and transparent clock configurations and incorporate timing considerations into the system design. 

Protection, Automation & SCADA Integration

- Integrate multi-vendor IEDs with protection settings and logic, coordinating measurements, controls, alarms, and event data with SCADA and HMI systems. 
 - Apply IEC 61850 data-modeling concepts to confirm interoperability across mixed fleets of protection and control devices. 

Cybersecurity & System Hardening

- Incorporate cybersecurity principles into system architecture, including authentication, role-based access control, network segmentation, secure communications, and device hardening. 
 - Apply cyber-informed engineering principles by identifying high-consequence functions and integrating protective measures directly into system architecture, embedding security decisions from the earliest stages of engineering rather than treating them as add-on controls. 

Virtualization of Substation Functions

- Develop and configure virtualized protection, HMI, gateway/RTU, and related substation applications on platforms including VMware ESXi with vCenter, vSAN, and NSX; Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization; and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform designed to run virtualized protection, automation, and control workloads with deterministic performance and PTP-synchronized operation on industrial servers meeting IEC 61850-3 and IEEE 1613 criteria. 

Industry Engagement & Technical Leadership

- Contribute to, or develop toward contributing to, IEEE and IEC standards and collaborative initiatives related to IEC 61850, digital substations, time synchronization, and cybersecurity. 
 - Support participation in technical bodies and industry groups such as IEC, IEEE, CIGRE, ISA99, and vPAC Alliance workstreams. 
 - Support the advancement and practical application of virtualized protection, automation, and control concepts in alignment with the architectural direction established by the vPAC Alliance. 

Project Delivery & Collaboration

- Produce engineering documentation including network specifications, SCL models, timing plans, interface definitions, and system diagrams used across design, laboratory validation, and field implementation. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, technical leads, clients, and vendors to align designs with project goals, operational requirements, and industry best practices. 

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks for operational technology environments, including secure communications and system-hardening practices. 
 - Interest or participation in IEEE and IEC standards development related to IEC 61850, time synchronization, digital substations, and cybersecurity. 
 - Experience deploying or supporting virtualized protection, automation, and control applications on VMware ESXi/vCenter/vSAN/NSX, Red Hat KVM or OpenShift Virtualization, and SEAPATH's real-time, high-availability hypervisor platform for vPAC workloads. 
 - Experience deploying virtualized substation workloads on industrial servers certified to IEC 618503 and IEEE 1613 environmental and EMC requirements. 
 - Familiarity with vPAC architectural principles and emerging practices for hosting protection, automation, and control systems on virtualized platforms.

Responsibilities

What You'll do

We are seeking an Automation & AI Agentic Engineer to design, build, and support a hybrid automation portfolio that spans traditional RPA and next-generation agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands-on across Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Studio, Agent Core, Power Automate, and UiPath (including UiPath Agentic Automation/Agentic Orchestration) evaluate which platform and approach - rule-based bot, low-code flow, or autonomous AI agent - best fits a given business process.

- Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate, following CoE development standards and reusable component libraries. 
 - Build and orchestrate AI agents using Agent Core, UiPath Agentic Automation (agentic orchestration, agent-to-agent/human-in-the-loop workflows), and Microsoft Copilot Studio for goal-driven, autonomous or semi-autonomous process automation. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot (chat, inline completion, agent mode) to accelerate development, code review, and testing across automation and supporting application code. 
 - Assess incoming automation requests and recommend the right-fit solution (deterministic RPA bot vs. low-code Power Platform flow vs. AI agent vs. hybrid) based on process complexity, data variability, and exception handling needs. 
 - Integrate automations with enterprise systems via APIs, databases, message queues, and connectors; manage credentials/secrets securely (vault integration, least-privilege access). 
 - Implement AI components where required: document/IDP processing, LLM-based reasoning steps, prompt design, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns for knowledge-grounded agents. 
 - Apply governance, security, and responsible-AI practices: exception handling, logging/observability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, data privacy, and bias/hallucination mitigation for agentic components. 
 - Participate in solution design reviews (PDD/SDD), UAT, hypercare, and production support/incident triage for deployed bots and agents. 
 - Maintain documentation for developed solutions, including agent decision logic, guardrails, and rollback/fallback procedures. 
 - Collaborate with Solution Leads/Architects on scalability, CI/CD pipeline integration, and CoE standards adoption; mentor junior developers on both RPA and agentic development practices. 
 - Stay current on platform releases (UiPath, Agent Core, Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot, GitHub Copilot) and recommend adoption of new capabilities.

 - Practical experience using GitHub Copilot (or similar AI coding assistant) in day-to-day development. 
 - Understanding of GenAI/LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, tokens/context windows, RAG concepts, and where AI agents outperform (or underperform) deterministic bots. 
 - Proficiency with REST APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, and at least one scripting/programming language (Python, VB. NET, or C#).

 - Excellent communication skills to translate business requirements into automation/agent solutions.

 - Streamline engineering workflows by removing friction, cutting redundant work, and avoiding over-engineered solutions. 
 - Integrate modern development tools, including AI tools, into daily engineering processes to boost overall team efficiency. 
 - Direct a team of senior technical professionals across performance reviews, hiring, retention, and team alignment. 

Requirements & Qualifications

- People Leadership: Minimum of 2-3 years of hands-on people management experience, having led teams through performance cycles, hiring, and retention management. 
 - Technical Background: Strong engineering foundation in backend systems, with primary proficiency in Python. 
 - Pragmatic Execution: Proven ability to make decisive calls on technical scope, feature trade-offs, and pragmatic engineering solutions. 
 - Domain Expertise (Preferred): Prior experience scaling lending businesses or working within fintech/credit domains. Candidates from high-throughput distributed systems backgrounds who demonstrate strong finance interest and fast learning agility will also be considered. 

Nice-to-Have: Previous experience or background in Product Management (~1 year).

data.title: Senior Principal Engineer, DFT
data.description:
Job Overview

Arm's Central Engineering DFT Architecture and Methodology team defines the future of Design-for-Test across Arm's CPUs, GPUs, System IP, AI accelerators and next-generation SoCs. The team develops DFT architectures, methodologies and implementation flows that enable high-quality, scalable test solutions across soft IP, hard macros, test chips and complex multi-die SoCs. 

Working at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, you will collaborate with product teams, system architects, design engineers and EDA vendors to shape DFT technologies several years ahead of production. This is a highly technical architecture role with significant influence across Arm and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Principal DFT Architect/Engineer, you will: 

- Define DFT architecture for next-generation Arm IPs and SoCs, including emerging AI and hyperscale computing products. 
 - Develop and drive scalable DFT methodologies and implementation flows used across multiple Arm engineering organizations. 
 - Evaluate emerging DFT technologies and lead technical investigations to solve future product challenges. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, implementation, verification and physical design teams to define robust DFT solutions. 
 - Work closely with EDA vendors to influence product roadmaps, evaluate new capabilities and drive adoption of new technologies. 
 - Produce architecture specifications, methodology documentation and deployment guidance. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship across project teams. 
 - Support strategic engagements with customers, ASIC partners and industry standards bodies where appropriate. 
 - Contribute to technical publications, patents and industry conferences. 

Required Skills and Experience : 

- Principal or Senior Principal level engineer with extensive experience in Design-for-Test architecture and implementation. 
 - Strong understanding of modern SoC DFT methodologies including: 
 - Scan architecture and scan compression 
 - ATPG and fault simulation 
 - At-speed testing 
 - Memory BIST 
 - Logic BIST 
 - JTAG / IEEE 1149. 1 
 - IJTAG / IEEE 1687 
 - DFT verification and debug 
 - Experience developing reusable DFT methodologies or automation rather than project-specific solutions. 
 - Experience evaluating and deploying Siemens Tessent, Synopsys and/or Cadence DFT solutions. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Perl, Tcl and/or Python) together with Linux/Unix expertise. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Degree (or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or related discipline. "Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Experience defining DFT architecture for large-scale SoCs. 
 - Experience with heterogeneous compute systems, AI accelerators or hyperscale computing products. 
 - Knowledge of IEEE 1500, IEEE 1838 and advanced IJTAG methodologies. 
 - Experience with Streaming Scan Network (SSN) and chiplet/3DIC architectures. 
 - Familiarity with silicon bring-up and production test. 
 - Experience working directly with EDA vendors on new technology development. 
 - Knowledge of synthesis, STA and physical implementation considerations for DFT. 
 - Experience with formal verification and simulation methodologies. 
 - Record of patents, conference publications or contributions to industry standards . 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.title: Lead Drive Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half. 

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send. 

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept. 

Where you'll leave your mark?

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks. 

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface. 

Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined. 

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it. 
 - An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one. 
 - Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules. 
 - 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed. 
 - Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt. 
 - Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal. 
 - Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing. 

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator. 

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

- Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

- Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

- Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

- Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

- Strong C++ design and coding skills

- Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

- Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

- Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

- Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

- Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

Role OverviewAre you passionate about building mission-critical enterprise systems and eager to drive real architectural impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where world-class software craftsmanship meets direct customer impact. 

We are seeking a seasoned Principal or Backend Software Engineer to design, build, and scale reliable, high-throughput microservices and SaaS infrastructure. Our platform is built on a mature, cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS, securing identity governance for the world's leading global enterprises. In this role, you will lead complex technical initiatives, mentor senior peers, collaborate across product and UX teams, and deliver robust software that defines the future of identity security.

What You'll Bring (Requirements)

 - Data & AI/ML Systems: Experience integrating with or designing for Big Data pipelines, streaming architectures (Kafka, Kinesis), or AI/ML-driven product features.

30 / 60 / 90-Day Success PlanThis roadmap provides clear expectations and milestones to empower you to ramp up quickly, integrate with the team, and deliver meaningful architectural impact. 

First 30 Days: Onboard, Understand & First Ship

 - Environment & Tooling: Set up local and cloud dev environments, CI/CD pipelines, test automation suites, and observability dashboards.

Days 31-60: Ownership, Feature Delivery & Design Collaboration

data.title: Compiler Performance Engineer
data.description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM. 

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator. 

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance. 

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

- Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

- Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

- Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

- Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

- Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

- 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

- Strong C++ design and coding skills

- Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

- Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

- Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

- Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

- Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

- Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

About The Role

Join the Vertical Solutions team and build UiPath's most ambitious product - an AI agentic orchestration platform that's been recognized as our Invention of the Year for two consecutive years. As a Principal Software Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of our Act 2 strategy, building the infrastructure that allows enterprises to seamlessly orchestrate AI agents, robots, and human-in-the-loop workflows to achieve critical business outcomes. 

You'll be working with Lax and the Maestro backend team to build the core orchestration engine that powers enterprise AI automation. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role on UiPath's biggest strategic bet. 

What You'll Do

- Build and Scale: Design, develop, and maintain full stack for Vertical Solutions products leveraging AI Coding Assistants. 
 - Hands-On Development: Write production-quality code daily, leveraging AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc. ) to enhance your development workflow
 - Prototype and Ship: Take ideas from Prototype to validate with real customers and turn the ones that prove value into production systems. 
 - Measure what matters: Design evaluations, measure quality against real customer data, and understand when metrics mislead. Our systems are often non-deterministic. Responsible shipping means measuring honestly, not chasing vanity numbers. 
 - Customer-Centric Engineering: Deeply understand who will use the features you build and why they need them, translating customer needs into elegant technical solutions
 - Ensure Reliability: Contribute to building highly scalable, reliable distributed systems that enterprises depend on. 

What We're Looking For

- Builder mindset - you enjoy turning ideas into working systems and taking ownership from Concept through, Customer impact and Production
 - Strong full stack knowledge including frontend systems like React and backend systems -Python and/or C# - most Vertical Solutions product development is Python (agents, APIs, ETL), while core platform work includes C#, frontend in React. Willingness to work across both is important. 
 - Experience building production AI systems - LLMs, tool-calling, multi-agent architectures, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), structured outputs, orchestration, and evaluation of model behavior in real-world workflows
 - Distributed systems experience - designing resilient systems with idempotency, replay ability, state management, and long-running jobs
 - Strong analytical thinking - able to reason quantitatively about system quality and make sound decisions using imperfect signals
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid prototyping - able to move from idea to proof-of-concept quickly and iterate based on customer feedback. 
 - Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience. 
 - 13+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on distributed systems and backend architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more system-level languages - Javascript / C# / Java etc
 - Full-stack experience: ability to work across backend services and frontend layers (REST/GraphQL APIs, basic UI integration, component contracts). 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, architectural design patterns, system design, and data structures & algorithms. 
 - Experience with React, TypeScript, or other modern frontend frameworks for deeper full-stack contribution. 
 - Strong grasp of multithreading, asynchronous programming, synchronization, and cloud-native programming models. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud ecosystems: Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Proficiency with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and coding agents (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to integrate these into daily engineering workflows. 
 - Experience driving team adoption of AI-powered productivity tools - setting norms, measuring impact, and iterating on usage patterns. 
 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices: agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, and infrastructure as code.

Area What good looks like

data.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY INFORMATION SECURITY

Job posting

AI and Automation Engineering Lead, Associate Director

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. 

EY focuses on high ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. 

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust. 

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. 

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI. 

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function. 

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people. 

Areas of focus

- AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output. 
 - Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes. 
 - Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time. 
 - Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it. 
 - AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program. 

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include: 

- Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems. 
 - Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces. 
 - Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take. 
 - Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them. 
 - Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue. 
 - Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data. 
 - Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved. 
 - Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program. 
 - Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others. 
 - Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality. 
 - Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums. 
 - Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on. 
 - Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual. 
 - Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations. 
 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership. 
 - Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders. 
 - Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience. 
 - Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program. 
 - Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines. 
 - Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production. 
 - Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task. 
 - Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable. 
 - Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent. 
 - Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph. 
 - Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs. 
 - A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes. 
 - Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling. 
 - Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it. 
 - Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns. 
 - A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 
 - Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources. 
 - Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path. 
 - Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation. 
 - Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience. 
 - Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling. 
 - Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers. 
 - Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering. 

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used. 

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms. 

About The Role

As a Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities.
