data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Principal Mobile Software Engineer (P5)

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services, transforming every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235, 000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our teams work on mission‐critical platforms that demand reliability, scalability, and thoughtful evolution of complex systems. 

Job Summary

- We're looking for a hands-on Principal Mobile Software Engineer (P5) who will lead the architecture, development, modernization, and delivery of enterprise-grade mobile platforms across iOS and Android. This role is focused on building reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing mobile experiences while using AI-driven development practices to accelerate engineering velocity, improve quality, and unlock intelligent mobile capabilities. 
 - This role is ideal for a senior technologist who: 
 - Leads complete, high-impact mobile initiatives end-to-end across discovery, architecture, implementation, launch, and continuous improvement
 - Designs and builds cross-platform mobile solutions spanning iOS, Android, and shared mobile platform capabilities
 - Applies AI-driven development practices, AI-assisted engineering tools, and intelligent mobile workflows to improve delivery speed and product quality
 - Makes pragmatic architectural decisions that balance native platform excellence, cross-platform reuse, performance, security, maintainability, and time-to-market
 - Partners effectively with product, design, architecture, backend, security, QA, DevOps/SRE, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous goals into mobile outcomes
 - Mentors mobile engineers and raises the technical standard through platform ownership, code review, architecture guidance, and hands-on implementation
 - You will operate with broad autonomy, lead complete mobile initiatives without requiring constant direction, influence mobile platform direction across teams, and be known as someone who ships, unblocks others, aligns stakeholders, and makes things happen. 

What You'll Do

Build, Ship, and Own Mobile Platforms

- Write production-quality mobile code regularly across iOS, Android, shared platform libraries, and mobile integration layers
 - Own and deliver high-impact mobile features, platform capabilities, and system improvements end-to-end
 - Lead modernization of legacy mobile applications, incrementally migrating toward modular, maintainable, testable, and scalable mobile architectures
 - Design and evolve mobile platform foundations, including app architecture, shared components, design systems, SDKs, offline capabilities, authentication flows, telemetry, and release infrastructure
 - Translate ambiguous business and user requirements into reliable, intuitive, and performant mobile experiences
 - Identify mobile technical risks early, including app performance, crash rates, app store constraints, OS fragmentation, security, privacy, offline behavior, and API reliability
 - Run complete project workstreams independently, including technical discovery, solution design, delivery planning, execution tracking, launch readiness, app store release coordination, and post-launch follow-through

AI-Driven Mobile Development & Intelligent Experiences

- Lead the adoption of AI-driven development practices for mobile engineering, including AI-assisted design, coding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and code review workflows
 - Design and implement intelligent mobile experiences that responsibly leverage LLMs, AI services, on-device intelligence, contextual assistance, automation, and personalization where appropriate
 - Integrate mobile applications with AI-enabled backend services, APIs, orchestration layers, and data sources
 - Evaluate when intelligence should run on-device, at the edge, or in cloud services based on latency, privacy, cost, reliability, and user experience
 - Establish guardrails for AI-assisted mobile engineering, including prompt patterns, generated-code review standards, test expectations, security review, privacy controls, and quality gates
 - Implement hallucination mitigation and validation strategies for AI-powered mobile features, including grounding, structured outputs, user confirmation, fallback states, and telemetry-driven evaluation
 - Design monitoring and feedback loops for AI-enabled mobile behavior in production
 - Ensure AI-enabled mobile capabilities meet security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and user trust requirements

Mobile Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set and evolve mobile architecture standards through hands-on implementation
 - Guide platform decisions across native iOS, native Android, cross-platform frameworks, shared libraries, backend integration, data synchronization, security, and observability
 - Make principled tradeoffs between native platform depth, cross-platform reuse, delivery speed, scalability, performance, correctness, and long-term maintainability
 - Act as a technical escalation point for challenging mobile problems, including performance, memory, battery usage, offline-first behavior, crash stability, OS compatibility, release quality, and integration reliability
 - Influence technical direction across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
 - Provide full technical leadership for projects by coordinating architecture, engineering execution, dependency management, risk mitigation, mobile release planning, and cross-team alignment
 - Communicate clearly with product owners, UX/design, engineering leaders, backend teams, security, DevOps/SRE, QA, support, and business stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with business outcomes

AI-Assisted Mobile Engineering & Developer Productivity

- Leverage AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and mobile-specific automation to accelerate high-quality delivery
 - Establish best practices and guardrails for safe, high-quality AI-assisted mobile coding
 - Use AI tools for mobile solution design, architecture analysis, refactoring, test generation, debugging, system comprehension, documentation, and release readiness
 - Improve developer productivity through reusable mobile components, shared architecture patterns, CI/CD automation, test automation, build optimization, and platform tooling
 - Help teams adopt modern mobile workflows that improve velocity while maintaining engineering rigor, security, accessibility, and release quality

Mentorship & Team Elevation

- Mentor mobile engineers through pairing, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design discussions
 - Help senior mobile engineers grow into broader technical leadership roles
 - Coach engineers on modern mobile architecture, cross-platform development, AI-aware engineering practices, quality engineering, observability, and secure development
 - Foster a culture of continuous learning, ownership, customer empathy, and technical excellence
 - Lead by example with clear communication, humility, accountability, and hands-on technical contribution

Mobile Execution, Quality & Operations

- Build and maintain enterprise mobile applications using modern native and/or cross-platform frameworks
 - Design and implement integrations with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, event-driven workflows, identity providers, analytics platforms, and mobile backend services
 - Optimize mobile applications for performance, memory usage, battery life, network efficiency, offline behavior, accessibility, localization, and reliability
 - Partner with DevOps/SRE and QA to ensure strong mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build signing, release automation, observability, crash reporting, and safe deployments
 - Own release quality across TestFlight, Google Play testing tracks, App Store, and Google Play production releases
 - Participate fully in the SDLC: design, coding, testing, deployment, production support, incident response, and continuous improvement

Experience

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of professional software development experience, including significant hands-on mobile engineering experience
 - Proven experience owning and delivering large, complex mobile applications or mobile platform capabilities
 - Demonstrated success modernizing legacy mobile applications, mobile architectures, and mobile delivery practices
 - Hands-on experience building and shipping iOS and Android applications, with strong cross-platform mobile development experience
 - Experience applying AI-assisted development tools and AI-driven engineering practices to improve quality, speed, testing, documentation, and maintainability
 - History of hands-on technical leadership across teams or mobile domains
 - Strong track record of mentoring and developing engineers
 - Proven ability to lead a complete project independently, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, manage technical risks, and drive execution through delivery

Technical Skills

- Expert-level mobile engineering experience across iOS and Android
 - Strong proficiency with Swift and iOS platform development, including Apple platform conventions, app lifecycle, concurrency, networking, persistence, testing, and App Store release practices
 - Strong proficiency with Kotlin and Android platform development, including Android architecture, Jetpack, coroutines, networking, persistence, testing, and Google Play release practices
 - Hands-on experience with cross-platform mobile technologies such as React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, . NET MAUI, or equivalent frameworks
 - Deep understanding of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, modular architecture, dependency injection, and design-system integration
 - Experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, identity providers, telemetry platforms, crash reporting, analytics, feature flags, and remote configuration
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-enabled engineering workflows
 - Working knowledge of LLM-powered product experiences, AI service integration, prompt-driven workflows, structured outputs, validation, and responsible AI guardrails
 - Strong understanding of mobile security, secure storage, authentication, authorization, privacy, encryption, certificate pinning, OWASP Mobile risks, and compliance-aware engineering
 - Strong experience with mobile testing strategies, including unit testing, UI automation, integration testing, contract testing, snapshot testing, and regression automation
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD, build automation, signing, provisioning, release tracks, app store submission, observability, and production monitoring
 - Comfort working with cloud environments and backend integration patterns across AWS and/or Azure
 - Proficient with Git and modern development workflows
 - Strong understanding of production-quality code, performance tuning, reliability engineering, accessibility, and user-centered mobile design

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, . NET MAUI, or other cross-platform mobile frameworks at scale
 - Experience building shared mobile platform libraries, SDKs, design systems, or reusable component frameworks
 - Experience with offline-first mobile applications, synchronization, conflict resolution, and intermittent connectivity scenarios
 - Experience with mobile observability, crash analytics, performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, and SLO-driven reliability practices
 - Experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile applications, including on-device AI, cloud AI services, personalization, automation, or contextual assistants
 - Experience with regulated, security-sensitive, or compliance-driven mobile applications
 - Background with event streaming, messaging, or real-time data workflows
 - Strong background in Agile/Scrum environments

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience

What Success Looks Like

- You are consistently delivering high-impact mobile features and platform capabilities across iOS and Android
 - Mobile applications are more reliable, performant, secure, observable, accessible, and easier to release
 - Legacy mobile systems are being systematically modernized without disrupting customers or business operations
 - AI-assisted engineering practices improve team velocity, code quality, test coverage, and documentation quality
 - AI-enabled mobile capabilities are designed responsibly, monitored effectively, and trusted in production
 - Teams move faster because of the mobile platform patterns, tools, automation, and examples you establish
 - Engineers seek you out for guidance on mobile architecture, cross-platform decisions, AI-assisted development, release quality, and production issues
 - Projects you lead are well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered through effective collaboration with product, design, engineering, operations, security, QA, and business stakeholders
 - Code quality, mobile reliability, release confidence, and development velocity improve measurably
 - You are recognized as a technical leader who ships and elevates everyone around them

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced QA/QC Manager with 12-15 years of experience in quality management for construction, real estate, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering projects. The role will be responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring Quality Assurance and Quality Control systems to ensure that all project activities, materials, and deliverables comply with organizational standards, client requirements, contract specifications, and regulatory guidelines. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management Systems

- Develop, implement, and maintain Project Quality Plans (PQP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), and quality procedures. 
 - Establish quality objectives, standards, and compliance requirements across projects. 
 - Ensure adherence to ISO standards and company quality management systems. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and best practices across project teams. Quality Assurance

- Monitor project processes to ensure compliance with approved quality procedures and standards. 
 - Conduct internal quality audits and assessments to evaluate process effectiveness. 
 - Review method statements, technical specifications, and quality documentation. 
 - Ensure preventive and corrective actions are implemented effectively. Quality Control

- Oversee inspections and testing activities for materials, workmanship, and completed works. 
 - Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, codes, and standards. 
 - Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), observations, and corrective action closure. 
 - Review and approve quality records, inspection reports, and test results. Site Quality Management

- Conduct site inspections and quality surveillance to ensure project quality objectives are achieved. 
 - Coordinate with contractors, consultants, vendors, and project teams to resolve quality-related issues. 
 - Monitor workmanship standards and ensure compliance with approved quality requirements. 
 - Support project teams in addressing quality concerns during execution. Stakeholder Coordination

- Interface with clients, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities on quality matters. 
 - Participate in client audits, inspections, and quality review meetings. 
 - Provide technical guidance and recommendations on quality-related issues. 
 - Ensure timely communication and resolution of quality concerns. Team Leadership & Development

- Lead and mentor QA/QC engineers, inspectors, and quality personnel. 
 - Conduct training programs to enhance quality awareness and compliance. 
 - Promote a culture of quality excellence across project teams. 
 - Evaluate team performance and identify development opportunities. Documentation & Reporting

- Maintain quality records, audit reports, inspection reports, and compliance documentation. 
 - Prepare weekly and monthly quality performance reports. 
 - Track quality KPIs and provide recommendations for improvement. 
 - Ensure documentation is maintained in line with project and organizational requirements. Health, Safety & Compliance

- Ensure quality processes align with HSE requirements and industry regulations. 
 - Support compliance with statutory, contractual, and client-specific quality standards. 
 - Participate in risk assessments and project governance reviews. 
 - Drive a proactive approach to quality and risk management. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. 
 - Certification in Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 Lead Auditor/Lead Implementer) preferred. 
 - Additional certifications in quality, auditing, or project management will be advantageous. Experience Requirements

- 12-15 years of experience in QA/QC management within construction, infrastructure, real estate, industrial, or engineering projects. 
 - Proven experience in implementing and managing quality management systems on large and complex projects. 
 - Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes, audits, inspections, testing procedures, and industry standards. 
 - Experience working with clients, consultants, contractors, and regulatory stakeholders. 

Additional Information

Role Overview

We are looking for a Quality and Reliability Manager to lead product-quality, package-reliability and qualification activities for memory products in a high-volume semiconductor assembly and test environment. 

The role will own reliability strategy, qualification execution, product-health monitoring, failure analysis and corrective-action closure for DRAM, NAND and related memory products. data.title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment - ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build agent evaluation frameworks - create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
 - Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e. g. , Vertex AI, Gemini models)
 - Build golden datasets and test harnesses - curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
 - Establish eval-as-a-service - build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
 - Automate regression and drift detection - implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
 - Define eval taxonomies and rubrics - establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
 - Instrument production observability - build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
 - Benchmark and select models - run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
 - Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
 - Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies - functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) - tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
 - Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
 - Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e. g. , new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
 - Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
 - Provide technical leadership to engineers, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
 - Collaborate cross-functionally - work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
 - 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
 - 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
 - 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

Technical Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation - familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns - tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
 - Production experience with eval pipelines - building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
 - Proficiency in Python - strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e. g. , Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
 - Statistical literacy - ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
 - Enterprise product sensibility - understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
 - Excellent communication - ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

Tech Stack

- Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
 - Test Automation: Selenium, Playwright
 - LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
 - Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
 - Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
 - Infrastructure: DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
 - Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e. g. , Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
 - Policy Background: Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
 - Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
 - Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
 - Experience with prompt injection (Must) and data poisoning skills is a plus
 - Certifications in AI/ML, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning. AI specializations and software testing methodologies

Soft Skills

- Proven ability to lead without direct authority, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy. 
 - Experience working in agile environments, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones. 
 - Excellent communication and documentation skills, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders. 
 - Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

Nice to have

- Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
 - Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
 - Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
 - Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
 - Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
 - Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
 - Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing - design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

Job Description

We are Omnissa!

The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere-from corporations to schools-are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That's where Omnissa comes in. 

The Omnissa Platform is the first AI-driven digital work platform that enables smart, seamless and secure work experiences from anywhere. It uniquely integrates multiple industry-leading solutions including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance through common data, identity, administration, and automation services. Built on the vision of autonomous workspaces - self configuring, self-healing, and self-securing - Omnissa continuously adapts to the way people work; delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth-and this is just the beginning of our journey!

At Omnissa, we're driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us: Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value-all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team. 

As a global private company with over 4, 000 employees, we're always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we'd love to hear from you! high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence

What is the opportunity?

Our software scales to support millions of devices across multiple device platforms. We have a high bar for quality, performance, scale, availability and supportability - our customers are counting on us to keep their business running. We support complex use cases that span across VMware and services/capabilities provided by OS vendors. We integrate with customers enterprise infrastructure to provide a seamless management experience. 

You will be part of a AI Platform team that is solely focused on driving AI features with Omnissa product portfolio. This role will be responsible for building tools and services that enable us to automate the complex use cases that we support. Responsibilities for this role will also include ensuring that the product being built is testable including designing and refactoring core platform components to ensure so. Team member is expected to participate actively in product design discussions and work closely with functional engineering teams to ensure that the product is built in parallel with the integrations, services and tooling required to effectively test it in an automated fashion. 

You will be owning engineering initiatives and champion a culture of high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. 

Responsibilities

- Own release readiness and quality sign-off for assigned product areas, defining and enforcing quality gates, applying severity/priority models, and making go/no-go calls on releases. 
 - Build and improve test automation (API, UI, or CLI) in Python and other scripting languages to increase coverage, reduce cycle time, and optimize test processes. 
 - Lead critical customer escalations by partnering with support and customer teams to reproduce, diagnose, and drive resolution of live issues under time pressure, keeping stakeholders updated with clear, actionable status. 
 - Perform deep log analysis and root-cause investigation across client and server logs and network captures to isolate failures in client-server products spanning Windows and Linux. 
 - Define test strategy for various components and features, identifying coverage gaps, risk areas, and the right mix of manual and automated testing. 
 - Design, write, and maintain test cases and regression suites, ensuring new functionality and prior fixes are validated consistently across supported platforms. 
 - Validate networking-centric functionality such as TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/DTLS, proxies, routing, and VPN/ZTNA, including certificate/PKI, firewall, and authentication scenarios where relevant. 
 - Manage test execution and defects end to end using a test-management tool (e. g. , TestRail) and Jira, producing clear bug reports, test summaries, and escalation updates others can act on directly. 

What will you bring to Omnissa?

- 12 to 18 Years in software / test engineering, including senior ownership of a product area or release. 
 - Proven experience in automation design, programming and process optimization. 
 - Experience in programming language Python. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/DTLS, proxies, routing, and VPN / ZTNA concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience testing across platforms (Windows and Linux) and testing client-server products. 
 - Proven skill in log analysis and root-cause investigation; comfortable reading server and client logs and network captures. 
 - Experience owning release readiness / sign-off and working to defined quality gates and severity/priority models. 
 - Experience with a test-management tool (e. g. TestRail) and defect-tracking in Jira. 
 - Excellent written communication - bug reports, test summaries and escalation updates that others can act on directly. 
 - Ability to work with customers and support teams on live escalations under time pressure. 

Preferred / Nice To Have

- Experience with endpoint management, secure access gateways, or SASE. 
 - Certificate / PKI, firewall and authentication troubleshooting experience. 
 - Test automation experience (API, UI or CLI) and scripting (Python, Bash, Go or similar). 
 - Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS) for standing up test infrastructure. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and containerized (Docker) test/release workflows.

Overview

Would you like to help enrich the lives of learners around the world?

RM India (RM Education Solutions India Private Limited) is the India Delivery Center for UK based RM Plc. A leading supplier of technology and resources to the education sector, RM India helps deliver great education products and services that help teachers to teach and learners to learn. Our mission is to achieve growth by improving life chances of people. At RM India, we are driven by the potential of our business to touch lives and shape the future. 

At RM, we've been pioneers of education technology since 1973. We provide technology and resources to the education sector, supporting over 20 million students and improving educational outcomes worldwide. 

What we do helps learners at all stages of their lives, from preschool to higher education and professional qualification; we partner with schools, examination boards, governments, and professional organisations globally to make learning more accessible, more engaging, and more impactful. 

RM operates through three divisions: Assessment (digital assessment and marking solutions), Technology (managed services, hardware, and software for schools), and TTS (educational resources). 

Visit us here to find out more: www. rmindia. co. in

We encourage early applications as the vacancy may close once the position has been filled or final interviews have been arranged. 

Responsibilities

Join Our Infrastructure Engineering Team as a Senior DevOps Engineer!

Are you passionate about building scalable, reliable, and cutting-edge infrastructure solutions? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation and collaboration are key? If so, we want you to join our Infrastructure Engineering team as a Senior DevOps Engineer!

About The Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and tools that power our organization's platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to enable seamless software delivery, optimize cloud environments, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our systems. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on our technology stack and drive the success of our strategic initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to accelerate application and infrastructure delivery and improve deployment reliability. 
 - Deploying infrastructure and applications using existing deployment pipelines. Troubleshoot deployment failures. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and monitoring to enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with development and operations teams to ensure platform reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Lead incident management efforts, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement proactive solutions to minimize downtime. 
 - Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. 
 - Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive continuous improvement in our platforms. 
 - Provide 4th line escalation for infrastructure issues including on call (on a rota basis). 
 - Produce technical documentation to a high standard. 

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineer, Deployment or related roles. 
 - Comprehensive knowledge of and implementation experience in Microsoft Azure ecosystem, which must include Azure Kubernetes, Application Gateway, and either PostgreSQL or SQL Server. Knowledge of APIM, ServiceBus and associated diagnostics services underpinning data processing and distributed applications is desirable. 
 - Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible and Helm Charts preferred) and CI/CD pipelines (ADO preferred). 
 - Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, etc. ) and experience with monitoring/logging tools (Grafana, Azure Log Analytics, etc. ). 
 - Deep understanding of networking, security, and system architecture best practices. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead incident response and root cause analysis. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a passion for mentoring and knowledge sharing. 

What's in it for you?

At RM My Work Blend @ RM provides office-based colleagues with flexible and hybrid working options to suit them. As well as, you can spend a proportion of your time working with flexibility of hours, as appropriate to the role. We encourage you to discuss arrangements for this role with your potential line manager during the recruitment process. We expect how we make best use of hybrid working may continue to adapt as we adjust to our new ways of working. 

As well as a competitive salary our core benefits package includes Group Health Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life Insurance, Doctor consultation reimbursement, annually, Medical reimbursement, monthly/Qtry/Annual Rewards & Recognition program, Annual Salary Review & Bonus payouts, Children's Education Assistance Subsidy, Summer Vacation Scheme, Staff Children Engagement Programme, Knowledge Acquisition Subsidy, Transportation Subsidy, Birthday & Marriage gifts and Subsidized Technopark Club Membership. RM India also has a comprehensive Rewards & recognition program to recognize and reward employees. You could even earn yourself an extra bonus for successfully recommending a friend or family member for a position within RM. 

To better reflect the society that we serve, we're committed to building a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all. To achieve this, we create teams of talented people from different backgrounds and experiences and strive to be a business where our people can bring their whole selves to work, we also want to make the recruitment process as inclusive as possible for everyone. Should you require additional support with your application or through the interview process, please contact us at recruitment@rm. com

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers' implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‐oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

- Core Tools: Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Oracle JET (JavaScript Extension Toolkit), Personalization Helper tool and Migration Tool(helps in getting your changes from Responsive version)

 - Data/Services: REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, and Groovy Scripting. 
 - Version Control: Git (built into VBS). 
 - Fusion Specifics: Knowledge of Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials, SCM, or HCM) and Redwood design patterns. 

Preferred Certifications

- Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Visual Builder Specialized.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Position Summary: 

The BU Quality Manager is responsible for implementing quality systems, processes and procedures to ensure product quality meets Sasmos HETs QA plan, guidelines & acceptance criteria. Qualifying suppliers, conducting first article inspection, addressing and resolving quality issues at various stages in production process is part of the role. This role is responsible to implement quality initiatives to improve product quality & reduce customer complaints. 

Key Responsibilities

- Participate in Corporate Quality Strategy & Planning
 - Develop BU Quality Assurance Plan
 - Oversee the BU Product Quality Assurance implementation
 - Develop & implement BU Testing Quality
 - Developing supplier capability to meet Sasmos HET's business objectives and defined quality standards 
 - Address customer complaints 
 - Monitor adherence to Systems and Process
 - Champion quality as a culture
 - Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation
 - Lead Quality Team

Indicative activities

Participate in Corporate Quality Strategy & Planning: 

- Participate in developing & Implementing strategies to enhance plant quality control in consultation with the Corporate Quality Head
 - Identify, plan and initiate investment requirements e. g. , testing equipment, quality tools, systems in consultation with Corporate Quality Head
 - Participate in creating the Quality Policy for overall Sasmos along with the Quality team & in consultation with the Corporate Quality Head

Develop BU Quality Assurance Plan

- Develop guidelines & acceptance criteria for quality control activities in the BU in alignment with corporate goals & customer expectations, to maximize product quality and customer satisfaction through effective preventive controls
 - Periodically review the quality standards based on customer requirements and feedback and provide inputs to the BU QA team
 - Develop, maintain and review quality control charts & database
 - Participate in the New Part/ Product Development process by planning & conducting First Article Inspection for every part, develop the inspection criteria & testing techniques to meet customer requirements
 - Give recommendations to Production, Process Engineering, Product Engineering on specific quality parameters and non-conformities to assist in development of new parts or products. 

Oversee the BU Product Quality Assurance implementation

- Monitor quality control activities to ensure adherence to quality assurance acceptance criteria and safety standards. 
 - Supervise in-process quality checks at every step of the process to ensure that the products are produced as per customer specified dimensions and standards. 
 - Supervise the inspection of finished products to check if they meet the desired quality standards as specified by the customer. 
 - Create and implement a system to ensure product quality traceability throughout the process flow
 - Conduct Root cause analysis and take corrective actions to avoid repeat of chronic errors
 - Participate in BU/Plant level discussions to draw up action plans to arrest quality rejection occurrences
 - Ensure consistent quality across several & diverse projects & especially for long duration projects (USEC BU)

Develop & implement BU Testing Quality

- Develop and implement test programs that meet customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Oversee electrical testing activities, ensuring reliability and safety through rigorous testing protocols. 
 - Calibrate & maintain equipment in accordance with relevant approved procedures, work instructions & test methods. 

Developing supplier capability to meet Sasmos HET's business objectives and defined quality standards

- Conduct supplier evaluation audits to assess supplier capability in alignment to Sasmos HETs guidelines
 - Manage supplier quality assurance activities, including supplier qualifications, audits, and inspections. 
 - Ensure quality checks are conducted for all inward material/products in coordination with the Purchase team. 
 - Review, analyze quality issues critical in nature, ensure resolution, course of action for mitigation of issues are addressed in defining projects
 - Review visual inspection reports, photographic / video graphic evidence of the quality issue, digital testing records, for further analysis
 - Collaborate withstakeholders including Production, Quality, Customer Quality for inputs on supplier development projects, as necessary
 - Monitor supplier quality rating for progress and plan of action, ensure achievement of supplier capability / capacity to meet BU's requirements including volumes, cost, quality and delivery

Address customer complaints

- Monitor and manage customer complaints and provide corrective action to avoid recurrences. 
 - Participate in quality related discussions with Customers and facilitate cascading of the concerns to stakeholders in the BU
 - Support the BU head & BD head in discussions with the customers to resolve disputes with respect to customer rejections
 - Address customer complaints leading to warranty claims due to gaps in production processes through study, in-depth analysis, process improvements, tools and other techniques and recommend suitable action

Monitor adherence to Systems and Process

- Monitor QC systems and advise team on system performance, publish statistics regarding performance against set targets
 - Ensure adherence to Quality systems such as AS9100 etc
 - Act as the Management Representative for the Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with AS 9100 certification and aerospace standards. 
 - Oversee quality manuals, procedures, and audit processes, ensuring adherence to customer and certification body requirements. 
 - Ensure compilation of information on - Quality status, Complaint sample results, and major deviations sent regularly
 - Ensure SAP is updated regularly and accurately by the team. 

Champion quality as a culture

- Review training material periodically to standardize content as required for conducting training programs
 - Train BU production team in quality systems, tools and techniques to ensure that quality becomes the Way of Working

Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Promote continuous improvement initiatives in quality processes, leveraging industry trends and technological advancements
 - Implement kaizen (projects) to address quality gaps / defects identified and ensure standardization of resolution in processes, as applicable
 - Drive innovation in quality assurance, including exploring automation and artificial intelligence in inspection processes

Lead Quality Team

- Mentor, provide operational leadership and technical guidance to the team, thereby developing a strong and competent team
 - Conduct effective performance appraisals for the team and identify training needs
 - Motivate, counsel and coach employees to ensure a conducive working environment
 - Ensure succession planning for self and critical roles in the teamcalibration

data.title: Quality Manager- Paint Shop
data.description:
Company Description Triveni Electroplast Pvt Ltd (Radiator Division) is a value-driven manufacturer known for integrity, excellence, and continuous improvement in transformer radiator production. With a state-of-the-art facility spanning 8, 300 square meters in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, the company serves a global clientele and is approved by leading public and private utilities in India up to the 765 kV class, including PGCIL, NTPC, RDSO, Adani, and Sterlite. Over more than a decade, Triveni Electroplast Pvt Ltd has earned a strong reputation for quality and reliability in the transformer manufacturing industry. Its customer base includes major companies such as Siemens Ltd, GE T&D Ltd, CG Power & Industrial Solutions Ltd, Hitachi Energy India Ltd, TBEA Energy India Pvt Ltd, Atlanta Electricals Pvt Ltd, and Toshiba Transmission & Distribution Systems India Pvt Ltd. 

Role Description

The Quality Manager - Paint Shop is a full-time, on-site role based in Allahabad, 

- Manage paint shop quality activities for radiators and structural components as per customer specifications and applicable standards. 
 - Ensure quality control of surface preparation, degreasing, shot blasting, primer application, and final coating. 
 - Monitor coating thickness (DFT), adhesion, surface finish, color, curing, and corrosion protection. 
 - Conduct inspections and testing, identify paint defects, and implement root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with customer requirements, quality management systems, and applicable painting standards. 
 - Reduce paint rejection, rework, and material consumption through continuous improvement. 
 - Lead and train the quality team, coordinate with production and other departments, and maintain quality documentation with reports and lead quality audits. Qualification: Diploma / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production / Paint Technology

Experience: 8-10 years of experience in paint shop quality, preferably in transformer radiators, transformer tanks, or heavy engineering fabrication. 

Technical Knowledge: Good understanding of surface preparation , shot blasting, primer application. 

Standards: Familiarity with ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and applicable painting and corrosion protection standards. 

Competencies: Root cause analysis, CAPA, quality audits, team handling, documentation, and coordination with production. 

Salary: Negotiable

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for the position of Quality Manager - Paint Shop

Please ensure your resume includes relevant experience in paint shop quality, surface preparation, coating inspection, DFT measurement, and corrosion protection. 

Kindly share your updated resume for consideration. 

Email id: hr_triveni@triveniradiators. com

website: www. triveniradiators. com

data.title: Head of Quality Assurance
data.description:
About our Client: 

A global leader in Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) software. Its AI-first products cover Risk, Compliance, Audit, Cyber GRC, Third-Party Risk and Resilience, and run on a single low-code/no-code cloud platform. It is trusted by over 1 million GRC professionals across 35+ countries, including global banks and regulated businesses, and has offices around the world. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Define and own the QA strategy, roadmap, budget and tooling across all products and services engagements. 
 - Set release quality gates and sign-off standards, including customer-specific releases. 
 - Scale test automation in CI/CD and take AI-driven testing from pilot to production. 
 - Set performance testing standards and work with DevOps on build-level quality gates. 
 - Be the senior quality contact for customer escalations, audits and critical defects. 
 - Define go-live readiness standards for Professional Services implementations. 
 - Build and lead a strong QA team and a second line of leaders. 
 - Report quality metrics to the CEO, leadership team and Board. 

Ideal Candidate Profile: 

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 15-20 years in software QA, with 6+ years leading QA teams. 
 - Release quality ownership for enterprise SaaS with parallel release trains. 
 - Strong in test automation, API testing and CI/CD. 
 - Experience applying AI to testing, with measurable results. 
 - Enterprise implementation experience (configuration, integration, data migration). 
 - Ability to lead through influence in a matrix organisation, with Board-level presence. 
 - Preferred: GRC knowledge (SOX, risk, audit), ServiceNow GRC, Archer or SAP GRC exposure, ISTQB, CISA or CRISC. 

On Offer: 

- Report directly to the CEO, with a seat at the leadership table. 
 - Lead a QA function known for strong automation and AI-led testing. 
 - Shape quality for products used by global banks and regulated businesses. 
 - Inherit a stable, experienced team with deep product knowledge. 
 - Competitive compensation

data.description:
Responsibilities

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

Quality Management & Assurance

- Ensure adherence to quality standards and specifications throughout the solar cell manufacturing process. 
 - Develop, implement, and monitor quality control plans, inspection methodologies, and testing procedures. 
 - Drive in-process quality checks and final product audits to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Lead quality improvement projects to reduce defects, enhance yield, and improve process capability. 

Process Monitoring & Control

- Analyze quality trends, process deviations, and manufacturing parameters to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Monitor key quality KPIs such as yield, defect density, scrap rates, reliability performance, and customer complaints. 
 - Collaborate with production and process engineering teams to establish robust process controls. 

Defect Analysis & Corrective Actions

- Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality failures, product non-conformities, and customer complaints. 
 - Implement CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions) to eliminate recurring quality issues. 
 - Utilize quality tools such as 8D, Fishbone Analysis, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, and Statistical Analysis techniques. 

Reliability & Product Performance

- Support reliability testing and validation activities to ensure product performance and long-term durability. 
 - Monitor cell efficiency trends and performance metrics to achieve quality and yield targets. 
 - Coordinate failure analysis activities with relevant stakeholders and laboratories. 

Supplier & Incoming Quality Management

- Review incoming material quality and collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality concerns. 
 - Conduct supplier performance assessments and quality improvement initiatives as required. 
 - Ensure compliance of raw materials with defined specifications and standards. 

Audits & Compliance

- Ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and other relevant quality management systems. 
 - Participate in internal, external, customer, and certification audits. 
 - Maintain quality documentation, SOPs, process records, and audit readiness. 

Stakeholder Management

- Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Technology, and Supply Chain teams. 
 - Support product qualification, process transfers, and new technology implementation projects. 
 - Mentor and guide team members on quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement methodologies. 

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Prepare and present quality dashboards, reports, and performance reviews to management. 
 - Lead Kaizen initiatives focused on manufacturing excellence and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement across the manufacturing organization. 

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - M. Tech/MBA in Operations, Quality, or Manufacturing Management will be an added advantage. 

Experience

- Minimum 4-6 years of experience in Solar Cell Manufacturing, Semiconductor, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Technology Manufacturing industries. 
 - Hands-on experience in solar cell manufacturing processes, defect reduction, yield improvement, and quality management systems.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - QA [T500-30168]
data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.

data.title: Senior R&D Manager, Smart Devices
data.description:
Vocera now a part of Stryker is looking for Senior Technical R&D Manager is sought to lead the Embedded OS and UX team responsible for creating dependable, intuitive, and maintainable device platforms. This role combines people leadership with technical direction across Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, board support packages, system services, device integration, and user experience. The manager will guide a multidisciplinary team through architecture, development, validation, release, and sustainment, partnering across product, hardware, quality, security, and operations to deliver high-quality embedded products. 

Success in this role means establishing technical clarity, raising engineering quality, and shipping platform capabilities that are scalable, secure, testable, and intuitive for the people who use them. 

What You Will Do

Technical / Managerial Responsibilities

- Lead the design and implementation of embedded OS platform architecture using Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, aligning platform choices with product, hardware, security, and UX goals. 
 - Own the team roadmap, architectural direction, technical debt strategy, and delivery plans for platform, middleware, device integration, and embedded UX capabilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership across board support packages, bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, system services, and application frameworks. 
 - Partner with Product, UX, Hardware, Systems, Quality, and Security teams to translate customer workflows into coherent, responsive, and accessible device experiences. 
 - Establish reproducible build and release practices, including source control, code review, continuous integration, automated validation, artifact traceability, and release governance. 
 - Strengthen product quality through unit, integration, system, performance, reliability, hardware-in-the-loop, and end-to-end testing across target devices. 
 - Guide secure platform engineering, including secure boot, signed software, permissions, vulnerability remediation, SBOM practices, and over-the-air update strategies. 
 - Work closely with Release Engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the smooth operation of build, test, packaging, deployment, and sustaining-engineering workflows. 
 - Drive functional excellence initiatives, deliver high-quality R&D functional deliverables, and ensure technical excellence for product or technology development. Drive technical projects of major magnitude and scope. 
 - Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, applying this knowledge to continuously improve embedded platform architecture, development practices, and UX quality. 
 - Act as a performance coach by providing actionable feedback, setting clear objectives, developing technical talent, and building an inclusive, accountable engineering culture. 
 - Communicate plans, risks, trade-offs, and technical information clearly to team members and business stakeholders, supporting decisions with evidence and sound engineering judgment. 

Technical Skills

What You Will Need

- Strong experience building and shipping embedded Linux and/or Android-based products, with a practical understanding of OS architecture, system startup, resource management, and device lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on expertise with the Yocto Project, including custom layers, recipes, image generation, SDKs, reproducible builds, package management, and distro or machine configuration. 
 - Experience with Android OS or AOSP, including the Android build system, framework services, HALs, permissions, system applications, OTA updates, and platform customization. 
 - Proficiency in modern C/C++ and scripting with Python and shell; familiarity with Java or Kotlin for Android platform and application integration is a plus. 
 - Deep understanding of BSP development, U-Boot or other bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, middleware, and hardware abstraction layers. 
 - Experience with embedded UX technologies such as Android UI, Qt/QML, Wayland/Weston, or comparable frameworks, including performance, responsiveness, and accessibility considerations. 
 - Working knowledge of hardware and connectivity interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and display or input subsystems. 
 - Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as GDB, perf, ftrace, kernel logs, logcat, crash dumps, tracing, and system observability tooling. 
 - Experience with CI/CD and engineering tools such as Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies. 
 - Understanding of embedded security, secure boot, code signing, key management, vulnerability response, SBOMs, and long-term product maintenance. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative, evidence-based solutions. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in Agile, cross-functional, and geographically distributed development environments. 

Leadership Experience

- Talented performance coach who is skilled at providing actionable feedback to team members, setting clear performance objectives, and managing team member performance. 
 - Experience executing a talent and performance-management strategy, including hiring, onboarding, development planning, succession planning, and organizational health. 
 - Demonstrated ability to communicate plans and technical information to team members and stakeholders within a business unit. 
 - Proven ability to deliver programs or other business goals on time, on quality, and within budget while managing scope, risk, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Ability to balance hands-on technical depth with thoughtful delegation, coaching, and long-term team capability building. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field required; master's degree in a related field preferred. 
 - 15+ years of applicable experience, with 6+ years of direct people-management experience preferred. 
 - A strong level of understanding and experience in one's technical or functional disciplines, with the ability to mentor others and raise the engineering bar. 

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.
