data.description:
About Milacron

We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding & Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co-injection systems and related parts and services. 

THE ROLE

The Milacron Supplier Development group, a global and progressive function within Milacron, is currently seeking strong, results-oriented candidates for the positions as a Supplier Quality Professional ranging from Specialist to Engineer. 

Reporting to Global Supplier Development, this position will support, facilitate, and lead Supplier Development actions for multiple regional facilities. The role focuses on supply chain performance with responsibility for supplier quality, assessing supplier capability, verifying the quality of purchased items at the source, providing timely and accurate supplier performance metrics, facilitating continuous improvement and training of the supporting supply base. In this role you will manage the resolution of supplier quality issues at the regional facilities as well as global suppliers for specific categories. 

As part of the Supplier Development organization, you will provide technical guidance in the use of quality management tools incorporating the technical disciplines found in FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans and Problem Analysis. Coordinate formal supplier training to drive consistency in process, including supplier continuous improvement and development programs. Work with underperforming suppliers to improve On-time Delivery (OTD) and non-conformance rates using improvement tools like 8Ds, A3's, etc. Review and maintain evaluations of perspective suppliers and existing supplier performance, report status of supplier performance, and proactively act when quality trends indicate such action is warranted. Serve as liaison between engineering, procurement, quality and production to assure quality and reliability from the supply base. In addition, you will help build and sustain a strategic supply base that aligns with the corporate category management team strategy. 

General Characteristics

To perform this job successfully, the candidate will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform the essential duties proficiently. 

- Process and results driven with strong project management skills
 - Have functional working knowledge of Quality Engineering principles
 - Be a self-starter with a proven ability to manage supplier improvement initiatives
 - Strategically lead supplier performance improvement projects to increase the supplier capability of consistently meeting Milacron requirements
 - Must be able to establish cross functional relationships and partnerships through your product and process knowledge
 - Implement and monitor the part qualification and certification process with elected suppliers
 - Champion problem solving and root cause analysis activities with suppliers and customers to eliminate recurrence of non-conformances
 - Function as liaison between procurement, engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support
 - Work to resolve supplier technical issues in a timely manner to ensure continuity of supply
 - Support leadership and maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and corporation
 - Review targeted supplier manufacturing processes, evaluate supplier root cause corrective actions relative to those processes and confirm identified failure modes. 
 - Ability to travel (up to 50%) is required

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Manufacturing Quality or Supplier Quality Engineering in a manufacturing environment or Comparable Work Experience
 - Understanding of Print Reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD&T)
 - Experience in Casting, Machining and Machined Components is preferred
 - Experience in facilitating change and working with cross functional teams including engineering and manufacturing
 - Experience in a high mix low volume global business is desired
 - Familiarity in auditing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
 - Familiarity with US and International Industry measurement standards and tools
 - Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and compliance auditing experience
 - Experience in using structured problem solving to drive acute and chronic quality issues to closure

Education

- B. E/B. Tech degree from an accredited 4-year college or university in a technical or supply chain related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing
 - Proficient oral and written communication skills
 - Proficient in English language (verbal and written communications).

data.title: Principal SOC Performance Verification Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft's expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft's "Intelligent Cloud" mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission. 

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more. 

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure. 

We are looking for a Principal SOC Performance Verification Engineer to join the team. 

#SCHIE #CSME

Responsibilities

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities: 

- Establish yourself as an integral member of a pre-silicon SoC verification team, owning aspects of performance verification, and aligning with architecture, design, firmware, and emulation. 
 - Become knowledgeable on the overall SoC architecture, including tradeoffs that effect power and performance. 
 - Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Apply your knowledge of performance verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral. 
 - Run tests, correlate results with architecture, debug failures to root cause, recommend fixes. 
 - Apply your growth mindset to learn and adapt in a complex and dynamic environment. 
 - Engage with partners to drive continuous improvement to the architecture, design, and verification plans/collateral, and to methodology to prevent, reduce, and/or find bugs sooner, more easily, or more reliably. 
 - Mentor and coach team members 
 - Apply your One Microsoft mentality to collaborate with and influence architects, logic designers, post-silicon validators, other verification engineers, and IP and tool providers. 
 - Embody our culture and values. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 14+ years of pre-silicon SOC or subsystem or IP verification experience. 
 - Candidate must have at least a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree 
 - 8+ years of verification experience working on CPU/Fabric/DDR/IO designs verification, with 6+ years of performance verification experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 14+ years of experience as part of a CPU, SoC and/or IP development team focusing on performance
 - Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following: 
 - Performance verification
 - ARM architecture
 - CPU architecture
 - Memory Controller/PHY IPs, DDR protocols
 - Coherent and non-coherent fabric IPs and protocols 
 - PCIe/CXL Controller/PHY IPs and protocols
 - ACE lite or CHI bus protocols
 - Working knowledge of C/C++
 - Experience with emulation, constraints, and implications on performance verification
 - Proficient communication, collaboration and teamwork skills and ability to contribute to diverse and inclusive teams. 
Screening Requirements

- Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 - This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U. S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e. g. , under 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate's citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

On Call: Yes

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimise agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision.

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps. 

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years of software engineering experience, primarily full stack with microservices architecture exposure, including senior-level ownership of quality engineering and test strategy. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Proven experience or strong proficiency in delivering production software using AI coding, test generation and orchestration tooling. 
 - Quality Ownership: Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end code quality, test strategy design, defect management and release gates directly, built through hands-on quality engineering experience.

Ideal Candidate

data.title: Enterprise Agentic AI Architect
data.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12, 000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog. 

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. 

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. 

About The Role

Coursera's AI adoption has moved fast - engineering teams code AI-first, dozens of internal tools have shipped, and functions across the business are building their own AI agents and automations. The next phase requires something different: a shared technical foundation that lets many teams build safely and cost-effectively at scale, instead of each team solving governance, security, and cost from scratch. 

This role owns that foundation. The Senior Agentic AI Architect Lead designs and builds the core architecture that Coursera's AI Builders and business pods will run on - so that a small team (a Business Product Owner, a Process Expert, an IT Product Owner, and an AI Engineer) can redesign a workflow and ship an AI-native solution in weeks, not months. 

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy role: you will be building, not just advising. 

What You'll Own

- Context & Semantic Architecture - Design how AI agents access and understand Coursera's internal data and knowledge, so agents retrieve the right information rather than guessing or over-fetching. Establish reusable patterns for RAG, semantic search, structured data access, and enterprise context, partnering with the Data team on existing data models and pipelines. 
 - Agentic Architecture & Harness Engineering - Design reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, multi-step workflows, state management, and human-in-the-loop decisions. Build the engineering harness around agents, including testing, evaluation, guardrails, retries, observability, and failure recovery, so agentic solutions are reliable and production-ready. 
 - Governance Architecture - Build technical guardrails that enforce-not just document-who can build what, what data and systems an agent can access, and what gets logged for audit and review. Establish standards for agent ownership, lifecycle management, and production readiness. 
 - Security Architecture - Design defenses specific to agentic AI, including agent identity and access control, least-privilege permissions, prompt injection, data leakage, secure credentials, and safe tool execution. Coordinate with Security to extend existing enterprise security standards. 
 - Self-Serve AI Development ("Vibe Coding") with CI/CD Automation - Extend and mature Coursera's self-serve deployment path so AI-assisted, conversational development ships through automated testing, security checks, and evaluation gates-safe by default, not safe by manual gatekeeping. 
 - LLM Cost & Performance Optimization - Design caching, model routing (matching task complexity to the right-sized model), token and context optimization, and usage monitoring so AI adoption can scale without costs growing linearly. Establish cost, latency, quality, and usage metrics. 
 - Agent Operating Model & Adoption - Define agent ownership, lifecycle management, production-readiness standards, adoption metrics, and reusable patterns so business teams can scale AI capabilities consistently across functions. Measure success through usage, workflow outcomes, productivity, quality, and business value. 
 - Architecture Strategy & Execution - Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable technical direction, practical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and production delivery. 
 - Enterprise Systems & Integration Architecture - Design AI solutions that understand dependencies across enterprise systems, business processes, integrations, and downstream impacts. Establish reusable patterns for APIs, enterprise tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable integration standards where appropriate. 
 - Production Readiness & Operational Excellence - Establish standards for reliability, observability, incident response, security, operational ownership, and continuous improvement across AI platforms and solutions. 

How This Role Works With Others

This role sits at the intersection of four groups and requires strong cross-functional partnership-it does not operate in isolation. 

- Engineering Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering leadership to align architecture decisions and share resources and infrastructure where possible, avoiding duplicate build efforts across the company. 
 - IT: IT owns broader company-wide tooling and platform decisions (procurement, provisioning, cost governance, enterprise policy). Coordinate closely with IT so agentic architecture decisions align with company-wide technical direction rather than creating a parallel, ungoverned stack. 
 - Data Team: The Data team owns Coursera's underlying data strategy. Partner with them to ensure context and semantic architecture aligns with existing data models, pipelines, and ownership rather than building a parallel, disconnected data layer for AI. 
 - Security Team: Design security architecture specific to agentic AI-including access control, prompt injection defense, and credential handling-in coordination with the Security team, which owns broader security standards and policy. 
 - Business Pods: Enable the 3-4 person pods (Business Product Owner, Process Expert, IT Product Owner, AI Engineer) to redesign workflows, build AI-native solutions, and drive measurable business outcomes using reusable architecture. 
 - Change Management & Enablement: Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows through enablement, feedback loops, process redesign, and continuous improvement. 

People Leadership

Build, coach, and develop the architecture and engineering capability required to scale the platform. This includes hiring, delegation, technical leadership development, performance management, and creating clear ownership across teams. 

Build strong technical leaders who can independently own architecture, delivery, stakeholder alignment, and operational outcomes. 

AI Center of Excellence / VP, AI and Operations

Report directly to the VP, AI and Operations, providing regular updates on architecture progress, risks, business impact, and resourcing needs. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

- 12+ years of experience with clear progression from engineer to senior/staff engineer to architect leader, including ownership of platforms or infrastructure used by multiple teams-not just individual feature delivery. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration (e. g. , LangGraph or comparable) and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to enterprise data and tools. 
 - Experience designing agent harnesses, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, observability, and failure recovery for production AI systems. 
 - Practical experience with enterprise context architecture, RAG, semantic search, or structured data access. 
 - Practical experience with LLM cost and performance engineering-prompt caching, model routing, token economics-with quantifiable results. 
 - AI security fundamentals, including access control, data isolation, prompt injection defense, and secure tool execution. 
 - CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and production operations experience. 
 - Experience defining enterprise AI architecture, reusable platform patterns, operating models, or governance standards across multiple teams. 
 - Direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, delegation, performance development, and building technical leadership capacity. 
 - Experience measuring AI adoption, productivity, quality, reliability, cost, and business value. 
 - Hands-on experience taking architecture from design through implementation, deployment, observability, and production operations. 
 - Strong architecture decision-making and communication skills, with the ability to align technical and business stakeholders around trade-offs involving value, risk, cost, and execution. 

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice. 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera. org/udemy. com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. 

If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form. 

Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera. org.

data.title: Full Stack Lead Engineer
data.description:
- Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
 - Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands-on experience?
 - Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?

If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!

We want to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high-growth environment with a fast-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems across the entire technology stack. 

About Us

At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money. 

Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform. 

Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights. 

Modulr values

- Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile. 
 - Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest. 
 - Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey. 
 - Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite. 

The Role

The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands-on with core development. The role is a blend of hands-on Python development, technical leadership, mentoring, and operational excellence. You will lead

the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full-stack solutions with frontend teams. 

Specific duties

- Lead a squad of software engineers, driving technical excellence through code reviews, architectural guidance, pair programming, and mentoring with strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI best practices. 
 - Technically efficient to write production-quality Python code, designing high-performance REST APIs, managing databases, async operations, and establishing coding standards. 
 - Own backend architecture decisions and lead the design of scalable, robust systems using Python, relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), caching layers, and message queues. 
 - Lead technical strategy for AWS cloud deployments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. 
 - Mentor team members to develop deep full stack expertise for both backend & frontend through 1-2-1s, code reviews, and pair programming, fostering their technical growth and career progression. 
 - Plan squad deliverables and delegate responsibilities clearly, ensuring the team has well-defined goals, unblocked paths to success, and regular progress tracking. 
 - Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend. 
 - Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy. 
 - Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values. 
 - Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation. 

About You

Must Have: 

- Expert-level proficiency in Python (9+ years), with deep knowledge of Python frameworks, async programming, and backend development best practices. 
 - Strong, hands-on experience with FastAPI, including building high-performance REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and async operations. 
 - Solid experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with understanding of full-stack integration and frontend-backend communication patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying systems on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc). 
 - Proven software development and technical team leadership experience, with a strong understanding of backend engineering practices and processes. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, database design, and cloud-native application patterns. 
 - Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of data modeling, optimization, and migrations. 
 - Strong testing discipline (unit, integration, and end-to-end testing) with TDD mindset for backend systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical decision-making in a collaborative environment. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration. 
 - Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code. 

Good to have: 

- Experience with caching solutions (Redis), message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and async task processing. 
 - Experience in the fintech or payments domain. 

Key Attributes: 

- Strong problem-solver with deep analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence. 
 - Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Self-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies. 
 - Passionate about code quality, performance optimization, and building scalable, maintainable systems. 
 - Team player with strong collaborative and leadership presence, comfortable guiding the team through technical decisions. 

ModInclusion

At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. data.title: Senior Engineer – Integrated Command Center (ICC)
data.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

At LPL's Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We're proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad. 

Join us as we create something extraordinary together. 

Role Overview

LPL Financial is seeking a Senior Engineer - Integrated Command Center (ICC) to serve as a principal technical authority within Production Services. This role is responsible for enterprise‐wide incident response excellence, observability maturity, and operational resilience across LPL's most critical platforms. 

As a Senior Engineer, you will lead complex incident management, advanced diagnostics, monitoring strategy, and systemic risk reduction initiatives. You will partner deeply with SRE, Observability, Infrastructure, Automation, and Application Engineering teams to proactively prevent incidents, reduce detection ambiguity, and improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to restore (MTTR) at scale. 

This is a high‐impact role focused on technical leadership, influence, and long‐term reliability outcomes, rather than day‐to‐day alert handling. 

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Incident Response Leadership

- Act as a principal technical authority during high‐severity and enterprise‐impacting incidents. 
 - Lead advanced troubleshooting and multi‐domain triage across applications, infrastructure, cloud, and network layers. 
 - Drive technical containment and restoration strategy in partnership with domain engineering teams. 
 - Establish incident command best practices, escalation models, and responder behaviors. 
 - Ensure incidents are resolved with a focus on durable fixes, not temporary recovery. 

Observability & Monitoring Strategy

- Own and evolve the ICC monitoring and observability strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise reliability objectives. 
 - Define standards for actionable alerting, thresholds, routing, deduplication, and noise reduction. 
 - Architect and oversee Dynatrace dashboards, service views, and eyes‐on‐glass experiences for mission‐critical services. 
 - Partner with Observability and SRE teams to improve logs, metrics, traces, and service telemetry coverage. 
 - Continuously evaluate tooling capabilities to ensure operational visibility keeps pace with platform complexity. 

Advanced Platform Diagnostics

- Perform deep, cross‐stack troubleshooting across AWS, Windows, Linux, networking, middleware, databases, and application services. 
 - Validate hypotheses using evidence‐based diagnostics rather than trial‐and‐error recovery. 
 - Serve as a go‐to expert for complex, ambiguous failure scenarios and cascading incidents. 
 - Provide technical guidance to reduce time‐to‐diagnose during critical events. 

Root Cause & Resilience Engineering

- Lead or significantly influence complex root cause analysis (RCA) for major or recurring incidents. 
 - Identify systemic weaknesses, architectural risks, and operational gaps. 
 - Translate incident learnings into preventative engineering, monitoring, or process improvements. 
 - Track recurring failure modes and sponsor long‐term remediation initiatives. 

Operational Readiness & Risk Management

- Drive operational readiness reviews for new or materially changed services. 
 - Ensure services meet readiness standards including: 
 - Monitoring and alerting coverage
 - Runbooks and escalation paths
 - Rollback and recovery procedures
 - Defined SLOs / SLIs (where applicable)
 - Partner with engineering teams early in the delivery lifecycle to reduce production risk. 
Technical Influence & Mentorship

- Mentor senior and mid‐level ICC, NOC, and production support engineers. 
 - Raise the technical bar for troubleshooting rigor, documentation quality, and incident response discipline. 
 - Influence reliability outcomes across teams without direct authority. 
 - Share expertise through post‐incident reviews, technical sessions, and operational drills. 

Goals & Outcomes

- Deliver measurable, sustained improvements in MTTD and MTTR for priority platforms. 
 - Reduce repeat incidents and operational toil through systemic fixes. 
 - Improve signal‐to‐noise ratio across enterprise monitoring. 
 - Enable responders to diagnose complex failures rapidly and confidently. 
 - Increase overall production resilience and advisor/client experience. 

Required Expertise & Experience

- 10-14+ years of progressive experience in Production Services, SRE, ICC/NOC, or large‐scale operations engineering roles. 
 - Deep expertise in enterprise incident management and ITSM practices. 
 - Advanced, hands‐on experience with Dynatrace (dashboards, alerts, service flows, diagnostics). 
 - Strong troubleshooting capabilities across: 
 - AWS (EC2, ALB/NLB, RDS, IAM, networking, failure modes)
 - Windows & Linux (performance, services, logs, resource analysis)
 - Proven experience operating in high‐severity, high‐stakes incident environments. 
 - Strong documentation and communication skills at technical and executive levels. 
Core Competencies

- Systems thinking across complex, distributed architectures. 
 - Ability to resolve ambiguity and make sound decisions under pressure. 
 - Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward prevention and automation. 
 - Exceptional collaboration and influence across engineering, leadership, and operations teams. 
 - Relentless focus on reliability, clarity, and operational maturity. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Financial Services or highly regulated industry experience. 
 - Experience working closely with SRE or Reliability Engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with automation in incident response or operational workflows. 
 - Experience defining monitoring or operational standards at scale. 

Why This Role Matters

Role

This Senior Engineer role is foundational to LPL's production reliability posture. The decisions, standards, and influence of this position directly shape: 

- Platform stability
 - Incident outcomes
 -

Advisor and investor experience

- Organizational confidence in production operations

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second. 

As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads. 

DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further. 

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers. 

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance

Lead the complete engineering and maintenance function for a Drug Product (DP) manufacturing site operating within a Vaccine MFG /CDMO environment, ensuring reliable, compliant, and cost-effective operation of all process areas and utilities. The role owns asset reliability, GMP engineering compliance, expansion project delivery, and the development of a large multi-disciplinary engineering team, with the mandate to build a world-class maintenance culture that consistently meets client, quality, and regulatory expectations.

- Establish and drive a world-class maintenance system built on preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), TPM, and a mature CMMS. 
 - Improve equipment reliability, OEE, and MTBF/MTTR; minimize unplanned downtime and breakdowns.

data.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. 

About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. 

  

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. 

Position Overview

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience to serve as a technical anchor, system architect, and engineering catalyst for our core platform. In this high-impact role, you will define macro-architectural strategy, author and pitch technical visions to cross-functional leaders, and anchor engineering teams in executing scalable, highly secure microservices. You will blend deep hands-on expertise in . NET, Go, and PAM solutions with strategic leadership in AI-driven development and modern release engineering. 

Architectural Leadership & Executive Pitching: 

- 
Architectural Ownership: Own the end-to-end technical vision and architectural decisions for high-throughput, highly available microservices and multi-platform solutions. 

- 
Technical Anchoring: Serve as the primary technical anchor across multiple engineering squads-establishing engineering standards, resolving complex system trade-offs, and mentoring senior engineers. 

- 
Technical Pitches & RFCs: Craft and deliver compelling technical pitches, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and RFCs to convince executive leadership, Product, and Infrastructure partners on strategic platform investments. 

- 
Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate complex business objectives into clear, scalable technical roadmaps while balancing velocity, technical debt, and system stability. 

Core Systems & Security Engineering

- 
Platform Development: Architect and write high-performance production code using C#, . NET (ASP. NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, TypeScript, and gRPC. 

- 
Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise PAM/IDAM architectures (CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault) and SCIM protocol integrations enforcing Zero Trust and Least Privilege principles. 

- 
Multi-Platform Strategy: Collaborate with the cross-functional teams (e. g. , data engineering team) to define data architecture strategy across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) platforms; across environments and similarly collaborative with the infrastructure teams to have better infrastructure strategy in place that targets towards cost-saving on a long-term basis. 

- 
Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.   

Delivery Automation & AI Strategy: 

- 
CI/CD & Quality Rigor: Champion deployment automation across Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK, ensuring comprehensive unit, functional, Playwright E2E, and Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing. 

- 
AI Framework Governance: Pioneer spec-driven AI development by championing the BMAD framework to standardize, govern, and scale AI-assisted coding (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and reusable skill libraries. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 
Experience: 12+ years of progressive software development experience, with a proven track record operating as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Lead Architect in enterprise product environments. 

- 
Architectural Mastery: Demonstrated history of making company-level architectural decisions, pitching complex technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders, and anchoring multi-team initiatives. 

- 
Core Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in C#, . NET (ABP framework), Go, gRPC, TypeScript, and database engineering (PostgreSQL / DocumentDB). 

- 
Security & Infrastructure: Hands-on expertise in Privileged Access Management (PAM), SCIM, AWS/GCP cloud platforms, and Kubernetes. 

- 
Testing & Release: Expertise in continuous delivery pipelines, PSR non-functional testing, and automated E2E testing frameworks (Playwright). 

Where you'll be working/Location: 

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. 

  

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.   

  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed. 

  

Language: 

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.   Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. 

  

Why JumpCloud?   

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You'll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We're out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You'll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to "Build Connections. " To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed. " - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.   Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.     

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

  

Scam Notice: 

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. 

  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud. com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud. com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

 - Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows. 
 - Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance. 
 - Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups. 

Test Planning and Execution

- Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team. 
 - Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions. 
 - Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments. 
 - Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests. 
 - Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early. 
 - Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows. 

API Cloud and Data Validation

- Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries. 
 - Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling. 
 - Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces. 
 - Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers. 
 - Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures. 
 - Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments. 

Networking and Troubleshooting

- Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi. 
 - Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting. 
 - Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump. 
 - Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team. 

Test Automation

- Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios. 
 - Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework. 
 - Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components. 
 - Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope. 
 - Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence. 
 - Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation. 

Defect Management and Team Collaboration

- Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable. 
 - Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions. 
 - Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues. 
 - Track assigned defects through retest and closure and communicate risks or delays promptly. 
 - Maintain test cases, automation and technical notes in the agreed repositories and tools. 

Release and Production Support

- Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned. 
 - Verify critical customer workflows after deployments and provide accurate test status to the QA lead. 
 - Assist with reproducing customer-reported or production issues in controlled environments. 
 - Contribute new regression tests for escaped defects and recurring failure patterns. 

Required Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of software QA or system validation experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing. 
 - Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data. 
 - Programming or test-automation experience using Python. 
 - Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool. 
 - Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports. 
 - Experience using Git and working with CI/CD test execution. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-functional team. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing cloud-managed networking or network management platforms. 
 - Hands-on exposure to access points, switches, routers or Wi-Fi test environments. 
 - Familiarity with AWS services, microservices, Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump and basic packet analysis. 
 - Exposure to mobile application testing, performance testing or API security testing. 
 - Awareness of Wi-Fi 5, Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 concepts. 
 - Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot for test design, automation, debugging or log analysis. 

Company Statement/Values

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live. 

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer / QA Lead with 10-12 years of experience in cloud-based network management solutions to join our engineering team.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in testing cloud-managed networking solutions, with a combination of networking, AWS/cloud, REST APIs, Python automation, TypeScript/Playwright and end-to-end system testing. 

This role requires someone who can understand and validate the complete solution across: 

Network Device → LAN/WAN → Internet → AWS Cloud → Cloud Services/APIs → Database → Web/Mobile Application

The candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across both the networking and cloud/application layers. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Network Management Testing

Test Execution

 - Test networking devices together with cloud services and applications. 
 - Validate APIs, backend services, database state and UI behavior as part of end-to-end workflows.

 - Execute testing across different network configurations and connectivity conditions. 
 - Analyze failures across device, network, cloud and application layers. 

API & Cloud Testing

 - Test AWS-hosted cloud applications and services. 
 - Validate cloud services, microservices and distributed workflows. 
 - Analyze cloud logs, metrics, traces and application telemetry. 
 - Test reliability, availability, scalability and failure/recovery scenarios. 
 - Validate deployments across QA, staging and production environments.

Strong hands-on knowledge of networking is essential.

 - DNS
 - ARP
 - ICMP
 - HTTP/HTTPS
 - TLS/SSL
 - NAT
 - Routing
 - Switching

Experience with Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7 is highly desirable. 

Network Troubleshooting & Diagnostics

Hands-on Experience With Tools Such As

- Wireshark
 - tcpdump
 - ping
 - traceroute
 - iperf
 - nslookup/dig
 - Network packet capture and protocol analysis

Ability To Troubleshoot Issues Across

Device → LAN/WLAN → WAN/Internet → Cloud → API → Backend → Application

The candidate should be able to use packet captures, logs, API traces and cloud telemetry to determine the root cause of complex issues. 

Test Automation

Python

- Strong hands-on experience developing Python-based test automation. 
 - Build automation for APIs, cloud workflows and network management functionality. 
 - Develop reusable test frameworks, libraries and utilities. 
 - Automate device onboarding, configuration, monitoring and management scenarios. 
 - Build regression automation for high-value customer workflows. 
 - Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Analyze automation failures and improve framework reliability. 

TypeScript / Playwright

- Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript for test automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium or equivalent. 
 - Automate cloud-based web applications and network management workflows. 
 - Develop end-to-end UI + API automation. 
 - Build reusable automation components and utilities. 
 - Maintain scalable and reliable regression suites. 

Defect Management & Root Cause Analysis

 - Collaborate with development, cloud, firmware and networking teams. 
 - Perform defect retesting and regression validation. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis for complex issues.

Release & Production Quality

is desirable.

CI/CD & DevOps

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.

data.description:
About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

Lead a team of engineers and technical leads responsible for architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple platforms. This role provides senior-level technical leadership, drives modern engineering practices, oversees secure API integrations, and ensures alignment between technology architecture, business priorities, and user needs. The incumbent champions innovation, software quality, documentation standards, and the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams by setting clear expectations, fostering career growth, and driving accountability for results. 
 - Provide strategic technical leadership and architectural direction for complex, enterprise-scale software and platform solutions. 
 - Drive the design, development, implementation, testing, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, and resilient technology solutions. 
 - Review and approve technical designs, architectural recommendations, and engineering deliverables to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and business objectives. 
 - Partner with business, product, UX, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver technology solutions that enhance user experience and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead resolution of complex technical challenges through root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, and proactive problem prevention. 
 - Establish and maintain engineering best practices, technical standards, governance processes, and software documentation frameworks. 
 - Guide the adoption of modern software engineering methodologies, development tools, automation, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Drive API strategy and integration architecture to support secure and seamless data exchange across enterprise systems and applications. 
 - Ensure solutions comply with information security, privacy, risk, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering continuous learning and technical excellence across the organization. 
 - Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, architecture evolution, and long-term investment planning. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, development efficiency, and platform scalability. 
 - Stay current on emerging technologies, industry trends, AI innovations, and modern software architecture practices. 
 - Support organizational initiatives and perform additional duties as assigned. 

Qualifications & Skills

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred. 
 - Minimum 10 years of software engineering or technology experience with at least 5 years leading engineering teams and managers. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale applications and technology platforms from concept through production. 
 - Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, application engineering, and modern development practices. 
 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript. 
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization, and microservices architecture. 
 - Experience designing and integrating APIs and enterprise-scale software solutions. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills. 
 - Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading multiple engineering teams, technical leaders, or platform organizations. 
 - Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern AI architectures. 
 - Experience building and scaling enterprise AI products, platforms, or developer enablement capabilities. 
 - Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, Responsible AI, security, privacy, and compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with agentic AI, multi-model architectures, and enterprise automation solutions. 
 - Ability to define technology vision, roadmaps, and investment priorities aligned to strategic business outcomes. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Financial services or other highly regulated industry experience. 
 - Experience driving enterprise-wide technology transformation and adoption initiatives. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

Benefits

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life: 

Financial wellness

We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs. 

Physical wellness

We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness. 

Personal wellness

We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life. 

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

data.title: Lead AI Product Engineer
data.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

The role

Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI Product for invoice-to-cash, covering Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Invoice Management and Credit Risk. It runs on a Next. js front end, a FastAPI service layer, the Cogentiq agentic runtime, and a data tier on Azure Databricks with PostgreSQL. 

You own the AI side: the agents, the models and everything that makes them accurate and dependable in front of a finance team. You design it, you lead the team that builds it, and you write code yourself. 

What you will own

- Technical design of the AI side: agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool design, memory and context strategy. 
 - The agents across all five modules, from document extraction and matching through to the reasoning steps behind a recommendation. 
 - Accuracy and reliability. Evaluation sets, regression suites, and a defensible number for how well each agent performs before it ships. 
 - Guardrails and human oversight: confidence thresholds, escalation to a person, audit trails, and traceable reasoning for any decision touching cash. 
 - Predictive and machine learning models where they serve the product better than an agent does. 
 - Model strategy: choice of models, cost and latency per workflow, and the ability to switch providers without a rewrite. 
 - The interfaces between your side and the platform, agreed jointly with the engineering. 

How you will work

- Lead the AI and agent engineering team. Set standards, coach engineers, and keep the team unblocked. 
 - Stay in the code. Take the hardest agents yourself and set the patterns others follow. 
 - Work as a pair with the Engineering Lead. 
 - Work with product management on what an agent can realistically be trusted to do, so external commitments are grounded. 
 - Be able to explain an agent's behaviour to a finance stakeholder who will not accept "the model decided". 

What you must have

- Ten to fourteen years in AI, machine learning or software, with at least three leading a team. 
 - Track record of owning technical design, not only implementing someone else's design. 
 - Production experience with LLM and agentic systems: multi-step workflows, tool use, orchestration frameworks, and the failure modes that only appear at scale. 
 - Real evaluation discipline. Evidence that you have measured agent quality with something more rigorous than manual spot checks. 
 - Strong Python engineering. Your team ships production code, not notebooks. 
 - Document understanding and information extraction experience, ideally on messy real-world inputs such as emails, remittance advices and attachments. 
 - Classical machine learning depth alongside the generative work, and the judgement to know which problem needs which. 
 - Enough understanding of services, data and deployment to build agents that fit the platform and to hold your side of a design argument with the Engineering Lead. 
 - Product track record: AI built for many clients, not one-off delivery for a single engagement. 

Good to have

- Order-to-cash or accounts receivable domain knowledge: collections, cash application, deductions, remittance handling. 
 - Experience with agent observability and tracing tooling. 
 - Experience getting AI through enterprise risk, compliance or model governance review. 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

Domain: Fintech, Lending, or Credit Systems

About The Team / Role

As a Staff SOFTWARE Engineer, you will be the primary architect and execution lead for the transformation of our Digital Credit Application. We are pivoting from a legacy monolith to a high-performance, pluggable API ecosystem. Your mission is to decouple core adjudication logic, enable rapid A/B testing of the customer journey, and lay the technical foundation for future AI-driven chat and automated decisioning experiences. 

This is a high-impact role designed for a true "builder" who thrives on the duality of supporting a live production environment while aggressively migrating mission-critical services to a modern, microservices-based backbone. 

The AI Edge: We are a forward-thinking engineering org. You are expected to be an expert in leveraging AI Software Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Amazon Q, LLM-based code gen and architecture agents) to accelerate migration, write bulletproof tests, and automate documentation. 

How You'll Make An Impact

Architectural Migration & Strategy

- Strangler Fig Migration: Lead the decoupling of core credit application logic out of the legacy monolith and into a scalable, cloud-native Java/Spring Boot microservices environment. 
 - Migration with Zero Downtime: Design and execute high-volume traffic migration strategies from legacy systems to new stacks seamlessly without disrupting live customers. 

Pluggable Adjudication & API Ecosystem

- Modular Architecture: Design and implement a modular adjudication layer allowing the business to swap or update credit rules and third-party data providers without impacting core application flows. 
 - API-First Design: Build and maintain robust, versioned REST/gRPC APIs that support a multi-channel experience (Mobile, Web, and future AI Chat interfaces). 
 - A/B Strategy Enablement: Engineer backend infrastructure for dynamic routing and experimentation, allowing real-time testing of various application flows. 

AI Readiness & Process Acceleration

- AI DLC Mastery: Champion the use of AI tools across the development lifecycle to write code faster, refactor legacy code into modern Java, and generate robust test suites. 
 - Data Science Partnership: Partner with Data Science teams to ensure data pipelines and backend schemas are optimized for LLM integration and real-time credit decisioning models. 

Operational Excellence & Leadership

- Observability & CI/CD: Establish rigorous standards for CI/CD, observability (OpenTelemetry), and automated contract testing. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Provide guidance to mid-level and senior engineers, fostering a culture of high engineering standards, clean code, and AI-assisted productivity. 

Experience You Will Bring

Technical Architecture & Stack

- 10+ Years of Engineering Excellence: Proven track record in backend architecture, specifically within Fintech, Lending, or Credit systems. 
 - Modern Java Stack: Expert-level proficiency in Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3. x, and Spring Cloud. 
 - Monolith-to-Distributed Migration: Significant experience extracting tightly coupled business logic from legacy backends into external, scalable cloud microservices (AWS). 
 - Complex Adjudication & Rules Engines: Experience building or implementing rules engines (e. g. , Drools, Camunda, or custom JSON-logic) for automated decisioning. 
 - Event-Driven Design: Deep experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ for maintaining asynchronous data consistency between the new API layer and legacy systems of record during migration phases. 
 - Contract-First Development: Strict adherence to API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) to ensure seamless collaboration with frontend teams. 

AI & Modern Delivery Tools

- AI DLC Proficiency: Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, etc. ) to optimize workflows, refactor legacy code, and accelerate delivery. 

Leadership & Education

- Strong analytical skills and a proven capability in resolving complex, cross-functional problems. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Platform & Multi-Cloud Development
